Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflight` für Fluggesellschaften aus, die in einer internen Tabelle definiert sind, unter Verwendung von `FOR ALL ENTRIES` in Kombination mit modernen internen Tabellenkonstruktoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #(...)` um die Treibertabelle für `FOR ALL ENTRIES` zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fae_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_id,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
      END OF ty_carrier_id,
      ty_carrier_id_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_ids TYPE ty_carrier_id_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fae_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carrier_ids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT *
      FROM sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrier_ids
      WHERE carrid = @it_carrier_ids-carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fae_with_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_fae_empty_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_fae_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fae_with_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fae_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_db_fae_modern=>ty_carrier_id_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights should be found' act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain LH flights' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain AA flights' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should not contain AZ flights' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AZ' ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fae_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fae_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights expected for empty carrier list' act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fae_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fae_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_db_fae_modern=>ty_carrier_id_tt(
      ( carrid = 'XX' ) " Assuming 'XX' does not exist
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights expected for non-existent carrier' act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ein älteres Konstrukt ist, wird es hier mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxelementen wie Inline-Deklarationen und dem `@`-Zeichen für Hostvariablen verwendet. Es ist immer noch nützlich, wenn die Treibertabelle sehr groß ist und ein `JOIN` zu Performance-Problemen führen könnte, oder wenn die Treibertabelle bereits im ABAP-Speicher vorhanden ist.
keywords: SELECT, FOR ALL ENTRIES, Database, Internal Tables, Host Variables

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Muster zur Konsumierung eines OData-Dienstes (z.B. für Mitarbeiterdaten) unter Verwendung einer Mock-Klasse, die moderne Objekterstellung, Datenzuordnung und Fehlerbehandlung hervorhebt.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Mock-Klasse, die die `CL_HCMFAB_EMPLOYEE_API` simuliert, um die Interaktion zu demonstrieren. Fokus auf JSON-Parsing.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_employee_api.
  TYPES:
    BEGIN OF ty_employee,
      employee_id TYPE string,
      first_name  TYPE string,
      last_name   TYPE string,
      email       TYPE string,
    END OF ty_employee,
    ty_employee_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_all_employees
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE ty_employee_tt
    RAISING
      zcx_api_error. " Custom exception for API errors
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcx_api_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: text TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_api_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    me->text = iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_hcmfab_employee_api DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_employee_api.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_hcmfab_employee_api IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_employee_api~get_all_employees.
    " Simulate an OData JSON response
    DATA(lv_json_response) = `{"d":{"results":[{"EmployeeId":"001","FirstName":"John","LastName":"Doe","Email":"john.doe@example.com"},{"EmployeeId":"002","FirstName":"Jane","LastName":"Smith","Email":"jane.smith@example.com"}]}}`.

    TRY.
        " This part would typically involve more robust JSON deserialization
        " For simplicity, we'll manually map the mock data.
        " In a real scenario, you'd use /UI2/CL_JSON or similar for complex structures.

        " Manual mapping for demonstration
        DATA(ls_employee_john) = VALUE zif_employee_api~ty_employee(
          employee_id = '001'
          first_name  = 'John'
          last_name   = 'Doe'
          email       = 'john.doe@example.com'
        ).
        APPEND ls_employee_john TO rt_employees.

        DATA(ls_employee_jane) = VALUE zif_employee_api~ty_employee(
          employee_id = '002'
          first_name  = 'Jane'
          last_name   = 'Smith'
          email       = 'jane.smith@example.com'
        ).
        APPEND ls_employee_jane TO rt_employees.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_api_error
          EXPORTING
            iv_text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_employees FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_api_error.
    METHODS test_api_error_handling FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_employees.
    DATA(lo_api) = NEW zcl_mock_hcmfab_employee_api( ).
    DATA(lt_employees) = lo_api->zif_employee_api~get_all_employees( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Employee list should not be empty' act = lt_employees ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 employees' act = lines( lt_employees ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check first employee ID' act = lt_employees[ 1 ]-employee_id exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check second employee name' act = lt_employees[ 2 ]-first_name exp = 'Jane' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_api_error_handling.
    " This test demonstrates catching the custom exception.
    " In a real scenario, you'd mock the JSON parser or HTTP client to return an error.
    DATA(lo_api) = NEW zcl_mock_hcmfab_employee_api( ).
    TRY.
        " Simulate an error by providing invalid JSON (not directly possible with current mock)
        " For this mock, we just check if the method is callable without error.
        DATA(lt_employees) = lo_api->zif_employee_api~get_all_employees( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should still get employees in this mock' act = lt_employees ).
      CATCH zcx_api_error INTO DATA(lx_api_error).

        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Es verwendet moderne ABAP-Features wie Interfaces, Custom Exceptions, Inline-Deklarationen und die manuelle JSON-Verarbeitung (in einem realen Szenario würde `CL_ABAP_JSON_PARSER` oder `/UI2/CL_JSON` für komplexere Strukturen verwendet).
keywords: OData, API, Mocking, Object Orientation, JSON, External Services, Interface, Exception

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung unter Verwendung von String-Templates, um Flüge basierend auf variablen Kriterien auszuwählen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `|...|` für String-Templates und `@` für Hostvariablen innerhalb des dynamischen SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_flight_key,
      ty_flight_key_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = ``.

    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = |carrid = '{ iv_carrid }'|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && | AND connid = '{ iv_connid }'|.
      ELSE.
        lv_where_clause = |connid = '{ iv_connid }'|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_where_clause IS INITIAL.
      " No criteria, select all (or handle as error)
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE (lv_where_clause) INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglichen die einfache und lesbare Konstruktion dynamischer Strings, was besonders nützlich für dynamisches SQL ist. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist obligatorisch und verbessert die Sicherheit und Lesbarkeit.
keywords: String Templates, Dynamic SQL, SELECT, WHERE, Host Variables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschafts-ID und die Flugverbindungs-ID aus einer bestehenden `sflight`-Tabelle enthält, unter Verwendung der `FOR`- und `VALUE`-Konstruktoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR <structure> IN <source_table> ( field1 = <structure>-field1 ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_flight_key,
      ty_flight_key_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_flight_keys
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE ty_flight_key_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_flight_keys.
    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_keys FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->extract_flight_keys( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 entries' act = lines( lt_flight_keys ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry carrid' act = lt_flight_keys[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry connid' act = lt_flight_keys[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->extract_flight_keys( VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected empty table for empty input' act = lt_flight_keys ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR` und `VALUE` ist ein leistungsstarkes Konstrukt, um interne Tabellen auf moderne und deklarative Weise zu transformieren oder zu füllen. Es ersetzt explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen und `APPEND`-Befehle, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Constructor Expressions, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze aller Flüge in einer `sflight`-Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Konstruktors.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR <structure> IN <source_table> NEXT sum = sum + <structure>-seatsocc )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 75 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( lt_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected total seats 225' act = lv_total exp = 225 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 0 for empty table' act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, die den Code kompakter und oft performanter macht als traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflight`-Einträgen, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestauslastung einzuschließen, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Konstruktors.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( <source_table> WHERE <condition> )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE sflight_tt
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_occ TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc >= iv_min_occ ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Filtering, Declarative

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('On Time', 'Delayed', 'Cancelled') basierend auf der Abflugzeit und einem Statuscode unter Verwendung von `COND` und `SWITCH`-Ausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND type( WHEN condition THEN value ELSE other_value )` und `SWITCH type( value WHEN case1 THEN result1 ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_scheduled_dep_time TYPE tims
        iv_actual_dep_time    TYPE tims
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_flight_status_switch
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_cond.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_actual_dep_time > iv_scheduled_dep_time THEN 'Delayed'
      WHEN iv_actual_dep_time < iv_scheduled_dep_time THEN 'Early'
      ELSE 'On Time'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_status_switch.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string( iv_status_code
      WHEN 'A' THEN 'Active'
      WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'
      WHEN 'D' THEN 'Departed'
      WHEN 'L' THEN 'Landed'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cond_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_switch_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cond_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch_flight_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'On Time' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_cond( iv_scheduled_dep_time = '100000' iv_actual_dep_time = '100000' ) exp = 'On Time' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Delayed' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_cond( iv_scheduled_dep_time = '100000' iv_actual_dep_time = '101500' ) exp = 'Delayed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Early' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_cond( iv_scheduled_dep_time = '100000' iv_actual_dep_time = '094500' ) exp = 'Early' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_switch_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch_flight_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Active' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_switch( 'A' ) exp = 'Active' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Cancelled' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_switch( 'C' ) exp = 'Cancelled' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Unknown' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_switch( 'X' ) exp = 'Unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COND` und `SWITCH` sind funktionale Ausdrücke, die es ermöglichen, bedingte Logik direkt in Zuweisungen oder Methodenparametern zu verwenden. Dies macht den Code wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen, insbesondere wenn ein Wert basierend auf Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll.
keywords: COND, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Functional Expressions

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf ein Feld aus einer internen Tabelle zu, die mit einem Tabellenausdruck indiziert ist, und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht existiert, mithilfe von `OPTIONAL`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lt_table[ key = value ]-field OPTIONAL`. Überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach dem Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_city,
        cityto TYPE s_city,
      END OF ty_flight_info,
      ty_flight_info_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_city_from
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info_tt
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid      TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_city) TYPE s_city.

    METHODS get_city_to_optional
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info_tt
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid      TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_city) TYPE s_city.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_from.
    " Access without OPTIONAL - will cause dump if entry not found
    TRY.
        rv_city = it_flight_info[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-cityfrom.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle error, e.g., return initial value or raise custom exception
        rv_city = 'NOT_FOUND'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_city_to_optional.
    " Access with OPTIONAL - sets sy-subrc if entry not found
    rv_city = it_flight_info[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-cityto OPTIONAL.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_city = 'NOT_FOUND_OPT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) für einen flüssigen API-Stil in einer einfachen Klasse.
hint: Methoden, die verkettet werden sollen, müssen eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_method_chaining.

    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_method_chaining.

    METHODS get_sum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_oo_method_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 20 )->get_sum( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected sum 30' act = lv_result exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies führt zu einem flüssigeren, lesbareren Code, der oft als "Fluent API" bezeichnet wird. Es wird erreicht, indem jede verkettbare Methode eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent API

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme (`zcx_division_by_zero`) auslöst, die vom Aufrufer abgefangen wird.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: text TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    me->text = iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          iv_text = 'Division by zero is not allowed!'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected result 5' act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_division( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected zcx_division_by_zero exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_div_zero).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check exception text' act = lx_div_zero->text exp = 'Division by zero is not allowed!' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP basiert auf Ausnahmen (Exceptions). Durch das Definieren eigener Ausnahmeklassen, die von `cx_static_check` erben, können spezifische Fehlerzustände klar kommuniziert werden. `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` löst die Ausnahme aus, und `TRY...CATCH` ermöglicht es dem aufrufenden Code, diese Fehler elegant zu behandeln, anstatt einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen.
keywords: Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY CATCH, Custom Exception

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen, um beispielsweise die Anzahl der Flüge pro Verbindung zu ermitteln, unter Verwendung von `LOOP AT GROUP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_member) GROUP BY ( key_field1 = group_member-field1 ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_loop_at_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_count,
      ty_flight_count_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_route
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_loop_at_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_route.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_flight_count) = VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid = ls_group_key-connid
        flight_count = lines( GROUP ls_flight )
      ).
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_loop_at_group( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_route( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 groups' act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    DATA(ls_lh_0400) = lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH 0400 count' act = ls_lh_0400-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    DATA(ls_aa_0017) = lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0017 count' act = ls_aa_0017-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_loop_at_group( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_route( VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected empty table for empty input' act = lt_flight_counts ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT GROUP` ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Konstrukt in ABAP 7.50+, das die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht. Es ermöglicht die direkte Verarbeitung von Gruppen und deren Mitgliedern, ohne dass manuelle Sortierungen oder zusätzliche Schleifen erforderlich sind. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code für Gruppierungsaufgaben.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `AVG()` und `GROUP BY` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_avg_seats,
        carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
        avg_seats TYPE f,
      END OF ty_avg_seats,
      ty_avg_seats_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_seats) TYPE ty_avg_seats_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_seats_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( seatsocc ) AS avg_seats
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_avg_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_seats) = lo_cut->get_avg_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lt_avg_seats ).
    " Assuming 'LH' exists and has some average seats
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain LH' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_avg_seats[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) ) ).
    DATA(ls_lh_avg) = lt_avg_seats[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average seats for LH should be positive' act = xsdbool( ls_lh_avg-avg_seats > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung mit Aggregatfunktionen wie `AVG()` ist die effizienteste Methode, um Daten auf Datenbankebene zu aggregieren. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_data)` ist eine moderne Syntax, die die Deklaration der Zieltabelle vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, Aggregation, Database, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle mit einem expliziten Schlüssel, der aus mehreren Komponenten besteht, unter Verwendung der modernen `READ TABLE` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE itab WITH KEY comp1 = val1 comp2 = val2 ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_read_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_detail,
      ty_flight_detail_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flight_detail_tt
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate  TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_read_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    READ TABLE it_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                                 connid = iv_connid
                                 fldate = iv_fldate
                                 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = ls_flight-price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

In modernen ABAP-Versionen wird sie oft mit Inline-Deklarationen (`INTO DATA(ls_flight)`) kombiniert, um den Code kompakter und lesbarer zu machen. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen numerischen Wert in einen String und umgekehrt, unter Verwendung des `CONV`-Konstruktors.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV type( value )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_type_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS int_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS string_to_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_type_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD int_to_string.
    rv_string = CONV string( iv_number ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD string_to_int.
    " CONV handles basic numeric strings, but for robust conversion,
    " consider CL_ABAP_CONV_CODEPAGE or similar for error handling.
    " For this example, we assume valid numeric string.
    rv_number = CONV i( iv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Dynpro (z.B. 9000) und betten Sie einen `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` in einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` ein. Zeigen Sie einen vordefinierten Text an und ermöglichen Sie die Bearbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` für `cl_gui_custom_container` und `cl_gui_textedit` im PBO des Dynpros. Nutzen Sie `set_text_as_stream` und `get_text_as_stream`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_text_editor.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_text_editor.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. "Muss im Screen Painter definiert sein

      CREATE OBJECT go_editor
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      DATA(lv_text) = `Dies ist ein Beispieltext für den Texteditor.`. "String Template
      go_editor->set_text_as_stream( text = lv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'SAVE'.
        DATA(lv_edited_text) TYPE string.
        go_editor->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_edited_text ).
        MESSAGE `Gespeicherter Text: ` && lv_edited_text TYPE 'I'. "String Concatenation
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Stellen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in einem einfachen Zeitdiagramm dar. Das Diagramm soll in einem `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` auf einem Dynpro angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und `COUNT(*)` für die Datenaggregation. Bereiten Sie die Daten für `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE` vor und nutzen Sie dessen Methoden zur Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flights_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_flight_chart.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_chart.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_chart
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
               carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
               fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
               count  TYPE i,
             END OF ty_flight_data.
      DATA lt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate.

      SELECT carrid, fldate, COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
        GROUP BY carrid, fldate
        ORDER BY carrid, fldate.

      " Daten für das Diagramm aufbereiten
      DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_data-carrid ) ASCENDING
        ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
            series_name = ls_data-carrid
            data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
              FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_data
              ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
                  x_value = ls_point-fldate
                  y_value = ls_point-count
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      go_chart->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
      go_chart->set_title( 'Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
      go_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Datum' ).
      go_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
      go_chart->draw_chart( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Integrieren Sie ein `CL_GUI_ALV_GRID` in einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` auf einem Dynpro und zeigen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` an. Implementieren Sie eine einfache Feldkatalog-Erstellung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_alv_grid` und `cl_salv_table=>factory` oder manuelle Feldkatalog-Erstellung. `set_table_for_first_display` ist entscheidend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_alv_grid_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_alv_grid.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
                gt_sflights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_grid_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_grid.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_alv_grid
        EXPORTING
          i_parent = go_container.

      SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @gt_sflights.

      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        FOR comp IN cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( gt_sflights )->get_components( )
        ( fieldname = comp-name
          coltext   = comp-name " Vereinfacht, in Realität aus DDIC lesen
          outputlen = 10 )
      ).

      go_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = gt_sflights
          it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Visualisieren Sie die durchschnittliche Belegung (OCCUPMAX / SEATSMAX) von Flügen pro Monat aus `SFLIGHTS` in einem `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE`.
hint: Aggregieren Sie die Daten nach Monat und berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_occupancy_chart.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_occupancy_chart.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_chart
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_occupancy,
               month_key TYPE string,
               occupancy TYPE f,
               count     TYPE i,
             END OF ty_monthly_occupancy.
      DATA lt_monthly_occupancy TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_monthly_occupancy WITH UNIQUE KEY month_key.

      SELECT fldate, seatsmax, occupmax
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

      " Aggregation der Daten nach Monat
      lt_monthly_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_data
                                      LET lv_month_key = ls_flight-fldate(6) IN
                                      ( month_key = lv_month_key
                                        occupancy = COND f( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_flight-occupmax / ls_flight-seatsmax ) ELSE 0 ) " Vermeidung Division durch Null
                                        count     = 1 ) ).

      DATA(lt_aggregated_occupancy) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_month IN lt_monthly_occupancy GROUP BY ( month_key = ls_month-month_key ) ASCENDING
        ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
            series_name = ls_month-month_key
            data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
              ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
                  x_value = CONV d( ls_month-month_key && '01' ) " Erster Tag des Monats
                  y_value = REDUCE f( INIT avg_occ = 0.0
                                      FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_month
                                      NEXT avg_occ = avg_occ + ls_point-occupancy ) / lines( GROUP ls_month ) " Durchschnitt berechnen
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      go_chart->set_chart_data( lt_aggregated_occupancy ).
      go_chart->set_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugbelegung pro Monat' ).
      go_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Monat' ).
      go_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Belegung (%)' ).
      go_chart->draw_chart( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch mehrere `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` auf einem Dynpro und betten Sie in jeden Container einen `CL_GUI_LABEL` mit einem eindeutigen Text ein. Die Anzahl der Container soll variabel sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife, um Container und Labels zu instanziieren. Achten Sie auf eindeutige Namen für die Container im Dynpro-Layout.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_gui_containers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_dynamic_containers IMPORTING iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 3.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_container_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
             label     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_label,
           END OF ty_container_info.
    CLASS-DATA: gt_containers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_container_info.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_gui_containers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_containers.
    " Initialisiere gt_containers mit den Namen der Container, die im Dynpro-Layout existieren
    " Für dieses Beispiel nehmen wir an, dass im Dynpro 9000 Felder wie 'CONTAINER_1', 'CONTAINER_2' etc. existieren.
    CLEAR gt_containers.
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( name = |CONTAINER_{ sy-index }| ) TO gt_containers.
    ENDDO.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    LOOP AT gt_containers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_container>).
      IF <fs_container>-container IS INITIAL.
        CREATE OBJECT <fs_container>-container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = <fs_container>-name.

        CREATE OBJECT <fs_container>-label
          EXPORTING
            parent = <fs_container>-container.

        <fs_container>-label->set_text( |Label für { <fs_container>-name }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Stellen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Monat und Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHTS` in einem `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE` dar, wobei jede Fluggesellschaft eine eigene Serie im Diagramm bildet.
hint: Gruppieren Sie die Daten nach Fluggesellschaft und Monat. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` um die Daten für jede Serie aufzubereiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flights_multi_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_multi_series_chart.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_multi_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_multi_series_chart.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_chart
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
               carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
               fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
               month  TYPE string,
               count  TYPE i,
             END OF ty_flight_count.
      DATA lt_flight_counts TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid month.

      SELECT carrid, fldate, COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
        GROUP BY carrid, fldate
        ORDER BY carrid, fldate.

      " Daten nach Fluggesellschaft und Monat aggregieren
      DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
        ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
            series_name = ls_flight-carrid
            data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
              FOR GROUPS OF ls_month IN GROUP ls_flight GROUP BY ( month = ls_month-fldate(6) ) ASCENDING
              ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
                  x_value = CONV d( ls_month-fldate(6) && '01' ) " Erster Tag des Monats
                  y_value = REDUCE i( INIT total_count = 0
                                      FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_month
                                      NEXT total_count = total_count + ls_point-count ) " Summe der Flüge pro Monat
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      go_chart->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
      go_chart->set_title( 'Flüge pro Monat und Fluggesellschaft' ).
      go_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Monat' ).
      go_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
      go_chart->draw_chart( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_flight_data,

             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_raw_flight_data.
    DATA lt_raw_data_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_flight_data.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20230101' count = 2 ) INTO TABLE lt_raw_data_mock.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20230115' count = 1 ) INTO TABLE lt_raw_data_mock.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20230105' count = 3 ) INTO TABLE lt_raw_data_mock.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20230201' count = 4 ) INTO TABLE lt_raw_data_mock.

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_data_mock GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
          series_name = ls_flight-carrid
          data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
            FOR GROUPS OF ls_month IN GROUP ls_flight GROUP BY ( month = ls_month-fldate(6) ) ASCENDING
            ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
                x_value = CONV d( ls_month-fldate(6) && '01' ) " Erster Tag des Monats
                y_value = REDUCE i( INIT total_count = 0
                                    FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_month
                                    NEXT total_count = total_count + ls_point-count ) " Summe der Flüge pro Monat
              )
            )
          )
        )
      ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_chart_data ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'AA' act = lt_chart_data[1]-series_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_chart_data[1]-data_points ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 3 act = lt_chart_data[1]-data_points[1]-y_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 4 act = lt_chart_data[1]-data_points[2]-y_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'LH' act = lt_chart_data[2]-series_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 1 act = lines( lt_chart_data[2]-data_points ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 3 act = lt_chart_data[2]-data_points[1]-y_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Datenaggregation verwendet verschachtelte `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdrücke und `REDUCE`, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Monat für jede Fluggesellschaft zu summieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Zeitdiagramm mit `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE`, das die Entwicklung der durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft über die Jahre aus `SFLIGHTS` darstellt.
hint: Extrahieren Sie das Jahr aus dem Flugdatum. Aggregieren Sie die Daten nach Fluggesellschaft und Jahr, um den Durchschnittspreis zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_avg_price_yearly DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_avg_price_chart.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_price_yearly IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_avg_price_chart.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_chart
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_yearly_price,
               carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
               year   TYPE string,
               price  TYPE sflight-price,
               count  TYPE i,
             END OF ty_yearly_price.
      DATA lt_yearly_prices TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_yearly_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid year.

      SELECT carrid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

      " Aggregation der Daten nach Fluggesellschaft und Jahr
      DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
        ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
            series_name = ls_flight-carrid
            data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
              FOR GROUPS OF ls_year IN GROUP ls_flight GROUP BY ( year = ls_year-fldate(4) ) ASCENDING
              ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
                  x_value = CONV d( ls_year-fldate(4) && '0101' ) " Erster Tag des Jahres
                  y_value = REDUCE f( INIT total_price = 0.0
                                      FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_year
                                      NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_point-price ) / lines( GROUP ls_year ) " Durchschnitt berechnen
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      go_chart->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
      go_chart->set_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugpreise pro Jahr und Fluggesellschaft' ).
      go_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Jahr' ).
      go_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Durchschnittspreis' ).
      go_chart->draw_chart( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Zeitdiagramm mit `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE`, das die Anzahl der verfügbaren Sitze (`SEATSMAX`) und der belegten Sitze (`OCCUPMAX`) für eine bestimmte Flugverbindung über die Zeit darstellt.
hint: Filtern Sie `SFLIGHTS` nach einer bestimmten Flugverbindung. Erstellen Sie zwei Datenserien für das Diagramm: eine für `SEATSMAX` und eine für `OCCUPMAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_seats_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_seats_chart IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'LH'
                                      iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid DEFAULT '0400'.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                      iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_seats_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_seats_chart.
    " Speichern der Parameter für PBO
    DATA(lv_carrid) = iv_carrid.
    DATA(lv_connid) = iv_connid.
    CALL SCREEN 9000 STARTING AT 10 10 ENDING AT 100 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_chart
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      SELECT fldate, seatsmax, occupmax
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
        ORDER BY fldate
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

      " Daten für 'SEATSMAX' Serie aufbereiten
      DATA(ls_seatsmax_series) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
        series_name = 'Max. Sitze'
        data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
          FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_data
          ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
              x_value = ls_flight-fldate
              y_value = ls_flight-seatsmax
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      " Daten für 'OCCUPMAX' Serie aufbereiten
      DATA(ls_occupmax_series) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
        series_name = 'Belegte Sitze'
        data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
          FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_data
          ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
              x_value = ls_flight-fldate
              y_value = ls_flight-occupmax
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
        ( ls_seatsmax_series )
        ( ls_occupmax_series )
      ).

      go_chart->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
      go_chart->set_title( |Sitzbelegung für Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid }| ).
      go_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Datum' ).
      go_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Anzahl Sitze' ).
      go_chart->draw_chart( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Zeitdiagramm mit `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE`, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Währung (`CURRENCY`) über die Zeit darstellt. Zeigen Sie nur die Top 3 Währungen an.
hint: Aggregieren Sie die Daten nach Währung und Datum. Verwenden Sie `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` oder `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um die Top 3 zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_top_currencies DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_currency_chart.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_top_currencies IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_currency_chart.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_chart
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_count,
               currency TYPE sflight-currency,
               fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
               count    TYPE i,
             END OF ty_currency_count.
      DATA lt_currency_counts TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_currency_count WITH UNIQUE KEY currency fldate.

      SELECT currency, fldate, COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
        GROUP BY currency, fldate
        ORDER BY currency, fldate.

      " Top 3 Währungen ermitteln
      DATA(lt_total_counts) = VALUE ty_currency_count_tt(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( currency = ls_data-currency ) ASCENDING
        ( currency = ls_data-currency
          count    = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0 FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_data NEXT total = total + ls_point-count ) )
      ).
      SORT lt_total_counts BY count DESCENDING.
      DATA(lt_top_currencies) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_top IN lt_total_counts UP TO 3 ROWS ( ls_top-currency ) ).

      " Daten für das Diagramm aufbereiten, nur für Top 3 Währungen
      DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( currency = ls_flight-currency ) ASCENDING
        WHERE ( currency IS IN lt_top_currencies )
        ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
            series_name = ls_flight-currency
            data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
              FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_flight
              ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
                  x_value = ls_point-fldate
                  y_value = ls_point-count
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      go_chart->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
      go_chart->set_title( 'Anzahl Flüge pro Währung (Top 3)' ).
      go_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Datum' ).
      go_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
      go_chart->draw_chart( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `WHERE` für die Filterung und `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation. Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` für die Datenaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_filtered_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_filtered_chart IMPORTING iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax DEFAULT 150.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo IMPORTING iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_filtered_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_chart.
    DATA(lv_min_seats) = iv_min_seats.
    CALL SCREEN 9000 STARTING AT 10 10 ENDING AT 100 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_chart
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_flight_count,
               carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
               fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
               month  TYPE string,
               count  TYPE i,
             END OF ty_monthly_flight_count.
      DATA lt_monthly_flight_counts TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_monthly_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid month.

      SELECT carrid, fldate, COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM sflights
        WHERE seatsmax >= @iv_min_seats
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
        GROUP BY carrid, fldate
        ORDER BY carrid, fldate.

      " Daten für das Diagramm aufbereiten
      DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
        ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
            series_name = ls_flight-carrid
            data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
              FOR GROUPS OF ls_month IN GROUP ls_flight GROUP BY ( month = ls_month-fldate(6) ) ASCENDING
              ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_data_point(
                  x_value = CONV d( ls_month-fldate(6) && '01' ) " Erster Tag des Monats
                  y_value = REDUCE i( INIT total_count = 0
                                      FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_month
                                      NEXT total_count = total_count + ls_point-count ) " Summe der Flüge pro Monat
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      go_chart->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
      go_chart->set_title( |Flüge pro Monat (Sitze >= { iv_min_seats })| ).
      go_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Monat' ).
      go_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
      go_chart->draw_chart( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gui_progress_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_progress_indicator.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_progress  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_progress_indicator.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_progress_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_progress_indicator.
    CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_progress
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      DO 100 TIMES.
        DATA(lv_percentage) = sy-index.
        go_progress->set_progress_indicator(
          percentage = lv_percentage
          text       = |Verarbeite Daten: { lv_percentage }% abgeschlossen|
        ).
        WAIT UP TO '0.01' SECONDS.
        CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
      ENDDO.
      MESSAGE 'Verarbeitung abgeschlossen!' TYPE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Zeitdiagramm mit `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE`, das die kumulierte Anzahl der Flüge pro Monat für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft darstellt.
hint: Aggregieren Sie die Daten nach Monat und berechnen Sie die kumulierte Summe mit `REDUCE` und `ACCUMULATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_cumulative_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS display_cumulative_chart IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'AA'.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.

    CLASS-METHODS: handle_pbo IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
                   handle_pai IMPORTING iv_ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_cumulative_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_cumulative_chart.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = iv_carrid.
    CALL SCREEN 9000 STARTING AT 10 10 ENDING AT 100 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_chart
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_count,
               fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
               month  TYPE string,
               count  TYPE i,
             END OF ty_monthly_count.
      DATA lt_monthly_counts TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_monthly_count WITH UNIQUE KEY month.

      SELECT fldate, COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
        GROUP BY fldate
        ORDER BY fldate.

      " Aggregation nach Monat und Berechnung der kumulierten Summe
      DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_chart_data(
        ( VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>s_chart_data(
            series_name = |Kumulierte Flüge für { iv_carrid }|
            data_points = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_point(
              REDUCE ty_monthly_count_tt(
                INIT lt_cumulative_data = VALUE ty_monthly_count_tt(
                ) " Initialisiere mit leerer Tabelle
                     lv_cumulative_count = 0
                FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( month = ls_flight-fldate(6) ) ASCENDING
                NEXT lv_cumulative_count = lv_cumulative_count + REDUCE i( INIT total = 0 FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT total = total + ls_point-count )
                     APPEND VALUE #( x_value = CONV d( ls_flight-fldate(6) && '01' ) y_value = lv_cumulative_count ) TO lt_cumulative_data
              )
            )
          )
        )
      ).

      go_chart->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
      go_chart->set_title( |Kumulierte Flüge für { iv_carrid } pro Monat| ).
      go_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Monat' ).
      go_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Kumulierte Anzahl Flüge' ).
      go_chart->draw_chart( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pai.
    CASE iv_ok_code.
      WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_count_tt,
             x_value TYPE d,
             y_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_monthly_count_tt.
    METHODS test_cumulative_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_calculation.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_raw_flight_data.
    DATA lt_raw_data_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_flight_data.

    INSERT VALUE #( fldate = '20230101' count = 5 ) INTO TABLE lt_raw_data_mock.
    INSERT VALUE #( fldate = '20230115' count = 3 ) INTO TABLE lt_raw_data_mock.
    INSERT VALUE #( fldate = '20230201' count = 2 ) INTO TABLE lt_raw_data_mock.
    INSERT VALUE #( fldate = '20230210' count = 4 ) INTO TABLE lt_raw_data_mock.

    DATA(lt_cumulative_points) = REDUCE ty_monthly_count_tt(
      INIT lt_cumulative_data = VALUE ty_monthly_count_tt(
      )
           lv_cumulative_count = 0
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_data_mock GROUP BY ( month = ls_flight-fldate(6) ) ASCENDING
      NEXT lv_cumulative_count = lv_cumulative_count + REDUCE i( INIT total = 0 FOR ls_point IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT total = total + ls_point-count )
           APPEND VALUE #( x_value = CONV d( ls_flight-fldate(6) && '01' ) y_value = lv_cumulative_count ) TO lt_cumulative_data
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_cumulative_points ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '20230101' act = lt_cumulative_points[1]-x_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 8 act = lt_cumulative_points[1]-y_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '20230201' act = lt_cumulative_points[2]-x_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 14 act = lt_cumulative_points[2]-y_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Berechnung und Visualisierung kumulierter Daten in einem `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE`. Es verwendet den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `INIT`-Klausel, die sowohl eine interne Tabelle als auch eine kumulative Zählvariable initialisiert. Innerhalb der `FOR GROUPS OF`-Schleife wird die kumulierte Summe berechnet und die Datenpunkte dynamisch zur internen Tabelle hinzugefügt. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes und sehr effizientes Muster für kumulative Berechnungen in modernem ABAP.
keywords: Chart, Data Visualization, SFLIGHTS, Cumulative, Aggregation, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, INIT, APPEND

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE type( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR num IN it_numbers
                       NEXT sum = sum + num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. sflights) nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung von VALUE und FILTER.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FILTER lt_sflights_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_no_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( 'XX' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_for_groups_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_groups_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE tt_carrier_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_all GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        count  = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_groups_count( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_count-count ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_aa_count-count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: FOR GROUPS ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen, was die Komplexität von manuellen Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen reduziert.
keywords: VALUE, FOR GROUPS, Grouping, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einem COND-Ausdruck, um einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zuzuweisen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_value_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_status_text

        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = VALUE string(
      COND #( WHEN iv_status = 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
