Instructions: Definieren Sie ein einfaches Interface mit einer Methode und implementieren Sie es in einer Klasse. Rufen Sie die Methode über eine Interface-Referenz auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` für die Definition und `INTERFACES` in der Klasse zur Implementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculator.
  METHODS add
    IMPORTING
      iv_num1 TYPE i
      iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculator~add.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add.
    DATA: lo_calculator TYPE REF TO zif_calculator,
          lv_result     TYPE i.

    lo_calculator = NEW zcl_simple_calculator( ).
    lv_result = lo_calculator->add( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 msg = 'Addition should be 8' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Definition und Implementierung eines Interfaces. Interfaces ermöglichen Polymorphie und entkoppeln die Implementierung von der Schnittstelle, was die Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit des Codes verbessert. Die Zuweisung einer Instanz der implementierenden Klasse an eine Interface-Referenz ist ein Kernkonzept der Objektorientierung.
keywords: INTERFACE, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Class

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine Standardimplementierung besitzt. Implementieren Sie das Interface in zwei Klassen, wobei eine die Standardimplementierung nutzt und die andere sie überschreibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DEFAULT` bei der Methodendefinition im Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_text TYPE string
    DEFAULT VIA zcl_default_logger.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_default_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_default_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message.
    " Standardimplementierung: Ausgabe auf Konsole
    WRITE: / 'Default Log:', iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  " Nutzt die Standardimplementierung des Interfaces
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " Überschreibt die Standardimplementierung
    WRITE: / 'File Log:', iv_text, '(written to file system - simulated)' .
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_log FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_override_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_log.
    DATA: lo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.

    lo_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " Erwartet, dass die Standardimplementierung aufgerufen wird (simuliert durch WRITE)
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Testnachricht (Default)' ).
    " Keine direkte Assertions für WRITE, da es nur Ausgabe ist. Fokus liegt auf Kompilierbarkeit und Aufruf.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' msg = 'Check console output for default log' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_override_log.
    DATA: lo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.

    lo_logger = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
    " Erwartet, dass die überschriebene Implementierung aufgerufen wird (simuliert durch WRITE)
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Testnachricht (Override)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' msg = 'Check console output for overridden log' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50 führte Standardimplementierungen für Interface-Methoden ein. Dies ermöglicht es, Interfaces zu erweitern, ohne alle implementierenden Klassen sofort anpassen zu müssen. Klassen können die Standardimplementierung entweder übernehmen oder überschreiben, was die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit von OO-Designs erheblich verbessert.
keywords: INTERFACE, DEFAULT, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.50, Default Methods

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Aliase, um auf eine Interface-Methode in einer implementierenden Klasse mit einem kürzeren oder sprechenderen Namen zuzugreifen.
hint: Der `ALIASES` Befehl in der `PUBLIC SECTION` der Klasse ist hier nützlich.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_processor.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      it_data TYPE string_table
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_processor.
    ALIASES handle_data FOR zif_data_processor~process_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_processor~process_data.
    rv_processed_count = lines( it_data ).
    " In einer realen Anwendung würde hier die Datenverarbeitung stattfinden
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_alias_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alias_access.
    DATA: lo_handler TYPE REF TO zcl_data_handler,
          lt_input   TYPE string_table,
          lv_count   TYPE i.

    APPEND 'Item 1' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'Item 2' TO lt_input.

    lo_handler = NEW zcl_data_handler( ).
    lv_count = lo_handler->handle_data( it_data = lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Alias method should return 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Aliase ermöglichen es, Interface-Komponenten (Methoden, Attribute, Typen) in einer implementierenden Klasse unter einem anderen Namen anzusprechen. Dies kann die Lesbarkeit verbessern, Namenskollisionen vermeiden oder einfach einen kürzeren, kontextbezogeneren Namen für eine Interface-Methode bereitstellen, wenn sie innerhalb der Klasse verwendet wird.
keywords: INTERFACE, ALIASES, Object Orientation, Readability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Anwendungsprotokoll mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und fügen Sie eine Informationsmeldung hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log` und `add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_add_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_add_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = iv_text ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( lo_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_log.
    DATA: lo_logger    TYPE REF TO zcl_bal_logger,
          lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh,
          lt_messages  TYPE bal_t_msg.

    lo_logger = NEW zcl_bal_logger( ).
    lv_log_handle = lo_logger->create_and_add_log( 'Erste Testnachricht' ).

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_messages( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = lv_log_handle IMPORTING et_messages = lt_messages ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_messages msg = 'Log should contain messages' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 msg = 'Log should contain exactly one message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Erste Testnachricht' msg = 'Message content mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_s_aut_bal_log` ist eine Hilfsklasse für das Application Log (BAL), die oft in Testumgebungen verwendet wird. Sie demonstriert das grundlegende Vorgehen: Log erstellen, Meldungen hinzufügen und speichern. Dies ist ein moderner Weg, um anwendungsbezogene Meldungen zentral zu verwalten und zu persistieren, anstatt sie direkt auf dem Bildschirm auszugeben.
keywords: cl_s_aut_bal_log, Application Log, BAL, Error Handling, Message

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem Anwendungsprotokoll eine Fehlermeldung mit variablen Platzhaltern hinzu und lesen Sie diese anschließend aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Parameter `iv_msgv1` bis `iv_msgv4` der Methode `add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_detail_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS log_error_with_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_param1 TYPE string
        iv_param2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_detail_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_error_with_details.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E'
                         iv_msgid = 'ZMSG'
                         iv_msgno = '002'
                         iv_msgv1 = iv_param1
                         iv_msgv2 = iv_param2 ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( lo_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_detailed_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_detailed_log.
    DATA: lo_logger     TYPE REF TO zcl_bal_detail_logger,
          lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh,
          lt_messages   TYPE bal_t_msg,
          ls_message    TYPE bal_s_msg.

    lo_logger = NEW zcl_bal_detail_logger( ).
    lv_log_handle = lo_logger->log_error_with_details( iv_param1 = 'Wert A' iv_param2 = 'Wert B' ).

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_messages( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = lv_log_handle IMPORTING et_messages = lt_messages ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_messages msg = 'Log should contain messages' ).
    READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 1 INTO ls_message.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgty exp = 'E' msg = 'Message type should be Error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgv1 exp = 'Wert A' msg = 'Message variable 1 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgv2 exp = 'Wert B' msg = 'Message variable 2 mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Das Hinzufügen von Meldungen mit variablen Platzhaltern (`MSGV1` bis `MSGV4`) ist entscheidend für aussagekräftige Anwendungsprotokolle. Es ermöglicht, dynamische Informationen in die Meldungstexte einzubetten, was die Fehleranalyse erheblich vereinfacht. Die `cl_s_aut_bal_log` Klasse bietet eine einfache Schnittstelle dafür.
keywords: cl_s_aut_bal_log, Application Log, Error Handling, Message Variables, Detailed Logging

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory Method Pattern unter Verwendung von Interfaces, um verschiedene Arten von 'Produkten' (z.B. Dokumente) zu erzeugen.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für das Produkt und ein Interface für die Fabrik. Nutzen Sie `CLASS-METHODS` für die Factory-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document.
  METHODS get_content
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

INTERFACE zif_document_factory.
  METHODS create_document
    IMPORTING
      iv_type TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zif_document.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_text_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_content.
    rv_content = 'This is a text document.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_content.
    rv_content = 'This is a PDF document.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document_factory.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document_factory~create_document.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'TEXT'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_text_document( ).
      WHEN 'PDF'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_pdf_document( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type, e.g., raise exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_text FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_pdf FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_text.
    DATA: lo_factory  TYPE REF TO zif_document_factory,
          lo_document TYPE REF TO zif_document,
          lv_content  TYPE string.

    lo_factory = NEW zcl_document_factory( ).
    lo_document = lo_factory->create_document( 'TEXT' ).
    lv_content = lo_document->get_content( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_content exp = 'This is a text document.' msg = 'Text document content mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_pdf.
    DATA: lo_factory  TYPE REF TO zif_document_factory,
          lo_document TYPE REF TO zif_document,
          lv_content  TYPE string.

    lo_factory = NEW zcl_document_factory( ).
    lo_document = lo_factory->create_document( 'PDF' ).
    lv_content = lo_document->get_content( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_content exp = 'This is a PDF document.' msg = 'PDF document content mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_invalid.
    DATA: lo_factory TYPE REF TO zif_document_factory,
          lo_document TYPE REF TO zif_document.

    lo_factory = NEW zcl_document_factory( ).
    TRY.
        lo_document = lo_factory->create_document( 'UNKNOWN' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for invalid document type' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught exception for invalid document type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory Method Pattern entkoppelt die Erzeugung von Objekten von der Logik, die sie verwendet. Durch die Verwendung von Interfaces für das Produkt (`zif_document`) und die Fabrik (`zif_document_factory`) wird ein hohes Maß an Flexibilität erreicht. Neue Dokumenttypen können hinzugefügt werden, ohne den Client-Code ändern zu müssen, der die Fabrik nutzt. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Design-Pattern für erweiterbare Architekturen.
keywords: INTERFACE, Factory Pattern, Design Patterns, Object Orientation, Polymorphism

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Dependency Injection, indem Sie eine Abhängigkeit (einen 'Service') über ein Interface in eine 'Client'-Klasse injizieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen Konstruktor für die Injektion der Interface-Referenz.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_service.
  METHODS send_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_recipient TYPE string
      iv_message   TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_email_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_service~send_message.
    WRITE: / 'Sending email to', iv_recipient, 'with message:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sms_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sms_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_service~send_message.
    WRITE: / 'Sending SMS to', iv_recipient, 'with message:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_notification_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_message_service TYPE REF TO zif_message_service.
    METHODS notify_user
      IMPORTING
        iv_user    TYPE string
        iv_content TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_service TYPE REF TO zif_message_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_notification_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_message_service = io_message_service.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD notify_user.
    mo_message_service->send_message( iv_recipient = iv_user iv_message = iv_content ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_email_notification FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sms_notification FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_email_notification.
    DATA: lo_email_service TYPE REF TO zcl_email_service,
          lo_client        TYPE REF TO zcl_notification_client.

    lo_email_service = NEW zcl_email_service( ).
    lo_client = NEW zcl_notification_client( io_message_service = lo_email_service ).

    lo_client->notify_user( iv_user = 'test@example.com' iv_content = 'Hello via Email!' ).
    " Keine direkte Assertion für WRITE, aber der Aufruf sollte erfolgreich sein.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' msg = 'Check console output for email notification' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sms_notification.
    DATA: lo_sms_service TYPE REF TO zcl_sms_service,
          lo_client      TYPE REF TO zcl_notification_client.

    lo_sms_service = NEW zcl_sms_service( ).
    lo_client = NEW zcl_notification_client( io_message_service = lo_sms_service ).

    lo_client->notify_user( iv_user = '+491761234567' iv_content = 'Hello via SMS!' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' msg = 'Check console output for SMS notification' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dependency Injection (DI) ist ein Design-Pattern, das die Abhängigkeiten zwischen Objekten reduziert. Anstatt dass eine Klasse ihre Abhängigkeiten selbst erzeugt, werden diese von außen (z.B. über den Konstruktor) injiziert. Durch die Verwendung von Interfaces (`zif_message_service`) wird die Client-Klasse (`zcl_notification_client`) von der konkreten Implementierung des Service entkoppelt, was die Testbarkeit (durch Mocking) und die Flexibilität des Systems erheblich verbessert.
keywords: INTERFACE, Dependency Injection, Design Patterns, Object Orientation, Testability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll und ordnen Sie Meldungen spezifischen Objekten und Unterobjekten zu, um eine bessere Kategorisierung zu ermöglichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Parameter `iv_object` und `iv_subobject` beim Erstellen des Logs oder beim Hinzufügen von Meldungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_obj_subobj_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_with_object_subobject
      IMPORTING
        iv_object    TYPE bal_object
        iv_subobject TYPE bal_subobj
        iv_message   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_obj_subobj_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_with_object_subobject.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( iv_object = iv_object iv_subobject = iv_subobject ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = iv_message ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( lo_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_object_subobject_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_object_subobject_log.
    DATA: lo_logger     TYPE REF TO zcl_bal_obj_subobj_logger,
          lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh,
          lt_messages   TYPE bal_t_msg,
          ls_message    TYPE bal_s_msg.

    lo_logger = NEW zcl_bal_obj_subobj_logger( ).
    lv_log_handle = lo_logger->log_with_object_subobject( iv_object = 'Z_APP' iv_subobject = 'PROCESS' iv_message = 'Prozess gestartet' ).

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_messages( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = lv_log_handle IMPORTING et_messages = lt_messages ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_messages msg = 'Log should contain messages' ).
    READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 1 INTO ls_message.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-object exp = 'Z_APP' msg = 'Object mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-subobject exp = 'PROCESS' msg = 'Subobject mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgv1 exp = 'Prozess gestartet' msg = 'Message content mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Zuweisung von Objekten und Unterobjekten zu Anwendungsprotokollen ist eine Best Practice, um Meldungen logisch zu gruppieren. Dies erleichtert die Filterung und Analyse großer Mengen von Protokolldaten, insbesondere in komplexen Anwendungen. `cl_s_aut_bal_log` unterstützt diese Kategorisierung direkt bei der Erstellung des Logs.
keywords: cl_s_aut_bal_log, Application Log, Object, Subobject, Categorization, Error Handling

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um eine interne Tabelle von Interface-Referenzen zu verarbeiten und eine Methode auf jeder Referenz aufzurufen, um eine neue Tabelle mit den Ergebnissen zu erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und den Methodenaufruf innerhalb der Expression.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_transformable.
  METHODS transform
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_upper_case_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_transformable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upper_case_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_transformable~transform.
    rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reverse_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_transformable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reverse_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_transformable~transform.
    DATA(lv_reversed) = iv_input.
    REVERSE lv_reversed.
    rv_output = lv_reversed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input_data,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_input_data.
    TYPES tt_input_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_transformed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_with_transformers
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_input_data
        it_transformers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_transformable WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_transformed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_transformers.
    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR <ls_data> IN it_data
                          FOR <lo_transformer> IN it_transformers
                          ( <lo_transformer>->transform( <ls_data>-value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_expression_with_interfaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_expression_with_interfaces.
    DATA: lo_processor      TYPE REF TO zcl_processor,
          lt_input_data     TYPE zcl_processor=>tt_input_data,
          lt_transformers   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_transformable WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_results        TYPE zcl_processor=>tt_transformed_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( value = 'hello' ) TO lt_input_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 'world' ) TO lt_input_data.

    APPEND NEW zcl_upper_case_transformer( ) TO lt_transformers.
    APPEND NEW zcl_reverse_transformer( ) TO lt_transformers.

    lo_processor = NEW zcl_processor( ).
    lt_results = lo_processor->process_with_transformers( it_data = lt_input_data it_transformers = lt_transformers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 4 msg = 'Expected 4 results (2 data * 2 transformers)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'HELLO' msg = 'First result (uppercase) mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'olleh' msg = 'Second result (reverse) mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ] exp = 'WORLD' msg = 'Third result (uppercase) mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 4 ] exp = 'dlrow' msg = 'Fourth result (reverse) mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Leistungsfähigkeit von Interfaces mit modernen `FOR`-Expressions. Es zeigt, wie eine Tabelle von Interface-Referenzen (`it_transformers`) verwendet werden kann, um polymorphe Operationen auf einer Datenmenge (`it_data`) durchzuführen. Die `FOR`-Expression ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung, indem sie die Transformationen direkt in der Zuweisung der Ergebnistabelle ausführt. Dies ist ein sehr effizienter und lesbarer Ansatz für komplexe Datenmanipulationen in modernem ABAP.
keywords: INTERFACE, FOR, Internal Tables, Object Orientation, Functional Programming, Polymorphism, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einem schreibgeschützten Attribut und einem schreibbaren Attribut. Implementieren Sie es in einer Klasse und greifen Sie auf die Attribute zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ-ONLY` für schreibgeschützte Attribute im Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_config_reader.
  INTERFACES zif_config_writer.
  DATA: config_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
  METHODS get_value
    IMPORTING
      iv_key TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

INTERFACE zif_config_writer.
  DATA: config_version TYPE string.
  METHODS set_value
    IMPORTING
      iv_key   TYPE string
      iv_value TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_app_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_config_reader.
    INTERFACES zif_config_writer.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_config_name    TYPE string,
          mv_config_version TYPE string,
          mt_settings       TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_config_name = iv_name.
    zif_config_reader~config_name = mv_config_name.
    zif_config_writer~config_version = '1.0'. " Initialwert
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_config_reader~get_value.
    " Dummy-Implementierung
    rv_value = |Value for { iv_key } from { zif_config_reader~config_name }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_config_writer~set_value.
    " Dummy-Implementierung
    APPEND |{ iv_key } = { iv_value }| TO mt_settings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_interface_attributes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_attributes.
    DATA: lo_config_reader TYPE REF TO zif_config_reader,
          lo_config_writer TYPE REF TO zif_config_writer,
          lv_name          TYPE string,
          lv_version       TYPE string,
          lv_value         TYPE string.

    DATA(lo_app_config) = NEW zcl_app_config( 'MyApp' ).
    lo_config_reader = lo_app_config.
    lo_config_writer = lo_app_config.

    lv_name = lo_config_reader->config_name.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'MyApp' msg = 'Config name should be MyApp' ).

    " Versuch, READ-ONLY Attribut zu schreiben (sollte Syntaxfehler geben, hier nur zur Demonstration)
    " lo_config_reader->config_name = 'NewName'. " -> Syntaxfehler

    lv_version = lo_config_writer->config_version.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_version exp = '1.0' msg = 'Config version should be 1.0' ).

    lo_config_writer->config_version = '1.1'.
    lv_version = lo_config_writer->config_version.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_version exp = '1.1' msg = 'Config version should be 1.1 after update' ).

    lo_config_writer->set_value( iv_key = 'Theme' iv_value = 'Dark' ).
    lv_value = lo_config_reader->get_value( 'Theme' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Value for Theme from MyApp' msg = 'Get value mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50 ermöglicht die Definition von Attributen in Interfaces, die entweder schreibgeschützt (`READ-ONLY`) oder schreibbar sein können. Dies ist nützlich, um den Zugriff auf bestimmte Eigenschaften über die Schnittstelle zu steuern. `READ-ONLY` Attribute können nur im Konstruktor der implementierenden Klasse oder durch andere Methoden der Klasse selbst gesetzt werden, aber nicht von außen über die Interface-Referenz. Dies fördert das Prinzip der Datenkapselung.
keywords: INTERFACE, Attributes, READ-ONLY, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.50, Data Encapsulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll und verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_messages_by_type` um nur Meldungen eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. Fehler) auszulesen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `get_messages_by_type` und geben Sie den gewünschten Meldungstyp an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_filter_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_and_filter_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
    METHODS get_errors
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_errors) TYPE bal_t_msg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_filter_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_and_filter_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Info message' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = 'Warning message' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = 'Error message 1' ).
    lo_log->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '004' iv_msgv1 = 'Error message 2' ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( lo_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_errors.
    rt_errors = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_messages_by_type( iv_log_handle = iv_log_handle iv_msgty = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_error_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_error_messages.
    DATA: lo_logger     TYPE REF TO zcl_bal_filter_logger,
          lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh,
          lt_errors     TYPE bal_t_msg.

    lo_logger = NEW zcl_bal_filter_logger( ).
    lv_log_handle = lo_logger->log_and_filter_messages( ).

    lt_errors = lo_logger->get_errors( lv_log_handle ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 error messages' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'E' msg = 'First message type should be Error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 2 ]-msgty exp = 'E' msg = 'Second message type should be Error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Error message 1' msg = 'First error message content mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_messages_by_type` der Klasse `cl_s_aut_bal_log` ermöglicht das gezielte Auslesen von Meldungen eines bestimmten Typs aus einem Anwendungsprotokoll. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Protokolldaten zu analysieren, da man sich auf relevante Meldungen (z.B. nur Fehler oder Warnungen) konzentrieren kann, ohne das gesamte Log durchsuchen zu müssen. Dies verbessert die Performance und die Übersichtlichkeit bei der Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: cl_s_aut_bal_log, Application Log, Filter Messages, Error Handling, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Verwenden Sie ein Interface, um eine generische Sortierfunktion zu implementieren, die mit verschiedenen Datentypen arbeiten kann, solange diese das Sortier-Interface implementieren.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode zum Vergleichen von zwei Objekten. Nutzen Sie eine generische Sortierklasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_comparable.
  METHODS compare_to
    IMPORTING
      io_other TYPE REF TO zif_comparable
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i. " -1 if self < other, 0 if self = other, 1 if self > other
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sortable_number DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_comparable.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i.
    DATA: value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sortable_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_comparable~compare_to.
    DATA(lo_other_number) = CAST zcl_sortable_number( io_other ).
    IF me->value < lo_other_number->value.
      rv_result = -1.
    ELSEIF me->value = lo_other_number->value.
      rv_result = 0.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS sort_list
      IMPORTING
        it_comparables TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_comparable WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_list) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_comparable WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_list.
    rt_sorted_list = it_comparables.
    SORT rt_sorted_list BY ( zif_comparable~compare_to( rt_sorted_list[ sy-tabix + 1 ] ) ). " Dummy sort, real sort needs custom comparison logic
    " For a real generic sort, you'd implement a custom sort algorithm or use a helper class.
    " ABAP's built-in SORT does not directly support custom comparison methods in this way.
    " This example focuses on the interface usage for comparison.
    " A more realistic approach would involve a custom bubble sort or similar.

    " Simple bubble sort for demonstration of interface usage
    DATA: lv_size TYPE i.
    lv_size = lines( rt_sorted_list ).
    DO lv_size - 1 TIMES.
      DO lv_size - sy-index TIMES.
        DATA(lo_current) = rt_sorted_list[ sy-index ].
        DATA(lo_next) = rt_sorted_list[ sy-index + 1 ].
        IF lo_current->compare_to( lo_next ) = 1.
          SWAP rt_sorted_list[ sy-index ] WITH rt_sorted_list[ sy-index + 1 ].
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_sort FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_sort.
    DATA: lt_unsorted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_comparable WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sorted   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_comparable WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lo_number   TYPE REF TO zcl_sortable_number.

    APPEND NEW zcl_sortable_number( 3 ) TO lt_unsorted.
    APPEND NEW zcl_sortable_number( 1 ) TO lt_unsorted.
    APPEND NEW zcl_sortable_number( 4 ) TO lt_unsorted.
    APPEND NEW zcl_sortable_number( 2 ) TO lt_unsorted.

    lt_sorted = zcl_generic_sorter=>sort_list( lt_unsorted ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = CAST zcl_sortable_number( lt_sorted[ 1 ] )->value exp = 1 msg = 'First element should be 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = CAST zcl_sortable_number( lt_sorted[ 2 ] )->value exp = 2 msg = 'Second element should be 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = CAST zcl_sortable_number( lt_sorted[ 3 ] )->value exp = 3 msg = 'Third element should be 3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = CAST zcl_sortable_number( lt_sorted[ 4 ] )->value exp = 4 msg = 'Fourth element should be 4' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von Interfaces zur Implementierung einer generischen Sortierfunktion. Durch das Interface `zif_comparable` können Objekte unterschiedlicher Typen verglichen werden, solange sie die `compare_to`-Methode implementieren. Die `zcl_generic_sorter` Klasse kann dann eine Liste dieser vergleichbaren Objekte sortieren, ohne deren konkreten Typ kennen zu müssen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Konzept für die Erstellung flexibler und wiederverwendbarer Algorithmen in der Objektorientierung.
keywords: INTERFACE, Generic Programming, Sorting, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Breite und Höhe eines Bildes unter Verwendung einer simulierten `cl_fxs_image_info` Klasse. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Objektinstanziierung und Datenzuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW` für die Objektinstanziierung und `VALUE` für die Strukturzuweisung. Inline-Deklarationen sind hier nützlich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_info_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_data,
             width  TYPE i,
             height TYPE i,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_data.

    METHODS get_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_image_data) TYPE ty_image_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_info_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_info.
    " In a real scenario, cl_fxs_image_info would be used here.
    " We simulate its behavior for demonstration purposes.
    IF iv_image_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Dummy logic: Assume width/height based on xstring length for simplicity.
      " And a fixed MIME type.
      DATA(lv_length) = xstrlen( iv_image_xstring ).
      rs_image_data = VALUE #( 
        width     = lv_length / 1000 + 100 " Example calculation
        height    = lv_length / 500 + 50  " Example calculation
        mime_type = 'image/jpeg'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_info.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Nachrichtenliste mit der simulierten `cf_reca_message_list` Factory und fügen Sie verschiedene Nachrichtentypen hinzu. Prüfen Sie anschließend, ob Fehler vorhanden sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Factory-Methode zur Instanziierung und eine Methode zum Hinzufügen von Nachrichten. Überprüfen Sie den Status mit einer booleschen Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_list_sim.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
           type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " S=Success, I=Info, W=Warning, E=Error, A=Abort
           text TYPE string,
         END OF ty_message.
  TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS add_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_type TYPE c LENGTH 1
      iv_text TYPE string.
  METHODS has_errors
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.
  METHODS get_messages
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_message_list_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  INTERFACES zif_message_list_sim.

  DATA mt_messages TYPE zif_message_list_sim=>tt_messages.

  METHOD zif_message_list_sim~add_message.
    APPEND VALUE #( type = iv_type text = iv_text ) TO mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_list_sim~has_errors.
    rv_has_errors = COND #( WHEN mt_messages IS NOT INITIAL AND line_exists( mt_messages[ type = 'E' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_list_sim~get_messages.
    rt_messages = mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_list_factory_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO zif_message_list_sim.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_list_factory_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_message_list.
    ro_message_list = NEW zcl_message_list_sim( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_messages.
    DATA(lo_msg_list) = zcl_message_list_factory_sim=>create_message_list( ).
    lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_type = 'I' iv_text = 'Information message' ).
    lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_type = 'W' iv_text = 'Warning message' ).
    lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_type = 'E' iv_text = 'Error message' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_msg_list->has_errors( ) ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_msg_list->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 3 ]-type exp = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Implementierung einer Factory-Klasse und eines Interfaces, um eine Nachrichtenliste zu verwalten. Die `COND`-Konstruktorexpression wird in `has_errors` verwendet, um eine boolesche Bedingung kompakt zu prüfen. Inline-Deklarationen und der `NEW`-Operator sind ebenfalls im Einsatz.
keywords: Factory Pattern, Interface, Error Handling, COND, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die nach dem 01.01.2023 stattfinden. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` Konstruktorexpressionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` um die relevanten Flüge zu filtern und `REDUCE` um die Sitze zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_analysis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_lh
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_lh.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND fldate > '20230101' )
      NEXT total = total + flight-seatsocc + flight-seatsfree
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_analysis( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_lh( ).
    " Since sflights data can vary, we'll assert it's greater than 0
    " or a known value if test data is controlled.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_seats >= 0 msg = 'Total seats should be greater than or equal to 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FOR`-Iteration mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um Einträge in einer internen Tabelle zu filtern, und die `REDUCE`-Konstruktorexpression, um einen einzelnen Wert (die Summe der Sitze) aus den gefilterten Einträgen zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_total_occupied_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_seats = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + grouped_flight-seatsocc
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( 
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        total_occupied_seats = lv_total_occupied_seats
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summary should not be empty' act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_sflights_grouping=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-total_occupied_seats >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe können komplexe Aggregationen sehr effizient durchgeführt werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, LOOP, REDUCE, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Bild die Mindestanforderungen an Breite und Höhe erfüllt. Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für die Rückgabe eines Status.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` mit mehreren `WHEN` Bedingungen, um den Status basierend auf Bildabmessungen zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_validation_status TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'O' ##NO_TEXT.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 ok TYPE ty_validation_status VALUE 'O',
                 too_small TYPE ty_validation_status VALUE 'S',
                 invalid_data TYPE ty_validation_status VALUE 'I',
               END OF gc_status.

    METHODS validate_image_size
      IMPORTING
        is_image_info TYPE zcl_image_info_sim=>ty_image_data " Reusing type
        iv_min_width  TYPE i
        iv_min_height TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE ty_validation_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_image_size.
    rv_status = SWITCH ty_validation_status(
      WHEN is_image_info-width = 0 OR is_image_info-height = 0 THEN gc_status-invalid_data
      WHEN is_image_info-width < iv_min_width OR is_image_info-height < iv_min_height THEN gc_status-too_small
      ELSE gc_status-ok
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_validation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_image_validator( ).
    DATA(ls_valid_image) = VALUE zcl_image_info_sim=>ty_image_data( width = 1024 height = 768 mime_type = 'image/png' ).
    DATA(ls_small_image) = VALUE zcl_image_info_sim=>ty_image_data( width = 100 height = 50 mime_type = 'image/jpeg' ).
    DATA(ls_invalid_image) = VALUE zcl_image_info_sim=>ty_image_data( width = 0 height = 0 mime_type = '' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->validate_image_size( ls_valid_image 800 600 ) exp = zcl_image_validator=>gc_status-ok ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->validate_image_size( ls_small_image 200 100 ) exp = zcl_image_validator=>gc_status-too_small ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->validate_image_size( ls_invalid_image 1 1 ) exp = zcl_image_validator=>gc_status-invalid_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SWITCH`-Konstruktorexpression (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Implementierung von bedingter Logik, die auf mehreren Fällen basiert. Sie ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: Conditional Logic, SWITCH, Object Orientation

Instructions: Sammeln Sie Nachrichten während einer Schleife und geben Sie eine zusammenfassende Nachricht zurück, die alle Fehler und Warnungen enthält. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` um Nachrichten zu iterieren und `REDUCE` oder eine Schleife mit String-Templates, um die Zusammenfassung zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_summarizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_summary_message
      IMPORTING
        it_messages TYPE zif_message_list_sim=>tt_messages " Reusing type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_summarizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_summary_message.
    DATA(lv_error_summary) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR msg IN it_messages WHERE ( type = 'E' )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |Fehler: { msg-text }| ELSE |{ s }; { msg-text }| )
    ).

    DATA(lv_warning_summary) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR msg IN it_messages WHERE ( type = 'W' )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |Warnung: { msg-text }| ELSE |{ s }; { msg-text }| )
    ).

    rv_summary = COND string(
      WHEN lv_error_summary IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_warning_summary IS NOT INITIAL THEN |{ lv_error_summary }. { lv_warning_summary }|
      WHEN lv_error_summary IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_error_summary
      WHEN lv_warning_summary IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_warning_summary
      ELSE 'Keine Fehler oder Warnungen.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_summarizer( ).
    DATA(lt_test_messages) = VALUE zif_message_list_sim=>tt_messages(
      ( type = 'I' text = 'Info message' )
      ( type = 'W' text = 'First warning' )
      ( type = 'E' text = 'Critical error' )
      ( type = 'W' text = 'Second warning' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_summary) = lo_cut->get_summary_message( lt_test_messages ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_summary,
      exp = 'Fehler: Critical error. Warnung: First warning; Second warning'
    ).

    DATA(lt_no_errors) = VALUE zif_message_list_sim=>tt_messages(
      ( type = 'I' text = 'Info' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_summary_message( lt_no_errors ) exp = 'Keine Fehler oder Warnungen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `COND` innerhalb von String-Templates, um eine komplexe Zusammenfassung von Nachrichten zu erstellen. Dies zeigt, wie moderne ABAP-Konstruktorexpressionen verwendet werden können, um deklarativen und funktionalen Code für die Datenaggregation und String-Formatierung zu schreiben.
keywords: Error Handling, REDUCE, FOR, COND, String Templates, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer Struktur basierend auf dem Feldnamen setzt. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_datadescr` für RTTI und Feldzugriff mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data     TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value    TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any STRUCTURE,
                   <fs_field>     TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    <fs_field> = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_field.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_data,
            field1 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Value 1',
            field2 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Value 2',
          END OF ls_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_setter( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_field_value( ir_data = REF #( ls_test_data ) iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' iv_value = 'New Value for Field 1' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_test_data-field1 exp = 'New Value for Field 1' ).

        lo_cut->set_field_value( ir_data = REF #( ls_test_data ) iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' iv_value = 'Updated Field 2' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_test_data-field2 exp = 'Updated Field 2' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_field_value( ir_data = REF #( ls_test_data ) iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' iv_value = 'Should fail' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for non-existent field' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception for non-existent field' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert dynamische Programmierung mit RTTI. Es verwendet `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` um zur Laufzeit auf Felder einer Struktur zuzugreifen und deren Werte zu ändern. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, bei denen Feldnamen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen demonstriert (Method Chaining), um eine Reihe von Operationen auf einem Objekt auszuführen.
hint: Jede Methode in der Kette sollte eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME->`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_object.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_object.

    METHODS reset
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_object.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_number.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_number.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reset.
    mv_value = 0.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_chainable_object( ).

    lo_calculator->add( 5 )->multiply( 2 )->add( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->mv_value exp = 20 ).

    lo_calculator->reset( )->add( 100 )->multiply( 0 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze für eine Liste von Flügen. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe der belegten Sitze zu berechnen und teilen Sie diese durch die Anzahl der Flüge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_occ = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + flight-seatsocc
    ).

    IF lines( it_flights ) > 0.
      rv_average = lv_total_seats / lines( it_flights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_avg_seats=>tt_flight_data(
      ( seatsocc = 100 )
      ( seatsocc = 150 )
      ( seatsocc = 50 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '100.00' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_avg_seats=>tt_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_average_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average_empty exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Konstruktorexpression wird hier verwendet, um die Summe der belegten Sitze in einer internen Tabelle effizient zu berechnen. Dies ist eine funktionale und kompakte Methode zur Aggregation von Daten, die den Code lesbarer macht als eine explizite Schleife mit einer Summenvariable.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und fügen Sie die Daten mit dem `VALUE` Operator und einer `FOR`-Schleife hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_spfli    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @lt_sflights-carrid AND connid = @lt_sflights-connid.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET spfli_entry = lt_spfli[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ] IN
      ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
        connid   = flight-connid,
        fldate   = flight-fldate,
        cityfrom = spfli_entry-cityfrom,
        cityto   = spfli_entry-cityto )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht die deklarative und kompakte Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP AT ... APPEND` Konstrukte und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes. Die `LET` Expression hilft, Zwischenergebnisse zu definieren.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, APPEND, Declarative, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Währung und einem Preis über einem Schwellenwert zu erhalten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_prices(
      FOR flight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight WHERE currency = @iv_currency )
      ( flight )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE currency = iv_currency AND price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      FOR flight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier )
      ( flight )
    ).

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere und den durchschnittlichen Preis, unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid          TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
             average_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      FOR flight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, price, currency FROM sflight )
      ( flight )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_passengers) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc
      ).

      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
      ).

      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP group_key ).
      DATA(lv_average_price) = COND sflight-price( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ).

      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid          = group_key->*-carrid
        total_passengers = lv_total_passengers
        average_price   = lv_average_price
      ) TO rt_summary.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_reduce FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_reduce.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summary ).
    IF lines( lt_summary ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_summary) = lt_summary[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_summary-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_summary-total_passengers >= 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_summary-average_price >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL (z.B. 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1') durch und geben Sie den Antworttext zurück. Behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url`, `send` und `receive`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. `sflight`) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbank.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_by_name`, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und Feld-Symbole (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
        it_keys        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_creation
        cx_sy_table_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_line         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Get structure description dynamically
    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_creation EXPORTING text = lx_runtime->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Create table type description dynamically
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    " 4. Create dynamic work area for appending
    CREATE DATA lo_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_line->* TO <ls_line>.

    " 5. Fill table with data (example using sflight)
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF <ls_line>
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_keys
      WHERE carrid = it_keys-carrid AND connid = it_keys-connid.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDSELECT.

    ro_data = lo_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_and_fill FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.
    METHODS test_invalid_struct FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.

  METHOD test_create_and_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA: lt_keys TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>ty_sflight_key_tt.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_keys ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_key>).
    <ls_key>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <ls_key>-connid = '0400'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_keys ASSIGNING <ls_key>.
    <ls_key>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <ls_key>-connid = '0017'.

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT' it_keys = lt_keys ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflight_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_sflight_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' act = <lt_sflight_table> initial = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should contain 2 entries' act = lines( <lt_sflight_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE <lt_sflight_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry CARRIER ID should be LH' act = <ls_sflight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_struct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA: lt_keys TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>ty_sflight_key_tt.
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( iv_struct_name = 'INVALID_STRUCT' it_keys = lt_keys ).

        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Exception should be caught for invalid structure' act = lv_exception_caught exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Daten werden dann dynamisch über Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zugewiesen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine externe URL durch und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort. Setzen Sie den Content-Type-Header korrekt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client`, `request->set_header_field` und `request->set_cdata`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_data,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_data.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url          TYPE string
        is_payload      TYPE ty_post_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_payload TYPE string,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    " Serialize payload to JSON
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = is_payload
        pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
      RECEIVING
        json        = lv_json_payload
    ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_payload ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_post_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_post_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_post_json( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts'.
    DATA(ls_payload) = VALUE zcl_http_post_json=>ty_post_data(
      title  = 'foo'
      body   = 'bar'
      userid = 1
    ).

    DATA(lv_response) = lo_cut->post_json_data( iv_url = lv_url is_payload = ls_payload ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Response should not be initial' act = lv_response initial = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Response should contain expected title' substring = '"title":"foo"' text = lv_response ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Response should contain an ID' substring = '"id":' text = lv_response ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, deren Name und Methodenname zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Übergeben Sie Parameter und empfangen Sie einen Rückgabewert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (lv_class_name)` und `CALL METHOD` mit `(lv_method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object,
          lv_result TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_param> TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        " Dynamische Objekterzeugung
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        " Dynamischer Methodenaufruf
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_param_value " Annahme: Methode hat einen Parameter IV_INPUT
          RECEIVING
            rv_output = lv_result.    " Annahme: Methode hat einen Rückgabewert RV_OUTPUT

        rv_result = lv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_object_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = lx_create_object_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Hilfsklasse für den dynamischen Aufruf
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target_class IMPLEMENTATION.
