Instructions: Lesen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode und die Header-Felder einer HTTP-Antwort aus und geben Sie diese zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `response->get_status_code` und `response->get_header_fields`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_response_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response_info,
             status_code TYPE i,
             status_text TYPE string,
             headers     TYPE string_table,
           END OF ty_http_response_info.

    METHODS get_response_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response_info) TYPE ty_http_response_info
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_response_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_response_info.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string,
          lt_header_fields TYPE tihttpnvp.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response_info-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
    rs_response_info-status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).

    lo_http_client->response->get_header_fields(
      CHANGING
        fields = lt_header_fields
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_header_fields INTO DATA(ls_header).
      APPEND |{ ls_header-name }: { ls_header-value }| TO rs_response_info-headers.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_response_info FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_response_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_response_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'.
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_response_info( lv_url ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Status text should not be initial' act = ls_info-status_text initial = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Headers should not be empty' act = ls_info-headers initial = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Headers should contain Content-Type' substring = 'Content-Type:' text = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = '' FOR h IN ls_info-headers NEXT s = s && h && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) ).

Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Fehlerbehandlung und das Parsen von Metadaten. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` für die String-Konkatenation der Header ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und `CONDENSE` für die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_where_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_selection_param,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_selection_param,
           tt_selection_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_selection_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_and_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        it_params     TYPE tt_selection_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_where_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_and_select.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string VALUE '1 = 1',
          lv_field_name   TYPE string,
          lv_field_value  TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_params INTO DATA(ls_param).
      lv_field_name = ls_param-field_name.
      lv_field_value = ls_param-field_value.

      " Escape single quotes for string values
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '''' IN lv_field_value WITH '''''''.

      lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && | AND { lv_field_name } = '{ lv_field_value }'|.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE rt_data WHERE (lv_where_clause).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING text = lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.

    METHODS test_dynamic_where_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_success.

    APPEND VALUE #( field_name = 'CARRID' field_value = 'LH' ) TO lt_params.
    APPEND VALUE #( field_name = 'CONNID' field_value = '0400' ) TO lt_params.

    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = lo_cut->build_and_select( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT' it_params = lt_params ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_sflight_data initial = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should contain 1 entry' act = lines( lt_sflight_data ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should be LH' act = lt_sflight_data[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_no_params.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_where_builder( ).

    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = lo_cut->build_and_select( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT' it_params = lt_params ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_sflight_data initial = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should contain all entries for SFLIGHT' act = lines( lt_sflight_data ) exp = 100 ). " Assuming SFLIGHT has 100 entries for test
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_where_builder( ).
    DATA: lt_params TYPE zcl_dynamic_where_builder=>tt_selection_params.
    APPEND VALUE #( field_name = 'INVALID_FIELD' field_value = 'X' ) TO lt_params.

    TRY.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Exception should be caught for invalid field' act = lv_exception_caught exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung dynamisch zur Laufzeit konstruiert werden kann. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Suchfunktionen oder Berichte, bei denen die Filterkriterien vom Benutzer definiert werden. Die Verwendung von String-Templates vereinfacht die Erstellung der SQL-Klausel erheblich. Die Initialisierung der WHERE-Klausel mit '1 = 1' ermöglicht eine einfache Verkettung weiterer Bedingungen.
keywords: DYNAMIC, SELECT, WHERE, String Templates, SQL, cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit benutzerdefinierten Headern durch und überprüfen Sie, ob die Header in der Antwort vorhanden sind (falls der Server sie zurückspiegelt).
hint: Verwenden Sie `request->set_header_field` und `response->get_header_fields`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_custom_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_header,
           tt_headers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_with_custom_headers
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
        it_headers  TYPE tt_headers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_response_headers) TYPE tt_headers
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_custom_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_with_custom_headers.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string,
          lt_response_header_fields TYPE tihttpnvp.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy_subrc }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.

    " Set custom request headers
    LOOP AT it_headers INTO DATA(ls_request_header).
      lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
        name  = ls_request_header-name
        value = ls_request_header-value
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    " Get response headers
    lo_http_client->response->get_header_fields(
      CHANGING
        fields = lt_response_header_fields
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_response_header_fields INTO DATA(ls_response_header).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_response_header-name value = ls_response_header-value ) TO rt_response_headers.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_custom_headers FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_custom_headers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_custom_headers( ).
    " Using a service like 'https://httpbin.org/headers' that echoes back request headers
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://httpbin.org/headers'.
    DATA: lt_request_headers TYPE zcl_http_custom_headers=>tt_headers.

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'X-Custom-Header' value = 'MyValue' ) TO lt_request_headers.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'User-Agent' value = 'ABAP-Client' ) TO lt_request_headers.

    DATA(lt_response_headers) = lo_cut->get_with_custom_headers( iv_url = lv_url it_headers = lt_request_headers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Response headers should not be empty' act = lt_response_headers initial = abap_false ).

    DATA(lv_found_custom_header) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_response_headers INTO DATA(ls_header).
      IF ls_header-name = 'X-Custom-Header' AND ls_header-value = 'MyValue'.
        lv_found_custom_header = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Custom header should be found in response' act = lv_found_custom_header exp = abap_true ).

    DATA(lv_found_user_agent) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_response_headers INTO ls_header.
      IF ls_header-name = 'User-Agent' AND ls_header-value = 'ABAP-Client'.
        lv_found_user_agent = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'User-Agent header should be found in response' act = lv_found_user_agent exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie benutzerdefinierte HTTP-Header zu einer Anfrage hinzugefügt und die Header der Antwort ausgelesen werden können. Dies ist wichtig für Authentifizierung, API-Versionierung oder das Übergeben spezifischer Metadaten. Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` und `VALUE #(...)` sind moderne ABAP-Syntaxen.
keywords: HTTP, Headers, Custom Headers, cl_http_client, Request, Response

Instructions: Weisen Sie dynamisch einem Feld-Symbol einen Komponentenwert einer Struktur zu, deren Feldname zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FIELD-SYMBOL>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_field_value = |{ <lv_field> }|.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = lx_assign_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TO <FIELD-SYMBOL>` ist ein Kernstück der dynamischen Programmierung. Es ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Felder, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist unerlässlich für generische Datenverarbeitung oder UI-Frameworks. Die Konvertierung des Feld-Symbols in einen String mittels String-Template (`|{ <lv_field> }|`) ist eine moderne und typsichere Methode.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request an eine URL durch, die SSL/TLS erfordert, und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Kommunikation über HTTPS erfolgt. (Hinweis: ABAP-Systeme sind in der Regel für HTTPS vorkonfiguriert, es geht hier um die Demonstration der URL-Verwendung).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine HTTPS-URL. Die `cl_http_client` Klasse handhabt SSL/TLS automatisch, wenn die URL mit `https://` beginnt und die Systemkonfiguration korrekt ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_https_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_from_https_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_https_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_https_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    " Ensure URL starts with https://
    IF NOT iv_url CS 'https://'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'URL must start with https:// for secure communication.'.
    ENDIF.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1

    ).

    ENDIF.

        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTPS request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTPS response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close( ).

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_inst DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_dynamic_processor.

    METHODS process_class_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_input_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_dynamic_processor.
  METHODS execute
    IMPORTING
      iv_data TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_inst IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_class_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO if_dynamic_processor.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        rv_result = lo_dynamic_object->execute( iv_data = iv_input_data ).

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = |Error creating object of class '{ iv_class_name }': { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = |Error calling method on class '{ iv_class_name }': { lx_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und überprüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode der Antwort. Geben Sie 'Success' zurück, wenn der Statuscode 200 ist, ansonsten 'Error'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `response->get_status_code` und eine `IF`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_http_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_http_status.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).

    IF lv_status_code = 200.
      rv_status_text = 'Success'.
    ELSE.
      rv_status_text = |Error: HTTP Status { lv_status_code }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten und füllen Sie diese mit generischen Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` mit einer dynamisch erstellten Struktur (`cl_abap_structdescr=>create`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, " e.g., 'STRING', 'I', 'D'
           END OF ty_column_def,
           tt_column_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_column_defs TYPE tt_column_defs
        iv_num_rows    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_creation
        cx_sy_table_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_line         TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Build components for dynamic structure
    LOOP AT it_column_defs INTO DATA(ls_col_def).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_col_def-type ).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_col_def-name
        type = lo_type_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic structure description
    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " 3. Create dynamic table type description
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    " 5. Create dynamic work area for appending
    CREATE DATA lo_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_line->* TO <ls_line>.

    " 6. Fill table with generic data
    DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
      LOOP AT it_column_defs INTO ls_col_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_col_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_col_def-type.
            WHEN 'STRING'.
              <lv_field> = |Row { sy-index }, Col { ls_col_def-name }|.
            WHEN 'I'.
              <lv_field> = sy-index * 10 + sy-tabix.
            WHEN 'D'.
              <lv_field> = sy-datum.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Handle other types or leave initial
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDDO.

    ro_data = lo_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und parsen Sie die JSON-Antwort in eine ABAP-Struktur oder interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` für den Request und `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize` für das Parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_response,
             userid TYPE i,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_post_response,
           tt_post_responses TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_post_response WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_parse_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_parsed_data) TYPE ty_post_response
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_parse_json.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string,
          lv_json_response TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).

    " Deserialize JSON response
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json        = lv_json_response
        pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
      CHANGING
        data        = rs_parsed_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_json_parsing_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_json_parsing_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_json_parsing_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_json_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'.
    DATA(ls_parsed_data) = lo_cut->get_and_parse_json( lv_url ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'User ID should be 1' act = ls_parsed_data-userid exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID should be 1' act = ls_parsed_data-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Title should not be initial' act = ls_parsed_data-title initial = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Title should contain expected text' substring = 'sunt aut facere' text = ls_parsed_data-title ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_json_parsing_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_json_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/comments/1'. " This returns a different JSON structure
    DATA(ls_parsed_data) TYPE zcl_http_json_parser=>ty_post_response.
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        ls_parsed_data = lo_cut->get_and_parse_json( lv_url ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.

    " The deserialize method might not raise an exception for structural mismatch, but rather fill with initial values.
    " So we check if the expected fields are initial.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'User ID should be initial due to mismatch' act = ls_parsed_data-userid exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID should be initial due to mismatch' act = ls_parsed_data-id exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert HTTP-Kommunikation mit der Verarbeitung von JSON-Daten. Nach dem Abrufen der JSON-Antwort wird `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize` verwendet, um den JSON-String in eine stark typisierte ABAP-Struktur zu konvertieren. Dies ist eine Standardmethode für die Integration mit REST-APIs, die JSON zurückgeben. Die Option `pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case` hilft bei der Konvertierung von CamelCase-JSON-Keys zu ABAP-Feldnamen.
keywords: HTTP, JSON, Deserialize, REST, cl_http_client, /ui2/cl_json

        VALUE(ro_target_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_creation
        cx_sy_table_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_target_data  TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_target_line  TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_target_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_target_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_target_field> TYPE ANY,
                   <ls_source_line>  TYPE ty_source_data,
                   <lv_source_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Build components for dynamic target structure
    LOOP AT it_target_column_defs INTO DATA(ls_col_def).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_col_def-type ).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_col_def-target_name
        type = lo_type_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic target structure description
    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " 3. Create dynamic target table type description
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal target table
    CREATE DATA lo_target_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_target_data->* TO <lt_target_table>.

    " 5. Create dynamic work area for target table
    CREATE DATA lo_target_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_target_line->* TO <ls_target_line>.

    " 6. Fill target table with mapped data from source table
    LOOP AT it_source_data INTO <ls_source_line>.
      CLEAR <ls_target_line>.
      LOOP AT it_target_column_defs INTO ls_col_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_col_def-target_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_target_line> TO <lv_target_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_col_def-source_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO <lv_source_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_target_field> = <lv_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_target_line> TO <lt_target_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_target_data = lo_target_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP PATCH-Request mit einem JSON-Payload durch, um eine Ressource teilweise zu aktualisieren. Überprüfen Sie den Statuscode der Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client`, `request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_patch )` und `request->set_cdata`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_patch_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_patch_data,
             title TYPE string,
           END OF ty_patch_data.

    METHODS patch_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url          TYPE string
        is_payload      TYPE ty_patch_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_patch_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD patch_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_payload TYPE string,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    " Serialize payload to JSON
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = is_payload
        pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
      RECEIVING
        json        = lv_json_payload
    ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_patch ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_payload ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle, wobei die Spaltenauswahl dynamisch erfolgt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` mit einer dynamisch erstellten Struktur und `SELECT (lv_field_list) FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE <lt_data>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        it_column_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_creation
        cx_sy_table_creation
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_dynamic_columns.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_field_list   TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    " 1. Build components for dynamic structure based on selected columns
    LOOP AT it_column_names INTO DATA(lv_col_name).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'STRING' ). " Default to STRING for simplicity
      " For real-world, you'd query DDIC for actual type of lv_col_name in iv_table_name
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = lv_col_name
        type = lo_type_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
      IF lv_field_list IS INITIAL.
        lv_field_list = lv_col_name.
      ELSE.
        lv_field_list = lv_field_list && `,` && lv_col_name.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_creation EXPORTING text = 'No columns provided for dynamic structure.'.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Create dynamic structure description
    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " 3. Create dynamic table type description
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    " 5. Select data dynamically
    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_field_list) FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING text = lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    ro_data = lo_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Exception should be caught for no columns' act = lv_exception_caught exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->select_dynamic_columns( iv_table_name = 'INVALID_TABLE' it_column_names = lt_columns ).

        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP DELETE-Request an eine externe URL durch, um eine Ressource zu löschen. Überprüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode der Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` und `request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_delete )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_delete_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_resource.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_error_message = |Error creating HTTP client: { sy-subrc }|.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_delete ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lo_http_client->get_last_error(
        IMPORTING
          message = lv_error_message
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle, wobei die `ORDER BY`-Klausel dynamisch über einen Feldnamen und eine Sortierrichtung (ASC/DESC) erfolgt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... ORDER BY (lv_order_by_clause)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_order_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_dynamic_order
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_order_field TYPE string
        iv_direction   TYPE string " 'ASC' or 'DESC'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_order_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_dynamic_order.
    DATA: lv_order_by_clause TYPE string.

    IF iv_order_field IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING text = 'Order field cannot be initial.'.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_direction IS INITIAL OR ( iv_direction <> 'ASC' AND iv_direction <> 'DESC' ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING text = 'Direction must be ASC or DESC.'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_order_by_clause = |{ iv_order_field } { iv_direction }|.

    TRY.
        SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE rt_data ORDER BY (lv_order_by_clause).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING text = lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR <fs_comp> IN lt_components
                             LET lo_type_descr = <fs_comp>-type->get_type_kind( ) IN
                             ( name = <fs_comp>-name
                               type = lo_type_descr ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) mit den Einträgen 'LH' und 'UA' unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` Schleifen oder direkter Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_sflight_key OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_carrid_range.
    IF it_carrids IS INITIAL.
      rt_range = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
                          ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) ).
    ELSE.
      rt_range = VALUE #( FOR <fs_carrid> IN it_carrids
                          ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <fs_carrid>-carrid ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        it_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflight_data.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_sflight_data
                                 WHERE ( it_carrid_range IS NOT INITIAL AND carrid IN it_carrid_range )
                                 AND   ( it_connid_range IS NOT INITIAL AND connid IN it_connid_range ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) und füllen Sie diese mit einigen Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung, sowie `ASSIGN` und `APPEND` für das Füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
        iv_num_rows   TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error,
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " 1. Get structure description of the base table
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ).

    " 2. Create a table type description based on the structure
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                       p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
                       p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                       p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Erstellen der dynamischen Tabelle.|.
    ENDIF.

    " 4. Fill the dynamic table with some dummy data
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-name = 'MANDT'. " Skip client field for dummy data
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      " For simplicity, we'll just fill the first few fields
      IF sy-tabix > 3. " Fill only first 3 non-MANDT fields
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      DATA(lv_field_name) = ls_component-name.
      DATA(lv_field_type) = ls_component-type->get_type_kind( ).

      DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
        CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
        ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO <fs_line>.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE lv_field_type.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
              <fs_field> = |{ lv_field_name } { sy-index }|.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
              <fs_field> = sy-index.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
              <fs_field> = sy-index.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
              <fs_field> = sy-datum + sy-index.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
              <fs_field> = sy-uzeit + sy-index * 100.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Do nothing or handle other types
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
      ENDDO.
      EXIT. " Only fill one field for simplicity in this example
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_fill_data.

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First row CARRID should be filled' act = <fs_line>-carrid exp = 'CARRID 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man RTTI (`cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr`) verwendet, um zur Laufzeit eine interne Tabelle dynamisch zu erstellen und zu füllen. `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` ermöglicht die Erzeugung von Datenobjekten basierend auf dynamisch ermittelten Typbeschreibungen. Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine Range-Tabelle, um in einer `COND` oder `SWITCH` Expression zu prüfen, ob ein Wert in einem bestimmten Bereich liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` mit der `IN RANGE` Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_range_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        it_vip_connids TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_connid IN it_vip_connids THEN 'VIP Flight'
      WHEN iv_connid >= '0001' AND iv_connid <= '0099' THEN 'Short Haul'
      WHEN iv_connid >= '0100' AND iv_connid <= '0999' THEN 'Medium Haul'
      ELSE 'Long Haul'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie dynamisch zwei Strukturen beliebigen Typs Feld für Feld und identifizieren Sie Unterschiede. Geben Sie die Namen der Felder aus, die unterschiedliche Werte haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data`, `get_components` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_diff_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_struct1 TYPE any
        is_struct2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_diff_fields) TYPE tt_diff_fields
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error,
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr1) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_struct1 ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr2) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_struct2 ).

    IF lo_struct_descr1->get_relative_name( ) <> lo_struct_descr2->get_relative_name( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Strukturen sind nicht vom gleichen Typ: '{ lo_struct_descr1->get_relative_name( ) }' vs. '{ lo_struct_descr2->get_relative_name( ) }'|.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field1> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field2> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr1->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_struct1 TO <fs_field1>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_struct2 TO <fs_field2>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF.

      IF <fs_field1> <> <fs_field2>.
        APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_diff_fields.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie mehrere Range-Tabellen für denselben Feldtyp zu einer einzigen, konsolidierten Range-Tabelle. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei überlappende oder angrenzende Bereiche.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer benutzerdefinierten Logik zur Konsolidierung oder die Methode `cl_abap_range_tabl=>compress` (falls verfügbar und passend).
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_consolidate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS consolidate_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_ranges TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF RANGE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_consolidated_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_consolidate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD consolidate_ranges.
    " For simplicity, this example assumes 'I' and 'EQ' or 'BT' options.
    " A full consolidation would be more complex, but this demonstrates REDUCE.
    rt_consolidated_range = REDUCE #( INIT r = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid( )
                                      FOR <fs_range_tab> IN it_ranges
                                      FOR <fs_range_line> IN <fs_range_tab>
                                      NEXT r = VALUE #( r ( <fs_range_line> ) ) ).

    " A more robust consolidation would involve sorting and merging, e.g., using a helper class
    " For a simple 'compress' functionality, one might use a custom method or external class.
    " Example: Sort and then iterate to merge adjacent/overlapping ranges.
    SORT rt_consolidated_range BY low ASCENDING option ASCENDING.

    DATA(lt_temp_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid( ).
    DATA(ls_current_entry) LIKE LINE OF rt_consolidated_range.
    LOOP AT rt_consolidated_range INTO DATA(ls_range_entry).
      IF ls_current_entry IS INITIAL.
        ls_current_entry = ls_range_entry.
      ELSEIF ls_range_entry-sign = 'I' AND ls_range_entry-option = 'EQ' AND
              ( ls_range_entry-low = ls_current_entry-low OR
                ( ls_range_entry-low > ls_current_entry-low AND ls_range_entry-low <= ls_current_entry-high ) ).
        " Merge or ignore if already covered
        IF ls_range_entry-high IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_range_entry-high > ls_current_entry-high.
          ls_current_entry-high = ls_range_entry-high.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        APPEND ls_current_entry TO lt_temp_range.
        ls_current_entry = ls_range_entry.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF ls_current_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND ls_current_entry TO lt_temp_range.
    ENDIF.
    rt_consolidated_range = lt_temp_range.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung basierend auf den Feldern einer Struktur und deren Werten. Die `SELECT`-Anweisung soll dann dynamisch ausgeführt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und String-Templates, um die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel zu konstruieren. Führen Sie die `SELECT`-Anweisung mit `FROM (iv_table_name) WHERE (lv_where_clause)` aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_dynamic_where
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
        is_criteria   TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error,
        cx_sy_assign_error,
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_criteria ).
    DATA(lv_where_clause) TYPE string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_criteria TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF.

      IF <fs_field> IS NOT INITIAL.
        IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && ' AND '.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_field_type) = ls_component-type->get_type_kind( ).
        CASE lv_field_type.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
            lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ ls_component-name } = '{ <fs_field> }'|.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
            lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ ls_component-name } = { <fs_field> }|.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
            lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ ls_component-name } = '{ <fs_field> }'|.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Handle other types or skip
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_where_clause IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Keine Kriterien für WHERE-Klausel gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.

    " Create dynamic internal table for results
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                             p_line_type  = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name )
                             p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                             p_unique     = abap_false ).
    CREATE DATA rt_result TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_result->* TO <fs_table>.

    TRY.
        SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE <fs_table> WHERE (lv_where_clause).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler bei dynamischem SELECT: { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es nutzt `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`, um die Felder einer Kriterienstruktur zu iterieren und eine `WHERE`-Klausel dynamisch zu konstruieren. String-Templates (`|...|`) erleichtern die Erstellung der SQL-Zeichenkette. Die `SELECT`-Anweisung wird dann mit `FROM (iv_table_name) WHERE (lv_where_clause)` dynamisch ausgeführt, wobei das Ergebnis in eine ebenfalls dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle geschrieben wird. Instructions: Parsen Sie einen String, der durch Kommas getrennte Werte oder Bereiche enthält (z.B. 'LH,UA,AA-DL'), und konvertieren Sie diesen in eine Range-Tabelle für `CARRID`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SPLIT` und `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Logik zur Bereichserkennung. String-Templates sind hilfreich für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_string_to_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_par_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_string_to_range.
    DATA: lt_parts TYPE string_table.

    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rt_range = VALUE #( FOR lv_part IN lt_parts
                        LET lv_trimmed_part = to_upper( CONV string( cl_abap_conv_ce=>_get_instance( )->convert( lv_part ) ) ) IN
                        ( COND #( WHEN lv_trimmed_part CS '-' THEN
                                  ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = substring( val = lv_trimmed_part off = 0 len = find( val = lv_trimmed_part sub = '-' ) ) high = substring( val = lv_trimmed_part off = find( val = lv_trimmed_part sub = '-' ) + 1 ) )
                                  WHEN lv_trimmed_part IS NOT INITIAL THEN
                                  ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = lv_trimmed_part )
                                  ELSE THROW cx_sy_strg_par_error( text = |Ungültiger Range-Eintrag: '{ lv_part }'| ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs als Eingabe akzeptiert und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur eine Untermenge der Spalten der Originaltabelle enthält. Die gewünschten Spaltennamen werden dynamisch übergeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `CREATE DATA` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die dynamische Datenübertragung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_project_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS project_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
        it_column_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_projected_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error,
        cx_sy_create_data_error,
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_project_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_columns.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_new_components     TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_new_struct_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_new_table_descr    TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " 1. Get description of the source table's line type
    lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
    lo_source_line_descr  ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_line_type( ).

    " 2. Build new structure components based on requested column names
    LOOP AT it_column_names INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      DATA(ls_source_component) = lo_source_line_descr->get_component( lv_column_name ).
      IF ls_source_component IS INITIAL.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_descr_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Spalte '{ lv_column_name }' nicht in Quelltabelle gefunden.|.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_source_component TO lt_new_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 3. Create new structure and table type descriptions
    lo_new_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_new_components ).
    lo_new_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                             p_line_type  = lo_new_struct_descr
                             p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                             p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table for results
    CREATE DATA rr_projected_table TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_projected_table->* TO <fs_projected_table>.

    " 5. Fill the new table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_line>     TYPE any,
                   <fs_projected_line>  TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA <fs_projected_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_projected_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_projected_line>->* TO <fs_projected_line>.

      " Move data for corresponding fields
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING <fs_source_line> TO <fs_projected_line>.

      APPEND <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_projected_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs als Eingabe akzeptiert und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die nach einer dynamisch angegebenen Spalte sortiert ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `CREATE DATA` und `SORT` mit dynamischer Spaltenangabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
        iv_sort_field   TYPE string
        iv_descending   TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_sorted_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error,
        cx_sy_create_data_error,
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " 1. Get description of the source table's line type
    lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
    lo_source_line_descr  ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_line_type( ).

    " 2. Check if sort field exists
    DATA(ls_component) = lo_source_line_descr->get_component( iv_sort_field ).
    IF ls_component IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Sortierfeld '{ iv_sort_field }' nicht in Tabelle gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Create a copy of the source table for sorting
    CREATE DATA rr_sorted_table TYPE HANDLE lo_source_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sorted_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_sorted_table->* TO <fs_sorted_table>.
    <fs_sorted_table> = it_source_table.

    " 4. Sort the dynamic table
    IF iv_descending = abap_true.
      SORT <fs_sorted_table> BY (iv_sort_field) DESCENDING.
    ELSE.
      SORT <fs_sorted_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die eigentliche Sortierung erfolgt mit der `SORT`-Anweisung, wobei der Feldname in Klammern `(iv_sort_field)` dynamisch übergeben wird. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT`-Daten, wobei die Filterkriterien (Feldname, Operator, Wert) dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle von Range-Definitionen stammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit einer dynamisch konstruierten `WHERE`-Klausel oder einer Schleife mit `LINE_EXISTS` und `IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_filter_criteria,
             field_name TYPE string,
             range_table TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid, " Generic range type, adjust as needed
           END OF ty_dynamic_filter_criteria.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_filter_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_filter_criteria WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflight_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_filter_criteria TYPE tt_dynamic_filter_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflight_dynamically.
    DATA(lt_temp_data) = it_sflight_data.

    LOOP AT it_filter_criteria INTO DATA(ls_criteria).
      CASE ls_criteria-field_name.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          lt_temp_data = FILTER #( lt_temp_data WHERE carrid IN ls_criteria-range_table ).
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          " Need to cast range_table to RANGE OF sflight-connid if it's generic
          DATA(lt_connid_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.
          lt_connid_range = CAST #( ls_criteria-range_table ). " This cast might fail if types are incompatible
          lt_temp_data = FILTER #( lt_temp_data WHERE connid IN lt_connid_range ).
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          DATA(lt_fldate_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-fldate.
          lt_fldate_range = CAST #( ls_criteria-range_table ).
          lt_temp_data = FILTER #( lt_temp_data WHERE fldate IN lt_fldate_range ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Handle unknown field or raise error
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_filtered_data = lt_temp_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs als Eingabe akzeptiert und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die nach einer dynamisch angegebenen Spalte gruppiert ist, wobei die Gruppierungsschlüssel und die Anzahl der Elemente pro Gruppe zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` mit dynamischer Spaltenangabe und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             key_value TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_result.
    TYPES tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
        iv_group_field  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_group_result
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error,
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " 1. Get description of the source table's line type
    lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
    lo_source_line_descr  ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_line_type( ).

    " 2. Check if group field exists
    DATA(ls_component) = lo_source_line_descr->get_component( iv_group_field ).
    IF ls_component IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Gruppierungsfeld '{ iv_group_field }' nicht in Tabelle gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_line> IN <fs_source_table> GROUP BY ( <fs_line>-* ) AS group_key
                                LET lv_key_value = CONV string( group_key ) IN
                                ( key_value = lv_key_value
                                  count = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    " The above GROUP BY ( <fs_line>-* ) AS group_key is a placeholder for dynamic field access.
    " A true dynamic GROUP BY requires more complex RTTI and dynamic programming.
    " For a simple demonstration, we'll simulate dynamic grouping by iterating and using ASSIGN COMPONENT.

    CLEAR rt_grouped_data.
    DATA: lt_temp_grouped TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH UNIQUE KEY key_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group_field_value> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_grouped_entry> TYPE ty_group_result.

    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_group_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_current_key) = CONV string( <fs_group_field_value> ).

      READ TABLE lt_temp_grouped ASSIGNING <fs_grouped_entry> KEY key_value = lv_current_key.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_grouped_entry>-count = <fs_grouped_entry>-count + 1.
      ELSE.
        APPEND VALUE ty_group_result( key_value = lv_current_key count = 1 ) TO lt_temp_grouped ASSIGNING <fs_grouped_entry>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_grouped_data = CORRESPONDING #( lt_temp_grouped ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_exclude_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_other_carrids_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

CLASS zcl_range_exclude_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_other_carrids_range.
    DATA: lt_all_carrids TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_carrids.

    DATA(lt_exclusion_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid( ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
                                                              ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) ).

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( FOR lv_carrid IN lt_all_carrids
                                WHERE ( lv_carrid IN lt_exclusion_range )
                                ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = lv_carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs als Eingabe akzeptiert und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die eindeutigen Zeilen basierend auf einer dynamisch angegebenen Spalte enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` mit dynamischer Spaltenangabe und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_distinct_rows DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_rows
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
        iv_distinct_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_distinct_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error,
        cx_sy_create_data_error,
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_distinct_rows IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_rows.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " 1. Get description of the source table's line type
    lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
    lo_source_line_descr  ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_line_type( ).

    " 2. Check if distinct field exists
    DATA(ls_component) = lo_source_line_descr->get_component( iv_distinct_field ).
    IF ls_component IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_distinct_field }' nicht in Tabelle gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Create a new table for results (same type as source)
    CREATE DATA rr_distinct_table TYPE HANDLE lo_source_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_distinct_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_distinct_table->* TO <fs_distinct_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_distinct_field_value> TYPE any.

    DATA(lt_seen_keys) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_distinct_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_distinct_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_current_key) = CONV string( <fs_distinct_field_value> ).

      IF NOT line_exists( lt_seen_keys[ table_line = lv_current_key ] ).
        APPEND lv_current_key TO lt_seen_keys.
        APPEND <fs_source_line> TO <fs_distinct_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_distinct_table>[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_distinct_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_distinct_rows( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
    ).

    DATA(lr_distinct_table) = lo_cut->get_distinct_rows( it_source_table = lt_sflight_data iv_distinct_field = 'CONNID' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_distinct_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    ASSIGN lr_distinct_table->* TO <fs_distinct_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_distinct_table> ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_distinct_table>[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_distinct_table>[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_distinct_table>[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_distinct_table>[ 4 ]-connid exp = '0020' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_distinct_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_distinct_rows( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_distinct_rows( it_source_table = lt_sflight_data iv_distinct_field = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_descr_error for invalid distinct field' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_descr_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_distinct_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_distinct_rows( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY( ).
    DATA(lr_distinct_table) = lo_cut->get_distinct_rows( it_source_table = lt_sflight_data iv_distinct_field = 'CARRID' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_distinct_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_distinct_table->* TO <fs_distinct_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <fs_distinct_table> ).
