ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man RTTI verwendet, um eindeutige Zeilen einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer dynamisch angegebenen Spalte zu extrahieren. Es wird eine neue interne Tabelle des gleichen Typs wie die Quelltabelle dynamisch erstellt. Durch Iteration über die Quelltabelle und Verwendung von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` wird der Wert des dynamischen Feldes extrahiert. Eine Hash-Tabelle (`lt_seen_keys`) wird verwendet, um bereits gesehene Schlüsselwerte zu verfolgen und so die Eindeutigkeit zu gewährleisten. Dies ist ein generisches Muster für die Datenbereinigung und -aggregation.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Distinct, Unique, ASSIGN COMPONENT, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für `CARRID`, die alle Fluggesellschaften enthält, die in der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle vorkommen, aber nicht in einer gegebenen Liste von 'Premium'-Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT DISTINCT` für alle Fluggesellschaften, dann `FILTER` mit einer `NOT IN` Bedingung für die Premium-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_non_premium DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_non_premium_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_premium_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_non_premium_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_non_premium IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_non_premium_carrids.
    DATA: lt_all_carrids TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_carrids.

    rt_non_premium_range = VALUE #( FOR lv_carrid IN lt_all_carrids
                                    WHERE ( NOT lv_carrid IN it_premium_carrids )
                                    ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = lv_carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_non_premium_carrids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_all_premium FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_premium_list FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_non_premium_carrids.
    " Ensure some data exists for testing
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE #(
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' fldate = sy-datum )
    ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_non_premium( ).
    DATA(lt_premium_list) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid( ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_non_premium_carrids( it_premium_carrids = lt_premium_list ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-low exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 2 ]-low exp = 'DL' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH should not be in range' act = xsdbool( 'LH' IN lt_range ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA should be in range' act = xsdbool( 'AA' IN lt_range ) exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_all_premium.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE #(
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum )
    ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_non_premium( ).
    DATA(lt_premium_list) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid( ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_non_premium_carrids( it_premium_carrids = lt_premium_list ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_premium_list.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE #(
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum )
    ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_non_premium( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_non_premium_carrids( it_premium_carrids = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid( ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-low exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 2 ]-low exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_sflight_data.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_non_premium( ).
    DATA(lt_premium_list) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid( ( 'LH' ) ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_non_premium_carrids( it_premium_carrids = lt_premium_list ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer Range-Tabelle, die alle Werte einer Spalte aus einer Datenbanktabelle enthält, die *nicht* in einer gegebenen Liste von Werten enthalten sind. Es werden alle eindeutigen `CARRID`s mit `SELECT DISTINCT` geholt. Anschließend wird der `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `WHERE` Bedingung verwendet, um nur die `CARRID`s in die Ergebnis-Range aufzunehmen, die *nicht* in der `it_premium_carrids`-Tabelle enthalten sind (`NOT lv_carrid IN it_premium_carrids`). Dies ist eine effiziente Methode zur Erstellung von Exklusions-Ranges.
keywords: Ranges, FILTER, SELECT DISTINCT, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, NOT IN, Exclusion, Database Access

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Binärdatei in eine XSTRING-Variable ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN DATASET` mit `FOR BINARY MODE` und `READ DATASET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_binary_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring_content) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_binary_file.
    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'File could not be opened.'.
    ENDIF.
    READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO rv_xstring_content.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error reading file.'.
    ENDIF.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_binary_file FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mv_temp_file_path TYPE string.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    mv_temp_file_path = |{ cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_temp_directory( ) }/test_binary_file.bin|.
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = '48656C6C6F2042696E61727921'X. " "Hello Binary!" in hex
    OPEN DATASET mv_temp_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.

    ELSE.

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lv_read_content) = lo_reader->read_binary_file( mv_temp_file_path ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_read_content,
      exp = '48656C6C6F2042696E61727921'X,
      msg = 'Content of the binary file should match.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisungen `OPEN DATASET ... FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE` und `READ DATASET` sind die Standardmethoden, um binäre Daten aus Dateien zu lesen. Die Verwendung von `XSTRING` ist für die Speicherung binärer Inhalte in ABAP unerlässlich.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine XSTRING-Variable, die UTF-8-kodierten Text enthält, in eine STRING-Variable und umgekehrt.

CLASS zcl_binary_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_binary_converter IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD string_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( encoding = iv_codepage ).

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine XSTRING-Variable und dekomprimieren Sie sie anschließend wieder.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_zip`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_compressor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS compress_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_uncompressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zip_error.

    METHODS decompress_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_data) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_compressor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_xstring.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add( name = 'data.bin' content = iv_uncompressed_data ).
    rv_compressed_data = lo_zip->get_zipped_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_xstring.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( iv_compressed_data ).
    lo_zip->get( EXPORTING name = 'data.bin' IMPORTING content = rv_decompressed_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compression.
    DATA(lo_compressor) = NEW zcl_binary_compressor( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = '48656C6C6F2042696E61727920446174612066FC'X.
    lv_original_xstring = lv_original_xstring && lv_original_xstring && lv_original_xstring.

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = lo_compressor->compress_xstring( lv_original_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = lo_compressor->decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_decompressed_xstring,
      exp = lv_original_xstring,
      msg = 'Decompressed data should match original data.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( xstrlen( lv_compressed_xstring ) < xstrlen( lv_original_xstring ) ),
      msg = 'Compressed data should be smaller than original data.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_zip` ermöglicht das einfache Komprimieren und Dekomprimieren von XSTRING-Daten im ZIP-Format. Dies ist nützlich, um die Größe von binären Daten zu reduzieren, z.B. für die Speicherung oder Übertragung.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, COMPRESSION, ZIP, CL_ABAP_ZIP

Instructions: Senden Sie eine XSTRING-Variable als HTTP POST-Anfrage-Payload an einen externen Dienst.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` und setzen Sie den Request-Body als XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_binary_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS send_binary_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_data TYPE xstring
        iv_content_type TYPE string DEFAULT 'application/octet-stream'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_binary_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_binary_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Failed to create HTTP client.'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( cl_http_client=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_content_type( iv_content_type ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_data( iv_data ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      DATA(lv_error_text) = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error
        EXPORTING
          text = lv_error_text.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      DATA(lv_error_text_rec) = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error
        EXPORTING
          text = lv_error_text_rec.
    ENDIF.

    rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_send_binary_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_binary_data.
    DATA(lo_sender) = NEW zcl_http_binary_sender( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_url) = 'http://localhost:8080/upload'.
    DATA(lv_binary_data) = '0102030405060708090A'X.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_status) = lo_sender->send_binary_data(
                            iv_url = lv_dummy_url,
                            iv_data = lv_binary_data
                          ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( lv_status IS NOT INITIAL ),
          msg = 'HTTP call should return a status code.'
        ).
      CATCH cx_http_client_error cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |HTTP call failed (expected without mock server): { lx_exception->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_http_client` ist das Standardwerkzeug in ABAP, um HTTP-Anfragen zu senden. Sie ermöglicht das einfache Setzen von binären Daten (XSTRING) als Request-Payload, was für die Integration mit externen Systemen, die binäre Inhalte erwarten, unerlässlich ist.
keywords: HTTP, BINARY, XSTRING, CL_HTTP_CLIENT, POST, EXTERNAL_SERVICE

Instructions: Empfangen Sie binäre Daten (z.B. ein Bild) aus der HTTP-Antwort eines externen Dienstes.

CLASS zcl_http_binary_receiver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             status_code TYPE i,

        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING

      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_binary_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD receive_binary_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Failed to create HTTP client.'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( cl_http_client=>co_request_method_get ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      DATA(lv_error_text) = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error
        EXPORTING
          text = lv_error_text.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      DATA(lv_error_text_rec) = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error
        EXPORTING
          text = lv_error_text_rec.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    rs_response-content = lo_http_client->response->get_data( ).
    rs_response-content_type = lo_http_client->response->get_content_type( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie eine große XSTRING-Variable in kleinere, gleich große Blöcke (Chunks) auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DO ... TIMES` und `SUBSTRING` für XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_chunker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS chunk_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_chunk_size       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_xstring_chunks) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_chunker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD chunk_xstring.
    IF iv_chunk_size <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Chunk size must be positive.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_length) = xstrlen( iv_original_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_remaining_length) = lv_total_length.

    WHILE lv_remaining_length > 0.
      DATA(lv_current_chunk_size) = COND #( WHEN lv_remaining_length < iv_chunk_size THEN lv_remaining_length ELSE iv_chunk_size ).
      APPEND iv_original_xstring+lv_offset(lv_current_chunk_size) TO rt_xstring_chunks.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_current_chunk_size.
      lv_remaining_length = lv_remaining_length - lv_current_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chunk_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chunk_xstring.
    DATA(lo_chunker) = NEW zcl_xstring_chunker( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = '0102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F1011121314'X. " 20 bytes

    " Test with even chunks
    DATA(lt_chunks_even) = lo_chunker->chunk_xstring( iv_original_xstring = lv_original_xstring iv_chunk_size = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chunks_even ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chunks_even[1] exp = '0102030405'X ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chunks_even[4] exp = '11121314'X ).

    " Test with uneven chunks
    DATA(lt_chunks_uneven) = lo_chunker->chunk_xstring( iv_original_xstring = lv_original_xstring iv_chunk_size = 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chunks_uneven ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chunks_uneven[1] exp = '01020304050607'X ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chunks_uneven[3] exp = '0F1011121314'X ).

    " Test with chunk size larger than total length
    DATA(lt_chunks_single) = lo_chunker->chunk_xstring( iv_original_xstring = lv_original_xstring iv_chunk_size = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chunks_single ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chunks_single[1] exp = lv_original_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Aufteilen großer XSTRING-Daten in kleinere Blöcke ist eine gängige Anforderung, z.B. für die Übertragung in Paketen oder die Verarbeitung in Teilschritten. Die moderne ABAP-Syntax mit `xstrlen` und `SUBSTRING` ermöglicht eine effiziente Implementierung dieser Logik.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, CHUNK, SUBSTRING, MANIPULATION

CLASS zcl_binary_file_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS write_binary_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_xstring_content TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_file_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_binary_file.
    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'File could not be opened for writing.'.
    ENDIF.
    TRANSFER iv_xstring_content TO iv_file_path.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error writing to file.'.
    ENDIF.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie den Abruf von Mitarbeiterdaten von einem OData-Service. Die Methode soll einen JSON-String empfangen, diesen parsen und eine interne Tabelle mit Mitarbeiterinformationen zurückgeben. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für das JSON-Parsing.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_json_parser` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für das JSON-Parsing. Für die Simulation können Sie einen festen JSON-String verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odata_employee_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id       TYPE string,
             name     TYPE string,
             position TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_employee_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employees.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_employee_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_employee_json.
    DATA: ls_employee_data TYPE ty_employee.
    DATA: lt_json_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_json_parser=>parse( EXPORTING json = iv_json_data IMPORTING data = lt_json_data ).
        rt_employees = lt_json_data.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_odata_parsing_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_odata_parsing_error=>json_parsing_failed
            previous = lx_root.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_success FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_odata_parsing_error.
    METHODS test_parse_invalid_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_employee_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"id":"001","name":"Max Mustermann","position":"Developer"},{"id":"002","name":"Erika Musterfrau","position":"Manager"}]`.
    DATA(lt_employees) = lo_cut->parse_employee_json( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_employees ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_employees[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Max Mustermann' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_employees[ 2 ]-position exp = 'Manager' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_invalid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_employee_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = `{"id":"001","name":"Max Mustermann","position":"Developer"`.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->parse_employee_json( lv_invalid_json ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_odata_parsing_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne JSON-Verarbeitung in ABAP mittels `cl_abap_json_parser`. Es ist eine effiziente und typsichere Methode, um Daten aus OData-Services oder anderen JSON-Quellen zu konsumieren. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung ist ebenfalls Best Practice.
keywords: OData, JSON, Parsing, `cl_abap_json_parser`, `cl_hcmfab_employee_api`, `ODATA_HCMFAB_REUSE`

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Mitarbeiterdaten nach aktiven Mitarbeitern (simuliert durch 'X' im Feld 'STATUS') und geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit nur deren Namen zurück. Nutzen Sie funktionale Programmierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_employee_data,
           tt_employee_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_employee_names
      IMPORTING
        it_employees TYPE tt_employee_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_active_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_employee_names.
    rt_active_names = VALUE #( FOR <fs_employee> IN FILTER #( it_employees WHERE status = 'X' ) ( <fs_employee>-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_active.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE zcl_employee_filter=>tt_employee_data(
      ( id = '001' name = 'Max Mustermann' status = 'X' )

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Informationsmeldung in das Application Log (BAL) unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_s_aut_bal_log`. Die Meldung soll den erfolgreichen Abschluss einer Mitarbeiterdatenverarbeitung protokollieren.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und verwenden Sie die Methode `add_message` mit den entsprechenden Parametern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_employee_process_success
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string
        iv_message     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_employee_process_success.
    DATA(lo_bal_log) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).

    lo_bal_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I' " Information
      i_msgid = 'ZEMPLOYEE_MSG' " Eigene Message-Klasse (muss existieren)
      i_msgno = '001' " Message-Nummer
      i_msgv1 = iv_employee_id
      i_msgv2 = iv_message
    ).

    " Optional: Log speichern
    " lo_bal_log->save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_employee_id) = 'EMP456'.
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Mitarbeiterdaten erfolgreich verarbeitet.'.

    " Da cl_s_aut_bal_log externe Abhängigkeiten hat (BAL-Objekte), ist ein direkter Unit-Test

    " In einem realen Szenario würde man cl_s_aut_bal_log mocken oder das BAL-Objekt nach dem Test auslesen.
    TRY.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie bietet eine strukturierte und zentrale Möglichkeit, System- und Anwendungsnachrichten zu erfassen, was für die Fehleranalyse und Überwachung unerlässlich ist. Die Verwendung von Message-Klassen und -Nummern sorgt für Konsistenz.
keywords: Logging, Application Log, BAL, `cl_s_aut_bal_log`, `S_AUT`, `Meldungsprotokoll-Behandler`

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Mitarbeiters (z.B. 'Active', 'On Leave', 'Terminated') basierend auf einem Statuscode (A, L, T). Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck für die Zuweisung.

CLASS zcl_employee_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

INTERFACE zif_employee.
  METHODS get_role RETURNING VALUE(rv_role) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_developer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_employee_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine simulierte Operation an Mitarbeiterdaten durchführt und dabei eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslösen kann. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahmeklasse. Nutzen Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_employee_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF employee_not_found,
                 msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZEMPLOYEE_MSG',
                 msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '002',
                 attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'EMPLOYEE_ID',
                 attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
                 attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
                 attr4 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
               END OF employee_not_found.
    DATA employee_id TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid        LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous      LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        employee_id   TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_employee_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->employee_id = employee_id.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = employee_not_found.

CLASS zcl_employee_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_employee_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_employee_error.
    METHODS execute_processing
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_employee_data.
    " Simulierte Operation, die fehlschlagen kann
    IF iv_employee_id = 'INVALID'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_employee_error
        EXPORTING
          employee_id = iv_employee_id.
    ENDIF.
    " Erfolgreiche Verarbeitung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_processing.
    DATA(lo_bal_log) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).
    TRY.
        process_employee_data( iv_employee_id ).
        lo_bal_log->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgid = 'ZEMPLOYEE_MSG'
          i_msgno = '003'
          i_msgv1 = iv_employee_id
          i_msgv2 = 'Verarbeitung erfolgreich.'
        ).
      CATCH zcx_employee_error INTO DATA(lx_employee_error).
        lo_bal_log->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = lx_employee_error->if_t100_message~t100key-msgid
          i_msgno = lx_employee_error->if_t100_message~t100key-msgno
          i_msgv1 = lx_employee_error->employee_id
          i_msgv2 = lx_employee_error->get_text( )
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lo_bal_log->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = 'ZEMPLOYEE_MSG'
          i_msgno = '999'
          i_msgv1 = iv_employee_id
          i_msgv2 = lx_root->get_text( )
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Gehälter (simuliert als Flugpreise aus `sflights`) aller Mitarbeiter in einer internen Tabelle, die einen bestimmten Status haben (z.B. 'X' für aktiv). Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um über die gefilterte Tabelle zu iterieren und die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_salary_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_salary,
             id       TYPE string,
             salary   TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             status   TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_employee_salary,
           tt_employee_salary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_salary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_salary
      IMPORTING
        it_employees TYPE tt_employee_salary
        iv_status    TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_salary) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_salary_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_salary.
    rv_total_salary = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_employee> IN FILTER #( it_employees WHERE status = iv_status )
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_employee>-salary
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Mitarbeiterdaten (simuliert aus `sflights`) nach 'Abteilung' (simuliert durch `CARRID`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Mitarbeiter pro Abteilung. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_employee_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_employee_raw,
           tt_employee_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_department_count,
             department TYPE s_carr_id,
             employee_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_department_count,
           tt_department_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_department_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_employees_by_department
      IMPORTING
        it_employees TYPE tt_employee_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_department_counts) TYPE tt_department_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_employees_by_department.
    rt_department_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_employee> IN it_employees GROUP BY <fs_employee>-carrid INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( department = group_key
        employee_count = count( ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data,
             id       TYPE string,
             name     TYPE string,
             position TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_employee_data TYPE ty_employee_data
        iv_field_name    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_dynamic_access_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_employee_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_dynamic_access_error
        EXPORTING
          textid    = zcx_dynamic_access_error=>field_not_found
          field_name = iv_field_name.
    ENDIF.

    rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_bonus_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter eines Mitarbeiters in Jahren basierend auf seinem Geburtsdatum. Nutzen Sie moderne Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` oder direkte Datumsberechnungen mit `sy-datum`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_age_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_age_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age_in_years.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_age) = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).

    IF lv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( lv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND lv_current_date(4) < iv_birth_date(4) ).
      lv_age = lv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
    rv_age = lv_age.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_currency  TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price AND currency = iv_currency )
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        price    = ls_flight-price
        currency = ls_flight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle sflights, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Nutzen Sie hierfür die REDUCE-Expression mit einer WHEN-Bedingung.
hint: REDUCE ist ideal für Aggregationen. Die WHEN-Bedingung kann innerhalb der REDUCE-Logik verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_fldate )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` vor. Fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Spalte 'Status' hinzu, deren Wert basierend auf dem Flugdatum ('Vergangen', 'Heute', 'Zukünftig') mit einer COND-Expression bestimmt wird. Nutzen Sie VALUE und FOR.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE und FOR, um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren und COND für die Statuslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             currency   TYPE sflight-currency,
             status     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_flight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
    rt_tree_data = VALUE tt_flight_nodes(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_current_date = sy-datum IN
      ( node_key   = |{ conv string( lv_node_key + 1 ) }|
        parent_key = ''
        text       = |{ ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }|
        carrid     = ls_flight-carrid
        connid     = ls_flight-connid
        fldate     = ls_flight-fldate
        price      = ls_flight-price
        currency   = ls_flight-currency
        status     = COND string(
          WHEN ls_flight-fldate < lv_current_date THEN 'Vergangen'
          WHEN ls_flight-fldate = lv_current_date THEN 'Heute'
          WHEN ls_flight-fldate > lv_current_date THEN 'Zukünftig'
          ELSE 'Unbekannt'
        )
      NEXT lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Nutzen Sie hierfür die FOR-Expression mit GROUP BY und einer COND-Expression für die Preisberechnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ... GROUP BY und die VALUE-Expression für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid       = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        avg_price    = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum_p = 0 count_p = 0
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT sum_p = sum_p + ls_flight-price,
               count_p = count_p + 1
          FINALLY = COND #( WHEN count_p > 0 THEN sum_p / count_p ELSE 0 )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Check if at least one entry exists and has valid data

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( ls_first_summary-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( ls_first_summary-avg_price >= 0 ) ).

CLASS zcl_weekday_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_weekday_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday_num) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( iv_date ).

    rv_weekday_name = COND string(
      WHEN lv_weekday_num = 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN lv_weekday_num = 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN lv_weekday_num = 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN lv_weekday_num = 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN lv_weekday_num = 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN lv_weekday_num = 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN lv_weekday_num = 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Wochentag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_info.

    METHODS format_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_info TYPE ty_sflight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_info.
    rv_formatted_string = |Flug { is_flight_info-carrid } { is_flight_info-connid } kostet { is_flight_info-price } { is_flight_info-currency }.
                           { COND string(
                               WHEN is_flight_info-price > 1000 THEN 'Dies ist ein teurer Flug.'
                               WHEN is_flight_info-price > 500 THEN 'Dies ist ein mittelpreisiger Flug.'
                               ELSE 'Dies ist ein günstiger Flug.'
                             ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (sflights), die nur Flüge enthält, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben und deren Preis in einer bestimmten Spanne liegt. Nutzen Sie hierfür die FILTER-Expression mit einer komplexeren WHERE-Bedingung, die auch eine WHEN-Bedingung impliziert.
hint: Die WHERE-Klausel der FILTER-Expression kann komplexe logische Ausdrücke enthalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_complex_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_price_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_price_range.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_sflight(
      lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND price BETWEEN iv_min_price AND iv_max_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_range_existing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_range_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_range_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_complex_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_price_range( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = '100' iv_max_price = '500' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( ls_flight-price >= '100' AND ls_flight-price <= '500' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_range_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_complex_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_price_range( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_price = '1' iv_max_price = '10000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Ihre WHERE-Klausel unterstützt komplexe logische Ausdrücke, einschließlich Bereichsbedingungen (BETWEEN), die implizit eine 'WHEN'-Logik für die Auswahl der Elemente darstellen. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem, lesbarem und performantem Code.

CLASS zcl_applog_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE bal_t_msg.

CLASS zcl_applog_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_filter_log.
    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object = 'ZDEMO'
      subobject = 'FILTER'
      extnumber = 'DEMO_004'
      aluser = sy-uname
      alprog = sy-repid
    ).

    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log_create=>create_log( ls_log_header ).
    lo_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Info message' ).
    lo_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = 'Warning message' ).
    lo_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '003' i_msgv1 = 'Error message 1' ).
    lo_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '004' i_msgv1 = 'Error message 2' ).
    lo_log->save( ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    DATA(lo_log_read) = cl_bal_log_read=>get_instance( lv_log_handle ).

    IF lo_log_read IS BOUND.
      DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_log_read->get_messages( ).
      rt_error_messages = FILTER #( lt_all_messages WHERE msgty = 'E' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Beziehung zwischen einem Flug (aus `SFLIGHTS`) und einem GOS-Anhang (z.B. einem Textdokument).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>CREATE_LINK` und die Business-Objekt-Typen für `SFLIGHT` und `SOFM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_rel_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_attachment_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_attachment_id TYPE so_obj_id " Object ID of the attachment (e.g., from SOFM)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_attachment_link.
    DATA(ls_flight_key) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
    ).

    " For SFLIGHT, the key is CARRIERID, CONNECTIONID, FLIGHTDATE
    DATA(lv_flight_objkey) = |{ ls_flight_key-carrid }{ ls_flight_key-connid }{ ls_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    DATA(ls_object_a) = VALUE sibflporb(
      instid = lv_flight_objkey
      typeid = 'BUS1075' " Business Object Type for SFLIGHT
      catid = 'BO'
    ).

    DATA(ls_object_b) = VALUE sibflporb(
      instid = iv_attachment_id
      typeid = 'SOFM' " Business Object Type for GOS attachment
      catid = 'BO'
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          is_object_a = ls_object_a
          is_object_b = ls_object_b
          ip_relation_type = 'ATTA' " Attachment relation type
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        " Handle error
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_link FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_link.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_attachment_id) = '00000000000000000000000000000000'. " Dummy SOFM ID, replace with real if needed

    " Ensure a flight exists for the test
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                            planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 ).
      INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_rel_create( ).

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_delete IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_flight_key) = VALUE sflight(

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_relation_info,
             objid TYPE sibflporb-instid,
             objtype TYPE sibflporb-typeid,
             reltype TYPE srel_type,
           END OF ty_relation_info.
    TYPES tt_relation_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_relation_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_and_filter_relations
      IMPORTING
        is_object TYPE sibflporb
        iv_filter_rel_type TYPE srel_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_relations) TYPE tt_relation_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_filter_relations.
    DATA(lt_all_links) = cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
      is_object = is_object
      ip_direction = cl_binary_relation=>direction_a
    ).

    rt_filtered_relations = VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_all_links
                                     WHERE ( reltype = iv_filter_rel_type )
                                     ( objid = ls_link-objid_b
                                       objtype = ls_link-typeid_b
                                       reltype = ls_link-reltype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_action_type,
             create  VALUE 'C',
             update  VALUE 'U',
             delete  VALUE 'D',
             display VALUE 'P', "Display
           END OF ENUM t_action_type.

    METHODS process_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_action TYPE t_action_type
        iv_data   TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_action.
    CASE iv_action.
      WHEN t_action_type=>create.
        rv_result = |Creating data: { iv_data }|.
      WHEN t_action_type=>update.
        rv_result = |Updating data: { iv_data }|.
      WHEN t_action_type=>delete.
        rv_result = |Deleting data: { iv_data }|.
      WHEN t_action_type=>display.
        rv_result = |Displaying data: { iv_data }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = 'Unknown action'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle. Gruppieren Sie diese interne Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und erstellen Sie für jede Gruppe eine neue interne Tabelle mit den Flügen dieser Gesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY group_key-field INTO DATA(group_result)` und `LOOP AT GROUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights  TYPE tt_flights,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS " Limit for demo
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_grouped_entry) = VALUE ty_grouped_flights( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_flight).
        APPEND ls_group_flight TO ls_grouped_entry-flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.

Die `INTO DATA(group_result)`-Variante ist besonders nützlich, um die gruppierten Daten direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle zu sammeln, was die Weiterverarbeitung vereinfacht.

Instructions: Laden Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle. Gruppieren Sie diese Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Auslastung (`SEATSOCC` / `SEATSMAX`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und innerhalb der Gruppe `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_occupancy,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_occupancy   TYPE f, " Average occupancy
           END OF ty_carrier_occupancy.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_carrier_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS " Limit for demo
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_occupancy) = REDUCE f(
        INIT sum_occ = 0.0
             sum_max = 0.0
        FOR  <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + <fs_group_flight>-seatsocc
             sum_max = sum_max + <fs_group_flight>-seatsmax
      ).

      DATA(lv_avg_occupancy) = COND f(
        WHEN lv_total_occupancy-sum_max > 0
        THEN lv_total_occupancy-sum_occ / lv_total_occupancy-sum_max
        ELSE 0.0
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_occupancy(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        avg_occupancy = lv_avg_occupancy
      ) TO rt_occupancy.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_analyzer->get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_occupancy
      msg = 'Should return average occupancies'
    ).
    " Check if average occupancy is within a reasonable range (0 to 1)
    LOOP AT lt_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_occupancy).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_occupancy-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_occupancy-avg_occupancy <= 1
        msg = |Average occupancy for { ls_occupancy-carrid } should be between 0 and 1|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes ABAP-Muster für die Aggregation von Daten innerhalb von Gruppen. Es ermöglicht die Berechnung komplexer Aggregatwerte (wie hier der Durchschnitt) in einer kompakten und funktionalen Weise.
keywords: Internal Table, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Laden Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle. Gruppieren Sie diese Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe, ob alle Flüge der Gruppe eine Auslastung von über 50% haben. Verwenden Sie `COND` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und innerhalb der Gruppe `FOR` mit `COND` für die Bedingungsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_performance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_performance,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             all_high_occupancy TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_carrier_performance.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_performance TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_performance WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_performance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_performance) TYPE tt_carrier_performance.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_performance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_performance.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS " Limit for demo
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_all_high) = COND abap_bool(
        WHEN NOT line_exists( lt_all_flights[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] WHERE ( seatsocc / seatsmax ) <= 0.5 ) " Check if any flight has <= 50% occupancy
        THEN abap_true
        ELSE abap_false
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_performance(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        all_high_occupancy = lv_all_high
      ) TO rt_performance.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_performance.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_performance( ).
    DATA(lt_performance) = lo_analyzer->get_carrier_performance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_performance
      msg = 'Should return carrier performance data'
    ).
    " Example: Check if a specific carrier's performance is evaluated
    READ TABLE lt_performance WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_perf).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " This test might need adjustment based on actual SFLIGHTS data
      " For now, just assert it's a boolean value
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_aa_perf-all_high_occupancy = abap_true OR ls_aa_perf-all_high_occupancy = abap_false )
        msg = 'all_high_occupancy should be a boolean'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COND` und `line_exists` (oder `FOR` mit `ALL`/`ANY`) ermöglicht eine effiziente und deklarative Prüfung von Bedingungen über alle Elemente einer Gruppe. Dies ist eine moderne Art, komplexe Gruppenlogik auszudrücken, ohne explizite Schleifen und Flags.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer Methode, die einen Enumerationstyp als Parameter akzeptiert. Implementieren Sie zwei Unterklassen, die diese Methode überschreiben und unterschiedliche Logik basierend auf dem Enum-Wert ausführen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_processor DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_processing_mode,
             fast   VALUE 'F',
             normal VALUE 'N',
             debug  VALUE 'D',
           END OF ENUM t_processing_mode.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_mode TYPE t_processing_mode
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string ABSTRACT.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fast_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_processor FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fast_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    CASE iv_mode.
      WHEN t_processing_mode=>fast.
        rv_output = |Fast processing: { iv_input }|.
      WHEN t_processing_mode=>normal.
        rv_output = |Normal processing (fast): { iv_input }|.
      WHEN t_processing_mode=>debug.
        rv_output = |Debug processing (fast): { iv_input }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_output = |Unknown mode (fast): { iv_input }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_debug_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_processor FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_debug_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    CASE iv_mode.
      WHEN t_processing_mode=>fast.
        rv_output = |Fast processing (debug): { iv_input }|.
      WHEN t_processing_mode=>normal.
        rv_output = |Normal processing (debug): { iv_input }|.
      WHEN t_processing_mode=>debug.
        rv_output = |Detailed debug processing: { iv_input }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_output = |Unknown mode (debug): { iv_input }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle. Gruppieren Sie diese Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und erstellen Sie für jede Gruppe eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Verbindungs-IDs (`CONNID`) unter Verwendung von `FOR` und String Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und innerhalb der Gruppe `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_connections DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connections,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connections TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_connections.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connections WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connections_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE tt_carrier_connections.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_connections IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS " Limit for demo
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_connections_list) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR  <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_group_flight>-connid
          ELSE s && ', ' && <fs_group_flight>-connid
        )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_connections(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connections = lv_connections_list
      ) TO rt_connections.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_connections_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_connections_list.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_connections( ).
    DATA(lt_connections) = lo_analyzer->get_connections_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_connections
      msg = 'Should return carrier connections'
    ).
    " Check if a specific carrier's connection list is not empty
    READ TABLE lt_connections WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_conn).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_lh_conn-connections
        msg = 'LH connections list should not be empty'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = count( val = ls_lh_conn-connections sep = ',' ) >= 0 " At least one connection or more
        msg = 'LH connections list should contain comma-separated values'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator und String Templates ist eine elegante Methode, um aggregierte Zeichenketten aus Gruppendaten zu erstellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Generierung von Berichten oder die Anzeige von zusammengefassten Informationen.
keywords: Internal Table, GROUP BY, REDUCE, FOR, String Templates, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Enumerationswert und einen numerischen Wert entgegennimmt. Basierend auf dem Enum-Wert soll eine Berechnung (Addition, Subtraktion, Multiplikation, Division) mit dem numerischen Wert durchgeführt werden. Verwenden Sie `CASE` und `ENUM`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` für den Enum-Wert und führen Sie die entsprechende arithmetische Operation durch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_operation,
             add      VALUE 'A',
             subtract VALUE 'S',
             multiply VALUE 'M',
             divide   VALUE 'D',
           END OF ENUM t_operation.

    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_operation TYPE t_operation
        iv_value1    TYPE f
        iv_value2    TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    CASE iv_operation.
      WHEN t_operation=>add.
        rv_result = iv_value1 + iv_value2.
      WHEN t_operation=>subtract.
        rv_result = iv_value1 - iv_value2.
      WHEN t_operation=>multiply.
        rv_result = iv_value1 * iv_value2.
      WHEN t_operation=>divide.
        IF iv_value2 = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = iv_value1 / iv_value2.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default or error handling
        rv_result = 0.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_addition.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->perform_calculation(

explanation: Enumerationen in Kombination mit `CASE`-Anweisungen bieten eine klare und wartbare Struktur für die Implementierung von bedingter Logik, insbesondere wenn verschiedene Aktionen basierend auf einem festen Satz von Optionen ausgeführt werden müssen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Fehleranfälligkeit im Vergleich zu String- oder Integer-basierten Flags.

Instructions: Laden Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle. Gruppieren Sie diese Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und filtern Sie die Gruppen so, dass nur Fluggesellschaften berücksichtigt werden, die mindestens 5 Flüge haben. Verwenden Sie `GROUP WHERE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... GROUP WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_group,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_filtered_group.
    TYPES: tt_filtered_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_carriers) TYPE tt_filtered_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 200 ROWS " More data for better grouping
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      GROUP WHERE ( GROUP SIZE >= iv_min_flights ) " Filter groups based on size
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE ty_filtered_group(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_filtered_carriers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_groups FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_groups.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_group( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_carriers) = lo_grouper->get_carriers_with_min_flights( iv_min_flights = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_filtered_carriers
      msg = 'Should return filtered carrier groups'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_carrier-flight_count >= 2
        msg = |Carrier { ls_carrier-carrid } should have at least 2 flights|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP WHERE`-Klausel in `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine effiziente Filterung von Gruppen basierend auf Aggregatbedingungen (wie `GROUP SIZE`). Dies ist eine moderne und deklarative Methode, um nur relevante Gruppen zu verarbeiten, ohne zusätzliche Schleifen oder manuelle Zählungen.
keywords: Internal Table, GROUP BY, GROUP WHERE, Filtering, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Laden Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle. Gruppieren Sie diese Tabelle dynamisch nach einem vom Benutzer angegebenen Feld (z.B. `CARRID` oder `CONNID`) und zählen Sie die Elemente in jeder Gruppe. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY ( ... )`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ( ... )` mit einem dynamischen Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             group_key_value TYPE string,
             flight_count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_group_field TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID' or 'CONNID'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_results) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_dynamically.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 200 ROWS " Limit for demo
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_group_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ( group_field = iv_group_field ) " Dynamic grouping
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_group_key-group_field OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO <fs_group_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
          group_key_value = <fs_group_field>
          flight_count    = GROUP SIZE
        ) TO rt_grouped_results.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf eine Spalte einer internen Tabelle zu und summiere deren Werte. Die Spalte wird als String übergeben.
hint: Nutze `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit einem Feldsymbol, um auf die dynamische Spalte zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_dynamic_column
      IMPORTING
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        it_data        TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum)  TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_dynamic_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_sum = rv_sum + <fs_value>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_line>-connid = '001'. <fs_line>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_line>-connid = '002'. <fs_line>-price = '200.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_column_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_dynamic_column( iv_column_name = 'PRICE' it_data = lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '300.00' msg = 'Summe der Preise korrekt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_dynamic_column_sum=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_line>-connid = '001'. <fs_line>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_line>-connid = '002'. <fs_line>-price = '200.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_column_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_dynamic_column( iv_column_name = 'CONNID' it_data = lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '3' msg = 'Summe der Verbindungsnummern korrekt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_column.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_dynamic_column_sum=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_line>-connid = '001'. <fs_line>-price = '100.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_column_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_dynamic_column( iv_column_name = 'NONEXISTENT' it_data = lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '0.00' msg = 'Summe bei ungültiger Spalte ist 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit Feldsymbolen ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit, was für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen unerlässlich ist. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field-Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).

Instructions: Rufe dynamisch eine Methode der Klasse `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` auf, um einen Zellwert zu setzen. Die Methode und der Wert sollen dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Nutze `CALL METHOD` mit `(lv_method_name)` und `ASSIGN` für die Parameterübergabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_excel_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_cell_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_row         TYPE i
        iv_column      TYPE i
        iv_value       TYPE string
        io_excel       TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_excel_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_cell_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sheet> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_sheet = io_excel->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ). " Get first sheet
        ASSIGN lo_sheet TO <fs_sheet>.

        IF <fs_sheet> IS ASSIGNED.
          CALL METHOD <fs_sheet>->(iv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              ip_row    = iv_row
              ip_column = iv_column
              ip_value  = iv_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
