Instructions: Lese Daten aus einer Excel-Datei in eine dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle. Die Struktur der Tabelle soll aus der ersten Zeile der Excel-Datei (Header) abgeleitet werden.
hint: Kombiniere `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Lesen, `cl_abap_structdescr` zur dynamischen Strukturdefinition und `CREATE DATA` mit `ASSIGN` für die dynamische Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_excel_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_excel_to_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_excel_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_excel_to_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet,
          lt_header TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string,
          ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_col_count TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_row> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( iv_xstring = iv_xstring ).
        lo_sheet = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ).

        " Read header row to determine structure
        lv_col_count = lo_sheet->get_max_column_dimension( ).
        DO lv_col_count TIMES.
          DATA(lv_header_name) = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = sy-index ).
          IF lv_header_name IS INITIAL. " Stop if header is empty
            lv_col_count = sy-index - 1.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND lv_header_name TO lt_header.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_header_name type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO ls_component.
        ENDDO.

        IF ls_component IS INITIAL.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Create dynamic structure and internal table
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( ls_component ).
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        " Read data rows
        DATA(lv_row_count) = lo_sheet->get_max_row_dimension( ).
        LOOP AT lt_header ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_header_name>).
          DO lv_row_count - 1 TIMES.
            DATA(lv_row_index) = sy-index + 1.
            DATA(lv_col_index) = sy-tabix.
            DATA(lv_cell_value) = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_index ip_column = lv_col_index ).

            IF <fs_table> IS NOT INITIAL.
              IF lv_col_index = 1. " First column, create new row
                APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
              ENDIF.
              IF <fs_row> IS ASSIGNED.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_header_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>.
                IF sy-subrc = 0.
                  <fs_field> = lv_cell_value.
                ENDIF.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDDO.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        CLEAR ro_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iteriere dynamisch durch Zeilen und Spalten eines Excel-Arbeitsblatts und lese die Werte aus, bis eine leere Zelle gefunden wird.
hint: Nutze `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Zugriff und `ASSIGN` in einer Schleife, um die Zellwerte zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_t_cell_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sheet_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_values) TYPE ty_t_cell_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sheet_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet,
          lv_row   TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col   TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_value TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( iv_xstring = iv_xstring ).
        lo_sheet = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ).

        DO.
          lv_col = 1.
          DATA(lv_row_has_data) = abap_false.
          DO.
            lv_value = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ).
            IF lv_value IS NOT INITIAL.
              APPEND lv_value TO rt_all_values.
              lv_row_has_data = abap_true.
            ELSE.
              EXIT. " End of column for current row
            ENDIF.
            lv_col = lv_col + 1.
          ENDDO.

          IF lv_row_has_data = abap_false.
            EXIT. " End of rows
          ENDIF.
          lv_row = lv_row + 1.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        CLEAR rt_all_values.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportiere ausgewählte Felder der Tabelle `sflights` in eine Excel-Datei. Die Feldnamen sollen dynamisch ausgelesen und als Header verwendet werden.
hint: Verwende `SELECT` auf `sflights`, `cl_abap_structdescr` zur Feldnamensermittlung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in einer Schleife, um Feldwerte zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_excel_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_sflights_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_excel_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet,
          lv_row   TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col   TYPE i VALUE 1.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field_value> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
        lo_sheet = lo_excel->create_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'SFLIGHTS' ).

        " Get field names dynamically for header
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                                  cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_SFLIGHT_EXCEL_EXPORT=>TY_SFLIGHT_DATA' ) ).
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = <fs_component>-name ).
          lv_col = lv_col + 1.
        ENDLOOP.
        lv_row = lv_row + 1.

        " Write data rows
        LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_row>).
          lv_col = 1.
          LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) ASSIGNING <fs_component>.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_component>-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_row> TO <fs_field_value>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = CONV string( <fs_field_value> ) ).
            ENDIF.
            lv_col = lv_col + 1.
          ENDLOOP.
          lv_row = lv_row + 1.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet cx_abap_descr_ref_error.
        CLEAR rv_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle mehrere Excel-Arbeitsblätter, deren Namen dynamisch aus den Werten einer Spalte einer internen Tabelle generiert werden. Jedes Blatt soll die Daten enthalten, die zu diesem Wert gehören.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>create_sheet` mit dynamischen Namen. `ASSIGN` für den Gruppenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sheet_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sheets_by_group
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight_data
        iv_group_by_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sheet_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sheets_by_group.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lv_row   TYPE i,
          lv_col   TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_group_key> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field_value> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).

        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                                  cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_SHEET_CREATOR=>TY_SFLIGHT_DATA' ) ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight_row) GROUP BY ( key = ls_sflight_row-(iv_group_by_field) ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_by_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_group> TO <fs_group_key>.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <fs_group_key> IS INITIAL.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.

          DATA(lv_sheet_name) = CONV string( <fs_group_key> ).
          DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_excel->create_sheet( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).

          " Write header
          lv_row = 1.
          lv_col = 1.
          LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
            lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = <fs_component>-name ).
            lv_col = lv_col + 1.
          ENDLOOP.
          lv_row = lv_row + 1.

          " Write data for current group
          LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group> INTO DATA(ls_member_row).
            lv_col = 1.
            LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING <fs_component>.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_component>-name OF STRUCTURE ls_member_row TO <fs_field_value>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = CONV string( <fs_field_value> ) ).
              ENDIF.
              lv_col = lv_col + 1.
            ENDLOOP.
            lv_row = lv_row + 1.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet cx_abap_descr_ref_error cx_sy_assign_error.
        CLEAR rv_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_empty_data.

Instructions: Wende dynamisch eine bedingte Formatierung auf eine Zelle in einem Excel-Arbeitsblatt an, basierend auf einem Wert, der über `ASSIGN` ermittelt wird.
hint: `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` bietet Methoden für Zellformatierung. `ASSIGN` kann verwendet werden, um den Wert der Zelle zu überprüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_conditional_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS apply_conditional_format
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_row     TYPE i
        iv_column  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_conditional_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_conditional_format.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet,
          lv_cell_value TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( iv_xstring = iv_xstring ).
        lo_sheet = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ).

        lv_cell_value = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = iv_row ip_column = iv_column ).
        ASSIGN lv_cell_value TO <fs_value>.

        IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_value> > '100'. " Dynamische Bedingung
          DATA(lo_format) = lo_excel->create_format( ).
          lo_format->set_font_color( cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_red ).
          lo_format->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
          lo_sheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = iv_row ip_column = iv_column ip_format = lo_format ).
        ELSEIF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_value> <= '100'.
          DATA(lo_format_green) = lo_excel->create_format( ).
          lo_format_green->set_font_color( cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_green ).
          lo_sheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = iv_row ip_column = iv_column ip_format = lo_format_green ).
        ENDIF.

        rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        CLEAR rv_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf ein Attribut eines Objekts zu und ändere dessen Wert. Der Attributname wird als String übergeben.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_attribute_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_static_attribute TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Static'.
    DATA mv_instance_attribute TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Instance'.

    METHODS set_attribute_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_attribute_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_attribute_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_attribute> TYPE any.

    " Try to assign instance attribute
    ASSIGN (iv_attribute_name) OF ME TO <fs_attribute>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_attribute> = iv_new_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Try to assign static attribute
    ASSIGN (iv_attribute_name) OF CLASS zcl_dynamic_attribute_access TO <fs_attribute>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_attribute> = iv_new_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_success = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine robuste Excel-Verarbeitung, die Fehler beim dynamischen Zugriff auf Zellen oder beim Speichern der Datei abfängt.
hint: Nutze `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen von `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` und `sy-subrc` nach `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_robust_excel_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_excel_robustly
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring OPTIONAL
        iv_cell_value TYPE string DEFAULT 'Test'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_excel_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_excel_robustly.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet,
          lv_dynamic_field TYPE string VALUE 'DYNAMIC_FIELD'.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        IF iv_xstring IS INITIAL.
          lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
          lo_sheet = lo_excel->create_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Sheet1' ).
        ELSE.
          lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( iv_xstring = iv_xstring ).
          lo_sheet = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ).
        ENDIF.

        " Simulate dynamic access and potential error
        ASSIGN iv_cell_value TO <fs_data>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = CONV string( <fs_data> ) ).

        " Simulate saving
        DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).
        IF lv_result_xstring IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        ENDIF.

        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        MESSAGE 'Excel-Verarbeitung fehlgeschlagen.' TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        MESSAGE 'Dynamische Zuweisung fehlgeschlagen.' TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root.
        MESSAGE 'Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten.' TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische Struktur für eine Excel-Zeile, befülle sie mit Daten und schreibe sie dann in ein Excel-Arbeitsblatt.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Struktur und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff auf deren Komponenten. `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_excel_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_t_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS write_dynamic_row_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE ty_t_field_names
        it_field_values TYPE ty_t_field_names " Assuming values are strings for simplicity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_excel_row IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_dynamic_row_to_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet,
          ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_col TYPE i VALUE 1.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_struct> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
        lo_sheet = lo_excel->create_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'DynamicRow' ).

        " Create dynamic structure definition
        LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_name>).
          APPEND VALUE #( name = <fs_name> type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO ls_component.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF ls_component IS INITIAL.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( ls_component ).
        CREATE DATA DATA(lo_dynamic_data) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_dynamic_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_struct>.

        " Write header row
        LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING <fs_name>.
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col ip_value = <fs_name> ).
          lv_col = lv_col + 1.
        ENDLOOP.
        lv_col = 1.

        " Populate dynamic structure and write data row
        LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING <fs_name>.
          READ TABLE it_field_values INDEX sy-tabix INTO DATA(lv_value).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_struct> TO <fs_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              <fs_field> = lv_value.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        " Write data from dynamic structure to Excel
        LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING <fs_name>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_struct> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = lv_col ip_value = CONV string( <fs_field> ) ).
          ENDIF.
          lv_col = lv_col + 1.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet cx_abap_descr_ref_error cx_sy_assign_error.
        CLEAR rv_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führe eine dynamische `SELECT` Abfrage auf der Tabelle `sflights` aus, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel und die auszuwählenden Felder dynamisch als Strings übergeben werden. Die Ergebnisse sollen in einer dynamisch erstellten internen Tabelle gespeichert werden.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische interne Tabelle und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff. Die `SELECT` Anweisung muss dynamisch konstruiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_fields_list TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE'
        iv_where_clause TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID = ''LH'''
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA: lv_select_statement TYPE string,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_field_name TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_row> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        " Determine structure from fields_list
        SPLIT iv_fields_list AT ',' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_fields).
        LOOP AT lt_fields ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_token>).
          lv_field_name = to_upper( trim( <fs_field_token> ) ).
          APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_field_name type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO lt_components.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        " Construct dynamic SELECT statement
        lv_select_statement = |
          SELECT { iv_fields_list } FROM sflight
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<fs_table>
          WHERE { iv_where_clause }.
        |.

        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement }
        ENDEXEC.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error cx_abap_descr_ref_error cx_sy_assign_error.
        CLEAR ro_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe dynamisch, ob ein bestimmtes Feld in einer Struktur existiert und ob es initial ist. Der Feldname wird als String übergeben.
hint: Nutze `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und prüfe `sy-subrc` sowie den Inhalt des Feldsymbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    METHODS is_field_initial
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_test_struct
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_initial) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS field_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_test_struct
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_field_initial.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF <fs_field> IS INITIAL.
        rv_is_initial = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_is_initial = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Field does not exist, consider it not initial (or handle as error)
      rv_is_initial = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD field_exists.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Excel-Datei mit mehreren Arbeitsblättern und benenne diese dynamisch. Füge dann in jedes Blatt einen spezifischen Text ein.
hint: Nutze `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` und `create_sheet` in einer Schleife mit dynamischen Blattnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_sheet_excel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_t_sheet_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_multi_sheet_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_sheet_names TYPE ty_t_sheet_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_sheet_excel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).

        LOOP AT it_sheet_names ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sheet_name>).
          DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_excel->create_sheet( iv_sheet_name = <fs_sheet_name> ).
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = |Data for { <fs_sheet_name> }| ).
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        CLEAR rv_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führe eine dynamische `LOOP AT` Anweisung auf einer internen Tabelle aus, deren Name und die zu verarbeitende Zeile dynamisch übergeben werden. Greife dabei auf eine dynamische Komponente der Zeile zu.
hint: Nutze `ASSIGN (lv_table_name) TO <fs_table>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_loop_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-DATA gt_global_data TYPE ty_t_data.

    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_values) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_loop_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_row> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND CONV string( <fs_component> ) TO rt_processed_values.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopiere ein Arbeitsblatt innerhalb einer Excel-Datei und benenne das neue Blatt dynamisch um.
hint: Nutze `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` und die Methode `copy_sheet`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_sheet_copier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_and_rename_sheet
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring        TYPE xstring
        iv_source_sheet   TYPE string
        iv_target_sheet   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_sheet_copier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_and_rename_sheet.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( iv_xstring = iv_xstring ).
        DATA(lo_source_sheet) = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_name( iv_source_sheet ).

        IF lo_source_sheet IS BOUND.
          lo_excel->copy_sheet( ip_source_sheet = lo_source_sheet ip_target_sheet_name = iv_target_sheet ).
          rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        CLEAR rv_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzeit (in Minuten) aller Termine in einer Liste. Nutzen Sie hierfür `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_tstmp`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um über die Termine zu iterieren und `cl_abap_tstmp=>diff` um die Dauer jedes Termins zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_calc_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_duration_minutes
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_calc_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_duration_minutes.
    rv_total_minutes = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_minutes = 0
      FOR appointment IN it_appointments
      LET timestamp_from = appointment->get_timestamp_from( )
          timestamp_to   = appointment->get_timestamp_to( )
          duration_seconds = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = timestamp_to iv_tstmp2 = timestamp_from )
      IN
        total_minutes + ( duration_seconds / 60 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_app_calc_duration( ).
    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment(
      ( NEW cl_appointment( i_subject = 'Kurz' i_date_from = sy-datum i_time_from = '090000' i_date_to = sy-datum i_time_to = '093000' ) ) " 30 min
      ( NEW cl_appointment( i_subject = 'Lang' i_date_from = sy-datum i_time_from = '100000' i_date_to = sy-datum i_time_to = '110000' ) ) " 60 min
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_minutes) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_duration_minutes( lt_appointments ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_minutes exp = 90 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von `cl_appointment`-Objekten basierend auf Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Jeder Flug soll als Termin repräsentiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration und `FOR` mit `VALUE` um die Daten zu transformieren und Termine zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_sflights_to_app DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_appointments_from_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_sflights_to_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_appointments_from_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate deptime arrtime
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL.

    rt_appointments = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_subject = |Flug { flight-carrid } { flight-connid }|
          lv_timestamp_dep = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( iv_date = flight-fldate iv_time = flight-deptime )
          lv_timestamp_arr = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( iv_date = flight-fldate iv_time = flight-arrtime )
      IN
        ( NEW cl_appointment(
            i_subject = lv_subject,
            i_date_from = flight-fldate,
            i_time_from = flight-deptime,
            i_date_to = flight-fldate,
            i_time_to = flight-arrtime,
            i_timestamp_from = lv_timestamp_dep,
            i_timestamp_to = lv_timestamp_arr
          ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_appointments.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_app_sflights_to_app( ).
    DATA(lt_appointments) = lo_converter->create_appointments_from_sflights( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_appointments ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_appointments ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_appointments[ 1 ]->get_subject( )+0(2) exp = 'Fl' ). " Check if subject starts with 'Fl'
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

String-Templates (`|...|`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit bei der String-Formatierung.
keywords: cl_appointment, SFLIGHTS, SELECT, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, Data Transformation

CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_property DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_gui_ecl_2dviewer_mock. " Mock-Interface für Testbarkeit

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS set_object_property
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id TYPE string
        iv_property_name TYPE string
        iv_property_value TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_property,
             object_id TYPE string,
             property_name TYPE string,
             property_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_object_property.
    DATA mt_object_properties TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object_property WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_gui_ecl_2dviewer_mock.
  METHODS get_object_property
    IMPORTING
      iv_object_id TYPE string
      iv_property_name TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_property_value) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_property IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_object_property.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde hier eine Methode des mo_viewer aufgerufen werden,
    " z.B. mo_viewer->set_property( i_object_id = iv_object_id i_property = iv_property_name i_value = iv_property_value ).
    " Für die Testbarkeit speichern wir die Eigenschaft intern.
    DATA(ls_property) = VALUE ty_object_property(
      object_id = iv_object_id
      property_name = iv_property_name
      property_value = iv_property_value
    ).

    " Beispiel für COND/SWITCH basierend auf Property-Name
    CASE iv_property_name.
      WHEN 'COLOR'.
        " Hier könnte spezifische Logik für Farbe stehen
        APPEND ls_property TO mt_object_properties.
      WHEN 'VISIBILITY'.
        " Hier könnte spezifische Logik für Sichtbarkeit stehen
        APPEND ls_property TO mt_object_properties.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        APPEND ls_property TO mt_object_properties.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_gui_ecl_2dviewer_mock~get_object_property.
    TRY.
        rv_property_value = mt_object_properties[ object_id = iv_object_id AND property_name = iv_property_name ]-property_value.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Property not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` in ein Format, das für die Visualisierung von Linien (z.B. Flugrouten) in einem 2D Viewer geeignet ist. Simulieren Sie hierfür die Erstellung von Start- und Endpunkten für Liniensegmente.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` um die `SFLIGHTS`-Daten in eine interne Tabelle von Liniensegmenten zu konvertieren. Nehmen Sie an, dass Sie simulierte Koordinaten haben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_sflights_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_line_segment,
             start_x TYPE i,
             start_y TYPE i,
             end_x   TYPE i,
             end_y   TYPE i,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid  TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_line_segment.
    TYPES: tt_line_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_line_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_routes_as_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_line_segments) TYPE tt_line_segments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_sflights_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_routes_as_lines.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL.

    " Simulierte Koordinaten für Flughäfen (Beispiel)
    DATA(lt_airport_coords) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF struct_airport_coords(
      ( airport_id = 'FRA' x = 100 y = 100 )
      ( airport_id = 'JFK' x = 500 y = 200 )
      ( airport_id = 'LHR' x = 150 y = 150 )
      ( airport_id = 'MUC' x = 120 y = 80 )
    ).

    rt_line_segments = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_from_airport = flight-carrid && flight-connid+0(1) " Vereinfachte Annahme für Startflughafen
          lv_to_airport   = flight-carrid && flight-connid+1(1) " Vereinfachte Annahme für Zielflughafen
          ls_start_coord  = VALUE struct_airport_coords( lt_airport_coords[ airport_id = lv_from_airport DEFAULT x = 0 y = 0 ] )
          ls_end_coord    = VALUE struct_airport_coords( lt_airport_coords[ airport_id = lv_to_airport DEFAULT x = 0 y = 0 ] )
      IN
        ( start_x = ls_start_coord-x,
          start_y = ls_start_coord-y,
          end_x   = ls_end_coord-x,
          end_y   = ls_end_coord-y,
          carrid  = flight-carrid,
          connid  = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Hilfsstruktur für simulierte Flughafenkoordinaten
TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_airport_coords,
         airport_id TYPE string,
         x TYPE i,
         y TYPE i,
       END OF struct_airport_coords.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_lines ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein `cl_appointment`-Objekt gültige Start- und Endzeitstempel hat. Nutzen Sie `COND` für eine kompakte Prüfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` um eine boolesche Variable basierend auf der Initialität der Zeitstempel zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_check_validity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_appointment_valid
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_check_validity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_appointment_valid.
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN io_appointment IS NOT INITIAL AND
           io_appointment->get_timestamp_from( ) IS NOT INITIAL AND
           io_appointment->get_timestamp_to( ) IS NOT INITIAL
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` um die Termine zu gruppieren und die Anzahl pro Gruppe zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_group_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointments_per_day,
             date TYPE d,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_appointments_per_day.
    TYPES: tt_appointments_per_day TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointments_per_day WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_appointments_per_day.

CLASS zcl_app_group_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_by_date.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF appointment IN it_appointments
      GROUP BY ( date = appointment->get_date_from( ) ) ASCENDING
      WITHOUT MEMBERS
      ( date = CORRESPONDING #( appointment )->date,
        count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment(

      ( NEW cl_appointment( i_subject = 'T2' i_date_from = '20250101' i_time_from = '110000' i_date_to = '20250101' i_time_to = '120000' ) )
      ( NEW cl_appointment( i_subject = 'T3' i_date_from = '20250102' i_time_from = '130000' i_date_to = '20250102' i_time_to = '140000' ) )
    ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Instanziierung des `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block kapselt, um mögliche Ausnahmen abzufangen. Nutzen Sie `MESSAGE ... INTO`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_root` um alle Ausnahmen abzufangen und die Fehlermeldung mit `MESSAGE ... INTO` zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_viewer_safely
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_viewer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_viewer_safely.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_viewer
          EXPORTING
            parent = io_container.

    CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        DATA(lv_error_message) = lx_exception->get_text( ).
        " In einem echten Szenario könnte hier eine detailliertere Fehlerbehandlung erfolgen,
        " z.B. Protokollierung oder Benachrichtigung des Benutzers.
        MESSAGE e000(sy) WITH lv_error_message INTO DATA(lv_msg_text).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lv_msg_text.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_viewer_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_viewer_failure RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_viewer_success.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_ecl_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).

    DATA(lo_viewer) = lo_handler->create_viewer_safely( lo_container ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_viewer ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_viewer_failure.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_ecl_error_handling( ).
    " Simulieren eines Fehlers, indem ein ungültiger Container übergeben wird
    " (z.B. ein Container, der bereits zerstört wurde oder nicht existiert)
    " Hier wird ein NULL-Container übergeben, was zu einem Fehler führen sollte.
    DATA(lo_invalid_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    TRY.
        lo_handler->create_viewer_safely( lo_invalid_container ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception was caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` ist essentiell für eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung in modernem ABAP. Das Abfangen von `cx_root` stellt sicher, dass alle Ausnahmen behandelt werden. `MESSAGE ... INTO` ist eine moderne Art, Fehlermeldungen aus Ausnahmen zu extrahieren und weiterzuverarbeiten, anstatt sie direkt auf dem Bildschirm auszugeben.
keywords: cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, cx_root, MESSAGE INTO

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine eindeutige ID für ein Objekt im 2D Viewer generiert, indem sie String-Templates verwendet.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_object_id) TYPE string.

    rv_object_id = |{ iv_prefix }-{ iv_index ALPHA = OUT }|.

solution:
CLASS zcl_math_safe_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_divisor  TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_default  TYPE p DECIMALS 2 OPTIONAL

        VALUE(rv_quotient) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

CLASS zcl_math_safe_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_divide.
    DATA(lv_result) = iv_dividend.
    TRY.

      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_quotient = COND #( WHEN iv_default IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_default ELSE '0.00' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `DIVIDE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um Summe und Anzahl zu aggregieren, und dann den `DIVIDE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR ls_flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ( ls_flight ) ).

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( "REDUCE expression to aggregate sum and count
        INIT sum_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2 = 0
             count     TYPE i = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT
            sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
            count     = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count > 0.
      DATA(lv_avg) = ls_aggregation-sum_price.
      lv_avg DIVIDE ls_aggregation-count.
      rv_avg_price = lv_avg.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = '0.00'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_avg ). " Placeholder, as SFLIGHTS content is unknown.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum und geben Sie einen deutschen Namen zurück. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` mit dem Systemfeld `sy-datum` und der Funktion `cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        id_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_switch_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday( id_date ).

    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH string(
      lv_weekday
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Sonntag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Samstag'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekday_monday.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ls_flight_line-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid    = ls_flight_line-carrid
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE
        total_price = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2(
                        INIT sum = '0.00'
                        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight_line
                        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ) ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    " Assuming SFLIGHTS contains:
    " LH, 0400, 100.00
    " LH, 0401, 200.00
    " AA, 0017, 300.00
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 groups' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ KEY carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-num_flights exp = 2 msg = 'LH num flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-total_price exp = '300.00' msg = 'LH total price' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_summary[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-num_flights exp = 1 msg = 'AA num flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-total_price exp = '300.00' msg = 'AA total price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_summary_empty.
    " This test would require mocking sflights to be empty.
    " For now, we assume sflights is not empty in the system.
    " If sflights could be empty, the result should be an empty table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summary ). " This would be the assertion if sflights was empty.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ). " Assuming sflights is not empty.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine sehr mächtige Funktion in ABAP 7.55, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Schleife können komplexe Aggregationen deklarativ und effizient durchgeführt werden.

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) in einen JSON-String. Beschränke die Ausgabe auf die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate`.
hint: Nutze `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize` mit einer internen Tabelle und optional `pretty_print` für bessere Lesbarkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_sflight_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_sflight_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_reduced(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid, connid = ls_sflight-connid, fldate = ls_sflight-fldate )
    ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = lt_sflights
        pretty_print = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_serialize_sflights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_sflights.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_json_sflight_serializer( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_serializer->serialize_sflights( iv_max_rows = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' act = lv_json exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should be an array' pattern = '[' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain carrid' pattern = '"carrid"' act = lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain fldate' pattern = '"fldate"' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `FOR`-Iteration innerhalb von `VALUE` ist eine moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu füllen. `pretty_print` verbessert die Lesbarkeit des JSON-Outputs. Die Verwendung von `sflights` zeigt die Integration mit Datenbanktabellen.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein Eingabeparameter (z.B. eine ID) leer ist. Die Ausnahme soll von `cx_static_check` erben.
hint: Definiere eine globale oder lokale Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt, und nutze `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_id.
    IF iv_id IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_validate_id_valid FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validate_id_valid.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_input_validator( ).
    lo_validator->validate_id( 'VALID_ID' ).
    " No exception should be raised
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_validate_id_invalid.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_input_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_validator->validate_id( '' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_invalid_input was not raised' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung und Verwendung einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme. Die Ausnahme `zcx_invalid_input` erbt von `cx_static_check`, was bedeutet, dass sie deklariert und abgefangen werden muss. `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` ist die moderne Syntax zum Auslösen von Ausnahmen. Der Unit Test demonstriert, wie man sowohl den Erfolgsfall als auch den Fehlerfall (erwartete Ausnahme) testet.

Instructions: Deserialisiere einen JSON-String. Fange die Ausnahme ab, wenn der JSON-String syntaktisch ungültig ist, und gib eine spezifische Fehlermeldung zurück, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen.
hint: Nutze `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_json_parser_error` um Fehler beim Parsen abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_safe_deserializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        es_data        TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_safe_deserializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_safe.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = es_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_parser_error).
        rv_error_message = |JSON-Parsing-Fehler: { lx_parser_error->get_text( ) }|.
        CLEAR es_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        rv_error_message = |JSON-Konvertierungsfehler: { lx_conversion_error->get_text( ) }|.
        CLEAR es_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcx_empty_json_output DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_empty_json_output IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_validated_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS serialize_and_validate
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_empty_json_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_validated_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_and_validate.
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data   = is_data
      RECEIVING
        json   = rv_json_string
    ).

    IF rv_json_string IS INITIAL AND NOT is_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_json_output
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_empty_json_output=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_json_validated_serializer( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'JSON string should be empty for empty input' act = lv_json exp = '{}' ).

  METHOD test_serialize_problematic_data.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_json_validated_serializer( ).
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_json_validated_serializer=>ty_data.
    " Simulate a scenario where serialization might yield empty JSON for non-empty data
    " (e.g., if 'data' was a reference to an empty object, or a complex type not handled by cl_json)
    " For simplicity, we'll force a scenario where the JSON is empty but input is not.
    " In a real scenario, cl_json is robust, so this exception would be rare.
    ls_data-key = 'problem'.
    ls_data-value = 'data'.

    TRY.
        " To trigger the exception, we'd need a scenario where cl_json returns empty JSON for non-empty data.
        " This is hard to simulate realistically without modifying cl_json behavior.
        " For this example, let's assume a hypothetical case where it happens.
        " In practice, this check is more for post-serialization validation logic.
        DATA(lv_json) = lo_serializer->serialize_and_validate( ls_data ).
        IF lv_json = '{}'. " Simulate the problematic case for testing
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_json_output.
        ENDIF.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' act = lv_json ).
      CATCH zcx_empty_json_output.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Exception caught as expected
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      EXPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_safe.
    TRY.
        ev_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_error_message = |Fehler bei Division: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.

Instructions: Lese Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights`, transformiere sie in eine interne Tabelle mit einer spezifischen Struktur und serialisiere diese dann in einen JSON-String. Verwende dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Transformation.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_json_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date  TYPE s_date,
             price        TYPE s_price,
             currency     TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_as_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_json_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_as_json.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_raw.

    DATA(lt_flight_info) = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrier_id    = ls_raw-carrid,
        connection_id = ls_raw-connid,
        flight_date   = ls_raw-fldate,
        price         = ls_raw-price,
        currency      = ls_raw-currency )
    ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = lt_flight_info
        pretty_print = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_serialize_nested_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_serialize_with_error FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_json_serialization_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_nested_structure.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_nested_json_serializer( ).
    DATA: ls_person TYPE zcl_nested_json_serializer=>ty_person.
    ls_person-name = 'Max Mustermann'.
    ls_person-age = 30.
    ls_person-address-street = 'Musterstr. 1'.
    ls_person-address-city = 'Musterstadt'.

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_serializer->serialize_person( ls_person ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain name' pattern = '"name":"Max Mustermann"' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain street' pattern = '"street":"Musterstr. 1"' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_serialize_with_error.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_nested_json_serializer( ).
    DATA: ls_person TYPE zcl_nested_json_serializer=>ty_person.
    " Simulate a scenario that might cause a serialization error.
    " cl_json is very robust, so directly causing cx_sy_json_serializer_error is hard.
    " For testing, we can simulate by calling a method that is known to fail or by passing a problematic object.
    " Here, we'll just call with an empty person, which should serialize to an empty object, not an error.
    " To truly test the CATCH, one would need a more complex, non-serializable data type.
    " For demonstration, let's assume an empty person *could* lead to an error in a hypothetical scenario.
    " In reality, cl_json handles empty structures gracefully.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_json) = lo_serializer->serialize_person( ls_person ).
        IF lv_json = '{}'. " If it serializes to an empty object, it's not an error for cl_json.
          " To trigger the CATCH, we would need a data type that cl_json cannot handle.
          " For this test, we'll manually raise the custom exception if the JSON is empty for a non-empty input (which is not the case here).
          " A more realistic test would involve a data type that cl_json explicitly cannot serialize.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Empty JSON expected for empty input' act = lv_json exp = '{}' ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH zcx_json_serialization_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Exception caught as expected
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Serialisierung geschachtelter ABAP-Strukturen in JSON. Es beinhaltet auch die Fehlerbehandlung für `cx_sy_json_serializer_error`, die auftreten könnte, wenn `cl_json` auf Probleme bei der Konvertierung komplexer oder nicht unterstützter Datentypen stößt. Eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme wird ausgelöst, um den Fehler auf einer höheren Ebene zu signalisieren.
keywords: JSON, Serialize, Geschachtelte Struktur, Exception, TRY CATCH, cx_sy_json_serializer_error, /ui2/cl_json

Instructions: Deserialisiere einen JSON-String in eine ABAP-Struktur. Nach der Deserialisierung soll eine Validierung der Daten erfolgen. Wenn ein Pflichtfeld fehlt oder ungültig ist, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Führe nach der Deserialisierung eine explizite Prüfung der Felder durch und nutze `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` bei Validierungsfehlern.
solution:
CLASS zcx_data_validation_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        field_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
    DATA: field_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_data_validation_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->field_name = field_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_validated_deserializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             product_id TYPE string,
             quantity   TYPE i,
             price      TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_order_item.

    METHODS deserialize_and_validate
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_order_item) TYPE ty_order_item
      RAISING
        cx_sy_json_parser_error
        cx_sy_conversion_error
        zcx_data_validation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_validated_deserializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_and_validate.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = rs_order_item
        ).

        IF rs_order_item-product_id IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_validation_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_data_validation_error=>default_text
              field_name = 'PRODUCT_ID'.
        ENDIF.
        IF rs_order_item-quantity LE 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_validation_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_data_validation_error=>default_text
              field_name = 'QUANTITY'.
        ENDIF.
        IF rs_order_item-price LE 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_validation_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_data_validation_error=>default_text
              field_name = 'PRICE'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_parser_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_validation_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_data_validation_error=>default_text
            field_name = 'JSON_SYNTAX'
            previous = lx_parser_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_validation_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_data_validation_error=>default_text
            field_name = 'TYPE_CONVERSION'
            previous = lx_conversion_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_deserialize_and_validate_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_deserialize_and_validate_missing_id FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_data_validation_error.
    METHODS test_deserialize_and_validate_invalid_quantity FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_data_validation_error.
    METHODS test_deserialize_and_validate_invalid_json FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_data_validation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_and_validate_valid.
    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_json_validated_deserializer( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"product_id":"ITEM001","quantity":5,"price":10.50}'.

    DATA(ls_item) = lo_deserializer->deserialize_and_validate( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Product ID mismatch' act = ls_item-product_id exp = 'ITEM001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Quantity mismatch' act = ls_item-quantity exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_and_validate_missing_id.
    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_json_validated_deserializer( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"quantity":5,"price":10.50}'. " Missing product_id

    TRY.
        lo_deserializer->deserialize_and_validate( lv_json ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_data_validation_error for missing product_id' ).
      CATCH zcx_data_validation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect field name in exception' act = lx_error->field_name exp = 'PRODUCT_ID' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_and_validate_invalid_quantity.
    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_json_validated_deserializer( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"product_id":"ITEM002","quantity":0,"price":10.50}'. " Invalid quantity

    TRY.
        lo_deserializer->deserialize_and_validate( lv_json ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_data_validation_error for invalid quantity' ).
      CATCH zcx_data_validation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect field name in exception' act = lx_error->field_name exp = 'QUANTITY' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_and_validate_invalid_json.
    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_json_validated_deserializer( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"product_id":"ITEM003","quantity":5,"price":10.50'. " Malformed JSON

    TRY.
        lo_deserializer->deserialize_and_validate( lv_json ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_data_validation_error for invalid JSON syntax' ).
      CATCH zcx_data_validation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect field name in exception' act = lx_error->field_name exp = 'JSON_SYNTAX' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine umfassende Fehlerbehandlung und Datenvalidierung nach der JSON-Deserialisierung. Es fängt sowohl technische JSON-Fehler (`cx_sy_json_parser_error`, `cx_sy_conversion_error`) als auch anwendungsspezifische Validierungsfehler (z.B. fehlende Pflichtfelder, ungültige Werte) ab. Eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme `zcx_data_validation_error` wird verwendet, um detaillierte Informationen über den Validierungsfehler zu liefern, einschließlich des betroffenen Feldnamens.
keywords: JSON, Deserialize, Validierung, Exception, TRY CATCH, RAISE EXCEPTION, /ui2/cl_json, Datenvalidierung

Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen den Tabellen `SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR` durch, um Flugdaten zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft abzurufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `SELECT` Anweisung mit `INNER JOIN` und `INTO TABLE @DATA()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_join_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_data
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN`, `WHERE`-Klausel, `GROUP BY` und eine Aggregatfunktion wie `AVG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_prices_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_date_from TYPE s_date DEFAULT '20000101'
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_prices_by_carrier.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, AVG( s~price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~fldate > @iv_date_from
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_prices_by_carrier( '20000101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_avg).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_avg-avg_price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `INNER JOIN` mit `WHERE` für Filterung und `GROUP BY` mit der Aggregatfunktion `AVG` in einer einzigen Open SQL-Anweisung. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Muster, um aggregierte Daten direkt aus der Datenbank abzurufen, was die Datenverarbeitung im ABAP-Programm reduziert und die Performance verbessert.
keywords: JOINS, SELECT, GROUP BY, AVG, Open SQL, Aggregatfunktionen

Instructions: Rufen Sie Flugdaten zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft und den Namen der Abflug- und Ankunftsflughäfen ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `INNER JOIN`s, um `SFLIGHTS`, `SCARR` und `SAIRPORT` zu verbinden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_multi_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_full_data,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname   TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             price      TYPE s_price,
             currency   TYPE s_currcode,
             airport_from TYPE sairport-city,
             airport_to   TYPE sairport-city,

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_full_data) TYPE tt_flight_full_data.

CLASS zcl_join_multi_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_full_flight_details.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, s~currency,
           apf~city AS airport_from, apt~city AS airport_to
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INNER JOIN sairport AS apf ON s~airpfrom = apf~id
      INNER JOIN sairport AS apt ON s~airpto = apt~id
      INTO TABLE @rt_full_data
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies vermeidet redundante Datenbankzugriffe und verbessert die Datenkonsistenz und Performance.

Instructions: Rufen Sie Flugdaten ab und klassifizieren Sie den Flugpreis direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung als 'Günstig', 'Standard' oder 'Teuer' basierend auf einem Schwellenwert, während Sie den Fluggesellschaftsnamen mit einem `INNER JOIN` hinzufügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Expression innerhalb der `SELECT`-Liste in Kombination mit einem `INNER JOIN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_case_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_cat,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate      TYPE s_date,
             price       TYPE s_price,
             price_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_price_cat.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_cat TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_cat WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_price_category
      IMPORTING iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price DEFAULT 500
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_price_cat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_case_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_price_category.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price,
           CASE WHEN s~price < @iv_price_threshold THEN 'Günstig'
                WHEN s~price >= @iv_price_threshold AND s~price < ( @iv_price_threshold * 2 ) THEN 'Standard'
                ELSE 'Teuer'
           END AS price_category
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_data
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).

    ENDIF.

In Kombination mit `JOIN`s können so angereicherte Daten direkt von der Datenbank abgerufen werden, was die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing im ABAP-Programm reduziert und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: JOINS, SELECT, CASE Expression, Open SQL, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die Flüge mit einer bestimmten Währung anbieten, und zeigen Sie deren Namen an. Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` und eine Subquery oder `EXISTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN` und eine `EXISTS`-Klausel mit einer Subquery, um die Filterung zu implementieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_currency,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_currency.
    TYPES tt_carrier_currency TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_currency WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_by_currency
      IMPORTING iv_currency TYPE s_currcode DEFAULT 'EUR'
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_currency.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_by_currency.
    SELECT DISTINCT c~carrid, c~carrname
      FROM scarr AS c
      INNER JOIN sflights AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sflights
                         WHERE carrid = s~carrid AND currency = @iv_currency )
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exists_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exists_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_by_currency( 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'LH should offer EUR flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet einen `INNER JOIN` in Kombination mit einer `EXISTS`-Subquery in der `WHERE`-Klausel. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um zu prüfen, ob in einer verknüpften Tabelle Zeilen existieren, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, ohne die Daten der Subquery selbst abrufen zu müssen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Textanhang, der aus einer internen Tabelle generiert wurde, und senden Sie diese über den Business Communication Service (BCS).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BCS_CONVERT` zur Konvertierung und `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS` sowie `CL_BCS` zum Erstellen und Senden der E-Mail.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
        it_attachment_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA: lo_bcs         TYPE REF TO cl_bcs,
          lo_document    TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs,
          lo_recipient   TYPE REF TO if_recipient_bcs,
          lt_solix_attach TYPE solix_tab,
          lv_size        TYPE i.

    " Convert text table to SOLIX_TAB
    DATA(lv_string) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR <line> IN it_attachment_text NEXT s = s && <line> && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string   = lv_string
        iv_codepage = '1100'
      IMPORTING
        et_solix    = lt_solix_attach
        ev_size     = lv_size
    ).

    " Create document
    lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE sol_tab( ( line = 'Siehe Anhang.' ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    " Add attachment
    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
      i_attachment_subject = 'Anhang.txt'
      i_attachment_size    = lv_size
      i_att_content_hex    = lt_solix_attach
    ).

    " Create send request
    lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add recipient
    lo_recipient = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
      iv_address_string = iv_recipient_email
    ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient ).

    " Send email
    lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = 'X' ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA lt_attach_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    APPEND 'Testzeile 1' TO lt_attach_text.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_send_email( ).

    lo_cut->send_email_with_attachment(

  ENDMETHOD.
