Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR` durch und verwenden Sie eine `HAVING`-Klausel, um nur Fluggesellschaften anzuzeigen, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN`, `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` mit einer Aggregatfunktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT( * ) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_having_clause FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_having_clause.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_having( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_min_flights( 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_flights).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_flights-flight_count > 50 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `HAVING`-Klausel in Open SQL ermöglicht es, Gruppen von Zeilen, die durch `GROUP BY` gebildet wurden, basierend auf Aggregatfunktionen zu filtern. In Kombination mit `INNER JOIN` ist dies eine sehr effiziente Methode, um komplexe Filterungen direkt auf der Datenbankebene durchzuführen, was die Datenmenge, die an das ABAP-Programm übertragen wird, erheblich reduziert.
keywords: JOINS, SELECT, GROUP BY, HAVING, Open SQL, Aggregatfunktionen, Filtering

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_binary_search_found FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_binary_search_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_search_xstring( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_binary_search_xstring=>tt_xstring_data(
      ( id = 1 content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->string_to_xstring( 'Alpha' ) )
      ( id = 2 content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->string_to_xstring( 'Beta' ) )
      ( id = 3 content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->string_to_xstring( 'Gamma' ) )
    ).

    DATA(ls_found) = lo_cut->find_xstring_entry( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Entry should be found' act = sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->xstring_to_string( ls_found-content ) exp = 'Beta' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_binary_search_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_search_xstring( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_binary_search_xstring=>tt_xstring_data(
      ( id = 1 content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->string_to_xstring( 'Alpha' ) )
      ( id = 3 content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->string_to_xstring( 'Gamma' ) )
    ).

    DATA(ls_found) = lo_cut->find_xstring_entry( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Entry should not be found' act = sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_found-id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die binäre Suche (`BINARY SEARCH`) ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Einträge in großen, sortierten internen Tabellen zu finden. Durch die Verwendung von `SORTED TABLE` mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel wird die Performance weiter optimiert, da die Tabelle immer sortiert bleibt.
keywords: Internal Tables, XSTRING, Binary Search, Performance, SORTED TABLE

CLASS zcl_read_binary_file IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             doc_id    TYPE so_obj_id,
             doc_type  TYPE so_obj_tp,
             doc_descr TYPE so_obj_des,
             created_by TYPE syuname,
             created_at TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.

        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey

CLASS zcl_gos_query_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments_for_object.
    DATA(ls_borident) = VALUE borident(
      objtype = iv_object_type
      objkey  = iv_object_key
    ).

    DATA(lt_attachments_raw) = cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachment_list( is_object = ls_borident ).

    rt_attachments = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_attachments_raw (
      doc_id    = ls_raw-doc_id
      doc_type  = ls_raw-doc_type
      doc_descr = ls_raw-doc_descr
      created_by = ls_raw-created_by
      created_at = ls_raw-created_at
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die abgerufenen GOS-Anlagen nach Dateityp (z.B. 'PDF') und Erstellungsdatum (z.B. nur Anlagen der letzten 30 Tage) unter Verwendung moderner Tabellenausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `COND` mit Datumskalkulationen wie `sy-datum - 30`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             doc_id    TYPE so_obj_id,
             doc_type  TYPE so_obj_tp,
             doc_descr TYPE so_obj_des,
             created_by TYPE syuname,
             created_at TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_attachments
      IMPORTING
        it_all_attachments TYPE tt_attachment_info
        iv_doc_type        TYPE so_obj_tp OPTIONAL
        iv_days_old_max    TYPE i DEFAULT 0 " 0 means no date filter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_attachments.
    DATA(lv_date_limit) = COND d( WHEN iv_days_old_max > 0 THEN sy-datum - iv_days_old_max ELSE '00000000' ).

    rt_filtered_attachments = FILTER #( it_all_attachments USING KEY primary
      WHERE ( iv_doc_type IS INITIAL OR doc_type = iv_doc_type )
      AND   ( iv_days_old_max = 0 OR created_at >= lv_date_limit ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Anlagen pro Business-Objekt-Typ aus einer Liste von GOS-Anlagen-Informationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der Aggregatfunktion `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_count_by_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_detail,
             object_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             doc_id      TYPE so_obj_id,
           END OF ty_attachment_detail.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_type_count,
             object_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             attachment_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_object_type_count.
    TYPES: tt_object_type_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object_type_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_attachments_by_object_type
      IMPORTING
        it_all_attachments TYPE tt_attachment_detail
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_object_type_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_count_by_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_attachments_by_object_type.
    LOOP AT it_all_attachments INTO DATA(ls_attachment)
         GROUP BY ls_attachment-object_type ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE ty_object_type_count(
        object_type = ls_group_key-object_type
        attachment_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_from_raw_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xstring_from_raw_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xstring_from_raw_table.
    rv_xstring = REDUCE xstring( INIT xstr = ''
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
      NEXT xstr = xstring( |{ xstr }{ ls_raw }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_stats_by_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_detail,
             object_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             object_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             doc_id      TYPE so_obj_id,
             size_bytes  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_detail.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_type_stats,
             object_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             attachment_count TYPE i,
             total_size_bytes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_object_type_stats.
    TYPES: tt_object_type_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object_type_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachment_stats_by_object_type
      IMPORTING
        it_all_attachments TYPE tt_attachment_detail
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_object_type_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_stats_by_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_stats_by_object_type.
    LOOP AT it_all_attachments INTO DATA(ls_attachment)
         GROUP BY ls_attachment-object_type ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE ty_object_type_stats(
        object_type = ls_group_key-object_type
        attachment_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_size_bytes = SUM( ls_attachment-size_bytes )
      ) TO rt_stats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen alle Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern dieser Flüge enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR Operator mit WHERE Klausel und Inline-Strukturzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_connids IMPORTING it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_connids.
    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
                          ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_frankfurt_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_frankfurt_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_for=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_connids( lt_all_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 Frankfurt flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connids[ 1 ]-table_line exp = '0400' msg = 'First connid incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connids[ 2 ]-table_line exp = '0401' msg = 'Second connid incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR Operator ermöglicht die Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. In Kombination mit der WHERE-Klausel können spezifische Einträge ausgewählt und deren Felder direkt in eine neue Tabelle projiziert werden.
keywords: FOR, Internal Table, Filter, Map, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität (seatsmax) aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight IN it_flights NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_reduce=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' seatsmax = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 450 msg = 'Expected total capacity of 450' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_reduce=>tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_total_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_empty exp = 0 msg = 'Expected total capacity of 0 for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und prägnanten Weise. Er initialisiert einen Akkumulator und wendet eine Operation auf jedes Element an, um ein Endergebnis zu erhalten.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen basierend auf der Flugnummer und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie itab[ key_field = value ] und DEFAULT für den Fall, dass kein Eintrag gefunden wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).

    TRY.
        rs_flight = lt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR rs_flight.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_table_expr( ).

    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' msg = 'Found flight cityfrom incorrect' ).

    DATA(ls_not_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_not_found_flight-carrid msg = 'Not found flight should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellen-Ausdrücke (Table Expressions) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle mittels Schlüssel oder Index. In Kombination mit TRY-CATCH können fehlende Einträge elegant behandelt werden, was den Code für das Lesen von Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: TABLE EXPRESSIONS, Internal Table, Read, Exception Handling

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für den Status eines Auftrags (z.B. 'Neu', 'In Bearbeitung', 'Abgeschlossen') und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie TYPES BEGIN OF ENUM ... END OF ENUM.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_status_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_status_type,
             new          VALUE IS INITIAL,
             in_progress  VALUE 'P',
             completed    VALUE 'C',
             cancelled    VALUE 'X',
           END OF ENUM order_status_type.

    METHODS get_status_description IMPORTING iv_status TYPE order_status_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN order_status_type-new.
        rv_description = 'Neuer Auftrag'.
      WHEN order_status_type-in_progress.
        rv_description = 'In Bearbeitung'.
      WHEN order_status_type-completed.
        rv_description = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN order_status_type-cancelled.
        rv_description = 'Storniert'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannter Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_status_description FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_order_status_enum( ).

    DATA(lv_desc_new) = lo_cut->get_status_description( zcl_order_status_enum=>order_status_type-new ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc_new exp = 'Neuer Auftrag' msg = 'Description for NEW incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_desc_progress) = lo_cut->get_status_description( zcl_order_status_enum=>order_status_type-in_progress ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc_progress exp = 'In Bearbeitung' msg = 'Description for IN_PROGRESS incorrect' ).

explanation: Enumerationen (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglichen die Definition von festen Wertemengen für Datentypen, was die Typsicherheit und Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert. Sie ersetzen oft Konstanten oder Domänen für Statusfelder und erleichtern die Wartung.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine einfache Bildverarbeitung, indem Sie eine 'Pixelmatrix' (interne Tabelle von Strukturen mit RGB-Werten) erstellen und eine Operation (z.B. Graustufenkonvertierung) darauf anwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE und FOR Ausdrücke, um die Pixelmatrix zu initialisieren und zu transformieren. Graustufen: (R+G+B)/3.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_processor_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_pixel,
             r TYPE i,
             g TYPE i,
             b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_pixel.
    TYPES: tt_pixel_row TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_pixel WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_pixel_matrix TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_pixel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sample_image RETURNING VALUE(rt_image) TYPE tt_pixel_matrix.
    METHODS convert_to_grayscale IMPORTING it_image TYPE tt_pixel_matrix RETURNING VALUE(rt_grayscale_image) TYPE tt_pixel_matrix.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_processor_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sample_image.
    " Create a 2x2 image with some colors
    rt_image = VALUE #( ( VALUE #( ( r = 255 g = 0 b = 0 ) ( r = 0 g = 255 b = 0 ) ) ) " Row 1: Red, Green
                        ( VALUE #( ( r = 0 g = 0 b = 255 ) ( r = 255 g = 255 b = 0 ) ) ) ). " Row 2: Blue, Yellow
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_to_grayscale.
    rt_grayscale_image = VALUE #( FOR row IN it_image
                                  ( VALUE #( FOR pixel IN row
                                             LET gray = ( pixel-r + pixel-g + pixel-b ) / 3 IN
                                             ( r = gray g = gray b = gray ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_grayscale_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grayscale_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_image_processor_sim( ).
    DATA(lt_original_image) = lo_cut->create_sample_image( ).
    DATA(lt_grayscale_image) = lo_cut->convert_to_grayscale( lt_original_image ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grayscale_image ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 rows' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grayscale_image[ 1 ] ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 pixels in first row' ).

    " Test first pixel (Red: 255,0,0) -> Grayscale (255+0+0)/3 = 85
    DATA(ls_pixel1) = lt_grayscale_image[ 1 ][ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_pixel1-r exp = 85 msg = 'Pixel 1 Red component incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_pixel1-g exp = 85 msg = 'Pixel 1 Green component incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_pixel1-b exp = 85 msg = 'Pixel 1 Blue component incorrect' ).

    " Test second pixel (Green: 0,255,0) -> Grayscale (0+255+0)/3 = 85
    DATA(ls_pixel2) = lt_grayscale_image[ 1 ][ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_pixel2-r exp = 85 msg = 'Pixel 2 Red component incorrect' ).

    " Test fourth pixel (Yellow: 255,255,0) -> Grayscale (255+255+0)/3 = 170
    DATA(ls_pixel4) = lt_grayscale_image[ 2 ][ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_pixel4-r exp = 170 msg = 'Pixel 4 Red component incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.

        MESSAGE lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CLEANUP.

        " but only if an exception was caught. Useful for releasing resources.
        " For this simple example, it's just a placeholder.
        " In a real scenario, you might close a database connection or file handle.
        CLEAR rv_result. " Ensure result is cleared if an error occurred
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode funktional auf, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme direkt im `TRY`-Block ab.

solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_functional_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_square_root
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS get_square_root_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_functional_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_square_root.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Cannot calculate square root of a negative number'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = sqrt( iv_number ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_square_root_safe.
    TRY.
        rv_result = calculate_square_root( iv_number = iv_number ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle the error, e.g., return a default value or log
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. " Log as warning
        rv_result = 0. " Return 0 for invalid input
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie den Index eines bestimmten Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle, nachdem diese sortiert wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` und `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` mit `sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_find_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE sy-tabix.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_find_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_index.
    DATA lt_sorted_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    lt_sorted_flights = it_flights. " Copy to avoid modifying original

    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING fldate ASCENDING.

    READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_index = sy-tabix.
    ELSE.
      rv_index = 0. " Not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_find_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_find_index( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_find_index=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' price = '200' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' )

    ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_in_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_find_index( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und fangen Sie dabei mögliche Ausnahmen ab, die während der Initialisierung auftreten könnten (z.B. Konvertierungsfehler).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE` mit `TRY...CATCH` für robuste Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_with_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_table_safe
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_with_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_table_safe.
    DATA lt_temp_data TYPE tt_data.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i VALUE 0.

    LOOP AT it_raw_data INTO DATA(lv_raw_line).
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      TRY.
          APPEND VALUE #( id = lv_index value = lv_raw_line ) TO lt_temp_data.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
          " Log error for specific line, continue with next
          MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          " Optionally append a default/error entry
          APPEND VALUE #( id = lv_index value = 'ERROR: ' && lv_raw_line ) TO lt_temp_data.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_result = lt_temp_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Datei und fangen Sie mögliche Ausnahmen wie 'Datei nicht gefunden' oder 'Berechtigungsfehler' ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_file_reader` oder `OPEN DATASET` mit `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_FILE_OPEN` oder `CX_SY_FILE_AUTHORITY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_file_read_safe DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_content_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_file_read_safe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_content_safe.
    DATA lv_line TYPE string.
    DATA lt_lines TYPE string_table.

    TRY.
        OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_open
            EXPORTING
              text = |Could not open file { iv_file_path }|.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND lv_line TO lt_lines.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.

        rv_content = cl_abap_string_utilities=>concatenate_string_table( it_string_table = lt_lines sep = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).

      CATCH cx_sy_file_open INTO DATA(lx_file_open).
        MESSAGE lx_file_open->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        rv_content = |ERROR: File not found or could not be opened: { iv_file_path }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_authority INTO DATA(lx_file_auth).
        MESSAGE lx_file_auth->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        rv_content = |ERROR: Authorization issue for file: { iv_file_path }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_access INTO DATA(lx_file_access).
        MESSAGE lx_file_access->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        rv_content = |ERROR: File access error: { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe eines Feldes in einer internen Tabelle, aber nur für die ersten N Einträge, wobei N durch `sy-tabix` in einer `REDUCE`-Expression bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... UNTIL` und `sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_tabix_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_first_n
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
        iv_n     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_tabix_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_first_n.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR ls_item IN it_items INDEX INTO sy-tabix
                       UNTIL sy-tabix > iv_n
                       NEXT s = s + ls_item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_last_line_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

      IMPORTING
        it_log_entries TYPE tt_log_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_last_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_last_line_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_log_entries.
    DATA(lv_num_lines) = lines( it_log_entries ).

    LOOP AT it_log_entries INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF sy-tabix = lv_num_lines.
        " This is the last line
        rv_last_message = |Last entry: { ls_entry-message } at { ls_entry-timestamp }|.
      ENDIF.
      " Other processing for all lines can go here
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... INDEX ...` und `INSERT ... INDEX sy-tabix`.

CLASS zcl_itb_dynamic_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_item_after_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_search_id TYPE i
        is_new_item  TYPE ty_item
      CHANGING
        ct_items     TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_dynamic_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_item_after_id.
    READ TABLE ct_items TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY id = iv_search_id.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Found the item, insert after it
      INSERT is_new_item INTO ct_items INDEX ( sy-tabix + 1 ).
    ELSE.
      " Item not found, append to end
      APPEND is_new_item TO ct_items.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_cut->insert_item_after_id( iv_search_id = 0 is_new_item = ls_new_item CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_after_last_element.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_dynamic_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_itb_dynamic_insert=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Item 1' )

    ).

explanation: Nachdem ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle mit `READ TABLE` gefunden wurde, liefert `sy-tabix` den Index dieses Eintrags. Dieser Index kann dann direkt in der `INSERT ... INDEX`-Anweisung verwendet werden, um eine neue Zeile an einer präzisen Position einzufügen. Dies ist eine flexible Methode zur dynamischen Tabellenmanipulation.
keywords: sy-tabix, READ TABLE, INSERT, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie ein Objekt dynamisch und fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab, falls die Klasse nicht gefunden wird oder die Instanziierung fehlschlägt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (lv_class_name)` und `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_dynamic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    METHODS create_object_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_object) TYPE REF TO object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_dynamic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_exc_dynamic_create( ).

    " Test with existing class
    DATA(lo_existing) = lo_creator->create_object_safe( 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' ).
    IF lo_existing IS BOUND.
      out->write( |Successfully created object of type CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Failed to create object of type CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT| ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test with non-existing class
    DATA(lo_non_existing) = lo_creator->create_object_safe( 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
    IF lo_non_existing IS BOUND.
      out->write( |Successfully created object of type ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS (unexpected!)| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Failed to create object of type ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS (expected)| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_object_safe.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        MESSAGE lx_create_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        CLEAR ro_object. " Ensure object is initial on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Um die Robustheit zu gewährleisten, ist es entscheidend, mögliche Fehler wie eine nicht existierende Klasse oder Probleme bei der Instanziierung mit `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR` abzufangen. Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die dynamische Zuweisung und anschließende Freigabe eines Feldsymbols zu einer Komponente einer Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT und UNASSIGN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS process_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_result = |Component '{ iv_component }' assigned with value '{ <fs_component> }'.|.
      UNASSIGN <fs_component>.
      IF <fs_component> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        rv_result = rv_result && | Field symbol successfully unassigned.|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Component '{ iv_component }' could not be assigned.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_component FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_component FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unassignment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_component.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_unassign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Value' act = lv_result exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Unassigned' act = lv_result exp = 'unassigned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_component.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_unassign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Not assigned' act = lv_result exp = 'could not be assigned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unassignment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_unassign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Test' field2 = 456 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Unassignment check' act = lv_result exp = 'Field symbol successfully unassigned.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ASSIGN COMPONENT ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. UNASSIGN wird verwendet, um ein Feldsymbol explizit freizugeben, was zur Vermeidung von Fehlern und zur besseren Speicherverwaltung beitragen kann, insbesondere in komplexen dynamischen Szenarien. Die Überprüfung mit IS ASSIGNED ist eine gute Praxis.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Programming, RTTI

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einem Feldsymbol und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach der Verarbeitung jedes Eintrags explizit freigegeben wird, um unbeabsichtigte Referenzen zu vermeiden.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und UNASSIGN innerhalb der Schleife oder nach bedingter Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE ty_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_item> TYPE ty_item.

    rt_processed_items = it_items. " Copy for modification or just process directly

    LOOP AT rt_processed_items ASSIGNING <fs_item>.
      " Beispiel: Text in Großbuchstaben umwandeln
      <fs_item>-text = to_upper( <fs_item>-text ).
      " Nach der Verarbeitung kann das Feldsymbol explizit freigegeben werden,
      " obwohl es am Ende der Schleife implizit freigegeben wird.
      " Dies ist hier zur Demonstration von UNASSIGN.
      UNASSIGN <fs_item>. " Demonstrative UNASSIGN
    ENDLOOP.

    " Nach der Schleife ist <fs_item> nicht mehr zugewiesen.
    " Eine explizite UNASSIGN hier wäre redundant, aber zur Verdeutlichung:
    UNASSIGN <fs_item>. " Redundant, aber zeigt die Möglichkeit
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_processing_and_unassign FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_processing_and_unassign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_unassign( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_itab_unassign=>ty_items(
      ( id = 1 text = 'first' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'second' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_itab_unassign=>ty_items(
      ( id = 1 text = 'FIRST' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'SECOND' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_and_unassign( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

    " Überprüfen, ob das Feldsymbol nach der Methode nicht zugewiesen ist (indirekt)
    " Dies kann nicht direkt im Unit Test geprüft werden, da das Feldsymbol lokal zur Methode ist.
    " Die Demonstration von UNASSIGN ist im Code selbst.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_unassign( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_itab_unassign=>ty_items( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_and_unassign( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs> ist die performanteste Methode zur Verarbeitung interner Tabellen, da keine Daten kopiert werden. UNASSIGN wird hier demonstrativ eingesetzt, um zu zeigen, wie ein Feldsymbol explizit freigegeben werden kann. Obwohl Feldsymbole, die in einer Schleife zugewiesen werden, am Ende der Schleife implizit freigegeben werden, kann UNASSIGN in komplexeren Szenarien, z.B. bei bedingten Zuweisungen, nützlich sein, um sicherzustellen, dass keine unerwünschten Referenzen bestehen bleiben.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, LOOP AT ASSIGNING

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die bedingte Freigabe eines Feldsymbols, um sicherzustellen, dass es nur dann freigegeben wird, wenn es zuvor zugewiesen wurde.
hint: Nutzen Sie IF <fs> IS ASSIGNED und UNASSIGN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_unassign
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE any OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    IF iv_value IS SUPPLIED.
      ASSIGN iv_value TO <fs_data>.
      IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_message = |Field symbol was assigned with value '{ <fs_data> }'.|.
        UNASSIGN <fs_data>.
        rv_message = rv_message && | Successfully unassigned.|.
      ELSE.
        rv_message = |Field symbol could not be assigned.|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Hier ist <fs_data> nicht zugewiesen.
      " Ein UNASSIGN würde keinen Fehler verursachen, ist aber unnötig.
      " Die Prüfung mit IS ASSIGNED ist gute Praxis.
      IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
        UNASSIGN <fs_data>.
        rv_message = |Field symbol was assigned (unexpectedly) and unassigned.|.
      ELSE.
        rv_message = |Field symbol was not assigned and remains unassigned.|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_with_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_without_value FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->safe_unassign( iv_value = 'Test String' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Assigned and unassigned' act = lv_message exp = 'Successfully unassigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Value check' act = lv_message exp = 'Test String' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_without_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->safe_unassign( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Not assigned' act = lv_message exp = 'not assigned and remains unassigned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die explizite Prüfung eines Feldsymbols mit IF <fs> IS ASSIGNED vor der Verwendung oder Freigabe ist eine wichtige defensive Programmierpraxis. Sie verhindert Laufzeitfehler, falls versucht wird, auf ein nicht zugewiesenes Feldsymbol zuzugreifen. UNASSIGN wird hier nur aufgerufen, wenn das Feldsymbol tatsächlich zugewiesen war, was die Robustheit des Codes erhöht.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Conditional Logic, IS ASSIGNED, Defensive Programming

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum innerhalb eines bestimmten Datumsbereichs liegt, unter Verwendung von CL_RECA_DATE.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden IS_BEFORE, IS_AFTER oder IS_BETWEEN der Klasse CL_RECA_DATE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reca_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_date_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_to_check TYPE d
        iv_start_date    TYPE d
        iv_end_date      TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_date_in_range.
    DATA(lo_date_to_check) = cl_reca_date=>create_date( iv_date_to_check ).
    DATA(lo_start_date)    = cl_reca_date=>create_date( iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lo_end_date)      = cl_reca_date=>create_date( iv_end_date ).

    " Prüfen, ob das Datum nach oder gleich dem Startdatum UND vor oder gleich dem Enddatum liegt
    IF lo_date_to_check->is_after( lo_start_date ) OR lo_date_to_check->is_equal( lo_start_date ).
      IF lo_date_to_check->is_before( lo_end_date ) OR lo_date_to_check->is_equal( lo_end_date ).
        rv_in_range = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Alternativ und kompakter mit IS_BETWEEN (falls verfügbar und passend zur Definition des Bereichs)
    " rv_in_range = lo_date_to_check->is_between( i_date_from = lo_start_date i_date_to = lo_end_date ).
    " Beachten: IS_BETWEEN ist oft exklusiv an den Grenzen, je nach Implementierung.
    " Die obige IF-Struktur ist explizit inklusiv.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Methode eines dynamisch erzeugten Objekts aus und geben Sie anschließend das Feldsymbol, das auf das Objekt zeigt, frei.
hint: Nutzen Sie CREATE OBJECT, ASSIGN und UNASSIGN in Kombination mit dynamischem Methodenaufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_test_interface.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_test_interface.
  METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE if_test_interface.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        ASSIGN lo_object TO <fs_object>.

        IF <fs_object> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_result = <fs_object>->(iv_method_name)( ).
          UNASSIGN <fs_object>.
          rv_result = rv_result && | Field symbol unassigned.|.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = |Object could not be assigned to field symbol.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        rv_result = |Error creating object for class '{ iv_class_name }'.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error calling method '{ iv_method_name }' dynamically.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_test_interface~get_message.
    rv_message = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_and_unassign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_UNASSIGN'
      iv_method_name = 'IF_TEST_INTERFACE~GET_MESSAGE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from dynamic method!' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Field symbol unassigned.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
      iv_method_name = 'GET_MESSAGE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error creating object' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_UNASSIGN'
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error calling method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Ein Objekt wird dynamisch mit CREATE OBJECT erzeugt und anschließend einem Feldsymbol zugewiesen. Der Methodenaufruf erfolgt ebenfalls dynamisch über den Namen der Methode. Nach der Ausführung wird das Feldsymbol explizit mit UNASSIGN freigegeben, um Ressourcen zu bereinigen und unbeabsichtigte Referenzen zu vermeiden. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit TRY...CATCH ist hierbei unerlässlich.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, CREATE OBJECT, Dynamic Method Call, RTTI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer RTTI-Typbeschreibung und geben Sie anschließend das Feldsymbol, das auf die Tabelle zeigt, frei.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>GET_TABLE_DESCR, CREATE DATA und UNASSIGN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_type TYPE string " z.B. 'ZCL_RTTI_UNASSIGN=>TY_SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lr_table        TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_type ).
        lo_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Beispiel: Eine Zeile hinzufügen
          APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table>.
          rv_message = |Dynamische Tabelle vom Typ '{ iv_struct_type }' erstellt und zugewiesen. Zeilen: { lines( <fs_table> ) }.|.
          UNASSIGN <fs_table>.
          rv_message = rv_message && | Feldsymbol erfolgreich freigegeben.|.
        ELSE.
          rv_message = |Feldsymbol konnte nicht zugewiesen werden.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        rv_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen der dynamischen Tabelle.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_message = |Fehler beim Casten der Typbeschreibung.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_invalid_type_descr.
        rv_message = |Ungültige Typbeschreibung für '{ iv_struct_type }'.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Eine interne Tabelle wird zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Typbeschreibung erstellt. Das Feldsymbol <fs_table> wird verwendet, um auf die dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle zuzugreifen. Die Fehlerbehandlung ist hierbei entscheidend.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung eines Feldsymbols, das auf ein Objekt zeigt, und dessen Freigabe nach der Verwendung.

CLASS zcl_oo_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        io_input_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_oo_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO object.

    ASSIGN io_input_object TO <fs_object>.

    IF <fs_object> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_message = |Object reference assigned to field symbol.|.
      " Hier könnte man Methoden des Objekts über <fs_object> aufrufen
      " z.B. IF <fs_object> IS INSTANCE OF lcl_my_class.
      "          DATA(lo_my_class) = CAST lcl_my_class( <fs_object> ).
      "          rv_message = rv_message && lo_my_class->get_info( ).
      "      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_object>.
      rv_message = rv_message && | Field symbol successfully unassigned.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Object reference could not be assigned to field symbol.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und geben Sie die Gruppierung mit einem Feldsymbol aus. Geben Sie das Feldsymbol nach der Verarbeitung frei.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und UNASSIGN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group> TYPE ty_sflight_data.

    LOOP AT it_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_group> GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid connid = <fs_group>-connid ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_group_key-carrid }, Flugnummer: { ls_group_key-connid }| TO rt_grouped_info.
      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group> ASSIGNING <fs_group>.
        APPEND |  Datum: { <fs_group>-fldate }, Preis: { <fs_group>-price }| TO rt_grouped_info.
        UNASSIGN <fs_group>. " Demonstrative UNASSIGN für innere Schleife
      ENDLOOP.
      UNASSIGN <fs_group>. " Demonstrative UNASSIGN für äußere Schleife
    ENDLOOP.

    " Nach den Schleifen ist <fs_group> nicht mehr zugewiesen.
    UNASSIGN <fs_group>. " Redundant, aber zeigt die Möglichkeit
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' price = '200.00' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_result[4] exp = 'Fluggesellschaft: AA, Flugnummer: 0017' ).

Hier wird ein Feldsymbol (<fs_group>) verwendet, um sowohl auf die Gruppenschlüssel als auch auf die einzelnen Elemente innerhalb einer Gruppe zuzugreifen. Dies ist nützlich für das Verständnis der Lebensdauer von Feldsymbolen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Referenz auf ein Datenobjekt eines bestimmten Typs und geben Sie das Feldsymbol, das auf die Referenz zeigt, nach der Verwendung frei.
hint: Nutzen Sie CREATE DATA TYPE REF TO, ASSIGN und UNASSIGN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_ref_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_ref
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string " z.B. 'STRING', 'I'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_ref_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_ref.
    DATA lr_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data_ref> TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA lr_data_ref TYPE (iv_type_name).
        ASSIGN lr_data_ref TO <fs_data_ref>.

        IF <fs_data_ref> IS ASSIGNED.
          ASSIGN <fs_data_ref>->* TO <fs_value>.
          IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
            " Beispiel: Wert zuweisen
            CASE iv_type_name.
              WHEN 'STRING'.
                <fs_value> = 'Dynamischer String'.
              WHEN 'I'.
                <fs_value> = 12345.
              WHEN OTHERS.
                " Nichts tun oder Fehler melden
            ENDCASE.
            rv_message = |Referenz auf '{ iv_type_name }' erstellt, Wert: '{ <fs_value> }'.|.
            UNASSIGN <fs_value>. " Feldsymbol für den Wert freigeben
          ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_data_ref>. " Feldsymbol für die Referenz freigeben
          rv_message = rv_message && | Feldsymbole erfolgreich freigegeben.|.
        ELSE.
          rv_message = |Feldsymbol für Referenz konnte nicht zugewiesen werden.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        rv_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen der dynamischen Referenz für Typ '{ iv_type_name }'.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_string_ref FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_integer_ref FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_string_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_ref_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_ref( iv_type_name = 'STRING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Referenz auf ''STRING'' erstellt, Wert: ''Dynamischer String''' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'erfolgreich freigegeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_integer_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_ref_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_ref( iv_type_name = 'I' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'erfolgreich freigegeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_type.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von Datenreferenzen und deren Zuweisung zu Feldsymbolen. Mit CREATE DATA TYPE (Typname) kann zur Laufzeit ein Datenobjekt eines beliebigen Typs erzeugt werden. Das Feldsymbol <fs_data_ref> zeigt auf diese Referenz, und <fs_value> wird verwendet, um auf den Inhalt des referenzierten Datenobjekts zuzugreifen. Die explizite Freigabe beider Feldsymbole mit UNASSIGN ist in solchen dynamischen Szenarien wichtig, um die Kontrolle über die Referenzen zu behalten und Speicherlecks zu vermeiden.
keywords: UNASSIGN, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, REF TO DATA

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Anwendungsprotokolleintrag mit der Standardklasse `CL_BAL_LOG` (als Alternative zu `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG`).

solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_app_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_log_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_app_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_entry.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).
    lo_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = '00'
      i_msgno = '001'
      i_msgv1 = iv_text

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_log_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simple_app_log( ).
    " Since CL_BAL_LOG saves to DB, direct assertion is hard.
    " We assert that no exception occurs during logging.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_log_entry( 'Testnachricht' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Logging should not raise an exception' ).

Instructions: Protokollieren Sie eine Fehlermeldung in `CL_BAL_LOG` (als Alternative zu `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG`) innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH` Blocks, wenn eine Division durch Null auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung und `ADD_MESSAGE` mit Nachrichtentyp 'E'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_and_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_and_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        lo_log->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = '00'
          i_msgno = '002'
          i_msgv1 = 'Division durch Null'
          i_msgv2 = lx_arith_error->get_text( )
        ).
        lo_log->save( ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bal_log_error EXPORTING textid = cx_bal_log_error=>error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_divide_and_log_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_bal_log_error.
    METHODS test_divide_and_log_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_divide_and_log_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_error_handling( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_bal_log_error=>error ).
    lo_cut->divide_and_log( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).

  METHOD test_divide_and_log_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_and_log( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).

explanation: Die Kombination von `TRY...CATCH` für die robuste Fehlerbehandlung und `CL_BAL_LOG` zum Protokollieren von Fehlern ist eine Best Practice in modernem ABAP. Dies stellt sicher, dass Fehler nicht nur abgefangen, sondern auch nachvollziehbar dokumentiert werden. Der `RAISE EXCEPTION` im CATCH-Block ermöglicht es, den Fehler an den Aufrufer weiterzugeben.
keywords: TRY...CATCH, Exception Handling, CL_BAL_LOG, Error Logging

Instructions: Löschen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.

CLASS zcl_delete_adj_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.

CLASS zcl_delete_adj_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen aus einer Liste von Strings in einer internen Tabelle und geben Sie die bereinigte Liste zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR` Ausdruck mit `strip`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_strip_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS strip_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stripped_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strip_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD strip_string_table.
    rt_stripped_strings = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <lv_string> IN it_strings
      ( CONV string( <lv_string> && | | )->strip_leading_and_trailing( ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_strip_string_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strip_string_table.
    DATA(lt_test_strings) = VALUE string_table(
      ( `  Hello World  ` )
      ( `  ABAP  ` )
      ( `NoSpaces` )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_strip_strings( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->strip_string_table( lt_test_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 'NoSpaces' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ist eine sehr moderne und kompakte Art, interne Tabellen zu transformieren. Die Methode `strip_leading_and_trailing()` (verfügbar ab 7.50) ist eine elegante Möglichkeit, Leerzeichen zu entfernen, ohne auf ältere Funktionen wie `CONDENSE` zurückgreifen zu müssen. Die Konvertierung zu `string` und das Anhängen eines Leerzeichens (`&& | |`) ist ein Workaround, um `strip_leading_and_trailing` auf `string` Typen anzuwenden, da es direkt auf `xstring` oder `string` Feldern funktioniert, aber nicht direkt auf `c` oder `n` Typen in einer `string_table` (die `string` Elemente enthält).
keywords: FOR, VALUE, String Templates, strip_leading_and_trailing, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll, fügen Sie mehrere Nachrichten hinzu und zeigen Sie es dann mit der Standard-Anzeigefunktion an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG` zum Erstellen und `CL_BAL_LOG_DISPLAY` zum Anzeigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_display_app_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_display_app_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = '00'
      i_msgno = '003'
      i_msgv1 = 'Erste Informationsnachricht'
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'W'
      i_msgid = '00'
      i_msgno = '004'
      i_msgv1 = 'Warnung: Etwas ist passiert'
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'E'
      i_msgid = '00'
      i_msgno = '005'
      i_msgv1 = 'Fehler: Kritischer Zustand'
    ).

    lo_log->save( ).

    " Display the log
    DATA(lo_log_display) = NEW cl_bal_log_display( ).
    lo_log_display->display_log( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_display_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_display_app_log( ).
    " This test can only verify that the method runs without error.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_and_display_log( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Log creation and display should not raise an exception' ).

explanation: Die Erstellung und Anzeige von Anwendungsprotokollen erfolgt in modernem ABAP über die Klassen `CL_BAL_LOG` und `CL_BAL_LOG_DISPLAY`. Dies ermöglicht eine strukturierte und standardisierte Protokollierung und Visualisierung von Nachrichten, was für die Fehleranalyse und das Monitoring unerlässlich ist. `GET_LOG_HANDLE()` ist entscheidend, um das erstellte Protokoll an die Anzeigeklasse zu übergeben. (Hinweis: `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG` ist möglicherweise eine spezifische Klasse; `CL_BAL_LOG` ist die generische Standardlösung.)
keywords: CL_BAL_LOG, CL_BAL_LOG_DISPLAY, Application Log, Display Log, Object Orientation

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag (Montag, Dienstag, etc.) für ein gegebenes Datum.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck mit `cl_abap_context_info` zur Ermittlung des Wochentags.
solution:
CLASS zcl_day_of_week DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_day_of_week IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_name.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week_num) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_day_of_week( iv_date ).
    rv_day_name = SWITCH #( lv_day_of_week_num
                            WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
                            WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
                            WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
                            WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
                            WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
                            WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
                            WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
                            ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_day) = lo_cut->get_day_name( lv_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_day exp = 'Montag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sunday.

INTERFACE zif_shape.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die den Status von Flügen (aus `sflights`) basierend auf der Flugdauer kategorisiert: 'Kurzstrecke' (< 2 Stunden), 'Mittelstrecke' (2-5 Stunden), 'Langstrecke' (> 5 Stunden).
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `SWITCH` zur Kategorisierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             duration TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS categorize_flights
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD categorize_flights.
        DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

        rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                    LET lv_duration = ( ls_sflight-arrtime - ls_sflight-deptime ) / 3600 " Duration in hours
                                    IN ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                         connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                         fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                         fltime   = ls_sflight-fltime
                                         deptime  = ls_sflight-deptime
                                         arrtime  = ls_sflight-arrtime
                                         duration = lv_duration
                                         category = SWITCH #( WHEN lv_duration < 2 THEN 'Kurzstrecke'
                                                              WHEN lv_duration >= 2 AND lv_duration <= 5 THEN 'Mittelstrecke'
                                                              WHEN lv_duration > 5 THEN 'Langstrecke'
                                                              ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) ) ).
      ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_categorization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorization.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_categorizer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->categorize_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ). " Check if not empty
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( lt_flights ) ). " Check if not empty

    " Check some categories (assuming some data exists)
    DATA(lv_short_flights) = lines( VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( category = 'Kurzstrecke' ) ( flight ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_medium_flights) = lines( VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( category = 'Mittelstrecke' ) ( flight ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_long_flights) = lines( VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( category = 'Langstrecke' ) ( flight ) ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_short_flights > 0 OR lv_medium_flights > 0 OR lv_long_flights > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Ausdruck und `SWITCH` innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktes ermöglicht die deklarative und effiziente Transformation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Die Flugdauer wird dynamisch berechnet und direkt zur Kategorisierung verwendet.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, SWITCH, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Auftrags basierend auf mehreren Kriterien: 'Offen' (Menge > 0, Datum in Zukunft), 'Überfällig' (Menge > 0, Datum in Vergangenheit), 'Abgeschlossen' (Menge = 0), 'Storniert' (spezieller Status-Code).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` mit `COND` für komplexe Bedingungen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             due_date TYPE sy-datum,
             status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_order.

    CLASS zcl_order_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_order_status
          IMPORTING
            is_order TYPE ty_order
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_status.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( is_order-status_code
                               WHEN 'X' THEN 'Storniert' " Specific status code for cancelled
                               WHEN OTHERS THEN
                                 SWITCH #( COND #( WHEN is_order-quantity = 0 THEN 1 " Completed
                                                   WHEN is_order-due_date < sy-datum THEN 2 " Overdue
                                                   WHEN is_order-quantity > 0 AND is_order-due_date >= sy-datum THEN 3 " Open
                                                   ELSE 0 ) " Default/Unknown
                                           WHEN 1 THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                                           WHEN 2 THEN 'Überfällig'
                                           WHEN 3 THEN 'Offen'
                                           ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Die Verschachtelung von `SWITCH`- und `COND`-Ausdrücken ermöglicht die prägnante Abbildung komplexer Entscheidungslogik. `COND` wird verwendet, um eine Zahl basierend auf Bedingungen zu erzeugen, die dann vom äußeren `SWITCH` ausgewertet wird. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und lesbare Art, komplexe `IF-ELSE IF` Ketten zu vermeiden.
keywords: SWITCH, COND, Conditional Logic, Nested Expressions

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in der `sflights`-Tabelle existiert und geben Sie 'Flug gefunden' oder 'Flug nicht gefunden' zurück.

CLASS zcl_flight_existence_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_flight_existence_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_status = SWITCH #( WHEN line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN 'Flug gefunden'
                          ELSE 'Flug nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Flugdaten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle darstellt. Jede Zeile soll ein `<Flight>`-Element mit Attributen für `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` sowie Kind-Elementen für `Price` und `Currency` sein.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie die Writer-Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_xml_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_flight_xml
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_xml_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_xml.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for example

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'CarrierID' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'ConnectionID' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'FlightDate' value = ls_flight-fldate ).

      lo_writer->open_element( 'Price' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-price ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).

      lo_writer->open_element( 'Currency' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-currency ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).

      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flight
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flight CarrierID=' ).n    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Price>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_xml_cdata.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_cdata_generator( ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH'). Berechnen Sie die Summe der Kapazität (SEATSMAX) multipliziert mit einem Faktor von 2 für alle gefundenen Flüge unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_adjusted_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_adjusted_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ( flight-seatsmax * 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_capacity_calc) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_capacity_calc->calculate_total_adjusted_capacity( 'LH' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum_from_db) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsmax ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected_sum_from_db.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_sum_from_db * 2 msg = 'Calculated capacity incorrect for LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_carrier.

Die Multiplikation (`*`) wird direkt im Ausdruck durchgeführt, was den Code lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP` und `MULTIPLY` Statements.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Struktur und den Namen eines numerischen Feldes als String entgegennimmt. Multiplizieren Sie den Wert des dynamisch angegebenen Feldes in der Struktur mit einem Faktor. Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und die `MULTIPLY` Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_field>` und `MULTIPLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_multiplier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
        value1 TYPE i,
        value2 TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        text   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_s_data.

    METHODS multiply_dynamic_field
      CHANGING
        cs_data      TYPE ty_s_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_factor     TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_multiplier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      IF <fs_field> IS SUPPLIED AND ( <fs_field> IS INITIAL OR <fs_field> IS NUMERIC ).
        MULTIPLY <fs_field> BY iv_factor.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      END IF.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_multiply_value1.
