    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_multiplier=>ty_s_data( value1 = 10 value2 = '5.50' text = 'Test' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_dyn_mult->multiply_dynamic_field(
      CHANGING cs_data = ls_data

                iv_factor     = '2.5'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value1 exp = 25 msg = 'Dynamic multiply VALUE1 failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Success flag incorrect for VALUE1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply_value2.
    DATA(lo_dyn_mult) = NEW zcl_dynamic_multiplier( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_multiplier=>ty_s_data( value1 = 10 value2 = '5.50' text = 'Test' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_dyn_mult->multiply_dynamic_field(
      CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
      IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'VALUE2'
                iv_factor     = '2.0'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value2 exp = '11.00' msg = 'Dynamic multiply VALUE2 failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Success flag incorrect for VALUE2' ).

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA(lo_dyn_mult) = NEW zcl_dynamic_multiplier( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_multiplier=>ty_s_data( value1 = 10 ).

    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_multiplier=>ty_s_data( value1 = 10 value2 = '5.50' text = 'Test' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_dyn_mult->multiply_dynamic_field(
      CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
      IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'TEXT'
                iv_factor     = '2.0'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Success flag incorrect for non-numeric field' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Programmierung mit Field-Symbols, um auf Komponenten einer Struktur zuzugreifen, deren Name erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die `MULTIPLY` Anweisung wird dann auf das zugewiesene Field-Symbol angewendet. Dies ist nützlich für generische Datenverarbeitungsroutinen, erfordert aber sorgfältige Typüberprüfung.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('AA'). Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und greifen Sie dabei nur auf die Felder `CARRID` und `CONNID` zu, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit diesen beiden Feldern zu füllen. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO ... BEGIN OF ... END OF`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(wa) BEGIN OF ... END OF` um nur auf die benötigten Felder zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_subset DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_s_flight_key.
    TYPES:
      ty_t_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_keys
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE ty_t_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_subset IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) BEGIN OF carrid, connid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) TO rt_flight_keys.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_keys ) > 0 ) msg = 'No flight keys found for AA' ).
    IF lines( lt_keys ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_keys[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight carrid incorrect' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_keys[ 1 ]-connid msg = 'First flight connid is initial' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_keys msg = 'Flight keys should be empty for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... INTO ... BEGIN OF ... END OF` Syntax ermöglicht es, nur auf eine Teilmenge der Felder einer Struktur oder Workarea zuzugreifen, was die Performance verbessern kann, wenn nur wenige Felder benötigt werden. In Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(ls_flight)`) ist dies eine moderne und effiziente Art der Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: LOOP AT, BEGIN OF, Internal Tables, sflights, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Basiswert und einen Multiplikationsfaktor entgegennimmt. Wenn der Faktor größer als 10 ist, soll der Basiswert mit dem Faktor multipliziert werden. Andernfalls soll der Basiswert mit 2 multipliziert werden. Verwenden Sie die `MULTIPLY` Anweisung innerhalb einer `IF` Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `IF ... ELSE ... ENDIF` Struktur und die `MULTIPLY` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_multiplier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_value TYPE i
        iv_factor     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_calculated_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_multiplier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_value.
    rv_calculated_value = iv_base_value.

    IF iv_factor > 10.
      MULTIPLY rv_calculated_value BY iv_factor.
    ELSE.
      MULTIPLY rv_calculated_value BY 2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_factor_greater_than_10 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factor_less_than_or_equal_10 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factor_is_10 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_base_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factor_greater_than_10.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Zeitdiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Tag aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und `cl_time_chart_simple`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_chart_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_chart.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_chart_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_chart_data    TYPE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_points.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_data.

    " Group by flight date and count flights
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-fldate.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight.
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( timestamp = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }000000| value = lv_flight_count ) TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart->add_series(
      EXPORTING
        i_series_id = 'FLIGHTS_PER_DAY'
        i_series_name = 'Anzahl Flüge pro Tag'
        it_data_points = lt_chart_data
    ).
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flüge pro Tag (SFLIGHTS)' ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( 'Datum' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
    lo_chart->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Zeitdiagramm, das Datenreihen basierend auf einer Bedingung dynamisch hinzufügt. Verwenden Sie `sflights` und fügen Sie eine Reihe für Flüge mit mehr als 50% Auslastung hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` für die dynamische Datenaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_chart_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_chart.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_chart_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_data.

    " Prepare data for all flights
    DATA(lt_all_flights_data) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_points(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_data
      GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight NEXT c = c + 1 ) IN
      ( timestamp = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }000000| value = lv_count )
    ).

    lo_chart->add_series(
      EXPORTING
        i_series_id = 'ALL_FLIGHTS'
        i_series_name = 'Alle Flüge'
        it_data_points = lt_all_flights_data
    ).
    lo_chart->set_series_color( i_series_id = 'ALL_FLIGHTS' i_color = cl_time_chart_simple=>co_color_blue ).

    " Prepare data for high-occupancy flights (over 50%)
    DATA(lt_high_occupancy_flights) = VALUE cl_time_chart_simple=>tt_data_points(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_data
      WHERE ( ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 AND ( ls_sflight-seatsocc * 100 / ls_sflight-seatsmax ) > 50 )
      GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight NEXT c = c + 1 ) IN
      ( timestamp = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }000000| value = lv_count )
    ).

    IF lt_high_occupancy_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      lo_chart->add_series(
        EXPORTING
          i_series_id = 'HIGH_OCCUPANCY'
          i_series_name = 'Hohe Auslastung (>50%)'
          it_data_points = lt_high_occupancy_flights
      ).
      lo_chart->set_series_color( i_series_id = 'HIGH_OCCUPANCY' i_color = cl_time_chart_simple=>co_color_red ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flugauslastung (SFLIGHTS)' ).
    lo_chart->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder einer anderen internen Tabelle (SFLIGHT) enthält und dabei Einträge nach einer Bedingung filtert. Nutzen Sie die FOR-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                           WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price )
                           ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                             connid = ls_flight-connid,
                             price  = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT unter Verwendung einer REDUCE-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE type( INIT var = initial_value FOR ... NEXT var = var + ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In jedem Schritt (`NEXT`) wird der Wert der Variablen aktualisiert. Dies ersetzt explizite LOOP-Anweisungen und macht den Code funktionaler und leichter verständlich.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL (z.B. http://worldtimeapi.org/api/timezone/Europe/Berlin) durch und lesen Sie die Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url`, `send`, `receive` und `response->get_cdata`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_world_time
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_world_time.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_text  TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Client creation failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_text = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_text.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_text = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_text.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine externe URL (z.B. https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts) und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Setzen Sie den Content-Type auf `application/json` und verwenden Sie `request->set_cdata` für den Payload. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains` für die Überprüfung der Antwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_json_payload TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_text  TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Client creation failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( iv_json_payload ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_text = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_text.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_text = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_text.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für einen HTTP-Request, der mit `cl_http_client` durchgeführt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_http_dest_state_error` und `cx_http_client_error` und lesen Sie Fehlermeldungen mit `get_text()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_safe_get
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_safe_get.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Client creation failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_error_message = lo_http_client->get_last_error( ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        lv_error_message = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_and_get_http_client INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        lv_error_message = lx_create_error->get_text( ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_message.
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHT), der eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt, und geben Sie ihn zurück. Wenn kein Eintrag gefunden wird, soll ein Initialwert zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` mit `VALUE` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_first_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_flight_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_first_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight_by_criteria.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rs_flight = VALUE #( lt_sflight[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid ] DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ).
    " The above is for direct key access. For a more general 'find first' with WHERE:
    TRY.
        rs_flight = lt_sflight[ WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc > iv_min_seatsocc ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR rs_flight. " Return initial value if not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Einträge einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie die `GROUP BY` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_carrid_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit initialen Werten und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle (SFLIGHT), wobei Sie nur die ersten N Einträge übernehmen. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` mit `UP TO`.

CLASS zcl_value_for_up_to DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_up_to IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    DATA lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_source_flights
      ORDER BY carrid, connid
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight UP TO iv_number_of_rows ROWS IN lt_source_flights
                          ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) basierend auf einer komplexen Logik, die in einer separaten funktionalen Methode gekapselt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine funktionale Methode im `WHERE`-Ausdruck des `FILTER`-Operators, um die Filterlogik auszulagern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflight_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_special_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_occupancy TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tt.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_special_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
        iv_min_occupancy TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_special) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_special_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE sflight_tt.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE is_special_flight( is_flight = table_line iv_min_occupancy = iv_min_occupancy ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_special_flight.
    " Beispiel: Ein Flug ist 'speziell', wenn er von 'LH' ist, nach 'NYC' fliegt
    " und eine Mindestauslastung hat.
    IF is_flight-carrid = 'LH' AND
       is_flight-airpto = 'NYC' AND
       is_flight-seatsocc >= iv_min_occupancy.
      rv_is_special = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_special = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_with_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_with_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflight_method( ).
    DATA(lv_min_occ) = 50.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_special_flights( lv_min_occ ).

    " Assuming there are some special flights in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No special flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect carrier' act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect destination' act = <fs_flight>-airpto exp = 'NYC' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Occupancy too low' act = <fs_flight>-seatsocc >= lv_min_occ ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Integration von funktionalen Methoden in den `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht die Kapselung komplexer Filterlogik und fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit des Codes. Dies ist ein Beispiel für modernes, objektorientiertes ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Methods, Object Orientation, Complex Logic

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Struktur einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) zur Laufzeit, einschließlich der Namen und Typen ihrer Komponenten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind,
             length    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_components.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( ir_table_data ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp>).
      DATA(ls_comp_info) = VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = <fs_comp>-name
        type_kind = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( <fs_comp>-type )->type_kind
        length = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( <fs_comp>-type )->length
      ).
      APPEND ls_comp_info TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of components' act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 16 ). " SFlight has 16 components

    DATA(ls_carrid_comp) = lt_components[ name = 'CARRID' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID type kind incorrect' act = ls_carrid_comp-type_kind exp = cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_char ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID length incorrect' act = ls_carrid_comp-length exp = 3 ).

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure.|.

    rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) nach Flügen, deren Fluggesellschaften in einem dynamisch definierten Selektionsbereich liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `IN`-Operator mit einem Range-Tabelle im `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflight_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_range.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE sflight_tt.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE carrid IN it_carrier_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_with_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_with_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflight_range( ).
    DATA: lt_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid,
          ls_range_line LIKE LINE OF lt_range.

    ls_range_line-sign = 'I'.
    ls_range_line-option = 'EQ'.
    ls_range_line-low = 'LH'.
    APPEND ls_range_line TO lt_range.

    ls_range_line-low = 'AA'.
    APPEND ls_range_line TO lt_range.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier_range( lt_range ).

    " Assuming there are flights for LH and AA in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for specified carriers' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrier not in range' act = <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH' OR <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit Range-Tabellen bietet eine mächtige und flexible Möglichkeit, Daten basierend auf dynamischen Selektionskriterien zu selektieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Benutzeroberflächen, die dynamische Filteroptionen bieten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. `sflight`), fügen Sie Daten hinzu und lesen Sie diese aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und Feld-Symbole für die dynamische Datenmanipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error
        cx_sy_create_data_error.

    METHODS read_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ) ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any STRUCTURE.
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_dynamic_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    " Fill data dynamically
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_carrid> = 'LH'.
      <fs_connid> = '0400'.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

      <fs_carrid> = 'AA'.
      <fs_connid> = '0017'.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid table reference'.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any STRUCTURE.
    LOOP AT <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      DATA ls_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_flight_data-carrid = <fs_carrid>.
        ls_flight_data-connid = <fs_connid>.
        APPEND ls_flight_data TO rt_flight_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) und erstellen Sie gleichzeitig eine neue Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder der gefilterten Einträge enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `VALUE` für eine kompakte Filterung und Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_map_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin_airport TYPE sflight-airpfrom
        iv_min_occupancy  TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_map_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE sflight_tt.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE airpfrom = iv_origin_airport AND seatsocc >= iv_min_occupancy )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                            connid = flight-connid,
                            fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_map_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_origin) = 'FRA'.
    DATA(lv_min_occ) = 100.
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_summary( iv_origin_airport = lv_origin iv_min_occupancy = lv_min_occ ).

    " Assuming there are flights from FRA with >= 100 occupancy
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No filtered flight summaries found' act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_summary ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_summary>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect origin airport in summary' act = <fs_summary>-carrid exp = 'LH' ). " Assuming LH for FRA
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CONNID should not be initial' act = <fs_summary>-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'FLDATE should not be initial' act = <fs_summary>-fldate ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine bestimmte Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_interfaces` um die implementierten Interfaces einer Klasse zu ermitteln.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_my_interface.
  METHODS do_something.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_implements_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_my_interface.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_implements_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_my_interface~do_something.
    " Implementierung
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_implements_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_implements_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_class_implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name    TYPE string
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_class_implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_interfaces) = lo_class_descr->get_class_interfaces( ).

    LOOP AT lt_interfaces ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_interface>).
      IF <fs_interface>-name = iv_interface_name.
        rv_implements = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, die von 'FRA' abfliegen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_from_origin
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin_airport TYPE sflight-airpfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_from_origin.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE sflight_tt.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE airpfrom = iv_origin_airport )
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur zur Laufzeit und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_data` oder `create_by_components` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_custom_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type_name TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_def.
    TYPES: tt_component_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_custom_table
      IMPORTING
        it_component_defs TYPE tt_component_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error
        cx_sy_create_data_error.

    METHODS get_table_as_string
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_table_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_custom_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_custom_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  LIKE LINE OF lt_components.

    LOOP AT it_component_defs ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp_def>).
      ls_component-name = <fs_comp_def>-name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_name( <fs_comp_def>-type_name ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any STRUCTURE.
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_dynamic_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    " Fill data dynamically
    LOOP AT it_component_defs ASSIGNING <fs_comp_def>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_comp_def>-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CASE <fs_comp_def>-name.
          WHEN 'FIELD1'. <fs_field> = 'Value1'.
          WHEN 'FIELD2'. <fs_field> = 123.
          WHEN 'FIELD3'. <fs_field> = '20251206'.
          WHEN OTHERS. " Handle other fields or leave empty
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Add a second row
    LOOP AT it_component_defs ASSIGNING <fs_comp_def>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_comp_def>-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CASE <fs_comp_def>-name.
          WHEN 'FIELD1'. <fs_field> = 'ValueA'.
          WHEN 'FIELD2'. <fs_field> = 456.
          WHEN 'FIELD3'. <fs_field> = '20260115'.
          WHEN OTHERS. " Handle other fields or leave empty
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_table_as_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid table reference'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_dynamic_table ) ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any STRUCTURE.
    LOOP AT <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      DATA lv_line_content TYPE string.
      LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_comp>-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_line_content = lv_line_content && |{ <fs_comp>-name }: { <fs_field_value> } |.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      rv_table_content = rv_table_content && lv_line_content && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_custom_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_descr_error cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_custom_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_custom_table( ).
    DATA: lt_comp_defs TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_custom_table=>tt_component_def,
          ls_comp_def  LIKE LINE OF lt_comp_defs.

    ls_comp_def-name = 'FIELD1'. ls_comp_def-type_name = 'STRING'. APPEND ls_comp_def TO lt_comp_defs.
    ls_comp_def-name = 'FIELD2'. ls_comp_def-type_name = 'I'. APPEND ls_comp_def TO lt_comp_defs.
    ls_comp_def-name = 'FIELD3'. ls_comp_def-type_name = 'DATS'. APPEND ls_comp_def TO lt_comp_defs.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_custom_table( lt_comp_defs ).
    DATA(lv_table_content) = lo_cut->get_table_as_string( lr_dynamic_table ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table content should not be empty' act = lv_table_content ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Content for first row missing' pattern = 'FIELD1: Value1 FIELD2: 123 FIELD3: 20251206' act = lv_table_content ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Content for second row missing' pattern = 'FIELD1: ValueA FIELD2: 456 FIELD3: 20260115' act = lv_table_content ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von RTTI, um zur Laufzeit eine interne Tabelle mit einer vollständig dynamisch definierten Struktur zu erstellen. `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` sind die Schlüsselklassen, um Typbeschreibungen zu generieren, die dann mit `CREATE DATA` instanziiert werden können. Dies ist extrem nützlich für generische Datenimporte, -exporte oder Metadaten-gesteuerte Anwendungen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Table, Custom Structure, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `REDUCE` um eine gefilterte Liste zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE sflight_tt.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrier )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming LH has some flights with occupied seats
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total seats for LH should be greater than 0' act = lv_total_seats > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_seats_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier

  ENDMETHOD.

Es ermöglicht das Filtern einer internen Tabelle und die anschließende Aggregation der gefilterten Daten in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein bestimmtes Feld in einer Struktur existiert und welchen Typ es hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_component` und `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             exists    TYPE abap_bool,
             type_kind TYPE cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind,
             length    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_info.

    METHODS get_field_type_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_field_info) TYPE ty_field_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_field_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_info.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_structure ) ).

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_component) = lo_struct_descr->get_component( iv_field_name ).
        rs_field_info-exists = abap_true.
        DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type ).
        rs_field_info-type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind.
        rs_field_info-length = lo_elem_descr->length.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_component_error.
        rs_field_info-exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) und sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `SORT` für eine gefilterte und sortierte Ergebnismenge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sort_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_and_sorted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin_airport TYPE sflight-airpfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sort_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_sorted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE sflight_tt.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE airpfrom = iv_origin_airport ).
    SORT rt_filtered_flights BY carrid ASCENDING fldate ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_and_sort FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_sort.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sort_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_origin) = 'FRA'.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_sorted_flights( lv_origin ).

    " Assuming there are flights from FRA
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No filtered flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 1.
      DATA(ls_prev_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) FROM 2.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Sorting by CARRID failed' act = <fs_flight>-carrid GE ls_prev_flight-carrid ).
        IF <fs_flight>-carrid = ls_prev_flight-carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Sorting by FLDATE failed' act = <fs_flight>-fldate GE ls_prev_flight-fldate ).
        ENDIF.
        ls_prev_flight = <fs_flight>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination des `FILTER`-Operators mit der `SORT`-Anweisung. Obwohl `SORT` keine neue ABAP-Funktion ist, ist die Kombination mit dem modernen `FILTER`-Operator ein gängiges und effizientes Muster, um gefilterte Daten in einer gewünschten Reihenfolge zu präsentieren.
keywords: FILTER, SORT, Internal Tables, Sorting, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Cache-Prüfung für einen gegebenen Schlüssel. Wenn der Schlüssel im 'Cache' (einer internen Tabelle) gefunden wird, geben Sie eine Erfolgsmeldung zurück, andernfalls eine Fehlermeldung. Nutzen Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(...)` für die Deklaration und `|...|` für String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cache_check_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    TYPES tt_cache_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_initial_cache TYPE tt_cache_entries OPTIONAL.
    METHODS check_cache_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_cache TYPE tt_cache_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_check_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_cache = it_initial_cache.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_cache_entry.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    READ TABLE mt_cache WITH KEY key = iv_key TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_found = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_found = abap_true.
      rv_message = |Cache-Eintrag für Schlüssel '{ iv_key }' gefunden. (Simuliert: S_ESH_ENG_CACHE)|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Cache-Eintrag für Schlüssel '{ iv_key }' nicht gefunden. (Simuliert: S_ESH_ENG_CACHE)|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazitäten aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (ähnlich `SFLIGHTS`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ...` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_capacities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für einen simulierten Cache-Zugriff. Fangen Sie eine spezifische, selbstdefinierte Ausnahme ab und nutzen Sie `WHEN OTHERS` für unerwartete Fehler. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, z.B. `zcx_cache_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_cache_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_cache_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_cache_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS access_cache_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL
        iv_simulate_other_error TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_cache_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_cache_entry.
    TRY.
        IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_cache_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_cache_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
        IF iv_simulate_other_error = abap_true.
          " Simulate a different, unexpected error, e.g., division by zero
          DATA(lv_zero) = 0.
          DATA(lv_result) = 1 / lv_zero.
        ENDIF.

        rv_result_message = |Cache-Zugriff für '{ iv_key }' erfolgreich. (Simuliert: cl_esh_ca_check)|.

      CATCH zcx_cache_error INTO DATA(lx_cache_error).
        rv_result_message = |Spezifischer Cache-Fehler für '{ iv_key }': { lx_cache_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler beim Cache-Zugriff für '{ iv_key }': { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es demonstriert das Abfangen einer spezifischen Ausnahme (`zcx_cache_error`) und die Verwendung von `WHEN OTHERS` im `CATCH`-Block, um alle anderen, nicht explizit behandelten Ausnahmen abzufangen. Dies ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen, die mit Systemkomponenten wie `cl_esh_ca_check` interagieren.

CLASS zcl_modern_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_data) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight_data = ls_flight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie effizient, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer internen Tabelle (simulierte `SFLIGHTS`-Daten) existiert, ohne die Daten selbst zu lesen. Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS`.

CLASS zcl_read_table_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        is_key     TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flight_exists.
    READ TABLE it_flights WITH KEY is_key TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Abrufen eines Wertes aus einem 'Cache' (repräsentiert durch eine interne Tabelle). Wenn der Wert gefunden wird, geben Sie ihn zurück; andernfalls geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `COND` für eine kompakte Logik, die an `S_ESH_ENG_CACHE` erinnert.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE` mit `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` oder `READ TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simulated_cache_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    TYPES tt_cache_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_initial_cache TYPE tt_cache_entries OPTIONAL.
    METHODS get_from_cache
      IMPORTING
        iv_key         TYPE string
        iv_default_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_cache TYPE tt_cache_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simulated_cache_get IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_cache = it_initial_cache.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_from_cache.
    rv_value = COND string(
      WHEN line_exists( mt_cache[ key = iv_key ] ) THEN mt_cache[ key = iv_key ]-value
      ELSE iv_default_value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_not_found_with_default FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_not_found_no_default FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_found.
    DATA(lt_initial_cache) = VALUE zcl_simulated_cache_get=>tt_cache_entries(
      ( key = 'ITEM1' value = 'CachedValue1' )
      ( key = 'ITEM2' value = 'CachedValue2' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simulated_cache_get( it_initial_cache = lt_initial_cache ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_from_cache( iv_key = 'ITEM1' iv_default_value = 'Default' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'CachedValue1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_not_found_with_default.
    DATA(lt_initial_cache) = VALUE zcl_simulated_cache_get=>tt_cache_entries(
      ( key = 'ITEM1' value = 'CachedValue1' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simulated_cache_get( it_initial_cache = lt_initial_cache ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_from_cache( iv_key = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_default_value = 'DefaultValue' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'DefaultValue' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_not_found_no_default.
    DATA(lt_initial_cache) = VALUE zcl_simulated_cache_get=>tt_cache_entries(
      ( key = 'ITEM1' value = 'CachedValue1' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simulated_cache_get( it_initial_cache = lt_initial_cache ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_from_cache( iv_key = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne und kompakte Art, Werte aus internen Tabellen abzurufen und dabei Standardwerte zu setzen, falls der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird. Die Kombination von `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` (oder Tabellen-Ausdrücken) ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, die die Logik für 'Cache-Checks' wie bei `S_ESH_ENG_CACHE` elegant abbildet.
keywords: CACHE, S_ESH_ENG_CACHE, VALUE, COND, LINE_EXISTS, INTERNAL TABLE

  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_salv_events_table~double_click.
    " e_row is the row index that was double-clicked
    mv_clicked_row = e_row.
    " In a real scenario, you would now read the data for e_row

    DATA(lv_clicked_row) = 5. " Simulate a double-click on row 5

    " Call the event handler method directly for testing

        e_column = 'CARRID'. " Dummy column name

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Mock a container, as we don't have a real GUI environment in unit tests

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in ein JSON-Format.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA(lo_json_writer) = NEW /ui2/cl_json( ).
    lo_json_writer->serialize(
      EXPORTING

        pretty_print = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_serialize_sflights FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_serialize_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_json_serialize_sflight=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).

    <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    <fs_sflight>-planetype = 'A320'.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, wobei nur die Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen kopiert werden sollen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_fields_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
             field4 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_fields_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_fields_struct=>ty_source.
    ls_source-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_source-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-field3 = 'World'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_fields_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String mit Flugdaten und transformieren Sie diese direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und das Datum enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>deserialize` gefolgt von einem `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_raw_flight.
    TYPES: tt_raw_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simplified_flight,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_simplified_flight.
    TYPES: tt_simplified_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simplified_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_and_transform
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_simplified_flights) TYPE tt_simplified_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_and_transform.
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE tt_raw_flight.

    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json        = iv_json_string
      CHANGING
        data        = lt_raw_flights
    ).

    rt_simplified_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_flights
        ( flight_id   = |{ ls_raw-carrid } { ls_raw-connid }|
          flight_date = ls_raw-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen potenziell fehlerhaften JSON-String und fangen Sie mögliche Ausnahmen ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahme `/UI2/CX_JSON_PARSER_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = rt_data
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            previous = lx_json_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten (Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft) und serialisieren Sie das Ergebnis in JSON.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `/UI2/CL_JSON=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_reduce_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_reduce_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_json.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_raw.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_carrier_counts) = REDUCE tt_carrier_count(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_carrier_count( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO GROUP lg_flights
      (
        counts = VALUE #( 
          counts
          ( carrier = lg_flights-carrid
            flight_count = lines( lg_flights ) )
        )
      )
    ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = lt_carrier_counts
        pretty_print = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Struktur aus einer bestehenden, indem Sie nur die korrespondierenden Felder kopieren und gleichzeitig ein neues Feld initialisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_value_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS create_target_from_source
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_value_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_target_from_source.
    rs_target = VALUE #( 
      BASE CORRESPONDING ty_target( is_source )
      active = COND #( WHEN is_source-status = 'A' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
      comment = 'Created from source'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_create_target_inactive FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_target_active.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_value_struct=>ty_source.
    ls_source-id = 1.
    ls_source-name = 'Item A'.
    ls_source-status = 'A'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_value_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->create_target_from_source( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-active exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-comment exp = 'Created from source' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_target_inactive.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_value_struct=>ty_source.
    ls_source-id = 2.
    ls_source-name = 'Item B'.
    ls_source-status = 'X'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_value_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->create_target_from_source( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-active exp = abap_false ).

explanation: Die Kombination des `CORRESPONDING` Operators mit dem `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und prägnante Erstellung und Initialisierung von Strukturen. Man kann Basisfelder automatisch kopieren und gleichzeitig andere Felder mit neuen Werten oder bedingten Ausdrücken (`COND`) belegen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, VALUE, Structure, COND, Data Transfer

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, filtern Sie diese vorher nach einem Kriterium und verwenden Sie dabei String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Tabellenfilterung und String-Templates für die JSON-Ausgabe (falls manuell). Für `/UI2/CL_JSON` ist der Filter vor der Serialisierung anzuwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_filter_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filter_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_json.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER tt_sflight(
      lt_all_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
    ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = lt_filtered_sflights
        pretty_print = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights_json FOR TESTING.

    " Assuming SFLIGHT has data for 'LH' and other carriers.

explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` für die effiziente Filterung interner Tabellen und der anschließenden JSON-Serialisierung ist ein modernes und leistungsstarkes Muster. `FILTER` ermöglicht eine deklarative und performante Datenreduktion direkt im Code.
