Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur die korrespondierenden Felder übertragen werden und leere Zeilen ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... EXCEPT ... )` oder `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_fields_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_and_filter_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_fields_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_and_filter_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      it_source MAPPING name = name WHERE ( name IS NOT INITIAL ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_and_filter_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_and_filter_table.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_corr_fields_table_filter=>tt_source.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>).
    <fs_source>-id = 1.
    <fs_source>-name = 'Item A'.
    <fs_source>-value = 10.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_source>.
    <fs_source>-id = 2.
    <fs_source>-name = ''. " Empty name
    <fs_source>-value = 20.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_source>.
    <fs_source>-id = 3.
    <fs_source>-name = 'Item C'.
    <fs_source>-value = 30.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_fields_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_and_filter_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_target1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target1-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target1-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_target2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target2-id exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target2-name exp = 'Item C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator kann mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel erweitert werden, um Zeilen während der Zuweisung zu filtern. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen zu übertragen und gleichzeitig unerwünschte Einträge zu eliminieren.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Filter, Data Transfer

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine einzelne Flugstruktur in JSON und fügen Sie dabei ein dynamisches Feld hinzu, das nicht Teil der ursprünglichen Struktur ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>serialize` mit einem `data` Parameter vom Typ `DATA` und einer dynamisch erstellten Struktur oder einer Hash-Map.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_base,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_base.

    METHODS serialize_with_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_base TYPE ty_sflight_base
        iv_dynamic_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_with_dynamic_field.
    DATA: ls_dynamic_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA ls_dynamic_data LIKE is_sflight_base.
    ASSIGN ls_dynamic_data->* TO <fs_struct>.
    <fs_struct> = is_sflight_base.

    " Add dynamic field
    INSERT DATA(lv_dynamic_field_name) = 'dynamic_info' INTO TABLE <fs_struct> INDEX 1.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_dynamic_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_field> = iv_dynamic_value.
    ENDIF.

    " Note: /UI2/CL_JSON does not directly support adding dynamic fields to a typed structure for serialization.
    " A common workaround is to serialize to a JSON-like internal table (e.g., ABAP_JSON_OBJECT) first,
    " or to use a generic data reference and manipulate it via RTTS or field symbols.
    " For simplicity and directness with /UI2/CL_JSON, we'll use a simple structure and assume the dynamic field
    " is part of a broader, more flexible structure (e.g., a nested table of name-value pairs) or use a map.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flexible_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             dynamic_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flexible_data.
    DATA(ls_flexible_data) = VALUE ty_flexible_data(
      carrid = is_sflight_base-carrid
      connid = is_sflight_base-connid
      fldate = is_sflight_base-fldate
      dynamic_info = iv_dynamic_value
    ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = ls_flexible_data
        pretty_print = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_dynamic_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_dynamic_field.
    DATA: ls_sflight_base TYPE zcl_json_dynamic_field=>ty_sflight_base.
    ls_sflight_base-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight_base-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight_base-fldate = '20250101'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_field( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_with_dynamic_field(
      is_sflight_base = ls_sflight_base,
      iv_dynamic_value = 'Extra Info'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_json,
      exp = '"carrid": "LH"'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_json,
      exp = '"dynamic_info": "Extra Info"'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Hinzufügen dynamischer Felder zu einer JSON-Ausgabe erfordert oft eine flexible Datenstruktur oder die Verwendung von RTTS/Field-Symbols. Hier wird eine flexible Struktur verwendet, die das dynamische Feld bereits enthält, um die direkte Serialisierung mit `/UI2/CL_JSON` zu ermöglichen. Dies ist eine gängige Praxis, wenn die Struktur der JSON-Ausgabe nicht statisch ist.
keywords: JSON, Serialization, Dynamic Fields, /UI2/CL_JSON, RTTS

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung von Flugdaten in einer internen Tabelle durch, indem Sie eine Quelltabelle verwenden und nur die korrespondierenden Felder aktualisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` und `FOR` für die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_update_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_update_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_update_data.
    TYPES: tt_update_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_update_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_current_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        it_updates         TYPE tt_update_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_update_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_current IN it_current_flights
      LET ls_update = it_updates[ KEY carrid connid fldate = ls_current-carrid ls_current-connid ls_current-fldate ] IN
      ( COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN CORRESPONDING #( BASE (ls_current) ls_update ) ELSE ls_current ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flights.
    DATA: lt_current TYPE zcl_corr_update_table=>tt_flight_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_current.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A321' seatsocc = 150 ) INTO TABLE lt_current.

    DATA: lt_updates TYPE zcl_corr_update_table=>tt_update_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 120 ) INTO TABLE lt_updates.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_updates.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_update_table( ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->update_flights( it_current_flights = lt_current it_updates = lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_updated ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_updated WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-seatsocc exp = 120 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-planetype exp = 'A320' ). " Unchanged field
    READ TABLE lt_updated WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-seatsocc exp = 150 ). " Unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine moderne und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu aktualisieren. Durch die Kombination von `FOR`, `LET`, `COND` und `CORRESPONDING` kann eine Massenaktualisierung mit bedingter Zuweisung in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung durchgeführt werden, was die Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Update, FOR, LET, COND

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Objekten enthält, in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie dabei die neue Syntax für die Fehlerbehandlung mit `CATCH SYSTEM-EXCEPTIONS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>deserialize` und fangen Sie Fehler mit `CATCH SYSTEM-EXCEPTIONS` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_catch_exceptions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_items
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_item
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_catch_exceptions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_items.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = rt_items
        ).
    CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_parser_error).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
          previous = lx_json_parser_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"id":1,"name":"Apple"},{"id":2,"name":"Banana"}]`.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle aus einer anderen, indem Sie nur die korrespondierenden Felder kopieren und dabei eine Sortierung anwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( SORTED BY ... FOR ... IN ... )` in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             order_key TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             name   TYPE string,
             id     TYPE i,
             sort_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sorted_target_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sorted_target_table.
    rt_target = VALUE tt_target(
      FOR ls_source IN it_source
      ( CORRESPONDING ty_target(
          ls_source MAPPING sort_field = order_key
        ) )
    ).
    SORT rt_target BY sort_field.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_sorted_target_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_sorted_target_table.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_corr_sorted_table=>tt_source.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item C' order_key = 3 ) INTO TABLE lt_source.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Item A' order_key = 1 ) INTO TABLE lt_source.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'Item B' order_key = 2 ) INTO TABLE lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->create_sorted_target_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_target1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target1-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_target2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target2-name exp = 'Item B' ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_target3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target3-name exp = 'Item C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für die feldweise Zuweisung mit einer expliziten `SORT` Anweisung nach der Erstellung der Zieltabelle. Dies ist eine klare und effiziente Methode, um Daten zu transformieren und gleichzeitig eine bestimmte Reihenfolge zu gewährleisten.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in JSON, wobei Datumsfelder im ISO 8601-Format ausgegeben werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>serialize` und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Datumsfelder korrekt formatiert sind, eventuell durch vorherige Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_iso_date_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_iso,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE string,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_iso.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_iso TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_iso WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_iso_dates
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_iso_date_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_iso_dates.
    DATA(lt_sflights_iso) = VALUE tt_sflight_iso(
      FOR ls_raw IN it_sflights
      ( 
        CORRESPONDING ty_sflight_iso( ls_raw )
        fldate = |{ ls_raw-fldate(4) }-{ ls_raw-fldate+4(2) }-{ ls_raw-fldate+6(2) }|
      )
    ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = lt_sflights_iso
        pretty_print = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_serialize_iso_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_iso_dates.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE zcl_json_iso_date_serialize=>tt_sflight_raw.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights_raw ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    <fs_sflight>-planetype = 'A320'.
    <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 100.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um Datumsfelder im ISO 8601-Format in JSON zu serialisieren, ist eine vorherige Transformation des Datumsfeldes in einen String notwendig. Dies wird hier elegant mit einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck und String-Templates in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` gelöst, was den Code kompakt und lesbar macht.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine bedingte Zuweisung von Werten zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, basierend auf einem Kriterium, wobei nur korrespondierende Felder betroffen sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator in Kombination mit `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_cond_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             processed_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS assign_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
        iv_condition TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_cond_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_conditionally.
    rs_target = COND ty_target(
      WHEN iv_condition = abap_true
      THEN CORRESPONDING #( 
        is_source MAPPING processed_value = value 
      )
      ELSE VALUE ty_target(
        id = is_source-id
        name = is_source-name
        status = 'I' " Inaktiv
        processed_value = 0
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_assign_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_assign_false FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_true.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_cond_assign=>ty_source.
    ls_source-id = 1.
    ls_source-name = 'Test Item'.
    ls_source-status = 'A'.
    ls_source-value = 100.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_cond_assign( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->assign_conditionally( is_source = ls_source iv_condition = abap_true ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Test Item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-processed_value exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_assign_false.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_cond_assign=>ty_source.
    ls_source-id = 2.
    ls_source-name = 'Another Item'.
    ls_source-status = 'X'.
    ls_source-value = 200.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_cond_assign( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->assign_conditionally( is_source = ls_source iv_condition = abap_false ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Another Item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-processed_value exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination des `CORRESPONDING` Operators mit dem `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und prägnante bedingte Zuweisung von Werten zwischen Strukturen. Dies reduziert `IF`-Blöcke und macht den Code funktionaler und leichter verständlich.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, COND, Structure, Conditional Logic, Data Transfer

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in `sflights` pro Fluggesellschaft und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Map (Hash-Tabelle).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und `COUNT( GROUP ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_carrid_count.
    TYPES ty_carrid_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrid_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rt_carrier_counts = REDUCE ty_carrid_count_map(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_carrid_count_map( )
      FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid )
      LET lv_count = COUNT( GROUP <group_key> ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_carrid_count_map( BASE result ( key <group_key>-carrid = lv_count ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flight_counts( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_counts ) >= 0 ). " Check it runs.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS` ist eine sehr mächtige Expression, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu aggregieren und zu transformieren. Hier wird `COUNT( GROUP <group_key> )` verwendet, um die Anzahl der Elemente pro Gruppe zu ermitteln.
keywords: COUNT, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, Internal Tables, sflights, Map, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_ida_currency_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_salv_gui_table_ida_calc_col~get_value.
    " This is a simplified example. In a real scenario, you'd fetch

    " a proper currency conversion.
    " For demo, we just multiply by a fixed factor.
    DATA(lv_price) = CAST sflight-price( row_data->get_value( 'PRICE' ) ).

    " Simplified conversion: EUR to USD (fixed rate)

CLASS zcl_count_multi_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_flight_group_count.

CLASS zcl_count_multi_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multi_grouped_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, fldate, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rt_grouped_counts = VALUE tt_flight_group_count(
      FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid fldate = sflight-fldate )
      ( carrid = <group_key>-carrid,
        fldate = <group_key>-fldate,
        count  = COUNT( GROUP <group_key> ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die 'MAX_SEATS' eines spezifischen Fluges in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf dem Flugdatum und der Flugnummer. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Syntax zur Datenkonstruktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... INDEX ... TRANSPORTING ...` oder `MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE ...`. Für die Erstellung der zu aktualisierenden Zeile nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, " Simplified SFLIGHTS structure for demo
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_seats.
    DATA(ls_flight_key) = VALUE ty_sflight(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
    ).

    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM VALUE ty_sflight(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
      max_seats = iv_new_max_seats
    ) TRANSPORTING max_seats WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_single_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_updater=>ty_sflights.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_updater( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' max_seats = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' max_seats = 150 ) TO lt_flights.

    " Update a specific flight
    lo_updater->update_flight_seats(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid   = 'LH'
        iv_connid   = '0400'
        iv_fldate   = '20251201'
        iv_new_max_seats = 120
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  = lt_flights
    ).

    " Assert the change
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_updated_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-max_seats exp = 120 msg = 'MAX_SEATS should be updated' ).

    " Assert other flights are unchanged
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_unchanged_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_unchanged_flight-max_seats exp = 150 msg = 'Other flights should remain unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` Syntax ermöglicht eine gezielte Aktualisierung von Zeilen in internen Tabellen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für die Konstruktion der zu aktualisierenden Zeile ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, Daten zu initialisieren.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, VALUE, SFLIGHTS, Update

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie die 'MAX_SEATS' für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS` um einen festen Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE ... TRANSPORTING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_mass_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, " Simplified SFLIGHTS structure for demo
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase_by TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_mass_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_seats_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-max_seats = <fs_flight>-max_seats + iv_increase_by.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_mass_updater=>ty_sflights.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_mass_updater( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' max_seats = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' max_seats = 150 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' max_seats = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    " Increase seats for 'LH' flights by 20
    lo_updater->increase_seats_by_carrier(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid   = 'LH'
        iv_increase_by = 20
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  = lt_flights
    ).

    " Assert the changes for 'LH' flights
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-max_seats exp = 120 msg = 'LH flight 1 seats should be 120' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-max_seats exp = 170 msg = 'LH flight 2 seats should be 170' ).

    " Assert 'AA' flight is unchanged
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-max_seats exp = 200 msg = 'AA flight seats should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Aktualisierung mehrerer Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle kann effizient mit einer `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) WHERE ...` Schleife durchgeführt werden. Dies ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der Zeilen über das Feldsymbol, ohne explizit `MODIFY TABLE` aufrufen zu müssen.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, WHERE, SFLIGHTS, LOOP, Field-Symbol

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der UTF-8-Zeichen enthält, in die Codepage 'ISO-8859-1'.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>convert`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_iso
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_utf8_string
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Convert xstring (UTF-8) to string (ISO-8859-1)
    rv_iso_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source      = lv_xstring
      source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_utf8_to_iso FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_utf8_to_iso_unrepresentable FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_input) = `Grüße`.
    DATA(lv_iso_expected) = `Grüße`.

    DATA(lv_iso_output) = lo_converter->convert_utf8_to_iso( lv_utf8_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_iso_output exp = lv_iso_expected msg = 'UTF-8 to ISO-8859-1 conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_utf8_to_iso_unrepresentable.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_input) = `你好`.
    DATA(lv_iso_expected) = `??`.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_iso_output) = lo_converter->convert_utf8_to_iso( lv_utf8_input ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_iso_output exp = lv_iso_expected msg = 'Unrepresentable characters should be replaced' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Conversion should not raise an error for unrepresentable characters without replacement option' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` ist das zentrale Werkzeug für die Codepage-Konvertierung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht die Umwandlung von `xstring` (binäre Daten) zwischen verschiedenen Codepages. Hier wird ein UTF-8-String zunächst in ein `xstring` umgewandelt und dann in einen `string` mit ISO-8859-1-Codierung konvertiert. Nicht darstellbare Zeichen werden standardmäßig durch '?' ersetzt.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Convert, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, Character Set, xstring

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der in der Codepage 'ISO-8859-1' vorliegt, in UTF-8.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>convert`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_converter_iso_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_iso_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_iso_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_converter_iso_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_iso_to_utf8.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string to xstring (ISO-8859-1)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_iso_string
        encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Convert xstring (ISO-8859-1) to string (UTF-8)
    rv_utf8_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source      = lv_xstring
      source_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
      target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_iso_to_utf8 FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter_iso_utf8( ).
    DATA(lv_iso_input) = `Grüße`.
    DATA(lv_utf8_expected) = `Grüße`.

    DATA(lv_utf8_output) = lo_converter->convert_iso_to_utf8( lv_iso_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_utf8_output exp = lv_utf8_expected msg = 'ISO-8859-1 to UTF-8 conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Ähnlich wie bei der Konvertierung von UTF-8 zu ISO-8859-1 wird hier der umgekehrte Weg beschritten. Der String wird zunächst als ISO-8859-1 in ein `xstring` umgewandelt und dann mit `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` in einen UTF-8-String konvertiert. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Darstellung von Zeichen in Systemen, die unterschiedliche Standard-Codepages verwenden.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Convert, ISO-8859-1, UTF-8, Character Set, xstring

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` enthält, deren 'MAX_SEATS' um 10% erhöht wurden, aber nur für Flüge mit mehr als 100 Sitzen. Verwenden Sie dabei eine `FOR`-Expression und `VALUE #(...)`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` mit `VALUE #(...)` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, " Simplified SFLIGHTS structure for demo
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights  TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                      WHERE ( max_seats > 100 )
                                      ( VALUE #( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )
                                                 max_seats = CONV #( ls_flight-max_seats * '1.1' ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_transformer=>ty_sflights.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' max_seats = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' max_seats = 150 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' max_seats = 80 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lt_flights ).

    " Assert the transformed table has correct entries and values
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 1 msg = 'Only one flight should be transformed' ).

    READ TABLE lt_transformed WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_transformed_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_transformed_flight-max_seats exp = 165 msg = 'MAX_SEATS should be 150 * 1.1 = 165' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` und `CORRESPONDING #(...)` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier werden nur Flüge mit mehr als 100 Sitzen ausgewählt (`WHERE`) und deren `MAX_SEATS` um 10% erhöht, während alle anderen Felder beibehalten werden (`CORRESPONDING`).
keywords: Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft in `SFLIGHTS` und aktualisieren Sie dann einen separaten Datensatz (z.B. in einer Konfigurationstabelle, hier simuliert) mit diesem Wert. Demonstrieren Sie die Aggregation mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `MODIFY` für die Aktualisierung des Zieldatensatzes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_seat_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, " Simplified SFLIGHTS structure for demo
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES ty_carrier_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS aggregate_and_update
      IMPORTING
        it_flights  TYPE ty_sflights
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_summaries TYPE ty_carrier_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_seat_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_update.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                     WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-max_seats ).

    MODIFY TABLE ct_summaries FROM VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      total_seats = lv_total_seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregate_and_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_and_update.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_seat_aggregator=>ty_sflights.
    DATA: lt_summaries TYPE zcl_seat_aggregator=>ty_carrier_summaries.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_seat_aggregator( ).

    " Initial flight data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' max_seats = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' max_seats = 150 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' max_seats = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    " Initial summary data (optional, MODIFY will insert if not found)
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' total_seats = 0 ) TO lt_summaries.

    " Aggregate and update for 'LH'
    lo_aggregator->aggregate_and_update(
      EXPORTING
        it_flights  = lt_flights
        iv_carrid   = 'LH'
      CHANGING
        ct_summaries = lt_summaries
    ).

    " Assert the updated summary
    READ TABLE lt_summaries WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-total_seats exp = 250 msg = 'Total seats for LH should be 250' ).

    " Test for a new carrier (MODIFY should insert)
    lo_aggregator->aggregate_and_update(
      EXPORTING
        it_flights  = lt_flights
        iv_carrid   = 'AA'
      CHANGING
        ct_summaries = lt_summaries
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_summaries WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO ls_summary.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-total_seats exp = 200 msg = 'Total seats for AA should be 200' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen. Hier wird die Gesamtzahl der Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft berechnet. Anschließend wird der aggregierte Wert mit `MODIFY TABLE` in einer separaten internen Tabelle aktualisiert. Wenn der Schlüssel nicht existiert, wird ein neuer Eintrag erstellt; ansonsten wird der bestehende aktualisiert.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Markieren Sie alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS`, die in der Vergangenheit liegen, als 'abgelaufen', indem Sie ein neues Feld `STATUS` hinzufügen und aktualisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um die relevanten Zeilen zu identifizieren und dann `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` diese Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_status.
    TYPES ty_flights_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mark_past_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE ty_flights_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mark_past_flights.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE fldate < lv_current_date.
      <fs_flight>-status = 'ABGELAUFEN'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mark_past_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mark_past_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_status_updater=>ty_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_status_updater( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' max_seats = 100 status = 'OFFEN' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' max_seats = 150 status = 'OFFEN' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20260101' max_seats = 200 status = 'OFFEN' ) TO lt_flights.

    " Set a fixed date for testing to simulate past flights
    DATA(lv_test_date) = '20251215'.
    " Temporarily override sy-datum for testing purposes (not recommended in productive code)
    " For a real test, you'd pass the 'current date' as a parameter to the method.
    " Here, we simulate it by adjusting the fldate in test data.

    " Mark flights before 20251215 as 'ABGELAUFEN'
    lo_updater->mark_past_flights(
      CHANGING
        ct_flights = lt_flights
    ).

    " Assert the status of past flights
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_past_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_past_flight1-status exp = 'ABGELAUFEN' msg = 'Flight 20251201 should be expired' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_past_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_past_flight2-status exp = 'ABGELAUFEN' msg = 'Flight 20251202 should be expired' ).

    " Assert the status of future flights
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20260101' INTO DATA(ls_future_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_future_flight-status exp = 'OFFEN' msg = 'Future flight should remain open' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl die `FILTER`-Expression eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, kann die Logik des Filterns auch direkt in einer `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` Anweisung verwendet werden, um Zeilen einer bestehenden Tabelle zu modifizieren. Dies ist effizient, da keine neue Tabelle erstellt werden muss. Das Feldsymbol `<fs_flight>` ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung der Tabellenzeile.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, FILTER, SFLIGHTS, Date/Time, LOOP, Field-Symbol

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von UTF-8 nach ISO-8859-1 und behandeln Sie dabei Zeichen, die nicht in der Ziel-Codepage darstellbar sind, indem Sie ein spezifisches Ersatzzeichen verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Parameter `REPLACEMENT` und `REPLACEMENT_CODEPAGE` von `cl_abap_codepage=>convert`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_replacement
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
        iv_replacement_char TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT '#'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_replacement.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_utf8_string
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Convert xstring (UTF-8) to string (ISO-8859-1) with replacement
    rv_iso_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source            = lv_xstring
      source_codepage   = 'UTF-8'
      target_codepage   = 'ISO-8859-1'
      replacement       = iv_replacement_char
      replacement_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_convert_with_custom_replacement FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_with_custom_replacement.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_input) = `你好, Grüße`.
    DATA(lv_iso_expected) = `##, Grüße`.

    DATA(lv_iso_output) = lo_converter->convert_with_replacement( iv_utf8_string = lv_utf8_input iv_replacement_char = '#' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_iso_output exp = lv_iso_expected msg = 'Unrepresentable characters should be replaced by #' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` bietet Parameter wie `REPLACEMENT` und `REPLACEMENT_CODEPAGE`, um das Verhalten bei nicht darstellbaren Zeichen zu steuern. Dies ist entscheidend für die Datenintegrität, wenn Zeichen zwischen Codepages konvertiert werden, die nicht alle Zeichen gemeinsam haben. Statt eines Standard-Fragezeichens kann ein spezifisches Ersatzzeichen definiert werden.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Convert, Error Handling, Replacement, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS` mit Daten aus einer Quellstruktur, die nur eine Teilmenge der Felder enthält. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die Feldzuordnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ... TRANSPORTING CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_partial_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, " Simplified SFLIGHTS structure for demo
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_partial_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_partial_flight_data.

    METHODS update_flight_partial
      IMPORTING
        is_partial_data TYPE ty_partial_flight_data
      CHANGING
        ct_flights      TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_partial_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_partial.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM is_partial_data TRANSPORTING CORRESPONDING FIELDS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_partial_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_partial_fields.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_partial_updater=>ty_sflights.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_partial_updater( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' planetype = 'A320' max_seats = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' planetype = 'B747' max_seats = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    " Partial data to update
    DATA(ls_partial) = VALUE zcl_flight_partial_updater=>ty_partial_flight_data(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '0400'
      fldate = '20251201'
      max_seats = 120
    ).

    lo_updater->update_flight_partial(
      EXPORTING
        is_partial_data = ls_partial
      CHANGING
        ct_flights      = lt_flights
    ).

    " Assert only max_seats is updated, planetype remains original
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_updated_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-max_seats exp = 120 msg = 'MAX_SEATS should be updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-planetype exp = 'A320' msg = 'PLANETYPE should remain unchanged' ).

    " Assert other flights are unchanged
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_unchanged_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_unchanged_flight-max_seats exp = 200 msg = 'Other flight MAX_SEATS should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ... TRANSPORTING CORRESPONDING FIELDS` Syntax ist eine moderne und bequeme Möglichkeit, eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus einer Quellstruktur zu aktualisieren, die nicht alle Felder der Zieltabelle enthält. Nur die Felder, die in beiden Strukturen vorhanden sind und übereinstimmende Namen haben, werden aktualisiert. Dies vermeidet das manuelle Zuweisen einzelner Felder.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, CORRESPONDING, SFLIGHTS, Partial Update

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Flugverbindung in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS` ein. Wenn der Eintrag bereits existiert, soll er aktualisiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ...` ohne `WHERE` oder `INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_upserter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, " Simplified SFLIGHTS structure for demo
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,

    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_upserter=>ty_sflight(

explanation: Wenn `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ...` ohne `WHERE`-Klausel oder `INDEX` verwendet wird, versucht das System, die Zeile anhand des Primärschlüssels der internen Tabelle zu finden. Wenn eine Zeile mit dem gleichen Schlüssel gefunden wird, wird sie aktualisiert; andernfalls wird die Zeile als neuer Eintrag hinzugefügt. Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS` und fügen Sie dann eine neue Liste von Flügen für diese Fluggesellschaft ein. Verwenden Sie dabei `DELETE` und `MODIFY`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...` mit `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, " Simplified SFLIGHTS structure for demo
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS replace_carrier_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_new_flights TYPE ty_sflights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_carrier_flights.
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM TABLE it_new_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_flights_for_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_replacer=>ty_sflights.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_flight_replacer( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' planetype = 'A320' max_seats = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' planetype = 'B747' max_seats = 150 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' planetype = 'A380' max_seats = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    " New flights for 'LH'
    DATA(lt_new_lh_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_replacer=>ty_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20260101' planetype = 'CRJ' max_seats = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0501' fldate = '20260102' planetype = 'E190' max_seats = 80 )
    ).

    lo_replacer->replace_carrier_flights(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid      = 'LH'
        it_new_flights = lt_new_lh_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights     = lt_flights
    ).

    " Assert 'LH' flights are replaced
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Total flights should be 3 (2 new LH + 1 old AA)' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc msg = 'Old LH flight 0400 should be deleted' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20260101' INTO DATA(ls_new_lh_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_new_lh_flight-max_seats exp = 50 msg = 'New LH flight 0500 should be present' ).

    " Assert 'AA' flights are untouched
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_aa_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_flight-max_seats exp = 200 msg = 'AA flight should be untouched' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine 'Replace'-Operation für eine Gruppe von Datensätzen. Zuerst werden alle bestehenden Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft mit `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...` entfernt. Anschließend wird die neue Liste von Flügen für diese Fluggesellschaft mit `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM TABLE ...` eingefügt. Da die Zieltabelle einen eindeutigen Schlüssel hat, verhält sich `MODIFY FROM TABLE` hier wie ein `INSERT` für die neuen Zeilen.
keywords: MODIFY, DELETE, Internal Table, SFLIGHTS, Replace, Mass Update

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die 'PLANETYPE' eines Fluges in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf dem 'MAX_SEATS'-Wert. Wenn 'MAX_SEATS' über einem Schwellenwert liegt, setzen Sie einen 'GROSSFLUGZEUG'-Typ, sonst 'KLEINFLUGZEUG'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und eine `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_planetype_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, " Simplified SFLIGHTS structure for demo
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_planetype_by_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_seat_threshold TYPE sflight-max_seats
      CHANGING
        ct_flights        TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_planetype_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype_by_seats.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-max_seats > iv_seat_threshold.
        <fs_flight>-planetype = 'GROSSFLUGZEUG'.
      ELSE.
        <fs_flight>-planetype = 'KLEINFLUGZEUG'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Strings von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage. Behandeln Sie dabei mögliche Fehler bei der Konvertierung einzelner Strings, indem Sie fehlerhafte Strings protokollieren und überspringen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` in einer Schleife und fangen Sie `cx_sy_codepage_converter_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mass_codepage_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_string_list
      IMPORTING
        it_source_strings TYPE ty_strings
        iv_source_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      EXPORTING
        et_converted_strings TYPE ty_strings
        et_failed_strings    TYPE ty_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mass_codepage_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_list.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    LOOP AT it_source_strings INTO DATA(lv_source_string).
      TRY.
          " Convert string to xstring (source codepage)
          CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
            EXPORTING
              text     = lv_source_string
              encoding = iv_source_codepage
            IMPORTING
              buffer   = lv_xstring
            EXCEPTIONS
              OTHERS   = 1.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
          ENDIF.

          " Convert xstring to target codepage string
          APPEND cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
            source          = lv_xstring
            source_codepage = iv_source_codepage
            target_codepage = iv_target_codepage
          ) TO et_converted_strings.

        CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
          APPEND lv_source_string TO et_failed_strings.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mass_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mass_conversion_with_errors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mass_conversion_success.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_mass_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_mass_codepage_converter=>ty_strings(
      ( `Hello` )
      ( `World` )
      ( `Grüße` )
    ).
    DATA: lt_converted TYPE zcl_mass_codepage_converter=>ty_strings,
          lt_failed    TYPE zcl_mass_codepage_converter=>ty_strings.

    lo_converter->convert_string_list(
      EXPORTING
        it_source_strings  = lt_source
        iv_source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
        iv_target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        et_converted_strings = lt_converted
        et_failed_strings    = lt_failed
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_converted ) exp = 3 msg = 'All strings should be converted' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_failed msg = 'No strings should fail' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[1] exp = `Hello` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[3] exp = `Grüße` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mass_conversion_with_errors.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_mass_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_mass_codepage_converter=>ty_strings(
      ( `Hello` )
      ( `你好` ) " Unrepresentable in ISO-8859-1
      ( `Grüße` )
    ).
    DATA: lt_converted TYPE zcl_mass_codepage_converter=>ty_strings,
          lt_failed    TYPE zcl_mass_codepage_converter=>ty_strings.

    lo_converter->convert_string_list(
      EXPORTING
        it_source_strings  = lt_source
        iv_source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
        iv_target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        et_converted_strings = lt_converted
        et_failed_strings    = lt_failed
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_converted ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two strings should be converted' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_failed ) exp = 1 msg = 'One string should fail' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_failed[1] exp = `你好` msg = 'Failed string should be the unrepresentable one' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[1] exp = `Hello` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[2] exp = `Grüße` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der Massenkonvertierung von Strings ist es wichtig, Fehler bei einzelnen Elementen abzufangen, um den gesamten Prozess nicht zu unterbrechen. Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine `LOOP` über die Quell-Strings und einen `TRY...CATCH`-Block um `cx_sy_codepage_converter_error` abzufangen. Erfolgreich konvertierte Strings werden gesammelt, während fehlerhafte Strings protokolliert und übersprungen werden, was zu einem robusten Konvertierungsprozess führt.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Convert, Error Handling, Mass Conversion, TRY-CATCH, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1

Instructions: Berechne das Alter einer Person basierend auf dem Geburtsdatum bis zum heutigen Datum.
hint: Nutze moderne Datumsarithmetik und die Funktion `cl_abap_date_helper=>get_current_date`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_current_date( ).
    DATA(lv_years_diff) = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).

    IF lv_current_date(4) < iv_birth_date(4).
      rv_age = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( lv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND lv_current_date+2(2) < iv_birth_date+2(2) ).
      rv_age = lv_years_diff - 1.
    ELSE.
      rv_age = lv_years_diff.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_age FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_age.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_age_calculator( ).

    " Test case: Born today, age 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_current_date( ) ) exp = 0 msg = 'Test 1: Born today' ).

    " Test case: Born 10 years ago, same month/day
    DATA(lv_past_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_current_date( ) - 3650. " Approx 10 years
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age( lv_past_date ) exp = 9 msg = 'Test 2: Born 10 years ago' ).

    " Test case: Born 2000-01-01, current 2025-12-06, age 25

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Arbeitstage (Montag bis Freitag) zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten.
hint: Iteriere über den Datumsbereich und verwende `cl_abap_date_helper=>is_weekend`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_working_days.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d.

    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date.
      rv_working_days = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_date = iv_start_date.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      IF NOT cl_abap_date_helper=>is_weekend( lv_current_date ).
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe, ob ein bestimmtes Bit in einem Byte (XSTRING der Länge 1) gesetzt ist.
hint: Verwende die bitweise `BIT-AND` Operation mit einer Maske.
solution:
CLASS zcl_byte_bit_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_bit_set
      IMPORTING
        iv_byte    TYPE x LENGTH 1
        iv_bit_pos TYPE i " 0-7 for bit position
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_set) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_byte_bit_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_bit_set.
    IF iv_bit_pos < 0 OR iv_bit_pos > 7.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Bit position must be between 0 and 7.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_mask) TYPE x LENGTH 1.
    lv_mask = 1 BIT-LSHIFT iv_bit_pos. " Create a mask with the desired bit set

    IF ( iv_byte BIT-AND lv_mask ) = lv_mask.
      rv_is_set = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_set = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_is_bit_set.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_byte_bit_checker( ).

    " Test byte: '01'X (0000 0001 binary)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_byte = '01'X iv_bit_pos = 0 ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Test 1: Bit 0 in 01X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_byte = '01'X iv_bit_pos = 1 ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Test 2: Bit 1 in 01X' ).

    " Test byte: '80'X (1000 0000 binary)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_byte = '80'X iv_bit_pos = 7 ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Test 3: Bit 7 in 80X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_byte = '80'X iv_bit_pos = 6 ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Test 4: Bit 6 in 80X' ).

    " Test byte: 'FF'X (1111 1111 binary)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_byte = 'FF'X iv_bit_pos = 3 ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Test 5: Bit 3 in FFX' ).

    " Test byte: '00'X (0000 0000 binary)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_byte = '00'X iv_bit_pos = 0 ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Test 6: Bit 0 in 00X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_bit_set_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_byte_bit_checker( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_byte = '01'X iv_bit_pos = 8 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds for bit pos too high' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception for bit pos too high' ).
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_byte = '01'X iv_bit_pos = -1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds for negative bit pos' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception for negative bit pos' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Prüfen einzelner Bits in einem Byte ist eine grundlegende binäre Operation. Hier wird die `BIT-AND` Anweisung zusammen mit einer Bitmaske verwendet, die durch `BIT-LSHIFT` dynamisch erzeugt wird. Wenn das Ergebnis der `BIT-AND`-Operation gleich der Maske ist, bedeutet dies, dass das entsprechende Bit im Eingabebyte gesetzt ist. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode zur Bit-Manipulation.
keywords: Binary, Bit, Bitwise, BIT-AND, BIT-LSHIFT, Byte

Instructions: Setze ein bestimmtes Bit in einem Byte (XSTRING der Länge 1) auf 1 oder 0.
hint: Verwende bitweise `BIT-OR` zum Setzen und `BIT-AND` mit invertierter Maske zum Löschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_byte_bit_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_bit
      IMPORTING
        iv_byte    TYPE x LENGTH 1
        iv_bit_pos TYPE i " 0-7 for bit position
        iv_value   TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_byte) TYPE x LENGTH 1
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_byte_bit_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_bit.
    IF iv_bit_pos < 0 OR iv_bit_pos > 7.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Bit position must be between 0 and 7.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_mask) TYPE x LENGTH 1.
    lv_mask = 1 BIT-LSHIFT iv_bit_pos.

    IF iv_value = abap_true.
      rv_result_byte = iv_byte BIT-OR lv_mask. " Set bit
    ELSE.
      rv_result_byte = iv_byte BIT-AND BIT-NOT lv_mask. " Clear bit
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_set_bit FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_bit_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_bit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_byte_bit_setter( ).

    " Test byte: '00'X (0000 0000 binary)
    " Set bit 0 to 1 -> '01'X
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->set_bit( iv_byte = '00'X iv_bit_pos = 0 iv_value = abap_true ) exp = '01'X msg = 'Test 1: Set bit 0' ).
    " Set bit 7 to 1 -> '80'X
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->set_bit( iv_byte = '00'X iv_bit_pos = 7 iv_value = abap_true ) exp = '80'X msg = 'Test 2: Set bit 7' ).

    " Test byte: 'FF'X (1111 1111 binary)
    " Clear bit 0 to 0 -> 'FE'X
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->set_bit( iv_byte = 'FF'X iv_bit_pos = 0 iv_value = abap_false ) exp = 'FE'X msg = 'Test 3: Clear bit 0' ).
    " Clear bit 7 to 0 -> '7F'X
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->set_bit( iv_byte = 'FF'X iv_bit_pos = 7 iv_value = abap_false ) exp = '7F'X msg = 'Test 4: Clear bit 7' ).

    " Test byte: '01'X (0000 0001 binary)
    " Clear bit 0 to 0 -> '00'X
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->set_bit( iv_byte = '01'X iv_bit_pos = 0 iv_value = abap_false ) exp = '00'X msg = 'Test 5: Clear bit 0 from 01X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_bit_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_byte_bit_setter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_bit( iv_byte = '00'X iv_bit_pos = 8 iv_value = abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds for bit pos too high' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception for bit pos too high' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man einzelne Bits in einem Byte gezielt setzen oder löschen kann. Zum Setzen eines Bits wird die `BIT-OR` Operation mit einer Maske verwendet. Zum Löschen eines Bits wird die `BIT-AND` Operation mit der invertierten Maske (`BIT-NOT`) genutzt. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für die präzise Steuerung von binären Daten.
keywords: Binary, Bit, Bitwise, BIT-OR, BIT-AND, BIT-NOT, Byte Manipulation

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine interne Tabelle von XSTRINGs.

CLASS zcl_string_table_to_xstring_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create( ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_table_to_xstring_tab( ).

    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Line 1' ) ( 'Line 2' ) ( 'ÄÖÜ' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected_xstrings) = VALUE xstring_table(
      ( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create( )->convert( in = 'Line 1' ) )
      ( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create( )->convert( in = 'Line 2' ) )
      ( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create( )->convert( in = 'ÄÖÜ' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual_xstrings) = lo_cut->convert_table( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_xstrings ) exp = lines( lt_expected_xstrings ) msg = 'Test 1: Number of lines' ).

    LOOP AT lt_actual_xstrings INTO DATA(lv_actual_xstring).
      READ TABLE lt_expected_xstrings INTO DATA(lv_expected_xstring) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring msg = |Test { sy-tabix }: Line { sy-tabix }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_empty_xstrings) = lo_cut->convert_table( lt_empty_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_empty_xstrings msg = 'Test 4: Empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle wird die `cl_abap_conv_codepage` verwendet, um die Konvertierung durchzuführen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Syntax.

Instructions: Vergleiche zwei XSTRINGs auf Gleichheit, ohne sie in Strings zu konvertieren.
hint: XSTRINGs können direkt mit `=` verglichen werden.

CLASS zcl_xstring_comparator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS compare_xstrings

        iv_xstring1 TYPE xstring
        iv_xstring2 TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_xstring_comparator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_xstrings.
    IF iv_xstring1 = iv_xstring2.

    ELSE.
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_xstrings( iv_xstring1 = 'AABBCC'X iv_xstring2 = 'AABBCC'X ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Test 1: Equal' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_xstrings( iv_xstring1 = 'AABBCC'X iv_xstring2 = 'AABBEE'X ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Test 2: Different content' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_xstrings( iv_xstring1 = 'AABBCC'X iv_xstring2 = 'AABBCCDD'X ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Test 3: Different length' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_xstrings( iv_xstring1 = ''X iv_xstring2 = '01'X ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Test 5: One empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: XSTRINGs können in ABAP direkt mit dem Gleichheitsoperator (`=`) verglichen werden. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um binäre Daten auf Gleichheit zu prüfen, ohne den Overhead einer Konvertierung in Strings. Der Vergleich berücksichtigt sowohl den Inhalt als auch die Länge der XSTRINGs.

explanation: Die `STABLE` Option bei der `SORT` Anweisung garantiert, dass die relative Reihenfolge von Einträgen, die in den Sortierkriterien gleich sind, nicht verändert wird. Dies ist wichtig, wenn eine Tabelle bereits vorsortiert ist und diese Teilsortierung erhalten bleiben soll.
keywords: SORT STABLE, Internal Tables, Stable Sort

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` dynamisch nach einem Feld, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als Zeichenkette übergeben wird.

CLASS zcl_sort_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

                                           iv_field    TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
           RAISING cx_sy_dyn_sort_field_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_dynamic.
    rt_sorted_flights = it_flights.
    TRY.
        SORT rt_sorted_flights BY (iv_field) ASCENDING.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_sort_field_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_sort_field_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_dyn_sort_field_error=>cx_sy_dyn_sort_field_error
            field   = iv_field.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_carrid[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_carrid[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_by_connid) = lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamic( it_flights = lt_flights iv_field = 'CONNID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_connid[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_connid[ 2 ]-connid exp = '001A' ).

  METHOD test_dynamic_sort_invalid_field.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue sortierte interne Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf einer unsortierten, indem Sie ABAP SQL `ORDER BY` Semantik nutzen und das Ergebnis in einer `VALUE` Expression speichern.

SORTED BY ... )` Konstrukt in ABAP 7.52+ ermöglicht es, eine neue interne Tabelle direkt und funktional zu erstellen, die bereits nach den gewünschten Kriterien sortiert ist.
