Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf dem absoluten Wert des Flugpreises in `price` (aufsteigend).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Hilfsspalte oder eine benutzerdefinierte Sortierungslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_abs_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_price,
           tt_sflight_with_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sort_by_abs_price IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_with_price RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_with_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_abs_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_by_abs_price.
    DATA lt_temp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    lt_temp = it_flights.

    SORT lt_temp BY price ASCENDING.

    " No direct ABS(field) in SORT, so we manually do it or use different logic.
    " Modern approach using a temporary structure with calculated field, then sort.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_abs_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             abs_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_with_abs_price,
           tt_flight_with_abs_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_abs_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_with_abs) = VALUE tt_flight_with_abs_price(
      FOR flight IN it_flights ( VALUE #(
        carrid    = flight-carrid
        connid    = flight-connid
        price     = flight-price
        abs_price = ABS( flight-price )
      ) )
    ).

    SORT lt_with_abs BY abs_price ASCENDING.

    rt_sorted_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_with_price(
      FOR ls_with_abs IN lt_with_abs ( VALUE #(
        carrid = ls_with_abs-carrid
        connid = ls_with_abs-connid
        price  = ls_with_abs-price
      ) )
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_abs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_abs.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_sort_abs_value=>tt_sflight_with_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' price = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' price = -50 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'CC' connid = '003' price = 200 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'DD' connid = '004' price = -150 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'EE' connid = '005' price = 75 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_abs_value( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_by_abs_price( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-connid exp = '002' msg = '1. falscher connid' ). " abs(-50) = 50
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-connid exp = '005' msg = '2. falscher connid' ). " abs(75) = 75
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-connid exp = '001' msg = '3. falscher connid' ). " abs(100) = 100
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 4 ]-connid exp = '004' msg = '4. falscher connid' ). " abs(-150) = 150
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 5 ]-connid exp = '003' msg = '5. falscher connid' ). " abs(200) = 200
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da die `SORT` Anweisung selbst keine Funktion zum Sortieren nach dem absoluten Wert eines Feldes bietet, ist ein moderner Ansatz, temporäre innere Tabellen mit berechneten Feldern zu verwenden. Mithilfe von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` kann eine neue Tabelle mit einer zusätzlichen Spalte für den absoluten Wert einfach erstellt, dann sortiert und anschließend wieder in das ursprüngliche Format gebracht werden. Dies ist funktional und vermeidet explizite Schleifen.
keywords: SORT, ABS, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, Functional Programming

    " Simulate setting a query parameter
    lo_mock_request->set_form_field( iv_name = 'param1' iv_value = 'Wert123' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine JSON-Nutzlast aus dem HTTP-Anfragerumpf aus und parsen Sie diese in eine ABAP-Struktur. Das Beispiel emuliert die HTTP-Anfrage.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_CDATA` der Schnittstelle `IF_HTTP_REQUEST` und `cl_abap_conv_json_reader` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_read_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS read_json_payload
      IMPORTING
        io_request TYPE REF TO if_http_request
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_read_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_json_payload.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = io_request->get_cdata( ).

    IF lv_json_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          " Using CALL TRANSFORMATION is a modern and flexible way to handle JSON
          CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE XML lv_json_string RESULT (rs_data).
          " Note: For direct JSON parsing without intermediate XML, cl_abap_conv_json_reader is also an option,
          " but CALL TRANSFORMATION is often more robust for complex structures and comes with error handling.
        CATCH cx_xslt_format_error.
          " Handle parsing errors
          MESSAGE 'JSON-Parsingfehler' TYPE 'E' RAISING parsing_error.
        CATCH cx_xslt_serialization_error.
          MESSAGE 'JSON-Serialisierungsfehler' TYPE 'E' RAISING parsing_error.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_json_payload FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_json_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_json_payload.
    DATA lo_mock_request TYPE REF TO cl_http_request.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_request.

    DATA(lv_json_input) = '{"FIELD1": "TestValue", "FIELD2": 123}'.
    lo_mock_request->set_cdata( lv_json_input ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_read_json( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->read_json_payload( io_request = lo_mock_request ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result-field1
      exp = 'TestValue'
      msg = 'Feld1 nicht korrekt gelesen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result-field2
      exp = 123
      msg = 'Feld2 nicht korrekt gelesen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_json_invalid.
    DATA lo_mock_request TYPE REF TO cl_http_request.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_request.

    DATA(lv_json_invalid) = '{"FIELD1": "TestValue", "FIELD2": "abc"}'. " Invalid type for FIELD2
    lo_mock_request->set_cdata( lv_json_invalid ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_read_json( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act_class = 'CX_XSLT_FORMAT_ERROR'
      msg = 'Ungültiges JSON sollte eine Exception auslösen'
      act = INDIRECTION ##CALLMETHOD ( lo_cut->read_json_payload( io_request = lo_mock_request ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne ABAP-Systeme integrieren sich oft über REST-APIs, die JSON-Nutzlasten verwenden. Die Methode `GET_CDATA` ruft den Body der Anfrage ab, und `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` (mit dem Standard-ID-Transformation) kann direkt zur Deserialisierung von JSON in ABAP-Strukturen verwendet werden, was eine schlankere und weniger fehleranfällige Lösung als manuelle Parser bietet. Das Schlüsselwort `ID` (Identity Transformation) verarbeitet JSON-Formate automatisch, wenn das Ziel eine ABAP-Struktur ist.
keywords: HTTP, JSON, Payload, IF_HTTP_REQUEST, GET_CDATA, CALL TRANSFORMATION ID, cl_http_server

Instructions: Senden Sie eine JSON-Antwort, die aus einer ABAP-Struktur generiert wurde, an den HTTP-Client mit dem korrekten Content-Type.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION` zur JSON-Serialisierung und `SET_CDATA` sowie `SET_HEADER_FIELD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_send_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             status  TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
             value   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS send_json_response
      IMPORTING
        io_response TYPE REF TO if_http_response
        is_data     TYPE ty_response_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_send_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_json_response.
    DATA lv_json_string TYPE string.

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE (is_data) RESULT XML lv_json_string.
      CATCH cx_xslt_serialization_error.
        MESSAGE 'JSON-Serialisierungsfehler' TYPE 'E' RAISING serialization_error.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lv_json_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      io_response->set_header_field( iv_name = 'Content-Type' iv_value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8' ).
      io_response->set_cdata( lv_json_string ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_json_response FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_json_response.
    DATA lo_mock_response TYPE REF TO cl_http_response.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_response.

    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_http_send_json=>ty_response_data.
    ls_data-status = 'Success'.
    ls_data-message = 'Operation complete'.
    ls_data-value = 42.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_send_json( ).
    lo_cut->send_json_response( io_response = lo_mock_response is_data = ls_data ).

    DATA(lv_content_type) = lo_mock_response->get_header_field( 'Content-Type' ).
    DATA(lv_response_body) = lo_mock_response->get_cdata( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_content_type
      exp = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
      msg = 'Content-Type Header falsch' ).

    DATA ls_deserialized_data TYPE zcl_http_send_json=>ty_response_data.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE XML lv_response_body RESULT (ls_deserialized_data).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_deserialized_data-status
      exp = 'Success'
      msg = 'Status nicht korrekt deserialisiert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_deserialized_data-value
      exp = 42
      msg = 'Value nicht korrekt deserialisiert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zurücksenden von strukturierten Daten als JSON ist bei REST-APIs üblich. `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` kann nicht nur JSON parsen, sondern auch ABAP-Strukturen in JSON serialisieren. Zusammen mit dem Setzen des `Content-Type` Headers auf `application/json` wird eine standardkonforme JSON-Antwort geliefert. Dieser Ansatz ist effizient und nutzt die eingebauten ABAP-Fähigkeiten für JSON-Verarbeitung.
keywords: HTTP, JSON, Response, IF_HTTP_RESPONSE, SET_CDATA, SET_HEADER_FIELD, CALL TRANSFORMATION ID, cl_http_server

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle HTTP-Header aus einer Anfrage aus und geben Sie diese als interne Tabelle mit Name-Wert-Paaren zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_HEADER_FIELDS` der Schnittstelle `IF_HTTP_REQUEST`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_read_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_header,
           tt_headers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_request_headers
      IMPORTING
        io_request TYPE REF TO if_http_request
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_headers) TYPE tt_headers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_read_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_request_headers.
    DATA lt_header_names TYPE string_table.
    DATA lv_header_value TYPE string.

    " Get all header field names
    io_request->get_header_fields( CHANGING names = lt_header_names ).

    LOOP AT lt_header_names INTO DATA(lv_header_name).
      lv_header_value = io_request->get_header_field( lv_header_name ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_header( name = lv_header_name value = lv_header_value ) TO rt_headers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_headers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_headers.
    DATA lo_mock_request TYPE REF TO cl_http_request.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_request.

    lo_mock_request->set_header_field( iv_name = 'Accept' iv_value = 'application/json' ).
    lo_mock_request->set_header_field( iv_name = 'User-Agent' iv_value = 'ABAPUnit Test Client' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_read_headers( ).
    DATA(lt_headers) = lo_cut->get_all_request_headers( io_request = lo_mock_request ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_headers )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Anzahl der Header falsch' ).

    DATA(ls_header_accept) = lt_headers[ name = 'Accept' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_header_accept-value
      exp = 'application/json'
      msg = 'Accept Header Wert falsch' ).

    DATA(ls_header_user_agent) = lt_headers[ name = 'User-Agent' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_header_user_agent-value
      exp = 'ABAPUnit Test Client'
      msg = 'User-Agent Header Wert falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um auf alle HTTP-Header einer Anfrage zuzugreifen, können `GET_HEADER_FIELDS` (um alle Header-Namen zu erhalten) und eine Schleife mit `GET_HEADER_FIELD` verwendet werden. Dies ist ein flexibler Weg, um dynamisch auf unterschiedliche Header zu reagieren. Die moderne Inline-Deklaration und funktionale Syntax für die interne Tabelle machen den Code kompakt und lesbar.
keywords: HTTP, Headers, IF_HTTP_REQUEST, GET_HEADER_FIELDS, GET_HEADER_FIELD, Internal Tables, cl_http_server

Instructions: Führen Sie eine HTTP-Umleitung (Redirect) auf eine andere URL durch (HTTP 302 'Found').
hint: Setzen Sie den Status auf 302 und den 'Location'-Header.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_redirect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_redirect
      IMPORTING
        io_response TYPE REF TO if_http_response
        iv_target_url TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_redirect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_redirect.
    io_response->set_status( code = 302 reason = 'Found' ).
    io_response->set_header_field( iv_name = 'Location' iv_value = iv_target_url ).
    io_response->set_cdata( |Redirecting to { iv_target_url }| ).
    io_response->set_header_field( iv_name = 'Content-Type' iv_value = 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_http_redirect FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_http_redirect.
    DATA lo_mock_response TYPE REF TO cl_http_response.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_response.

    DATA(lv_target) = 'https://www.example.com/newpath'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_redirect( ).
    lo_cut->perform_redirect( io_response = lo_mock_response iv_target_url = lv_target ).

    DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_mock_response->get_status_code( ).
    DATA(lv_reason_phrase) = lo_mock_response->get_reason_phrase( ).
    DATA(lv_location_header) = lo_mock_response->get_header_field( 'Location' ).
    DATA(lv_response_body) = lo_mock_response->get_cdata( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_status_code
      exp = 302
      msg = 'Status Code nicht 302' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_reason_phrase
      exp = 'Found'
      msg = 'Reason Phrase falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_location_header
      exp = lv_target
      msg = 'Location Header falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( 
      act = lv_response_body 
      pat = lv_target 
      msg = 'Response Body enthält nicht die Ziel-URL' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: HTTP-Umleitungen sind unerlässlich für die Wartung von URLs, Lastverteilung oder das Umleiten von Benutzern nach Aktionen. Eine moderne Implementierung setzt den Statuscode auf 302 (temporäre Umleitung) und den `Location`-Header mit der Ziel-URL. ABAP string templates (backticks `` ` `` oder `|` ) sind eine komfortable Methode zur dynamischen Textgenerierung, hier für den Response-Body.
keywords: HTTP, Redirect, 302, Location Header, IF_HTTP_RESPONSE, SET_STATUS, SET_HEADER_FIELD, String Templates, cl_http_server

Instructions: Lesen Sie den HTTP-Anfragemethode (GET, POST etc.) aus und geben Sie diese zurück.

CLASS zcl_http_get_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_method.
    DATA lo_mock_request TYPE REF TO cl_http_request.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_request.

    lo_mock_request->set_request_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_get ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_method( ).

explanation: Das Lesen der HTTP-Methode (z.B. GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) ist grundlegend für die Unterscheidung von Anfrageszenarien in einem Web-Service. Die Methode `GET_METHOD` der `IF_HTTP_REQUEST` liefert einen String mit der verwendeten Methode. Die Verwendung von Konstanten wie `if_http_request=>co_request_method_get` ist eine moderne und typsichere Praxis, um mit diesen Werten zu arbeiten.
keywords: HTTP, Request Method, IF_HTTP_REQUEST, GET_METHOD, GET, POST, cl_http_server

Instructions: Senden Sie eine leere HTTP-Antwort mit dem Status '204 No Content'.
hint: Setzen Sie den Status auf 204 und stellen Sie sicher, dass kein Antwortbody gesendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_no_content DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_no_content_response
      IMPORTING
        io_response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_no_content IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_no_content_response.
    io_response->set_status( code = 204 reason = 'No Content' ).
    " No content is explicitly set, if any data was set before, clear it.
    io_response->set_cdata( '' ).
    io_response->set_header_field( iv_name = 'Content-Length' iv_value = '0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_no_content_response FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_no_content_response.
    DATA lo_mock_response TYPE REF TO cl_http_response.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_response.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_no_content( ).
    lo_cut->send_no_content_response( io_response = lo_mock_response ).

    DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_mock_response->get_status_code( ).
    DATA(lv_reason_phrase) = lo_mock_response->get_reason_phrase( ).
    DATA(lv_response_body) = lo_mock_response->get_cdata( ).
    DATA(lv_content_length) = lo_mock_response->get_header_field( 'Content-Length' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_status_code
      exp = 204
      msg = 'Status Code nicht 204' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_reason_phrase
      exp = 'No Content'
      msg = 'Reason Phrase falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_response_body
      exp = ''
      msg = 'Response Body sollte leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_content_length
      exp = '0'
      msg = 'Content-Length Header falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der HTTP-Statuscode 204 'No Content' wird verwendet, um anzuzeigen, dass der Server die Anfrage erfolgreich bearbeitet hat, aber keine Antwortinhalte zurückgibt. Dies ist typisch für REST-Operationen, die keine Rückgabewerte haben (z.B. erfolgreiches Löschen). Es ist wichtig, auch den `Content-Length`-Header auf '0' zu setzen und sicherzustellen, dass der Response-Body tatsächlich leer ist.
keywords: HTTP, No Content, 204, IF_HTTP_RESPONSE, SET_STATUS, Content-Length, cl_http_server

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die vor dem Jahr 2000 stattgefunden haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `DELETE` Anweisung mit einer `WHERE` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_delete_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_delete_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE fldate < '20000101'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '19991231' planetype = 'A320' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20010101' planetype = 'B747' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '19980515' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' fldate = '20050320' planetype = 'B737' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_delete_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_old_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate
      exp = '20010101'
      msg = 'Der erste verbleibende Flug sollte der von 2001 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE` Anweisung mit `WHERE` Klausel ist die moderne und effizienteste Methode, um Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, die bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen. Sie ist performanter als das Schleifen über die Tabelle und das Löschen einzelner Zeilen.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, WHERE, VALUE, TYPES

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugverbindungen, basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_del_adj_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES tt_connection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_connections TYPE tt_connection
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_connections) TYPE tt_connection.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_del_adj_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_connections = it_connections.
    SORT rt_unique_connections BY carrid connid. " Muss sortiert sein für ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_connections COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES tt_connection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_test_connections) = VALUE tt_connection(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230103' ) " Duplicate, but not adjacent after sort
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20230101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' ) " Duplicate
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_del_adj_dup( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( lt_test_connections ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 eindeutige Verbindungen übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'Erste Verbindung sollte AA sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Zweite Verbindung sollte LH sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Dritte Verbindung sollte UA sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um doppelte Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, da nur *aufeinanderfolgende* Duplikate entfernt werden.
keywords: DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Table, SORT, COMPARING

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft in einem einfachen ALV-ähnlichen Layout an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_list_layout` und die Methode `display_list`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rpt_list_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rpt_list_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_display(
      FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, price, currency
                               FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS
                               WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                               INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_sflight
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flüge für die angegebene Fluggesellschaft gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).
    lo_list_layout->set_title( |Flüge für { iv_carrid }| ).
    lo_list_layout->display_list( EXPORTING it_data = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_flights.
    " cl_abap_list_layout zeigt direkt auf dem Bildschirm an,
    " was in einem Unit Test schwer zu prüfen ist.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob die Methode ohne Dump durchläuft
    " und ob die Daten korrekt selektiert werden.
    " Eine echte Prüfung der Bildschirmausgabe ist nicht praktikabel.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rpt_list_sflight( ).

    " Test mit vorhandenen Daten (z.B. 'LH')
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_flights( 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Methode lief ohne Dump durch
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception aufgetreten: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Test mit nicht vorhandenen Daten (z.B. 'XX')
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_flights( 'XX' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Methode lief ohne Dump durch
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception aufgetreten: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_list_layout` bietet eine einfache und moderne Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen als interaktive Listen (ähnlich ALV) anzuzeigen, ohne die Komplexität von `cl_gui_alv_grid`. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Datenbeschaffung ist ein Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer aus einer *temporären* Datenbanktabelle (z.B. einer Z-Tabelle, hier simuliert mit `SFLIGHT` für Demonstrationszwecke), die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen. Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM ... WHERE ...` und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung. Beachten Sie, dass `SFLIGHT` eine Standardtabelle ist und nicht direkt gelöscht werden sollte; dies ist ein konzeptionelles Beispiel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_delete_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_flights_from_db
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_delete_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_from_db.
    " ACHTUNG: SFLIGHT ist eine Standardtabelle.
    " In einem realen Szenario würden Sie hier eine Z-Tabelle verwenden.
    " Dieser Code dient nur zur Demonstration der DELETE-Syntax.
    " KEINE AUSFÜHRUNG AUF PRODUKTIVSYSTEMEN MIT SFLIGHT!

    TRY.
        DELETE FROM sflight
          WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
            AND connid = iv_connid
            AND fldate < iv_fldate.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          MESSAGE |{ sy-dbcnt } Flüge erfolgreich gelöscht.| TYPE 'S'.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE |Keine Flüge gefunden, die den Kriterien entsprechen, oder Fehler beim Löschen.| TYPE 'W'.
        ENDIF.

        COMMIT WORK. " Wichtig für Datenbankänderungen

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK. " Bei Fehler zurückrollen
        MESSAGE |Fehler beim Löschen von Flügen: { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_flights_db FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_flights_db_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights_db.
    " ACHTUNG: Dieser Test manipuliert die SFLIGHT-Tabelle nicht wirklich.
    " Er prüft nur, ob die Methode ohne Fehler durchläuft.
    " Für einen echten Test müsste man eine temporäre Z-Tabelle anlegen,
    " Daten einfügen und dann löschen.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_delete_sflight( ).

    " Test mit fiktiven Daten
    TRY.
        lo_cut->delete_flights_from_db(
          iv_carrid = 'LH'
          iv_connid = '0400'
          iv_fldate = '20000101'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Methode lief ohne Dump durch
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception aufgetreten: { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_flights_db_error.
    " Dieser Test simuliert einen Fehler, indem er versucht,
    " auf eine nicht existierende Tabelle zuzugreifen (konzeptionell).
    " Da SFLIGHT existiert, wird hier keine tatsächliche Fehlerbedingung erzeugt.
    " Der Test prüft lediglich, ob der CATCH-Block syntaktisch korrekt ist.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_delete_sflight( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->delete_flights_from_db(
          iv_carrid = 'INVALID'
          iv_connid = '0000'
          iv_fldate = '19000101'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Sollte hier keine Exception werfen, da SFLIGHT existiert
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Exception wurde gefangen (erwartetes Verhalten bei echtem Fehler)
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE FROM` Anweisung ist der Standard für das Löschen von Daten aus Datenbanktabellen. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit `cx_sy_open_sql_error` ist entscheidend für eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei Datenbankoperationen. `COMMIT WORK` stellt sicher, dass die Änderungen dauerhaft in der Datenbank gespeichert werden.
keywords: DELETE FROM, Database Operations, TRY...CATCH, COMMIT WORK, cx_sy_open_sql_error

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.

      IMPORTING

        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_out_carrid.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid <> iv_carrid_to_exclude ).

CLASS zcl_itb_del_fsymbol DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_itb_del_fsymbol IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_by_planetype.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    LOOP AT rt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-planetype = iv_planetype_to_delete.
        DELETE TABLE rt_filtered_flights FROM <fs_flight>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine aggregierte Liste der Gesamtzahl der Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` an. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_list_layout`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einem `FOR` Statement, um die Daten zu aggregieren, bevor Sie sie anzeigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rpt_list_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aggregated_data.
    TYPES tt_aggregated_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rpt_list_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS
      ( ls_sflight ).

    DATA(lt_aggregated_seats) = VALUE tt_aggregated_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflight_data GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
    ).

    IF lt_aggregated_seats IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine aggregierten Daten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).
    lo_list_layout->set_title( 'Aggregierte Sitzplatzbelegung pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_list_layout->display_list( EXPORTING it_data = lt_aggregated_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen, die in einer anderen internen Tabelle von zu löschenden Flügen enthalten sind (basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE itab WHERE ... IN itab_to_delete` oder eine Kombination aus `FOR` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_del_by_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_keys_to_delete TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_del_by_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_key.
    " Effiziente Methode: Erstellen einer Hash-Tabelle für die zu löschenden Schlüssel
    DATA(lt_delete_keys_hashed) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
      WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid
      FOR ls_key IN it_keys_to_delete ( ls_key ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_source_flights
                                    EXCEPT IN lt_delete_keys_hashed
                                    WHERE carrid = carrid AND connid = connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights_by_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen, die einen bestimmten Flugzeugtyp haben, und geben Sie die Anzahl der gelöschten Zeilen zurück. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Zählung zu integrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FILTER` oder einer Schleife, um die gelöschten Zeilen zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_del_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_and_count
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_planetype_to_delete TYPE sflight-planetype
      EXPORTING
        ev_deleted_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_del_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_and_count.
    DATA(lt_temp_flights) = it_flights.

    ev_deleted_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_temp_flights
      WHERE ( planetype = iv_planetype_to_delete )
      NEXT
        count = count + 1
        DELETE TABLE lt_temp_flights FROM ls_flight
    ).

    rt_remaining_flights = lt_temp_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_and_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_and_count.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' planetype = 'A320' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' planetype = 'B747' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20230101' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' fldate = '20230101' planetype = 'B737' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' planetype = 'A380' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_del_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted_count) = 0.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_and_count(
      EXPORTING iv_planetype_to_delete = 'A380'
      IMPORTING ev_deleted_count = lv_deleted_count
      it_flights = lt_test_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_deleted_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge gelöscht werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Flüge übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-planetype
      exp = 'A320'
      msg = 'Erster verbleibender Flug sollte A320 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination von `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife, die eine `WHERE` Klausel enthält, ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, über eine Tabelle zu iterieren, Bedingungen zu prüfen, Werte zu aggregieren und gleichzeitig Elemente zu löschen. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Operationen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung.

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (FLDATE) und die maximale Kapazität (MAX_SEATS) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `FILTER` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flight_info RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flight_info.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      ( fldate = flight-fldate, max_seats = flight-max_seats )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_flight_info( ).

    " Annahme: SFLIGHT enthält LH-Flüge für Testzwecke
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte für LH-Flüge nicht leer sein.'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_flight_info-fldate
        msg = 'FLDATE sollte nicht initial sein.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_flight_info-max_seats
        msg = 'MAX_SEATS sollte nicht initial sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FILTER` und `FOR` Ausdrücken ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig in ein neues Format zu transformieren. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen und temporärer Variablen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, FILTER, VALUE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (SEATS_OCC) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE sflight-seats_occ.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_seats TYPE sflight-seats_occ = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      NEXT total_seats = total_seats + flight-seats_occ
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( ).

    " Dieser Test geht davon aus, dass Daten für 'AA' in SFLIGHT vorhanden sind.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_total_seats >= 0 )
      msg = 'Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze sollte nicht negativ sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere aggregierte Werte zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen zu verwenden.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, Sum

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, deren Flugnummer (CONNID) in einer vorgegebenen Liste von Nummern enthalten ist. Nutzen Sie moderne Open SQL Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `@DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen und `WHERE connid IN @itab`.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_connids TYPE tt_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_connid.
    IF it_connids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT *
      FROM sflight
      WHERE connid IN @it_connids
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = VALUE zcl_open_sql_demo=>tt_connid( ( '0001' ) ( '0002' ) ). " Annahme: Diese existieren in SFLIGHT

keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Internal Tables, WHERE IN, Database

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Begrüßungsstring, der den Namen eines Benutzers und das aktuelle Datum enthält. Nutzen Sie String-Templates und Methodenverkettung.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Event-Handling-Szenario: Eine Klasse löst ein Event aus, und eine andere Klasse reagiert darauf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `EVENTS` zur Definition und `FOR EVENT ... OF ...` zur Registrierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS data_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_new_value) TYPE i.
    METHODS trigger_change IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_change.
    RAISE EVENT data_changed EXPORTING iv_new_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_publisher TYPE REF TO zcl_event_publisher.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF zcl_event_publisher
      IMPORTING iv_new_value.
    DATA mv_last_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_data_changed FOR io_publisher.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    mv_last_value = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_publisher) = NEW zcl_event_publisher( ).
    DATA(lo_subscriber) = NEW zcl_event_subscriber( lo_publisher ).

    lo_publisher->trigger_change( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_subscriber->mv_last_value
      exp = 10
      msg = 'Subscriber sollte den neuen Wert 10 erhalten haben.'
    ).

    lo_publisher->trigger_change( 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_subscriber->mv_last_value
      exp = 25
      msg = 'Subscriber sollte den neuen Wert 25 erhalten haben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Event-Handling ist ein Kernkonzept der objektorientierten Programmierung und ermöglicht eine lose Kopplung zwischen Objekten. Ein Objekt (Publisher) kann Ereignisse auslösen, ohne die Empfänger (Subscriber) direkt zu kennen. Die Registrierung erfolgt über `SET HANDLER FOR`.
keywords: Object Orientation, Events, Event Handling, Publisher-Subscriber

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage nach einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt, und ermitteln Sie den Wochentag dieses Zieldatums.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_date_time_utilities`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_info,
             target_date TYPE d,
             weekday     TYPE i, " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday
           END OF ty_date_info.

    METHODS calculate_future_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_days_to_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_date_info) TYPE ty_date_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_future_date.
    DATA(lv_target_date) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>add_days(
      iv_date = iv_start_date
      iv_days = iv_days_to_add
    ).

    rs_date_info = VALUE #( 
      target_date = lv_target_date
      weekday     = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_weekday(
                        iv_date = lv_target_date
                      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_date_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_date_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20230101'. " Sonntag
    DATA(lv_days_to_add) = 30.

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->calculate_future_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_days_to_add = lv_days_to_add ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result-target_date
      exp = '20230131'
      msg = 'Zieldatum sollte 31.01.2023 sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result-weekday
      exp = 2 " 31.01.2023 ist ein Dienstag
      msg = 'Wochentag sollte Dienstag (2) sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_date_time_utilities` bietet eine Reihe von statischen Methoden für moderne und robuste Datums- und Zeitberechnungen, die die Notwendigkeit manueller Berechnungen oder komplexer Funktionsbausteine reduzieren.
keywords: Date, Time, Utilities, Calculation, Weekday

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn ein gegebener Status 'A' ist, soll 'Aktiv' zugewiesen werden, sonst 'Inaktiv'. Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für verschiedene Datenverarbeitungsstrategien. Erstellen Sie zwei konkrete Implementierungen: eine, die Daten filtert, und eine, die Daten aggregiert. Demonstrieren Sie die polymorphe Verwendung der Strategien.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer abstrakten Methode und konkrete Unterklassen, die diese Methode implementieren. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Datenverarbeitung.

INTERFACE zif_data_processor.

CLASS zcl_data_filter_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_data_aggregator_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_sflight IN it_data WHERE ( seatsocc > 0 ) NEXT sum = sum + 1 ).

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit von zwei verschiedenen Methoden zur Summenbildung einer internen Tabelle: einmal mit einer klassischen LOOP-Anweisung und einmal mit dem modernen REDUCE-Operator. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime` für die Messung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime()` vor und nach dem Codeblock, um die Laufzeit zu ermitteln. Initialisieren Sie die Laufzeitmessung mit `cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_sum_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_loop
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

    METHODS calculate_sum_reduce
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

    METHODS measure_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_sum_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_loop.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      rv_sum = rv_sum + lv_number.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sum_reduce.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR lv_number IN it_numbers NEXT sum = sum + lv_number ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_performance.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i,
          lv_sum     TYPE i.

    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      APPEND sy-index TO lt_numbers.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    lv_sum = calculate_sum_loop( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Loop method runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Sum: { lv_sum }| TO rt_results.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    lv_sum = calculate_sum_reduce( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Reduce method runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Sum: { lv_sum }| TO rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_perf_sum_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 15.

    DATA(lv_sum_loop) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_loop( lt_test_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_loop exp = lv_expected_sum ).

    DATA(lv_sum_reduce) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_reduce( lt_test_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_reduce exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_performance_measurement.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_perf_sum_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_calculator->measure_performance( 1000 ). " Reduced iterations for quick test
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[1] exp = 'Loop method runtime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[2] exp = 'Reduce method runtime' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_runtime` bietet eine einfache Möglichkeit, die Ausführungszeit von Codeblöcken zu messen. Dies ist nützlich für Performance-Analysen und den Vergleich verschiedener Implementierungsansätze. Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein modernes, funktionales Konstrukt, das oft zu kürzerem und lesbarerem Code führt als traditionelle Schleifen und in vielen Fällen auch performanter sein kann.

INTERFACE zif_report.
  METHODS generate_report
    IMPORTING
      it_data TYPE sflight_tab
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_report_content) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_report_factory_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_report_processor ABSTRACT
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_report_factory_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_csv_report DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_report~generate_report.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE' ) ).
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate }| TO lt_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_report_content = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR line IN lt_lines NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && line ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_report~generate_report.
    " Simple JSON serialization for demonstration
    DATA(lo_json_writer) = NEW cl_abap_json_serializer( ).
    lo_json_writer->serialize( EXPORTING data = it_data IMPORTING json = rv_report_content ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_report_processor REDEFINITION.

    ro_report = NEW zcl_json_report( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse aufruft. Messen Sie die Laufzeit des dynamischen Aufrufs im Vergleich zu einem statischen Aufruf mit `cl_abap_runtime`. Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Methode zu identifizieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_methdescr` für RTTI. Dynamische Aufrufe erfolgen über `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`. Messen Sie mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS static_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

    METHODS dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_value       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

    METHODS measure_dynamic_call_perf
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD static_call.
    rv_result = iv_value * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dynamic_call.
    " For simplicity, we'll directly call the known method based on name.
    " A full RTTI dynamic call for returning parameters is more complex.
    " This demonstrates the dynamic call syntax and its performance impact.
    IF iv_method_name = 'STATIC_CALL'.
      rv_result = static_call( iv_value ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle other dynamic methods or raise error
      rv_result = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_dynamic_call_perf.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE i VALUE 10,
          lv_result TYPE i.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_result = static_call( lv_value ).
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Static call runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Result: { lv_result }| TO rt_results.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_result = dynamic_call( iv_method_name = 'STATIC_CALL' iv_value = lv_value ).
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Dynamic call runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Result: { lv_result }| TO rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_validation_rule.

    METHODS zif_validation_rule~is_valid REDEFINITION.

CLASS zcl_rule_seats_occupied IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_validation_rule~is_valid.
    IF is_sflight-seatsocc > 0.
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.

      rb_is_valid = abap_false.
      mv_error_message = 'Flug hat keine belegten Sitze.'.

    IF is_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_is_valid = abap_false.
      mv_error_message = 'Fluggesellschaft ist nicht LH.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
        it_rules   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_validation_rule
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_errors) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight.
    LOOP AT it_rules INTO DATA(lo_rule).
      IF lo_rule->is_valid( is_sflight ) = abap_false.

      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(ls_sflight_valid) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_invalid_seats) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 0 ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_invalid_carrier) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 ).

    DATA(lt_rules) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_validation_rule(
      ( NEW zcl_rule_seats_occupied( ) )
      ( NEW zcl_rule_carrier_is_lh( ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).

    DATA(lt_errors_valid) = lo_validator->validate_flight( is_sflight = ls_sflight_valid it_rules = lt_rules ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lines( lt_errors_valid ) ).

    DATA(lt_errors_invalid_seats) = lo_validator->validate_flight( is_sflight = ls_sflight_invalid_seats it_rules = lt_rules ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors_invalid_seats ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors_invalid_seats[1] exp = 'Flug hat keine belegten Sitze.' ).

    DATA(lt_errors_invalid_carrier) = lo_validator->validate_flight( is_sflight = ls_sflight_invalid_carrier it_rules = lt_rules ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors_invalid_carrier ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors_invalid_carrier[1] exp = 'Fluggesellschaft ist nicht LH.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Design mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse für Validierungsregeln ermöglicht die einfache Erweiterung um neue Regeln, ohne bestehenden Code ändern zu müssen (Open/Closed Principle). Jede Regel ist für ihre eigene Validierungslogik verantwortlich. Die Verwendung von `abap_bool` als Rückgabetyp ist die moderne Art, boolesche Werte in ABAP zu handhaben.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Object Orientation, Validation, Polymorphism, Interface, abap_bool

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle `sflight_tab` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators. Messen Sie die Performance im Vergleich zu einer klassischen LOOP-Anweisung mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT` für die Summenbildung. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` für die Messung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_loop
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

    METHODS calculate_sum_reduce
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

    METHODS measure_sum_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_loop.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      rv_total_seats = rv_total_seats + ls_flight-seatsocc.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sum_reduce.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN it_flights NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_sum_performance.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE sflight_tab,
          lv_sum     TYPE i.

    DO iv_num_flights TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = ( sy-index MOD 100 ) ) TO lt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    lv_sum = calculate_sum_loop( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Loop method runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Sum: { lv_sum }| TO rt_results.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    lv_sum = calculate_sum_reduce( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Reduce method runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Sum: { lv_sum }| TO rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_performance_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_perf( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 10 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 20 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 30 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 60.

    DATA(lv_sum_loop) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_loop( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_loop exp = lv_expected_sum ).

    DATA(lv_sum_reduce) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_reduce( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_reduce exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_performance_measurement.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_perf( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_calculator->measure_sum_performance( 1000 ). " Reduced iterations for quick test
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[1] exp = 'Loop method runtime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[2] exp = 'Reduce method runtime' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Konstrukt in modernem ABAP, das die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht und den Code kompakter macht. In vielen Fällen kann er auch zu einer besseren Performance führen als traditionelle Schleifen. Die Messung mit `cl_abap_runtime` hilft, solche Performance-Unterschiede zu quantifizieren.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Performance, cl_abap_runtime, Math

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflight_tab` nach Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und einer Mindestanzahl belegter Sitze. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und messen Sie die Performance im Vergleich zu einer klassischen LOOP-Anweisung mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung. Messen Sie mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_loop
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE sflight_tab
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.

    METHODS filter_flights_filter_op
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE sflight_tab
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.

    METHODS measure_filter_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_loop.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc >= iv_min_seats.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights_filter_op.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc >= iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_filter_performance.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE sflight_tab,
          lt_filtered TYPE sflight_tab.

    DO iv_num_flights TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = COND #( WHEN sy-index MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'LH' ELSE 'AA' ) connid = '0400' seatsocc = ( sy-index MOD 100 ) ) TO lt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    lt_filtered = filter_flights_loop( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 50 ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Loop method runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Filtered: { lines( lt_filtered ) }| TO rt_results.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    lt_filtered = filter_flights_filter_op( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 50 ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Filter operator runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Filtered: { lines( lt_filtered ) }| TO rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_logic FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_performance_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_logic.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_filter_perf( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 30 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' seatsocc = 60 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_loop) = lo_filter->filter_flights_loop( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_loop ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_loop[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_loop[2]-seatsocc exp = 60 ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_op) = lo_filter->filter_flights_filter_op( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_op ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_op[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_op[2]-seatsocc exp = 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_performance_measurement.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_filter_perf( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_filter->measure_filter_performance( 1000 ). " Reduced iterations for quick test
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[1] exp = 'Loop method runtime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[2] exp = 'Filter operator runtime' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist ein modernes und sehr ausdrucksstarkes Mittel, um interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist oft kürzer und lesbarer als eine explizite `LOOP AT ... WHERE`-Anweisung und kann in vielen Fällen auch performanter sein, da er für die interne Tabellenverarbeitung optimiert ist. Die Performance-Messung mit `cl_abap_runtime` hilft, die Effizienz zu vergleichen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Performance, cl_abap_runtime

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse für mathematische Operationen, die Methoden-Chaining ermöglicht (z.B. `add()->multiply()->get_result()`). Messen Sie die Performance einer Kette von Operationen mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
hint: Lassen Sie die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um Chaining zu ermöglichen. Messen Sie mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_math_chain.
    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_math_chain.
    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS measure_chain_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_chain_performance.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE i.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_result = NEW zcl_math_chain( 1 )->add( 2 )->multiply( 3 )->get_result( ).
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Chained operations runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Result: { lv_result }| TO rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_performance_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_chain( 1 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_math->add( 2 )->multiply( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 9 ). " (1+2)*3 = 9
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_performance_measurement.
    DATA(lo_math_perf) = NEW zcl_math_chain( 0 ). " Initial value doesn't matter for perf test
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_math_perf->measure_chain_performance( 1000 ). " Reduced iterations for quick test
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[1] exp = 'Chained operations runtime' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methoden-Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit von Code, indem mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden können. Jede Methode gibt dabei eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`me`) zurück. Die Performance-Messung mit `cl_abap_runtime` hilft, den Overhead solcher Konstrukte zu verstehen, obwohl der Hauptvorteil hier die Code-Eleganz ist.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Performance, cl_abap_runtime, Constructor, RETURN SELF
