CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " Since cl_demo_output writes to a global buffer, we can't directly assert its output.
    " We can only verify that the methods execute without dump.
    lo_logger->log_info( 'Test Info Message' ).
    lo_logger->log_error( 'Test Error Message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Assert no dump occurred
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine abstrakte Logger-Klasse ermöglicht die Definition einer standardisierten Schnittstelle für die Protokollierung, unabhängig von der tatsächlichen Implementierung (z.B. Konsole, Datei, Datenbank). Dies ist ein Beispiel für das Strategy Pattern. Konkrete Logger-Implementierungen können einfach hinzugefügt oder ausgetauscht werden. `cl_demo_output` ist eine einfache Möglichkeit, Text in der ABAP-Umgebung auszugeben, ideal für Demos und Tests.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Object Orientation, Logger, Strategy Pattern, Polymorphism, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei Daten. Messen Sie die Performance dieser Berechnung mit `cl_abap_runtime` für eine große Anzahl von Iterationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Differenz von Datumstypen für die Berechnung. Messen Sie mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_diff_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.

    METHODS measure_date_diff_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 1000000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_diff_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between.
    rv_days = iv_date_to - iv_date_from.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_date_diff_performance.
    DATA: lv_date_from TYPE d VALUE '20240101',
          lv_date_to   TYPE d VALUE '20241231',
          lv_days      TYPE i.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_days = get_days_between( iv_date_from = lv_date_from iv_date_to = lv_date_to ).
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Date difference calculation runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, Days: { lv_days }| TO rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_date_difference FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_performance_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_difference.
    DATA(lo_date_calc) = NEW zcl_date_diff_perf( ).
    DATA(lv_days) = lo_date_calc->get_days_between( iv_date_from = '20240101' iv_date_to = '20240131' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days exp = 30 ).

    lv_days = lo_date_calc->get_days_between( iv_date_from = '20240101' iv_date_to = '20231231' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_performance_measurement.
    DATA(lo_date_calc) = NEW zcl_date_diff_perf( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_date_calc->measure_date_diff_performance( 10000 ). " Reduced iterations for quick test
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[1] exp = 'Date difference calculation runtime' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die direkte Subtraktion von Datumstypen in ABAP ist eine einfache und effiziente Methode zur Berechnung der Tagesdifferenz. Die Performance-Messung mit `cl_abap_runtime` zeigt, dass diese Operation auch bei sehr vielen Iterationen schnell ist, was sie für datumsintensive Berechnungen geeignet macht.
keywords: Date/Time, Performance, cl_abap_runtime, Data Types

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( field1 field2 ... )` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF struct_grouped_flight.

  TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_grouped_flight,
           carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
           total_seats TYPE i,
         END OF struct_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats_in_group) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight_in_group IN GROUP group_key NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight_in_group-seatsocc ).
      APPEND VALUE struct_grouped_flight( carrid = group_key-carrid total_seats = lv_total_seats_in_group ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 75 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-total_seats exp = 300 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-total_seats exp = 50 ).

    DATA(ls_ba_group) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'BA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ba_group-total_seats exp = 75 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature in ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und Sortierungen und führt zu deutlich kürzerem und lesbarerem Code. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe ist dies ein sehr effizienter Ansatz.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der Informationen über einen Flug aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` enthält, unter Verwendung von String-Templates. Messen Sie die Performance der String-Erstellung mit `cl_abap_runtime` im Vergleich zur Verkettung mit `&&`.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit Backticks (`` ` ``) und eingebetteten Ausdrücken. Messen Sie mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_template_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_string_concat
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS create_string_template
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS measure_string_perf
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_string_concat.
    rv_string = 'Flug ' && is_sflight-carrid && '-' && is_sflight-connid && ' am ' && is_sflight-fldate && ' mit ' && is_sflight-seatsocc && ' belegten Sitzen.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_string_template.
    rv_string = |Flug { is_sflight-carrid }-{ is_sflight-connid } am { is_sflight-fldate } mit { is_sflight-seatsocc } belegten Sitzen.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_string_perf.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight VALUE VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 150 ),
          lv_string  TYPE string.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_string = create_string_concat( ls_sflight ).
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |Concatenation runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, String: { lv_string }| TO rt_results.

    cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_string = create_string_template( ls_sflight ).
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
    APPEND |String Template runtime: { cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ) } microseconds, String: { lv_string }| TO rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_performance_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_creation.
    DATA(lo_string_creator) = NEW zcl_string_template_perf( ).
    DATA(ls_test_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 150 ).
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = 'Flug LH-0400 am 20250101 mit 150 belegten Sitzen.'.

    DATA(lv_concat_string) = lo_string_creator->create_string_concat( ls_test_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_concat_string exp = lv_expected_string ).

    DATA(lv_template_string) = lo_string_creator->create_string_template( ls_test_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_template_string exp = lv_expected_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_performance_measurement.
    DATA(lo_string_creator) = NEW zcl_string_template_perf( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_string_creator->measure_string_perf( 1000 ). " Reduced iterations for quick test
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[1] exp = 'Concatenation runtime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[2] exp = 'String Template runtime' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates sind die moderne und bevorzugte Methode zur String-Erstellung in ABAP. Sie sind deutlich lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig als die Verkettung mit `&&`, insbesondere bei komplexeren Strings. Obwohl die Performance-Unterschiede bei einfachen Fällen gering sein können, bieten String-Templates eine sauberere Syntax und sind oft auch performanter, da sie intern optimiert sind. `cl_abap_runtime` hilft, dies zu verifizieren.
keywords: String Processing, String Templates, Performance, cl_abap_runtime, Concatenation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für einen 'Command'-Pattern. Erstellen Sie konkrete Befehle (z.B. 'Flug buchen', 'Flug stornieren') und eine Invoker-Klasse, die Befehle ausführt. Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit der Befehle mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `zcl_command_abstract` mit einer abstrakten Methode `execute`. Die Invoker-Klasse hält eine Referenz auf `zcl_command_abstract`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_command.
  METHODS execute.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_command_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_command.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_command_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_book_flight_command DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_command_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS zif_command~execute REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_book_flight_command IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_command~execute.
    " Simulate booking logic
    WAIT UP TO 10 MILLISECONDS.
    mv_status = |Flight { mv_carrid }-{ mv_connid } booked.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cancel_flight_command DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_command_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS zif_command~execute REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cancel_flight_command IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_command~execute.
    " Simulate cancellation logic
    WAIT UP TO 5 MILLISECONDS.
    mv_status = |Flight { mv_carrid }-{ mv_connid } cancelled.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_command_invoker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_command IMPORTING io_command TYPE REF TO zif_command.
    METHODS execute_command
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_command TYPE REF TO zif_command.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_command_invoker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_command.
    mo_command = io_command.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD execute_command.
    IF mo_command IS BOUND.
      cl_abap_runtime=>reset_runtime( ).
      cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_on( ).
      mo_command->execute( ).
      cl_abap_runtime=>set_runtime_off( ).
      rv_runtime_us = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_command_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_command_pattern.
    DATA(lo_invoker) = NEW zcl_command_invoker( ).

    DATA(lo_book_cmd) = NEW zcl_book_flight_command( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    lo_invoker->set_command( lo_book_cmd ).
    DATA(lv_book_runtime) = lo_invoker->execute_command( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lo_book_cmd->mv_status exp = 'booked' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_book_runtime ).

    DATA(lo_cancel_cmd) = NEW zcl_cancel_flight_command( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    lo_invoker->set_command( lo_cancel_cmd ).
    DATA(lv_cancel_runtime) = lo_invoker->execute_command( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lo_cancel_cmd->mv_status exp = 'cancelled' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_cancel_runtime ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Command Pattern kapselt eine Anfrage als Objekt und ermöglicht so die Parametrisierung von Clients mit verschiedenen Anfragen, die Warteschlangen von Anfragen oder die Protokollierung von Anfragen. Eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Befehle (`zcl_command_abstract`) definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle `execute`. Die `cl_abap_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Ausführungszeit der einzelnen Befehle zu messen, was für Performance-Analysen in komplexen Systemen nützlich ist.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Object Orientation, Command Pattern, Design Patterns, Performance, cl_abap_runtime, Interface

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch, indem Sie in einer Schleife auf Zeilen über Feldsymbole zugreifen und den Gesamtpreis berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` für performanten Zeilenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.
    rv_total_price = 0.
    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      rv_total_price = rv_total_price + <fs_flight>-price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_fds_dynamic_loop=>ty_sflight_tab,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_fds_dynamic_loop=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_flight-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0401'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_flight-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_dynamic_loop( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total,
      exp = '300.00',
      msg = 'Total price should be 300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_fds_dynamic_loop=>ty_sflight_tab( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_dynamic_loop( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Total price should be 0 for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` ist die performanteste Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten, da keine Daten kopiert werden. Das Feldsymbol zeigt direkt auf die Zeile im Speicher, was besonders bei großen Tabellen effizient ist.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, LOOP AT, Performance

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und geben Sie deren Wert zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data        TYPE ty_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_component_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_component_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_fds_dynamic_component=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_data-field3 = 'World'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_dynamic_component( ).
    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Value of FIELD1 should be Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' msg = 'Value of FIELD2 should be 123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_component_not_found.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_fds_dynamic_component=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Test'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_dynamic_component( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Component not found' msg = 'Should indicate component not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, bei denen Feldnamen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität des Codes.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Structure, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüssel und weisen Sie sie einem Feldsymbol zu, um den Preis des Fluges zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... ASSIGNING <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE it_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                                 connid = iv_connid
                                 fldate = iv_fldate
                                 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = <fs_flight>-price.
    ELSE.
      rv_price = 0. " Not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_price.

CLASS zcl_fds_modify_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS increase_flight_price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_modify_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE ct_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                                 connid = iv_connid
                                 fldate = iv_fldate
                                 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price + iv_increase_by.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei sowohl das Objekt als auch der Methodenname zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die Methode soll einen String-Parameter empfangen und einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD (object_ref)->(method_name) ...` und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_a IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = |Method A called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = |Method B called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) EXPORTING iv_input = iv_param_value RECEIVING rv_output = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found or wrong signature'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen CSV-String und parsen Sie ihn zeilenweise in eine interne Tabelle. Der String enthält keine Kopfzeile.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string` und `get_next_line`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_read_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_data_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_read_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA: lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
          lt_line       TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_line,
          ls_data       TYPE ty_data.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string(
          iv_string = iv_csv_string,
          iv_separator = ',' ).

        DO.
          lo_csv_parser->get_next_line( IMPORTING et_line = lt_line ).
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT. " No more lines
          ENDIF.

          IF lines( lt_line ) >= 3.
            ls_data-col1 = lt_line[ 1 ].
            ls_data-col2 = lt_line[ 2 ].
            ls_data-col3 = lt_line[ 3 ].
            APPEND ls_data TO rt_data.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " In a real scenario, log the error or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle in einen CSV-String, wobei die erste Zeile die Kopfzeile der Tabelle darstellt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_icf_csv=>create_for_string` und `add_line` oder `add_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_write_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_write_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_string.
    DATA: lo_csv_writer TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
          lt_header     TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_line.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_writer = cl_icf_csv=>create_for_string(
          iv_separator = ',' ).

        " Add header line manually
        APPEND 'Column1' TO lt_header.
        APPEND 'Column2' TO lt_header.
        APPEND 'Column3' TO lt_header.
        lo_csv_writer->add_line( it_line = lt_header ).

        " Add data lines
        LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
          lo_csv_writer->add_line(
            it_line = VALUE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_line(
              ( ls_data-col1 )
              ( ls_data-col2 )
              ( ls_data-col3 ) ) ).
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_csv_string = lo_csv_writer->get_string( ).

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen CSV-String, der Werte mit Kommas innerhalb von Anführungszeichen enthält, und parsen Sie ihn korrekt.
hint: Die Klasse `cl_icf_csv` behandelt Anführungszeichen und Separatoren innerhalb von Werten automatisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_quoted_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             descr TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES ty_item_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_quoted_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE ty_item_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_quoted_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_quoted_csv.
    DATA: lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
          lt_line       TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_line,
          ls_item       TYPE ty_item.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string(
          iv_string = iv_csv_string,
          iv_separator = ',' ).

        DO.
          lo_csv_parser->get_next_line( IMPORTING et_line = lt_line ).
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.

          IF lines( lt_line ) >= 3.
            ls_item-id    = lt_line[ 1 ].
            ls_item-name  = lt_line[ 2 ].
            ls_item-descr = lt_line[ 3 ].
            APPEND ls_item TO rt_items.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_filter_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_fds_filter_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WHERE price > iv_min_price.
      APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_expensive_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch setzt, dessen Name und Wert zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und die Zuweisung an das Feldsymbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_set_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_generic_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             flag  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_generic_data.

    METHODS set_component_value
      CHANGING
        cs_data        TYPE any
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_set_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Attempt to assign the new value. Type conversion might be implicit or require explicit handling.
      TRY.
          <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error, e.g., log or raise exception
          MESSAGE 'Type conversion error for component' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Component not found, handle error
      MESSAGE 'Component not found in structure' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen CSV-String aus einer internen Tabelle und verwenden Sie dabei ein benutzerdefiniertes Trennzeichen (z.B. Semikolon) und ein benutzerdefiniertes Anführungszeichen (z.B. Apostroph).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_icf_csv=>create_for_string` mit den Parametern `iv_separator` und `iv_quote_char`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_custom_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_custom_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_tab
        iv_separator TYPE c DEFAULT ';'
        iv_quote_char TYPE c DEFAULT '''
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_custom_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_custom_csv.
    DATA: lo_csv_writer TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
          lt_header     TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_line.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_writer = cl_icf_csv=>create_for_string(
          iv_separator = iv_separator,
          iv_quote_char = iv_quote_char ).

        " Add header line manually
        APPEND 'COL1' TO lt_header.
        APPEND 'COL2' TO lt_header.
        APPEND 'COL3' TO lt_header.
        lo_csv_writer->add_line( it_line = lt_header ).

        " Add data lines
        LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
          lo_csv_writer->add_line(
            it_line = VALUE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_line(
              ( ls_data-col1 )
              ( ls_data-col2 )
              ( ls_data-col3 ) ) ).
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_csv_string = lo_csv_writer->get_string( ).

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Suchfunktion für interne Tabellen, die dynamisch nach einem Wert in einer beliebigen Spalte sucht und die passenden Zeilen zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line> WHERE (<component_name>) = <search_value>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_generic,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_generic.
    TYPES ty_sflight_generic_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_generic WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_in_table
      IMPORTING
        it_table        TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_search_value   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_lines) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA REF TO <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN <fs_table>->* TO rt_found_lines.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <fs_comp> = iv_search_value.
          APPEND <fs_line> TO rt_found_lines.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Profilparameter, die mit 'rdisp/' beginnen, und speichern Sie deren Namen und Werte in einer internen Tabelle. Filtern Sie dabei nur die Parameter, die einen Wert haben.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_profile_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_profile_param.
    TYPES: tt_profile_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_profile_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_rdisp_params RETURNING VALUE(rt_params) TYPE tt_profile_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_rdisp_params.
    DATA(lt_all_params) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameters_by_pattern( 'rdisp/*' ).

    rt_params = VALUE #( FOR param IN lt_all_params
                           WHERE ( value IS NOT INITIAL )
                           ( name = param-name, value = param-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Profilparameter im System existiert und geben Sie einen booleschen Wert zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GET_PARAMETER` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH` Blocks, um das Vorhandensein zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_param_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parameter_exists IMPORTING iv_param_name TYPE string
                             RETURNING VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parameter_exists.
    TRY.
        cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter( iv_param_name ).
        rb_exists = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter.
        rb_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,

                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                            WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                            ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                              connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                              fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
                              price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von Daten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert den Akkumulator, `FOR` iteriert über die gefilterten Einträge der Tabelle, und `NEXT` definiert die Aggregationslogik. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, um eine Liste von Flugdaten zu filtern und dann die Anzahl der verbleibenden Flüge zu ermitteln.
hint: Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, ermöglichen das Chaining. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_initial_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    METHODS filter_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                              RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_processor.
    METHODS filter_by_min_price IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE s_price
                                RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_processor.
    METHODS get_flight_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_initial_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_carrier.
    mt_flights = FILTER #( mt_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_min_price.
    mt_flights = FILTER #( mt_flights WHERE price >= iv_min_price ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_count.
    rv_count = lines( mt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 500 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' price = 750 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251202' price = 600 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251202' price = 1000 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( lt_initial_flights ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_processor->filter_by_carrier( 'LH' )->filter_by_min_price( 700 )->get_flight_count( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect flight count after chaining' act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht einen flüssigen, funktionalen Programmierstil, bei dem mehrere Methodenaufrufe hintereinander ausgeführt werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem die filternden Methoden (`filter_by_carrier`, `filter_by_min_price`) eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben. In Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen führt dies zu sehr elegantem und lesbarem Code, der die Datenverarbeitungsschritte klar darstellt.
keywords: METHOD CHAINING, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, OBJECT ORIENTATION, FILTER, INTERNAL TABLES

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie Variablen inline, wenn Sie den Rückgabewert einer Methode empfangen oder in einer Schleife über eine interne Tabelle iterieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lv_variable)` für die Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declaration_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_inline_data.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_some_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declaration_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_some_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD demonstrate_inline_data.
    " Inline-Deklaration für Methodenrückgabe
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_some_flights( ).

    " Inline-Deklaration in einer LOOP-Schleife
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      " Hier können Sie mit ls_flight arbeiten
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }, Flugnummer: { ls_flight-connid }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Inline-Deklaration für einen einzelnen Tabellenzeilenzugriff
    IF line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ).
      DATA(ls_first_lh_flight) = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ].
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Erster LH-Flug: { ls_first_lh_flight-connid }| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inline_declarations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inline_declarations.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_inline_declaration_demo( ).
    " Die Methode demonstrate_inline_data schreibt in cl_demo_output.
    " Für einen Unit Test müsste man die Ausgabe mocken oder die Methode so anpassen,
    " dass sie Werte zurückgibt, die getestet werden können.
    " Hier wird nur sichergestellt, dass die Methode ohne Dump durchläuft.
    lo_demo->demonstrate_inline_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Dummy-Assert, da die Methode keine direkten Rückgabewerte hat.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration von Variablen (`DATA(...)`) ist ein zentrales Merkmal von modernem ABAP ab Version 7.40. Sie reduziert den Boilerplate-Code, indem Variablen genau dort deklariert werden, wo sie zum ersten Mal verwendet werden. Der Typ der Variablen wird dabei automatisch vom System abgeleitet. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit, reduziert Fehler und fördert einen deklarativeren Programmierstil.
keywords: INLINE DECLARATION, DATA, LOOP, METHOD, GENERAL ABAP

CLASS zcl_param_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_message.
    rv_message = SWITCH #( iv_param_name
                           WHEN 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' THEN
                             SWITCH #( iv_param_value
                                       WHEN '0' THEN 'Unbegrenzte Laufzeit eingestellt.'
                                       WHEN '600' THEN 'Standardlaufzeit von 10 Minuten.'
                                       ELSE 'Benutzerdefinierte Laufzeit.' )
                           WHEN 'login/system_client' THEN
                             |Der Systemmandant ist { iv_param_value }.| " String Template
                           ELSE
                             |Unbekannter Parameter '{ iv_param_name }'.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und mit einer bestimmten Mindestkapazität zu erhalten.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine prägnante Syntax für das Filtern von Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                           iv_min_capacity TYPE s_seatsmax

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Methode, die den Wert eines Profilparameters liest, dessen Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird, und den Wert in den korrekten Typ konvertiert (z.B. Integer für 'rdisp/max_wprun_time').
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER=>GET_PARAMETER` und dynamische Typkonvertierung oder `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_param_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_param IMPORTING iv_param_name TYPE string
                                         iv_target_type TYPE string " z.B. 'I', 'STRING'
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_param_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_param.
    DATA(lv_raw_value) = VALUE string( ).
    TRY.
        lv_raw_value = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter( iv_param_name ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter.
        rv_value = 'Parameter not found'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    CASE iv_target_type.
      WHEN 'I'.
        TRY.
            rv_value = CONV string( CONV i( lv_raw_value ) ).
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            rv_value = 'Conversion to I failed'.
        ENDTRY.
      WHEN 'STRING'.
        rv_value = lv_raw_value.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_value = 'Unsupported target type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Profilparameter nach ihrem Präfix (z.B. 'rdisp/', 'login/') und zählen Sie, wie viele Parameter es pro Präfix gibt. Nutzen Sie dabei den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER=>GET_ALL_PARAMETERS` und den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_param_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_group,
             prefix TYPE string,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_param_group.
    TYPES: tt_param_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_params_by_prefix RETURNING VALUE(rt_groups) TYPE tt_param_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_params_by_prefix.
    DATA(lt_all_params) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters( ).

    rt_groups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_param IN lt_all_params
                            GROUP BY substring_before( val = ls_param-name sep = '/' )
                            ASCENDING AS prefix
                            ( prefix = prefix,
                              count  = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR p IN GROUP ls_param NEXT c = c + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_prefix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_prefix.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_profile_param_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_groups) = lo_grouper->group_params_by_prefix( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped parameters should not be empty' act = lt_groups ).

    " Überprüfen, ob 'rdisp' und 'login' Präfixe existieren und eine Anzahl haben
    IF line_exists( lt_groups[ prefix = 'rdisp' ] ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'rdisp group count should be positive' act = xsdbool( lt_groups[ prefix = 'rdisp' ]-count > 0 ) ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'rdisp prefix group not found' ).
    ENDIF.

    IF line_exists( lt_groups[ prefix = 'login' ] ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'login group count should be positive' act = xsdbool( lt_groups[ prefix = 'login' ]-count > 0 ) ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'login prefix group not found' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.55) für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Alle Profilparameter werden zuerst mit `CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER=>GET_ALL_PARAMETERS` gelesen. Anschließend werden sie nach ihrem Präfix (extrahiert mit `substring_before`) gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird der `REDUCE` Operator verwendet, um die Anzahl der Elemente zu zählen. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Art, Aggregationen und Gruppierungen direkt im Code auszudrücken.
keywords: GROUP BY, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, REDUCE, SUBSTRING_BEFORE, CL_SPFL_PROFILE_PARAMETER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`. Für jeden Flug soll ein String generiert werden, der Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Abflugdatum enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei den `FOR` Operator und String Templates.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_flight_strings = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null verhindert und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ausnahmeklasse von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
                                  previous LIKE if_t100_message=>previous OPTIONAL.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING

        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        MESSAGE e001(zmsg_abap_ai) WITH 'Division durch Null nicht erlaubt'. " ZMSG_ABAP_AI muss mit Nachricht 001 '&1' existieren
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).

    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme mit einer dynamischen Fehlermeldung auslöst, wenn ein Wert außerhalb eines gültigen Bereichs liegt. Nutzen Sie die `MESSAGE` Ergänzung mit Platzhaltern.

CLASS zcx_invalid_range DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_data_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_data.
    IF iv_id = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_read_error
        MESSAGE e003(zmsg_abap_ai) WITH 'ID 0 ist ungültig'. " ZMSG_ABAP_AI muss mit Nachricht 003 '&1' existieren
    ENDIF.
    rv_data = |Data for ID { iv_id }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_application_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_data_reader( ).
    TRY.
        rv_processed_data = lo_reader->read_data( iv_id = iv_id ).
      CATCH zcx_data_read_error INTO DATA(lx_data_read_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_application_error
          MESSAGE e004(zmsg_abap_ai) WITH 'Fehler beim Verarbeiten der Daten'
          PREVIOUS lx_data_read_error. " ZMSG_ABAP_AI muss mit Nachricht 004 '&1' existieren
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine funktionale Methode, die eine Ausnahme deklariert und auslöst, wenn ein ungültiger Parameter (z.B. eine negative Zahl) übergeben wird.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein nicht-kritischer Fehler auftritt, und zeigen Sie, wie diese behandelt wird, sodass die Verarbeitung fortgesetzt werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE` und `CATCH RESUMABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_minor_warning DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
                                  previous LIKE if_t100_message=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_minor_warning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_item
      IMPORTING
        iv_item_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_minor_warning.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_item.
    IF iv_item_id MOD 2 <> 0. " Simuliert ein geringfügiges Problem für ungerade IDs
      RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_minor_warning
        MESSAGE e006(zmsg_abap_ai) WITH iv_item_id. " ZMSG_ABAP_AI muss mit Nachricht 006 'Warnung: Artikel &1 hat ein geringfügiges Problem' existieren
    ENDIF.
    rv_status = |Item { iv_item_id } processed successfully|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_processing
      IMPORTING
        it_item_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_resumable_processor( ).
    LOOP AT it_item_ids INTO DATA(lv_item_id).
      TRY.
          APPEND lo_processor->process_item( lv_item_id ) TO rt_results.
        CATCH RESUMABLE zcx_minor_warning INTO DATA(lx_warning).
          APPEND |Warning for item { lv_item_id }: { lx_warning->get_text( ) }| TO rt_results.
          " Die Verarbeitung wird nach der Warnung fortgesetzt
        CATCH cx_root. " Andere kritische Ausnahmen abfangen
          APPEND |Critical error for item { lv_item_id }| TO rt_results.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_processing.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_resumable_caller( ).
    DATA(lt_item_ids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_caller->run_processing( lt_item_ids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Item 2 processed successfully' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_substring( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Warning for item 3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ] exp = 'Item 4 processed successfully' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_substring( act = lt_results[ 4 ] exp = 'Warning for item 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (`RESUMABLE EXCEPTION`) sind für nicht-kritische Fehler gedacht, bei denen die Programmausführung nach der Fehlerbehandlung fortgesetzt werden kann. Dies ist nützlich für Massenverarbeitungen, bei denen einzelne Fehler nicht zum Abbruch des gesamten Prozesses führen sollen. Die `CATCH RESUMABLE` Anweisung fängt die Ausnahme, ermöglicht die Reaktion und setzt die Ausführung fort.
keywords: EXCEPTION, RAISE, RESUMABLE, CATCH_RESUMABLE, CX_ROOT

CLASS lcl_calendar_highlighter DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS highlight_weekends
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        iv_month          TYPE monat
        iv_year           TYPE gjahr
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekends_for_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_month TYPE monat
        iv_year  TYPE gjahr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_weekends) TYPE tt_calendar_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_calendar_highlighter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD highlight_weekends.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF go_calendar IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_calendar
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_weekends) = get_weekends_for_month( iv_month = iv_month iv_year = iv_year ).

    CALL METHOD go_calendar->set_table_for_dates
      EXPORTING
        date_table = lt_weekends.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_weekends_for_month.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_day_of_week TYPE i.

    DATA(lv_first_day_of_month) = |{ iv_year }{ iv_month }01|.
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_month) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_last_day_of_month( iv_date = lv_first_day_of_month ).

    DO.
      lv_date = lv_first_day_of_month + ( sy-index - 1 ).
      IF lv_date > lv_last_day_of_month.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      CALL FUNCTION 'DATE_DAY_IN_WEEK'
        EXPORTING
          date = lv_date
        IMPORTING
          weekday = lv_day_of_week.

      IF lv_day_of_week = 6 OR lv_day_of_week = 7. " 6=Samstag, 7=Sonntag
        APPEND VALUE ty_calendar_date( date = lv_date color = 6 ) TO rt_weekends. " Farbe 6 für Hervorhebung
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`) verarbeitet. Wenn ein Flug mit einer ungültigen Flugnummer gefunden wird, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme `ZCX_INVALID_FLIGHT_NUMBER` ausgelöst werden, die die ungültige Nummer enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` für die Iteration und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` mit einem Attribut in der Ausnahmeklasse, um die ungültige Flugnummer zu speichern.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_number DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA invalid_flight_number TYPE s_flt_num READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid                LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous              LIKE if_t100_message=>previous OPTIONAL
        invalid_flight_number TYPE s_flt_num OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->invalid_flight_number = invalid_flight_number.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_number.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_flight_number_valid
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_number TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_valid_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                 WHERE ( is_flight_number_valid( ls_flight-connid ) = abap_true )
                                 ( ls_flight ) ).

    " Prüfen, ob ungültige Flüge vorhanden waren, die eine Ausnahme auslösen sollten
    DATA(lt_invalid_flights) = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                        WHERE ( is_flight_number_valid( ls_flight-connid ) = abap_false )
                                        ( ls_flight ) ).
    IF lt_invalid_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_number
        EXPORTING
          invalid_flight_number = lt_invalid_flights[ 1 ]-connid
        MESSAGE e009(zmsg_abap_ai) WITH lt_invalid_flights[ 1 ]-connid. " ZMSG_ABAP_AI muss mit Nachricht 009 'Ungültige Flugnummer: &1' existieren
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_flight_number_valid.
    " Beispielvalidierung: Flugnummern müssen positiv sein und dürfen nicht '9999' sein
    IF iv_flight_number > 0 AND iv_flight_number <> '9999'.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine kritische Operation ausführt. Wenn diese Operation fehlschlägt, soll eine Ausnahme `CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB` (oder eine andere geeignete Systemausnahme) gefangen und in eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme `ZCX_CRITICAL_DB_ERROR` umgewandelt werden, um die interne Implementierungsdetails zu verbergen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Systemausnahme und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` mit `PREVIOUS` für die benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_critical_db_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid   LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE if_t100_message=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_critical_db_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_db_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RAISING
        zcx_critical_db_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_db_operation.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    TRY.
        " Simulieren einer DB-Operation, die fehlschlagen könnte (z.B. ungültige WHERE-Klausel)
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = 'INVALID'.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          " Wenn kein Eintrag gefunden wird, ist das kein DB-Fehler, aber wir können es als Anwendungsfehler behandeln
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_critical_db_error
            MESSAGE e010(zmsg_abap_ai) WITH 'Flug nicht gefunden'. " ZMSG_ABAP_AI muss mit Nachricht 010 '&1' existieren
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        " Eine Systemausnahme in eine benutzerdefinierte umwandeln
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_critical_db_error
          MESSAGE e011(zmsg_abap_ai) WITH 'Kritischer Datenbankfehler aufgetreten'
          PREVIOUS lx_db_error. " ZMSG_ABAP_AI muss mit Nachricht 011 '&1' existieren
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        lo_operation->perform_db_operation( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).

      CATCH zcx_critical_db_error INTO DATA(lx_critical_error).

        " Für einen echten CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB Fehler müsste man eine ungültige SQL-Anweisung simulieren,

CLASS lcl_calendar_manager DEFINITION FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      EXPORTING

    CREATE OBJECT mo_calendar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
      EXCEPTIONS

    ENDIF.

    ro_calendar = mo_calendar.

      CALL METHOD mo_calendar->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR mo_calendar.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_container IS NOT INITIAL.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und füllen Sie diese mit `VALUE` und `FOR`-Ausdrücken.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                          ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                            connid    = flight-connid
                            fldate    = flight-fldate
                            planetype = flight-planetype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( 'LH' ). " Lufthansa

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights OPTIONAL_MESSAGE = 'Table should not be initial for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 10 " Assuming there are 10 LH flights in SFLIGHTS for test data
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative und kompakte Initialisierung und Füllung interner Tabellen. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP` und `APPEND`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung von `VALUE` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( REDUCE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = VALUE #( REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR flight IN sflights
                              WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                              NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming LH flights in SFLIGHTS have prices that sum up to 10000 for test data
    " This value might need adjustment based on actual SFLIGHTS data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 10000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen oder anderen Datenquellen in einer funktionalen und deklarativen Weise. In Kombination mit `VALUE` kann das Ergebnis direkt zugewiesen werden, was den Code sehr kompakt macht.
keywords: VALUE, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_value_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = VALUE string( COND #( 
      WHEN ib_is_delayed = abap_true THEN 'Delayed'

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine andere Struktur, indem Sie den `VALUE`-Operator für die Feldzuordnung verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( field1 = ... field2 = ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_data_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             flight_date TYPE string,
             formatted_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flights_for_display
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_display_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_data_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flights_for_display.
    rt_display_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_raw_flights
                                  ( flight_id = |{ flight-carrid } { flight-connid }|
                                    flight_date = |{ flight-fldate DATE = USER }|
                                    formatted_price = |{ flight-price CURRENCY = flight-currency }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach mehreren Kriterien und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit `VALUE` und `FILTER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FILTER ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_cityfrom    TYPE sflight-cityfrom OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FILTER tt_sflight( it_all_flights
                                    WHERE ( carrid = COND #( WHEN iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_carrid ELSE carrid ) AND
                                            cityfrom = COND #( WHEN iv_cityfrom IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_cityfrom ELSE cityfrom ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit `VALUE` und `LINE OF` basierend auf einer vorhandenen Struktur.

             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_value_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_dynamic_table = VALUE #( ( field1 = iv_initial_field1 field2 = iv_initial_field2 )

ENDCLASS.
