Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie einen Wert aus einer bestimmten Spalte. Beachten Sie, dass für den dynamischen Zugriff auf lokale Variablen im Testkontext ein Workaround mit dem vollständigen Programmnamen erforderlich ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN (table_name) TO <fs_table>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`. Für den Test muss der dynamische Tabellenname den vollständigen Pfad zur lokalen Variable enthalten (z.B. `\PROGRAM=LTCL_TEST\DATA=LT_MY_TABLE`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Dynamische Zuweisung der internen Tabelle
    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Table not found or not accessible'.
    ENDIF.

    " Annahme: Tabelle ist nicht leer, nehmen wir die erste Zeile
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Dynamische Zuweisung der Komponente
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_result = <fs_field>.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Field not found in table line'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Table is empty'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_field_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_table_empty FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

    DATA lt_my_table TYPE zcl_dyn_table_processor=>tt_data.
    DATA lt_empty_table TYPE zcl_dyn_table_processor=>tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Hello' ) TO lt_my_table.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'World' ) TO lt_my_table.

    " Für den dynamischen Zugriff auf lokale Variablen im Testkontext
    " muss der vollständige Pfad zur Variable angegeben werden.
    DATA(lv_table_name) = '\PROGRAM=LTCL_TEST\DATA=LT_MY_TABLE'.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_processor( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_dynamic_table(
                             iv_table_name = lv_table_name
                             iv_field_name = 'TEXT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_not_found.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_dynamic_table(
          iv_table_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE'
          iv_field_name = 'TEXT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for non-existent table' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Success, exception caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Hello' ) TO lt_my_table.
    DATA(lv_table_name) = '\PROGRAM=LTCL_TEST\DATA=LT_MY_TABLE'.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_dynamic_table(
          iv_table_name = lv_table_name
          iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for non-existent field' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Success, exception caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_empty.
    DATA(lv_table_name) = '\PROGRAM=LTCL_TEST\DATA=LT_EMPTY_TABLE'.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_dynamic_table(
          iv_table_name = lv_table_name
          iv_field_name = 'TEXT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for empty table' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Success, exception caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Zuweisung mittels `ASSIGN (variable_name) TO <field_symbol>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>` ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit auf Datenstrukturen und deren Komponenten zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst während der Programmausführung bekannt sind. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme und Frameworks. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols ist hierbei essentiell. Beachten Sie die Besonderheit beim Zugriff auf lokale Variablen in Unit-Tests, die den vollständigen Programmnamen erfordert.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Data Access

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine zentrale Nachrichtenbehandlung unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_message_handler`, um verschiedene Meldungen zu sammeln und auszugeben. Die vom Benutzer genannte Klasse `cf_reca_message_list` würde ein ähnliches Muster verwenden, ist aber spezifischer für RE-FX.
hint: Erzeugen Sie eine Instanz von `cl_abap_message_handler` und nutzen Sie deren Methoden wie `add_message` und `get_messages`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_message_handler. " Für Typkompatibilität

    METHODS add_info_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string.

    METHODS add_error_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string.

    METHODS get_all_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE if_abap_message_handler=>tt_message.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_handler TYPE REF TO cl_abap_message_handler.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_abap_message_handler~add_message.
    " Delegiert an die interne Instanz
    mo_message_handler->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = i_msgty
        i_msgid = i_msgid
        i_msgno = i_msgno
        i_msgv1 = i_msgv1
        i_msgv2 = i_msgv2
        i_msgv3 = i_msgv3
        i_msgv4 = i_msgv4
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_message_handler~get_messages.
    " Delegiert an die interne Instanz
    rt_messages = mo_message_handler->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_message_handler~has_messages.
    " Delegiert an die interne Instanz
    rv_has_messages = mo_message_handler->has_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_message_handler~clear_messages.
    " Delegiert an die interne Instanz
    mo_message_handler->clear_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    mo_message_handler = NEW cl_abap_message_handler( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_info_message.
    mo_message_handler->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = '00' " Beispiel-Nachrichtenklasse
      i_msgno = '001' " Beispiel-Nachrichtennummer
      i_msgv1 = iv_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_error_message.
    mo_message_handler->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'E'
      i_msgid = '00'
      i_msgno = '002'
      i_msgv1 = iv_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_messages.
    rt_messages = mo_message_handler->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_message_collection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_message_collection.
    DATA(lo_collector) = NEW zcl_message_collector( ).

    lo_collector->add_info_message( 'Information 1' ).
    lo_collector->add_error_message( 'Error 1' ).
    lo_collector->add_info_message( 'Information 2' ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_collector->get_all_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_msg1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg1-msgty exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg1-msgv1 exp = 'Information 1' ).

    READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_msg2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg2-msgty exp = 'E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg2-msgv1 exp = 'Error 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_messages.
    DATA(lo_collector) = NEW zcl_message_collector( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_collector->get_all_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_messages ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_message_handler` bietet eine standardisierte und objektorientierte Möglichkeit, Meldungen zu sammeln, zu verwalten und auszugeben. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zur direkten Verwendung von `MESSAGE` Statements und ermöglicht eine entkoppelte Fehlerbehandlung. Die vom Benutzer genannte Klasse `cf_reca_message_list` aus dem RE-FX Modul würde ein ähnliches Muster zur Nachrichtenverwaltung verwenden, ist aber spezifischer. `cl_abap_message_handler` ist generischer und in vielen ABAP-Anwendungen verfügbar.
keywords: Message Handling, Error Handling, Object Orientation, cl_abap_message_handler

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und übergeben Sie Parameter.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object_reference) PARAMETER-TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error.

    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_farewell
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_farewell) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameter_table TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter       TYPE abap_parmbind,
          lr_data            TYPE REF TO data.

    IF it_parameters IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_parameter_table = it_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameter_table
          RECEIVING
            FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_result>) = lr_data. " Ergebnis in Data Reference

        IF lr_data IS BOUND.
          ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_value>).
          IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
            rv_result = <fs_value>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = |Hello, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_farewell.
    rv_farewell = 'Goodbye!' .
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_greeting FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_farewell FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_method_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_greeting.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ). " Target object for method call

    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NAME'.
    GET REFERENCE OF 'World' INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->execute_dynamic_method(
                             io_object     = lo_target
                             iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING'
                             it_parameters = lt_parameters ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello, World!' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_farewell.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->execute_dynamic_method(
                             io_object     = lo_target
                             iv_method_name = 'GET_FAREWELL' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Goodbye!' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method_not_found.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).

    TRY.
        lo_caller->execute_dynamic_method(
          io_object     = lo_target
          iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error for non-existent method' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Success, exception caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF object PARAMETER-TABLE ...` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das es ermöglicht, den Namen der aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Frameworks, Plugins oder zur Implementierung von Command-Pattern-ähnlichen Architekturen. Die Parameterübergabe erfolgt über eine Tabelle von `abap_parmbind` Strukturen, was Flexibilität bei der Parameteranzahl und -typen bietet.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, CALL METHOD, RTTI, Parameter-Table

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine bestimmte Währung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_curr   TYPE sflight-curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Daten aus sflight lesen (für Demo-Zwecke)
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR  <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND curr = iv_curr )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_multiple_currencies FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_found.
    " Annahme: sflight enthält Daten. Für einen echten Unit-Test müsste man Testdaten einfügen.
    " Hier simulieren wir das Ergebnis basierend auf erwarteten Daten.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_curr = 'EUR' ).
    " Der erwartete Wert hängt von den Daten in der SFLIGHT-Tabelle ab.
    " Für einen stabilen Test müsste man SFLIGHT mocken oder Testdaten einfügen.
    " Hier nehmen wir an, dass es LH-Flüge in EUR gibt und die Summe > 0 ist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_not_found.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_curr = 'YYY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_multiple_currencies.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_eur) = lo_aggregator->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_curr = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lv_total_usd) = lo_aggregator->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_curr = 'USD' ).
    " Es sollte für jede Währung eine separate Summe geben.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_eur >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_usd >= 0 ).
    " Wenn AA sowohl EUR als auch USD Flüge hat, sollten beide > 0 sein.
    " Ohne Mocking ist dies schwer zu testen.
    " Hier prüfen wir nur, dass keine negativen Werte entstehen.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Konstrukt, um Werte aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` ermöglicht er eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Syntax, um über Tabellen zu iterieren, Bedingungen anzuwenden und ein Ergebnis zu akkumulieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen deklarieren zu müssen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer, den Preis und eine um 10% erhöhte Preisversion aus `sflight` enthält, gefiltert nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             price_inc TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
        connid    = ls_flight-connid
        price     = ls_flight-price
        price_inc = ls_flight-price * '1.10' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transformation_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transformation_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation_found.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_sflight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_transformer->get_transformed_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-price_inc exp = ls_first_flight-price * '1.10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transformation_not_found.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_sflight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_transformer->get_transformed_flights( iv_carrid = 'ZZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben, kann man in einer Zeile definieren, wie die neue Tabelle aus den Elementen einer Quelltabelle erzeugt werden soll, inklusive Filterung und Feldzuordnung. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und wartungsfreundlicherem Code.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, Functional Programming, sflight

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflight`, um alle Flüge zu finden, die von einer bestimmten Stadt abfliegen und ein bestimmtes Datum überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflight
      WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom AND fldate > iv_fldate
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_found.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge von 'FRANKFURT' nach dem 01.01.2020
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20200101'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-fldate > lv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_not_found.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_cityfrom = 'NONEXISTENT' iv_fldate = '20000101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine prägnante und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ersetzt die Notwendigkeit expliziter `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleifen und die manuelle Konstruktion einer neuen Tabelle, was den Code deutlich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, sflight

    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu verketten und zu formatieren. Sie ermöglichen das direkte Einbetten von Variablen und Ausdrücken (`{ variable }`) sowie die Anwendung von Formatierungsoptionen (`DATE = USER`, `CURRENCY = ...`) innerhalb des Strings, was zu einem sehr lesbaren und wartungsfreundlichen Code führt, verglichen mit der alten `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, Formatting, sflight

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Status basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze eines Fluges zu (z.B. 'Available', 'Limited', 'Full').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seats_max TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_free_seats) = iv_seats_max - iv_seats_occ.

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_free_seats = 0 THEN 'Full'
      WHEN lv_free_seats <= 10 THEN 'Limited'
      ELSE 'Available'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_checker->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occ = 100 iv_seats_max = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Full' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Available' ).

explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen. Er ersetzt die traditionellen `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Konstrukte für einfache Zuweisungen und macht den Code deutlich kürzer und lesbarer, insbesondere wenn nur ein Wert zugewiesen werden soll.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming, sflight

Instructions: Klassifizieren Sie einen Flug basierend auf seiner Flugdauer (z.B. 'Short-Haul', 'Medium-Haul', 'Long-Haul').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_classifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS classify_flight_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_fltime TYPE sflight-fltime " Flugzeit in HHMMSS
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_classifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_flight_duration.
    DATA(lv_hours) = iv_fltime DIV 10000. " Stunden extrahieren

    rv_category = SWITCH string( lv_hours
      WHEN 0  THEN 'Unknown' " Oder Fehlerbehandlung
      WHEN 1  THEN 'Short-Haul'
      WHEN 2  THEN 'Short-Haul'
      WHEN 3  THEN 'Medium-Haul'
      WHEN 4  THEN 'Medium-Haul'
      WHEN 5  THEN 'Medium-Haul'
      WHEN 6  THEN 'Long-Haul'
      WHEN 7  THEN 'Long-Haul'
      WHEN 8  THEN 'Long-Haul'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Ultra-Long-Haul'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Er ist eine elegante Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Statements, wenn es um die Zuweisung eines einzelnen Ergebnisses geht.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming, sflight

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz einer Hilfsklasse und rufen Sie direkt eine Methode auf, die eine formatierte Zeichenkette zurückgibt, ohne eine separate Referenzvariable zu deklarieren. Demonstrieren Sie dabei Method Chaining.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW class_name( )->method_name( )` und lassen Sie Methoden die eigene Instanz zurückgeben (`ro_self = me`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem übergebenen Feldnamen und Wert filtert. Die Methode soll eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field    TYPE string
        iv_value    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    rt_filtered_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_line> IN it_data
                                 WHERE ( ( ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component> )
                                         AND ( <fs_component> = iv_value ) )
                                 ( <fs_line> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer internen Tabelle für alle Zeilen aktualisiert. Der Feldname und der neue Wert werden dynamisch übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb der Schleife, um den Feldwert zu ändern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_field_in_table
      CHANGING
        ct_data     TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_field    TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX) pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` und der Aggregationsfunktion `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_result = REDUCE tt_carrier_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      " ( key = ls_flight-carrid )
      " ( total_seats = SUM( ls_flight-seatsmax ) )
      " ( result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats( BASE result ( key = ls_flight-carrid total_seats = SUM( ls_flight-seatsmax ) ) ) )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats( BASE result
                                            ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                              total_seats = SUM( ls_flight-seatsmax ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Aggregated table should not be initial' act = lt_aggregated ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Expected at least one aggregated row' act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 0 ).

    " Example: Check if LH has a positive total_seats
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_lh_seats) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH total seats should be positive' act = ( ls_lh_seats-total_seats > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

GROUP BY` ermöglicht er die effiziente Gruppierung von Daten und die Berechnung von Aggregatwerten (wie `SUM`) in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und oft performanter als traditionelle `LOOP`- und `COLLECT`-Ansätze.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen akzeptiert. Die Methode soll den Typ des Feldes dynamisch ermitteln und den Inhalt des Feldes für die erste Zeile als String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `GET REFERENCE` oder `DESCRIBE FIELD` in Kombination mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value_as_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_field_value_as_string = |{ <fs_field> }|.
      ELSE.
        rv_field_value_as_string = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value_as_string = 'Tabelle ist leer'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `if_oo_adt_classrun`-Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflight` nach `CARRID` gruppiert und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge sowie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX) ausgibt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `if_oo_adt_classrun` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_classrun_grouped_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_classrun_grouped_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_summary) = REDUCE tt_carrier_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrier_summary( BASE result
                                            ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                                              total_seats = SUM( ls_flight-seatsmax ) ) ) ).

    IF lt_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      out->write( 'Zusammenfassung der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft:' ).
      LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
        out->write( |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_summary-carrid }, Flüge: { ls_summary-flight_count }, Gesamtsitze: { ls_summary-total_seats }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      out->write( 'Keine Flugdaten zur Zusammenfassung gefunden.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_filter_operator_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der maximalen Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX) aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `DIV` und `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_sflight ).

      rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_calculation.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_average_seats=>tt_sflight.
    lt_test_flights = VALUE #( ( seatsmax = 100 ) ( seatsmax = 200 ) ( seatsmax = 150 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_seats( ).

    " Since we are using actual sflight data, we can't predict the exact average.
    " We'll test with a mock table for predictable results.
    DATA(lv_expected_average) = ( 100 + 200 + 150 ) / 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average calculation incorrect' act = ( ( 100 + 200 + 150 ) / 3 ) exp = lv_expected_average ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_seats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average for empty table should be 0' act = lv_average exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts wird hier in zwei Schritten mit modernen ABAP-Konstrukten durchgeführt: Zuerst wird die Summe der Sitzplätze mit einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ermittelt, dann die Anzahl der Zeilen mit `lines()`. Die Division liefert den Durchschnitt. `REDUCE` ist eine elegante Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein Datum als Eingabe akzeptiert und das Datum des nächsten Werktags (Montag bis Freitag) zurückgibt. Wochenenden sollen übersprungen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik mit `CASE` für Wochentage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_next_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_weekday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_weekday) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_weekday.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE sy-datum.
    lv_current_date = iv_date.

    DO.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5. " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday
        rv_next_weekday = lv_current_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_service_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS add_text_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        is_bus_obj_key  TYPE ty_sflight_key
        iv_file_name    TYPE string
        iv_file_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_text_attachment.
    DATA(lv_object_id) = |{ is_bus_obj_key-carrid }{ is_bus_obj_key-connid }{ is_bus_obj_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_gos_manager) = NEW cl_gos_manager(
          i_service_type = iv_bus_obj_type
          i_object_id    = lv_object_id
        ).

        DATA(lt_content_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_by_external_encoding( )->string_to_xstring( iv_file_content ).
        DATA(lv_size) = xstrlen( lt_content_x ).

        lo_gos_manager->create_attachment(
          EXPORTING
            i_file_name    = iv_file_name
            i_file_extension = 'TXT'
            i_file_size    = lv_size
            i_mime_type    = 'text/plain'
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_gos_error. " Catch GOS specific errors
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             file_name TYPE string,
             file_size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        is_bus_obj_key  TYPE ty_sflight_key
        io_gos_manager  TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager OPTIONAL " For testing
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments.
    DATA(lv_object_id) = |{ is_bus_obj_key-carrid }{ is_bus_obj_key-connid }{ is_bus_obj_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    DATA lo_gos_manager TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager.

    IF io_gos_manager IS BOUND.
      lo_gos_manager = io_gos_manager.
    ELSE.
      TRY.
          lo_gos_manager = NEW cl_gos_manager(
            i_service_type = iv_bus_obj_type
            i_object_id    = lv_object_id
          ).
        CATCH cx_gos_error.
          RETURN. " Return empty table on error
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_attachments_raw) = lo_gos_manager->get_attachment_list( ).

    rt_attachments = VALUE #( " Modern table construction with FOR
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_attachments_raw
      ( file_name = ls_raw-file_name
        file_size = ls_raw-file_size ) " Map fields to new structure
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             file_name TYPE string,
             file_extension TYPE string,
             file_size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        is_bus_obj_key  TYPE ty_sflight_key
        iv_filter_extension TYPE string " e.g., 'PDF'
        io_gos_manager  TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager OPTIONAL " For testing
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_attachments.
    DATA(lv_object_id) = |{ is_bus_obj_key-carrid }{ is_bus_obj_key-connid }{ is_bus_obj_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    DATA lo_gos_manager TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager.

    IF io_gos_manager IS BOUND.
      lo_gos_manager = io_gos_manager.
    ELSE.
      TRY.
          lo_gos_manager = NEW cl_gos_manager(
            i_service_type = iv_bus_obj_type
            i_object_id    = lv_object_id
          ).
        CATCH cx_gos_error. " Catch GOS specific errors
          RETURN. " Return empty table on error
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_attachments_raw) = lo_gos_manager->get_attachment_list( ).

    rt_filtered_attachments = FILTER #( lt_attachments_raw USING KEY primary_key
                                        WHERE file_extension = iv_filter_extension ).

CLASS zcl_da_conditional_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action_by_temperature.
    DATA(lv_current_temperature) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_session_temperature( ).

    rv_action_description = SWITCH #( lv_current_temperature
      WHEN 'H' THEN 'Datenzugriff für Hot-Daten optimiert.'
      WHEN 'W' THEN 'Datenzugriff für Warm-Daten optimiert.'
      WHEN 'C' THEN 'Datenzugriff für Cold-Daten optimiert (ggf. Archivzugriff).' 
      ELSE 'Unbekannte Temperatur, Standardzugriff.'
    ). " SWITCH expression for concise conditional logic
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_read_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_read_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_temperature.
    DATA(lv_current_temperature) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_session_temperature( ).
    DATA(lv_hot_data_threshold) = sy-datum - 365. " Flüge innerhalb des letzten Jahres sind 'hot'

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights). " Inline declaration for internal table

    IF lv_current_temperature = 'H'. " Nur 'hot' Daten anzeigen (Simulation)
      rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( fldate >= lv_hot_data_threshold ) ( ls_flight ) ).
    ELSE. " Alle Daten anzeigen (oder 'cold'/'warm' basierend auf tatsächlicher DA-Konfiguration)
      rt_flights = lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_hot.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_da_read_sflight( ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( 'H' ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_temperature( ).
    " Prüfen, ob Flüge innerhalb des 'hot'-Schwellenwerts (letztes Jahr) liegen
    DATA(lv_hot_threshold) = sy-datum - 365.
    DATA(lv_all_hot) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < lv_hot_threshold.
        lv_all_hot = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_all_hot msg = 'Alle Flüge sollten 'hot' sein, wenn Temperatur 'H' ist' ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( 'H' ). " Zurücksetzen
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_all.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_da_read_sflight( ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( 'C' ). " Auf 'Cold' setzen, um in dieser Simulation alle Daten zu erhalten
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_temperature( ).
    " Prüfen, ob einige Flüge älter als der 'hot'-Schwellenwert sind
    DATA(lv_hot_threshold) = sy-datum - 365.
    DATA(lv_has_cold) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < lv_hot_threshold.
        lv_has_cold = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_cold msg = 'Sollte 'kalte' Flüge enthalten, wenn Temperatur 'C' ist' ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( 'H' ). " Zurücksetzen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_dynamic_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_record,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_record.
    TYPES tt_data_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_data_dynamically
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_dynamic_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_current_temperature) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_session_temperature( ).

    DATA(lv_source_type) = SWITCH #( lv_current_temperature
      WHEN 'H' THEN 'DB_TABLE'
      WHEN 'W' THEN 'DB_TABLE_PARTITIONED'
      WHEN 'C' THEN 'ARCHIVE'
      ELSE 'DEFAULT_DB'
    ). " SWITCH expression to determine source type

    " Simulieren der Datenabfrage basierend auf dem Quelltyp
    CASE lv_source_type.
      WHEN 'DB_TABLE'.
        " Simulieren des Lesens aus einer 'hot' Datenbanktabelle
        rt_data = VALUE #( ( key_field = 'HotKey1' value_field = 'HotValue1' )
                           ( key_field = 'HotKey2' value_field = 'HotValue2' ) ).
      WHEN 'DB_TABLE_PARTITIONED'.
        " Simulieren des Lesens aus einer 'warm' partitionierten Tabelle
        rt_data = VALUE #( ( key_field = 'WarmKey1' value_field = 'WarmValue1' ) ).
      WHEN 'ARCHIVE'.
        " Simulieren des Lesens aus einem Archiv
        rt_data = VALUE #( ( key_field = 'ColdKey1' value_field = 'ColdValue1' ) ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Standard
        rt_data = VALUE #( ( key_field = 'DefaultKey' value_field = 'DefaultValue' ) ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_support_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

      IMPORTING

        is_bus_obj_key  TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_supports_gos) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_gos_support_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_gos_support.
    DATA(lv_object_id) = |{ is_bus_obj_key-carrid }{ is_bus_obj_key-connid }{ is_bus_obj_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    TRY.
        " Versuch, den GOS Manager zu instanziieren. Wenn dies fehlschlägt, wird GOS nicht unterstützt.
        DATA(lo_gos_manager) = NEW cl_gos_manager(
          i_service_type = iv_bus_obj_type
          i_object_id    = lv_object_id
        ).
        rv_supports_gos = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_gos_error. " Wenn ein Fehler auftritt, wird GOS nicht unterstützt oder ist nicht richtig konfiguriert.
        rv_supports_gos = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_da_set_and_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hot_flights_after_setting_temp
      IMPORTING
        iv_set_temperature TYPE sabp_daag_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_set_and_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hot_flights_after_setting_temp.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( iv_set_temperature ).
      CATCH cx_sabp_daag_error.
        " Fehler beim Setzen der Temperatur, Standardverhalten beibehalten oder leere Tabelle zurückgeben
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lv_current_temperature) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_session_temperature( ).
    DATA(lv_hot_data_threshold) = sy-datum - 365. " Flüge innerhalb des letzten Jahres sind 'hot'

    IF lv_current_temperature = 'H'.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE fldate >= @lv_hot_data_threshold " Direkte Filterung in SELECT für 'Hot' Daten
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ELSE.
      " Für andere Temperaturen (W, C) oder wenn das Setzen fehlschlug, alle Daten (oder spezifische Logik)
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Anzahl der Anlagen für ein Business-Objekt zählt und dabei nur Anlagen mit einer bestimmten Dateierweiterung berücksichtigt, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_manager->get_attachment_list` und den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die gefilterten Anlagen zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_count_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS count_filtered_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        is_bus_obj_key  TYPE ty_sflight_key
        iv_filter_extension TYPE string " e.g., 'PDF'
        io_gos_manager  TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager OPTIONAL " For testing
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_count_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_filtered_attachments.
    DATA(lv_object_id) = |{ is_bus_obj_key-carrid }{ is_bus_obj_key-connid }{ is_bus_obj_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    DATA lo_gos_manager TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager.

    IF io_gos_manager IS BOUND.
      lo_gos_manager = io_gos_manager.
    ELSE.
      TRY.
          lo_gos_manager = NEW cl_gos_manager(
            i_service_type = iv_bus_obj_type
            i_object_id    = lv_object_id
          ).
        CATCH cx_gos_error.
          RETURN. " Return 0 on error
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_attachments_raw) = lo_gos_manager->get_attachment_list( ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR ls_raw IN lt_attachments_raw
                         WHERE ( file_extension = iv_filter_extension )
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Session-Temperatur auf 'W' (Warm) setzt und anschließend eine Liste von Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` zurückgibt, die älter als 1 Jahr, aber jünger als 5 Jahre sind, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Setzen Sie die Temperatur auf 'W' und verwenden Sie dann `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um den gewünschten Datumsbereich zu selektieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_da_read_warm_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_warm_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_read_warm_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_warm_flights.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( 'W' ). " Setzen auf Warm
      CATCH cx_sabp_daag_error.
        RETURN. " Fehler beim Setzen der Temperatur
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lv_one_year_ago) = sy-datum - 365.
    DATA(lv_five_years_ago) = sy-datum - ( 365 * 5 ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    " Filtern der Flüge, die älter als 1 Jahr, aber jünger als 5 Jahre sind (Simulation von 'Warm' Daten)
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                            WHERE fldate < lv_one_year_ago AND fldate >= lv_five_years_ago ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_warm_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_warm_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_warm_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_da_read_warm_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_warm_flights( ).

    DATA(lv_one_year_ago) = sy-datum - 365.
    DATA(lv_five_years_ago) = sy-datum - ( 365 * 5 ).

    DATA(lv_all_warm) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate >= lv_one_year_ago OR ls_flight-fldate < lv_five_years_ago.
        lv_all_warm = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_all_warm msg = 'Alle Flüge sollten im 'warmen' Bereich liegen' ).
    " Prüfen, ob überhaupt 'warme' Flüge gefunden wurden (abhängig von SFLIGHT-Daten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Es sollten 'warme' Flüge gefunden werden' ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( 'H' ). " Zurücksetzen
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_warm_flights_empty.
    " Für diesen Test müssten wir sicherstellen, dass keine Flüge im 'warmen' Bereich liegen.
    " Dies ist schwierig ohne Datenmanipulation oder Mocking der SFLIGHT-Tabelle.
    " Stattdessen simulieren wir eine leere SFLIGHT-Tabelle für den Test des FILTER-Operators.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_da_read_warm_flights( ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( 'W' ).
    " In einem echten Szenario würde man SFLIGHT mocken, um eine leere Tabelle zurückzugeben.
    " Hier wird angenommen, dass die Methode bei fehlenden Daten korrekt eine leere Tabelle zurückgibt.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_warm_flights( ).
    " Wenn SFLIGHT keine passenden Daten hat, sollte die Liste leer sein.
    " Dies ist ein schwacher Test, da er von den tatsächlichen SFLIGHT-Daten abhängt.
    " Für einen robusten Test müsste SFLIGHT gemockt werden.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Keine 'warmen' Flüge erwartet, wenn SFLIGHT leer ist' ).
    " Da wir SFLIGHT nicht mocken können, überspringen wir diesen spezifischen Assert oder machen ihn weniger streng.
    " Wir können nur die Logik des FILTER-Operators testen, wenn Daten vorhanden sind.
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( 'H' ). " Zurücksetzen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen, was ab ABAP 7.55 verfügbar ist.

CLASS zcl_sxml_simple_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_sxml_simple_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_simple_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_intf_ixml
    ).

    lo_writer->open_element( 'RootElement' ).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Child1' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( 'Value of Child 1' ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Child2' ).
        lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'attr' value = 'attributeValue' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( 'Value of Child 2' ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).
    lo_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS als verschachtelte Elemente darstellt, unter Verwendung von CL_SEC_SXML_WRITER und FOR-Ausdrücken.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die SFLIGHTS-Daten mit FOR und schreiben Sie die Elemente dynamisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_sflights_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_sflights_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_sflights_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflights_xml.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_intf_ixml
    ).

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
          lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Carrier' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
          lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
          lo_writer->open_element( 'Date' ).
            lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-fldate ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ).
          lo_writer->open_element( 'Price' ).
            lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-price ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ).
      ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flight Carrier="LH" Connection="0400">' msg = 'XML should contain flight data' ).

INTO DATA(...)`-Syntax ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das die Inline-Deklaration von Arbeitsbereichen ermöglicht. Attribute werden direkt beim Öffnen des Elements hinzugefügt.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die nach 'FRA' fliegen und einen bestimmten Preis überschreiten, und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_destination TYPE s_to_city
        iv_min_price   TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityto = iv_destination
                                    AND price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( 0 ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price_lh msg = 'Total price for LH should not be zero' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price_aa msg = 'Total price for AA should not be zero' ).

    " Example: If we know LH has flights with prices 100, 200, 300, expected would be 600
    " For a real test, you'd need to mock SFLIGHTS or know its content.
    " Here, we assume some flights exist and prices are summed.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_price_lh > 0 msg = 'LH total price should be positive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein funktionales Programmierkonstrukt, das eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert reduziert. `INIT` initialisiert den Akkumulator (`sum`), `FOR` iteriert über die Tabelle (optional mit `WHERE`-Klausel), und `NEXT` definiert die Aggregationslogik. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Aggregation.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Methode, die einen beliebigen Wert in einen String konvertiert und dabei RTTI verwendet, um den Typ zu bestimmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR und CAST.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_any_to_string
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_any_to_string.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    CASE lo_typedescr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_char> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lv_char>.
        rv_string = <lv_char>.

      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1 OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2 OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_int> TYPE i.
        ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lv_int>.
        rv_string = |{ <lv_int> }|.

      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat16 OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat34 OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_float> TYPE f.
        ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lv_float>.
        rv_string = |{ <lv_float> }|.

      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_date> TYPE d.
        ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lv_date>.
        rv_string = |{ <lv_date> DATE = USER }|.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_string = 'Unsupported Type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
