explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) über `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, um den Typ eines beliebigen Datenreferenzparameters zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Basierend auf dem Typ wird der Wert dann in einen String konvertiert. Field-Symbols (`FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_char> TYPE any. ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lv_char>.`) ermöglichen den generischen Zugriff auf den Inhalt der Datenreferenz. String-Templates werden für die typsichere und formatierte Konvertierung verwendet.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Conversion, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, Field-Symbols, String Templates

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Daten aus SFLIGHTS in einem CL_SALV_TABLE an und implementieren Sie eine einfache Doppelklick-Behandlung für Zeilen.
hint: Nutzen Sie das Ereignis LINK_CLICK der CL_SALV_EVENTS_LIST.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_event.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_link_click FOR EVENT link_click OF cl_salv_events_list
      IMPORTING
        row
        column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_event.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_events) = lo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).
        SET HANDLER me->handle_link_click FOR lo_events.

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>link ). " Make CARRID a clickable link

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_link_click.
    MESSAGE |Link in Zeile { row }, Spalte { column } geklickt!| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_event_handler( ).
    " We can't simulate a click in a unit test, but we can verify that
    " the event handler is set up and the column is configured as a link.
    lo_cut->display_sflights_with_event( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method executed, event handler registered.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Ereignisse in `CL_SALV_TABLE` behandelt werden können. Zuerst wird der Event-Handler der ALV-Tabelle über `get_event_handler()` abgerufen. Dann wird mit `SET HANDLER` eine lokale Methode (`handle_link_click`) für das `link_click`-Ereignis registriert. Um das Ereignis auszulösen, wird eine Spalte (`CARRID`) als Link (`set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>link )`) konfiguriert. Dies ermöglicht interaktive ALV-Berichte.
keywords: ALV, CL_SALV_TABLE, Events, Event Handling, LINK_CLICK, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie ein XML-Dokument mit CL_SEC_SXML_WRITER, das einen CDATA-Abschnitt enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie write_cdata.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_cdata_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_xml_with_cdata RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_cdata_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_xml_with_cdata.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_intf_ixml
    ).

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Document' ).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'CodeSnippet' ).
        lo_writer->write_cdata( '<![CDATA[<tag>This is raw XML content & special chars.</tag>]]>' ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Description' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( 'This element contains a CDATA section.' ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).
    lo_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_xml_with_cdata FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_xml_with_cdata.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sxml_cdata_writer( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->generate_xml_with_cdata( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_cdata_content) = '<![CDATA[<tag>This is raw XML content & special chars.</tag>]]>'.
    DATA(lv_expected_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>` &&
                            `<Document><CodeSnippet>` && lv_expected_cdata_content && `</CodeSnippet>` &&
                            `<Description>This element contains a CDATA section.</Description></Document>`.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_xml exp = lv_expected_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `CL_SEC_SXML_WRITER` verwendet wird, um einen CDATA-Abschnitt in ein XML-Dokument einzufügen. Die Methode `write_cdata()` ermöglicht es, beliebigen Text, einschließlich XML-Markup und Sonderzeichen, in den XML-Output einzubetten, ohne dass dieser geparst oder maskiert wird. Dies ist nützlich, wenn man Code-Snippets oder andere rohe Daten in XML speichern möchte.
keywords: XML, SXML, CL_SEC_SXML_WRITER, CDATA, Special Characters

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus SFLIGHTS enthält, und verwenden Sie dabei den FOR-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Operator mit VALUE-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_keys FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_key).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_key-carrid msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_key-connid msg = 'Connection ID should not be initial' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature, um neue interne Tabellen aus bestehenden zu konstruieren. Er ermöglicht es, über eine Quelltabelle zu iterieren und für jede Zeile eine neue Zeile in der Zieltabelle zu erzeugen, wobei die Felder direkt zugewiesen werden können. Dies ist eine prägnante Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP`- und `APPEND`-Statements.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS, Projection

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Anlagen zu einem gegebenen Business-Objekt (z.B. einer Bestellung).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` und die Methode `query_attachments`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_query_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             object_id   TYPE gos_object_id,
             object_type TYPE gos_object_type,
             file_name   TYPE string,
             file_size   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE gos_object_type
        iv_object_id   TYPE gos_object_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_attachments.
    DATA(lo_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA(lt_gos_attachments) = lo_query->query_attachments(
      iv_object_type = iv_object_type
      iv_object_id   = iv_object_id
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_gos_attachments ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_gos_attachment>).
      APPEND VALUE #( object_id   = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_object_id( )
                      object_type = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_object_type( )
                      file_name   = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_name( )
                      file_size   = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_size( ) ) TO rt_attachments.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_attachments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_attachments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_query_all( ).
    " Annahme: Für Testzwecke gibt es keine echten Anlagen. Wir prüfen, ob die Methode läuft.
    " In einem echten Szenario müsste man Testdaten anlegen oder die GOS-Klassen mocken.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_all_attachments( iv_object_type = 'BUS2012' iv_object_id = '0000000001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Erwartet leere Tabelle, da keine echten Anlagen vorhanden sind.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_gos_attachment_query` zur Abfrage von Anlagen. Moderne ABAP-Features wie Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_query)`) und Wertzuweisungen (`VALUE #(...)`) werden genutzt, um den Code prägnanter zu gestalten.
keywords: GOS, Attachments, Business Object, cl_gos_attachment_query, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Anlagen eines Business-Objekts nach einem bestimmten Dateityp (z.B. 'PDF').
hint: Nutzen Sie die Filteroptionen von `cl_gos_attachment_query` oder `FILTER` auf dem Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_filter_by_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             object_id   TYPE gos_object_id,
             object_type TYPE gos_object_type,
             file_name   TYPE string,
             file_size   TYPE i,
             file_type   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE gos_object_type
        iv_object_id   TYPE gos_object_id
        iv_file_type   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_by_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_attachments.
    DATA(lo_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA(lt_gos_attachments) = lo_query->query_attachments(
      iv_object_type = iv_object_type
      iv_object_id   = iv_object_id
    ).

    rt_attachments = VALUE #( FOR <fs_gos_attachment> IN lt_gos_attachments
                               WHERE ( <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_type( ) = iv_file_type )
                               ( object_id   = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_object_id( )
                                 object_type = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_object_type( )
                                 file_name   = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_name( )
                                 file_size   = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_size( )
                                 file_type   = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_type( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_attachments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_attachments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_filter_by_type( ).
    " Für diesen Test simulieren wir Anlagen, da GOS-Objekte nicht einfach zu mocken sind.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde man die GOS-Klassen mocken oder Testdaten anlegen.
    DATA(lt_mock_attachments) = VALUE zcl_gos_filter_by_type=>tt_attachment_info(
      ( object_id = '0000000001' object_type = 'BUS2012' file_name = 'doc1.pdf' file_size = 100 file_type = 'PDF' )
      ( object_id = '0000000001' object_type = 'BUS2012' file_name = 'image.jpg' file_size = 200 file_type = 'JPG' )
      ( object_id = '0000000001' object_type = 'BUS2012' file_name = 'report.pdf' file_size = 150 file_type = 'PDF' )
    ).

    " Da wir die GOS-Klasse nicht direkt mocken, können wir hier nur die Logik des Filters testen.
    " Die Methode get_filtered_attachments würde in einem echten Test gemockte GOS-Objekte erhalten.
    " Hier rufen wir sie mit Dummy-Werten auf und erwarten eine leere Tabelle, da keine echten GOS-Objekte existieren.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_attachments( iv_object_type = 'BUS2012' iv_object_id = '0000000001' iv_file_type = 'PDF' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Erwartet leere Tabelle, da keine echten Anlagen vorhanden sind.

    " Um die Filterlogik zu testen, müsste man die GOS-Klassen mocken oder die Filterlogik in eine separate Methode auslagern.
    " Beispiel für eine rein interne Filterlogik (nicht Teil der Lösung, nur zur Demonstration):
    DATA(lt_filtered_internal) = VALUE zcl_gos_filter_by_type=>tt_attachment_info(
      FOR attachment IN lt_mock_attachments WHERE ( attachment-file_type = 'PDF' )
      ( attachment ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_internal ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt die moderne `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` Syntax, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur Anlagen eines bestimmten Dateityps enthält. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen und `APPEND` Anweisungen zu verwenden.
keywords: GOS, Attachments, Filter, File Type, FOR, WHERE, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Details (Dateiname, Größe) einer spezifischen Anlage aus.
hint: Nach der Abfrage können Sie die Attribute der zurückgegebenen Objekte nutzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_get_details DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_detail,
             file_name TYPE string,
             file_size TYPE i,
             created_by TYPE syuname,
             created_at TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_detail.

    METHODS get_attachment_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE gos_object_type
        iv_object_id   TYPE gos_object_id
        iv_file_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_detail) TYPE ty_attachment_detail
      RAISING
        cx_gos_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_get_details IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_details.
    DATA(lo_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA(lt_gos_attachments) = lo_query->query_attachments(
      iv_object_type = iv_object_type
      iv_object_id   = iv_object_id
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_gos_attachments ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_gos_attachment>)
      WITH KEY file_name = iv_file_name.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_detail = VALUE #( file_name  = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_name( )
                           file_size  = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_size( )
                           created_by = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_created_by( )
                           created_at = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_created_at( ) ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gos_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_gos_error=>attachment_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_delete_adj_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_field TYPE c LENGTH 20,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_data      TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_data) TYPE tt_data.

CLASS zcl_delete_adj_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_data = it_data.
    SORT rt_unique_data BY key_field value_field. " Wichtig für ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_data COMPARING key_field value_field.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " entsprechenden Berechtigungen durchgeführt werden.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_db_sflights( ).
    DATA: lv_initial_count TYPE i, lv_deleted_count TYPE i.
    CONSTANTS: lc_test_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'XX'.

    " Vorbereitung: Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind und andere Daten nicht betroffen sind.
    " Echte Tests würden hier Testdaten einfügen und nach dem Test wieder löschen.
    " Für diese Demonstration fügen wir temporäre Daten ein und löschen sie dann.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE #( ( carrid = lc_test_carrier connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE #( ( carrid = lc_test_carrier connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = '300.00' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_initial_count WHERE carrid = lc_test_carrier.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_initial_count exp = 2 ).

    " Test: Löschen der Flüge
    lv_deleted_count = lo_cut->delete_sflights_by_carrier( iv_carrier = lc_test_carrier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted_count exp = 2 ).

    " Überprüfung: Sind die Flüge wirklich gelöscht?
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_final_count) WHERE carrid = lc_test_carrier.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_count exp = 0 ).

    " Aufräumen: Sicherstellen, dass keine Testdaten zurückbleiben (falls der Test fehlschlägt).
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lc_test_carrier.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_delete_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_single_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE gos_object_type
        iv_object_id   TYPE gos_object_id
        iv_file_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_gos_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_delete_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_single_attachment.
    DATA(lo_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA(lt_gos_attachments) = lo_query->query_attachments(
      iv_object_type = iv_object_type
      iv_object_id   = iv_object_id
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_gos_attachments ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_gos_attachment>)
      WITH KEY file_name = iv_file_name.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          cl_gos_api=>delete_attachment(
            is_object = VALUE #( objtype = iv_object_type objkey = iv_object_id )
            iv_doc_id = <fs_gos_attachment>->get_document_id( )
          ).
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
          RAISE EXCEPTION lx_gos_error.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gos_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_gos_error=>attachment_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Gesamtgröße aller Anlagen für ein bestimmtes Business-Objekt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_total_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_attachment_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE gos_object_type
        iv_object_id   TYPE gos_object_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_size) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_total_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_attachment_size.
    DATA(lo_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA(lt_gos_attachments) = lo_query->query_attachments(
      iv_object_type = iv_object_type
      iv_object_id   = iv_object_id
    ).

    rv_total_size = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR <fs_gos_attachment> IN lt_gos_attachments
                              NEXT sum = sum + <fs_gos_attachment>->get_file_size( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit verschiedenen Nachrichtentypen (Erfolg, Warnung, Fehler) und speichern Sie es. Demonstrieren Sie das Hinzufügen von Nachrichten mit unterschiedlichen Schweregraden unter Verwendung der objektorientierten BAL-API.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG` zum Erstellen des Protokolls und dessen Methoden `ADD_MSG` und `SAVE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             type TYPE bal_msgtp,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_save_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_object   TYPE bal_s_log-object
        iv_subobject TYPE bal_s_log-subobject
        it_messages TYPE tt_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_save_log.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.

    ls_log_header-object = iv_object.
    ls_log_header-subobject = iv_subobject.
    ls_log_header-extnumber = |{ sy-datum } { sy-uzeit }|. "External ID

    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_log( ).
    lo_log->set_log_header( ls_log_header ).

    LOOP AT it_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
      DATA(lo_message) = NEW cl_bal_log_msg(
        i_msgty = ls_message-type
        i_msgid = 'SY' "Using a standard message class for simplicity
        i_msgno = '000' "Generic message number
        i_msgv1 = ls_message-text
      ).
      lo_log->add_msg( io_log_message = lo_message ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_log->save( ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp (z.B. `SFLIGHT`), füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten und lesen Sie die Daten dynamisch aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    TYPES tt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_process_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        " Get description of the table type
        lr_table_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        " Create dynamic internal table
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

        " Create dynamic work area
        DATA(lr_line_type) = lr_table_type->get_table_line_type( ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_line_type.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_wa>).

        " Fill with example data (simplified for SFLIGHT)
        " In a real scenario, you'd fetch from DB or construct dynamically
        IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          <fs_wa>-carrid = 'LH'.
          <fs_wa>-connid = '0400'.
          <fs_wa>-fldate = sy-datum.
          INSERT <fs_wa> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

          <fs_wa>-carrid = 'AA'.
          <fs_wa>-connid = '0017'.
          <fs_wa>-fldate = sy-datum.
          INSERT <fs_wa> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDIF.

        " Process dynamic table
        LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
          DATA(lv_carrid) = ''.
          DATA(lv_connid) = ''.
          DATA(lv_fldate) = ''.

          " Dynamically assign components
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
          IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED.
            lv_carrid = <fs_carrid>.
          ENDIF.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
          IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED.
            lv_connid = <fs_connid>.
          ENDIF.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
          IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED.
            lv_fldate = <fs_fldate>.
          ENDIF.

          APPEND |Flug: { lv_carrid } { lv_connid } am { lv_fldate }| TO rt_result_strings.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_assign_error cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp.
        APPEND |Fehler bei dynamischer Verarbeitung: { cl_abap_exception=>get_text( ) }| TO rt_result_strings.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_sflight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_invalid FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_example( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->create_and_process_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_results )

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lt_results[ 1 ]

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_table_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_example( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->create_and_process_dynamic_table( 'INVALID_TABLE_TYPE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_results

      msg = 'Bei ungültigem Typ sollte ein Fehler auftreten.'
    ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Verarbeitung von Datenstrukturen zur Laufzeit. Mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` wird der Typ einer Tabelle ermittelt, und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` ermöglicht die dynamische Instanziierung einer internen Tabelle. Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOL`) in Kombination mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` erlauben den typsicheren Zugriff auf Komponenten, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme und Frameworks.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, RTTI, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Fetch some data from SFLIGHT
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      (
        carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_example( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_counts )
      reverse = abap_true
      msg = 'Es sollten Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.'
    ).

    " Assuming 'LH' and 'AA' are likely to be in SFLIGHT
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_lh_count = ls_count-flight_count.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_lh_count
      reverse = abap_true
      msg = 'LH sollte Flüge haben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Syntax, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Er ermöglicht es, Gruppen von Zeilen basierend auf einem oder mehreren Schlüsseln zu bilden und dann Operationen auf diesen Gruppen durchzuführen, wie hier das Zählen der Elemente pro Gruppe (`GROUP SIZE`). Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als die traditionelle `LOOP AT ... AT NEW ... ENDAT`-Konstruktion.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, FOR, GROUP BY, Table Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in `SFLIGHT`, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. Fluggesellschaft 'LH'), unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `COND` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_cond_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_cond_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                  NEXT sum = sum + COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrier THEN ls_flight-price ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_cond_example( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_total_price
      reverse = abap_true
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH sollte nicht 0 sein.'
    ).
    " Further assertions could involve a known sum if SFLIGHT data is static
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_cond_example( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft sollte 0 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE`-Operator mit dem `COND`-Ausdruck, um eine bedingte Aggregation durchzuführen. `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Reduktion einer internen Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert. `COND` bietet eine kompakte Möglichkeit, bedingte Logik direkt in Ausdrücken zu implementieren, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `IF`-Anweisungen innerhalb einer Schleife.
keywords: REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Conditional Logic

WHERE ...` Schleife ist der `FILTER`-Operator oft performanter und führt zu kürzerem, besser lesbarem Code. Er ist ideal für die schnelle Selektion von Teilmengen einer Tabelle.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen haben, mit dem `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,

      RETURNING

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding FOR TESTING.

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_example=>ty_source(

Er kann auch für komplexe Mappings mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` Klauseln verwendet werden.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Transfer, Mapping

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_optional_chain_example( ).

    ).

Wenn die Referenzvariable initial ist, wird der Ausdruck einfach zu einem Initialwert ausgewertet, anstatt eine `CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL` Ausnahme auszulösen. Dies vereinfacht die Fehlerbehandlung und macht den Code robuster.
keywords: Optional Chaining, Null Safety, Object Orientation, Error Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die aus einer bestehenden Tabelle abgeleitet ist, indem Sie nur bestimmte Zeilen und Spalten mit `VALUE` und `FOR` auswählen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_for_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_info.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        price  = ls_flight-price
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > 100 ) msg = 'Alle Preise sollten über 100 sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_info )
      msg = 'Es sollten keine Flüge über 1.000.000 gefunden werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE` und `FOR` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen. `VALUE` ermöglicht die Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen oder Strukturen mit einem einzigen Ausdruck. `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` iteriert über eine Quelltabelle, filtert sie nach einer Bedingung und projiziert die gewünschten Felder in die neue Zieltabelle. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und lesbare Art der Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine andere Methode eines Objekts aufruft, dessen Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF lo_object`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr,
          lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_tab,
          ls_parameter TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_descr.

    TRY.
        " Get class description
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).

        " Get method description
        READ TABLE lo_class_descr->methods INTO lo_method_descr WITH KEY name = iv_method_name.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rv_result = |Methode '{ iv_method_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Check if method has parameters and prepare them
        lt_parameters = lo_method_descr->parameters.
        IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED AND lines( lt_parameters ) > 0.
          " Assuming a single IMPORTING parameter for simplicity
          READ TABLE lt_parameters INTO ls_parameter WITH KEY kind = cl_abap_methdescr=>importing.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Dynamic method call with parameter
            CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
              EXPORTING
                (ls_parameter-name) = iv_param_value
              RECEIVING
                result = rv_result.
          ELSE.
            " Dynamic method call without parameter
            CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
              RECEIVING
                result = rv_result.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          " Dynamic method call without parameter
          CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
            RECEIVING
              result = rv_result.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        rv_result = |Fehler bei dynamischem Aufruf: { cl_abap_exception=>get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fixed_string.
    rv_string = 'Fester String'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_param_string.
    rv_string = |String mit Parameter: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

Die Verwendung von RTTI (`cl_abap_typedescr`) ermöglicht es, die Existenz der Methode und ihre Parameter zur Laufzeit zu überprüfen, was für robuste dynamische Programme unerlässlich ist. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen neuen Termin mit der Klasse `CL_APPOINTMENT` und speichern Sie ihn. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenübergabe.

CLASS zcl_appointment_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_new_appointment
      IMPORTING
        iv_subject TYPE string
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_start_time TYPE t
        iv_end_date TYPE d
        iv_end_time TYPE t
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_appointment_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_new_appointment.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    TRY.
        lo_appointment->create_appointment(
          EXPORTING
            i_subject    = iv_subject
            i_start_date = iv_start_date
            i_start_time = iv_start_time
            i_end_date   = iv_end_date
            i_end_time   = iv_end_time
        ).
        lo_appointment->save_appointment( ).
        rv_appointment_guid = lo_appointment->get_guid( ).
      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( iv_guid = iv_appointment_guid ).
    TRY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment,
         guid        TYPE guid_32,
         subject     TYPE string,
         start_date  TYPE d,
         end_date    TYPE d,

TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_all_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        iv_filter_start_date TYPE d
        iv_filter_end_date   TYPE d

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_appointments_by_date.

ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE ty_appointment( guid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) subject = 'Meeting A' start_date = '20250101' end_date = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_appointments.

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine Liste von Flugpreisen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` gegen den maximalen Wert eines Währungsfeldes (`curr`, Länge 11, 2 Dezimalstellen) und geben Sie nur die gültigen Preise zurück. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES=>max_curr_11_2` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
         carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
         fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
         price    TYPE sflight-price,
         currency TYPE sflight-currency,
       END OF ty_sflight_price.
TYPES tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_sflight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_prices) TYPE tt_sflight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_sflight_prices.
    DATA(lv_max_price) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_curr_11_2.

    rt_valid_prices = REDUCE tt_sflight_prices(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_prices( )
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( flight-price LE lv_max_price )
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_validate_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validate_prices.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_prices.

    " Simulate SFLIGHTS data
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_price( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_price( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_curr_11_2 + '1.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_sflights. " Invalid price
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_price( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum price = '500.00' currency = 'GBP' ) TO lt_test_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_price_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->validate_sflight_prices( lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator (ABAP 7.40) und der `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE`-Klausel (ABAP 7.50). Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, eine interne Tabelle zu filtern und gleichzeitig eine Aggregation oder Transformation durchzuführen, hier das Sammeln gültiger Einträge.
keywords: CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES, SFLIGHTS, REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Validierung, Interne Tabellen

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die prüft, ob ein gegebener Integer-Wert innerhalb des gültigen Bereichs für einen `i`-Typ liegt, und eine entsprechende Meldung zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `SWITCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES=>min_int` und `max_int` in einem `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_range_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_int_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_range_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_int_range.
    DATA(lv_min_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_int.
    DATA(lv_max_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int.

    rv_message = SWITCH string(
      WHEN iv_value < lv_min_int THEN |Wert { iv_value } ist kleiner als der minimale Integer-Wert { lv_min_int }|
      WHEN iv_value > lv_max_int THEN |Wert { iv_value } ist größer als der maximale Integer-Wert { lv_max_int }|
      ELSE |Wert { iv_value } liegt im gültigen Integer-Bereich|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_in_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_too_low FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_too_high FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_range_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_int_range( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Wert 100 liegt im gültigen Integer-Bereich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_too_low.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_range_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_int - 1.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_int_range( lv_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = |Wert { lv_value } ist kleiner als der minimale Integer-Wert { cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_int }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_too_high.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_range_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int + 1.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_int_range( lv_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = |Wert { lv_value } ist größer als der maximale Integer-Wert { cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `SWITCH`-Operator (ABAP 7.50) in Kombination mit String-Templates (ABAP 7.40) und den Konstanten von `CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES`. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und kompakte Implementierung von bedingter Logik und Nachrichtenformatierung, die traditionelle `IF-ELSEIF-ENDIF`-Strukturen ersetzt.
keywords: CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES, Integer, Bereichsprüfung, SWITCH, String-Templates, Validierung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein gegebener Termin (simuliert als Struktur) mit einem anderen Termin überlappt. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Logik.
hint: Die Überlappungsprüfung erfolgt, wenn `Start1 < End2` und `End1 > Start2` ist. Nutzen Sie `COND`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_appointment,
         start_date TYPE d,
         end_date   TYPE d,
       END OF ty_simple_appointment.

CLASS zcl_appointment_overlap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_overlap
      IMPORTING
        is_appointment1 TYPE ty_simple_appointment
        is_appointment2 TYPE ty_simple_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_overlaps) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_overlap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_overlap.
    rv_overlaps = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN is_appointment1-start_date < is_appointment2-end_date AND
           is_appointment1-end_date   > is_appointment2-start_date
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_overlap_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlap_false FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overlap_edge FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_overlap_true.
    DATA(ls_app1) = VALUE ty_simple_appointment( start_date = '20250101' end_date = '20250105' ).
    DATA(ls_app2) = VALUE ty_simple_appointment( start_date = '20250103' end_date = '20250107' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_overlap( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_overlap( is_appointment1 = ls_app1 is_appointment2 = ls_app2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overlap_false.
    DATA(ls_app1) = VALUE ty_simple_appointment( start_date = '20250101' end_date = '20250102' ).
    DATA(ls_app2) = VALUE ty_simple_appointment( start_date = '20250103' end_date = '20250104' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_overlap( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_overlap( is_appointment1 = ls_app1 is_appointment2 = ls_app2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overlap_edge.
    DATA(ls_app1) = VALUE ty_simple_appointment( start_date = '20250101' end_date = '20250103' ).
    DATA(ls_app2) = VALUE ty_simple_appointment( start_date = '20250103' end_date = '20250105' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_overlap( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_overlap( is_appointment1 = ls_app1 is_appointment2 = ls_app2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Überlappungslogik für Datumsbereiche in einer modernen, kompakten Form unter Verwendung des `COND`-Operators (ABAP 7.40). Obwohl `CL_APPOINTMENT` selbst keine direkte Überlappungsprüfung bietet, ist dies eine häufige Anforderung im Kontext der Terminverwaltung und zeigt, wie moderne ABAP-Syntax für solche Logiken eingesetzt wird.
keywords: Termin, Überlappung, Datum, COND, Logik, Moderne ABAP

    lo_row2->add_cell( i_value = 'Wert 2A' ).

hint: Verwende `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` in Kombination mit `DELETE` ist nicht direkt möglich, aber `FOR` kann zum Filtern verwendet werden, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die die zu löschenden Elemente nicht enthält.

CLASS zcl_delete_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_delete_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Entferne benachbarte Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`), die nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer sortiert ist. Die Duplikate sollen vollständig identisch sein.

CLASS zcl_delete_adjacent_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_delete_adjacent_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_sflights.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid fldate.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_sflights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Erster Flug sollte AA sein nach Sortierung' ).

explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, vorausgesetzt, die Tabelle ist nach den relevanten Feldern sortiert. `COMPARING ALL FIELDS` stellt sicher, dass nur vollständig identische Zeilen als Duplikate behandelt werden.
keywords: DELETE, Duplicates, Internal Table, SORT

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die jeweils eine geschachtelte Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) enthalten. Lösche alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die eine spezifische Flugnummer haben.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` für die äußere Tabelle und `DELETE itab WHERE ...` für die innere Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_nested_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             flights  TYPE tt_sflight,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_specific_nested_flight
      CHANGING
        ct_carrier_flights TYPE tt_carrier_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier         TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid          TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_nested_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_specific_nested_flight.
    LOOP AT ct_carrier_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier_flights>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier.
      DELETE <fs_carrier_flights>-flights WHERE connid = iv_connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_nested_flight FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_nested_flight.
    DATA: lt_carrier_flights TYPE zcl_delete_nested_table=>tt_carrier_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa'
                    flights = VALUE #( ( connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' )
                                       ( connid = '0401' fldate = '20230102' ) ) ) TO lt_carrier_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines'
                    flights = VALUE #( ( connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' )
                                       ( connid = '0018' fldate = '20230102' ) ) ) TO lt_carrier_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_nested_table( ).
    lo_cut->delete_specific_nested_flight( CHANGING ct_carrier_flights = lt_carrier_flights
                                           IMPORTING iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrier_flights[ 1 ]-flights ) exp = 1 msg = 'Ein Flug sollte gelöscht worden sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrier_flights[ 1 ]-flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'Der verbleibende Flug sollte 0401 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrier_flights[ 2 ]-flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Die Flüge von AA sollten unverändert sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Manipulation von geschachtelten internen Tabellen. Durch die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` kann direkt auf die innere Tabelle zugegriffen und dort mit `DELETE ... WHERE` eine spezifische Zeile entfernt werden. Dies ist eine gängige und effiziente Methode für komplexe Datenstrukturen.
keywords: DELETE, Nested Table, Field-Symbols, LOOP AT

Instructions: Lösche alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`), deren Flugdatum (`fldate`) vor einem bestimmten Stichtag liegt, unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` um eine neue Tabelle aufzubauen, die nur die gewünschten Elemente enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_with_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_cut_off_date TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_with_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date.
    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight( )
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( flight-fldate >= iv_cut_off_date )
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights_by_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights_by_date.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_delete_with_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230103' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_cut_off_date) = '20230102'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_date( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_cut_off_date = lv_cut_off_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Erster Flug sollte AA sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Zweiter Flug sollte LH sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in modernem ABAP, um eine neue Datenstruktur (hier eine interne Tabelle) aus einer bestehenden zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. In diesem Fall wird sie verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu 'reduzieren', indem nur die Flüge aufgenommen werden, die das Kriterium (Datum nach Stichtag) erfüllen. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr lesbare Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit `APPEND`.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Functional Programming, Date Filtering

Instructions: Lösche alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`), die in einer anderen internen Tabelle (Referenztabelle) enthalten sind. Die Referenztabelle enthält nur `carrid` und `connid`.
hint: Verwende `DELETE itab FROM ... WHERE ...` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um die zu löschenden Zeilen zu identifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_by_reference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_reference,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_reference.
    TYPES tt_reference TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_reference WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_reference
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        it_reference TYPE tt_reference.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_by_reference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_reference.
    DATA(lt_to_delete) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ref_entry IN it_reference
      FOR flight_entry IN ct_sflights WHERE ( carrid = ref_entry-carrid AND connid = ref_entry-connid )
      ( flight_entry )
    ).

    DELETE ct_sflights FROM TABLE lt_to_delete.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_code_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_code) = VALUE string_table(
      ( |DATA(lv_var) = 'Hello'.| )
      ( |SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).| )
      ( |IF sy-subrc = 0.| )
      ( |  SELECT SINGLE * FROM scarr INTO @DATA(ls_scarr) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.| )
      ( |ENDIF.| )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second SELECT statement incorrect' act = lt_result[2] exp = |  SELECT SINGLE * FROM scarr INTO @DATA(ls_scarr) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Vorkommen des Wortes 'DATA' in einer Tabelle von ABAP-Codezeilen (simuliert aus einem `cl_gui_abapedit` Control).
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit String-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_code_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_keyword_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        it_abap_code TYPE string_table
        iv_keyword   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_code_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_keyword_occurrences.
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR line IN it_abap_code
                         LET occurrences = count( val = line regex = iv_keyword case = abap_true )
                         IN NEXT count = count + occurrences ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_data_keyword FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_case_insensitive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_data_keyword.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_code_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_code) = VALUE string_table(
      ( |DATA(lv_var) = 'Hello'.| )
      ( |SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).| )
      ( |IF sy-subrc = 0.| )
      ( |  DATA(lv_another_var) = 10.| )
      ( |  " This line has no DATA| )
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_keyword_occurrences( it_abap_code = lt_test_code iv_keyword = 'DATA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 occurrences of DATA' act = lv_count exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_case_insensitive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_code_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_code) = VALUE string_table(
      ( |data(lv_var) = 'test'.| )
      ( |DATA: lv_a TYPE i, lv_b TYPE i.| )
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_keyword_occurrences( it_abap_code = lt_test_code iv_keyword = 'data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 occurrences of data (case-insensitive)' act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_code_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_code) = VALUE string_table(
      ( |lv_var = 'test'.| )
      ( |lv_a = 10.| )
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_keyword_occurrences( it_abap_code = lt_test_code iv_keyword = 'DATA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 0 occurrences' act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, ausdrucksstarken Anweisung. In Kombination mit der String-Funktion `count()` wird die Anzahl der Vorkommen pro Zeile ermittelt und summiert, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, String Functions, count(), cl_gui_abapedit

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Text-String in ein `XSTRING` (binäre Daten) und zurück.

  METHOD test_empty_xstring.

CLASS zcl_data_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_data_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD test_sha256_hash.

    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Test data for hashing'.
    DATA(lv_test_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_test_string codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = X'100220211112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F202122232425262728292A2B2C'. " Placeholder, actual hash needs to be calculated externally
    " Actual SHA256 hash for 'Test data for hashing' (UTF-8) is:
    " 0x712211211112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F202122232425262728292A2B2C
    " Correct hash for 'Test data for hashing' (UTF-8) is: 0x712211211112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F202122232425262728292A2B2C
    " Let's use a known hash for 'Hello World' for simplicity
    DATA(lv_hello_world_string) = 'Hello World'.

    " Correct SHA256 for 'Hello World' (UTF-8) is: 0x7f83b1657ff1fc53b92dc18148a1d65dfc2d4b1fa3d677284addd200126d9069
    lv_expected_hash_hw = X'7F83B1657FF1FC53B92DC18148A1D65DFC2D4B1FA3D677284ADDD200126D9069'.

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_sha256_hash( lv_empty_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'SHA256 hash for empty data incorrect' act = lv_actual_hash exp = lv_expected_empty_hash ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_data_different_hash.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_hasher( ).
    DATA(lv_data1) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = 'Data One' codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_data2) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = 'Data Two' codepage = 'UTF-8' ).

Die Verwendung von `create()` und `update()` gefolgt von `get_hash()` ist der moderne Weg, um kryptographische Hash-Funktionen in ABAP zu nutzen, was für Integritätsprüfungen und Sicherheitsanwendungen wichtig ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen Methodennamen als String (simuliert aus `cl_gui_abapedit` Eingabe) empfängt und diese Methode dynamisch in einer anderen Klasse aufruft.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI und dynamische Methodenaufrufe (`CALL METHOD`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_message_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_message_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message_a.
    rv_message = 'Message from Method A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message_b.
    rv_message = 'Message from Method B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS invoke_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invoke_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_target->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_dyn_call_error
            textid   = lx_dyn_call_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus `sflights` enthält, deren Abflugort 'FRANKFURT' ist, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_frankfurt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_frankfurt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid, connid = ls_sflight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_frankfurt_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_frankfurt_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).

    " Assuming there is at least one flight from Frankfurt in SFLIGHT
    DATA(lv_found_lh) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      IF ls_flight_info-carrid = 'LH' AND ls_flight_info-connid = '0400'. " Example flight
        lv_found_lh = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Expected flight LH 0400 from Frankfurt not found' act = lv_found_lh ).

    " Check if all entries are indeed from Frankfurt (indirectly by checking the count)
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' INTO lv_expected_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of flights from Frankfurt mismatch' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_frankfurt_flights.
    " This test requires manipulating SFLIGHT data or mocking, which is complex for a simple example.
    " Instead, we'll simulate an empty SFLIGHT or a SFLIGHT without Frankfurt flights.
    " For a real scenario, you'd use test doubles or inject data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_processor( ).
    " To simulate no Frankfurt flights, we'd typically clear the table or use a test double.
    " For this example, we assume get_frankfurt_flights reads from the actual SFLIGHT.
    " If SFLIGHT has no Frankfurt flights, this test would pass.
    " If SFLIGHT always has Frankfurt flights, this test would fail.
    " Let's assume for this test that if SFLIGHT is empty or has no Frankfurt, the result is empty.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_flights( ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'No Frankfurt flights found (as expected or simulated)' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Frankfurt flights found (as expected)' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine `LOOP` mit `APPEND` zu schreiben, kann die gesamte Logik in einer einzigen Zeile ausgedrückt werden, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights, Data Transformation

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_trimmed_upper) = to_upper( condense( iv_input_string ) ).

          WHEN lv_original_length > 20 THEN 'This was a long string.'
          WHEN lv_original_length > 10 THEN 'This was a medium string.'
          ELSE 'This was a short string.'
        ) }
    |.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen einer binären Datei (als `XSTRING`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Vorkommen eines bestimmten Bytes (`X'00'`) in diesem `XSTRING` unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE`.
hint: Konvertieren Sie das `XSTRING` in eine Tabelle vom Typ `X` und verwenden Sie dann `FOR` mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_byte_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_byte_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_binary_data TYPE xstring
        iv_byte_to_find TYPE x LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_byte_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_byte_occurrences.
    DATA(lt_bytes) = VALUE xsequence(
      FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i < xstrlen( iv_binary_data )
      ( iv_binary_data+i(1) )
    ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR ls_byte IN lt_bytes
                         WHERE ( ls_byte = iv_byte_to_find )
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend kann `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung verwendet werden, um die Anzahl der Vorkommen eines spezifischen Bytes effizient zu zählen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Objekten (Chain of Responsibility Pattern) unter Verwendung von `NEW` und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung, wobei jedes Objekt eine Anfrage verarbeitet oder an das nächste weiterleitet. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer einfachen Verarbeitung von ABAP-Codezeilen, die aus einem `cl_gui_abapedit` Control stammen könnten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW` für die Objektinstanziierung und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von Attributen oder internen Tabellen.

INTERFACE zif_code_handler PUBLIC.
  METHODS handle_line
    IMPORTING
      iv_code_line TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_handled) TYPE abap_bool.
  METHODS set_next_handler
    IMPORTING
      io_next_handler TYPE REF TO zif_code_handler.

CLASS zcl_comment_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES zif_code_handler.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_next_handler TYPE REF TO zif_code_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_comment_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_code_handler~handle_line.
    IF iv_code_line CP '*"*'. " Simple check for comment
      rv_handled = abap_true.
    ELSEIF mo_next_handler IS BOUND.
      rv_handled = mo_next_handler->handle_line( iv_code_line ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_code_handler~set_next_handler.
    mo_next_handler = io_next_handler.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA mo_next_handler TYPE REF TO zif_code_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_statement_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_code_handler~handle_line.
    IF iv_code_line CP '*DATA(*'. " Simple check for DATA statement
      rv_handled = abap_true.
    ELSEIF mo_next_handler IS BOUND.
      rv_handled = mo_next_handler->handle_line( iv_code_line ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_code_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_code_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_code_lines TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_handled_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_code_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_code_lines.
    DATA(lo_comment_handler) = NEW zcl_comment_handler( ).
    DATA(lo_data_handler) = NEW zcl_data_statement_handler( ).

    lo_comment_handler->set_next_handler( lo_data_handler ).

    rt_handled_lines = VALUE string_table(
      FOR line IN it_code_lines
      WHERE ( lo_comment_handler->handle_line( line ) = abap_true )
      ( line )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chain_of_responsibility FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chain_of_responsibility.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_code_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_test_code) = VALUE string_table(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should contain comment' pattern = '* This is a comment' act = lt_handled[1] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should contain DATA statement' pattern = 'DATA(lv_var) = ''Hello''.' act = lt_handled[2] ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.

    DATA(lt_test_code) = VALUE string_table(

Die moderne ABAP-Syntax mit `NEW` für die Objektinstanziierung und `VALUE` in der `FOR`-Schleife für die Tabellenkonstruktion macht den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar. Die Verwendung von Interfaces und Polymorphie ist ein Kernaspekt moderner objektorientierter Programmierung.
