Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `X` (Byte)-Werten in ein `XSTRING` und umgekehrt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONV` und `VALUE` für die Konvertierung zwischen `XSTRING` und `X`-Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_table_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_x_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF x WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS xstring_to_x_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_x_table) TYPE ty_x_table.

    METHODS x_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_x_table TYPE ty_x_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_table_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD xstring_to_x_table.
    rt_x_table = VALUE ty_x_table(
      FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i < xstrlen( iv_xstring )
      ( iv_xstring+i(1) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD x_table_to_xstring.
    rv_xstring = REDUCE xstring( INIT xstr = X''
                                 FOR ls_byte IN it_x_table
                                 NEXT xstr = xstr && ls_byte ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_xstring_x_table_roundtrip FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_xstring_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_byte FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_x_table_roundtrip.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xstring_table_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = X'010203FF00AA'.

    DATA(lt_x_table) = lo_cut->xstring_to_x_table( lv_original_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_converted_xstring) = lo_cut->x_table_to_xstring( lt_x_table ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Converted XSTRING should match original' act = lv_converted_xstring exp = lv_original_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should match XSTRING length' act = lines( lt_x_table ) exp = xstrlen( lv_original_xstring ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_xstring_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xstring_table_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_xstring) = X'00'. " Represents an empty xstring

    DATA(lt_x_table) = lo_cut->xstring_to_x_table( lv_empty_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_converted_xstring) = lo_cut->x_table_to_xstring( lt_x_table ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Empty XSTRING conversion should yield empty XSTRING' act = lv_converted_xstring exp = lv_empty_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Empty XSTRING should yield empty table' act = lt_x_table IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_byte.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xstring_table_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_single_byte_xstring) = X'AB'.

    DATA(lt_x_table) = lo_cut->xstring_to_x_table( lv_single_byte_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_converted_xstring) = lo_cut->x_table_to_xstring( lt_x_table ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Single byte XSTRING conversion incorrect' act = lv_converted_xstring exp = lv_single_byte_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Single byte table content incorrect' act = lt_x_table[1] exp = X'AB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung zwischen `XSTRING` und einer Tabelle von `X`-Werten ist ein häufiges Szenario bei der Verarbeitung binärer Daten. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife für die Zerlegung des `XSTRING` in eine Tabelle und `REDUCE` für die Rekonstruktion des `XSTRING` aus der Tabelle sind moderne, deklarative und effiziente Ansätze, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessern.
keywords: XSTRING, BINARY, Data Conversion, VALUE, FOR, REDUCE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT contains data for at least LH and AA
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_count).
      IF ls_flight_count-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = ls_flight_count-flight_count.
      ELSEIF ls_flight_count-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = ls_flight_count-flight_count.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_lh_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_expected_lh_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH flight count mismatch' act = lv_lh_count exp = lv_expected_lh_count ).

    DATA(lv_expected_aa_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO lv_expected_aa_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA flight count mismatch' act = lv_aa_count exp = lv_expected_aa_count ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Expected at least two carriers' act = lines( lt_result ) >= 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflight.
    " This test would require mocking SFLIGHT or ensuring it's empty.
    " For this example, we assume get_flight_counts_by_carrier reads from the actual SFLIGHT.
    " If SFLIGHT is empty, the result should be empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'No flight counts found (as expected or simulated)' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Flight counts found (as expected)' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` und `VALUE` ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion zur Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Gruppierungslogik deklarativ und in einer einzigen Anweisung zu formulieren, was die Lesbarkeit und Performance gegenüber manuellen Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen erheblich verbessert.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, FOR GROUPS OF, VALUE, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Instanz einer Klasse, deren Name als String übergeben wird (simuliert aus `cl_gui_abapedit` Eingabe), und rufen Sie eine Methode dieser Instanz auf. Die Klasse soll ein Interface implementieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW #( )` mit einem dynamischen Typnamen und `CAST` auf ein Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_dynamic_callable PUBLIC.
  METHODS execute_action RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_callable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_callable~execute_action.
    rv_result = 'Action executed by Class A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_callable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_callable~execute_action.
    rv_result = 'Action executed by Class B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_execute
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_error
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_execute.
    DATA lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lo_callable       TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_callable.

    TRY.
        lo_dynamic_object = NEW #( iv_class_name ).
        lo_callable ?= lo_dynamic_object.
        IF lo_callable IS BOUND.
          rv_output = lo_callable->execute_action( ).
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>dyn_call_error.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_create_error
            textid   = lx_create_error->textid.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_cast_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_cast_error
            textid   = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>dyn_call_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_execute_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_and_execute_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_non_existent_class RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_create_non_callable_class RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_execute_a.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factory( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_factory->create_and_execute( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_CLASS_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Class A action incorrect' act = lv_result exp = 'Action executed by Class A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_and_execute_b.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factory( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_factory->create_and_execute( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_CLASS_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Class B action incorrect' act = lv_result exp = 'Action executed by Class B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_non_existent_class.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factory( ).
    TRY.
        lo_factory->create_and_execute( 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_create_error for non-existent class' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_create_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_non_callable_class.
    " Create a dummy class that does not implement the interface
    CLASS zcl_dummy_non_callable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS dummy_method.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_dummy_non_callable IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD dummy_method. ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factory( ).
    TRY.
        lo_factory->create_and_execute( 'ZCL_DUMMY_NON_CALLABLE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_call_error for non-callable class' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_dyn_call_error for non-callable class' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Instanziierung von Klassen mit `NEW #( iv_class_name )` und der anschließende `CAST` auf ein Interface (`lo_callable ?= lo_dynamic_object`) ist ein fortgeschrittenes, aber sehr mächtiges Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.55). Es ermöglicht die Implementierung von Factory-Mustern oder Plugin-Architekturen, bei denen die zu verwendende Klasse zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, was die Flexibilität und Erweiterbarkeit des Systems erheblich steigert. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei unerlässlich.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, NEW, CAST, Interfaces, RTTI, Factory Pattern, cl_gui_abapedit

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_names IMPORTING is_structure TYPE any
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_names.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
        LOOP AT lo_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp).
          APPEND ls_comp-name TO rt_component_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " is_structure ist keine Struktur, leere Tabelle zurückgeben.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein übergebenes Datenobjekt eine Referenz auf eine Instanz einer bestimmten Klasse ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_refdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_referenced_type` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_p_by_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_is_instance_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_instance_of IMPORTING ir_object    TYPE REF TO object
                                      iv_classname TYPE string
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_instance) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_instance_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_instance_of.
    IF ir_object IS NOT BOUND.
      rv_is_instance = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_ref_descr) = cl_abap_refdescr=>describe_by_data( ir_object ).
        DATA(lo_referenced_type) = lo_ref_descr->get_referenced_type( ).
        DATA(lo_target_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_p_by_name( iv_classname ).

        IF lo_referenced_type->is_a( lo_target_class_descr ) = abap_true.
          rv_is_instance = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_instance = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_descr_type.
        " Klasse nicht gefunden oder Referenztyp nicht verarbeitbar
        rv_is_instance = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " ir_object ist keine Objekt-Referenz
        rv_is_instance = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen nach einem dynamisch angegebenen numerischen Feld sortiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `SORT` mit `DYNAMIC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_by_numeric_field
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_table        TYPE any table
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_component_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_by_numeric_field.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          ls_component   TYPE abap_compdescr.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ct_table ).
    lo_line_descr  ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    READ TABLE lo_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_component_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in Struktur gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type_descr ).
    IF lo_elem_descr->is_numeric_type( ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_component_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' ist kein numerischer Typ.|.
    ENDIF.

    SORT ct_table BY (iv_field_name).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) in einem lesbaren, formatierten String für die Anzeige in einem `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` Control aufbereitet. Jede Zeile soll die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Datum enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `FOR`-Iteratoren, um die Daten zeilenweise zu formatieren. Die Methode sollte den formatierten String zurückgeben, der dann an `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT->SET_TEXT_AS_STREAM` übergeben werden könnte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ts_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_sflight_data.
    rv_formatted_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT text = ``
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT text = |
{ text }{ <fs_sflight>-carrid } { <fs_sflight>-connid } { <fs_sflight>-fldate DATE = USER }|
    ).
    IF rv_formatted_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_formatted_text = rv_formatted_text+1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Zeile einer beliebigen internen Tabelle dynamisch ausliest. Der Feldname und die Zeilennummer sollen ebenfalls dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>` nach dem Zugriff auf die Zeile der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_index      TYPE i
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_value> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX iv_index ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_value>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <lv_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch aufruft und dabei sowohl Import- als auch Exportparameter dynamisch übergibt/empfängt. Die Methode soll den Wert eines Exportparameters zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE it_parameters` und `RECEIVING parameter = rv_result`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object       TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name  TYPE string
        it_import_params TYPE abap_parmbind_tab OPTIONAL
        iv_export_param_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_export_params TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA: ls_export_param  TYPE abap_parmbind.
    DATA: lr_result        TYPE REF TO data.

    IF iv_export_param_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE DATA lr_result TYPE string.
      ls_export_param = VALUE #( name = iv_export_param_name kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>exporting value = lr_result ).
      APPEND ls_export_param TO lt_export_params.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE it_import_params
          CHANGING PARAMETER-TABLE lt_export_params.

        IF lr_result IS BOUND.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_result> TYPE any.
          ASSIGN lr_result->* TO <lv_result>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_result = <lv_result>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING previous = lx_dyn_call_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Logik, die Schlüsselwörter in einem gegebenen Text (simuliert aus `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`) identifiziert und eine Liste von Startpositionen und Längen für diese Schlüsselwörter zurückgibt, um eine Syntaxhervorhebung zu ermöglichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit der `RESULTS`-Klausel und `FOR` für die Transformation der Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_syntax_highlighter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_highlight_pos,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ts_highlight_pos.
    TYPES: tt_highlight_pos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_highlight_pos WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_keyword_positions
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        it_keywords TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_positions) TYPE tt_highlight_pos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_syntax_highlighter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_keyword_positions.
    DATA: lt_find_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    LOOP AT it_keywords INTO DATA(lv_keyword).
      FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_keyword IN SECTION LENGTH strlen( iv_text ) OF iv_text
        IGNORING CASE
        RESULTS lt_find_results.

      rt_positions = VALUE #( BASE rt_positions
                              FOR <fs_result> IN lt_find_results
                              ( offset = <fs_result>-offset length = <fs_result>-length ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer dynamisch erzeugten `WHERE`-Klausel auswählt. Die `WHERE`-Klausel soll als interne Tabelle von Strings übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE (itab_with_conditions)` für dynamische Open SQL-Abfragen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ts_sflight_full.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_sflights_dynamic_where
      IMPORTING
        it_where_conditions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_full
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_sflights_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR condition IN it_where_conditions
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN condition ELSE s && ` AND ` && condition ) ).

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
          FROM sflights
          WHERE (lv_where_clause)
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Logik für eine Undo/Redo-Funktionalität, die Textänderungen (simuliert aus `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`) in einer Historie speichert und das Zurücksetzen auf frühere Zustände ermöglicht.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle als Stack für die Historie und `INSERT`/`DELETE` für die Verwaltung der Zustände. Der `VALUE`-Operator kann für die Initialisierung genutzt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_undo_redo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_state IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS undo RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS redo RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_current_text RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_history TYPE string_table.
    DATA mv_current_state_index TYPE i VALUE -1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_undo_redo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_state.
    IF mv_current_state_index < lines( mt_history ) - 1.
      DELETE mt_history FROM mv_current_state_index + 2.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND iv_text TO mt_history.
    mv_current_state_index = lines( mt_history ) - 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD undo.
    IF mv_current_state_index > 0.
      mv_current_state_index = mv_current_state_index - 1.
      rv_text = mt_history[ mv_current_state_index + 1 ].
    ELSE.
      rv_text = mt_history[ 1 ]. " Return initial state or empty if no states
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD redo.
    IF mv_current_state_index < lines( mt_history ) - 1.
      mv_current_state_index = mv_current_state_index + 1.
      rv_text = mt_history[ mv_current_state_index + 1 ].
    ELSE.
      rv_text = mt_history[ lines( mt_history ) ]. " Return current state
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_text.
    IF mv_current_state_index >= 0 AND mv_current_state_index < lines( mt_history ).
      rv_text = mt_history[ mv_current_state_index + 1 ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem dynamisch übergebenen Strukturtyp (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') erzeugt und diese mit Beispieldaten füllt. Die Methode soll eine Referenz auf die dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (structure_name)` und `INSERT TABLE` für die Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_structure_name).
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Example: Fill with SFLIGHT data if structure is SFLIGHT
        IF iv_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).
          LOOP AT lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
            INSERT <fs_sflight> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ENDLOOP.
        ELSEIF iv_structure_name = 'SBOOK'.
          SELECT * FROM sbook UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sbook_data).
          LOOP AT lt_sbook_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sbook>).
            INSERT <fs_sbook> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ENDLOOP.
        ELSE.
          " Generic filling for other structures (simplified)
          CREATE DATA REF TO (iv_structure_name) INTO DATA(lr_line).
          ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Attempt to fill some fields generically (e.g., first field)
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              TRY.
                  <fs_field> = 'DynamicValue'.
                CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
                  " Ignore if type mismatch
              ENDTRY.
            ENDIF.
            INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING previous = lx_create_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die einen mehrzeiligen Text (simuliert aus `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`) empfängt und jede Zeile mit einer fortlaufenden Nummer versieht. Die nummerierten Zeilen sollen als ein einziger String zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SPLIT` um den Text in Zeilen zu zerlegen und String-Templates mit `FOR` für die Nummerierung und Rekombination.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_line_numberer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_line_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_numbered_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_line_numberer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_line_numbers.
    DATA: lt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SPLIT iv_text AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    rv_numbered_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT text = ``
           idx  = 0
      FOR line IN lt_lines
      NEXT idx  = idx + 1
           text = |
{ text }{ idx PAD LEFT = 4 COLS = '0' }: { line }|
    ).
    IF rv_numbered_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_numbered_text = rv_numbered_text+1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `REDUCE`-Operator mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer zusätzlichen Zählervariable (`idx`) wird verwendet, um jede Zeile zu nummerieren und gleichzeitig den gesamten Text wieder zusammenzusetzen. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` auswählt, wobei die auszuwählenden Felder dynamisch als interne Tabelle von Feldnamen übergeben werden. Die Methode soll eine Referenz auf eine dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle mit den ausgewählten Feldern zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT (itab_with_fieldnames) FROM ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_result)` für dynamische Feldselektion und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Ergebnistabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_dynamic_fields
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name   TYPE string
        it_field_names  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_result_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_dynamic_fields.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_result> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    DATA(lv_field_list) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR field IN it_field_names
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && `,` && field ) ).

    IF lv_field_list IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error=>no_fields_specified.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA rr_result_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_table_name).
        ASSIGN rr_result_table->* TO <lt_result>.

        SELECT (lv_field_list)
          FROM (iv_table_name)
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_result>.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING previous = lx_create_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die die Logik für die Verarbeitung eines 'TEXT_CHANGED'-Ereignisses eines `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` Controls kapselt. Die Methode soll den geänderten Text empfangen und eine einfache Analyse durchführen (z.B. die Anzahl der Wörter zählen).
hint: Fokussieren Sie sich auf die Logik, die durch das Ereignis ausgelöst würde. Nutzen Sie `COUNT` und `SPLIT` für die Wortzählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_text_changed
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_word_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_text_changed.
    DATA: lt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Split the text by spaces, tabs, newlines to count words
    SPLIT iv_new_text AT ` ` INTO TABLE lt_words.
    lt_words = VALUE #( FOR word IN lt_words WHERE ( word IS NOT INITIAL )
                        ( word ) ).

    rv_word_count = lines( lt_words ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem übergebenen Feld sortiert. Der Feldname und die Sortierreihenfolge (aufsteigend/absteigend) sollen dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT <itab> BY (field_name) ASCENDING/DESCENDING` mit dynamischen Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ts_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_direction  TYPE string " 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sort_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sort_error.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        IF iv_direction = 'ASCENDING'.
          SORT <lt_table> BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
        ELSEIF iv_direction = 'DESCENDING'.
          SORT <lt_table> BY (iv_field_name) DESCENDING.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sort_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_sort_error=>invalid_sort_direction.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sort_error INTO DATA(lx_sort_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sort_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sort_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Komponenten (Felder) eines dynamisch übergebenen Strukturtyps ausliest und deren Namen und Typen als interne Tabelle zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI-Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ts_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE (iv_structure_name).
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lr_data ).

        rt_components = VALUE #( FOR component IN lo_struct_descr->get_components( )
                                 ( name      = component-name
                                   type_kind = component-type_kind
                                   length    = component-length ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING previous = lx_create_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_cast_error).
        " Not a structure type
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING previous = lx_cast_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch filtert. Die Filterkriterien sollen als interne Tabelle von `WHERE`-Klausel-Fragmenten übergeben werden, ähnlich wie bei dynamischem Open SQL.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamisch konstruierten Ausdruck oder eine Kombination aus `LOOP AT` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        it_conditions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_filtered_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <lt_target_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_source_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_source_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_source_table> ).
    CREATE DATA rr_filtered_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_filtered_table->* TO <lt_target_table>.

    LOOP AT <lt_source_table> ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
      DATA(lv_condition_met) = abap_true.
      LOOP AT it_conditions INTO DATA(lv_condition_string).
        " This is a simplified dynamic evaluation. For complex conditions, a dynamic expression parser
        " or a more sophisticated approach would be needed (e.g., using dynamic WHERE for internal tables
        " if the syntax supported it directly, or building a dynamic predicate).
        " For this example, we assume simple 'FIELD = VALUE' conditions.
        DATA(lv_field_name)  TYPE string.
        DATA(lv_operator)    TYPE string.
        DATA(lv_value_str)   TYPE string.

        SPLIT lv_condition_string AT '=' INTO lv_field_name lv_value_str.
        CONDENSE: lv_field_name, lv_value_str.

        IF lv_field_name IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_value_str IS NOT INITIAL.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field_value> TYPE ANY.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            IF <lv_field_value> <> lv_value_str.
              lv_condition_met = abap_false.
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            " Field not found, condition cannot be met
            lv_condition_met = abap_false.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_condition_met = abap_true.
        INSERT <ls_source_line> INTO TABLE <lt_target_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch in eine andere interne Tabelle mit einer dynamisch definierten Zielstruktur umwandelt. Dabei sollen nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen kopiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` für die Zielstruktur und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit Feld-Symbolen für die Datenübertragung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data
        iv_target_structure_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <lt_target> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_source_line> TYPE ANY,
                   <ls_target_line> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_source_table->* TO <lt_source>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA rr_target_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_target_structure_name).
        ASSIGN rr_target_table->* TO <lt_target>.

        CREATE DATA REF TO (iv_target_structure_name) INTO DATA(lr_target_line).
        ASSIGN lr_target_line->* TO <ls_target_line>.

        LOOP AT <lt_source> ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
          CLEAR <ls_target_line>.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING <ls_source_line> TO <ls_target_line>.
          INSERT <ls_target_line> INTO TABLE <lt_target>.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING previous = lx_create_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine dynamische `GROUP BY`-Klausel in einer Open SQL-Abfrage verwendet, um aggregierte Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` zu ermitteln. Die zu gruppierenden Felder sollen dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY (itab_with_group_fields)` für dynamische Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_sflights_dynamic_group
      IMPORTING
        it_group_fields TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_result_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_sflights_dynamic_group.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_result> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    DATA(lv_group_field_list) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR field IN it_group_fields
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && `,` && field ) ).

    IF lv_group_field_list IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error=>no_fields_specified.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_select_list) = lv_group_field_list && `, COUNT(*) AS num_flights, SUM(seatsocc) AS total_seats_occ`.

    TRY.
        " Create dynamic structure for result table
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
        DATA: lt_result_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

        LOOP AT it_group_fields INTO DATA(lv_group_field).
          READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = lv_group_field INTO DATA(ls_component).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND ls_component TO lt_result_components.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        APPEND VALUE #( name = 'NUM_FLIGHTS' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) ) TO lt_result_components.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = 'TOTAL_SEATS_OCC' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_decfloat16( ) ) TO lt_result_components.

        DATA(lo_result_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_result_components ).
        DATA(lo_result_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_result_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_result_table TYPE HANDLE lo_result_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_result_table->* TO <lt_result>.

        SELECT (lv_select_list)
          FROM sflights
          GROUP BY (lv_group_field_list)
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_result>.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING previous = lx_create_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation_error INTO DATA(lx_struct_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING previous = lx_struct_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verschieben Sie die Zeichen eines Strings zirkulär um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen nach rechts.

solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_circular_right DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_circular_right
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_places       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_circular_right IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_circular_right.
    rv_result_string = iv_input_string.
    IF iv_places < 0.
      " For negative shifts, convert to left circular shift
      DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
      IF lv_length > 0.
        DATA(lv_actual_places) = abs( iv_places ) MOD lv_length.
        SHIFT rv_result_string LEFT CIRCULAR BY lv_actual_places PLACES.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      SHIFT rv_result_string RIGHT CIRCULAR BY iv_places PLACES.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens in einem String durch ein anderes, beginnend ab einer bestimmten Position.
hint: Verwenden Sie SHIFT ... UP TO ... AND REPLACE ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_replace_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_char_from_pos
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_char_to_find TYPE c
        iv_char_to_replace TYPE c
        iv_start_pos    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_replace_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_char_from_pos.
    rv_result_string = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_offset) = iv_start_pos - 1.
    IF lv_offset < 0 OR lv_offset >= strlen( rv_result_string ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_char_to_find IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF rv_result_string MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_match_offset).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_result_string+lv_match_offset(1) = iv_char_to_replace.
        lv_offset = lv_match_offset + 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_replace_char( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_char_from_pos( iv_input_string = `ABCCDEFF` iv_char_to_find = `C` iv_char_to_replace = `X` iv_start_pos = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `ABXXDEFF` ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_char_from_pos( iv_input_string = `ABCCDEFF` iv_char_to_find = `C` iv_char_to_replace = `X` iv_start_pos = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `ABCXDEFF` ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_char_from_pos( iv_input_string = `AAAAA` iv_char_to_find = `A` iv_char_to_replace = `B` iv_start_pos = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `AABBB` ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_char_from_pos( iv_input_string = `Hello` iv_char_to_find = `z` iv_char_to_replace = `y` iv_start_pos = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `Hello` ).

explanation: Während die SHIFT-Anweisung selbst keine direkte 'replace all from position'-Funktion bietet, kann man dies durch eine Schleife mit FIND und direkter Zuweisung erreichen. Für komplexere Ersetzungen wäre REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF oder reguläre Ausdrücke (REGEX) die modernere Wahl, aber dieses Beispiel zeigt eine SHIFT-ähnliche Logik für zeichenweise Manipulation.
keywords: SHIFT, REPLACE, String, Character, Position

CLASS zcl_char_check_control DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_contains) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_char_check_control IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_control_chars.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = iv_input_string+sy-index-1(1).
      IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>is_control( lv_char ) = abap_true.
        rv_contains = abap_true.

    ENDDO.
    rv_contains = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen aus einem String, aber nur, wenn der String nicht leer ist. Verwenden Sie moderne String-Funktionen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_strip_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS strip_leading_trailing_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_stripped_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_strip_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD strip_leading_trailing_spaces.
    rv_stripped_string = COND string(
      WHEN iv_input_string IS NOT INITIAL THEN

      ELSE
        iv_input_string

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle nicht-druckbaren Steuerzeichen (z.B. Tab, Newline, Carriage Return) aus einem gegebenen String.

solution:
CLASS zcl_remove_ctrl_chars DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_control_characters
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_remove_ctrl_chars IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_control_characters.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>CR_LF IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ''.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>CR IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ''.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>LF IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ''.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>HORIZONTAL_TAB IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ''.
    " Weitere Steuerzeichen können bei Bedarf hinzugefügt werden, z.B. FORM_FEED, VERTICAL_TAB
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String nicht-druckbare Zeichen enthält.
hint: Iterieren Sie durch den String und vergleichen Sie jedes Zeichen mit den Konstanten von `cl_abap_char_utilities` oder verwenden Sie `FIND` mit einem regulären Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_non_printable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_non_printable
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_contains) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_non_printable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_non_printable.
    DATA(lv_control_chars) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>CR_LF &&
                                 cl_abap_char_utilities=>CR &&
                                 cl_abap_char_utilities=>LF &&
                                 cl_abap_char_utilities=>HORIZONTAL_TAB &&
                                 cl_abap_char_utilities=>FORM_FEED &&
                                 cl_abap_char_utilities=>VERTICAL_TAB.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '[' && lv_control_chars && ']' IN iv_input_string.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rb_contains = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_contains = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) in einen CSV-formatierten String, der als E-Mail-Anhang verwendet werden kann.
hint: Generieren Sie den CSV-String mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_char_utilities=>CR_LF` für Zeilenumbrüche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv.
    DATA: lv_header TYPE string.

    " Generate CSV header
    lv_header = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY'.
    rv_csv_string = lv_header.

    " Generate CSV data using REDUCE and string templates
    rv_csv_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = rv_csv_string
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflight_data
      NEXT s = s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>CR_LF &&
               |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid };{ <fs_sflight>-connid };{ <fs_sflight>-fldate DATE = ISO };{ <fs_sflight>-price };{ <fs_sflight>-currency }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE zcl_itab_to_csv=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '123.45'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Text-Anhang für eine E-Mail unter Verwendung von `cl_bcs_convert` und `cl_document_bcs`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix` um den String in das benötigte Format zu konvertieren und `cl_document_bcs=>create_document`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_create_text_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_text_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_name TYPE string
        iv_file_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_create_text_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_text_attachment.
    DATA: lt_solix TYPE solix_tab.

    TRY.
        cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
          EXPORTING
            iv_string = iv_file_content
            iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
            iv_add_bom = abap_true
          IMPORTING
            et_solix = lt_solix
        ).

        ro_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = iv_file_name " Subject for document, not attachment name
          i_length  = xstrlen( iv_file_content ) " Not strictly needed for RAW, but good practice
          i_language = sy-langu
        ).

        ro_document->add_attachment(
          i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
          i_attachment_subject = iv_file_name
          i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( iv_file_content )
          i_att_content_hex    = lt_solix
        ).

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings und ersetzen Sie diese durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONDENSE` und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` oder String-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_clean_string_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clean_string_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_spaces.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.
    " Entferne führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und reduziere interne Leerzeichen auf eines
    rv_cleaned_string = condense( rv_cleaned_string ).
    " CONDENSE entfernt nur führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und ersetzt mehrere Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes.
    " Es behandelt jedoch keine anderen Whitespace-Zeichen wie Tabs oder Newlines.
    " Für eine umfassendere Bereinigung könnte man REGEX verwenden:
    " rv_cleaned_string = replace( val = rv_cleaned_string regex = `\s+` with = ` ` ).
    " Hier bleiben wir bei CONDENSE für die Einfachheit und da es oft ausreicht.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der in einer bestimmten Codepage (z.B. '1100' für Latin-1) vorliegt, in einen UTF-8 kodierten String.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` oder `cl_abap_char_utilities` für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_codepage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_source_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_convert_codepage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_utf8.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        " String in XSTRING der Quell-Codepage konvertieren
        cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          EXPORTING
            encoding = iv_source_codepage
            endian   = 'L'
          RECEIVING
            conv     = DATA(lo_conv_out)
        )->write(
          EXPORTING
            data = iv_input_string
          IMPORTING
            buffer = lv_xstring
        ).

        " XSTRING in UTF-8 String konvertieren
        cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          EXPORTING
            encoding = 'UTF-8'
            endian   = 'L'
          RECEIVING
            conv     = DATA(lo_conv_in)
        )->read(
          EXPORTING
            data = lv_xstring
          IMPORTING
            nbytes = DATA(lv_bytes_read)
            data   = rv_utf8_string
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rv_utf8_string.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_latin1_to_utf8 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_codepage FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_latin1_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_codepage( ).
    DATA(lv_latin1_string) = 'Grüße'. " Assuming this is represented in Latin-1
    DATA(lv_expected_utf8) = 'Grüße'. " In ABAP, string is Unicode, so direct comparison is fine if source is correctly interpreted
    DATA(lv_result_utf8) = lo_cut->convert_to_utf8( iv_input_string = lv_latin1_string iv_source_codepage = '1100' ). " 1100 is ISO-8859-1 (Latin-1)

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_utf8 exp = lv_expected_utf8 msg = 'Latin-1 string should be converted to UTF-8' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_codepage( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_string) = ''.
    DATA(lv_result_utf8) = lo_cut->convert_to_utf8( iv_input_string = lv_empty_string iv_source_codepage = '4103' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_utf8 exp = '' msg = 'Empty string should result in empty UTF-8 string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_codepage.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_codepage( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Test'.
    " Expecting an exception or empty string due to invalid codepage
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_to_utf8( iv_input_string = lv_input iv_source_codepage = '9999' ). " Invalid codepage
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Invalid codepage should result in empty string or error' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception should be caught and handled gracefully' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: String Conversion, Codepage, UTF-8, cl_abap_conv_out_ce, cl_abap_conv_in_ce

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens in einem String durch ein anderes Zeichen, wobei die Groß- und Kleinschreibung ignoriert werden soll.

CLASS zcl_replace_ignoring_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_replace_ignoring_case IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Knotentabelle für einen `cl_gui_list_tree` generiert. Die Tabelle soll Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer hierarchisch anzeigen. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung und -strukturierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `GROUP BY` für die hierarchische Strukturierung der Daten und `VALUE` für die Erstellung der Knotentabelle (`LVC_T_OUTL`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE lvc_value,
             level TYPE i,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,
             image TYPE lvc_image,
             item_image TYPE lvc_image,
             tooltip TYPE lvc_value,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES tt_sflight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_tree_nodes
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_sflight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_tree_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( BASE rt_nodes (
      FOR GROUPS car_group OF sflight IN lt_sflight_data
        GROUP BY sflight-carrid
        ( LET lv_car_key = CONV lvc_nkey( lv_node_key + 1 ) IN
          VALUE #( node_key = lv_car_key
                   parent_key = ''
                   text = |Carrier: { car_group-carrid }|
                   level = 1
                   exp_image = '@DI@'
                   image = '@DP@'
                   tooltip = |Flüge von { car_group-carrid }|
                   ( FOR flight_group OF sflight IN car_group
                       GROUP BY flight_group-connid
                       ( LET lv_flight_key = CONV lvc_nkey( lv_node_key + 2 ) IN
                         VALUE #( node_key = lv_flight_key
                                  parent_key = lv_car_key
                                  text = |Flight: { flight_group-connid }|
                                  level = 2
                                  exp_image = '@DR@'
                                  image = '@DS@'
                                  tooltip = |Verbindung { flight_group-connid }|
                                  ( FOR single_flight IN flight_group
                                      ( VALUE #( node_key = CONV lvc_nkey( lv_node_key + 3 )
                                                parent_key = lv_flight_key
                                                text = |Date: { single_flight-fldate DATE = USER } - { single_flight-planetype }|
                                                level = 3
                                                image = '@5C@'
                                                tooltip = |Flug am { single_flight-fldate DATE = USER } mit { single_flight-planetype }|
                                      ) )
                         ) )
        ) )
    ) ).

    " Increment node_key for next usage (not strictly needed here, but good practice for dynamic keys)
    lv_node_key = lines( rt_nodes ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_sflight_tree_nodes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY`, um hierarchische Daten aus `sflight` zu aggregieren. Der `VALUE`-Operator wird verwendet, um die Knotentabelle (`LVC_T_OUTL`) direkt und deklarativ zu füllen, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) und String-Templates (`|...|`) tragen zur Modernität bei. Die `CONV` Funktion wird verwendet, um den `node_key` in den korrekten Typ zu konvertieren.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_icons DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE lvc_value,
             level TYPE i,
             exp_image TYPE lvc_image,

    METHODS get_sflight_tree_nodes_with_icons
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_sflight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_icons IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_tree_nodes_with_icons.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( BASE rt_nodes (
      FOR GROUPS car_group OF sflight IN lt_sflight_data
        GROUP BY sflight-carrid
        ( LET lv_car_key = CONV lvc_nkey( lv_node_key + 1 ) IN
          VALUE #( node_key = lv_car_key
                   parent_key = ''
                   text = |Carrier: { car_group-carrid }|
                   level = 1
                   exp_image = '@DI@'
                   image = '@DP@'
                   tooltip = |Flüge von { car_group-carrid }|
                   ( FOR flight_group OF sflight IN car_group
                       GROUP BY flight_group-connid
                       ( LET lv_flight_key = CONV lvc_nkey( lv_node_key + 2 ) IN
                         VALUE #( node_key = lv_flight_key
                                  parent_key = lv_car_key
                                  text = |Flight: { flight_group-connid }|
                                  level = 2
                                  exp_image = '@DR@'
                                  image = '@DS@'
                                  tooltip = |Verbindung { flight_group-connid }|
                                  ( FOR single_flight IN flight_group
                                      ( VALUE #( node_key = CONV lvc_nkey( lv_node_key + 3 )
                                                parent_key = lv_flight_key
                                                text = |Date: { single_flight-fldate DATE = USER } - { single_flight-planetype }|
                                                level = 3
                                                image = '@5C@'
                                                item_image = COND #( WHEN single_flight-seatsocc > 0 THEN '@01@' ELSE '@02@' ) " Example: @01@ for occupied, @02@ for free
                                                tooltip = |Flug am { single_flight-fldate DATE = USER } mit { single_flight-planetype }. Belegte Sitze: { single_flight-seatsocc }|
                                      ) )
                         ) )
        ) )
    ) ).

    lv_node_key = lines( rt_nodes ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode soll auch eine Referenz auf den Tree zurückgeben, um weitere dynamische Operationen zu ermöglichen. (Hinweis: Für eine vollständige GUI-Anwendung wäre ein Screen und PBO/PAI erforderlich).

solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_inst DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE lvc_value,
             level TYPE i,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_init_tree

      RETURNING VALUE(ro_list_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree
      RAISING cx_gui_exception.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_initial_nodes

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_inst IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_init_tree.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Knotentabelle für einen `cl_gui_list_tree` generiert, wobei die Hierarchie durch eine rekursive Funktion oder Methode aufgebaut wird, um eine beliebige Tiefe zu unterstützen. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Eine rekursive Methode kann die Hierarchieebenen verwalten. `REDUCE` kann zur Sammlung der Knoten verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_recursive_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE lvc_value,
             level TYPE i,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_recursive_tree_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_depth TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS add_child_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_current_level TYPE i
        iv_max_depth TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
        cv_node_counter TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_recursive_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_recursive_tree_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Root' level = 0 ) ).
    lv_node_counter = 1.

    add_child_nodes(
      iv_parent_key = 'ROOT'
      iv_current_level = 0
      iv_max_depth = iv_max_depth
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes = rt_nodes
        cv_node_counter = lv_node_counter
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_child_nodes.
    IF iv_current_level >= iv_max_depth.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_child_count) = 3.
    DO lv_child_count TIMES.
      cv_node_counter = cv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_child_key) = |CHILD_{ iv_current_level }_{ sy-index }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node(
        node_key = lv_child_key
        parent_key = iv_parent_key
        text = |Node { iv_current_level + 1 }.{ sy-index }|
        level = iv_current_level + 1
      ) TO ct_nodes.

      add_child_nodes(
        iv_parent_key = lv_child_key
        iv_current_level = iv_current_level + 1
        iv_max_depth = iv_max_depth
        CHANGING
          ct_nodes = ct_nodes
          cv_node_counter = cv_node_counter
      ).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_recursive_nodes( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Nodes for depth 1' act = lines( lt_nodes_depth1 ) exp = 4 ). " 1 root + 3 children
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last node level for depth 1' act = lt_nodes_depth1[ lines( lt_nodes_depth1 ) ]-level exp = 1 ).

    " Test with depth 2

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last node level for depth 2' act = lt_nodes_depth2[ lines( lt_nodes_depth2 ) ]-level exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen HMAC-SHA256 für eine gegebene Nachricht und einen geheimen Schlüssel. Die Ausgabe soll im Hexadezimalformat erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac` und die Methode `calculate_hmac`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_key     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_sha256.
    DATA(lv_message_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_message ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)     = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_key ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      if_key       = lv_key_x
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = lv_message_x
      IMPORTING
        ef_hmac = DATA(lv_hmac_x)
    ).

    rv_hmac_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hmac_x ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein empfangener HMAC-SHA256 für eine Nachricht und einen geheimen Schlüssel gültig ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac` und die Methode `verify_hmac`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_verifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_hmac_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_key     TYPE string
        iv_hmac_hex TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_verifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_hmac_sha256.
    DATA(lv_message_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_message ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)     = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_key ).
    DATA(lv_hmac_x)    = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( iv_hmac_hex ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      if_key       = lv_key_x
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_hmac->verify_hmac(
          EXPORTING
            if_data = lv_message_x
            if_hmac = lv_hmac_x
        ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_abap_hmac_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen HMAC für eine Nachricht unter Verwendung eines dynamisch übergebenen Hash-Algorithmus (z.B. SHA256 oder SHA512).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac=>create` mit dem Parameter `if_algorithm` und den Konstanten der Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_hash_algorithm TYPE c LENGTH 10. " e.g., 'SHA256', 'SHA512'

    METHODS calculate_hmac_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_key     TYPE string
        iv_algorithm TYPE ty_hash_algorithm
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_message_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_message ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)     = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_key ).

    DATA(lv_hmac_alg) TYPE i.
    CASE iv_algorithm.
      WHEN 'SHA256'.
        lv_hmac_alg = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256.
      WHEN 'SHA512'.
        lv_hmac_alg = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha512.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_hmac_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Unsupported hash algorithm'.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      if_algorithm = lv_hmac_alg
      if_key       = lv_key_x
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = lv_message_x
      IMPORTING
        ef_hmac = DATA(lv_hmac_x)
    ).

    rv_hmac_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hmac_x ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_fluent_api DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_raw,
             employee_id TYPE string,

             last_name   TYPE string,

      IMPORTING iv_department TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_odata_fluent_api.
    METHODS order_by_salary
      IMPORTING iv_direction TYPE string OPTIONAL " 'ASC' or 'DESC'
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_odata_fluent_api.
    METHODS execute
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employee_raw.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_filter_department TYPE string.
    DATA mv_order_by_salary_direction TYPE string.

    METHODS simulate_odata_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_department TYPE string
        iv_order_by_salary_direction TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_raw_data) TYPE tt_employee_raw.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_fluent_api IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_filter_department = ''.
    mv_order_by_salary_direction = ''.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_department.
    mv_filter_department = iv_department.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD order_by_salary.
    mv_order_by_salary_direction = iv_direction.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    rt_employees = simulate_odata_call(
      iv_filter_department         = mv_filter_department
      iv_order_by_salary_direction = mv_order_by_salary_direction
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_odata_call.
*   Simulate data fetched from cl_hcmfab_employee_api based on filters/orders
    DATA(lt_all_employees) = VALUE #(
      ( employee_id = 'E001' first_name = 'Max' last_name = 'Mustermann' department = 'IT' salary = '50000' )
      ( employee_id = 'E002' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Musterfrau' department = 'HR' salary = '60000' )
      ( employee_id = 'E003' first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Pan' department = 'IT' salary = '55000' )
      ( employee_id = 'E004' first_name = 'Lisa' last_name = 'Simpson' department = 'HR' salary = '62000' )
    ).

    rt_raw_data = lt_all_employees.

    IF iv_filter_department IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_raw_data = FILTER #( rt_raw_data WHERE department = iv_filter_department ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_order_by_salary_direction = 'ASC'.
      SORT rt_raw_data BY salary ASCENDING.
    ELSEIF iv_order_by_salary_direction = 'DESC'.
      SORT rt_raw_data BY salary DESCENDING.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_switch_response DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_odata_switch_response IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen eingehenden Request (simuliert als JSON-String) validiert, indem sie den mitgelieferten HMAC überprüft. Bei erfolgreicher Validierung wird ein Status 'OK' zurückgegeben, sonst 'FEHLER'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_hmac=>verify_hmac` und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_request_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_request_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_payload TYPE string
        iv_received_hmac_hex TYPE string
        iv_secret_key   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_request_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_request_hmac.
    DATA(lv_message_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_json_payload ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)     = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_secret_key ).
    DATA(lv_hmac_x)    = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( iv_received_hmac_hex ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      if_key       = lv_key_x
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_hmac->verify_hmac(
          EXPORTING
            if_data = lv_message_x
            if_hmac = lv_hmac_x
        ).
        rv_status = 'OK'.
      CATCH cx_abap_hmac_error.
        rv_status = 'FEHLER'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die versucht, einen HMAC zu generieren. Bei einem Fehler (z.B. ungültiger Algorithmus) soll eine spezifische, benutzerdefinierte Exception ausgelöst werden, die die Original-Exception kapselt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ... EXPORTING previous = ...` um Exceptions zu kapseln.
solution:
CLASS zcx_hmac_custom_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_hmac_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_hmac_robust
      IMPORTING
        iv_message   TYPE string
        iv_key       TYPE string
        iv_algorithm TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_hmac_custom_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_hmac_robust.
    DATA(lv_message_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_message ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)     = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_key ).

    DATA(lv_hmac_alg) TYPE i.
    CASE iv_algorithm.
      WHEN 'SHA256'.
        lv_hmac_alg = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256.
      WHEN 'SHA512'.
        lv_hmac_alg = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha512.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_hmac_custom_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unsupported HMAC algorithm: { iv_algorithm }|.
    ENDCASE.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
          if_algorithm = lv_hmac_alg
          if_key       = lv_key_x
        ).

        lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
          EXPORTING
            if_data = lv_message_x
          IMPORTING
            ef_hmac = DATA(lv_hmac_x)
        ).

        rv_hmac_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hmac_x ).

      CATCH cx_abap_hmac_error INTO DATA(lx_hmac_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_hmac_custom_error
          EXPORTING
            text     = 'Error during HMAC calculation'
            previous = lx_hmac_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
