Instructions: Berechnen Sie den HMAC für eine Liste von Nachrichten und geben Sie die Ergebnisse als interne Tabelle zurück. Nutzen Sie dabei eine `FOR`-Expression mit `LET` für lokale Variablen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `LET` und `cl_abap_hmac` für eine funktionale Verarbeitung der Nachrichtenliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_list_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_hmac,
             message TYPE string,
             hmac_hex TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message_hmac.
    TYPES: tt_message_hmac TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message_hmac WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_hmacs_for_list
      IMPORTING
        it_messages TYPE string_table
        iv_key      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hmacs) TYPE tt_message_hmac
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_list_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmacs_for_list.
    DATA(lv_key_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( iv_key ).

    rt_hmacs = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_message IN it_messages
      LET lv_message_x = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->u_to_x_string( lv_message )
          lo_hmac      = cl_abap_hmac=>create( if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256 if_key = lv_key_x )
          lv_hmac_x    = VALUE xstring( )
      IN
      ( message = lv_message
        hmac_hex = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ''
          FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > 1
          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN i = 1 THEN
            lo_hmac->calculate_hmac( EXPORTING if_data = lv_message_x IMPORTING ef_hmac = lv_hmac_x ).
            cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hmac_x )
          ELSE s ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( 'Message 1' )

    ).

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-message exp = 'Message 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_results[ 1 ]-hmac_hex ).

explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR`-Expression mit `LET` ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb der Expression, was den Code modularer und lesbarer macht. Die verschachtelte `REDUCE`-Expression wird hier verwendet, um den `calculate_hmac` Aufruf zu integrieren, da dieser einen `IMPORTING` Parameter hat und nicht direkt in `FOR` als funktionaler Ausdruck verwendet werden kann. Dies demonstriert fortgeschrittene funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: FOR, LET, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, HMAC, cl_abap_hmac

CLASS zcl_app_create DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    METHODS create_new_appointment
      IMPORTING
        iv_subject TYPE string
        iv_start   TYPE timestampl
        iv_end     TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_appointment_id) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS zcl_app_create IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_start_ts) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = sy-tstmpl days = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_end_ts) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = lv_start_ts seconds = 3600 ). " 1 hour later

        iv_subject = 'Meeting mit Team'

        iv_end     = lv_end_ts
    ).

    DATA(ls_appointment_data) = VALUE cl_appointment=>ty_s_appointment_data(
        subject = iv_subject

Instructions: Suchen Sie einen Termin anhand seiner ID und aktualisieren Sie dessen Status. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine Liste von Termin-IDs zu verarbeiten und deren Status zu ändern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_APPOINTMENT=>GET_APPOINTMENT_BY_ID` und die Instanzmethode `SET_STATUS`. `REDUCE` kann verwendet werden, um eine Liste von IDs zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_update DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    METHODS update_appointment_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_appointment_id TYPE string
        iv_new_status     TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS update_multiple_appointment_status
      IMPORTING
        it_appointment_ids TYPE string_table
        iv_new_status      TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count_updated) TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_app_update IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    " Create a dummy appointment for testing
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_app_create( ).
    DATA(lv_start_ts) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = sy-tstmpl days = 3 ).
    DATA(lv_end_ts) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = lv_start_ts seconds = 3600 ).
    DATA(lv_app_id1) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment( iv_subject = 'Update Me 1' iv_start = lv_start_ts iv_end = lv_end_ts ).
    DATA(lv_app_id2) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment( iv_subject = 'Update Me 2' iv_start = lv_start_ts iv_end = lv_end_ts ).

    IF lv_app_id1 IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_app_id2 IS NOT INITIAL.
      out->write( |Termin { lv_app_id1 } Status ändern zu '02' (In Bearbeitung)...| ).
      DATA(lb_success) = update_appointment_status( iv_appointment_id = lv_app_id1 iv_new_status = '02' ).
      IF lb_success = abap_true.
        out->write( |Status erfolgreich geändert für { lv_app_id1 }.| ).
      ELSE.
        out->write( |Fehler beim Ändern des Status für { lv_app_id1 }.| ).
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_ids) = VALUE string_table( ( lv_app_id1 ) ( lv_app_id2 ) ).
      out->write( |Ändere Status für mehrere Termine zu '03' (Abgeschlossen)...| ).
      DATA(lv_updated_count) = update_multiple_appointment_status( it_appointment_ids = lt_ids iv_new_status = '03' ).
      out->write( |{ lv_updated_count } Termine aktualisiert.| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Fehler beim Erstellen von Testterminen.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_appointment_status.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>get_appointment_by_id( iv_appointment_id ).
        lo_appointment->set_status( iv_new_status ).
        " In a real scenario, you'd also call lo_appointment->save( ) and COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_app_error).
        out->write( |Error updating appointment { iv_appointment_id }: { lx_app_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_multiple_appointment_status.
    rv_count_updated = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                 FOR lv_id IN it_appointment_ids
                                 WHERE ( lv_id IS NOT INITIAL )
                                 NEXT count = COND #( WHEN update_appointment_status( lv_id iv_new_status ) = abap_true THEN count + 1 ELSE count ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_multiple_appointment_status( it_appointment_ids = lt_ids iv_new_status = '03' ).

    " Verify status of one updated appointment

CLASS zcl_app_delete IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Terminen. Gruppieren Sie diese Termine nach ihrem Startdatum und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jedes Datum die Anzahl der Termine und eine Liste der Betreffs enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` und `VALUE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_group_by DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_grouped_appointment,
        appointment_date TYPE d,
        count            TYPE i,
        subjects         TYPE string_table,
      END OF ty_s_grouped_appointment,
      ty_t_grouped_appointment TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_grouped_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_t_appointment_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_apps) TYPE ty_t_grouped_appointment.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_app_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_test_appointments) = VALUE cl_appointment=>ty_t_appointment_data(
        ( subject = 'Meeting A' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( sy-datum '090000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( sy-datum '100000' ) )
        ( subject = 'Meeting B' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( sy-datum '110000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( sy-datum '120000' ) )
        ( subject = 'Meeting C' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( ( sy-datum + 1 ) '090000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( ( sy-datum + 1 ) '100000' ) )
        ( subject = 'Meeting D' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( sy-datum '140000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( sy-datum '150000' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_grouped) = group_appointments_by_date( lt_test_appointments ).

    out->write( |Gruppierte Termine:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_grouped).
      out->write( |Datum: { ls_grouped-appointment_date }, Anzahl: { ls_grouped-count }| ).
      LOOP AT ls_grouped-subjects INTO DATA(lv_subject).
        out->write( |  - { lv_subject }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD group_appointments_by_date.
    rt_grouped_apps = VALUE #(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_app IN it_appointments
        GROUP BY ( appointment_date = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_tstmp( ls_app-start_timestamp ) )
        ASCENDING
        " ( key = appointment_date ) " Optional: if you want to name the group key
        " ( appointment_date = GROUP KEY ) " This is the implicit way
        (
            appointment_date = GROUP KEY
            count = GROUP SIZE
            subjects = VALUE string_table( FOR member IN GROUP ( member-subject ) )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_appointments_by_date( lt_test_appointments_full ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 groups (dates)' ).

    " Check first group (lv_date1)
    DATA(ls_group1) = lt_grouped[ 1 ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = ls_group1-subjects needle = 'Meeting X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = ls_group1-subjects needle = 'Meeting Y' ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen (Fluent Interface) zur Konfiguration und Erstellung eines Termins. Da `CL_APPOINTMENT` selbst keine Fluent Interface bietet, erstellen Sie eine Wrapper-Klasse, die dies ermöglicht.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Builder-Klasse, deren Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um Verkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_builder DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS with_subject
      IMPORTING
        iv_subject TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_app_builder.
    METHODS with_start_end
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_ts TYPE timestampl
        iv_end_ts   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_app_builder.
    METHODS build_and_create
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_appointment_id) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_appointment_data TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_s_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_app_builder IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_start_ts) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = sy-tstmpl days = 8 ).
    DATA(lv_end_ts) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = lv_start_ts seconds = 3600 ).

    DATA(lv_app_id) = NEW zcl_app_builder( )->with_subject( 'Fluent Interface Demo'
                                        )->with_start_end( iv_start_ts
                                                            iv_end_ts
                                        )->build_and_create( ).

    out->write( |Termin über Fluent Interface erstellt mit ID: { lv_app_id }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    ms_appointment_data-type = '01'. " Default type
    ms_appointment_data-status = '01'. " Default status
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD with_subject.
    ms_appointment_data-subject = iv_subject.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD with_start_end.
    ms_appointment_data-start_timestamp = iv_start_ts.
    ms_appointment_data-end_timestamp = iv_end_ts.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_and_create.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>create_appointment( ms_appointment_data ).
        rv_appointment_id = lo_appointment->get_id( ).
        " In a real scenario, you'd also call lo_appointment->save( ) and COMMIT WORK.
      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_app_error).
        rv_appointment_id = |Error: { lx_app_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_type_desc DEFINITION

CLASS zcl_app_type_desc IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_type

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen hat, unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die feldnamenbasierte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapping DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_source,
        id      TYPE string,
        subject TYPE string,
        start_date TYPE d,
        start_time TYPE t,
      END OF ty_s_source,
      BEGIN OF ty_s_target,
        appointment_id TYPE string,
        subject        TYPE string,
        appointment_date TYPE d,
        " No start_time in target
        status         TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_status,
      END OF ty_s_target.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_s_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_s_target.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_data_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE ty_s_source(
        id = 'APP_001'
        subject = 'Projektbesprechung'
        start_date = sy-datum
        start_time = '100000'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = map_data( ls_source ).

    out->write( |Original Subject: { ls_source-subject }| ).
    out->write( |Mapped Subject: { ls_target-subject }| ).
    out->write( |Mapped Date: { ls_target-appointment_date }| ).
    out->write( |Mapped Status: { ls_target-status }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING appointment_id = id
                                             appointment_date = start_date ).
    rs_target-status = '01'. " Set default status as it's not in source
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_mapping( ).

    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 10.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapping=>ty_s_source(
        id = 'TEST_ID_123'
        subject = 'Test Subject for Mapping'
        start_date = lv_test_date
        start_time = '153000'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-appointment_id exp = 'TEST_ID_123' msg = 'ID mapping incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-subject exp = 'Test Subject for Mapping' msg = 'Subject mapping incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-appointment_date exp = lv_test_date msg = 'Date mapping incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = '01' msg = 'Default status incorrect' ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der ein Datum enthält, in ein echtes Datum (`d`) und umgekehrt, unter Verwendung des `CONV`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONV` für die Typkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_operator DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    METHODS string_to_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d.
    METHODS date_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date_string) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_conv_operator IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_date_str) = '20251206'.
    DATA(lv_date) = string_to_date( lv_date_str ).
    out->write( |String '{ lv_date_str }' konvertiert zu Datum: { lv_date }| ).

    DATA(lv_new_date) = sy-datum + 10.
    DATA(lv_new_date_str) = date_to_string( lv_new_date ).
    out->write( |Datum '{ lv_new_date }' konvertiert zu String: { lv_new_date_str }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD string_to_date.
    TRY.
        rv_date = CONV d( iv_date_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        out->write( |Fehler bei Konvertierung von String '{ iv_date_string }' zu Datum: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        CLEAR rv_date.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD date_to_string.
    rv_date_string = CONV string( iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Termin in einer internen Tabelle existiert und geben Sie dessen Index zurück, falls vorhanden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` für effiziente Prüfungen und Indexermittlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_line_ops DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_appointment_simple,
        id      TYPE string,
        subject TYPE string,
      END OF ty_s_appointment_simple,
      ty_t_appointment_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_appointment_simple WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS check_and_get_index
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE ty_t_appointment_simple
        iv_id           TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_itab_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_apps) = VALUE ty_t_appointment_simple(
        ( id = 'A001' subject = 'Meeting Alpha' )
        ( id = 'A002' subject = 'Meeting Beta' )
        ( id = 'A003' subject = 'Meeting Gamma' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_index1) = check_and_get_index( it_appointments = lt_apps iv_id = 'A002' ).
    IF lv_index1 > 0.
      out->write( |Termin 'A002' gefunden an Index: { lv_index1 }| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Termin 'A002' nicht gefunden.| ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_index2) = check_and_get_index( it_appointments = lt_apps iv_id = 'A005' ).
    IF lv_index2 > 0.
      out->write( |Termin 'A005' gefunden an Index: { lv_index2 }| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Termin 'A005' nicht gefunden.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( it_appointments[ id = iv_id ] ).
      rv_index = LINE_INDEX( it_appointments[ id = iv_id ] ).
    ELSE.
      rv_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_and_get_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_and_get_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_line_ops( ).

    DATA(lt_test_apps) = VALUE zcl_itab_line_ops=>ty_t_appointment_simple(
        ( id = 'X001' subject = 'Test App 1' )
        ( id = 'X002' subject = 'Test App 2' )
        ( id = 'X003' subject = 'Test App 3' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_index) = lo_cut->check_and_get_index( it_appointments = lt_test_apps iv_id = 'X002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 2 msg = 'Index for X002 should be 2' ).

    lv_index = lo_cut->check_and_get_index( it_appointments = lt_test_apps iv_id = 'X001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 1 msg = 'Index for X001 should be 1' ).

    lv_index = lo_cut->check_and_get_index( it_appointments = lt_test_apps iv_id = 'X004' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 msg = 'Non-existent ID should return 0' ).

    " Test with empty table

explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` sind funktionale Operatoren, die eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit bieten, das Vorhandensein von Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu prüfen und deren Index zu ermitteln, ohne explizite `READ TABLE`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme mit dem `THROW`-Ausdruck auslöst, wenn eine ungültige Eingabe erkannt wird.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse und verwenden Sie `THROW cx_your_exception( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_appointment_data DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  INHERITING FROM cx_static_check
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA:
      invalid_field TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid        LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous      LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        invalid_field TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcx_invalid_appointment_data IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->invalid_field = invalid_field.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_throw_exception DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    METHODS validate_appointment_subject
      IMPORTING
        iv_subject TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_appointment_data.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_throw_exception IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TRY.
        validate_appointment_subject( 'Valid Subject' ).
        out->write( |'Valid Subject' ist gültig.| ).

        validate_appointment_subject( '' ).
        out->write( |Dies sollte nicht erreicht werden.| ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_appointment_data INTO DATA(lx_invalid).
        out->write( |Fehler: { lx_invalid->get_text( ) } (Feld: { lx_invalid->invalid_field })| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        out->write( |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_appointment_subject.
    IF iv_subject IS INITIAL.
      THROW zcx_invalid_appointment_data( invalid_field = 'Subject'
                                          textid = zcx_invalid_appointment_data=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Musters in einem String durch einen anderen String, wobei das Muster ein regulärer Ausdruck ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_replace DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    METHODS replace_regex_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_pattern      TYPE string
        iv_replacement  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_str_regex_replace IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_text) = `Der Termin ist am 2025-12-06 und ein weiterer am 2026-01-15.`.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}`. " Matches YYYY-MM-DD
    DATA(lv_replacement) = `[DATUM]`.

    DATA(lv_result) = replace_regex_pattern(
        iv_input_string = lv_text
        iv_pattern      = lv_pattern
        iv_replacement  = lv_replacement
    ).
    out->write( |Original: { lv_text }| ).
    out->write( |Ersetzt: { lv_result }| ).

    DATA(lv_text2) = `Email: test@example.com, Support: support@domain.org`.
    DATA(lv_pattern2) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b`. " Matches email addresses
    DATA(lv_replacement2) = `[EMAIL_ANONYM]`.
    DATA(lv_result2) = replace_regex_pattern(
        iv_input_string = lv_text2
        iv_pattern      = lv_pattern2
        iv_replacement  = lv_replacement2
    ).
    out->write( |Original: { lv_text2 }| ).
    out->write( |Ersetzt: { lv_result2 }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_regex_pattern.
    rv_output_string = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX iv_pattern IN rv_output_string WITH iv_replacement.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_replace_regex_pattern FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_regex_pattern.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_regex_replace( ).

    DATA(lv_input) = `Hello 123 World 456`.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+`. " Matches one or more digits
    DATA(lv_replacement) = `NUM`.
    DATA(lv_expected) = `Hello NUM World NUM`.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->replace_regex_pattern( lv_input lv_pattern lv_replacement ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Digit replacement failed' ).

    lv_input = `apple, banana; cherry`.
    lv_pattern = `[;,]\s*`. " Matches comma or semicolon followed by optional space
    lv_replacement = ` | `.
    lv_expected = `apple | banana | cherry`.
    lv_actual = lo_cut->replace_regex_pattern( lv_input lv_pattern lv_replacement ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Punctuation replacement failed' ).

    lv_input = `NoMatchHere`.
    lv_pattern = `\d+`.
    lv_replacement = `NUM`.
    lv_expected = `NoMatchHere`.
    lv_actual = lo_cut->replace_regex_pattern( lv_input lv_pattern lv_replacement ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Terminen nach einem bestimmten Status und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Betreffs und Startdaten der gefilterten Termine enthält. Verwenden Sie `COND` um einen Standardbetreff zu setzen, falls der Originalbetreff leer ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... WHERE` mit `VALUE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_filter_map DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_filtered_app,
        subject    TYPE string,
        start_date TYPE d,
      END OF ty_s_filtered_app,
      ty_t_filtered_app TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_filtered_app WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_map_appointments
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_t_appointment_data
        iv_status       TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_apps) TYPE ty_t_filtered_app.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_app_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = lv_today + 1.

    DATA(lt_test_appointments) = VALUE cl_appointment=>ty_t_appointment_data(
        ( subject = 'Planned Meeting' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_today '090000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_today '100000' ) status = '01' )
        ( subject = 'In Progress Call' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_today '110000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_today '120000' ) status = '02' )
        ( subject = '' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_tomorrow '090000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_tomorrow '100000' ) status = '01' ) " Empty subject
        ( subject = 'Completed Task' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_tomorrow '140000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_tomorrow '150000' ) status = '03' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = filter_and_map_appointments(
        it_appointments = lt_test_appointments
        iv_status       = '01'
    ).

    out->write( |Gefilterte und gemappte Termine (Status '01'):| ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_filtered).
      out->write( |Betreff: { ls_filtered-subject }, Datum: { ls_filtered-start_date }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_and_map_appointments.
    rt_filtered_apps = VALUE #(
        FOR ls_app IN it_appointments
        WHERE ( status = iv_status )
        (
            subject = COND string( WHEN ls_app-subject IS INITIAL THEN 'Kein Betreff' ELSE ls_app-subject )
            start_date = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_tstmp( ls_app-start_timestamp )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_map_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_map_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_filter_map( ).

    DATA(lv_date1) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_date2) = sy-datum + 1.

    DATA(lt_test_appointments) = VALUE cl_appointment=>ty_t_appointment_data(
        ( subject = 'Planned A' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date1 '090000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date1 '100000' ) status = '01' )
        ( subject = 'In Progress B' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date1 '110000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date1 '120000' ) status = '02' )
        ( subject = '' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date2 '090000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date2 '100000' ) status = '01' ) " Empty subject
        ( subject = 'Planned C' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date2 '140000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date2 '150000' ) status = '01' )
        ( subject = 'Completed D' start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date2 '160000' ) end_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time( lv_date2 '170000' ) status = '03' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_and_map_appointments(
        it_appointments = lt_test_appointments
        iv_status       = '01'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should find 3 appointments with status 01' ).

    DATA(ls_app1) = lt_filtered[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_app1-subject exp = 'Planned A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_app1-start_date exp = lv_date1 ).

    DATA(ls_app2) = lt_filtered[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_app2-subject exp = 'Kein Betreff' msg = 'Empty subject should be replaced' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_app2-start_date exp = lv_date2 ).

    DATA(ls_app3) = lt_filtered[ 3 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_app3-subject exp = 'Planned C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_app3-start_date exp = lv_date2 ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_none) = lo_cut->filter_and_map_appointments(
        it_appointments = lt_test_appointments
        iv_status       = '99' " Non-existent status
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_none msg = 'Should find no appointments for non-existent status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR ... WHERE` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen in einem einzigen Schritt. `COND` wird verwendet, um konditional Werte zuzuweisen, was den Code kompakter macht als eine `IF`-Anweisung.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, VALUE, COND, Filtering, Mapping

CLASS zcl_ctx_user_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ctx_user_case IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_user) = lo_context_info->get_user_name( ).

    rv_message = CASE lv_user.
                   WHEN 'DEVELOPER1' THEN 'Welcome, Developer1!'
                   WHEN 'ADMIN'      THEN 'Administrator access granted.'
                   WHEN sy-uname     THEN 'Hello, current user!' " Dynamic check for current user
                   WHEN OTHERS       THEN 'Access denied.'
                 END CASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_user) = lo_context_info->get_user_name( ).

    IF lv_user = 'DEVELOPER1'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Welcome, Developer1!' ).
    ELSE IF lv_user = 'ADMIN'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Administrator access granted.' ).
    ELSE IF lv_user = sy-uname.

Instructions: Sammeln Sie verschiedene Kontextinformationen (Benutzer, System, Mandant, Programm, Transaktion, Datum, Zeit, Sprache, Verarbeitungsmodus) in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie `VALUE` für die Initialisierung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ctx_log_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_context_log,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_context_log.
    TYPES: tt_context_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_context_log WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_context_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_context_log) TYPE tt_context_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctx_log_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_context_log.
    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).

    rt_context_log = VALUE #( 
      ( field_name = 'User Name'        field_value = lo_context_info->get_user_name( ) )
      ( field_name = 'System ID'        field_value = lo_context_info->get_system_id( ) )
      ( field_name = 'Client'           field_value = lo_context_info->get_client( ) )
      ( field_name = 'Program Name'     field_value = lo_context_info->get_program_name( ) )
      ( field_name = 'Transaction Code' field_value = lo_context_info->get_transaction_code( ) )
      ( field_name = 'System Date'      field_value = |{ lo_context_info->get_system_date() DATE = ISO }| )
      ( field_name = 'System Time'      field_value = |{ lo_context_info->get_system_time() TIME = ISO }| )
      ( field_name = 'Language'         field_value = lo_context_info->get_language( ) )
      ( field_name = 'Processing Mode'  field_value = COND #( WHEN lo_context_info->is_dialog_processing() THEN 'DIALOG' ELSE 'BACKGROUND' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_context_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ctx_log_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_context_log( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 9
      msg = 'Internal table should contain 9 entries'
    ).

    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY field_name = 'User Name' INTO DATA(ls_user_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_user_entry-field_value
      exp = lo_context_info->get_user_name()
      msg = 'User name entry should match'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY field_name = 'Processing Mode' INTO DATA(ls_mode_entry).
    DATA(lv_expected_mode) = COND #( WHEN lo_context_info->is_dialog_processing() THEN 'DIALOG' ELSE 'BACKGROUND' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_mode_entry-field_value
      exp = lv_expected_mode
      msg = 'Processing mode entry should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE`-Operator mit Zeilenkonstruktoren (`( ... )`) ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um interne Tabellen direkt zu initialisieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste aller verfügbaren Methoden der `cl_abap_context_info` Klasse zurückgibt, die mit 'GET_' beginnen. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr()` und `get_methods()` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctx_rtti_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_context_get_methods
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctx_rtti_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_context_get_methods.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( 'CL_ABAP_CONTEXT_INFO' ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    rt_method_names = FILTER #( lt_methods USING KEY name WHERE name CP 'GET_*' ).
    SORT rt_method_names BY table_line ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_context_get_methods FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_context_get_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ctx_rtti_methods( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_context_get_methods( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Method list should not be empty'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    " Check for at least one expected method
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(lv_method_name).
      IF lv_method_name = 'GET_USER_NAME'.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_found
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'GET_USER_NAME method should be found'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit `cl_abap_classdescr` und dem `FILTER`-Operator. Es ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Klassenstrukturen zur Laufzeit, hier um alle 'GET_'-Methoden der `cl_abap_context_info` Klasse zu finden. Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern.
keywords: cl_abap_context_info, RTTI, cl_abap_classdescr, get_methods, FILTER, Object Orientation, Dynamic Programming, ASSERT

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Situation, in der `cl_abap_context_info` verwendet wird, um eine kritische Aktion nur unter bestimmten Bedingungen auszuführen. Wenn die Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `ASSERT` im Unit Test.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name()` und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctx_critical_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: 
      perform_critical_action
        IMPORTING
          iv_required_user TYPE syuname
        RAISING
          zcx_not_authorized.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_not_authorized DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_not_authorized IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctx_critical_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_critical_action.
    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_user) = lo_context_info->get_user_name( ).

    IF lv_current_user <> iv_required_user.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_not_authorized(
        textid = zcx_not_authorized=>default_text
        previous = NEW cx_sy_authorization_error(
          textid = cx_sy_authorization_error=>default_text
          user = lv_current_user
          object = 'Z_CRITICAL_ACTION'
        )
      ).
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate critical action
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_critical_action_authorized FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_critical_action_not_authorized FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_critical_action_authorized.
    " This test assumes the current user is authorized
    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_user) = lo_context_info->get_user_name( ).

    TRY.
        zcl_ctx_critical_action=>perform_critical_action( iv_required_user = lv_current_user ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = abap_true
          msg = 'Critical action should succeed for authorized user'
        ).
      CATCH zcx_not_authorized.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception for authorized user' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_critical_action_not_authorized.
    " This test assumes 'ANOTHER_USER' is not the current user
    DATA(lv_required_user) = 'ANOTHER_USER'.
    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).
    IF lo_context_info->get_user_name() = lv_required_user.
      " If by chance the current user is 'ANOTHER_USER', skip this test or adjust
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Test user is unexpectedly ANOTHER_USER, cannot test unauthorized scenario' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        zcl_ctx_critical_action=>perform_critical_action( iv_required_user = lv_required_user ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for unauthorized user' ).
      CATCH zcx_not_authorized.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = abap_true
          msg = 'Expected exception for unauthorized user'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_abap_context_info` für Berechtigungsprüfungen verwendet werden kann. Bei Nichterfüllung der Bedingung wird eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme (`zcx_not_authorized`) ausgelöst. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` im Unit Test ist entscheidend, um das erwartete Ausnahmeverhalten zu überprüfen und die Robustheit des Codes zu gewährleisten.
keywords: cl_abap_context_info, get_user_name, Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, RAISE EXCEPTION, ASSERT, Error Handling, System Context, Object Orientation

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Filtern Sie diese Daten basierend auf dem aktuellen Mandanten und dem Systemdatum, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die in der Zukunft liegen. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_context_info` und den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_client()` und `get_system_date()` in Kombination mit `SELECT` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctx_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctx_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_client) = lo_context_info->get_client( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = lo_context_info->get_system_date( ).

    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all
      WHERE mandt = @lv_current_client.

    rt_future_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_all USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate > lv_current_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ctx_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    DATA(lo_context_info) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = lo_context_info->get_system_date( ).

    " Assert that all returned flights are in the future
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-fldate > lv_current_date )
        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } on { ls_flight-fldate } is not in the future|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some flights are returned (if test data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Expected some future flights to be returned'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den Zugriff auf Systemkontextinformationen (`cl_abap_context_info`) mit der Abfrage von Datenbanktabellen (`SFLIGHTS`) und dem modernen `FILTER`-Operator. Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und performante Filterung von internen Tabellen basierend auf dynamischen Kriterien, wie hier dem aktuellen Mandanten und Datum.
keywords: cl_abap_context_info, get_client, get_system_date, SFLIGHTS, FILTER, Internal Tables, System Context, ASSERT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT und fügen Sie einen neuen Eintrag mit dem VALUE-Operator hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit INSERT, um eine neue Zeile zu erstellen und einzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_value_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_value_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                    connid = iv_connid
                    fldate = iv_fldate
                    planetype = iv_planetype ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_value_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = sy-datum iv_planetype = 'A320' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE-Operator ermöglicht die kompakte Erstellung einer Struktur und deren direkte Zuweisung oder Einfügung in eine interne Tabelle, was den Code lesbarer und kürzer macht als die traditionelle Vorgehensweise mit `CLEAR` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
keywords: INSERT, VALUE, Internal Table, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere neue Flugdatensätze aus einer internen Tabelle in die Datenbanktabelle ZSFLIGHT_CUSTOM ein. Die interne Tabelle hat dabei leicht abweichende Feldnamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie INSERT ... FROM TABLE @itab CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ... um die Feldzuordnung automatisch vorzunehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_db_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_flight,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id  TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             plane_type TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_custom_flight.
    TYPES tt_custom_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_custom_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flights_to_db
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_custom_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_db_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_to_db.
    " Annahme: ZSFLIGHT_CUSTOM ist eine existierende Datenbanktabelle mit Feldern wie SFLIGHT.
    " CREATE TABLE ZSFLIGHT_CUSTOM ( CARRID VARCHAR(3), CONNID VARCHAR(4), FLDATE DATE, PLANETYPE VARCHAR(10) );
    INSERT zflight_custom FROM TABLE @it_flights CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF zflight_custom.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_db_corr( ).
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_insert_db_corr=>tt_custom_flight.

    APPEND VALUE #( airline_id = 'UA' flight_id = '0010' flight_date = sy-datum plane_type = 'B747' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( airline_id = 'AA' flight_id = '0020' flight_date = sy-datum plane_type = 'A380' ) TO lt_test_data.

    " Vor dem Test sicherstellen, dass die Einträge nicht existieren oder gelöscht werden.
    DELETE FROM zflight_custom WHERE carrid IN ('UA', 'AA').

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flights_to_db( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-dbcnt exp = 2 ).

    " Aufräumen nach dem Test
    DELETE FROM zflight_custom WHERE carrid IN ('UA', 'AA').
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klausel `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` in der `INSERT`-Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das Einfügen von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Feldnamen nicht exakt mit denen der Datenbanktabelle übereinstimmen müssen. Das System versucht, Felder mit ähnlichen Namen automatisch zuzuordnen, was den Code flexibler und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: INSERT, Database, CORRESPONDING, Internal Table

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den aktuellen UTC-Zeitstempel mit der XCO CP Time API.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>now()` um ein Zeitobjekt zu erhalten und dann `as_utc_timestamp()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_current_timestamp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_current_utc_timestamp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.

CLASS zcl_xco_current_timestamp IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_timestamp = xco_cp_time=>now()->as_utc_timestamp( ).

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_current_utc_timestamp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_current_utc_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_current_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = lo_cut->get_current_utc_timestamp( ).

    " Überprüfen, ob der Zeitstempel in einem sinnvollen Bereich liegt (z.B. nicht null und nahe der aktuellen Zeit)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_timestamp msg = 'Timestamp should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).

    DATA(lv_current_system_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_system_timestamp.

    " Der generierte Zeitstempel sollte nicht mehr als ein paar Sekunden vom Systemzeitstempel abweichen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_timestamp exp = lv_current_system_timestamp tolerance = 5 msg = 'Timestamp should be close to current system time' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die XCO CP Time API bietet eine moderne, objektorientierte Schnittstelle zur Handhabung von Datum und Uhrzeit. `xco_cp_time=>now()` liefert ein Objekt, das den aktuellen Zeitpunkt repräsentiert, von dem aus verschiedene Darstellungen (z.B. UTC-Zeitstempel) oder Manipulationen durchgeführt werden können. Dies ist flexibler und typsicherer als ältere Funktionsbausteine.
keywords: XCO, Time, Timestamp, Date/Time, API

Instructions: Berechnen Sie ein Datum, das eine bestimmte Anzahl von Tagen in der Zukunft liegt, ausgehend von einem gegebenen Startdatum, unter Verwendung der XCO CP Time API.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>create_from_date()` und `add_days()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_add_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_days_to_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_add_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_date.
    DATA(lo_time) = xco_cp_time=>create_from_date( iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lo_future_time) = lo_time->add_days( iv_days_to_add ).
    rv_future_date = lo_future_time->as_date( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_add_days( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20230101'.
    DATA(lv_days_to_add) = 10.
    DATA(lv_expected_date) = '20230111'.

    DATA(lv_future_date) = lo_cut->get_future_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_days_to_add = lv_days_to_add ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_future_date exp = lv_expected_date ).

    lv_start_date = '20231225'.
    lv_days_to_add = 7.
    lv_expected_date = '20240101'.
    lv_future_date = lo_cut->get_future_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_days_to_add = lv_days_to_add ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_future_date exp = lv_expected_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die XCO CP Time API ermöglicht eine intuitive und typsichere Datumskalkulation. Anstatt mit komplexen Funktionsbausteinen zu arbeiten, können Datumsobjekte erstellt und Methoden wie `add_days()` direkt aufgerufen werden, was den Code sauberer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.
keywords: XCO, Time, Date, Add Days, API

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile an einer bestimmten Position (Index) in eine interne Tabelle ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `INSERT ... INDEX ...` Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_at_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_item_at_index
      IMPORTING
        it_original_items TYPE tt_items
        is_new_item       TYPE ty_item
        iv_index          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_at_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_item_at_index.
    rt_modified_items = it_original_items.
    INSERT is_new_item INTO TABLE rt_modified_items INDEX iv_index.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_at_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_at_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_at_index( ).
    DATA: lt_initial_items TYPE zcl_insert_at_index=>tt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Item A' ) TO lt_initial_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Item B' ) TO lt_initial_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 text = 'Item C' ) TO lt_initial_items.

    DATA(ls_new_item) = VALUE zcl_insert_at_index=>ty_item( id = 99 text = 'New Item' ).
    DATA(lv_index) = 2.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_item_at_index( it_original_items = lt_initial_items is_new_item = ls_new_item iv_index = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-text exp = 'New Item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-id exp = 2 ). " Check if original item B shifted
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT ... INDEX ...` Syntax ist die direkte und effiziente Methode, um eine einzelne Zeile an einer spezifischen Position in einer internen Tabelle einzufügen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Reihenfolge der Elemente eine Rolle spielt und nicht nur das Anhängen am Ende der Tabelle gewünscht ist.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Table, Index

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Minuten zwischen zwei gegebenen UTC-Zeitstempeln mit der XCO CP Time API.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>create_from_timestamp()` für beide Zeitstempel und dann `get_difference_in_minutes()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_time_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_time_difference_in_minutes
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_time_difference_in_minutes.
    DATA(lo_time1) = xco_cp_time=>create_from_timestamp( iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_time2) = xco_cp_time=>create_from_timestamp( iv_timestamp2 ).
    rv_minutes = lo_time1->get_difference_in_minutes( lo_time2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_time_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_time_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_time_difference( ).

    DATA(lv_ts1) TYPE timestampl VALUE '20230101100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_ts2) TYPE timestampl VALUE '20230101103000.0000000'. " 30 minutes later
    DATA(lv_diff_minutes) = lo_cut->get_time_difference_in_minutes( iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts1 iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff_minutes exp = 30 ).

    lv_ts1 = '20230101110000.0000000'.
    lv_ts2 = '20230101100000.0000000'. " 60 minutes earlier
    lv_diff_minutes = lo_cut->get_time_difference_in_minutes( iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts1 iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff_minutes exp = -60 ).

    lv_ts1 = '20230101100000.0000000'.
    lv_ts2 = '20230101100000.0000000'. " Same timestamp
    lv_diff_minutes = lo_cut->get_time_difference_in_minutes( iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts1 iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff_minutes exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die XCO CP Time API vereinfacht die Berechnung von Zeitdifferenzen erheblich. Durch die Kapselung der Zeitpunkte in Objekten und die Bereitstellung von Methoden wie `get_difference_in_minutes()` entfallen manuelle Berechnungen und die Notwendigkeit, verschiedene Datentypen zu konvertieren, was die Codequalität und Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: XCO, Time, Difference, Timestamp, Minutes, API

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Einträge aus einer bestehenden SFLIGHT-Tabelle filtern und transformieren, und diese dann in die neue Tabelle einfügen, unter Verwendung eines FOR-Ausdrucks.
hint: Kombinieren Sie INSERT LINES OF mit einem FOR-Ausdruck, der Filter- und Mapping-Operationen enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             departure_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_summary.
    INSERT LINES OF
      ( FOR flight IN it_all_flights
        WHERE ( flight-connid > iv_min_connid )
        ( VALUE #( airline = flight-carrid
                    flight_num = flight-connid
                    departure_date = flight-fldate ) ) )
      INTO TABLE rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_expression_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_expression_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_for_expression( ).
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0005' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'B747' ) TO lt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A380' ) TO lt_sflight_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_summary( it_all_flights = lt_sflight_data iv_min_connid = '0002' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-airline exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-airline exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren von Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung. In Kombination mit `INSERT LINES OF` kann das Ergebnis direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle eingefügt werden, was den Code sehr funktional und ausdrucksstark macht und die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen reduziert.
keywords: INSERT, FOR, Internal Table, Filter, Transform, Functional Programming

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Eintrag in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierung erhalten bleibt.
hint: Bei sortierten Tabellen fügt `INSERT` den Eintrag automatisch an der korrekten Position ein, um die Sortierreihenfolge zu wahren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_flight_to_sorted_table
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_flights TYPE tt_sorted_flights
        is_new_flight      TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sorted_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_to_sorted_table.
    rt_updated_flights = it_initial_flights.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE rt_updated_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_into_sorted FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_into_sorted.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sorted_table( ).
    DATA: lt_initial_flights TYPE zcl_insert_sorted_table=>tt_sorted_flights.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0005' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.

    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted_table=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_flight_to_sorted_table( it_initial_flights = lt_initial_flights is_new_flight = ls_new_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Einfügen von Zeilen in eine sortierte interne Tabelle mit `INSERT` ist eine effiziente Methode, da das System automatisch die korrekte Position für den neuen Eintrag findet und die Sortierreihenfolge beibehält. Dies ist performanter als das Einfügen in eine Standardtabelle und anschließendes Sortieren.
keywords: INSERT, Sorted Table, Internal Table, Performance

Instructions: Formatieren Sie ein Datumsobjekt, das den aktuellen Zeitpunkt repräsentiert, in ein benutzerfreundliches String-Format (z.B. 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS') mit der XCO CP Time API.
hint: Nutzen Sie `xco_cp_time=>now()` und die Methode `format()` mit einem passenden Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_format_datetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_current_datetime
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_format_datetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_current_datetime.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = COND string( WHEN iv_pattern IS SUPPLIED AND iv_pattern IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_pattern ELSE 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' ).
    rv_formatted_string = xco_cp_time=>now()->format( iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_current_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_current_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_format_datetime( ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_default) = lo_cut->format_current_datetime( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = lv_formatted_default exp = '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}' msg = 'Default format should match YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_custom) = lo_cut->format_current_datetime( iv_pattern = 'DD.MM.YYYY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = lv_formatted_custom exp = '\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}' msg = 'Custom format should match DD.MM.YYYY' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `format()`-Methode der XCO CP Time API bietet eine flexible und lokalisierungsunabhängige Möglichkeit, Datum- und Zeitobjekte in Strings umzuwandeln. Durch die Angabe von Mustern können Entwickler das Ausgabeformat präzise steuern, ohne auf veraltete oder umständliche Konvertierungsfunktionen zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: XCO, Time, Format, String, Date/Time, API

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere für jeden Flug aus einer SFLIGHT-Tabelle und fügen Sie das Ergebnis in eine neue interne Tabelle ein, unter Verwendung von REDUCE.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Ausdruck, um die Aggregation durchzuführen, und INSERT, um das Ergebnis zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_passenger_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_passenger_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_passenger_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_passenger_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_passenger_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_passenger_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_summary.
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_passenger_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflight_data BY ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid )
      ( VALUE #( carrid = flight-carrid
                  connid = flight-connid
                  total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP flight NEXT sum = sum + <member>-seatsocc ) ) )
    ).
    INSERT LINES OF lt_grouped_flights INTO TABLE rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_reduce( ).
    DATA: lt_sflight_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflight_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflight_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0005' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_sflight_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 75 ) TO lt_sflight_test_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_passenger_summary( lt_sflight_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-total_passengers exp = 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'UA' connid = '0005' ]-total_passengers exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ]-total_passengers exp = 75 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und kompakte Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Anstatt explizite Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen zu verwenden, kann die gesamte Gruppierungs- und Aggregationslogik in einem einzigen Ausdruck formuliert werden, dessen Ergebnis dann mit `INSERT LINES OF` in die Zieltabelle eingefügt wird.
keywords: INSERT, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Table, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Zeitstempel in der Vergangenheit liegt, unter Verwendung der XCO CP Time API.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein Zeitobjekt aus dem gegebenen Zeitstempel und vergleichen Sie es mit dem aktuellen Zeitpunkt mittels `is_before()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_is_past DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_timestamp_in_past
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_past) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_is_past IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_timestamp_in_past.
    DATA(lo_given_time) = xco_cp_time=>create_from_timestamp( iv_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_current_time) = xco_cp_time=>now( ).
    rv_is_past = lo_given_time->is_before( lo_current_time ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_timestamp_in_past FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_timestamp_in_past.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_is_past( ).

    DATA(lv_past_ts) TYPE timestampl VALUE '20200101000000.0000000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_past_ts ) exp = abap_true ).

    DATA(lv_future_ts) TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_future_ts.
    lv_future_ts = lv_future_ts + ( 60 * 60 * 24 ). " One day in the future
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_future_ts ) exp = abap_false ).

    DATA(lv_current_ts) TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_ts.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_current_ts ) exp = abap_false ). " Current is not 'in the past'
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die XCO CP Time API bietet Methoden zum Vergleich von Zeitpunkten, wie z.B. `is_before()`. Dies ermöglicht eine semantisch klare und typsichere Überprüfung von Zeitbeziehungen, ohne manuelle Vergleiche von Zeitstempel-Strings oder -Zahlen, was die Fehleranfälligkeit reduziert.
keywords: XCO, Time, Timestamp, Comparison, Past, API

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_lines_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS merge_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_data
        it_target_table TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_merged_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_lines_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables.
    rt_merged_table = it_target_table.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source_table INTO TABLE rt_merged_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen Datum- und Zeit-String in ein XCO CP Time Objekt und dann in einen UTC-Zeitstempel. Der String hat ein nicht-standardisiertes Format.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>create_from_string()` mit einem passenden Muster und dann `as_utc_timestamp()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_string_to_timestamp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_utc_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_datetime_string TYPE string
        iv_pattern         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utc_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_string_to_timestamp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_utc_timestamp.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_time) = xco_cp_time=>create_from_string( iv_datetime_string = iv_datetime_string
                                                          iv_pattern         = iv_pattern ).
        rv_utc_timestamp = lo_time->as_utc_timestamp( ).
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_time_exception INTO DATA(lx_xco_time).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder Standardwert zurückgeben
        MESSAGE lx_xco_time->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_to_timestamp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_to_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_string_to_timestamp( ).

    DATA(lv_datetime_string) = '25.12.2023 14:30:00'.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = 'DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS'.
    DATA(lv_expected_timestamp) TYPE timestampl VALUE '20231225133000.0000000'. " Annahme: UTC+1 für 14:30 MEZ

    DATA(lv_utc_timestamp) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_utc_timestamp( iv_datetime_string = lv_datetime_string iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).

    " Die genaue UTC-Konvertierung hängt von der Zeitzone des Systems ab, daher ist ein direkter Vergleich schwierig.
    " Stattdessen prüfen wir, ob ein gültiger Zeitstempel zurückgegeben wird und ob er in einem erwarteten Bereich liegt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_utc_timestamp msg = 'Timestamp should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).

    " Grobe Überprüfung des Datumsanteils
    DATA(lv_date_part) TYPE sy-datum.
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_utc_timestamp TIME ZONE 'UTC' INTO DATE lv_date_part.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_date_part exp = '20231225' ).

    " Test mit ungültigem String
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_string_to_utc_timestamp( iv_datetime_string = 'invalid date' iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for invalid date string' ).
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_time_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for invalid date string' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `create_from_string()`-Methode der XCO CP Time API ist entscheidend für die Verarbeitung von Datum- und Zeit-Strings in beliebigen Formaten. Durch die Angabe eines Musters kann der String korrekt geparst und in ein typsicheres Zeitobjekt umgewandelt werden, von dem aus weitere Operationen wie die Konvertierung in einen UTC-Zeitstempel erfolgen können. Dies ist eine robuste Lösung für die Handhabung externer Datumsformate.
keywords: XCO, Time, String, Convert, Timestamp, Pattern, API

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen einzelnen Datensatz in die Datenbanktabelle ZSFLIGHT_CUSTOM ein und behandeln Sie mögliche Duplikate.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` um Duplikate abzufangen und den `sy-subrc` zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_db_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_custom,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_custom.

    METHODS insert_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_sflight_custom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_db_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_single_flight.
    INSERT zflight_custom FROM @is_flight_data ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 4. " Duplicate key
      rv_success = abap_false.
      " Optional: Loggen oder andere Fehlerbehandlung
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      " Optional: Andere Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_single_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_single_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_db_single( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_insert_db_single=>ty_sflight_custom( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'TEST' ).

    " Sicherstellen, dass der Eintrag nicht existiert
    DELETE FROM zflight_custom WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0001'.

    " Erster Insert sollte erfolgreich sein
    DATA(lv_success1) = lo_cut->insert_single_flight( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success1 exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-dbcnt exp = 1 ).

    " Zweiter Insert mit denselben Schlüsseln sollte fehlschlagen (Duplikat)
    DATA(lv_success2) = lo_cut->insert_single_flight( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success2 exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-dbcnt exp = 0 ). " sy-dbcnt ist 0, da kein neuer Eintrag hinzugefügt wurde

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM zflight_custom WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0001'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klausel `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` bei der `INSERT`-Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht es, das Einfügen von Datensätzen mit bereits existierenden Primärschlüsseln abzufangen, ohne dass ein Laufzeitfehler auftritt. Stattdessen wird `sy-subrc` auf 4 gesetzt, was eine kontrollierte Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht und den Code robuster macht.
keywords: INSERT, Database, Duplicate Keys, Error Handling

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um über die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und die Preise zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
