Instructions: Mappen Sie eine Struktur auf eine andere, wobei die Zielstruktur Felder enthält, die aus einer internen Tabelle der Quellstruktur aggregiert werden sollen.
hint: Für Aggregationen innerhalb des Mappings ist `cl_abap_corresponding` nicht direkt geeignet. Eine manuelle Aggregation vor oder nach dem Mapping ist erforderlich. Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine manuelle Aggregation vor dem Mapping.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_map_agg_manual DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        amount TYPE i,
      END OF ty_item,
      tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_source,
        header_id TYPE i,
        items TYPE tt_items,
      END OF ty_source,
      BEGIN OF ty_target,
        target_id TYPE i,
        total_amount TYPE i,
      END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_with_aggregation
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_map_agg_manual IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_aggregation.
    " Manuelle Aggregation vor dem Mapping
    DATA(lv_total_amount) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR item IN is_source-items
        NEXT sum = sum + item-amount
    ).

    " Mapping der Hauptfelder
    DATA(lo_mapper) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
        i_source_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_source )
        i_target_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( rs_target )
        )->add_mapping( iv_source = 'HEADER_ID' iv_target = 'TARGET_ID' ).

    lo_mapper->execute( EXPORTING is_source = is_source IMPORTING es_target = rs_target ).

    " Zuweisung des aggregierten Wertes
    rs_target-total_amount = lv_total_amount.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_with_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_with_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_map_agg_manual( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_dyn_map_agg_manual=>ty_source(
        header_id = 1
        items = VALUE #( ( amount = 10 ) ( amount = 20 ) ( amount = 30 ) )
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_with_aggregation( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_id exp = 1 msg = 'Header ID gemappt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-total_amount exp = 60 msg = 'Gesamtbetrag aggregiert und gemappt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, dass `cl_abap_corresponding` primär für 1:1-Feldzuordnungen konzipiert ist. Für Aggregationen (z.B. Summenbildung aus einer internen Tabelle) ist es effizienter und klarer, die Aggregation manuell mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxen wie `REDUCE` vor dem eigentlichen Mapping durchzuführen. Der aggregierte Wert wird dann dem Zielfeld zugewiesen. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster, wenn komplexe Transformationen erforderlich sind, die über einfache Feldzuordnungen hinausgehen.
keywords: Dynamic Mapping, cl_abap_corresponding, Aggregation, REDUCE, Manual Mapping

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` für die direkten Feldzuordnungen und ergänzen Sie die Zielzeilen mit weiteren Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_map_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
        id TYPE i,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_source_line,
      tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
        target_id TYPE i,
        transformed_value TYPE string,
        additional_info TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_line,
      tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_and_transform
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_table
        iv_additional_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_map_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_and_transform.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
        i_source_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source )
        i_target_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( rt_target )
        )->add_mapping( iv_source = 'ID' iv_target = 'TARGET_ID'
        )->add_mapping( iv_source = 'VALUE' iv_target = 'TRANSFORMED_VALUE' ).

    lo_mapper->execute( EXPORTING it_source = it_source IMPORTING et_target = rt_target ).

    " Ergänzung der Zielzeilen mit zusätzlichen Daten und Transformation
    LOOP AT rt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_line>).
      <fs_target_line>-transformed_value = |Transformed: { <fs_target_line>-transformed_value }|.
      <fs_target_line>-additional_info = iv_additional_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_and_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_and_transform.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_map_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_dyn_map_transform=>tt_source_table(
        ( id = 1 value = 'Data1' )
        ( id = 2 value = 'Data2' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_additional_data) = 'Extra Info'.
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_and_transform( it_source = lt_source iv_additional_data = lv_additional_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Zwei Zeilen erwartet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-target_id exp = 1 msg = 'Erste Zeile ID gemappt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-transformed_value exp = 'Transformed: Data1' msg = 'Erste Zeile Wert transformiert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-additional_info exp = 'Extra Info' msg = 'Erste Zeile zusätzliche Info gesetzt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine Kombination aus `cl_abap_corresponding` für die direkte Feldzuordnung und einer anschließenden manuellen Transformation und Ergänzung der Zieltabellenzeilen. Während `cl_abap_corresponding` effizient für 1:1-Mappings ist, können komplexere Transformationen oder das Hinzufügen von Daten, die nicht direkt aus der Quelle stammen, durch eine Schleife über die gemappte Zieltabelle erfolgen. Dies bietet maximale Flexibilität bei der Datenaufbereitung.
keywords: Dynamic Mapping, cl_abap_corresponding, Transformation, Internal Table, String Templates

Instructions: Listen Sie alle Dateien und Unterverzeichnisse in einem bestimmten Verzeichnis auf dem Applikationsserver auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `get_directory_list` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_FILE_UTILITIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dir_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_file_info,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string, " 'F' for file, 'D' for directory
      END OF ty_file_info,
      tt_file_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dir_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_directory_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_content) TYPE tt_file_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dir_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dir_content.
    DATA: lt_files TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_file_list.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_list(
          EXPORTING
            i_directory_name = iv_directory_path
          IMPORTING
            e_file_list      = lt_files
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
          APPEND VALUE ty_file_info( name = ls_file-name
                                     type = COND string( WHEN ls_file-is_directory = abap_true THEN 'D' ELSE 'F' ) ) TO rt_content.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., directory not found or no access
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_dir_content FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_dir_content_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_dir_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dir_list( ).
    DATA(lv_dir_path) = '/tmp/test_dir_list'.
    DATA(lv_file_path) = lv_dir_path && '/test_file.txt'.
    DATA(lv_subdir_path) = lv_dir_path && '/subdir'.

    " Create dummy directory and file
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_dir_path ).
    OPEN DATASET lv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER 'Content' TO lv_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path.
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_subdir_path ).

    DATA(lt_content) = lo_cut->get_dir_content( lv_dir_path ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_content[ name = 'test_file.txt' ]-name
                                         msg = 'File should be in list' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_content[ name = 'subdir' ]-name
                                         msg = 'Subdirectory should be in list' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_content[ name = 'test_file.txt' ]-type
                                      exp = 'F' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_content[ name = 'subdir' ]-type
                                      exp = 'D' ).

    " Clean up
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_file_path ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( lv_subdir_path ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( lv_dir_path ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_dir_content_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dir_list( ).
    DATA(lv_dir_path) = '/tmp/non_existent_dir_list_123'.
    DATA(lt_content) = lo_cut->get_dir_content( lv_dir_path ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_content )
                                       msg = 'Should return empty table for non-existent directory' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in ein einzelnes XSTRING, wobei jeder String durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt und das Ganze in UTF-16 (Big Endian) kodiert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ=>create_out` mit `encoding = 'UTF-16BE'` und `ENDIAN = 'BIG'` sowie `cl_abap_conv_obj=>cc_cr_lf` für Zeilenumbrüche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_to_xstring_utf16 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_to_xstring_utf16 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs> IN it_strings
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs> ELSE s && cl_abap_conv_obj=>cc_cr_lf && <fs> ) ).

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      encoding = 'UTF-16BE'
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_obj=>endian_big
    ).
    lo_conv->convert( EXPORTING in  = lv_concatenated_string
                      IMPORTING out = rv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Textdatei vom Applikationsserver in eine interne Tabelle von Strings, wobei die Datei in UTF-16 (Little Endian) kodiert ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_FILE_UTILITIES=>read_file_into_string` (oder `read_file_into_xstring` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ`) und `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ=>create_in` mit `encoding = 'UTF-16LE'` und `ENDIAN = 'LITTLE'`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_utf16_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_utf16_file_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_content) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_utf16_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_utf16_file_to_table.
    DATA: lv_xstring_content TYPE xstring,
          lv_string_content  TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_file_into_xstring(
          EXPORTING
            i_file_name = iv_file_path
          IMPORTING
            e_xstring   = lv_xstring_content
        ).

        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
          encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_obj=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv->convert( EXPORTING in  = lv_xstring_content
                          IMPORTING out = lv_string_content ).

        SPLIT lv_string_content AT cl_abap_conv_obj=>cc_cr_lf INTO TABLE rt_content.

      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities_error.
        " Handle file errors
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_obj_error.
        " Handle conversion errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_utf16_file FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existent_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_utf16_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_utf16_file( ).
    DATA(lv_file_path) = '/tmp/test_utf16le_file.txt'.
    DATA(lt_original_content) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Erste Zeile' ) ( 'Zweite Zeile mit Umlauten' ) ).

    " Create UTF-16LE file
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs> IN lt_original_content
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs> ELSE s && cl_abap_conv_obj=>cc_cr_lf && <fs> ) ).

    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_obj=>endian_little
    ).
    DATA(lx_utf16_content) TYPE xstring.
    lo_conv_out->convert( EXPORTING in  = lv_concatenated_string
                          IMPORTING out = lx_utf16_content ).

    OPEN DATASET lv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    TRANSFER lx_utf16_content TO lv_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path.

    DATA(lt_read_content) = lo_cut->read_utf16_file_to_table( lv_file_path ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_read_content )
                                      exp = lines( lt_original_content )
                                      msg = 'Number of lines should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_content[ 1 ]
                                      exp = lt_original_content[ 1 ]
                                      msg = 'First line should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_content[ 2 ]
                                      exp = lt_original_content[ 2 ]
                                      msg = 'Second line should match' ).

    DELETE DATASET lv_file_path. " Clean up
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existent_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_utf16_file( ).
    DATA(lv_file_path) = '/tmp/non_existent_utf16_file.txt'.

                                       msg = 'Should return empty table for non-existent file' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Lesen einer binären Datei mit `CL_ABAP_FILE_UTILITIES=>read_file_into_xstring` und die anschließende Dekodierung des XSTRINGs in einen ABAP-String unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ` mit spezifischem Encoding (UTF-16LE) und Endianness. Die `SPLIT` Anweisung zerlegt den String in Zeilen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das Änderungsdatum und die Änderungszeit einer Datei auf dem Applikationsserver.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `get_file_attributes` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_FILE_UTILITIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_timestamp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_attributes,
             last_modified_date TYPE d,
             last_modified_time TYPE t,
           END OF ty_file_attributes.

    METHODS get_file_modification_time
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_attributes) TYPE ty_file_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_timestamp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_file_modification_time.
    DATA: ls_attributes TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>ty_file_attributes.

    TRY.
        ls_attributes = cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_file_attributes( iv_file_path ).
        rs_attributes-last_modified_date = ls_attributes-last_modified_date.
        rs_attributes-last_modified_time = ls_attributes-last_modified_time.
      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., file not found
        CLEAR rs_attributes.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_modification_time FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_modification_time_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_modification_time.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_file_path) = '/tmp/test_file_mod_time.txt'.

    " Create and modify a dummy file
    OPEN DATASET lv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER 'Initial content' TO lv_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path.

    " Wait a bit to ensure different timestamp if modified again
    WAIT UP TO '0.001' SECONDS.

    OPEN DATASET lv_file_path FOR APPENDING IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER 'More content' TO lv_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path.

    DATA(ls_attributes) = lo_cut->get_file_modification_time( lv_file_path ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_attributes-last_modified_date
                                         msg = 'Modification date should be filled' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_attributes-last_modified_time
                                         msg = 'Modification time should be filled' ).

    " Basic check: date should be today's date
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_attributes-last_modified_date
                                      exp = sy-datum
                                      msg = 'Modification date should be current date' ).

    DELETE DATASET lv_file_path. " Clean up
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_modification_time_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_file_path) = '/tmp/non_existent_file_mod_time.txt'.
    DATA(ls_attributes) = lo_cut->get_file_modification_time( lv_file_path ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_attributes-last_modified_date
                                       msg = 'Date should be initial for non-existent file' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_attributes-last_modified_time
                                       msg = 'Time should be initial for non-existent file' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_file_attributes` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_FILE_UTILITIES` bietet eine umfassende Möglichkeit, Metadaten einer Datei abzurufen, einschließlich des Änderungsdatums und der Änderungszeit. Dies ist eine moderne und zuverlässige Methode.

Instructions: Find all email addresses in a given text and return them as a list of strings.
hint: Use `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` with a suitable regex pattern and process the `RESULTS` table using a `FOR` loop and `String Templates` for extraction.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b`.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_emails = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches
                         ( substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[ 1 ] exp = `info@example.com` ).

Instructions: Implement a division function in a class that raises a custom class-based exception if division by zero occurs.
hint: Define a local exception class inheriting from `cx_static_check` and use `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` in the method.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_dividend TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_divisor TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_dividend = iv_dividend.
    me->mv_divisor  = iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          iv_dividend = iv_dividend
          iv_divisor  = iv_divisor.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extract flight number, connection ID, and date from a log entry string using regular expressions and `SUBMATCHES`.
hint: Define a regex with capturing groups and use `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` with the `SUBMATCHES` addition.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_number TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_flight_log_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS parse_log_entry
          IMPORTING
            iv_log_entry TYPE string
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_log_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_entry.
    DATA(lv_regex) = `Flight (\w{2}\d{3}) ConnID: (\d{4}) Date: (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})`.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_log_entry
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches)
      SUBMATCHES DATA(lt_submatches).

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches INDEX INTO sy-tabix
                              LET ls_sub = lt_submatches[ sy-tabix ] IN
                              ( flight_number = ls_sub-submatch1
                                connection_id = ls_sub-submatch2
                                flight_date   = ls_sub-submatch3 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a generic processor class that can dynamically call a method of another object based on a method name provided as a string.
hint: Use `CALL METHOD` with `(lv_method_name)` and `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_operation.
  METHODS execute
    IMPORTING
      iv_value1 TYPE i
      iv_value2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_addition DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_addition IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_operation~execute.
    rv_result = iv_value1 + iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtraction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_operation~execute.
    rv_result = iv_value1 - iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_operation
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_value1     TYPE i
        iv_value2     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error. " For simplicity, using generic exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_operation.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_VALUE1'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_value1 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_VALUE2'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_value2 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_RESULT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Error calling method '{ iv_method_name }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a class with a fluent interface (method chaining) for building a query string.
hint: Each method in the chain should return `ME` (a reference to the current object).
solution:
CLASS zcl_query_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_select_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_query_builder.

    METHODS add_where_condition
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_query_builder.

    METHODS build
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_query) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_select_fields TYPE string.
    DATA mv_where_conditions TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_query_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_select_field.
    IF mv_select_fields IS INITIAL.
      mv_select_fields = iv_field.
    ELSE.
      mv_select_fields = mv_select_fields && `, ` && iv_field.
    ENDIF.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_where_condition.
    IF mv_where_conditions IS INITIAL.
      mv_where_conditions = iv_condition.
    ELSE.
      mv_where_conditions = mv_where_conditions && ` AND ` && iv_condition.
    ENDIF.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    rv_query = |SELECT { mv_select_fields } FROM some_table|.
    IF mv_where_conditions IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_query = rv_query && | WHERE { mv_where_conditions }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_only_select FOR TESTING.

                                           ->add_select_field( 'FIELD2' )

CLASS zcl_word_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_match_info,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_match_info.

      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
        iv_word     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_match_info) TYPE ty_match_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_word.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_word IN iv_sentence
      MATCH OFFSET rs_match_info-offset
      MATCH LENGTH rs_match_info-length.

      CLEAR rs_match_info.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implement a class that uses a local helper class to encapsulate complex calculation logic, demonstrating composition.
hint: Define a `PRIVATE SECTION` local class within the main class and instantiate it.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
             price    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total) TYPE decfloat16.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS lcl_price_calculator DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS calculate_item_total
          IMPORTING
            is_item TYPE ty_item
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_item_total) TYPE decfloat16.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_price_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD calculate_item_total.
        rv_item_total = is_item-quantity * is_item-price.
        " Add some complex logic, e.g., discount based on quantity
        IF is_item-quantity > 10.
          rv_item_total = rv_item_total * '0.9'. " 10% discount
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW lcl_price_calculator( ).
    rv_total = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_item IN it_items
      NEXT total = total + lo_calculator->calculate_item_total( ls_item ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Use RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) to dynamically get the attributes of a class instance and their values.
hint: Use `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` and `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>GET_COMPONENTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attributes_and_values
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attributes_and_values.
    DATA: lo_data_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE abap_compdescr_tab,
          ls_component TYPE abap_compdescr,
          lv_value_ref TYPE REF TO data,
          lv_value TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_data_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( io_object ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_data_descr.
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE io_object TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            GET REFERENCE OF <fs_value> INTO lv_value_ref.
            IF lv_value_ref IS BOUND.
              lv_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
            ELSE.
              lv_value = 'NULL'.
            ENDIF.
            APPEND VALUE ty_attribute( name = ls_component-name value = lv_value ) TO rt_attributes.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error if object is not a structure or cannot be described
        " For simplicity, return empty table
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a class with a static method that acts as a utility to convert a date from `YYYYMMDD` format to `DD.MM.YYYY` format.
hint: Use `CLASS-METHODS` for the static method and string slicing or `CONCATENATE` for formatting.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS convert_date_format
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_yyyymmdd TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date_ddmmyyyy) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_par_error. " For invalid date format
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_date_format.
    IF strlen( iv_date_yyyymmdd ) <> 8 OR NOT iv_date_yyyymmdd CO '0123456789'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_strg_par_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Invalid date format: { iv_date_yyyymmdd }. Expected YYYYMMDD.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_year)  = iv_date_yyyymmdd(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date_yyyymmdd+4(2).
    DATA(lv_day)   = iv_date_yyyymmdd+6(2).

    rv_date_ddmmyyyy = |{ lv_day }.{ lv_month }.{ lv_year }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Find and count all occurrences of a specific substring in a text, ignoring case.
hint: Use `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` with `IGNORING CASE` and check `sy-fdpos` or `lines()` of `RESULTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_substring_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_substring_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_substring_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_substring_occurrences.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_substring IN SECTION LENGTH strlen( iv_text ) OF iv_text
      IGNORING CASE
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).
    rv_count = lines( lt_matches ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiple_occurrences_case_insensitive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_occurrence FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_occurrences_case_insensitive.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_substring_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_counter->count_substring_occurrences(
      iv_text      = 'Hello world, World is a great place. WORLD!'
      iv_substring = 'world' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_occurrence.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_substring_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_counter->count_substring_occurrences(
      iv_text      = 'This is a test.'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overlapping_occurrences.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_substring_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_counter->count_substring_occurrences(
      iv_text      = 'ababab'
      iv_substring = 'aba' ).
    " FIND ALL OCCURRENCES counts non-overlapping matches by default
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filter a list of flight connections (from `sflights`) to find all flights departing from 'FRANKFURT' and group them by airline, returning a map of airline to a list of connection IDs.
hint: Use `FOR` with `FILTER` and `GROUP BY` to achieve this in a functional style.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: ty_airline_connections TYPE HASHED TABLE OF tt_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS group_flights_from_frankfurt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE ty_airline_connections.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_from_frankfurt.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE ty_airline_connections(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) )
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        TABLE = VALUE tt_flight_key( FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP
                                     ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid connid = <fs_flight>-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a class with a static factory method that returns different instances of a base class based on a configuration, demonstrating polymorphism and dependency injection principles.
hint: Use an interface for the base type, concrete classes implementing it, and a static factory method to return the interface type.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_source.
  METHODS get_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_db_data_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_source.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_data_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_source~get_data.
    " Simulate fetching data from DB
    APPEND 'Data from Database 1' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Data from Database 2' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_data_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_source.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_data_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_source~get_data.
    " Simulate fetching data from File
    APPEND 'Data from File A' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Data from File B' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_source_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_data_source
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_source) TYPE REF TO zif_data_source
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_source_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_data_source.
    CASE iv_source_type.
      WHEN 'DB'.
        ro_data_source = NEW zcl_db_data_source( ).
      WHEN 'FILE'.
        ro_data_source = NEW zcl_file_data_source( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown data source type: { iv_source_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

The `zcl_data_source_factory` provides a static method to create different concrete data source objects (`zcl_db_data_source`, `zcl_file_data_source`) based on a runtime parameter. CLASS zcl_itab_read_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        value TYPE string,

    rv_value = VALUE #( it_data[ key = iv_key ]-value OPTIONAL ).
    IF rv_value IS INITIAL. " If not found, OPTIONAL returns initial value

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flug aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Flug nicht gefunden wird, und potenzielle Datenbankfehler.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT SINGLE mit INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...) und TRY...CATCH für Datenbankausnahmen.

CLASS zcl_db_read_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
      END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      EXPORTING
        es_flight TYPE ty_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_read_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    TRY.
        SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
          FROM sflight
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @es_flight
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_found = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_found = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Textdatei zeilenweise. Behandeln Sie Fehler beim Öffnen oder Lesen der Datei mit Ausnahmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für Dateisystemausnahmen wie CX_SY_FILE_OPEN oder CX_SY_FILE_ACCESS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_read_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES string_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_text_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_content) TYPE string_tab
      RAISING
        cx_sy_file_open
        cx_sy_file_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_read_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_text_file.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    OPEN DATASET iv_filepath FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_open
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not open file { iv_filepath }|.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      TRY.
          READ DATASET iv_filepath INTO lv_line.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND lv_line TO rt_content.
          ELSEIF sy-subrc = 4. " End of file
            EXIT.
          ELSE.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access
              EXPORTING
                text = |Error reading file { iv_filepath }|.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_file_access INTO DATA(lx_access_error).
          CLOSE DATASET iv_filepath.
          RAISE EXCEPTION lx_access_error.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_filepath.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen Funktionsbaustein auf, der Ausnahmen werfen kann, und behandeln Sie diese mit TRY...CATCH anstelle von EXCEPTIONS OTHERS.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Ausnahmen des Funktionsbausteins in der CATCH-Anweisung oder fangen Sie generische Ausnahmen ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fm_call_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS call_bapi_flight_getlist
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflight_tab
      RAISING
        cx_bapi_error. " Custom exception for BAPI errors

ENDCLASS.

" Custom exception class (needs to be defined in SE24 or locally)
CLASS cx_bapi_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        text   TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_bapi_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    IF text IS NOT INITIAL.
      me->if_t100_message~t100key-msgv1 = text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fm_call_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_bapi_flight_getlist.
    DATA: lt_flight_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapisfligt,
          lt_return      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2.

    TRY.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_FLIGHT_GETLIST'
          EXPORTING
            max_rows   = iv_max_rows
          TABLES
            flight_list = lt_flight_list
            return     = lt_return.

        LOOP AT lt_return INTO DATA(ls_return) WHERE type CA 'AE'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bapi_error
            EXPORTING
              text = ls_return-message.
        ENDLOOP.

        rt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_flight_list MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid ).

      CATCH cx_bapi_error INTO DATA(lx_bapi_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_bapi_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bapi_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Dynamic call error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie nach einem Teilstring in einem gegebenen String und geben Sie dessen Startposition zurück. Wenn der Teilstring nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie -1 zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS find_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_pattern  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_offset) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_substring.
    DATA(lv_offset) = -1.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_pattern IN iv_text MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
    rv_offset = COND #( WHEN lv_offset >= 0 THEN lv_offset ELSE -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in eine Ganzzahl. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der String keine gültige Zahl darstellt, mit einer Ausnahme.
hint: Verwenden Sie den MOVE-Befehl oder eine Zuweisung in einem TRY...CATCH-Block, um CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR abzufangen.

CLASS zcl_str_to_int_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS convert_string_to_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_to_int_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_int.
    TRY.
        rv_integer = iv_string.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Berechtigungsprüfung für ein bestimmtes Objekt und Feld durch. Behandeln Sie das Ergebnis der Prüfung, ohne direkt sy-subrc zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_AUTH_CHECK.
solution:
CLASS zcl_auth_check_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS check_authorization
      IMPORTING
        iv_auth_obj TYPE auth_obj
        iv_field    TYPE auth_field
        iv_value    TYPE auth_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_authorized) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_auth_check_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_authorization.
    DATA(lo_auth_check) = NEW cl_abap_auth_check(
      i_auth_object = iv_auth_obj
    ).

    lo_auth_check->add_field(
      i_field = iv_field
      i_value = iv_value
    ).

    rv_authorized = lo_auth_check->check( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_authorized FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_not_authorized FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_authorized.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_auth_check_modern( ).
    " This test assumes the current user has S_DEVELOP authorization for ACTVT '03'.
    " In a real scenario, test users with specific roles would be used.
    DATA(lv_authorized) = lo_cut->check_authorization(
      iv_auth_obj = 'S_DEVELOP'
      iv_field    = 'ACTVT'
      iv_value    = '03'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_authorized ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_not_authorized.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_auth_check_modern( ).
    " This test assumes the current user does NOT have S_DEVELOP authorization for ACTVT '99'.
    DATA(lv_authorized) = lo_cut->check_authorization(
      iv_auth_obj = 'S_DEVELOP'
      iv_field    = 'ACTVT'
      iv_value    = '99'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_authorized ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_ABAP_AUTH_CHECK bietet eine objektorientierte und moderne Alternative zum direkten AUTHORITY-CHECK-Befehl und der anschließenden sy-subrc-Prüfung. Sie ermöglicht eine klarere Definition der zu prüfenden Berechtigungen und liefert das Ergebnis direkt als booleschen Wert, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: Authorization, Security, CL_ABAP_AUTH_CHECK, AUTHORITY-CHECK replacement, sy-subrc replacement

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle nach bestimmten Kriterien und geben Sie nur die passenden Einträge zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      ty_flight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_flight_tab
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_price.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_modern=>ty_flight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' price = 50 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_price( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_modern=>ty_flight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_price( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ist eine leistungsstarke und kompakte Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ersetzt explizite LOOP AT ... WHERE-Konstrukte und die Notwendigkeit, sy-subrc zu prüfen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Conditional Logic, sy-subrc replacement

Instructions: Eine Methode soll eine Operation durchführen, die fehlschlagen kann. Kommunizieren Sie den Fehler durch das Werfen einer klassenbasierten Ausnahme anstatt einen Rückgabeparameter oder sy-subrc zu verwenden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahmeklasse und verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_risky_operation_failed.
ENDCLASS.

" Custom exception class
CLASS zcx_risky_operation_failed DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE if_abap_behv_message~previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_risky_operation_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_risky_operation_failed
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_risky_operation_failed=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate successful operation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_operation_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_fail EXPECTING ZCX_RISKY_OPERATION_FAILED.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_error_handling( ).
    lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'No exception expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_error_handling( ).
    lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( -5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: In der objektorientierten Programmierung ist das Werfen von klassenbasierten Ausnahmen der bevorzugte Weg, um Fehlerzustände aus Methoden zu kommunizieren. Dies ist wesentlich sauberer und expliziter als die Verwendung von Rückgabeparametern oder der globalen Variablen sy-subrc, da es den Aufrufer zwingt, den Fehler zu behandeln (TRY...CATCH).
keywords: Object Orientation, Error Handling, Class-based Exceptions, RAISE EXCEPTION, sy-subrc replacement

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Dies ersetzt die veraltete MESSAGE ... RAISING-Syntax und ermöglicht eine konsistente, strukturierte und objektorientierte Fehlerbehandlung im gesamten System.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung. Verwenden Sie eine moderne Syntax, die IF-Anweisungen und sy-subrc-Prüfungen vermeidet.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie eine moderne Syntax, die explizite Schleifen und Zwischenvariablen minimiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      ty_flight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_operator_modern=>ty_flight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' price = 50 )

explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck. Er ersetzt explizite LOOP-Anweisungen mit manueller Summenbildung und macht den Code deutlich kompakter und ausdrucksstärker, ohne dass sy-subrc-Prüfungen für Schleifenenden oder Fehler erforderlich sind.
keywords: Grouping, Aggregation, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, sy-subrc replacement

Instructions: Iteriere über eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (ähnlich SFLIGHT) und erhöhe den Preis jedes Flugs um einen bestimmten Faktor. Nutze dabei ein Field-Symbol für den direkten Zugriff auf die Zeilen.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_name>)` für die effiziente Bearbeitung von Tabellenzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_loop_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_factor   TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_loop_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_prices.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights. " Kopiere die Eingabetabelle

    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * iv_factor.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fsy_loop_modify=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '200.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_loop_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_modified_sflights) = lo_cut->modify_prices( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_factor = '1.1' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'Price of first flight should be 110.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-price exp = '220.00' msg = 'Price of second flight should be 220.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_name>)` ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung von Tabellenzeilen, ohne dass Daten kopiert werden müssen. Dies ist effizienter als die Verwendung eines Work-Bereichs und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten `MODIFY` Anweisung.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Lese einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle (ähnlich SFLIGHT) basierend auf einem Schlüssel und greife direkt auf die Daten zu, um den Preis zurückzugeben.
hint: Nutze `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_name>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = <fs_sflight>-price.
    ELSE.
      rv_price = 0. " Nicht gefunden
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_price_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_price_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_price_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fsy_read_table=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_read_table( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
      iv_connid   = '0400'
      iv_fldate   = sy-datum
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Price should be 100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_price_not_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fsy_read_table=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_read_table( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'UA'
      iv_connid   = '0001'
      iv_fldate   = sy-datum
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = 0 msg = 'Price should be 0 for not found flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Lesen einer Tabelle mit `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf die gefundene Zeile im Speicher. Dies ist performanter als das Kopieren der Zeile in einen Work-Bereich, da keine unnötigen Datenbewegungen stattfinden.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, READ TABLE, Internal Tables, Direct Access

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird, und setze ihren Wert.
hint: Nutze `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field-symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_data     TYPE REF TO ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value    TYPE string
      RAISING cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE io_data->* TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
              message = |Conversion error for field { iv_field_name } with value { iv_value }|.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
          message = |Field { iv_field_name } not found|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle einen einfachen Baum mit `cl_gui_simple_tree` und zeige einige statische Knoten an (Wurzel und zwei Kinder).
hint: Instanziiere `cl_gui_simple_tree` und nutze `ADD_NODES` mit einer Tabelle von `t_outln_node`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_tree_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree.
    DATA: lo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA: lt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outln_node_table.
    DATA: ls_node  TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outln_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent              = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    " Wurzelknoten
    ls_node-node_key = 'ROOT'.
    ls_node-text     = 'Mein Wurzelknoten'.
    ls_node-exp_image = 'ICON_FOLDER'.
    ls_node-coll_image = 'ICON_FOLDER'.
    APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.

    " Kindknoten 1
    ls_node-node_key = 'CHILD1'.
    ls_node-relatkey = 'ROOT'.
    ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ls_node-text     = 'Erstes Kind'.
    ls_node-exp_image = 'ICON_DOCUMENT'.
    ls_node-coll_image = 'ICON_DOCUMENT'.
    APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.

    " Kindknoten 2
    ls_node-node_key = 'CHILD2'.
    ls_node-relatkey = 'ROOT'.
    ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ls_node-text     = 'Zweites Kind'.
    ls_node-exp_image = 'ICON_DOCUMENT'.
    ls_node-coll_image = 'ICON_DOCUMENT'.
    APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.

    CALL METHOD lo_tree->add_nodes
      EXPORTING
        table_structure_name = 'T_OUTLN_NODE_TABLE'
        node_table           = lt_nodes
      EXCEPTIONS
        error_in_tree        = 1
        OTHERS               = 2.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD lo_tree->set_first_visible_node
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'ROOT'.

    CALL METHOD lo_tree->expand_node
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'ROOT'.

    CALL METHOD io_container->set_visible
      EXPORTING
        visible = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeige Flugdaten aus einer internen Tabelle (ähnlich SFLIGHT) in einem `cl_gui_simple_tree` hierarchisch an (z.B. Fluggesellschaft -> Flugnummer -> Datum).
hint: Sortiere die Daten und nutze `ADD_NODES` in einer Schleife, um die Hierarchie aufzubauen. Verwende String-Templates für die Knotentexte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_tree_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflight_tree
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    DATA: lo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA: lt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outln_node_table.
    DATA: ls_node  TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outln_node.
    DATA: lv_carrid_key TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_connid_key TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_fldate_key TYPE string.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent              = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    " Flüge für hierarchische Anzeige sortieren
    SORT it_sflights BY carrid connid fldate.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight>).
      " Fluggesellschaft-Knoten
      lv_carrid_key = <fs_sflight>-carrid.
      READ TABLE lt_nodes TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY node_key = lv_carrid_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        ls_node-node_key = lv_carrid_key.
        ls_node-text     = |Fluggesellschaft: { <fs_sflight>-carrid }|.
        ls_node-exp_image = 'ICON_AIRLINE'.
        ls_node-coll_image = 'ICON_AIRLINE'.
        APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.
      ENDIF.

      " Flugnummer-Knoten
      lv_connid_key = |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }-{ <fs_sflight>-connid }|.
      READ TABLE lt_nodes TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY node_key = lv_connid_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        ls_node-node_key = lv_connid_key.
        ls_node-relatkey = lv_carrid_key.
        ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child.
        ls_node-text     = |Flugnummer: { <fs_sflight>-connid }|.
        ls_node-exp_image = 'ICON_FLIGHT'.
        ls_node-coll_image = 'ICON_FLIGHT'.
        APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.
      ENDIF.

      " Flugdatum-Knoten
      lv_fldate_key = |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }-{ <fs_sflight>-connid }-{ <fs_sflight>-fldate }|.
      ls_node-node_key = lv_fldate_key.
      ls_node-relatkey = lv_connid_key.
      ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child.
      ls_node-text     = |Datum: { <fs_sflight>-fldate DATE = USER } Preis: { <fs_sflight>-price CURRENCY = 'EUR' }|.
      ls_node-exp_image = 'ICON_DATE'.
      ls_node-coll_image = 'ICON_DATE'.
      APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.

    CALL METHOD lo_tree->add_nodes
      EXPORTING
        table_structure_name = 'T_OUTLN_NODE_TABLE'
        node_table           = lt_nodes
      EXCEPTIONS
        error_in_tree        = 1
        OTHERS               = 2.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD lo_tree->set_first_visible_node
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'LH'.

    CALL METHOD lo_tree->expand_node
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'LH'.

    CALL METHOD io_container->set_visible
      EXPORTING
        visible = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, indem du über eine bestehende Tabelle (ähnlich SFLIGHT) iterierst, nur bestimmte Felder kopierst und dabei ein Field-Symbol im `FOR`-Ausdruck verwendest.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    rt_summaries = VALUE #( " Erstelle eine neue Tabelle
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights " Iteriere über die Eingabetabelle mit Field-Symbol
      WHERE ( price > 150 ) " Beispiel-Filterbedingung
      ( " Füge eine neue Zeile zur Ergebnistabelle hinzu
        carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
        connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
        price  = <fs_sflight>-price
      )
    ).

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle (ähnlich SFLIGHT) mit dem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck und Field-Symbolen.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ... ASSIGNING <field-symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( " Aggregiere Werte
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0 " Initialisiere den Akkumulator
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights " Iteriere über die Tabelle mit Field-Symbol
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) " Filterbedingung
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price " Aggregationslogik
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle (ähnlich SFLIGHT) existiert und greife direkt darauf zu, falls ja, um seinen Status zurückzugeben.
hint: Nutze `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN` und einem Field-Symbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( it_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      ASSIGN it_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight>).
      rv_status = |Flug { <fs_sflight>-carrid } { <fs_sflight>-connid } am { <fs_sflight>-fldate DATE = USER } existiert. Preis: { <fs_sflight>-price CURRENCY = 'EUR' }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine generische interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit und greife mit Field-Symbolen auf ihre Zeilen und Komponenten zu, um einen Text zu verketten.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` für den Tabellentyp und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb einer Schleife mit Field-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_generic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_structure,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_structure.

    METHODS process_generic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data " Generischer Tabellenreferenz
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_generic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_generic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_generic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_generic_line>  TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_text_field>    TYPE string.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_generic_table>.
    IF <lt_generic_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_generic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_generic_line>.
      " Dynamischer Zugriff auf die Komponente 'TEXT'
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TEXT' OF STRUCTURE <ls_generic_line> TO <lv_text_field>.
      IF <lv_text_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_concatenated_text = |{ rv_concatenated_text }{ <lv_text_field> } |.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_concatenated_text = condense( rv_concatenated_text ). " Entferne überflüssige Leerzeichen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle einen `cl_gui_simple_tree` und implementiere die Behandlung eines Doppelklicks auf einen Knoten, um ein benutzerdefiniertes Ereignis auszulösen.
hint: Registriere einen Event-Handler für das `NODE_DOUBLE_CLICK` Ereignis der Klasse `cl_gui_simple_tree`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_tree_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS node_double_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(e_node_key) TYPE string.

    METHODS display_tree_with_events
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree_with_events.
    DATA: lt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outln_node_table.
    DATA: ls_node  TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outln_node.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent              = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    " Event-Handler registrieren
    SET HANDLER handle_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.

    " Wurzelknoten
    ls_node-node_key = 'ROOT'.
    ls_node-text     = 'Klickbarer Wurzelknoten'.
    APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.

    " Kindknoten
    ls_node-node_key = 'CHILD1'.
    ls_node-relatkey = 'ROOT'.
    ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ls_node-text     = 'Klickbares Kind'.
    APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.

    CALL METHOD mo_tree->add_nodes
      EXPORTING
        table_structure_name = 'T_OUTLN_NODE_TABLE'
        node_table           = lt_nodes
      EXCEPTIONS
        error_in_tree        = 1
        OTHERS               = 2.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD mo_tree->set_first_visible_node
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'ROOT'.

    CALL METHOD mo_tree->expand_node
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'ROOT'.

    CALL METHOD io_container->set_visible
      EXPORTING
        visible = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    " Löst ein benutzerdefiniertes Ereignis aus
    RAISE EVENT node_double_clicked EXPORTING e_node_key = node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_aunit_assert.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR lo_cut.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'DUMMY_EVENT_CONTAINER'.
        lo_cut->display_tree_with_events( lo_container ).

Instructions: Erstelle einen `cl_gui_simple_tree` und füge ein Kontextmenü hinzu, das beim Rechtsklick auf einen Knoten erscheint und Aktionen ermöglicht.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        node_key
        menu.
    METHODS handle_context_menu_selected FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu
      IMPORTING
        fcode.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mo_context_menu TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
    DATA mv_current_node_key TYPE string. " Speichert den Knotenschlüssel für die Menüauswahl

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree_with_context_menu.
    DATA: lt_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outln_node_table.
    DATA: ls_node  TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outln_node.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent              = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    " Event-Handler für Kontextmenü-Anfrage registrieren
    SET HANDLER handle_context_menu_request FOR mo_tree.

    " Wurzelknoten
    ls_node-node_key = 'ROOT'.
    ls_node-text     = 'Wurzel mit Kontextmenü'.
    APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.

    " Kindknoten
    ls_node-node_key = 'CHILD1'.
    ls_node-relatkey = 'ROOT'.
    ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ls_node-text     = 'Kind mit Kontextmenü'.
    APPEND ls_node TO lt_nodes.

    CALL METHOD mo_tree->add_nodes
      EXPORTING
        table_structure_name = 'T_OUTLN_NODE_TABLE'
        node_table           = lt_nodes
      EXCEPTIONS
        error_in_tree        = 1
        OTHERS               = 2.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD mo_tree->set_first_visible_node
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'ROOT'.

    CALL METHOD mo_tree->expand_node
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'ROOT'.

    CALL METHOD io_container->set_visible
      EXPORTING
        visible = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_request.
    mv_current_node_key = node_key. " Knotenschlüssel speichern

    " Kontextmenü erstellen
    CREATE OBJECT mo_context_menu.
    mo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SHOW_INFO' text = 'Informationen anzeigen' ).
    mo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 'DELETE_NODE' text = 'Knoten löschen' ).

    " Handler für Menüauswahl registrieren
    SET HANDLER handle_context_menu_selected FOR mo_context_menu.

    " Menü an den Baum übergeben
    menu = mo_context_menu.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_selected.
    " Löst ein benutzerdefiniertes Ereignis mit Funktionscode und Knotenschlüssel aus
    RAISE EVENT context_menu_selected EXPORTING e_fcode = fcode e_node_key = mv_current_node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
