Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen und Typen aller öffentlichen Attribute einer gegebenen Klasse. Die Lösungsklasse soll selbst öffentliche Attribute besitzen, die inspiziert werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und `get_included_components` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_attr` und `cl_abap_objectdescr=>public`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mv_public_attr1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_public_attr2 TYPE i.

    METHODS get_public_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attribute_info) TYPE tt_attribute_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_attributes.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lt_components  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component   TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>component.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
        lt_components = lo_class_descr->get_included_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          IF ls_component-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public
             AND ls_component-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_attr. "Ensure it's an attribute, not a method/event
            APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_component-name
                            type = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ) ) TO rt_attribute_info.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., class not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen und Typen aller IMPORTING-Parameter einer Methode einer gegebenen Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr`, `get_method_descr` und `get_parameters`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param_info.
    TYPES: tt_param_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_importing_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE clike
        iv_method_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_param_info) TYPE tt_param_info.

    METHODS dummy_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_param1 TYPE string
        iv_param2 TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_result TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_importing_parameters.
    DATA: lo_class_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.
    DATA: lt_parameters   TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_table.
    DATA: ls_parameter    TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( iv_method_name ).
        lt_parameters = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).

        LOOP AT lt_parameters INTO ls_parameter.
          IF ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_methdescr=>kind_importing.
            APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_parameter-name
                            type = ls_parameter-type_descr->get_name( )
                            kind = 'IMPORTING' ) TO rt_param_info.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method.
    ev_result = iv_param1 && | - | && iv_param2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie dynamisch ein Datenobjekt basierend auf einem Typnamen und weisen Sie ihm einen Wert zu. Die Methode soll einen Referenz auf das dynamisch erzeugte Objekt zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name` und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_set_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE clike
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_data.
    DATA: lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA: lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_type_descr.

        " Assign value dynamically based on type
        CASE lo_type_descr->kind.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_elem.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
            ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              TRY.
                  <fs_data> = iv_value.
                CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                  " Handle conversion error
              ENDTRY.
            ENDIF.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Handle other types if necessary, e.g., structures, tables
        ENDCASE.

        ro_data_ref = lr_data.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., type not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Spaltennamen und deren Typen einer gegebenen internen Tabelle. Die Methode soll eine Referenz auf die interne Tabelle als Eingabe erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_by_data_ref` und `get_table_line_type` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_structdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_column_info.
    TYPES: tt_column_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_columns
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_info) TYPE tt_column_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_columns.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data_ref( ir_table_data ).
        lo_line_descr  ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_component-name
                          type = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ) ) TO rt_column_info.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_type_compatible.
    DATA: lo_data_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA: lo_target_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    TRY.
        lo_data_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data_ref( ir_data_ref ).
        lo_target_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( iv_type_name ).

        rv_is_compatible = lo_data_type_descr->is_compatible( lo_target_type_descr ).

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        rv_is_compatible = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_attr_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string

    CLASS zcl_test_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA: lo_object_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_objectdescr.
    DATA: lr_data_ref    TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_object_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_object_ref( io_object ).
        lo_class_descr ?= lo_object_descr.

        " Get reference to the attribute
        lr_data_ref = lo_class_descr->get_attribute_descr(
            p_name = iv_attribute_name
        )->get_data_ref( io_object ).

        ASSIGN lr_data_ref->* TO <fs_any>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <fs_any>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., attribute not found or object is initial
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Attributnamen und einem Wert filtert. Die Methode soll eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Zeilen zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr` und Field-Symbols für den dynamischen Zugriff und `FOR` mit `COND` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_by_attribute
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_attribute_name   TYPE string
        iv_filter_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_filtered_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_by_attribute.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lr_filtered_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_attribute>    TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_filtered_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data_ref( ir_source_table_ref ).
        lo_line_descr  ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        " Create a new table of the same type
        CREATE DATA lr_filtered_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_filtered_table->* TO <fs_filtered_table>.

        ASSIGN ir_source_table_ref->* TO <fs_source_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_attribute_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_attribute>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              IF <fs_attribute> = iv_filter_value.
                APPEND <fs_source_line> TO <fs_filtered_table>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

        rr_filtered_table_ref = lr_filtered_table.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine Klasse eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und `get_interfaces`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_test_interface.

    METHODS implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name     TYPE clike
        iv_interface_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool.

    INTERFACE if_test_interface PUBLIC.
      METHODS dummy_method.
    ENDINTERFACE.

    CLASS zcl_implementing_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES if_test_interface.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_implementing_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD if_test_interface~dummy_method. ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_non_implementing_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_non_implementing_class IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lt_interfaces  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>interface_table.
    DATA: ls_interface   TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>interface.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
        lt_interfaces = lo_class_descr->get_interfaces( ).

        LOOP AT lt_interfaces INTO ls_interface.
          IF ls_interface-name = iv_interface_name.
            rv_implements = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., class not found
    ENDTRY.

    rv_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Attributnamen sortiert. Die Methode soll eine neue Tabelle mit den sortierten Zeilen zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr` und `SORT` mit dynamischer Angabe des Sortierfeldes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_by_attribute
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_attribute_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_sorted_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_by_attribute.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lr_sorted_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sorted_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data_ref( ir_source_table_ref ).

        " Create a new table of the same type
        CREATE DATA lr_sorted_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_sorted_table->* TO <fs_sorted_table>.

        ASSIGN ir_source_table_ref->* TO <fs_source_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_sorted_table> = <fs_source_table>.
          SORT <fs_sorted_table> BY (iv_attribute_name).
        ENDIF.

        rr_sorted_table_ref = lr_sorted_table.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
        " Handle error if attribute not found or not sortable
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft (Feld 'CARRID') aus der Tabelle 'sflight'.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_by_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_sum,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrid_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_prices_by_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_sums) TYPE tt_carrid_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_prices_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_group_sum) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                     FOR flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_sum( carrid = lv_carrid total_price = lv_group_sum ) TO rt_carrid_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_cond IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > 500 )
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING io_object     TYPE REF TO object
                iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _test_method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS _test_method_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string VALUE iv_method_name.
    DATA lv_input TYPE string.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF io_object
          RECEIVING
            rv_result = rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _test_method_a.
    rv_text = 'Method A called'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _test_method_b.
    rv_text = |Method B called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).

    " Test 1: Dynamischer Aufruf einer Methode ohne Parameter
    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = '_TEST_METHOD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_a exp = 'Method A called' msg = 'Method A should be called' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).

    " Test 2: Dynamischer Aufruf einer Methode mit Parameter (hier nicht direkt demonstriert, da CALL METHOD mit RECEIVING nur für Rückgabewert ist)
    " Für Methoden mit IMPORTING/EXPORTING Parametern müsste man dynamische Parameterübergabe mit CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR/CL_ABAP_METHdescr verwenden.
    " Hier nur ein einfacher Fall mit Rückgabewert.
    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = '_TEST_METHOD_B' ). " Dies wird fehlschlagen, da _TEST_METHOD_B einen Parameter erwartet
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error' act = lv_result_b msg = 'Method B call should result in an error due to missing parameter' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF object` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Szenarien, in denen die aufzurufende Methode erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. bei Plugin-Architekturen oder generischen Event-Handlern. Für komplexere Szenarien mit Parametern ist die Verwendung von RTTI-Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` erforderlich.
keywords: DYNAMIC, Method Call, Object Orientation, RTTI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur (z.B. mit Feldern 'FIELD1' und 'FIELD2').
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS get_table_content
      IMPORTING ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_content) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    DATA lt_field_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    " Beispiel: Felder dynamisch definieren
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )->get_handle( ). " Alle Felder als STRING
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_table_content.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_line_content TYPE string.

    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      CLEAR lv_line_content.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_line> ) ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_line_content = |{ lv_line_content }{ ls_component-name }:{ <fs_field> } |.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lv_line_content TO rt_content.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creation( ).
    DATA lt_field_names TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'FIELD1' TO lt_field_names.
    APPEND 'FIELD2' TO lt_field_names.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_field_names ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Dynamic table reference should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).

    " Test: Daten hinzufügen und auslesen
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
    IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_field1> = 'Value1'.
      <fs_field2> = 'ValueA'.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_content) = lo_cut->get_table_content( lr_dynamic_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_content ) exp = 1 msg = 'Table should contain one line' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_content[ 1 ] exp = 'FIELD1:Value1 FIELD2:ValueA ' msg = 'Content should match' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Datenobjekten, insbesondere interner Tabellen, ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das durch RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) ermöglicht wird. Dies ist entscheidend für Frameworks oder Tools, die zur Laufzeit unbekannte Datenstrukturen verarbeiten müssen.
keywords: DYNAMIC, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Internal Tables, Reflection

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise (Feld 'PRICE') aus der Tabelle 'sflight' und multipliziere das Ergebnis mit einem Faktor, alles in einer `REDUCE`-Operation.
hint: Integriere die Multiplikation direkt in die `REDUCE`-Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_factor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_with_factor
      IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE f
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_factor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_with_factor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ) * iv_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Abfrage aus, bei der sowohl die Felder als auch die `WHERE`-Bedingung dynamisch zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT (dynamic_fields) FROM ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ... WHERE (dynamic_condition)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_fields_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING iv_fields_clause TYPE string
                iv_where_clause  TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS get_table_content
      IMPORTING ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_content) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_fields_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA lv_dynamic_fields TYPE string VALUE iv_fields_clause.
    DATA lv_dynamic_where  TYPE string VALUE iv_where_clause.

    " Dynamische Tabellenerstellung für die Ergebnisse
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    DATA(lt_field_names) = cl_abap_table_utilities=>string_to_string_table( iv_fields_clause ).
    LOOP AT lt_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )->get_handle( ). " Alle Felder als STRING
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      SELECT (lv_dynamic_fields) FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> WHERE (lv_dynamic_where).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_table_content.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_line_content TYPE string.

    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      CLEAR lv_line_content.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_line> ) ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_line_content = |{ lv_line_content }{ ls_component-name }:{ <fs_field> } |.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lv_line_content TO rt_content.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'CARRID:LH' act = lt_content[ 1 ] msg = 'First line should contain CARRID:LH' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'PRICE:' act = lt_content[ 1 ] msg = 'First line should contain PRICE' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise (Feld 'PRICE') für jede Fluggesellschaft (Feld 'CARRID') und nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, unter Verwendung von `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombiniere `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_group_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_sum_date,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_sum_date.
    TYPES tt_carrid_sum_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_sum_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_prices_by_carrid_after_date
      IMPORTING iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_sums) TYPE tt_carrid_sum_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_group_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_prices_by_carrid_after_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_group_sum) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                     FOR flight IN FILTER #( GROUP ls_flight WHERE fldate > iv_date )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_sum_date( carrid = lv_carrid total_price = lv_group_sum ) TO rt_carrid_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_prices_by_carrid_after_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_prices_by_carrid_after_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_sflights_group_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 365. " Flüge vom letzten Jahr bis heute
    DATA(lt_carrid_sums) = lo_cut->get_total_prices_by_carrid_after_date( lv_test_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_carrid_sums ) msg = 'Result table should not be empty' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).

    READ TABLE lt_carrid_sums INTO DATA(ls_sum_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_sum_lh-total_price > 0 msg = 'LH total price after date should be greater than 0' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einem `FILTER`-Ausdruck innerhalb der Gruppe und `REDUCE`. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und ausdrucksstarke Datenaggregation mit Gruppierung und Filterung in einem einzigen, modernen ABAP-Statement.
keywords: SUM, REDUCE, GROUP BY, FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, wobei die Feldnamen und Werte dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit RTTI-Klassen und Feldsymbole für den Datenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_pair,
             field_name TYPE fieldname,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_pair.
    TYPES tt_data_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING it_data_to_fill TYPE tt_data_pairs
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS get_table_content
      IMPORTING ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_content) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.
    DATA lt_field_names TYPE string_table.

    " Sammle eindeutige Feldnamen für die Strukturdefinition
    LOOP AT it_data_to_fill INTO DATA(ls_data_pair).
      INSERT ls_data_pair-field_name INTO TABLE lt_field_names.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )->get_handle( ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.

      LOOP AT it_data_to_fill INTO ls_data_pair.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_data_pair-field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_field> = ls_data_pair-field_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_table_content.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_line_content TYPE string.

    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      CLEAR lv_line_content.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_line> ) ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_line_content = |{ lv_line_content }{ ls_component-name }:{ <fs_field> } |.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lv_line_content TO rt_content.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_fill( ).
    DATA lt_data_pairs TYPE zcl_dyn_table_fill=>tt_data_pairs.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_dyn_table_fill=>ty_data_pair( field_name = 'ID' field_value = '001' ) TO lt_data_pairs.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_dyn_table_fill=>ty_data_pair( field_name = 'NAME' field_value = 'Test A' ) TO lt_data_pairs.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_data_pairs ).
    DATA(lt_content) = lo_cut->get_table_content( lr_dynamic_table ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_content ) exp = 1 msg = 'Table should contain one line' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'ID:001' act = lt_content[ 1 ] msg = 'Content should contain ID:001' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'NAME:Test A' act = lt_content[ 1 ] msg = 'Content should contain NAME:Test A' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die dynamische Tabellenerstellung um das dynamische Füllen der Tabelle mit Daten. Es zeigt, wie man mit RTTI eine Struktur und Tabelle zur Laufzeit definiert und dann mit Feldsymbolen auf die dynamisch erstellten Felder zugreift, um Werte zuzuweisen. Dies ist für hochflexible Datenverarbeitungsszenarien unerlässlich.
keywords: DYNAMIC, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Internal Tables, Reflection, Field Symbol

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise (Feld 'PRICE') aus der Tabelle 'sflight', aber nur für die ersten N Einträge, wobei N dynamisch übergeben wird.
hint: Verwende `FOR ... UP TO N` in Kombination mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_upto_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_upto_n
      IMPORTING iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflights_upto_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_upto_n.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights UP TO iv_count ROWS
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_price_upto_n FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_price_upto_n.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_sflights_upto_n( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    IF lines( lt_sflights_all ) >= 2.
      DATA(lv_expected_sum_2) = lt_sflights_all[ 1 ]-price + lt_sflights_all[ 2 ]-price.
      DATA(lv_actual_sum_2) = lo_cut->get_total_price_upto_n( 2 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum_2 exp = lv_expected_sum_2 msg = 'Sum of first 2 flights should match' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum_0) = lo_cut->get_total_price_upto_n( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum_0 exp = 0 msg = 'Sum of 0 flights should be 0' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... UP TO N ROWS`-Syntax in Kombination mit `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, Aggregationen auf einer begrenzten Anzahl von Einträgen einer internen Tabelle durchzuführen. Dies ist nützlich für Paging-Funktionen oder wenn nur eine Teilmenge der Daten relevant ist.
keywords: SUM, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Limit, Aggregation

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Abfrage aus, bei der die `ORDER BY`-Klausel dynamisch zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_order_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_order_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_order_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_order_by( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    " Test 1: Sortierung nach CARRID
    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic_order( `CARRID ASCENDING` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) msg = 'Should find flights' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid LE lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid msg = 'Table should be sorted by CARRID ASC' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).

    " Test 2: Sortierung nach PRICE DESCENDING
    CLEAR lt_flights.
    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic_order( `PRICE DESCENDING` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) msg = 'Should find flights' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price GE lt_flights[ 2 ]-price msg = 'Table should be sorted by PRICE DESC' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_ua FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for LH' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should be LH' act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_ua.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for UA' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should be UA' act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_none.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( 'XX' ). " Assuming 'XX' does not exist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for non-existent carrid' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und prägnante Filterung interner Tabellen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als traditionelle LOOP-WHERE-Konstrukte.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, WHERE, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie mehrere Bedingungen im WHERE-Teil des FILTER-Operators.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_multi_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_multi_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_available_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_lh_50_free FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_ua_10_free FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lh_50_free.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_multi_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_available_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free_seats = 50 ).
    " Assuming some LH flights have >= 50 free seats in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for LH with 50 free seats' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should be LH' act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should have at least 50 free seats' act = ( <fs_flight>-seatsmax - <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) >= 50 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_ua_10_free.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_multi_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_available_flights( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_min_free_seats = 10 ).
    " Assuming some UA flights have >= 10 free seats in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for UA with 10 free seats' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should be UA' act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should have at least 10 free seats' act = ( <fs_flight>-seatsmax - <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) >= 10 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_multi_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_available_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_free_seats = 1 ). " Assuming 'XX' does not exist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for non-existent carrid' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von Bedingungen im FILTER-Operator mit logischen Operatoren (AND, OR) ermöglicht komplexe Filterungen direkt in der Deklaration der neuen Tabelle, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Multiple Conditions, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie die SFLIGHT-Tabelle nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (CONNID) und den Preis (PRICE) dieser Flüge enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER, um die Quelltabelle zu reduzieren, und anschließend FOR mit VALUE, um die gefilterten Daten in eine neue Struktur zu mappen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( connid = flight-connid, price = flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for LH' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_summary>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Connid should not be initial' act = <fs_summary>-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Price should not be initial' act = <fs_summary>-price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for non-existent carrid' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von FILTER und FOR-Ausdrücken mit VALUE ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von Daten. Zuerst wird die Quelltabelle gefiltert, und dann werden die gefilterten Zeilen in eine neue Struktur gemappt, alles in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen, deklarativen ABAP-Code.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Mapping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die SFLIGHT-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY, um Daten zu gruppieren und auf Gruppenebene zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_group_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_all INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_group_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_group_by_counts FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    " Assert specific counts if dummy data is predictable, otherwise just check structure
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_summary>).
      IF <fs_summary>-carrid = 'LH'.

      ELSEIF <fs_summary>-carrid = 'UA'.

      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    " These assertions depend on the actual data in SFLIGHT.
    " For a robust test, one would mock SFLIGHT or use a known dataset.

    IF lv_lh_count > 0.

    ENDIF.

Dies vereinfacht Aggregationen und die Verarbeitung von Gruppendaten erheblich, ohne manuelle Sortierungen oder zusätzliche Hilfstabellen zu benötigen. Die Syntax ist deklarativ und leicht verständlich.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die SFLIGHT-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe den Gesamtumsatz (PAYMENTSUM) und die durchschnittliche Auslastung (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX).
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY in Kombination mit REDUCE, um Aggregationen auf Gruppenebene durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_revenue TYPE sflight-paymentsum,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_agg_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_agg_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_carrier_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_agg_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_agg_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_carrier_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, paymentsum, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_all INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_revenue) = REDUCE sflight-paymentsum(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + member-paymentsum
      ).

      DATA(lv_total_seatsocc) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc
      ).

      DATA(lv_total_seatsmax) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax
      ).

      DATA(lv_avg_occupancy) = COND f(
        WHEN lv_total_seatsmax > 0 THEN lv_total_seatsocc / lv_total_seatsmax
        ELSE 0
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( 
        carrid        = ls_group_key-carrid
        total_revenue = lv_total_revenue
        avg_occupancy = lv_avg_occupancy
      ) TO rt_agg_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregated_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregated_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_carrier_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Check if at least one entry exists and has valid data
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Carrid should not be initial' act = ls_first_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total revenue should be non-negative' act = ls_first_entry-total_revenue >= 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Avg occupancy should be between 0 and 1' act = ls_first_entry-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_first_entry-avg_occupancy <= 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von LOOP AT ... GROUP BY mit dem REDUCE-Operator ist extrem effizient für Aggregationen. REDUCE ermöglicht es, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable durch Iteration über die Elemente einer Gruppe zu berechnen, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht. Dies ist ein Kernstück der funktionalen Programmierung in modernem ABAP.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie die SFLIGHT-Tabelle und für jeden Flug suchen Sie in einer zweiten internen Tabelle (z.B. SBOOK) nach zugehörigen Buchungen, die einen bestimmten Status haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte LOOP AT-Anweisungen mit WHERE-Klauseln für effiziente Suche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_loop_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             custtype TYPE sbook-custtype,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_bookings_by_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_booking_status TYPE sbook-custtype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_bookings) TYPE tt_flight_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_loop_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_bookings_by_status.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_sbook_all   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, bookid, custtype
      FROM sbook
      INTO TABLE @lt_sbook_all
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_all INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      LOOP AT lt_sbook_all INTO DATA(ls_booking)
           WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid
             AND connid = ls_flight-connid
             AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate
             AND custtype = iv_booking_status.
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                        connid = ls_flight-connid
                        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                        bookid = ls_booking-bookid
                        custtype = ls_booking-custtype ) TO rt_flight_bookings.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for status B' act = lt_result ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for status C' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_booking>).

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob in einer gefilterten SFLIGHT-Tabelle ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator in Kombination mit LINE_EXISTS, um die Existenz eines Eintrags zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    rv_exists = xsdbool( LINE_EXISTS( lt_filtered_flights[ connid = iv_connid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_flight_exists_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_exists_false FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists_true.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' and '0400' exist in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight LH 0400 should exist' act = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_exists_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' and '9999' do not exist in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Flight LH 9999 should not exist' act = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '9999' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_exists_wrong_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    " Assuming 'UA' and '0400' (from LH) do not exist together
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Flight UA 0400 should not exist' act = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0400' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination von FILTER und LINE_EXISTS ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um die Existenz eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, nachdem diese vorab gefiltert wurde. LINE_EXISTS ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der direkt im Code verwendet werden kann und die Notwendigkeit eines expliziten LOOPs oder READ TABLE überflüssig macht.

CLASS zcl_filter_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die SFLIGHT-Tabelle nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller dieser Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER, um die relevanten Flüge zu isolieren, und dann REDUCE, um den Gesamtpreis zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price for LH should be greater than 0' act = lv_total > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_empty_table.
    " This test would require mocking SFLIGHT or ensuring it's empty
    " For simplicity, we assume the current SFLIGHT has data.
    " A more advanced test would inject an empty table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'AA' ). " Assuming AA has no flights or is not in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price for a carrier with no flights should be 0 or initial' act = lv_total >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von FILTER und REDUCE ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, Aggregationen auf gefilterten Daten durchzuführen. Zuerst wird die Datenmenge mit FILTER auf die relevanten Einträge reduziert, und dann wird REDUCE verwendet, um eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable (hier die Summe der Preise) aus diesen gefilterten Daten zu berechnen. Dies ist ein funktionaler Ansatz, der den Code sehr kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Tabelle und geben Sie nur die ersten N Einträge aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... UP TO N ROWS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_up_to_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_n_rows      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_data.

CLASS zcl_loop_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_loop_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB

      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die SFLIGHT-Tabelle nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben, und sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Flugdatum absteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER, um die Tabelle zu filtern, und dann SORT, um die gefilterte Tabelle zu sortieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_and_sorted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_sorted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    SORT rt_flights BY fldate DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sort_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_sort_empty FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sort_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_sorted_flights( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for LH' act = lt_result ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 1.
      LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        IF sy-tabix > 1.
          DATA(lv_prev_fldate) = lt_result[ sy-tabix - 1 ]-fldate.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flights should be sorted descending by date' act = <fs_flight>-fldate <= lv_prev_fldate ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_sort_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_sorted_flights( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for non-existent carrier' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von FILTER und SORT ist ein gängiges Muster, um Daten zuerst nach bestimmten Kriterien zu selektieren und dann in einer gewünschten Reihenfolge zu präsentieren. FILTER erstellt effizient eine Teilmenge, die dann mit SORT nach den gewünschten Feldern sortiert wird. Dies ist eine klare und performante Vorgehensweise.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT enthält, deren Fluggesellschaft nicht 'LH' ist, und wandeln Sie dabei die Flugnummer in einen String um.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER mit einer Negationsbedingung und FOR mit VALUE, um die Daten zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid_str TYPE string,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights_except_lh
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights_except_lh.
    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid <> 'LH' )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid_str = CONV string( flight-connid ),
        fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA-256-Hash-Wert eines großen XSTRINGs, indem Sie es in kleineren Chunks verarbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `update` und `get_hash_value` von `cl_abap_message_digest`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_chunked DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_chunked_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_large_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sha256_hash) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_chunked IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_chunked_sha256.
    DATA(lo_sha256) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( algorithm = cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_chunk_size) TYPE i VALUE 10. " Example chunk size

    WHILE lv_offset < xstrlen( iv_large_xstring ).
      DATA(lv_chunk) = iv_large_xstring+lv_offset(lv_chunk_size).
      lo_sha256->update( lv_chunk ).
      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_sha256_hash = lo_sha256->get_hash_value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie den Hash-Wert eines Strings mit einem erwarteten Hash-Wert, um die Datenintegrität zu überprüfen.
hint: Berechnen Sie den Hash des Eingabestrings und vergleichen Sie ihn direkt mit dem erwarteten XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_string_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_expected_hash TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_string_hash.
    DATA(lo_md5) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( algorithm = cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 ).
    DATA(lv_calculated_hash) = lo_md5->calculate_hash_for_string( iv_input_string ).
    IF lv_calculated_hash = iv_expected_hash.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
         field_a TYPE string,
         field_b TYPE i,
       END OF ty_source_data.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
         b_field TYPE i,
         a_field TYPE string,
       END OF ty_target_data.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_to_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_to_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_structure.
    rs_target = CONV ty_target_data(
                  b_field = is_source-field_b
                  a_field = is_source-field_a
                ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_structure_conversion FOR TESTING.

    ls_source-field_a = 'Hello'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_struct_to_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->convert_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-a_field exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Feld A sollte korrekt konvertiert werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-b_field exp = 123 msg = 'Feld B sollte korrekt konvertiert werden.' ).

Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit mehr Kontrolle.
keywords: CONV, Structure, Type Conversion, Field Assignment

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein spezifisches Feld in einer internen Tabelle in einen anderen Typ, während Sie eine neue interne Tabelle erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Kombination aus `FOR` und `CONV` in einer Tabellenkonstruktor-Expression.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
         id    TYPE i,
         value TYPE string,
       END OF ty_source_line.
TYPES: tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
         id    TYPE i,
         value TYPE c LENGTH 10,
       END OF ty_target_line.
TYPES: tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_field
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_field.
    rt_target = VALUE tt_target_table(
                  FOR ls_source IN it_source
                  ( id = ls_source-id
                    value = CONV c LENGTH 10( ls_source-value ) )
                ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_field_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_field_conversion.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE tt_source_table.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>).
    <fs_source>-id = 1.
    <fs_source>-value = 'TestValue1'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_source>.
    <fs_source>-id = 2.
    <fs_source>-value = 'AnotherValue'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_table_field( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->convert_table_field( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'ID der ersten Zeile sollte korrekt sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = 'TestValue1' msg = 'Wert der ersten Zeile sollte korrekt konvertiert sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 msg = 'ID der zweiten Zeile sollte korrekt sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-value exp = 'AnotherVal' msg = 'Wert der zweiten Zeile sollte korrekt gekürzt konvertiert sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `FOR` Iteration und `CONV` innerhalb einer `VALUE` Tabellenkonstruktor-Expression kann eine neue interne Tabelle erzeugt werden, wobei einzelne Felder während der Zuweisung konvertiert werden. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und performante Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu transformieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: CONV, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Table Expression, Type Conversion

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Beziehung zwischen zwei generischen Objekten (dargestellt durch GUIDs) mithilfe der Klasse `CL_BINARY_RELATION`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>CREATE_LINK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_rel_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_object_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_guid_a TYPE sysuuid_c32
        iv_guid_b TYPE sysuuid_c32
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_rel_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_object_link.
    DATA: lo_object_a TYPE sibflporb,
          lo_object_b TYPE sibflporb.

    lo_object_a-instid = iv_guid_a.
    lo_object_a-typeid = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ'. " Beispiel Objekttyp
    lo_object_a-catid  = 'BO'.

    lo_object_b-instid = iv_guid_b.
    lo_object_b-typeid = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ'. " Beispiel Objekttyp
    lo_object_b-catid  = 'BO'.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle binären Beziehungen, die mit einem bestimmten generischen Objekt (GUID) verknüpft sind.

solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_rel_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_link_info,
             relation_type TYPE sibfrelat,
             target_guid   TYPE sysuuid_c32,
           END OF ty_link_info.
    TYPES: tt_link_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_link_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_object_links
      IMPORTING
        iv_guid TYPE sysuuid_c32
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_links) TYPE tt_link_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_rel_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_object_links.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE sibflporb.
    lo_object-instid = iv_guid.
    lo_object-typeid = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ'.
    lo_object-catid  = 'BO'.

    DATA: lt_raw_links TYPE sibflporbt.

    cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = lo_object
      IMPORTING
        et_links  = lt_raw_links
    ).

    rt_links = VALUE tt_link_info(
                 FOR ls_link IN lt_raw_links
                 ( relation_type = ls_link-relation
                   target_guid   = ls_link-object_b-instid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Strings in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen, wobei jeder String ein Feld der Struktur darstellt.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid TYPE s_conn_id,
       END OF ty_flight_data.
TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_list_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_strings_to_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_string_list TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_list_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings_to_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
                   FOR lv_string IN it_string_list
                   LET lv_carrid = substring( val = lv_string off = 0 len = 3 )
                       lv_connid = substring( val = lv_string off = 3 len = 4 )
                   IN
                   ( carrid = CONV s_carr_id( lv_carrid )
                     connid = CONV s_conn_id( lv_connid ) )
                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
