TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_link,
         relation_type TYPE sibfrelat,
         target_guid   TYPE sysuuid_c32,
       END OF ty_filtered_link.
TYPES: tt_filtered_links TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_link WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_binary_rel_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_links
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_guid TYPE sysuuid_c32
        iv_relation_type TYPE sibfrelat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_links) TYPE tt_filtered_links.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_rel_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_links.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE sibflporb.
    lo_object-instid = iv_source_guid.
    lo_object-typeid = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ'.
    lo_object-catid  = 'BO'.

    DATA: lt_raw_links TYPE sibflporbt.

    cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = lo_object
      IMPORTING
        et_links  = lt_raw_links
    ).

    rt_filtered_links = VALUE tt_filtered_links(
                          FOR ls_link IN lt_raw_links
                          WHERE ( relation = iv_relation_type )
                          ( relation_type = ls_link-relation
                            target_guid   = ls_link-object_b-instid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_links FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_links.
    DATA(lv_guid_a) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_guid_b) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_guid_c) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_guid_d) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).

    " Links erstellen
    DATA(lo_create) = NEW zcl_binary_rel_create( ).
    lo_create->create_object_link( iv_guid_a = lv_guid_a iv_guid_b = lv_guid_b ). " Z_LINK_TYPE
    cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      EXPORTING
        is_object_a = VALUE sibflporb( instid = lv_guid_a typeid = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ' catid = 'BO' )
        is_object_b = VALUE sibflporb( instid = lv_guid_c typeid = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ' catid = 'BO' )
        ip_relation = 'Z_ANOTHER_LINK' " Anderer Beziehungstyp
    ).
    lo_create->create_object_link( iv_guid_a = lv_guid_a iv_guid_b = lv_guid_d ). " Z_LINK_TYPE
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_rel_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_links( iv_source_guid = lv_guid_a iv_relation_type = 'Z_LINK_TYPE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Links vom Typ Z_LINK_TYPE gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered[ target_guid = lv_guid_b ] IS NOT BOUND msg = 'GUID B sollte im Ergebnis sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered[ target_guid = lv_guid_d ] IS NOT BOUND msg = 'GUID D sollte im Ergebnis sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered[ target_guid = lv_guid_c ] IS BOUND msg = 'GUID C sollte NICHT im Ergebnis sein.' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DATA(lo_delete) = NEW zcl_binary_rel_delete( ).
    lo_delete->delete_object_link( iv_guid_a = lv_guid_a iv_guid_b = lv_guid_b ).
    cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
      EXPORTING
        is_object_a = VALUE sibflporb( instid = lv_guid_a typeid = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ' catid = 'BO' )
        is_object_b = VALUE sibflporb( instid = lv_guid_c typeid = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ' catid = 'BO' )
        ip_relation = 'Z_ANOTHER_LINK'
    ).
    lo_delete->delete_object_link( iv_guid_a = lv_guid_a iv_guid_b = lv_guid_d ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>READ_LINKS` mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einem `WHERE` Zusatz innerhalb eines Tabellenkonstruktors. Dies ermöglicht das effiziente Lesen und gleichzeitige Filtern von Beziehungen nach einem bestimmten Typ. Die moderne Syntax mit `VALUE` und `FOR...WHERE` ist sehr ausdrucksstark und reduziert die Notwendigkeit von expliziten Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen, was den Code kompakter und performanter macht.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, Object Relationship, GUID, Integration, READ_LINKS, FILTER, VALUE, FOR...WHERE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Kontextmenü mit zwei Einträgen: 'Option 1' und 'Option 2'. Das Menü soll programmatisch angezeigt werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ctmenu` und die Methode `add_function`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_menu.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_menu_selection FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_menu.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'OPT1' text = 'Option 1' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'OPT2' text = 'Option 2' ).

    SET HANDLER me->handle_menu_selection FOR lo_menu.

    " In einer realen Anwendung würde das Menü an ein UI-Element gebunden sein.
    " Hier simulieren wir die Anzeige.
    MESSAGE 'Kontextmenü erstellt. Wählen Sie eine Option (simuliert).' TYPE 'I'.
    " Für einen echten Test müsste ein UI-Element vorhanden sein, das das Menü anzeigt.
    " Da dies ein reines Backend-Beispiel ist, wird die Anzeige nur simuliert.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_selection.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'OPT1'.
        MESSAGE 'Option 1 ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'OPT2'.
        MESSAGE 'Option 2 ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE 'Unbekannte Option ausgewählt!' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_menu_creation.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, dessen Einträge dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle generiert werden. Jeder Eintrag soll eine Fluggesellschaft repräsentieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` Ausdrücke, um die Menüeinträge zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_menu.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_menu_selection FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_menu.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_airline.
    DATA: lt_airlines TYPE TABLE OF ty_airline.

    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_airlines UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    LOOP AT lt_airlines INTO DATA(ls_airline).
      lo_menu->add_function( fcode = |AIR_{ ls_airline-carrid }| text = ls_airline-carrname ).
    ENDLOOP.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_menu_selection FOR lo_menu.
    MESSAGE 'Dynamisches Kontextmenü erstellt.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_selection.
    IF fcode CS 'AIR_'.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = fcode+4.
      MESSAGE |Fluggesellschaft { lv_carrid } ausgewählt!| TYPE 'S'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Unbekannte Option ausgewählt!' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_menu_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_menu_items.
    DATA(lo_menu_instance) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_airline,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_test_airline.
    DATA: lt_test_airlines TYPE TABLE OF ty_test_airline.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_airline( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' ) TO lt_test_airlines.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_airline( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' ) TO lt_test_airlines.

    LOOP AT lt_test_airlines INTO DATA(ls_test_airline).
      lo_menu_instance->add_function( fcode = |AIR_{ ls_test_airline-carrid }| text = ls_test_airline-carrname ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu_instance->get_function_text( 'AIR_LH' ) exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu_instance->get_function_text( 'AIR_AA' ) exp = 'American Airlines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von Menüeinträgen basierend auf Daten aus der Tabelle `SCARR`. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|AIR_{ ls_airline-carrid }|`) für die Funktionscodes ist eine moderne und lesbare Art der String-Manipulation. Die Schleife über die interne Tabelle zeigt eine typische Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: Context Menu, cl_ctmenu, Dynamic Menu, String Templates, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü mit Untermenüs. Das Hauptmenü soll 'Aktionen' heißen und zwei Untermenüs 'Berichte' und 'Einstellungen' enthalten. Jedes Untermenü soll eigene Einträge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `add_submenu` von `cl_ctmenu`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_submenus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_nested_menu.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_menu_selection FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_submenus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_nested_menu.
    DATA(lo_main_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    DATA(lo_reports_submenu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    DATA(lo_settings_submenu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    lo_reports_submenu->add_function( fcode = 'REP1' text = 'Flugliste' ).
    lo_reports_submenu->add_function( fcode = 'REP2' text = 'Buchungsübersicht' ).

    lo_settings_submenu->add_function( fcode = 'SET1' text = 'Benutzereinstellungen' ).
    lo_settings_submenu->add_function( fcode = 'SET2' text = 'Systemeinstellungen' ).

    lo_main_menu->add_submenu( fcode = 'REPORTS' text = 'Berichte' submenu = lo_reports_submenu ).
    lo_main_menu->add_submenu( fcode = 'SETTINGS' text = 'Einstellungen' submenu = lo_settings_submenu ).

    SET HANDLER me->handle_menu_selection FOR lo_main_menu.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_menu_selection FOR lo_reports_submenu.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_menu_selection FOR lo_settings_submenu.

    MESSAGE 'Kontextmenü mit Untermenüs erstellt.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_selection.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'REP1'.
        MESSAGE 'Bericht: Flugliste ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'REP2'.
        MESSAGE 'Bericht: Buchungsübersicht ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'SET1'.
        MESSAGE 'Einstellung: Benutzereinstellungen ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'SET2'.
        MESSAGE 'Einstellung: Systemeinstellungen ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE |Unbekannte Option '{ fcode }' ausgewählt!| TYPE 'W'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, das bestimmte Einträge basierend auf einer Bedingung aktiviert oder deaktiviert. Zum Beispiel soll eine 'Löschen'-Option nur aktiv sein, wenn ein bestimmtes Element ausgewählt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_function_enabled` oder `set_function_visible`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_cond_enable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_conditional_menu IMPORTING iv_item_selected TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_menu_selection FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_cond_enable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_conditional_menu.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'EDIT' text = 'Bearbeiten' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'DELETE' text = 'Löschen' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'VIEW' text = 'Anzeigen' ).

    IF iv_item_selected = abap_true.
      lo_menu->set_function_enabled( fcode = 'DELETE' enabled = abap_true ).
    ELSE.
      lo_menu->set_function_enabled( fcode = 'DELETE' enabled = abap_false ).
    ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_menu_selection FOR lo_menu.
    MESSAGE |Kontextmenü erstellt. Löschen ist { COND string( WHEN iv_item_selected = abap_true THEN 'aktiviert' ELSE 'deaktiviert' ) }.| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_selection.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'EDIT'.
        MESSAGE 'Bearbeiten ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'DELETE'.
        MESSAGE 'Löschen ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'VIEW'.
        MESSAGE 'Anzeigen ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE |Unbekannte Option '{ fcode }' ausgewählt!| TYPE 'W'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_enable FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_enable.
    DATA(lo_menu_instance) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu_instance->add_function( fcode = 'COND_OPT' text = 'Conditional Option' ).

    lo_menu_instance->set_function_enabled( fcode = 'COND_OPT' enabled = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu_instance->get_function_enabled( 'COND_OPT' ) exp = abap_false ).

    lo_menu_instance->set_function_enabled( fcode = 'COND_OPT' enabled = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu_instance->get_function_enabled( 'COND_OPT' ) exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Aktivierung von Menüeinträgen dynamisch gesteuert werden kann. Die Methode `set_function_enabled` von `cl_ctmenu` wird verwendet, um die 'Löschen'-Option basierend auf dem Parameter `iv_item_selected` zu aktivieren oder zu deaktivieren. Der `COND` Operator im `MESSAGE` Statement ist ein Beispiel für moderne, kompakte bedingte Logik.
keywords: Context Menu, cl_ctmenu, Conditional Logic, Enable Function, COND Operator

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flügen aus `SFLIGHT` in einem ALV-Grid an und passen Sie die Spaltenüberschriften sowie die Sichtbarkeit einer Spalte an. Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_controller_metadata` indirekt über `cl_salv_table`.
hint: Greifen Sie über `get_columns()` auf die Spalteneinstellungen zu und nutzen Sie `get_column()` und `set_long_text()` / `set_visible()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_column_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_column_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_alv.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_sflight ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).

        " Spaltenüberschriften anpassen
        lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' )->set_long_text( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' )->set_long_text( 'Flugnummer' ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'FLDATE' )->set_long_text( 'Flugdatum' ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' )->set_long_text( 'Preis' ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'CURRENCY' )->set_long_text( 'Währung' ).

        " Spalte 'PLANETYPE' unsichtbar machen
        lo_columns->get_column( 'PLANETYPE' )->set_visible( abap_false ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_column_visibility FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_column_visibility.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             col1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE TABLE OF ty_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( col1 = 'A' col2 = 1 ) TO lt_test_data.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv_test) = cl_salv_table=>factory( t_table = lt_test_data ).
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv_test->get_columns( ).

        lo_columns->get_column( 'COL2' )->set_visible( abap_false ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_columns->get_column( 'COL2' )->is_visible( ) exp = abap_false ).

        lo_columns->get_column( 'COL2' )->set_visible( abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_columns->get_column( 'COL2' )->is_visible( ) exp = abap_true ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception during ALV column configuration' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Anpassung von ALV-Spalteneigenschaften. Über `lo_alv->get_columns()` erhält man Zugriff auf das `cl_salv_columns_list`-Objekt, das die Spalten verwaltet. Mit `get_column()` und Methoden wie `set_long_text()` und `set_visible()` können einzelne Spalten konfiguriert werden. Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flügen an und implementieren Sie einen Hotspot-Klick auf die Flugnummer (`CONNID`), der eine Meldung mit der ausgewählten Flugnummer ausgibt. Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_events_list`.

CLASS zcl_salv_hotspot DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_hotspot.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_link_click FOR EVENT link_click OF cl_salv_events_list
      IMPORTING r_salv_column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_hotspot IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_hotspot.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_sflight ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' )->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>hotspot ).

        DATA(lo_events) = lo_alv->get_event_manager( ).
        SET HANDLER me->handle_link_click FOR lo_events.

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_link_click.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    " Daten der geklickten Zeile ermitteln
    r_salv_column->get_row_data( IMPORTING s_row_data = ls_sflight ).

    MESSAGE |Flugnummer '{ ls_sflight-connid }' der Fluggesellschaft '{ ls_sflight-carrid }' wurde geklickt!| TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT`. Fügen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Spalte hinzu, die den Status des Fluges ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet') basierend auf einer Logik anzeigt. Die Spalte soll nicht in der Datenbanktabelle existieren.

CLASS zcl_salv_custom_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_custom_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_with_status.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    DATA: lt_sflight_ext TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw) UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Daten mit Statusfeld füllen (Beispiel-Logik)
    lt_sflight_ext = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                               ( ls_raw
                                 status = COND string( WHEN ls_raw-price > 500 THEN 'Verspätet' ELSE 'Pünktlich' ) ) ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_sflight_ext ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_optimize( abap_true ).

        DATA(lo_status_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'STATUS' ).
        lo_status_column->set_long_text( 'Flugstatus' ).
        lo_status_column->set_medium_text( 'Status' ).
        lo_status_column->set_short_text( 'Stat' ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flügen an und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` Ausdrücke, um den Durchschnittspreis aller angezeigten Flüge zu berechnen und in einer Meldung auszugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Aggregation über die `PRICE`-Spalte durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_avg_price.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 20 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( lt_sflight ).
    DATA(lv_average_price) = COND s_price(
      WHEN lv_num_flights > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_num_flights
      ELSE 0
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_sflight ).
        lo_alv->display( ).

        MESSAGE |Durchschnittlicher Flugpreis: { lv_average_price } { lt_sflight[1]-currency }| TYPE 'S'.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_average FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_average.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE TABLE OF ty_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( value = 10 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( value = 20 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( value = 30 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lv_total) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_data IN lt_test_data
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_data-value
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_test_data ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = COND f(
      WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total / lv_count
      ELSE 0
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 60 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators, um eine Aggregation (hier: Summe und Durchschnitt) über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und lesbarer macht. Der `COND`-Operator wird für die bedingte Zuweisung des Durchschnittspreises verwendet, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden.
keywords: ALV, cl_salv_table, REDUCE Operator, Functional Programming, Average, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie ein ALV-Grid mit einem Kontextmenü. Das ALV soll Flüge anzeigen. Beim Rechtsklick auf eine Zeile soll ein Kontextmenü erscheinen, das eine Option 'Flugdetails anzeigen' bietet. Beim Klick darauf soll eine Meldung mit den Details des ausgewählten Fluges erscheinen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table=>get_functions()` und `cl_salv_functions_list=>set_all_functions( abap_true )` für das Standard-Kontextmenü und `cl_salv_events_list=>add_function_for_fcode` für eigene Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_ctx_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_with_ctx_menu.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    METHODS handle_context_menu FOR EVENT added_function_selected OF cl_salv_events_list
      IMPORTING e_salv_function.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_ctx_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_with_ctx_menu.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        mo_alv = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                          t_table   = lt_sflight ).

        " Standard ALV-Funktionen aktivieren (inkl. Kontextmenü)
        DATA(lo_functions) = mo_alv->get_functions( ).
        lo_functions->set_all_functions( abap_true ).

        " Eigene Funktion zum Kontextmenü hinzufügen
        DATA(lo_events) = mo_alv->get_event_manager( ).
        lo_events->add_function_for_fcode( fcode = 'SHOW_DETAILS' text = 'Flugdetails anzeigen' position = 1 ).
        SET HANDLER me->handle_context_menu FOR lo_events.

        mo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu.
    IF e_salv_function = 'SHOW_DETAILS'.
      DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.
      DATA(lo_selections) = mo_alv->get_selections( ).
      DATA(lt_selected_rows) = lo_selections->get_selected_rows( ).

      IF lines( lt_selected_rows ) = 1.
        DATA(lv_index) = lt_selected_rows[ 1 ].
        mo_alv->get_data_ref( )->* = CAST ty_sflight_table( mo_alv->get_data_ref( )->* ).
        DATA(lt_alv_data) = CAST ty_sflight_table( mo_alv->get_data_ref( )->* ).
        ls_sflight = lt_alv_data[ lv_index ].

        MESSAGE |Details für Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate } (Preis: { ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency })| TYPE 'S'.
      ELSEIF lines( lt_selected_rows ) > 1.
        MESSAGE 'Bitte wählen Sie genau eine Zeile aus.' TYPE 'W'.
      ELSE.
        MESSAGE 'Keine Zeile ausgewählt.' TYPE 'W'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flügen an und verwenden Sie eine dynamische Feldkatalog-Erstellung, um die Spalten des ALV-Grids zur Laufzeit zu definieren. Die Spalten sollen `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `PRICE` sein.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `LVC_T_FCAT` und übergeben Sie diese an `cl_salv_table=>factory`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_fcat_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_fcat_alv.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Dynamischen Feldkatalog erstellen
    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' ) 
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Flugnummer' ) 
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'  coltext = 'Preis' ) 
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
          r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          t_table     = lt_sflight
          t_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_fieldcatalog FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_fieldcatalog.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             field_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE TABLE OF ty_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( field_a = 'X' field_b = 1 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_test_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'FIELD_A' coltext = 'Test Field A' )
      ( fieldname = 'FIELD_B' coltext = 'Test Field B' )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv_test) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
          t_table = lt_test_data
          t_fieldcatalog = lt_test_fcat
        ).
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv_test->get_columns( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_columns->get_column( 'FIELD_A' ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_columns->get_column( 'FIELD_A' )->get_long_text( ) exp = 'Test Field A' ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception during ALV dynamic field catalog creation' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Erstellung eines Feldkatalogs für das ALV-Grid. Anstatt dass das ALV den Feldkatalog automatisch aus der Struktur der internen Tabelle ableitet, wird hier eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `LVC_T_FCAT` manuell mit den gewünschten Spaltendefinitionen befüllt. Die Befüllung erfolgt mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, was eine moderne und kompakte Syntax für die Tabellenkonstruktion ist. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die anzuzeigenden Spalten zur Laufzeit variieren oder spezielle Anpassungen erfordern.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, das einen Trennstrich zwischen zwei Gruppen von Optionen anzeigt. Die erste Gruppe soll 'Standardaktionen' und die zweite 'Spezialaktionen' heißen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_separator()` von `cl_ctmenu`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_separator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_menu_with_separator.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_menu_selection FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_separator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_menu_with_separator.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'STD1' text = 'Standardaktion 1' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'STD2' text = 'Standardaktion 2' ).

    lo_menu->add_separator( ).

    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SPEC1' text = 'Spezialaktion 1' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SPEC2' text = 'Spezialaktion 2' ).

    SET HANDLER me->handle_menu_selection FOR lo_menu.

    MESSAGE 'Kontextmenü mit Trennstrich erstellt.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_selection.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'STD1'.
        MESSAGE 'Standardaktion 1 ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'STD2'.
        MESSAGE 'Standardaktion 2 ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'SPEC1'.
        MESSAGE 'Spezialaktion 1 ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'SPEC2'.
        MESSAGE 'Spezialaktion 2 ausgewählt!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE |Unbekannte Option '{ fcode }' ausgewählt!| TYPE 'W'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_menu_separator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_menu_separator.
    DATA(lo_menu_instance) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu_instance->add_function( fcode = 'ITEM1' text = 'Item 1' ).
    lo_menu_instance->add_separator( ).
    lo_menu_instance->add_function( fcode = 'ITEM2' text = 'Item 2' ).

    " Direkte Prüfung eines Separators ist schwierig, da er keinen FCODE hat.
    " Wir prüfen indirekt, ob die Funktionen korrekt hinzugefügt wurden.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu_instance->get_function_text( 'ITEM1' ) exp = 'Item 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu_instance->get_function_text( 'ITEM2' ) exp = 'Item 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies hilft, Menüoptionen logisch zu gruppieren und die Benutzerfreundlichkeit zu verbessern. Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flügen an und verwenden Sie `cl_salv_controller_metadata` um die Spalte `PRICE` farblich hervorzuheben, wenn der Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt (z.B. 1000).
hint: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Daten und einer zusätzlichen Spalte für die Farbe. Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_column_list->get_column()->set_cell_type` mit `if_salv_c_cell_type=>colored_text` und `set_color`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_colored_cells DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_colored_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_colored_cells IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_colored_price.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_colored,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
             price_color TYPE lvc_s_colo,
           END OF ty_sflight_colored.
    DATA: lt_sflight_colored TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight_colored.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw) UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Daten mit Farb-Information füllen
    lt_sflight_colored = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                                   ( ls_raw
                                     price_color = COND lvc_s_colo(
                                       WHEN ls_raw-price > 1000 THEN VALUE lvc_s_colo( col = 6 int = 0 inv = 0 ) " Rot
                                       ELSE VALUE lvc_s_colo( col = 0 int = 0 inv = 0 ) " Standard
                                     ) ) ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_sflight_colored ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_optimize( abap_true ).

        " Spalte 'PRICE' als farbigen Text definieren und Farbspalte zuweisen
        DATA(lo_price_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' ).
        lo_price_column->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>colored_text ).
        lo_price_column->set_color( 'PRICE_COLOR' ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_colored_cells_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_colored_cells_logic.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             value TYPE i,
             color_field TYPE lvc_s_colo,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE TABLE OF ty_test_data.

    lt_test_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UP TO 3
                              ( value = i * 500
                                color_field = COND lvc_s_colo(
                                  WHEN i * 500 > 1000 THEN VALUE lvc_s_colo( col = 6 int = 0 inv = 0 )
                                  ELSE VALUE lvc_s_colo( col = 0 int = 0 inv = 0 )
                                ) ) ).

    DATA(ls_entry_low) = lt_test_data[ 1 ].
    DATA(ls_entry_high) = lt_test_data[ 3 ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry_low-color_field-col exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry_high-color_field-col exp = 6 ).

    " Test der ALV-Erstellung mit der erweiterten Struktur und Farbspalte
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv_test) = cl_salv_table=>factory( t_table = lt_test_data ).
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv_test->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_value_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'VALUE' ).
        lo_value_column->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>colored_text ).
        lo_value_column->set_color( 'COLOR_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_value_column->get_cell_type( ) exp = if_salv_c_cell_type=>colored_text ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception during ALV colored cell creation' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Zellen in einem ALV-Grid basierend auf Daten farblich hervorhebt. Dazu wird die interne Tabelle um eine zusätzliche Spalte (`PRICE_COLOR` vom Typ `LVC_S_COLO`) erweitert, die die Farbattribute enthält. Die Befüllung dieser Farbspalte erfolgt mit dem `VALUE`- und `COND`-Operator, was eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Syntax ist. Anschließend wird die `PRICE`-Spalte im ALV als `colored_text` definiert und die Farbspalte zugewiesen. Dies ermöglicht eine visuell ansprechende und informative Darstellung von Daten.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaften, deren ID einem bestimmten regulären Ausdruck entspricht (z.B. alle IDs, die mit 'LH' beginnen).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` mit `FILTER` und `cl_abap_regex` im `WHERE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_carrid_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_carrid_regex.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflights ( 
                                            carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                            connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                            fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate ) ).

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( lo_matcher->match( val = flight-carrid ) IS NOT INITIAL )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_regex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_carrid_regex( '^LH.*' ). " Matches 'LH' at the beginning

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) )
      msg = 'Should contain flights for LH'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_regex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_carrid_regex( '^XX.*' ). " No match expected

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FOR...IN...` mit `FILTER` und `cl_abap_regex` zur effizienten Filterung einer internen Tabelle. Der `WHERE`-Ausdruck innerhalb des `FOR`-Loops nutzt den Matcher der `cl_abap_regex`-Klasse, um dynamisch Zeilen basierend auf einem regulären Ausdruck zu selektieren. Dies ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Art der Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle gültigen E-Mail-Adressen aus einem gegebenen Textstring und geben Sie diese als interne Tabelle von Strings zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `find_all` und `FOR...IN...` mit `VALUE` für die Ergebnisaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_extract_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_emails TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_all_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE tt_emails.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_emails.
    DATA(lv_email_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_email_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text = iv_text ).

    lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    rt_emails = VALUE tt_emails(
      FOR match_result IN lo_matcher->get_found_submatches( )
      ( match_result-offset_and_length[1]-text )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_multiple_emails FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_no_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_multiple_emails.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_emails( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Kontaktieren Sie uns unter info@example.com oder support@domain.net.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_emails( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'info@example.com' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'support@domain.net' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_no_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_emails( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Dies ist ein Text ohne E-Mail-Adressen.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_emails( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_abap_regex` verwendet wird, um alle Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks (hier: E-Mail-Adressen) in einem String zu finden. Die Methode `get_found_submatches()` liefert eine interne Tabelle mit den Treffern, die dann mit `FOR...IN...` und `VALUE` in eine String-Tabelle umgewandelt wird. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Extraktion strukturierter Daten aus unstrukturierten Texten.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem gegebenen Textstring alle Vorkommen von bestimmten Schlüsselwörtern (z.B. 'SAP', 'ABAP') durch eine markierte Version (z.B. '[SAP]', '[ABAP]'). Die zu ersetzenden Wörter sollen dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle kommen.
hint: Erstellen Sie einen Regex-Pattern aus der internen Tabelle und nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `replace_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_regex_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_keywords TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_keywords
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        it_keywords TYPE tt_keywords
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_regex_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_keywords.
    IF it_keywords IS INITIAL.
      rv_result_text = iv_text.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_pattern_parts) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR keyword IN it_keywords
      ( |({ cl_abap_regex=>escape( keyword ) })| ) " Escape keywords for regex and make them capture groups
    ).
    DATA(lv_pattern) = cl_abap_string_utilities=>concatenate_string_table(
                           i_string_table = lv_pattern_parts
                           i_separator    = '|' ). " Combine patterns with OR

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_pattern
                                        iv_case_sensitive = abap_false ). " Case-insensitive replacement
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text = iv_text ).

    rv_result_text = lo_matcher->replace_all( iv_replacement = `[$0]` ). " $0 refers to the entire match
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_multiple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_no_match FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_regex_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_keywords) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_regex_replace=>tt_keywords( ( 'SAP' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `SAP ist eine Firma, ABAP ist eine Sprache.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_keywords( iv_text = lv_text it_keywords = lt_keywords ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = `[SAP] ist eine Firma, [ABAP] ist eine Sprache.`
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_regex_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_keywords) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_regex_replace=>tt_keywords( ( 'Java' ) ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `ABAP ist eine Sprache.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_keywords( iv_text = lv_text it_keywords = lt_keywords ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = `ABAP ist eine Sprache.`
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_keywords.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_regex_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_keywords) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_regex_replace=>tt_keywords( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `ABAP ist eine Sprache.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_keywords( iv_text = lv_text it_keywords = lt_keywords ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = `ABAP ist eine Sprache.`
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `cl_abap_regex` zur dynamischen Erstellung eines Regex-Patterns aus einer Liste von Schlüsselwörtern. Die `FOR...IN...` Schleife wird verwendet, um die einzelnen Keywords zu escapen und zu einem "OR"-Pattern zu verbinden. `replace_all` ersetzt dann alle Treffer im Text. Die Verwendung von `$0` in der Ersetzung steht für den gesamten gefundenen Match.
keywords: cl_abap_regex, String Processing, Regex, FOR...IN..., Dynamic Pattern, replace_all

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft ein bestimmtes Wort (z.B. 'Flug') in einer Liste von Sätzen vorkommt, wobei die Zählung case-insensitiv sein soll.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR...IN...` und `cl_abap_regex` für die Zählung der Treffer pro String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_regex_occurrences DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sentences TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_word_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_word      TYPE string
        it_sentences TYPE tt_sentences
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_regex_occurrences IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_word_occurrences.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = |({ cl_abap_regex=>escape( iv_word ) })|. " Escape word and make it a capture group
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_pattern
                                        iv_case_sensitive = abap_false ). " Case-insensitive

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT total_count = 0
                             FOR sentence IN it_sentences
                             LET lo_matcher = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text = sentence ) IN
                             NEXT total_count = total_count + lo_matcher->count( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_multiple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_case_insensitive FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_regex_occurrences( ).
    DATA(lt_sentences) = VALUE zcl_count_regex_occurrences=>tt_sentences(
      ( `Der Flug geht nach Berlin.` )
      ( `Ein weiterer Flug ist geplant.` )
      ( `Kein Flug hier.` )
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_word_occurrences( iv_word = 'Flug' it_sentences = lt_sentences ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_regex_occurrences( ).
    DATA(lt_sentences) = VALUE zcl_count_regex_occurrences=>tt_sentences(
      ( `Der Zug fährt nach München.` )

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie eine Liste von Telefonnummern. Filtern Sie nur die Nummern heraus, die einem deutschen Format (z.B. +49 123 4567890 oder 0123-4567890) entsprechen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` mit `FILTER` und `cl_abap_regex` im `WHERE`-Ausdruck für die Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_validate_phone_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_phone_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_german_phone_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_phone_numbers TYPE tt_phone_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_numbers) TYPE tt_phone_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validate_phone_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_german_phone_numbers.
    " Regex for German phone numbers (simplified for example)
    " Allows: +49 176 12345678, 030-1234567, 089 987654321
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\+49|\(0\d{2,5}\)|\d{2,5})[\s\-\/]?\d{3,10}$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( ).

    rt_valid_numbers = VALUE tt_phone_numbers(
      FOR phone_number IN it_phone_numbers
        WHERE ( lo_matcher->match( val = phone_number ) IS NOT INITIAL )
      ( phone_number )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie eine Liste von Flugnummern (z.B. 'LH400', 'AA123') in ein lesbareres Format um (z.B. 'Lufthansa Flight 400', 'American Airlines Flight 123'). Die Fluggesellschaften sollen dabei aus einer Mapping-Tabelle ermittelt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit Capture Groups und `FOR...IN...` mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_transform_flight_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_input,
             flight_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_input.
    TYPES tt_flight_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_output,
             original_id TYPE string,
             formatted_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_output.
    TYPES tt_flight_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_map,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             name   TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_map.
    TYPES tt_carrier_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_map WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_ids TYPE tt_flight_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_output.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_carrier_map TYPE tt_carrier_map.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_flight_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Populate carrier map (simplified for example)
    mt_carrier_map = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' name = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' name = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' name = 'United Airlines' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^([A-Z]{2})(\d+)$`. " Capture Carrier ID (2 letters) and Flight Number (digits)
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE tt_flight_output(
      FOR flight_input IN it_flight_ids
      LET lo_matcher = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text = flight_input-flight_id ) IN
      IF lo_matcher->match( ) IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA(lv_carrier_id) = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 )-text.
        DATA(lv_flight_num) = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 )-text.
        DATA(lv_carrier_name) = COND string(
          WHEN line_exists( mt_carrier_map[ carrid = lv_carrier_id ] )
          THEN mt_carrier_map[ carrid = lv_carrier_id ]-name
          ELSE lv_carrier_id
        ).
        ( original_id = flight_input-flight_id
          formatted_id = |{ lv_carrier_name } Flight { lv_flight_num }| )
      ELSE.
        ( original_id = flight_input-flight_id
          formatted_id = flight_input-flight_id ) " Return original if no match
      ENDIF.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Regex-Suche in einer internen Tabelle durch, wobei sowohl das Suchmuster als auch das zu durchsuchende Feld dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit dynamischem Pattern und `FOR...IN...` mit `FIELD-SYMBOL` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_regex_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS dynamic_regex_search
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_pattern    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_entries) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_regex_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_regex_search.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( ).

    rt_found_entries = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_data
      LET lv_field_value = SWITCH string(
                               iv_field_name
                               WHEN 'FIELD1' THEN <fs_data>-field1
                               WHEN 'FIELD2' THEN <fs_data>-field2
                               WHEN 'FIELD3' THEN <fs_data>-field3
                               ELSE '' ) IN
      IF lo_matcher->match( val = lv_field_value ) IS NOT INITIAL.
        ( <fs_data> )
      ENDIF.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaften und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Filtern Sie dabei nur Fluggesellschaften, deren ID einem bestimmten Regex-Muster entspricht.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` mit `GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_regex` im `WHERE`-Ausdruck des `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_count_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count_by_regex.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflights ( 
                                            carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                            connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                            fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate ) ).

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( ).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( lo_matcher->match( val = flight-carrid ) IS NOT INITIAL )
        GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
        WITHOUT MEMBERS
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        count  = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie eine Liste von Dateinamen. Filtern Sie nur die Dateinamen heraus, die eine bestimmte Erweiterung haben (z.B. '.txt', '.log') und dabei keine Sonderzeichen im Namen enthalten (außer dem Punkt vor der Erweiterung).

CLASS zcl_validate_filenames DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_filenames TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_valid_filenames
      IMPORTING
        it_filenames TYPE tt_filenames
        iv_extension TYPE string " e.g., '.txt'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_filenames) TYPE tt_filenames.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validate_filenames IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_valid_filenames.
    " Regex: starts with alphanumeric/underscore, then any alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen, ends with .extension
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^[a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_\-]*` & cl_abap_regex=>escape( iv_extension ) & `$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( ).

    rt_valid_filenames = VALUE tt_filenames(
      FOR filename IN it_filenames
        WHERE ( lo_matcher->match( val = filename ) IS NOT INITIAL )
      ( filename )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Hashtags (Wörter, die mit '#' beginnen) aus einer Liste von Texten und geben Sie diese als eine flache Liste von eindeutigen Hashtags zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `find_all` und `REDUCE` mit `FOR...IN...` für die Aggregation und `DISTINCT` für Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_extract_unique_hashtags DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_texts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_hashtags TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE HASHED KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_hashtags
      IMPORTING
        it_texts TYPE tt_texts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_hashtags) TYPE tt_hashtags.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_unique_hashtags IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_hashtags.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `#\w+`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).

    rt_unique_hashtags = REDUCE tt_hashtags(
      INIT hashtags = VALUE tt_hashtags( )
      FOR text IN it_texts
      LET lo_matcher = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text = text ) IN
      NEXT hashtags = VALUE tt_hashtags(
                         FOR match_result IN lo_matcher->get_found_submatches( )
                         ( INSERT match_result-offset_and_length[1]-text INTO TABLE hashtags RESULT <fs_hashtag> )
                         ( hashtags ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Maskieren Sie sensible Daten (z.B. Kreditkartennummern) in einem Textstring, indem Sie alle Ziffern außer den letzten vier durch 'X' ersetzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit Capture Groups und `replace_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mask_credit_card DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS mask_card_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_masked_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mask_credit_card IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mask_card_number.
    " Regex for a typical 16-digit credit card number, possibly with spaces or hyphens
    " Captures the first 12 digits and the last 4 digits separately
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `(\d{4}[\s\-]?){3}(\d{4})`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text = iv_text ).

    rv_masked_text = lo_matcher->replace_all( iv_replacement = `XXXX XXXX XXXX $2` ). " $2 refers to the last 4 digits
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Fuzzy-Suche in einer internen Tabelle von Produktbeschreibungen durch. Finden Sie alle Beschreibungen, die ein Suchwort enthalten, auch wenn es leicht abweicht (z.B. 'Farbe' soll auch 'Farben' finden).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` mit `FILTER` und `cl_abap_regex` mit einem Pattern, das geringfügige Abweichungen zulässt (z.B. `\w*` für optionale Zeichen).
solution:
CLASS zcl_fuzzy_search_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id          TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fuzzy_search_description
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
        iv_search_term TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fuzzy_search_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fuzzy_search_description.
    " Create a fuzzy regex pattern: search_term with optional characters around it
    " e.g., 'color' -> 'c\w*o\w*l\w*o\w*r'
    DATA(lv_fuzzy_pattern_parts) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR char IN iv_search_term
      ( |{ char }\w*| )
    ).
    DATA(lv_fuzzy_pattern) = cl_abap_string_utilities=>concatenate_string_table(
                                 i_string_table = lv_fuzzy_pattern_parts
                                 i_separator    = '' ).
    lv_fuzzy_pattern = `(?i)` & lv_fuzzy_pattern. " (?i) for case-insensitive

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_fuzzy_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( ).

    rt_found_products = VALUE tt_products(
      FOR product IN it_products
        WHERE ( lo_matcher->match( val = product-description ) IS NOT INITIAL )
      ( product )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem Textstring, die in Klammern stehen (z.B. '(123)', '(456)'), und geben Sie diese als Liste von Integern zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit Capture Groups und `FOR...IN...` mit `VALUE` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_extract_numbers_in_brackets DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_bracketed_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_numbers_in_brackets IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_bracketed_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\((\d+)\)`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text = iv_text ).

    lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    rt_numbers = VALUE tt_numbers(
      FOR match_result IN lo_matcher->get_found_submatches( )
      ( CONV i( match_result-offset_and_length[2]-text ) ) " Capture group 1 is the number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Kombiniere SELECT DISTINCT mit einer FOR-Schleife für interne Tabellen und dem VALUE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dba_distinct_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             prefixed TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_id.
    TYPES tt_flight_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_prefixed_flight_ids RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_ids) TYPE tt_flight_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dba_distinct_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_prefixed_flight_ids.
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_raw_flights.

    rt_flight_ids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_raw_flights
                             ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                               connid   = flight-connid
                               prefixed = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_flight_ids) = lo_cut->get_prefixed_flight_ids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flight_ids )
      msg = 'Es sollten eindeutige Flug-IDs gefunden werden.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error
    ).
    IF lines( lt_flight_ids ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_flight_ids[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_first_entry-prefixed
        msg = 'Das Präfix sollte nicht leer sein.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = contains( val = ls_first_entry-prefixed sub = '-' )
        msg = 'Das Präfix sollte einen Bindestrich enthalten.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Kombination von SELECT DISTINCT zur effizienten Datenbeschaffung und dem VALUE-Operator mit einer FOR-Schleife, um die Ergebnisse in einem einzigen Ausdruck zu transformieren und eine neue interne Tabelle zu füllen. Instructions: Lese alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus sflights und erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft ein Feld für den Namen und ein leeres Feld für eine spätere Beschreibung enthält.
hint: Nutze SELECT DISTINCT, um die Basisdaten zu erhalten, und den VALUE-Operator mit einer FOR-Schleife zur Transformation und Ergänzung der Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dba_distinct_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_info,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrier_name TYPE s_carrname,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_info.
    TYPES tt_carrier_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_info RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_info) TYPE tt_carrier_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dba_distinct_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_info.
    DATA: lt_distinct_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_distinct_carrids.

    rt_carrier_info = VALUE #( FOR carrid_entry IN lt_distinct_carrids
                                   LET lv_carrid = carrid_entry
                                       lv_carrname = COND #( WHEN line_exists( scarr[ carrid = lv_carrid ] )
                                                             THEN scarr[ carrid = lv_carrid ]-carrname
                                                             ELSE 'Unknown' ) IN
                                   ( carrid       = lv_carrid
                                     carrier_name = lv_carrname
                                     description  = '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    IF lines( lt_carrier_info ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_carrier_info[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_first_entry-carrid
        msg = 'Carrier ID sollte nicht leer sein.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_first_entry-carrier_name
        msg = 'Carrier Name sollte nicht leer sein.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert SELECT DISTINCT zur Ermittlung eindeutiger Schlüssel mit dem mächtigen VALUE-Operator und einer FOR-Schleife. Innerhalb der Schleife wird der LET-Ausdruck verwendet, um temporäre Variablen zu definieren, und der COND-Operator für eine bedingte Zuweisung des Fluggesellschaftsnamens aus der Tabelle SCARR. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von Daten.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT, VALUE, FOR, LET, COND, Internal Tables, Open SQL

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_distinct_carriers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_distinct_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dba_distinct_order( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_sorted_distinct_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_carriers )
      msg = 'Es sollten sortierte, eindeutige Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error
    ).
    IF lines( lt_carriers ) > 1.
      DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = lt_carriers[ 1 ]-carrid.
      LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_current_carrier) FROM 2.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( ls_current_carrier-carrid GE lv_prev_carrid )
          msg = |Tabelle ist nicht korrekt sortiert: { lv_prev_carrid } vor { ls_current_carrier-carrid }|
        ).
        lv_prev_carrid = ls_current_carrier-carrid.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies vermeidet eine nachträgliche Sortierung in ABAP und nutzt die Optimierungen des Datenbank-Systems.

CLASS zcl_ui_dynamic_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_display_type = iv_display_type.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    CASE mv_display_type.
      WHEN 'ALV'.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_control TYPE cl_gui_alv_grid
          EXPORTING
            i_parent = mo_custom_container
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1.
      WHEN 'TEXT'.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_control TYPE cl_gui_textedit
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_custom_container
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default or error handling
    ENDCASE.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_distinct_carriers.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.

    CASE mv_display_type.
      WHEN 'ALV'.
        DATA(lt_carriers) = get_distinct_carriers( ).
        TRY.
            CAST cl_gui_alv_grid( mo_control )->set_table_for_first_display(
              EXPORTING
                i_structure_name = 'ZCL_UI_DYNAMIC_CONTAINER=>TY_CARRIER'
              CHANGING

            ).
            CAST cl_gui_alv_grid( mo_control )->frontend_update( ).
          CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
            " Handle error if cast fails
        ENDTRY.

      WHEN 'TEXT'.
        TRY.
            CAST cl_gui_textedit( mo_control )->set_text_as_stream( 'Dynamisch geladener Text!' ).
          CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
            " Handle error if cast fails
        ENDTRY.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

    SELECT DISTINCT s~carrid, c~carrname, c~currcode AS currency

Instructions: Erstelle einen Custom Container und zeige darin einen Texteditor an. Implementiere eine Methode, die den Inhalt des Texteditors mit einem REDUCE-Ausdruck verarbeitet (z.B. Zeilen zählen).
hint: Nutze cl_gui_custom_container, cl_gui_textedit und den REDUCE-Operator für die Textverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui_text_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname,
             display_text IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string,
             count_lines RETURNING VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          mo_text_editor      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui_text_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_text.
    IF mo_text_editor IS BOUND.
      mo_text_editor->set_text_as_stream( iv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD count_lines.
    DATA: lt_text_lines TYPE string_table.
    IF mo_text_editor IS BOUND.
      mo_text_editor->get_text_as_stream(
        IMPORTING
          text = lt_text_lines
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1
      ).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_line_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR line IN lt_text_lines WHERE ( line IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT count = count + 1 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstelle einen Custom Container und zeige darin einen Tree Control (cl_gui_tree_control) an, der eine hierarchische Struktur von Fluggesellschaften und deren Flügen darstellt.
hint: Nutze cl_gui_custom_container und cl_gui_tree_control. Die Daten für den Baum können mit modernen Open SQL-Abfragen vorbereitet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui_tree_control DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname,
             display_flight_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          mo_tree_control     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_tree_control.

    METHODS get_flight_hierarchy RETURNING VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE cl_gui_tree_control=>nodes_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui_tree_control IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree_control
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_tree_control=>node_selection_mode_single
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_hierarchy.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_flights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights UP TO 50 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_tree_control=>node_info(
        node_key = |C{ lv_node_key }|
        text     = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrid }|
        relatkey = cl_gui_tree_control=>relatkey_last
        relatnode = cl_gui_tree_control=>relatnode_root
      ) TO rt_hierarchy.

      DATA(lv_parent_key) = |C{ lv_node_key }|.

      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        APPEND VALUE cl_gui_tree_control=>node_info(
          node_key = |F{ lv_node_key }|
          text     = |Flug { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate }|
          relatkey = cl_gui_tree_control=>relatkey_last
          relatnode = lv_parent_key
        ) TO rt_hierarchy.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flight_tree.
    DATA(lt_hierarchy) = get_flight_hierarchy( ).

    IF mo_tree_control IS BOUND.
      mo_tree_control->add_nodes(
        EXPORTING
          table_structure_name = 'CL_GUI_TREE_CONTROL=>NODE_INFO'
        CHANGING
          nodes_table          = lt_hierarchy
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS               = 1
      ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Handle error
      ENDIF.
      mo_tree_control->expand_node(
        EXPORTING
          node_key = cl_gui_tree_control=>relatnode_root
      ).
      mo_tree_control->frontend_update( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und weisen Sie ihr einen Wert zu. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_assign_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_value          TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data           TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_assign_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_component> = iv_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
          " Type mismatch, assignment failed
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_component_value.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_assign_fs=>ty_data,
          lo_cut  TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_assign_fs.

    lo_cut = NEW #( ).
    ls_data-field1 = 'Initial'.
    ls_data-field2 = 10.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->set_component_value(
      iv_component_name = 'FIELD1'

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 'New Value' ).

    lv_success = lo_cut->set_component_value(

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 20 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in Verbindung mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Programming, RTTI

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und setzen Sie für alle Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 EUR die Währung auf 'USD'. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>) WHERE ...` zur direkten Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_loop_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_tab_loop_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_currency_for_high_price.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) WHERE price > '500.00' AND currency = 'EUR'.
      <fs_sflight>-currency = 'USD'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_data_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fs_data_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_variable_via_fs.
    DATA lv_local_var TYPE i VALUE iv_initial_value.
