Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Zeile aus der internen Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf `carrid` und `connid` und weisen Sie das Ergebnis einem `FIELD-SYMBOL` zu. Wenn die Zeile gefunden wird, ändern Sie den Preis direkt über das `FIELD-SYMBOL`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE itab WITH KEY ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_read_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_read_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE ct_sflights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ... FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ) )
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter_fs IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_tab_sort_dyn_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_tab_sort_dyn_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sort_field> TYPE any.

    " Check if the field exists in the structure (optional but good practice)
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_sort_field OF STRUCTURE ct_sflights[1] TO <fs_sort_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SORT ct_sflights BY (iv_sort_field).
    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_line_exists_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Sprachdatei (z.B. eine OTR-Textdatei) mit der Klasse `cl_cts_language_file_io` und geben Sie den Inhalt als String zurück.

CLASS zcl_read_lang_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_lang_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_language_file.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lv_size    TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_instance( )->read_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_file_name = iv_file_path
          IMPORTING
            e_xstring   = lv_xstring
            e_size      = lv_size
        ).

        IF lv_size > 0.
          " Convert xstring to string (assuming UTF-8 for modern systems)
          rv_content = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( source = lv_xstring ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_cts_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_cts_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        ir_any TYPE any

        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_rtti_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fs_type_name.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_any TO <fs_any>.

      DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
      GET REFERENCE OF <fs_any> INTO lr_data.

      DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_data ).

CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_direction  TYPE string " 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Check if the field exists in the structure
    IF lines( ct_sflights ) > 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ct_sflights[1] TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    CASE iv_direction.
      WHEN 'ASCENDING'.
        SORT ct_sflights BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      WHEN 'DESCENDING'.
        SORT ct_sflights BY (iv_field_name) DESCENDING.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      mo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
      CALL SCREEN mv_dynnr STARTING AT 10 10 ENDING AT 90 90.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_dialog_container IS BOUND.
      mo_dialog_container->free( ).
      FREE mo_dialog_container.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_grid->free( ).
      FREE mo_alv_grid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für eine potenzielle Ausnahme bei der GUI-Control-Initialisierung innerhalb eines `CL_GUI_DIALOGBOX_CONTAINER` und zeigen Sie eine Fehlermeldung an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen abzufangen, und `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>MESSAGE_BOX` zur Anzeige der Fehlermeldung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_repid TYPE syrepid i_dynnr TYPE sydynnr.
    METHODS open_dialog.
    METHODS trigger_error_and_handle.
    METHODS close_dialog.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_dialog_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
    DATA mo_text_edit      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mv_repid          TYPE syrepid.
    DATA mv_dynnr          TYPE sydynnr.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_repid = i_repid.
    mv_dynnr = i_dynnr.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_dialog_container
          EXPORTING
            parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0
            width  = 400
            height = 200
            left   = 150
            top    = 150
            caption = 'Fehlerbehandlung Dialog'
            dynnr  = mv_dynnr
            repid  = mv_repid.

        " Simulate an error: try to create a control with an invalid parent
        " (e.g., parent is not a container or already freed)
        " For demonstration, we'll just create a valid one here and trigger error later.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_dialog_container.

      CATCH cx_gui_error INTO DATA(lx_gui_error).
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>message_box(
          EXPORTING
            text  = |Fehler bei GUI-Initialisierung: { lx_gui_error->get_text( ) }|
            title = 'GUI Fehler'
            type  = cl_gui_frontend_services=>msg_type_error
        ).
        " Clean up if container was partially created
        IF mo_dialog_container IS BOUND.
          mo_dialog_container->free( ).
          FREE mo_dialog_container.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD open_dialog.
    IF mo_dialog_container IS BOUND.
      mo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
      CALL SCREEN mv_dynnr STARTING AT 10 10 ENDING AT 50 50.
    ELSE.
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>message_box(
        EXPORTING
          text  = 'Dialog konnte aufgrund eines Fehlers nicht geöffnet werden.'
          title = 'Fehler'
          type  = cl_gui_frontend_services=>msg_type_error
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_error_and_handle.
    TRY.
        " Simulate an error, e.g., by trying to free a non-existent object or invalid operation
        " For a real error, you might pass an invalid parameter to a method.
        " Here, we'll just raise a dummy exception for demonstration.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_gui_error=>gui_error.

      CATCH cx_gui_error INTO DATA(lx_gui_error).
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>message_box(
          EXPORTING
            text  = |Behandelter Fehler: { lx_gui_error->get_text( ) }|
            title = 'Behandelter GUI Fehler'
            type  = cl_gui_frontend_services=>msg_type_warning
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD close_dialog.
    IF mo_dialog_container IS BOUND.
      mo_dialog_container->free( ).
      FREE mo_dialog_container.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_text_edit IS BOUND.
      mo_text_edit->free( ).
      FREE mo_text_edit.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus `SFLIGHTS`, transformieren Sie diese mit `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücken (z.B. berechnen Sie die Auslastung pro Flug) und zeigen Sie die transformierten Daten in einem `CL_GUI_ALV_GRID` innerhalb eines `CL_GUI_DIALOGBOX_CONTAINER` an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Datenaggregation und -transformation. Berechnen Sie `booked_seats / max_seats` für die Auslastung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_data_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_repid TYPE syrepid i_dynnr TYPE sydynnr.
    METHODS display_transformed_data.
    METHODS close_dialog.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_dialog_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
    DATA mo_alv_grid         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mv_repid            TYPE syrepid.
    DATA mv_dynnr            TYPE sydynnr.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             booked_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             max_seats  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             booked_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             max_seats  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             occupancy  TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_data_transform IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_repid = i_repid.
    mv_dynnr = i_dynnr.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_dialog_container
      EXPORTING
        parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        width  = 900
        height = 600
        left   = 30
        top    = 30
        caption = 'Transformierte SFLIGHTS Daten'
        dynnr  = mv_dynnr
        repid  = mv_repid.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_dialog_container.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_transformed_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc AS booked_seats, seatsmax AS max_seats
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_transformed_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_transformed(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_sflights
      LET lv_occupancy = COND p(
                             WHEN ls_raw-max_seats > 0
                             THEN ( ls_raw-booked_seats / ls_raw-max_seats ) * 100
                             ELSE 0
                           )
      IN
        ( carrid     = ls_raw-carrid
          connid     = ls_raw-connid
          fldate     = ls_raw-fldate
          booked_seats = ls_raw-booked_seats
          max_seats  = ls_raw-max_seats
          occupancy  = lv_occupancy )
    ).

    IF lt_transformed_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'ZCL_GUI_DATA_TRANSFORM=>TY_SFLIGHT_TRANSFORMED'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_transformed_sflights
      ).
      mo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
      CALL SCREEN mv_dynnr STARTING AT 10 10 ENDING AT 95 95.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD close_dialog.
    IF mo_dialog_container IS BOUND.
      mo_dialog_container->free( ).
      FREE mo_dialog_container.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_grid->free( ).
      FREE mo_alv_grid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_data_transform( i_repid = sy-repid i_dynnr = '9000' ).

    DATA(lt_raw_test_data) = VALUE zcl_gui_data_transform=>tt_sflight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' booked_seats = 50 max_seats = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' booked_seats = 0 max_seats = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20230101' booked_seats = 75 max_seats = 75 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0200' fldate = '20230101' booked_seats = 10 max_seats = 0 ) " Division by zero case
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed_expected) = VALUE zcl_gui_data_transform=>tt_sflight_transformed(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' booked_seats = 50 max_seats = 100 occupancy = '50.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' booked_seats = 0 max_seats = 200 occupancy = '0.00' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20230101' booked_seats = 75 max_seats = 75 occupancy = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0200' fldate = '20230101' booked_seats = 10 max_seats = 0 occupancy = '0.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed_actual) = VALUE zcl_gui_data_transform=>tt_sflight_transformed(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_test_data
      LET lv_occupancy = COND p(
                             WHEN ls_raw-max_seats > 0
                             THEN ( ls_raw-booked_seats / ls_raw-max_seats ) * 100
                             ELSE 0
                           )
      IN
        ( carrid     = ls_raw-carrid
          connid     = ls_raw-connid
          fldate     = ls_raw-fldate
          booked_seats = ls_raw-booked_seats
          max_seats  = ls_raw-max_seats
          occupancy  = lv_occupancy )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_transformed_actual
      exp = lt_transformed_expected
      msg = 'Daten Transformation ist nicht korrekt.'
    ).

    lo_cut->close_dialog( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Datenmanipulation mit `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücken (ab ABAP 7.40/7.55). Es ermöglicht die Transformation und Berechnung neuer Felder (hier: Auslastung) in einer internen Tabelle auf eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Weise, bevor die Daten im ALV Grid angezeigt werden. Die `COND` Expression behandelt dabei elegant die Division durch Null.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) in ein `XSTRING`-Format unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>FILL_CONTAINER_X` und fangen Sie mögliche Ausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_serialize_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_sflights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING   cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_serialize_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_x(
          EXPORTING
            im_value    = lt_sflights
          IMPORTING
            ex_container = rv_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid   = lx_conv_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_deserialization DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS deserialize_dynamic
      IMPORTING im_xstring TYPE xstring
                im_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING   cx_sy_conversion_error
                cx_sy_create_data_error.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_deserialization IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_dynamic.
    DATA lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( im_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_type_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

        cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_x(
          EXPORTING
            im_container = im_xstring
          IMPORTING
            ex_value     = <fs_data>
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid   = lx_conv_error->textid.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_create_error
            textid   = lx_create_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.

    mv_resource_locked = abap_true.
    " Simulieren einer Ressourcensperre

          DATA(lv_zero) = 0.
          DATA(lv_result) = 10 / lv_zero. " Löst CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR aus

            textid   = lx_arith_error->textid.

      CLEANUP.
        " Dieser Block wird immer ausgeführt, egal ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht

    METHODS test_cleanup_on_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_success FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_error.
    DATA(lo_cleanup_demo) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cleanup_demo->mv_resource_locked msg = 'Ressource sollte initial nicht gesperrt sein.' ).

    TRY.
        lo_cleanup_demo->perform_operation_with_cleanup( abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR sollte ausgelöst werden.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR wurde wie erwartet abgefangen.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cleanup_demo->mv_resource_locked msg = 'Ressource sollte nach Fehler freigegeben sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_on_success.
    DATA(lo_cleanup_demo) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cleanup_demo->mv_resource_locked msg = 'Ressource sollte initial nicht gesperrt sein.' ).

    lo_cleanup_demo->perform_operation_with_cleanup( abap_false ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cleanup_demo->mv_resource_locked msg = 'Ressource sollte nach Erfolg freigegeben sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in einer `TRY...CATCH`-Anweisung. Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt oder nicht. Dies ist ideal, um Ressourcen (wie Sperren oder Dateihandles) freizugeben und den Systemzustand konsistent zu halten. Hier wird eine simulierte Ressourcensperre im `CLEANUP`-Block zurückgesetzt.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Error Handling, Resource Management, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) in ein `XSTRING`-Format und komprimieren Sie diese anschließend mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>FILL_CONTAINER_X` gefolgt von `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_serialize_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_and_compress
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING   cx_sy_conversion_error
                cx_sy_compression_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_serialize_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_and_compress.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lv_raw_xstring TYPE xstring.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_x(
          EXPORTING
            im_value    = lt_sflights
          IMPORTING
            ex_container = lv_raw_xstring
        ).

        cl_abap_gzip=>compress(
          EXPORTING
            raw_in  = lv_raw_xstring
          IMPORTING
            gzip_out = rv_compressed_xstring
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid   = lx_conv_error->textid.
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error INTO DATA(lx_comp_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_compression_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_comp_error
            textid   = lx_comp_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialization_compression FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialization_compression.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_serialize_compress( ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = lo_processor->serialize_and_compress( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_compressed_xstring msg = 'Komprimiertes XSTRING sollte nicht initial sein.' ).

    DATA lv_decompressed_xstring TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_gzip=>decompress(
      EXPORTING
        gzip_in  = lv_compressed_xstring
      IMPORTING
        raw_out = lv_decompressed_xstring
    ).

    DATA lt_deserialized_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_x(
      EXPORTING
        im_container = lv_decompressed_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ex_value     = lt_deserialized_sflights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_deserialized_sflights ) > 0 ),
      msg = 'Deserialisierte Tabelle sollte Einträge enthalten.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Serialisierung um eine Komprimierungsfunktion. Eine interne Tabelle wird zuerst in ein `XSTRING` serialisiert und dann mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS` komprimiert. Dies ist nützlich, um die Größe von Daten zu reduzieren, die gespeichert oder übertragen werden. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` deckt sowohl Konvertierungs- als auch Komprimierungsfehler ab.
keywords: XSTRING, Serialization, Compression, CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES, CL_ABAP_GZIP, TRY, CATCH, sflight

Instructions: Dekompression und Deserialisierung eines `XSTRING`-Formats, das zuvor eine komprimierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) enthielt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>DECOMPRESS` gefolgt von `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>READ_CONTAINER_X`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_decompress_deserialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_and_deserialize
      IMPORTING im_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RAISING   cx_sy_conversion_error
                cx_sy_compression_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_decompress_deserialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_and_deserialize.
    DATA lv_raw_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress(
          EXPORTING
            gzip_in  = im_compressed_xstring
          IMPORTING
            raw_out = lv_raw_xstring
        ).

        cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_x(
          EXPORTING
            im_container = lv_raw_xstring
          IMPORTING
            ex_value     = rt_sflights
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error INTO DATA(lx_comp_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_compression_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_comp_error
            textid   = lx_comp_error->textid.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid   = lx_conv_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_decompression_deserialization FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_decompression_deserialization.
    DATA lt_original_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_original_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA lv_raw_xstring TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_x(
      EXPORTING
        im_value    = lt_original_sflights
      IMPORTING
        ex_container = lv_raw_xstring
    ).

    DATA lv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_gzip=>compress(
      EXPORTING
        raw_in  = lv_raw_xstring
      IMPORTING
        gzip_out = lv_compressed_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_decompress_deserialize( ).
    DATA(lt_deserialized_sflights) = lo_processor->decompress_and_deserialize( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_deserialized_sflights ),

      msg = 'Anzahl der deserialisierten Zeilen sollte übereinstimmen.'
    ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel ist das Gegenstück zu SER_011 und zeigt den Prozess der Dekompression und Deserialisierung. Ein komprimiertes `XSTRING` wird zuerst mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>DECOMPRESS` dekomprimiert und dann mit `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>READ_CONTAINER_X` in die ursprüngliche interne Tabelle deserialisiert. Die `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke behandeln mögliche Kompressions- und Konvertierungsfehler.
keywords: XSTRING, Deserialization, Decompression, CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES, CL_ABAP_GZIP, TRY, CATCH, sflight

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine einfache ALV-Liste der Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` an. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung und die Instanziierung des ALV-Grid-Objekts.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und den `NEW` Operator für `cl_gui_alv_grid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_basic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_basic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Erstelle einen Custom Container, falls noch nicht vorhanden
    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Erstelle das ALV Grid Objekt
    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    " Zeige die Daten an
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights
    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_display_sflights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Behandlung eines Doppelklick-Ereignisses in einem ALV-Grid. Bei einem Doppelklick auf eine Zeile soll die Flugnummer und das Flugdatum der ausgewählten Zeile in einer Nachricht angezeigt werden. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife oder Tabellenausdrücke, um die Daten zu finden.
hint: Registrieren Sie eine lokale Klasse als Event-Handler für das `double_click`-Ereignis und nutzen Sie `FOR` oder `itab[ key = value ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_double_click DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_row
        e_column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_double_click IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @mt_sflights.

    IF lines( mt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA(lv_index) = e_row - 1. " e_row ist 1-basiert

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_flight) = mt_sflights[ lv_index ].
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Flugnummer:' ls_flight-connid 'Datum:' ls_flight-fldate.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        MESSAGE 'Zeile nicht gefunden.' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_double_click_handler FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_double_click_handler.
    " Direkter Test des Event-Handlers ist schwierig ohne UI-Interaktion.
    " Wir können jedoch die Logik, die der Handler ausführen würde, isoliert testen.
    DATA(lo_alv_handler) = NEW zcl_alv_double_click( ).

    " Mock-Daten für mt_sflights
    lo_alv_handler->mt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) ).

    " Simulieren eines Doppelklicks auf die erste Zeile
    " Da MESSAGE direkt eine Interaktion auslöst, können wir hier nur prüfen,
    " ob die Daten korrekt gefunden würden.
    DATA(lv_expected_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_expected_fldate) = '20250101'.

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_flight) = lo_alv_handler->mt_sflights[ 1 ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = lv_expected_connid ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = lv_expected_fldate ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Flugdaten nicht gefunden.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Event-Behandlung in ABAP ist ein Standardmuster. Hier wird das `double_click`-Ereignis des ALV-Grids registriert. Die moderne Syntax zeigt sich im Zugriff auf die Tabellenzeile mittels Tabellenausdruck `mt_sflights[ lv_index ]`, was den Code prägnanter macht als `READ TABLE`.
keywords: ALV, Event Handling, double_click, FOR, Tabellenausdruck, cl_gui_alv_grid

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Feldkatalog für eine ALV-Liste dynamisch zur Laufzeit, basierend auf der Struktur einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) für diese Aufgabe.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_salv_table=>factory` (oder manuelle Konvertierung) für den Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_field_catalog
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_catalog.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_fcat         TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " RTTI: Struktur der Tabelle beschreiben
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Feldkatalog dynamisch aufbauen
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      CLEAR ls_fcat.
      ls_fcat-fieldname = ls_component-name.
      ls_fcat-coltext   = ls_component-name. " Oder aus DDIC-Info holen
      APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fcat.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_catalog FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_catalog.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat( ).
    DATA(lt_fcat) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_catalog( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_fcat ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_fcat ) exp = 16 ). " SFLIGHTS hat 16 Felder

    DATA(ls_fcat_carrid) = lt_fcat[ fieldname = 'CARRID' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_fcat_carrid-fieldname exp = 'CARRID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische ALV-Anzeigen, bei denen die Datenstruktur nicht zur Designzeit bekannt ist.
keywords: ALV, RTTI, Dynamische Programmierung, Feldkatalog, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Passen Sie das ALV-Layout an, indem Sie die Spaltenüberschriften zentrieren und die Zeilen farblich hervorheben, wenn der Flugstatus 'X' ist. Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator, um Layout-Einstellungen zu übertragen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` für `lvc_s_layo` und setzen Sie `col_opt` und `info_fieldname`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_layout_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_alv_layout RETURNING VALUE(rs_layout) TYPE lvc_s_layo.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_layout_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_alv_layout.
    DATA: ls_layout_template TYPE lvc_s_layo.

    ls_layout_template-cwidth_opt = abap_true. " Optimale Spaltenbreite
    ls_layout_template-zebra      = abap_true. " Zebrastreifenmuster
    ls_layout_template-f2code     = '&IC1'.    " Doppelklick-Funktion
    ls_layout_template-info_fieldname = 'ROW_COLOR'. " Feld für Zeilenfarbe

    " Übertrage die Einstellungen mit CORRESPONDING
    rs_layout = CORRESPONDING #( ls_layout_template ).

    " Beispiel für eine zusätzliche Layout-Einstellung, die nicht über CORRESPONDING kommt
    rs_layout-grid_title = 'Flugübersicht (mit Layout-Anpassung)'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten aus `sflights` so, dass nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') und mit einem Flugdatum nach einem bestimmten Stichtag angezeigt werden. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #(...)` um die interne Tabelle zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_filter_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_filter_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflights.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    rt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                            WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck, um die Summe zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #(...)` mit einer `FOR` Schleife über die gruppierten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_sum.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passenger_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_passenger_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_passenger_sum(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_passenger_sum( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
                                   INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                   NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_passengers = lv_total_seats ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid, das bestimmte Spalten (z.B. 'PRICE') bearbeitbar macht. Implementieren Sie die Behandlung des `data_changed`-Ereignisses, um die Änderungen in der internen Tabelle zu verarbeiten und zu validieren.
hint: Setzen Sie `i_grid->set_ready_for_input( 1 )` und registrieren Sie einen Handler für `data_changed`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_editable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_editable_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_mod_cells
        e_mod_rows.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_editable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_editable_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @mt_sflights.

    IF lines( mt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    SET HANDLER me->handle_data_changed FOR mo_alv_grid.

    DATA(ls_layout) = VALUE lvc_s_layo( edit = abap_true ). " ALV bearbeitbar machen
    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' no_out = abap_true )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' coltext = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'  coltext = 'Preis' edit = abap_true )
    ).

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        is_layout        = ls_layout
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
    ).

    mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input( 1 ). " Eingabebereitschaft aktivieren
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    DATA: lv_row_index TYPE i,
          lv_col_name  TYPE lvc_fname.

    LOOP AT e_mod_cells INTO DATA(ls_mod_cell).
      lv_row_index = ls_mod_cell-row_id - 1.
      lv_col_name  = ls_mod_cell-fieldname.

      " Beispiel: Validierung für den Preis
      IF lv_col_name = 'PRICE'.
        DATA(lv_new_price) = mt_sflights[ lv_row_index ]-price.
        IF lv_new_price < 0.
          MESSAGE 'Preis darf nicht negativ sein!' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
          " Fehlerbehandlung: Originalwert wiederherstellen oder Fehlermeldung im ALV
          " Hier nur eine einfache Meldung
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Änderungen im ALV aktualisieren
    mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_toolbar_btn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    CONSTANTS: gc_fcode_custom TYPE ui_func VALUE 'MY_BUTTON'.

    METHODS handle_toolbar FOR EVENT toolbar OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_object TYPE REF TO cl_alv_event_toolbar_set.

    METHODS handle_user_command FOR EVENT user_command OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_ucomm TYPE syucomm.

CLASS zcl_alv_toolbar_btn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_button.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @mt_sflights.

    IF lines( mt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    SET HANDLER me->handle_toolbar FOR mo_alv_grid.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_user_command FOR mo_alv_grid.

    mo_alv_grid->set_toolbar_interactive( ). " Toolbar interaktiv machen

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_toolbar.
    DATA: ls_button TYPE stb_button.

    CLEAR ls_button.
    ls_button-function = gc_fcode_custom.
    ls_button-icon     = icon_information.
    ls_button-quickinfo = 'Mein Custom Button'.
    ls_button-text     = 'Info'.
    ls_button-butn_type = 0. " Normaler Button

    e_object->add_button( is_button = ls_button ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_user_command.
    IF e_ucomm = gc_fcode_custom.
      MESSAGE 'Custom Button geklickt!' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Färben Sie Zeilen in der ALV-Liste basierend auf einer Bedingung ein. Wenn der Preis eines Fluges über 500 liegt, soll die Zeile rot hervorgehoben werden. Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck, um die Farbe dynamisch zu bestimmen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_cond_color DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_colored,
             INCLUDE TYPE sflights,
             row_color TYPE lvc_s_colo,
           END OF ty_sflight_colored.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_colored TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_colored WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_colored_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

CLASS zcl_alv_cond_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_colored_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Daten mit Farbinformationen füllen
    mt_sflights_colored = VALUE tt_sflight_colored(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )
        row_color = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > 500 THEN VALUE lvc_s_colo( col = 6 int = 0 inv = 0 ) " Rot
                            ELSE VALUE lvc_s_colo( ) ) )
    ).

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    DATA(ls_layout) = VALUE lvc_s_layo( info_fieldname = 'ROW_COLOR' ).

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        is_layout        = ls_layout
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights_colored
    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_alv_method_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

    METHODS display_alv_from_method.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

CLASS zcl_alv_method_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_from_method.
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = get_flight_data( ).

    IF lines( lt_flight_data ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_METHOD_DATA=>TY_FLIGHT_INFO'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_flight_data
    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights UP TO 50 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_data = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_checkbox_col DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_with_checkbox.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_sflights_status TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_checkbox_col IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_checkbox.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Daten mit booleschem Feld füllen (z.B. jeder zweite Flug ist aktiv)
    mt_sflights_status = VALUE tt_sflight_status(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lines( lt_sflights )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights INDEX i
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        is_active = COND abap_bool( WHEN i MOD 2 = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' coltext = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'IS_ACTIVE' coltext = 'Aktiv' checkbox = 'X' outputlen = 1 )
    ).

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights_status
    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie die Flugdaten, um eine neue Spalte 'Reisezeit' zu berechnen, die die Differenz zwischen 'DEPTIME' und 'ARRTIME' darstellt. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `LET` Ausdruck für die Berechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `LET` um temporäre Variablen für die Zeitberechnung zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_transform_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             deptime TYPE s_deptime,
             arrtime TYPE s_arrtime,
             travel_duration TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES: tt_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_with_duration.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_flight_duration TYPE tt_flight_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_transform_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_duration.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Daten mit berechneter Reisezeit füllen
    mt_flight_duration = VALUE tt_flight_duration(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_deptime_sec = ( ls_flight-deptime DIV 100 * 3600 ) + ( ls_flight-deptime MOD 100 * 60 )
          lv_arrtime_sec = ( ls_flight-arrtime DIV 100 * 3600 ) + ( ls_flight-arrtime MOD 100 * 60 )
          lv_duration_sec = COND i( WHEN lv_arrtime_sec >= lv_deptime_sec THEN lv_arrtime_sec - lv_deptime_sec
                                    ELSE lv_arrtime_sec - lv_deptime_sec + 24 * 3600 ) " Über Mitternacht
          lv_hours = lv_duration_sec DIV 3600
          lv_minutes = ( lv_duration_sec MOD 3600 ) DIV 60
      IN
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        deptime = ls_flight-deptime,
        arrtime = ls_flight-arrtime,
        travel_duration = |{ lv_hours }h { lv_minutes }min| ) ).

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' coltext = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'DEPTIME' coltext = 'Abflugzeit' )
      ( fieldname = 'ARRTIME' coltext = 'Ankunftszeit' )
      ( fieldname = 'TRAVEL_DURATION' coltext = 'Reisezeit' outputlen = 10 )
    ).

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_flight_duration
    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flugdaten in der ALV-Anzeige nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und zeigen Sie die Gruppensumme der Passagiere an. Verwenden Sie die moderne `GROUP BY` Syntax in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` um die Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
             flights_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_group_sum.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_grouped_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_flight_group_sum TYPE tt_flight_group_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_grouped_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Daten gruppieren und aggregieren
    mt_flight_group_sum = VALUE tt_flight_group_sum(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
                                   INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                   NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
      IN
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        total_passengers = lv_total_seats,
        flights_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight ( <fs_flight> ) ) ) ).

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_custom_container
    ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'TOTAL_PASSENGERS' coltext = 'Gesamtpassagiere' )
    ).

    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_GROUP_BY=>TY_FLIGHT_GROUP_SUM'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_flight_group_sum
    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_sflights_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_group_by( ).

    " Mock-Daten für sflights
    DATA(lt_mock_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).

    " Manuelles Gruppieren und Aggregieren, wie es die Methode tun würde
    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = VALUE zcl_alv_group_by=>tt_flight_group_sum(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_mock_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
                                   INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                   NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
      IN
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        total_passengers = lv_total_seats,
        flights_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight ( <fs_flight> ) ) ) ).

    " Prüfen der Gruppierung und Summen
    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_grouped_data[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-total_passengers exp = 250 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_lh_group-flights_data ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_ua_group) = lt_grouped_data[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_group-total_passengers exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_ua_group-flights_data ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF` Syntax (ab ABAP 7.50) in Kombination mit `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und lesbare Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu den älteren `LOOP AT ... AT END OF` Konstrukten und ideal, um zusammengefasste Daten in einem ALV anzuzeigen.
keywords: ALV, Gruppierung, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, Aggregation, sflights

solution:
CLASS zcl_dir_content_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dir_entry,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, " 'FILE' or 'DIR'
           END OF ty_dir_entry.
    TYPES tt_dir_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dir_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dir_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_directory_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dir_entries) TYPE tt_dir_entries
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_utilities.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dir_content_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dir_content.
    DATA: lt_files TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_file_names,
          lt_dirs  TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_dir_names.

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_content(
      EXPORTING
        iv_directory_name = iv_directory_path
      IMPORTING
        et_file_names     = lt_files
        et_dir_names      = lt_dirs
    ).

    rt_dir_entries = VALUE #( 
      FOR file IN lt_files ( name = file type = 'FILE' )
      FOR dir IN lt_dirs ( name = dir type = 'DIR' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_list_successful.
    DATA(lv_test_dir) = '/tmp/test_dir_list'.
    DATA(lv_file1) = lv_test_dir && '/file1.txt'.
    DATA(lv_subdir) = lv_test_dir && '/subdir'.
    DATA(lv_file2_in_subdir) = lv_subdir && '/file2.txt'.

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_test_dir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_subdir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_file( iv_file_name = lv_file1 it_content = VALUE string_table( ( 'Content' ) ) ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_file( iv_file_name = lv_file2_in_subdir it_content = VALUE string_table( ( 'Content' ) ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dir_content_list( ).
    DATA(lt_entries) = lo_cut->get_dir_content( lv_test_dir ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_entries ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of entries' ).

    DATA(lv_found_file) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_dir) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_entries INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-name = 'file1.txt' AND ls_entry-type = 'FILE'.
        lv_found_file = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_entry-name = 'subdir' AND ls_entry-type = 'DIR'.
        lv_found_dir = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_file msg = 'File1 not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_dir msg = 'Subdir not found' ).

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_file2_in_subdir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( lv_subdir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_file1 ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( lv_test_dir ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_list_non_existent_dir.
    DATA(lv_test_dir) = '/tmp/non_existent_dir_list_123'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dir_content_list( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_dir_content( lv_test_dir ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for non-existent directory' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lx_ex->get_text( ) msg = 'Exception message should not be initial' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_aging_info,
             table_name TYPE tabname,
             is_aging_relevant TYPE abap_bool,
             aging_status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_aging_info.

    METHODS get_aging_info_for_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_aging_info) TYPE ty_data_aging_info.

    METHODS react_to_aging_status
      IMPORTING
        is_aging_info TYPE ty_data_aging_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_taken) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aging_info_for_table.
    rs_aging_info-table_name = iv_table_name.

    " Konzeptionelle Prüfung: In einem realen System würde man hier
    " über DDIC-Metadaten oder spezielle Data-Aging-APIs prüfen.
    " CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE ist primär für das Framework selbst.
    " Hier simulieren wir die Relevanz für SFLIGHTS.
    IF iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS'.
      rs_aging_info-is_aging_relevant = abap_true.
      rs_aging_info-aging_status_text = 'Tabelle ist Data Aging relevant (simuliert)'.
    ELSE.
      rs_aging_info-is_aging_relevant = abap_false.
      rs_aging_info-aging_status_text = 'Tabelle ist nicht Data Aging relevant (simuliert)'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD react_to_aging_status.
    IF is_aging_info-is_aging_relevant = abap_true.
      rv_action_taken = |Datenzugriff für { is_aging_info-table_name } wird optimiert (z.B. auf Cold Store umgeleitet).|.
    ELSE.
      rv_action_taken = |Standard-Datenzugriff für { is_aging_info-table_name } wird verwendet.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aging_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_aging
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_age_days TYPE i " Maximale Tage für 'heiße' Daten
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hot_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aging_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_aging.
    DATA(lv_aging_date) = cl_abap_tims_utl=>get_current_date( ) - iv_max_age_days.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate >= @lv_aging_date
      INTO TABLE @rt_hot_flights.

    " In einem realen Szenario könnte hier eine weitere Logik folgen,
    " um 'kalte' Daten aus einem Archiv zu lesen, falls iv_max_age_days
    " überschritten wird und keine Daten in der Haupttabelle gefunden wurden.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die prüft, ob eine gegebene Tabelle für Data Aging aktiviert ist, indem sie die DDIC-Metadaten abfragt. Dies ist eine indirekte Interaktion mit dem Data Aging Framework.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_DDIC_TABLE` oder `DDIC_GET_TABLE_INFO` um Informationen über die Tabelle zu erhalten und nach Data Aging relevanten Feldern oder Eigenschaften zu suchen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_aging_activation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_table_aging_enabled
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_enabled) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_aging_activation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_table_aging_enabled.
    DATA: ls_table_info TYPE dd02l.

    " In einem realen System würde man hier DDIC-Funktionen oder APIs nutzen,
    " um die Data Aging Relevanz zu prüfen. Z.B. ob ein Feld für Data Aging
    " (z.B. ein AGING_DATE-Feld) in der Tabelle existiert oder ob die Tabelle
    " im Data Aging Framework registriert ist.
    " Hier simulieren wir die Prüfung für SFLIGHTS.
    IF iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS'.
      rv_is_enabled = abap_true.
    ELSEIF iv_table_name = 'T000'.
      rv_is_enabled = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      " Für andere Tabellen könnte man hier eine generische DDIC-Prüfung einbauen.
      " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob ein Feld mit dem Namen 'AGING_DATE' existiert.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ).
          DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr ).
          LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
            IF ls_component-name = 'AGING_DATE'. " Beispiel für ein Data Aging Feld
              rv_is_enabled = abap_true.
              RETURN.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        CATCH cx_sy_runtime_error.
          " Tabelle existiert nicht oder ist keine Struktur
      ENDTRY.
      rv_is_enabled = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

    METHODS get_random_flight RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO lv_count.

    IF lv_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_count - 1 ).
    DATA(lv_offset) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF rs_flight
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      OFFSET lv_offset.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig durch (Shuffle).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Schleife, um Elemente an zufälligen Positionen zu tauschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table IMPORTING it_input TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled_table = it_input.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( rt_shuffled_table ).
    IF lv_size <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_size ).

    LOOP AT rt_shuffled_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entry>).
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-tabix.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      " Swap current entry with a random entry
      ASSIGN rt_shuffled_table[ lv_random_index ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_random_entry>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_temp) = <fs_entry>.
        <fs_entry> = <fs_random_entry>.
        <fs_random_entry> = lv_temp.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) msg = 'Shuffled table size mismatch' ).

    " Assert that the content is the same, but order is likely different
    DATA(lt_sorted_original) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_sorted_original ASCENDING.
    DATA(lt_sorted_shuffled) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled ASCENDING.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled exp = lt_sorted_original msg = 'Shuffled table content mismatch' ).

    " This assertion is probabilistic, but for a small table, it's highly likely to be true
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_original msg = 'Table was not shuffled (unlikely)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert einen Fisher-Yates-Shuffle-Algorithmus für interne Tabellen. `cl_abap_random_int` wird verwendet, um zufällige Indizes für den Tausch von Elementen zu generieren. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen (`FIELD-SYMBOL`) ermöglicht einen effizienten direkten Zugriff und Tausch von Tabellenzeilen.
keywords: Random, Internal Tables, Shuffle, cl_abap_random_int, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig ein Objekt aus einer Liste von Objekten (z.B. `sflight`-Instanzen) aus.

CLASS zcl_random_object_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_object
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_selected_object) TYPE ty_sflight_data.

CLASS zcl_random_object_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_object.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( it_objects ).
    IF lv_size = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_size ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE it_objects INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_selected_object.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_object_selection FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_object_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_object_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_random_object_selector=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'GBP' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_selected_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_object( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_selected_flight-carrid exp = abap_false msg = 'No object selected' ).

    " Verify that the selected object is one of the original objects
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight = ls_selected_flight.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found exp = abap_true msg = 'Selected object not in original list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und wählen Sie für jede Gruppe einen zufälligen Flug aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_random_int` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_grouped_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_random_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_grouped_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lt_group_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_data( FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key ( <fs_flight> ) ).
      DATA(lv_group_size) = lines( lt_group_flights ).

      IF lv_group_size > 0.
        DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_group_size ).
        DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
        READ TABLE lt_group_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(ls_random_flight).
        APPEND ls_random_flight TO rt_random_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouped_flight( ).
    DATA(lt_random_flights) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_random_flights ) exp = 0 msg = 'No random flights returned' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_msg_level_info ).

    " Verify that each carrier has at most one entry
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_flight IN lt_random_flights ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
    DATA(lv_distinct_carriers) = lines( lt_carriers ).
    SORT lt_carriers ASCENDING DUPLICATES ELIMINATE.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carriers ) exp = lv_distinct_carriers msg = 'Duplicate carriers found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax, um Datensätze nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `cl_abap_random_int` verwendet, um einen zufälligen Flug auszuwählen. Die `FOR`-Iteration über die Gruppe (`FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key`) ist eine moderne Art, auf die Gruppenelemente zuzugreifen.
keywords: Grouping, Random, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, cl_abap_random_int, sflights

Instructions: Formatieren Sie eine Liste von Werten (z.B. Flugnummern) in einen kommaseparierten String, wobei `cl_abap_format` für die individuelle Wertformatierung verwendet wird (falls anwendbar).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates und `cl_abap_format`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_list_to_string
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_list_to_string.
    rv_formatted_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <fs_value> IN it_values
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_value>
        ELSE s && ', ' && <fs_value> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_list_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_list_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_list_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Value1' ) ( 'Value2' ) ( 'Value3' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_list_to_string( lt_input ) exp = 'Value1, Value2, Value3' msg = 'List format failed' ).

    lt_input = VALUE string_table( ( 'SingleValue' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_list_to_string( lt_input ) exp = 'SingleValue' msg = 'Single value format failed' ).

Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen. Obwohl `cl_abap_format` hier nicht direkt für jeden Wert verwendet wird, könnte es in der `NEXT`-Klausel integriert werden, um komplexere Formatierungen pro Element anzuwenden, falls erforderlich.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von 2D-Punkten (X, Y Koordinaten) unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression und fügen Sie diese Punkte in eine neue Tabelle ein. Diese Punkte sollen später in einem `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` angezeigt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR`-Expression, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, und `INSERT` um Elemente hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_insert_points DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_point,
             x TYPE i,
             y TYPE i,
           END OF ty_point.
    TYPES tt_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_points
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_points) TYPE tt_points.

    METHODS display_points_in_viewer
      IMPORTING
        it_points TYPE tt_points
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_insert_points IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_points.
    rt_points = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                         ( x = i * 10 y = i * 5 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_points_in_viewer.
    DATA: lo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    " Example: How to use INSERT in a modern context (though not directly with viewer)
    " Let's say we want to add a specific point after generation
    DATA(lt_additional_points) = VALUE tt_points( ( x = 100 y = 50 ) ).
    INSERT LINES OF lt_additional_points INTO TABLE it_points. " Demonstrates INSERT

    " In a real scenario, you would pass it_points to the viewer
    " For demonstration, we just show the viewer creation.
    " lo_viewer->load_data_from_table( it_points ). " Placeholder for viewer interaction
    MESSAGE 'Viewer created and points prepared.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_insert_points( ).
    DATA(lt_points) = lo_cut->generate_points( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_points )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Incorrect number of points generated.'

Die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht eine deklarative und lesbare Initialisierung von Tabellen. Zusätzlich wird `INSERT LINES OF` gezeigt, um Elemente in eine bestehende interne Tabelle einzufügen, was eine moderne Art der Datenmanipulation darstellt.
