Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) basierend auf einem Kriterium (z.B. maximale Flugdauer) unter Verwendung einer `FILTER`-Expression. Die gefilterten Daten sollen dann für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` vorbereitet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FILTER`-Expression, um eine neue Tabelle mit den gewünschten Einträgen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             deptime  TYPE s_time,
             arrtime  TYPE s_time,
             duration TYPE s_fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_duration TYPE s_fltime
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS display_filtered_flights_in_viewer
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    " Fetch data from sflights using modern SELECT syntax
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime, fltime AS duration
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    " Filter using FILTER expression
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE duration <= iv_max_duration ).

    " Example of INSERT (e.g., adding a dummy flight for visualization)
    DATA(ls_dummy_flight) = VALUE ty_flight_data( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' fldate = sy-datum deptime = '000000' arrtime = '000000' duration = 0 ).
    INSERT ls_dummy_flight INTO TABLE rt_filtered_flights INDEX 1. " Demonstrates INSERT
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_filtered_flights_in_viewer.
    DATA: lo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    " In a real scenario, you would pass it_flights to the viewer
    " For demonstration, we just show the viewer creation.
    " lo_viewer->load_flight_path_data( it_flights ). " Placeholder for viewer interaction
    MESSAGE 'Viewer created and filtered flights prepared.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 100 ). " Max duration 100 minutes

    " Assert that all remaining flights have duration <= 100
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_flight-duration <= 100
        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } has duration { ls_flight-duration } > 100.|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that the dummy flight was inserted
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'XX'
      msg = 'Dummy flight not inserted at the beginning.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FILTER`-Expression, um Elemente einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung auszuwählen. Dies ist eine moderne, deklarative und performante Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `DELETE`. Die `INSERT` Anweisung wird hier verwendet, um einen zusätzlichen Datensatz in die gefilterte Tabelle einzufügen, was die Flexibilität der Datenmanipulation demonstriert. Die `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` dient als Visualisierungskontext für die gefilterten Flugdaten.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, SELECT, INSERT, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtflugdauer aller Flüge aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression. Das Ergebnis soll dann in einem `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` als Textinformation angezeigt werden.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             duration TYPE s_fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES tt_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_duration.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_duration.

    SELECT carrid, fltime AS duration
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_duration = REDUCE s_fltime( INIT sum = 0
                                         FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                         NEXT sum = sum + flight-duration ).

    " Example of INSERT (e.g., logging the aggregation result into a temporary table)
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_duration TYPE s_fltime,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    DATA lt_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE ty_log_entry( carrid = iv_carrid total_duration = rv_total_duration timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ) )
      INTO TABLE lt_log. " Demonstrates INSERT
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_duration_in_viewer.
    DATA: lo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    " In a real scenario, you would display this information in the viewer
    " For demonstration, we just show the viewer creation.
    " lo_viewer->set_text_overlay( |Total duration for { iv_carrid }: { iv_total_duration } minutes.| ).
    MESSAGE |Viewer created. Total duration for { iv_carrid }: { iv_total_duration } minutes.| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_connection,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_connection.
    TYPES tt_flight_connection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_connections
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date

        VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE tt_flight_connection.

    METHODS display_connections_in_viewer
      IMPORTING
        it_connections TYPE tt_flight_connection

CLASS zcl_modern_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_connections.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, sa~cityfrom, sa~cityto
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS sp ON s~carrid = sp~carrid AND s~connid = sp~connid
      INNER JOIN sairport AS sa ON sp~airpfrom = sa~id
      INNER JOIN sairport AS sb ON sp~airpto = sb~id
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid AND s~fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_connections.

    " Example of INSERT (e.g., adding a manually defined connection for testing/demo)
    DATA(ls_manual_connection) = VALUE ty_flight_connection( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251231' cityfrom = 'New York' cityto = 'London' ).
    INSERT ls_manual_connection INTO TABLE rt_connections INDEX 1. " Demonstrates INSERT
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_connections_in_viewer.
    DATA: lo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    " In a real scenario, you would pass it_connections to the viewer
    " For demonstration, we just show the viewer creation.
    " lo_viewer->load_route_data( it_connections ). " Placeholder for viewer interaction
    MESSAGE 'Viewer created and flight connections prepared.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modern_select( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20251201'. " Assuming some data for AA on this date

    DATA(lt_connections) = lo_cut->get_flight_connections(
                                 iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                 iv_fldate = lv_fldate
                               ).

    " Assert that the manually inserted connection is present
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_connections[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'Manually inserted connection not found.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_connections[ 1 ]-connid
      exp = '0001'
      msg = 'Manually inserted connection not found.'
    ).

    " Assert that the table is not empty (assuming data exists for the query)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_connections )
      msg = 'No flight connections found (expected some).'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,

             size   TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_switch_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_object_config.
    rs_config = SWITCH ty_object_config(
      iv_status
      WHEN 'A' THEN VALUE ty_object_config( status = iv_status color = 'GREEN' size = 10 )
      WHEN 'B' THEN VALUE ty_object_config( status = iv_status color = 'YELLOW' size = 15 )
      WHEN 'C' THEN VALUE ty_object_config( status = iv_status color = 'RED' size = 20 )
      ELSE VALUE ty_object_config( status = iv_status color = 'GREY' size = 5 )
    ).

    " Example of INSERT (e.g., storing the configuration in a temporary table)
    DATA lt_configs TYPE tt_object_config.
    INSERT rs_config INTO TABLE lt_configs INDEX 1. " Demonstrates INSERT
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_configured_object_in_viewer.
    DATA: lo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    " In a real scenario, you would use is_config to set viewer properties
    " For demonstration, we just show the viewer creation.
    " lo_viewer->set_object_properties( is_config-color, is_config-size ).
    MESSAGE |Viewer created. Object configured with Color: { is_config-color }, Size: { is_config-size }.| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für die Instanziierung eines `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer`. Fügen Sie im Fehlerfall eine Fehlermeldung in eine interne Tabelle von Log-Einträgen ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um Ausnahmen abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             type    TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             message TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_viewer_robustly
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
      EXPORTING
        eo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer
      CHANGING
        ct_log_entries TYPE tt_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_viewer_robustly.
    TRY.
        eo_viewer = NEW cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer(
          parent = io_container
        ).
        INSERT VALUE ty_log_entry( type = 'S' message = 'cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer successfully created.' timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ) )
          INTO TABLE ct_log_entries. " Demonstrates INSERT

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        INSERT VALUE ty_log_entry( type = 'E' message = |Error creating viewer: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }| timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ) )
          INTO TABLE ct_log_entries. " Demonstrates INSERT
        MESSAGE |Error creating viewer: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E'.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        INSERT VALUE ty_log_entry( type = 'E' message = |Unexpected error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ) )
          INTO TABLE ct_log_entries. " Demonstrates INSERT

CLASS zcl_db_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id TYPE syuuid_x16,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

    " Assuming a custom database table ZLOG_VIEWER_EVENTS exists with fields ID, TIMESTAMP, MESSAGE
    METHODS insert_log_entry

CLASS zcl_db_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_log_entry.
    DATA(ls_new_entry) = VALUE ty_log_entry(
      id = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16_static( )->if_system_uuid_static~get_uuid_x16( )
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( )
      message = iv_message
    ).

    TRY.
        INSERT zlog_viewer_events FROM ls_new_entry.
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db_error INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        MESSAGE |DB Insert Error: { lx_db_error->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und fügen Sie Daten ein, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Diese dynamisch erstellten und gefüllten Daten sollen dann für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` vorbereitet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und Feld-Symbole für dynamische Tabellen und `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS insert_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
        it_values TYPE string_table.

    METHODS display_dynamic_data_in_viewer
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD insert_dynamic_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_field> = lv_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>. " Demonstrates INSERT into dynamic table
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_dynamic_data_in_viewer.
    DATA: lo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    " In a real scenario, you would process ir_dynamic_table for viewer display
    " For demonstration, we just show the viewer creation.
    MESSAGE 'Viewer created and dynamic data prepared.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation_and_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation_and_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA lt_field_names TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'FIELD1' TO lt_field_names.
    APPEND 'FIELD2' TO lt_field_names.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_names ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Dynamic table not created.' ).

    DATA lt_values TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Value A' TO lt_values.
    APPEND 'Value B' TO lt_values.

    lo_cut->insert_dynamic_data( ir_dynamic_table = lr_dynamic_table it_values = lt_values ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 1 msg = 'Data not inserted into dynamic table.' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE ANY.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Anzahl von Flügen aus der Tabelle `sflight` aus. Die Anzahl der ausgewählten Flüge soll zufällig zwischen 1 und einem Maximalwert liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` zur Bestimmung der Anzahl und `FOR` mit `sy-tabix` zur Auswahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flights.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    IF lt_all_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_all_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random_count) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = iv_max_flights ).
    DATA(lv_num_to_select) = lo_random_count->get_next( ).

    " Ensure we don't select more than available
    lv_num_to_select = COND #( WHEN lv_num_to_select > lv_table_size THEN lv_table_size ELSE lv_num_to_select ).

    " Select random unique indices
    DATA lt_selected_indices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).

    DO lv_num_to_select TIMES.
      DATA(lv_index) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      " Ensure unique indices
      WHILE line_exists( lt_selected_indices[ table_line = lv_index ] ).
        lv_index = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      ENDWHILE.
      APPEND lv_index TO lt_selected_indices.
    ENDDO.

    " Sort indices to access table efficiently
    SORT lt_selected_indices ASCENDING.

    " Use FOR expression to select flights based on random indices
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_index IN lt_selected_indices
                          ( lt_all_sflights[ ls_index ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergeben Sie einen zufälligen Bonus (1-10%) für jeden 3. Flug in einer Liste und berechnen Sie den Endpreis. Verwenden Sie `sy-tabix` für die Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `sy-tabix MOD 3` und `cl_abap_random_float` in einer `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_bonus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_bonus,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price         TYPE sflight-price,
             currency      TYPE sflight-currency,
             bonus_percent TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1,
             final_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_bonus.
    TYPES tt_sflight_bonus TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_bonus WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_bonuses
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_bonus) TYPE tt_sflight_bonus.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bonus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonuses.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_float=>get_seed( ) min = 0.01 max = 0.10 ). " 1% to 10%

    rt_flights_with_bonus = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN it_flights
                                     LET lv_bonus_factor = COND #( WHEN ( sy-tabix MOD 3 ) = 0 THEN lo_random->get_next( ) ELSE 0 ) IN
                                     ( carrid        = flight_line-carrid
                                       connid        = flight_line-connid
                                       fldate        = flight_line-fldate
                                       price         = flight_line-price
                                       currency      = flight_line-currency
                                       bonus_percent = lv_bonus_factor * 100 " Store as percentage (e.g., 5.0)
                                       final_price   = flight_line-price * ( 1 - lv_bonus_factor ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bonuses.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 100. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 200. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0402'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 300. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0403'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 400. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0404'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 500. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0405'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 600. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_bonus( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_bonuses( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 6 ).

    " Check that only every 3rd flight has a bonus
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-bonus_percent exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-bonus_percent exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-bonus_percent exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-bonus_percent exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 5 ]-bonus_percent exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lt_result[ 6 ]-bonus_percent exp = 0 ).

    " Check bonus range for 3rd and 6th flight (values are random, so check range)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_between( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-bonus_percent exp_low = 1.0 exp_high = 10.0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_between( act = lt_result[ 6 ]-bonus_percent exp_low = 1.0 exp_high = 10.0 ).

    " Check final price calculation for 3rd flight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-final_price exp = lt_result[ 3 ]-price * ( 1 - ( lt_result[ 3 ]-bonus_percent / 100 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_bonus( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_bonuses( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Anzahl von Einträgen, wobei jeder Eintrag eine zufällige Ganzzahl und einen zufälligen String enthält. Die Länge des Strings soll fest sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `VALUE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife. Für den String nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_test_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_test_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_test_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_data.
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 1000 ).
    DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 65 max = 90 ). " ASCII for A-Z

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                       LET lv_random_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR j = 1 THEN j + 1 WHILE j <= 5
                                                             NEXT s = s && cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_by_encoding( 'UTF-8' )->convert_from( x = lo_random_char->get_next( ) ) ) IN
                       ( id    = lo_random_int->get_next( )
                         value = lv_random_string ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig. Die ursprüngliche Reihenfolge soll nicht beibehalten werden.
hint: Fügen Sie eine temporäre Spalte mit Zufallszahlen hinzu und sortieren Sie danach. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_shuffled,
             random_key TYPE i,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_shuffled.
    TYPES tt_sflight_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_shuffled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_shuffled.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 1000000 ). " Large range for better randomness

    " Add a random key to each flight and collect in a new table
    DATA lt_flights_with_key TYPE tt_sflight_shuffled.
    lt_flights_with_key = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN it_flights
                                   ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( )
                                     carrid     = flight_line-carrid
                                     connid     = flight_line-connid
                                     fldate     = flight_line-fldate ) ).

    " Sort by the random key to shuffle
    SORT lt_flights_with_key BY random_key.

    " Remove the random key column if not needed in the final output
    rt_shuffled_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN lt_flights_with_key
                                   ( carrid = flight_line-carrid
                                     connid = flight_line-connid
                                     fldate = flight_line-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_single_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA lt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_original_flights.

    IF lt_original_flights IS INITIAL.
      " Skip test if sflight is empty, or create dummy data
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_flights) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_original_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_flights ) exp = lines( lt_original_flights ) ).

    " Check if content is the same (ignoring order)
    DATA lt_sorted_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_sflight_shuffled.
    lt_sorted_original = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN lt_original_flights
                                  ( carrid = flight_line-carrid
                                    connid = flight_line-connid
                                    fldate = flight_line-fldate ) ).
    SORT lt_sorted_original BY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA lt_sorted_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_sflight_shuffled.
    lt_sorted_shuffled = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN lt_shuffled_flights
                                  ( carrid = flight_line-carrid
                                    connid = flight_line-connid
                                    fldate = flight_line-fldate ) ).
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled BY carrid connid fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled exp = lt_sorted_original ).

    " It's highly improbable for a shuffled table to be in the exact same order as original
    " unless the original table has 0 or 1 entry.
    IF lines( lt_original_flights ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lt_shuffled_flights exp = lt_original_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty.
    DATA lt_empty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_shuffled ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_single_entry.
    DATA lt_single_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_single_flight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_single_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = 1 ).

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Stichprobe von Flügen aus `sflight` basierend auf einem Prozentsatz. Jeder Flug soll mit der angegebenen Wahrscheinlichkeit in die Stichprobe aufgenommen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und eine `FOR`-Expression mit einer `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sample DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sample
      IMPORTING
        iv_sample_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1 " e.g., 10.0 for 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sample_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sample IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sample.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    IF lt_all_sflights IS INITIAL OR iv_sample_percentage <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_float=>get_seed( ) min = 0.0 max = 1.0 ). " 0.0 to 1.0

    DATA(lv_sample_threshold) = iv_sample_percentage / 100.

    rt_sample_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN lt_all_sflights
                                 WHERE ( lo_random->get_next( ) < lv_sample_threshold )
                                 ( flight_line ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie jedem Flug in einer Liste eine zufällige Gruppennummer zu (z.B. 1, 2 oder 3) und gruppieren Sie die Flüge anschließend nach dieser Gruppennummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Gruppennummer und `GROUP BY` mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_group,
             group_id TYPE i,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_with_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             group_id TYPE i,
             flights  TYPE tt_flight_with_group,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH UNIQUE KEY group_id.

    METHODS group_flights_randomly
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_num_groups TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_randomly.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL OR iv_num_groups <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = iv_num_groups ).

    DATA lt_flights_with_group TYPE tt_flight_with_group.
    lt_flights_with_group = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN it_flights
                                     ( group_id = lo_random->get_next( )
                                       carrid   = flight_line-carrid
                                       connid   = flight_line-connid
                                       fldate   = flight_line-fldate ) ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_flights_with_group GROUP BY ( group_id = ls_group-group_id )
                                  ( group_id = ls_group-group_id
                                    flights  = VALUE #( FOR flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_group ( flight_in_group ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DO 10 TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '000' && sy-index. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_grouped IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_equal( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_group).
      lv_total_flights = lv_total_flights + lines( ls_group-flights ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_between( act = ls_group-group_id exp_low = 1 exp_high = 3 ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_flights exp = 10 ).

CLASS zcl_random_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_random_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dates) TYPE tt_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_dates.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_year) = lv_current_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_year) = lv_current_year && '1231'.

    DATA(lv_days_in_year) = cl_abap_date_helper=>days_between( iv_date1 = lv_first_day_of_year iv_date2 = lv_last_day_of_year ) + 1.

    DATA(lo_random_day) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = lv_days_in_year - 1 ).

    rt_dates = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                        LET lv_random_offset = lo_random->get_next( ) IN
                        ( cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = lv_first_day_of_year iv_days = lv_random_offset ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_strings IMPLEMENTATION.

                          ( lv_random_string ) ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen 'Zufallswalk' über 10 Schritte, bei dem ein Startwert in jedem Schritt zufällig um -1, 0 oder +1 geändert wird. Protokollieren Sie den Wert nach jedem Schritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Schrittänderung und `REDUCE` mit `sy-tabix` zur Protokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_walk DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_walk_step,
             step_number TYPE i,
             value       TYPE i,
           END OF ty_walk_step.
    TYPES tt_walk_steps TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_walk_step WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_walk
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_value TYPE i DEFAULT 0
        iv_num_steps   TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_walk_history) TYPE tt_walk_steps.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_walk IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_walk.
    DATA(lo_random_change) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = -1 max = 1 ).

    rt_walk_history = REDUCE tt_walk_steps( INIT current_value = iv_start_value
                                                 walk_steps    = VALUE tt_walk_steps( ( step_number = 0 value = iv_start_value ) )
                                           FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_steps
                                           NEXT current_value = current_value + lo_random_change->get_next( )
                                                walk_steps    = VALUE #( BASE walk_steps ( step_number = i value = current_value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_simulate_walk FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_steps FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_walk.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_walk( ).
    DATA(lt_history) = lo_cut->simulate_walk( iv_start_value = 10 iv_num_steps = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_history ) exp = 6 ). " 0-indexed steps
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_history[ 1 ]-step_number exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_history[ 1 ]-value exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_history[ 6 ]-step_number exp = 5 ).

    LOOP AT lt_history INTO DATA(ls_step).
      IF ls_step-step_number > 0.
        DATA(lv_prev_value) = lt_history[ ls_step-step_number ]-value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_between( act = ls_step-value exp_low = lv_prev_value - 1 exp_high = lv_prev_value + 1 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_steps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_walk( ).
    DATA(lt_history) = lo_cut->simulate_walk( iv_start_value = 5 iv_num_steps = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_history ) exp = 1 ). " Only initial step
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_history[ 1 ]-step_number exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_history[ 1 ]-value exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer zufälligen Anzahl von Spalten (z.B. 2-5 Spalten) und füllen Sie diese mit zufälligen Werten. Die Spaltennamen sollen 'COL_1', 'COL_2' etc. sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Spaltenanzahl und `cl_abap_structdescr` zum dynamischen Erstellen des Zeilentyps. `sy-tabix` kann für die Spaltennamen und Zeilenanzahl genutzt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_random_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_random_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_random_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_random_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_random_cols) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 2 max = 5 ).
    DATA(lv_num_columns) = lo_random_cols->get_next( ).

    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DO lv_num_columns TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component( name = |COL_{ sy-tabix }| type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO lt_components.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 65 max = 90 ).

    DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_line>).
      DO lv_num_columns TIMES.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-tabix OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_field>).
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          DATA(lv_random_string) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR j = 1 THEN j + 1 WHILE j <= 5
                                                  NEXT s = s && cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_by_encoding( 'UTF-8' )->convert_from( x = lo_random_char->get_next( ) ) ).
          <fs_field> = lv_random_string.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von 10 zufälligen Ganzzahlen zwischen 1 und 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `REDUCE` mit `sy-tabix`.

CLASS zcl_random_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_random_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_random_sum.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 100 ).

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                       NEXT s = s + lo_random->get_next( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflight` so, dass nur jeder 5. Flug in der Ergebnisliste enthalten ist. Die Auswahl soll deterministisch sein.

CLASS zcl_filter_by_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_every_nth_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_n TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_by_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_every_nth_flight.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    IF lt_all_sflights IS INITIAL OR iv_n <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( sy-tabix MOD iv_n ) = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_search_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_random_number_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_size TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_min_val    TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max_val    TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_search_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_random_number_index.
    DATA(lo_random_table_val) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = iv_min_val max = iv_max_val ).
    DATA(lo_random_search_val) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = iv_min_val max = iv_max_val ).

    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_table_size
                                         ( lo_random_table_val->get_next( ) ) ).

    DATA(lv_search_value) = lo_random_search_val->get_next( ).

    rv_index = LINE_INDEX( lt_numbers[ table_line = lv_search_value ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 10 zufälligen Ganzzahlen. Ersetzen Sie jeden Eintrag, dessen Index (`sy-tabix`) eine Primzahl ist, durch eine neue zufällige Zahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `FOR` mit `sy-tabix` und einer Hilfsfunktion zur Primzahlprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_prime_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_prime_indexed_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_size TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_min_val    TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max_val    TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS is_prime IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_prime) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_prime_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_prime_indexed_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random_initial) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = iv_min_val max = iv_max_val ).
    DATA(lo_random_replace) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = iv_min_val max = iv_max_val ).

    DATA lt_initial_numbers TYPE tt_numbers.
    lt_initial_numbers = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_table_size
                                  ( lo_random_initial->get_next( ) ) ).

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number_line IN lt_initial_numbers
                          LET lv_new_value = COND #( WHEN is_prime( sy-tabix ) = abap_true THEN lo_random_replace->get_next( ) ELSE number_line ) IN
                          ( lv_new_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_prime.
    IF iv_number <= 1.
      rv_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_number = 2.
      rv_is_prime = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_number MOD 2 = 0.
      rv_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_limit) = sqrt( iv_number ).
    DO.
      DATA(lv_divisor) = sy-index * 2 + 1.
      IF lv_divisor > lv_limit.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      IF iv_number MOD lv_divisor = 0.
        rv_is_prime = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_is_prime = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_primes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_prime_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_prime_indexed_numbers( iv_table_size = 10 iv_min_val = 10 iv_max_val = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 10 ).

    " Prime indices up to 10: 2, 3, 5, 7
    " Check that values at prime indices are different from initial (highly probable)
    " This test is probabilistic due to randomness, but should pass almost always.
    DATA(lo_random_initial_fixed) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = 1 min = 10 max = 20 ).
    DATA(lt_initial_fixed) = VALUE zcl_random_prime_replace=>tt_numbers( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 10
                                                                          ( lo_random_initial_fixed->get_next( ) ) ).

    DATA(lo_random_replace_fixed) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = 2 min = 10 max = 20 ).
    DATA(lt_expected_result) = VALUE zcl_random_prime_replace::tt_numbers( FOR number_line IN lt_initial_fixed
                                                                           LET lv_new_value = COND #( WHEN zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( sy-tabix ) = abap_true THEN lo_random_replace_fixed->get_next( ) ELSE number_line ) IN
                                                                           ( lv_new_value ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_prime.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 1 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 2 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 3 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 4 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 5 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 6 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 7 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 9 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 11 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 15 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_random_prime_replace=>is_prime( 17 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_prime_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_prime_indexed_numbers( iv_table_size = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die bedingte Ersetzung von Werten in einer internen Tabelle basierend auf dem Index (`sy-tabix`). Zuerst wird eine Tabelle mit zufälligen Zahlen erstellt. Dann wird eine `FOR`-Expression verwendet, um die Tabelle zu durchlaufen. Innerhalb der `FOR`-Expression prüft eine `COND`-Expression, ob `sy-tabix` eine Primzahl ist (mithilfe einer privaten Hilfsmethode `is_prime`). CLASS zcl_random_last_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_random_number_last_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_size TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_min_val    TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max_val    TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_last_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_random_number_last_index.
    DATA(lo_random_table_val) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = iv_min_val max = iv_max_val ).
    DATA(lo_random_search_val) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = iv_min_val max = iv_max_val ).

    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_table_size
                                         ( lo_random_table_val->get_next( ) ) ).

    DATA(lv_search_value) = lo_random_search_val->get_next( ).

    " Find last occurrence by iterating from the end
    LOOP AT lt_numbers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_number>) FROM iv_table_size TO 1.
      IF <fs_number> = lv_search_value.
        rv_index = sy-tabix.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " If not found, rv_index remains 0
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_last_index FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_occurrence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_last_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_last_index( ).
    " Create a predictable table for testing
    DATA(lo_random_table_val_fixed) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = 1 min = 1 max = 5 ).
    DATA(lt_numbers_fixed) = VALUE zcl_random_last_index=>tt_numbers( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 10
                                                                       ( lo_random_table_val_fixed->get_next( ) ) ).
    " Example: [3, 5, 2, 4, 1, 3, 5, 2, 4, 1]
    " Search for 3, last index should be 6
    DATA(lo_random_search_val_fixed) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = 1 min = 3 max = 3 ).
    DATA(lv_search_value_fixed) = lo_random_search_val_fixed->get_next( ).

    DATA(lv_index) = lo_cut->find_random_number_last_index( iv_table_size = 10 iv_min_val = 1 iv_max_val = 5 ).
    " Due to randomness in the test, we can't assert exact index, but we can assert it's within bounds if found.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_index IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_equal( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lv_index exp = 10 ).

    " Specific test for fixed data
    DATA(lv_expected_index) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers_fixed ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_num>) FROM 10 TO 1.
      IF <fs_num> = lv_search_value_fixed.
        lv_expected_index = sy-tabix.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->find_random_number_last_index( iv_table_size = 10 iv_min_val = 1 iv_max_val = 5 ) exp = lv_expected_index ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_last_index( ).
    " Generate numbers in a small range, then search for a number outside that range.
    DATA(lo_random_table_val_fixed) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = 1 min = 1 max = 5 ).
    DATA(lo_random_search_val_fixed) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = 2 min = 100 max = 100 ).

    DATA(lt_numbers_fixed) = VALUE zcl_random_last_index=>tt_numbers( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 5
                                                                       ( lo_random_table_val_fixed->get_next( ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_search_value_fixed) = lo_random_search_val_fixed->get_next( ).

    DATA(lv_index) = lo_cut->find_random_number_last_index( iv_table_size = 5 iv_min_val = 1 iv_max_val = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_last_index( ).
    DATA(lv_index) = lo_cut->find_random_number_last_index( iv_table_size = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_occurrence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_last_index( ).
    " Create a predictable table with one occurrence of the search value
    DATA(lo_random_table_val_fixed) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = 1 min = 1 max = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_random_search_val_fixed) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = 2 min = 5 max = 5 ).

    DATA(lt_numbers_fixed) = VALUE zcl_random_last_index=>tt_numbers( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 5
                                                                       ( COND #( WHEN i = 3 THEN 5 ELSE 1 ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_search_value_fixed) = lo_random_search_val_fixed->get_next( ).

    DATA(lv_index) = lo_cut->find_random_number_last_index( iv_table_size = 5 iv_min_val = 1 iv_max_val = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel generiert eine interne Tabelle mit zufälligen Ganzzahlen und sucht dann den Index des *letzten* Vorkommens einer ebenfalls zufällig ausgewählten Zahl. `cl_abap_random_int` wird verwendet, um die Zahlen zu generieren. Die `VALUE`-Expression mit einer `FOR`-Schleife erstellt die Tabelle. Um das letzte Vorkommen zu finden, wird eine `LOOP AT ... FROM ... TO ...` Schleife verwendet, die die Tabelle von hinten nach vorne durchläuft. `sy-tabix` liefert dabei den korrekten Index des gefundenen Elements.
keywords: RANDOM, cl_abap_random_int, Internal Tables, LOOP, sy-tabix, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_passengers,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_passengers.
    TYPES tt_carrier_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_passengers_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_passengers) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT sum = sum + <member>-seatsocc ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_passengers( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid total_passengers = lv_total_passengers ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_group_by_carrier=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers_by_carrier( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-total_passengers exp = 150 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-total_passengers exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator, um Daten effizient nach einem Kriterium zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Alternative zu klassischen Schleifen und `COLLECT`.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft, aber nur solche, bei denen mindestens ein Flug in der Gruppe mehr als 100 Passagiere hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY ... GROUP WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_info.
    TYPES tt_carrier_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_high_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_high_occupancy.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight)
         GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
         GROUP WHERE ( FILTER #( GROUP ls_sflight USING KEY default WHERE seatsocc > 100 ) IS NOT INITIAL )
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_info( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid num_flights = lines( GROUP ls_sflight ) ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `GROUP WHERE` ermöglicht es, Gruppen basierend auf einer Bedingung zu filtern, die auf die Mitglieder der Gruppe angewendet wird. Hier wird `FILTER` verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob mindestens ein Mitglied der Gruppe die Bedingung erfüllt.
keywords: GROUP BY, GROUP WHERE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

CLASS zcl_group_by_size_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_stats,
             group_index TYPE i,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             group_size  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_stats.
    TYPES tt_group_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_group_statistics
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_group_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_size_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_group_statistics.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_group_stats(
        group_index = GROUP INDEX
        carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
        group_size  = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum gruppiert, und listen Sie für jede Gruppe die Flugnummern auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             connids  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_details.
    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid fldate = ls_group-fldate )
      ( 
        carrid  = ls_group-carrid,
        fldate  = ls_group-fldate,
        connids = VALUE #( FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group ( <member>-connid ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: VALUE, FOR GROUPS, Internal Tables, Grouping, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Gruppe die Fluggesellschaft, das Flugdatum und die Anzahl der Flüge enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_summary.
    TYPES tt_grouped_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_summary) = CORRESPONDING ty_grouped_summary( ls_group_key ).
      ls_summary-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie für jede Gruppe eine kommaseparierte Liste der Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `FOR` mit `REDUCE` für die String-Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_for_members DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connids,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid_list TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_connids.
    TYPES tt_carrier_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connid_list_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_for_members IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_list_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_connid_list) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <member>-connid ELSE s && `, ` && <member>-connid ) ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_connids( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid connid_list = lv_connid_list ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_connid_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_for_members( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_group_by_for_members=>tt_sflight(

CLASS zcl_group_by_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Für jede Gruppe soll ein Anwendungsprotokoll-Objekt (`cl_bal_logobj`) erstellt und die Flugdetails in dieses Protokoll geschrieben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und instanziieren Sie `cl_bal_logobj` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_bal_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_with_log
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log_handles) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bal_logh WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_bal_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_with_log.
    DATA: lo_log_header TYPE REF TO cl_bal_log_create,
          ls_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      " Create a new log object for each group
      lo_log_header = NEW cl_bal_log_create( ).
      lo_log_header->set_object( 'SFLIGHT' ).
      lo_log_header->set_subobject( 'GROUPING' ).
      lo_log_header->set_extnumber( |{ ls_group_key-carrid }-{ ls_group_key-fldate }| ).
      lo_log_header->set_aluser( sy-uname ).
      lo_log_header->set_aldate( sy-datum ).
      lo_log_header->set_altime( sy-uzeit ).
      ls_log_handle = lo_log_header->create_log( ).
      APPEND ls_log_handle TO rt_log_handles.

      " Add messages for each member of the group
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group INTO DATA(<member>).
        DATA(lo_message) = NEW cl_bal_log_msg_create( ).
        lo_message->set_log_handle( ls_log_handle ).
        lo_message->set_msgty( 'I' ).
        lo_message->set_msgid( 'SFLIGHT' ). " Example message class
        lo_message->set_msgno( '000' ). " Example message number
        lo_message->set_msgv1( |Flug { <member>-connid }| ).
        lo_message->set_msgv2( |Datum { <member>-fldate }| ).
        lo_message->create_message( ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Save all logs
    cl_bal_log_db_save=>save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe den Flug mit den meisten Passagieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `MAX`-Operator innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_max_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_carrier_max_flight.
    TYPES tt_carrier_max_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_max_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_occupancy_flight_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_max_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_occupancy_flight_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE ty_sflight(
        INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( seatsocc = -1 )
        FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN <member>-seatsocc > max_flight-seatsocc THEN <member> ELSE max_flight )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_max_flight( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid connid = ls_max_flight-connid seatsocc = ls_max_flight-seatsocc ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe sollen die Flüge in 'hohe Auslastung' (seatsocc > 150) und 'normale Auslastung' (seatsocc <= 150) unterteilt und die Anzahl pro Kategorie gezählt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` oder `REDUCE` mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy_stats,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high_occupancy TYPE i,
             normal_occupancy TYPE i,
           END OF ty_occupancy_stats.
    TYPES tt_occupancy_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_stats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_occupancy_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_stats_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_stats) = REDUCE ty_occupancy_stats(
        INIT high = 0 normal = 0
        FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT
          high = high + COND #( WHEN <member>-seatsocc > 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ),
          normal = normal + COND #( WHEN <member>-seatsocc <= 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_occupancy_stats( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid high_occupancy = ls_stats-high normal_occupancy = ls_stats-normal ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 200 )

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '005' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 150 )

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (seatsocc) pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für Summe und `GROUP SIZE` für den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_occupancy,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_occupancy TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupancy_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seatsocc) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT sum = sum + <member>-seatsocc ).
      DATA(lv_group_size) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_average) = COND decfloat16( WHEN lv_group_size > 0 THEN lv_total_seatsocc / lv_group_size ELSE 0 ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_avg_occupancy( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid average_occupancy = lv_average ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_group_by_average=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_average_occupancy_by_carrier( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-average_occupancy exp = '75.0' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-average_occupancy exp = '200.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` die Summe der Auslastung berechnet und diese dann durch `GROUP SIZE` teilt, um den Durchschnitt zu erhalten. Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT16` für die Durchschnittsberechnung gewährleistet Genauigkeit.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass ein ungültiger JSON-String deserialisiert werden soll.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_fdt_json_parse_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_simple_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_simple_data) TYPE ty_simple_data
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        cl_fdt_json=>create_data_from_json( EXPORTING iv_json_string = iv_json_string
                                             IMPORTING eo_data        = DATA(lo_data_ref) ).
        ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_simple>).
        rs_simple_data = CORRESPONDING #( <fs_simple> ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_fdt_json_parse_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_parse_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling( lv_invalid_json ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_fdt_json_parse_error but none was raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_parse_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'cx_fdt_json_parse_error caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit der spezifischen Ausnahme `cx_fdt_json_parse_error` ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei der Deserialisierung ungültiger JSON-Strings.
keywords: JSON, Error Handling, Exception, TRY CATCH, cl_fdt_json

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_from_data( it_any_table ).

    CREATE DATA rt_processed_table LIKE it_any_table.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Verhalten von `cl_fdt_json` beim Serialisieren und Deserialisieren von Strukturen mit Feldern, die Initialwerte haben oder im JSON-String fehlen.
hint: Initialwerte werden standardmäßig nicht serialisiert. Beim Deserialisieren werden fehlende Felder mit Initialwerten belegt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_optional_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_data,
             setting_id   TYPE string,
             value        TYPE string,
             is_active    TYPE abap_bool,
             description  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config_data.

    METHODS serialize_config
      IMPORTING
        is_config TYPE ty_config_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS deserialize_config
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_config) TYPE ty_config_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_optional_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_config.
    rv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_from_data( is_config ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_config.
    cl_fdt_json=>create_data_from_json( EXPORTING iv_json_string = iv_json_string
                                         IMPORTING eo_data        = DATA(lo_data_ref) ).
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_config>).
    rs_config = CORRESPONDING #( <fs_config> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (Feld `SEATSCCK`) für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                         FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                         NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatscck ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_str DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
