CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_str IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

                            FOR flight IN lt_sflights

hint: Verwende `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_passengers,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_passengers.
    TYPES tt_carrid_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passengers_by_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrid_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passengers_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, seatscck FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                         ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                           total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatscck ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_earliest_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_earliest_appointment
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_earliest_appointment) TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_earliest_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_earliest_appointment.
    ro_earliest_appointment = REDUCE REF TO cl_appointment(
      INIT earliest_app = VALUE REF TO cl_appointment( )
      FOR app IN it_appointments
      NEXT earliest_app = COND REF TO cl_appointment(
        WHEN earliest_app IS INITIAL OR app->get_date_from( ) < earliest_app->get_date_from( )
          THEN app
        WHEN app->get_date_from( ) = earliest_app->get_date_from( ) AND app->get_time_from( ) < earliest_app->get_time_from( )
          THEN app
        ELSE earliest_app
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_appointments_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_appointments_in_month
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        iv_year         TYPE syear
        iv_month        TYPE sy-monat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_appointments_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_appointments_in_month.
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_month) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_month( iv_year = iv_year iv_month = iv_month ).
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_month) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_last_day_of_month( iv_year = iv_year iv_month = iv_month ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_appointments) = FILTER #( it_appointments USING KEY default
      WHERE get_date_from( ) GE lv_first_day_of_month AND get_date_from( ) LE lv_last_day_of_month ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR app IN lt_filtered_appointments
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_total_appointment_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_total_appointment_duration IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_filtered_appointments) = FILTER #( it_appointments USING KEY default

                                 FOR app IN lt_filtered_appointments

                                     iv_time_from = app->get_time_from( )

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lufthansa_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                            connid = ls_flight-connid,
                            fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                            flight_info = |Flugnummer: { ls_flight-connid }, Datum: { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode einer anderen Klasse aufruft, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die aufgerufene Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Angaben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_object      TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lt_parameters  TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter   TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        " Get class description
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).

        " Create object instance
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        " Prepare return parameter for dynamic method call
        ls_parameter-name = 'RV_RESULT'. " Assuming the method returns a parameter named RV_RESULT
        GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
        APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

        " Call method dynamically
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_dyn_call_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for dynamic call
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_hello_world RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_abap_version RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_result = 'Hello World from dynamic call!'.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Werte einer Spalte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_ua FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price msg = 'Total price for LH should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_price > 0 ) msg = 'Total price for LH should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_ua.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price msg = 'Total price for UA should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_price > 0 ) msg = 'Total price for UA should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Er ist sehr mächtig, um komplexe Berechnungen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung durchzuführen. `PRIVATE SECTION` wird für die Kapselung der Testmethoden verwendet.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt und diese mit einer geeigneten Ausnahmebehandlung abfängt. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` und eine vordefinierte Ausnahme.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_division_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_division_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        " Re-raise the exception or handle it as needed
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_zerodivide.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Sie ermöglichen eine saubere Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung. `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ist eine vordefinierte Systemausnahme für Division durch Null. `PRIVATE SECTION` wird für die Kapselung der Testmethoden verwendet.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY CATCH, Exceptions, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität für Economy-Sitze haben. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer geeigneten Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_by_eco_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_eco_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_eco_capacity.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE seatsocc >= iv_min_eco_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should find flights with capacity >= 100' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsocc >= 100 ) msg = 'Capacity should be >= 100' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_capacity( ).

Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und oft performanter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte. `PRIVATE SECTION` wird für die Kapselung der Testmethoden verwendet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentypnamen erzeugt und mit einigen Daten füllt. Die Daten sollen dann zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit dynamischem Typ und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA ro_data_ref TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name).
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lo_line_ref) LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
      ASSIGN lo_line_ref->* TO <ls_line>.

      IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Assuming the table type has at least two fields for demonstration
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_field> = 'Value 1A'.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 2 OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_field> = 'Value 1B'.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_field> = 'Value 2A'.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 2 OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_field> = 'Value 2B'.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper structure for dynamic table creation
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
         field1 TYPE string,
         field2 TYPE string,
       END OF ty_dynamic_data.
TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_data_error.
    METHODS test_invalid_table_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'TT_DYNAMIC_DATA' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should contain 2 entries' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE ty_dynamic_data.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_line>-field1 exp = 'Value 1A' ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_CREATE_DATA_ERROR for invalid type' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. `PRIVATE SECTION` wird für die Kapselung der Testmethoden verwendet.

CLASS zcl_join_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_join_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_busy_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_busy_carriers.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sflights AS sub WHERE sub~carrid = s~carrid GROUP BY sub~carrid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 )
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stack_temp_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_stack_temp_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_based_on_temp.
    DATA(lv_temperature) = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_stack_temperature_for_obj( io_data_ref ).

    CASE lv_temperature.
      WHEN 'H'.
        rv_log_message = 'Daten sind heiß: Aktive Verarbeitung fortsetzen.'.
      WHEN 'C'.
        rv_log_message = 'Daten sind kalt: Möglicherweise für Archivierung oder Verlagerung prüfen.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_log_message = 'Temperatur unbekannt: Standardverarbeitung.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `RIGHT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `scarr` und `sflights` durch, um alle Fluggesellschaften und deren zugehörige Flüge zu erhalten, auch wenn eine Fluggesellschaft keine Flüge hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... RIGHT OUTER JOIN ... ON ... INTO TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_right_outer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_optional_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_right_outer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_optional_flights.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM scarr AS c
      RIGHT OUTER JOIN sflights AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrier_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carriers_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carriers_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_right_outer( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_optional_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_results ). " Assuming sflights might be empty in test system
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results ). " Or assert_not_initial if data is expected
    IF lines( lt_results ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `RIGHT OUTER JOIN` gibt alle Zeilen aus der rechten Tabelle (`sflights`) zurück und die passenden Zeilen aus der linken Tabelle (`scarr`). Wenn keine Übereinstimmung gefunden wird, werden für die Spalten der linken Tabelle NULL-Werte zurückgegeben. Dies ist das Gegenstück zum `LEFT OUTER JOIN`.
keywords: JOIN, RIGHT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, Database Access

INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    rv_info = SWITCH #( io_shape
                        WHEN TYPE zcl_circle THEN
                          CAST zcl_circle( io_shape )->zif_shape~get_description( )
                        WHEN TYPE zcl_square THEN
                          CAST zcl_square( io_shape )->zif_shape~get_description( )
                        ELSE
                          'Unbekannte Form' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Endpreis eines Artikels. Wenn der Basispreis über 100 liegt, gibt es 10% Rabatt. Definiere den Rabattbetrag lokal im Ausdruck.
hint: Kombiniere COND mit dem LET Ausdruck, um lokale Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks zu verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_let DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_let IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    rv_final_price = COND #( LET discount_rate = CONV decfloat16( '0.10' ) IN
                                 WHEN iv_base_price > 100 THEN iv_base_price * ( 1 - discount_rate )
                                 ELSE iv_base_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_task_priority DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_task_priority IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_priority.
    rv_priority = SWITCH string(
                      WHEN is_task_status-is_urgent = abap_true THEN 'Sehr Hoch'
                      WHEN is_task_status-status_code = 'A' THEN 'Hoch'
                      WHEN is_task_status-status_code = 'B' THEN 'Mittel'
                      WHEN is_task_status-status_code = 'C' THEN 'Niedrig'
                      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simuliere die Verarbeitung von Entitäten in einem 'FOR MODIFY' Handler, um Daten zu aktualisieren. Die Simulation soll die Logik für das Setzen von 'failed' und 'reported' Nachrichten demonstrieren.
hint: Definiere lokale Typen, die den RAP-Strukturen für 'CREATE' und 'UPDATE' sowie 'failed' und 'reported' ähneln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_modify_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_create,
             key        TYPE string,
             field1     TYPE string,
             field2     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_create,
           ty_t_create TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_create WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_update,
             key        TYPE string,
             field1     TYPE string,
             field2     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_update,
           ty_t_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_failed_key,
             key TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_failed_key,
           ty_t_failed_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_failed_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_reported_message,
             key     TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
             type    TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_s_reported_message,
           ty_t_reported_message TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_reported_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_for_modify
      IMPORTING
        it_create_data TYPE ty_t_create OPTIONAL
        it_update_data TYPE ty_t_update OPTIONAL
      EXPORTING
        et_failed      TYPE ty_t_failed_key
        et_reported    TYPE ty_t_reported_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_modify_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_for_modify.
    " Simulate CREATE operations
    LOOP AT it_create_data INTO DATA(ls_create).
      IF ls_create-field1 IS INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_failed_key( key = ls_create-key ) TO et_failed.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_reported_message( key = ls_create-key message = 'Field1 darf nicht leer sein.' type = 'E' ) TO et_reported.
      ELSE.
        " Simulate successful creation
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_reported_message( key = ls_create-key message = 'Entität erfolgreich angelegt.' type = 'S' ) TO et_reported.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Simulate UPDATE operations
    LOOP AT it_update_data INTO DATA(ls_update).
      IF ls_update-field2 IS INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_failed_key( key = ls_update-key ) TO et_failed.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_reported_message( key = ls_update-key message = 'Field2 darf nicht leer sein.' type = 'E' ) TO et_reported.
      ELSE.
        " Simulate successful update
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_reported_message( key = ls_update-key message = 'Entität erfolgreich aktualisiert.' type = 'S' ) TO et_reported.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_read_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_read_key,
             key TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_read_key,
           ty_t_read_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_read_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_entity_data,
             key        TYPE string,
             field1     TYPE string,
             field2     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_entity_data,
           ty_t_entity_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_entity_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_for_read
      IMPORTING
        it_read_keys TYPE ty_t_read_key
      EXPORTING
        et_result    TYPE ty_t_entity_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_mock_data TYPE ty_t_entity_data.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_read_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    gt_mock_data = VALUE #(
      ( key = 'E1' field1 = 'Data1A' field2 = 'Data1B' )
      ( key = 'E2' field1 = 'Data2A' field2 = 'Data2B' )
      ( key = 'E3' field1 = 'Data3A' field2 = 'Data3B' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_for_read.
    LOOP AT it_read_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      READ TABLE gt_mock_data INTO DATA(ls_entity) WITH KEY key = ls_key-key.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_entity TO et_result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_validate_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_validate_key,
             key        TYPE string,
             field_to_validate TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_validate_key,
           ty_t_validate_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_validate_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_failed_key,
             key TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_failed_key,
           ty_t_failed_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_failed_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_reported_message,

        et_reported      TYPE ty_t_reported_message.

CLASS zcl_rap_validate_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_for_validate.
    LOOP AT it_validate_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      IF ls_data-field_to_validate IS INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_failed_key( key = ls_data-key ) TO et_failed.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_reported_message( key = ls_data-key message = 'Feld darf nicht leer sein.' type = 'E' ) TO et_reported.
      ELSEIF strlen( ls_data-field_to_validate ) < 3.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_failed_key( key = ls_data-key ) TO et_failed.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_reported_message( key = ls_data-key message = 'Feld muss mindestens 3 Zeichen lang sein.' type = 'E' ) TO et_reported.
      ELSE.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_reported_message( key = ls_data-key message = 'Validierung erfolgreich.' type = 'S' ) TO et_reported.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reported[ 1 ]-message exp = 'Status auf ''COMPLETED'' geändert.' ).

  METHOD test_action_fail.

                                 IMPORTING et_reported    = lt_reported ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_reported ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reported[ 1 ]-type exp = 'E' ).

Es zeigt, wie eine Business-Aktion auf ausgewählte Entitäten angewendet und 'reported'-Nachrichten zurückgegeben werden. Die Verwendung von lokalen Typen und Inline-Deklarationen ist modern. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine vereinfachte Simulation ist; ein vollständiger RAP-Handler würde in einer Klasse implementiert, die von `cl_abap_behavior_handler` erbt und die RAP-spezifischen Schnittstellen und Kontextobjekte nutzt.

CLASS zcl_calendar_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_date TYPE d.

CLASS zcl_calendar_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_selected_dates.

    rt_processed_dates = FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_dates

Erstellen Sie eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_SALES_ANALYST`, die auf diese private Tabelle zugreift und den Gesamtumsatz unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE` Ausdrucks berechnet.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FRIENDS` Deklaration und den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sales_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sale_item,
             product TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
             price   TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sale_item.
    TYPES tt_sale_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sale_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_sale IMPORTING iv_product TYPE string iv_quantity TYPE i iv_price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mt_sales TYPE tt_sale_items.
  FRIENDS: zcl_sales_analyst.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_sale.
    APPEND VALUE #( product = iv_product quantity = iv_quantity price = iv_price ) TO mt_sales.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sales_analyst DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_revenue IMPORTING io_sales_data TYPE REF TO zcl_sales_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_analyst IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    " Access private attribute mt_sales of zcl_sales_data
    rv_total = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_revenue TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 = 0
      FOR ls_sale IN io_sales_data->mt_sales
      NEXT total_revenue = total_revenue + ( ls_sale-quantity * ls_sale-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein `cl_gui_calendar` Control verwaltet und auf das `DATE_SELECTED` Ereignis reagiert. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck, um unterschiedliche Aktionen basierend auf dem Wochentag des ausgewählten Datums auszuführen.
hint: Implementieren Sie eine Event-Handler-Methode und nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für die Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS:
      handle_date_selected FOR EVENT date_selected OF cl_gui_calendar
        IMPORTING
          sender
          date.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'. " This would be a screen element in a real report

    CREATE OBJECT mo_calendar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER handle_date_selected FOR mo_calendar.

    " Simulate date selection for testing purposes
    " In a real scenario, this would be triggered by user interaction
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum. " Today's date
    RAISE EVENT date_selected EXPORTING date = lv_test_date.

    out->write( mv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_date_selected.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday( date ).

    mv_message = SWITCH #( lv_weekday
      WHEN 1 THEN |Montag: Wochenstart! Datum: { date DATE = USER }|
      WHEN 5 THEN |Freitag: Fast Wochenende! Datum: { date DATE = USER }|
      WHEN 6 THEN |Samstag: Wochenende! Datum: { date DATE = USER }|
      WHEN 7 THEN |Sonntag: Wochenende! Datum: { date DATE = USER }|
      ELSE |Wochentag: { lv_weekday }. Datum: { date DATE = USER }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_date_selection_monday.

Der `SWITCH` Ausdruck bietet eine elegante und lesbare Möglichkeit, bedingte Logik basierend auf dem Wochentag zu implementieren, anstatt verschachtelte `IF`-Anweisungen zu verwenden. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Feiertagen verwaltet. Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_calendar`, um diese Feiertage im Kalender hervorzuheben. Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` oder Tabellenausdrücke, um zu prüfen, ob ein Datum ein Feiertag ist, bevor es im Kalender markiert wird. Verwenden Sie die `sflights` Tabelle als Quelle für 'besondere' Daten (z.B. Flugdaten).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_calendar=>set_special_date` und `LINE_EXISTS` mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_holidays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: ty_date TYPE d.
    TYPES tt_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_holidays_in_calendar
      IMPORTING
        io_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar
        it_holidays TYPE tt_dates.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_holidays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_calendar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    " Simulate holidays from sflights data
    DATA(lt_sflights_dates) = VALUE tt_dates(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '400' ) " Example filter
      ( ls_sflight-fldate )
    ).

    set_holidays_in_calendar(
      io_calendar = mo_calendar
      it_holidays = lt_sflights_dates
    ).

    " In a real report, the calendar would be displayed on a screen.
    " For ADT classrun, we just demonstrate the logic.
    out->write( |Calendar special dates set based on sflights data.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_holidays_in_calendar.
    LOOP AT it_holidays INTO DATA(lv_holiday_date).
      " Check if the date already exists as a special date (simplified for demo)
      " In a real scenario, cl_gui_calendar might have a get_special_dates method
      " or you'd manage the list internally.
      " Here, we just demonstrate LINE_EXISTS for a generic check.
      IF LINE_EXISTS( it_holidays[ table_line = lv_holiday_date ] ).
        io_calendar->set_special_date(
          EXPORTING
            date = lv_holiday_date
            color = cl_gui_calendar=>co_color_red
            tooltip = |Flugdatum: { lv_holiday_date DATE = USER }|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_special_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_special_dates.
    DATA(lo_calendar) = NEW cl_gui_calendar( ). " Dummy calendar for testing
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_calendar_holidays( ).
    DATA(lt_test_holidays) = VALUE zcl_calendar_holidays=>tt_dates(
      ( '20231224' )
      ( '20231225' )
    ).

    " We cannot directly assert GUI changes in a unit test.
    " Instead, we assert that the method runs without error and
    " potentially check internal state if the class were designed to track it.
    " For this example, we'll just ensure the method can be called.
    TRY.
        lo_handler->set_holidays_in_calendar(
          io_calendar = lo_calendar
          it_holidays = lt_test_holidays
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Assert that no exception occurred
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception occurred during set_holidays_in_calendar' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `LINE_EXISTS` Ausdruck in Kombination mit einem Tabellenausdruck bietet eine effiziente Möglichkeit, die Existenz eines Datums in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, bevor es im Kalender markiert wird. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Art der Datenprüfung.

CLASS zcl_order_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_order_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.
    METHODS get_order_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.

CLASS zcl_order_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein `cl_gui_calendar` Control dynamisch instanziiert und grundlegende Eigenschaften (z.B. Startdatum) über Method Chaining setzt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `NEW` Operator für die Instanziierung und rufen Sie Methoden direkt nacheinander auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS create_and_configure_calendar
      IMPORTING
        io_parent TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        iv_start_date TYPE d DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_calendar) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    DATA(lo_calendar) = create_and_configure_calendar(
      io_parent = mo_container
      iv_start_date = '20240101'
    ).

    out->write( |Calendar created and configured. Start date: { lo_calendar->get_date( ) DATE = USER }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_configure_calendar.
    ro_calendar = NEW cl_gui_calendar(
      parent = io_parent
    )->set_date(
      date = iv_start_date
    )->set_display_mode(
      display_mode = cl_gui_calendar=>co_display_month
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Flugdaten aus der `sflights` Tabelle abruft und diese Daten als 'besondere Daten' im `cl_gui_calendar` Control markiert. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne `SELECT` Syntax und `FOR` Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `cl_gui_calendar=>set_special_date`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS mark_sflight_dates
      IMPORTING
        io_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_calendar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    mark_sflight_dates( mo_calendar ).

    out->write( |Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS im Kalender markiert.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD mark_sflight_dates.
    " Modern SELECT syntax with inline declaration
    SELECT fldate, carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Use FOR expression to iterate and set special dates
    FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_data.
      io_calendar->set_special_date(
        EXPORTING
          date = ls_sflight-fldate
          color = cl_gui_calendar=>co_color_blue
          tooltip = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|
      ).
    ENDFOR.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_catalog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_product IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i iv_name TYPE string iv_price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
    METHODS get_product_price IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_price) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mt_products TYPE tt_products.
  FRIENDS: zcl_price_updater.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_catalog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_product.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = iv_id name = iv_name price = iv_price ) INTO TABLE mt_products.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_product_price.
    TRY.
        rv_price = mt_products[ id = iv_id ]-price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle error or return initial value
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_product_price
      IMPORTING
        io_catalog TYPE REF TO zcl_product_catalog
        iv_product_id TYPE i
        iv_new_price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_product_price.
    " Access private attribute mt_products of zcl_product_catalog
    TRY.
        io_catalog->mt_products[ id = iv_product_id ]-price = iv_new_price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle error: product not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein `cl_gui_calendar` Control verwaltet. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die das aktuelle Datum im Kalender setzt und dann mit einem `SWITCH` Ausdruck prüft, ob es sich um einen Wochentag oder ein Wochenende handelt, und eine entsprechende Meldung zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_calendar=>set_date`, `cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday` und den `SWITCH` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_weekday_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS check_date_type
      IMPORTING
        io_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar
        iv_date TYPE d DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_weekday_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_calendar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    DATA(lv_message) = check_date_type(
      io_calendar = mo_calendar
      iv_date = sy-datum
    ).
    out->write( lv_message ).

    lv_message = check_date_type(
      io_calendar = mo_calendar
      iv_date = '20231202' " A Sunday
    ).
    out->write( lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_date_type.
    io_calendar->set_date( date = iv_date ).
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday( iv_date ).

    rv_message = SWITCH #( lv_weekday
      WHEN 6 OR 7 THEN |{ iv_date DATE = USER } ist ein Wochenende.|
      ELSE |{ iv_date DATE = USER } ist ein Wochentag.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_weekend FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekday.
    DATA(lo_calendar) = NEW cl_gui_calendar( ). " Dummy calendar
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_calendar_weekday_check( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = '20231204'. " Tuesday
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_checker->check_date_type( io_calendar = lo_calendar iv_date = lv_test_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = |{ lv_test_date DATE = USER } ist ein Wochentag.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_weekend.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_INVENTORY` mit einer privaten internen Tabelle von Lagerbeständen (Material, Menge). Erstellen Sie eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_STOCK_CHECKER`, die auf diese private Tabelle zugreift und eine Liste aller Materialien mit einer Menge unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert unter Verwendung eines `FILTER` Ausdrucks mit `COND` für die Ausgabe generiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FRIENDS`, `FILTER` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inventory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_stock_item,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_stock_item.
    TYPES tt_stock_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_stock_item WITH UNIQUE KEY material.

    METHODS add_stock IMPORTING iv_material TYPE string iv_quantity TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mt_stock TYPE tt_stock_items.
  FRIENDS: zcl_stock_checker.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inventory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_stock.
    INSERT VALUE #( material = iv_material quantity = iv_quantity ) INTO TABLE mt_stock.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stock_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_low_stock_report,
             material TYPE string,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_low_stock_report.
    TYPES tt_low_stock_report TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_low_stock_report WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_low_stock_report
      IMPORTING
        io_inventory TYPE REF TO zcl_inventory
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_report) TYPE tt_low_stock_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stock_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_low_stock_report.
    " Access private attribute mt_stock of zcl_inventory
    rt_report = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_item IN FILTER #( io_inventory->mt_stock WHERE quantity < iv_threshold )
      ( material = ls_item-material
        status = COND string( WHEN ls_item-quantity = 0 THEN 'Out of Stock' ELSE 'Low Stock' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_low_stock_report FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_low_stock_report.
    DATA(lo_inventory) = NEW zcl_inventory( ).
    lo_inventory->add_stock( iv_material = 'Pen' iv_quantity = 5 ).
    lo_inventory->add_stock( iv_material = 'Paper' iv_quantity = 0 ).
    lo_inventory->add_stock( iv_material = 'Stapler' iv_quantity = 15 ).

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_stock_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_report) = lo_checker->get_low_stock_report(
      io_inventory = lo_inventory
      iv_threshold = 10
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_report ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_report[ 1 ]-material exp = 'Pen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_report[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Low Stock' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_report[ 2 ]-material exp = 'Paper' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_report[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Out of Stock' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_upload DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fes_upload IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_file_content.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(

        file_read_error      = 2

    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Exception werfen oder Log-Eintrag

    ENDIF.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upload.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_upload( ).
    " Dieser Test kann ohne eine echte Frontend-Interaktion nicht vollständig automatisiert werden.
    " Wir können nur den Aufruf selbst testen oder den Frontend-Service mocken.
    " Für die Demonstration nehmen wir einen erfolgreichen Aufruf an oder behandeln den Fehlerpfad.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` und Inline-Deklaration `INTO @DATA()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_single_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_single_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflight
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_single_select( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_flight-carrid
      msg = 'Flugdaten sollten für existierenden Flug nicht initial sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte übereinstimmen'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight-connid
      exp = '0017'
      msg = 'Flugnummer sollte übereinstimmen'
    ).

    " Test für nicht existierenden Flug
    CLEAR ls_flight.
    ls_flight = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_flight-carrid
      msg = 'Flugdaten sollten für nicht existierenden Flug initial sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert moderne Open SQL-Syntax mit `SELECT SINGLE FROM ... WHERE ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA()`. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen und Inline-Deklarationen verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: Open SQL, SELECT SINGLE, CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF, INTO @DATA, 7.40, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit ausgewählten Feldern.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        fldate = flight-fldate ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_for( ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights_summary( ).

    " Prüfen, ob LH-Flüge zurückgegeben werden (vorausgesetzt SFLIGHT enthält LH-Daten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_lh_flights )
      msg = 'Sollte einige LH-Flüge zurückgeben'
    ).

    " Prüfen, ob alle zurückgegebenen Flüge 'LH' sind
    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Alle zurückgegebenen Flüge sollten LH sein'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `FILTER` für die effiziente Manipulation interner Tabellen. `FILTER` ermöglicht das Filtern von Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen, und `FOR` in Verbindung mit `VALUE` erlaubt die direkte Konstruktion einer neuen Tabelle mit transformierten Daten, was den Code sehr kompakt macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, FILTER, 7.40, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Finden Sie den niedrigsten Preis unter allen Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_min DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_min IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_price = 0. " Oder Exception werfen
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT min_price TYPE sflight-price = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT min_price = COND #( WHEN flight-price < min_price THEN flight-price ELSE min_price ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_min_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_min_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_min( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price_aa) = lo_cut->get_min_price_for_carrier( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_min_price_lh) = lo_cut->get_min_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_min_price_non_existent) = lo_cut->get_min_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ).

    " Vorausgesetzt 'AA' hat einen Mindestpreis
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_min_price_aa
      msg = 'Mindestpreis für AA sollte nicht initial sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_min_price_aa > 0
      msg = 'Mindestpreis für AA sollte größer als 0 sein'
    ).

    " Vorausgesetzt 'LH' hat einen Mindestpreis
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_min_price_lh
      msg = 'Mindestpreis für LH sollte nicht initial sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_min_price_lh > 0
      msg = 'Mindestpreis für LH sollte größer als 0 sein'
    ).

    " Test für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_min_price_non_existent
      msg = 'Mindestpreis für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft sollte initial (0) sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verwendet den `REDUCE`-Operator, um iterativ den minimalen Flugpreis in einer internen Tabelle zu finden. Dies ist eine moderne, funktionale Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, die den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle Schleifen. Der `COND`-Operator wird für die bedingte Zuweisung innerhalb von `REDUCE` verwendet.
keywords: REDUCE, MINIMUM, Internal Tables, 7.50, SFLIGHT, COND

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf einer Status-ID.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cll_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cll_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status_id
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Abgesagt'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cll_switch( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'Pünktlich'
      msg = 'Status 1 sollte Pünktlich sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 2 )
      exp = 'Verspätet'
      msg = 'Status 2 sollte Verspätet sein'

CLASS zcl_itb_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_flight_key
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    TRY.
        rs_flight = it_flights[ carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. leere Struktur zurückgeben oder Exception werfen
        CLEAR rs_flight.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Flugnummern einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_connids.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      rv_connids_string = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_connids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid
        ELSE |{ s }, { flight-connid }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_string( ).
    DATA(lv_connids_aa) = lo_cut->concatenate_connids( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_connids_lh) = lo_cut->concatenate_connids( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_connids_non_existent) = lo_cut->concatenate_connids( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_connids_aa
      msg = 'Flugnummern für AA sollten nicht initial sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_connids_lh
      msg = 'Flugnummern für LH sollten nicht initial sein'
    ).

    " Prüfen, ob der String Kommas enthält (wenn mehr als ein Eintrag)
    IF count( val = lv_connids_aa sep = ',' ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
        act = lv_connids_aa
        exp = ','
        msg = 'String sollte Kommas enthalten'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_connids_non_existent
      msg = 'String für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft sollte initial sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code verwendet den `REDUCE`-Operator, um alle Flugnummern einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String zu verketten. Die Kombination mit `COND` und String-Templates macht dies zu einer sehr modernen und ausdrucksstarken Lösung, die eine explizite Schleife überflüssig macht.
keywords: REDUCE, String Processing, Internal Tables, 7.50, SFLIGHT, COND, STRING_TEMPLATES

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten. Die Feldnamen sollen 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'FLDATE' sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` zur dynamischen Typbeschreibung und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    ls_component-name = 'CARRID'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( 3 ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'CONNID'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_n( 4 ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).

    IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_carrid> = 'LH'.
      <fs_connid> = '0400'.
      <fs_fldate> = sy-datum.
      INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

      <fs_carrid> = 'AA'.
      <fs_connid> = '0017'.
      <fs_fldate> = sy-datum + 1.
      INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = <lt_table> IS INITIAL exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'First line should not be initial' act = <ls_line> IS INITIAL exp = abap_false ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID of first line should be LH' act = <fs_carrid> exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit. Durch die Verwendung von `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` können beliebige Strukturen und Tabellentypen definiert werden. `CREATE DATA` erzeugt dann eine Referenz auf das dynamische Datenobjekt. Der Zugriff auf die Komponenten erfolgt über Field-Symbols, was eine flexible Bearbeitung der Daten ermöglicht. Dies ist modern, da es die starre Typisierung zur Designzeit umgeht und flexible Lösungen für unbekannte Datenstrukturen bietet.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei sowohl der Methodenname als auch die Parameter zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die Methode soll eine einfache Addition durchführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE` und `EXCEPTION-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param1      TYPE i
        iv_param2      TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS add_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM1'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param1 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM2'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param2 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    DATA(lv_result_ref) = NEW i( ).
    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_SUM'.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_result_ref->* INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
        rv_result = lv_result_ref->*.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        " Handle dynamic call error
        MESSAGE lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_numbers_dynamic FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_numbers_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( iv_method_name = 'ADD_NUMBERS' iv_param1 = 5 iv_param2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic method call should return 8' act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' iv_param1 = 1 iv_param2 = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_DYN_CALL_ERROR for invalid method' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected CX_SY_DYN_CALL_ERROR' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf mit variablen Parametern. Die `CALL METHOD` Anweisung in Verbindung mit `PARAMETER-TABLE` ermöglicht es, Methoden und deren Parameter zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Frameworks oder bei der Implementierung von Plugins, wo die aufzurufende Logik erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von `GET REFERENCE OF` für Parameter und Ergebnisse ist entscheidend für die Übergabe von Werten. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ist ebenfalls ein wichtiger Aspekt moderner ABAP-Programmierung.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, PARAMETER-TABLE, RTTI, Exceptions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV-Grid für die Tabelle SFLIGHT, bei dem der Feldkatalog zur Laufzeit generiert wird, um nur die Felder 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'FLDATE' anzuzeigen. Zusätzlich soll 'CARRID' als Schlüsselfeld markiert und 'FLDATE' als Datum formatiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und manipulieren Sie den Feldkatalog über `cl_salv_table` Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_fieldcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_alv_with_fieldcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_fieldcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_alv_with_fieldcat.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_alv_table_create) = NEW cl_alv_table_create( ).
    DATA(lo_alv_table) = lo_alv_table_create->create_alv_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        i_tabname        = 'LT_SFLIGHT'
    ).

    DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>create_for_data_ref( lo_alv_table->get_data_ref( ) ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
    lo_columns->set_optimize( abap_true ).

    " Hide all columns first
    LOOP AT lo_columns->get_column_names( ) INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_name )->set_visible( abap_false ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Make specific columns visible and set properties
    DATA(lo_column_carrid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
    lo_column_carrid->set_visible( abap_true ).
    lo_column_carrid->set_key( abap_true ).
    lo_column_carrid->set_long_text( 'Airline' ).

    DATA(lo_column_connid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' ).
    lo_column_connid->set_visible( abap_true ).
    lo_column_connid->set_long_text( 'Flight Number' ).

    DATA(lo_column_fldate) = lo_columns->get_column( 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_column_fldate->set_visible( abap_true ).
    lo_column_fldate->set_long_text( 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_column_fldate->set_f4( abap_true ). " Example: enable F4 help

    lo_salv_table->display( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_fieldcat( ).

Die moderne Herangehensweise liegt in der objektorientierten Konfiguration des ALV und der Flexibilität, die angezeigten Daten und deren Darstellung zur Laufzeit zu steuern.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Komponenten einer Struktur zu, deren Namen zur Laufzeit in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert sind. Lesen Sie die Werte der Felder 'CARRID' und 'CONNID' aus einer Zeile der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_component_values
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_line TYPE sflight
        it_component_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_component_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_component_names INTO DATA(lv_component_name).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_sflight_line TO <fs_value>.
      IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND |{ <fs_value> }| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.

INTERFACE zif_dynamic_class_example.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_class_example.

CLASS zcl_dyn_class_instantiation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_call_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_class_instantiation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_class_example.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        rv_result = lo_dynamic_object->get_name( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        rv_result = |Error creating object: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error calling method: { lx_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_sort_field TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN io_data_ref->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED AND NOT iv_sort_field IS INITIAL.
      TRY.
          SORT <lt_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error INTO DATA(lx_sort_error).
          MESSAGE lx_sort_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer internen Tabelle dynamisch aktualisiert, basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen und einem neuen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_table_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_key_field TYPE string
        iv_key_value TYPE string
        iv_target_field TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_table_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_key_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data_ref->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_key_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_key_field>.
        IF <fs_key_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_key_field> = iv_key_value.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_target_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
          IF <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_target_field> = iv_new_value.
            EXIT. " Assuming unique key for simplicity
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch filtert, basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen, einem Operator und einem Vergleichswert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer dynamisch erstellten Bedingung oder eine Schleife mit dynamischem Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_filter_field TYPE string
        iv_operator TYPE string " e.g., '=', '>', '<'
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_filtered_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_source_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field_value>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data_ref->* TO <lt_source_table>.

    IF <lt_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR iv_filter_field IS INITIAL OR iv_operator IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_source_table> ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    CREATE DATA ro_filtered_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_filtered_data->* TO <lt_target_table>.

    LOOP AT <lt_source_table> ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_filter_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO <fs_field_value>.
      IF <fs_field_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        CASE iv_operator.
          WHEN '='.
            IF <fs_field_value> = iv_filter_value.
              INSERT <ls_source_line> INTO TABLE <lt_target_table>.
            ENDIF.
          WHEN '>'.
            IF <fs_field_value> > iv_filter_value.
              INSERT <ls_source_line> INTO TABLE <lt_target_table>.
            ENDIF.
          WHEN '<'.
            IF <fs_field_value> < iv_filter_value.
              INSERT <ls_source_line> INTO TABLE <lt_target_table>.
            ENDIF.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Handle unsupported operator or raise exception
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen aggregiert (z.B. Zählung der Einträge pro Wert eines Feldes).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus dynamischem Feldzugriff und einer Hash-Tabelle für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_group_field TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregation_result) TYPE ztt_dyn_aggregation_result.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF zts_dyn_aggregation_result,
         key_value TYPE string,
         count     TYPE i,
       END OF zts_dyn_aggregation_result.
TYPES ztt_dyn_aggregation_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zts_dyn_aggregation_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_source_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_group_field>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data_ref->* TO <lt_source_table>.

    IF <lt_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR iv_group_field IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lt_temp_aggregation TYPE HASHED TABLE OF zts_dyn_aggregation_result
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY key_value.

    LOOP AT <lt_source_table> ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO <fs_group_field>.
      IF <fs_group_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        DATA(lv_key) = |{ <fs_group_field> }|.
        READ TABLE lt_temp_aggregation INTO DATA(ls_agg_entry) WITH TABLE KEY key_value = lv_key.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ls_agg_entry-count = ls_agg_entry-count + 1.
          MODIFY TABLE lt_temp_aggregation FROM ls_agg_entry.
        ELSE.
          INSERT VALUE #( key_value = lv_key count = 1 ) INTO TABLE lt_temp_aggregation.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_aggregation_result = CORRESPONDING #( lt_temp_aggregation ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
