Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Typ eines Feldes einer dynamisch übergebenen Struktur zur Laufzeit ermittelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_type_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_type_info
      IMPORTING
        io_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_type_info) TYPE zts_field_type_info.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF zts_field_type_info,
         type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
         length    TYPE i,
         decimals  TYPE i,
         description TYPE string,
       END OF zts_field_type_info.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_type_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data_ref->* TO <fs_structure>.

    IF <fs_structure> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR iv_field_name IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_structure> ) ).

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_component) = lo_struct_descr->get_component( iv_field_name ).
        DATA(lo_type_descr) = ls_component-type.

        rs_type_info-type_kind = lo_type_descr->type_kind.
        rs_type_info-length = lo_type_descr->length.
        rs_type_info-decimals = lo_type_descr->decimals.
        rs_type_info-description = lo_type_descr->get_relative_name( ).

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_struct_error).
        " Handle error if component not found
        rs_type_info-description = |Error: { lx_struct_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie verschiedene Objekttypen polymorph, indem Sie `CASE TYPE OF` verwenden, um spezifische Methoden basierend auf dem Laufzeittyp des Objekts aufzurufen.
hint: Der Ausdruck `CASE TYPE OF` erlaubt die Typidentifikation und den Downcast in einer Anweisung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape PUBLIC.
  METHODS draw RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA radius TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~draw.
    rv_output = |Drawing a Circle with radius { me->radius }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA side TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~draw.
    rv_output = |Drawing a Square with side { me->side }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_result = lo_circle->zif_shape~draw( ) && ` - Type: Circle`.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
        rv_result = lo_square->zif_shape~draw( ) && ` - Type: Square`.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = `Unknown shape`.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_circle_processing FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_circle_processing.
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( 5 ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_square ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = `Drawing a Square with side 10 - Type: Square` act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_shape.
    " Dummy class for testing OTHERS branch
    CLASS lcl_unknown_shape DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_shape.
    ENDCLASS.

explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` ist ein mächtiges Feature für objektorientierte Programmierung, das eine elegante und typsichere Möglichkeit bietet, abhängig vom Laufzeittyp eines Objekts zu verzweigen und einen Downcast vorzunehmen. Dies ersetzt separate `IF TYPE OF` Prüfungen und Downcasts und macht den Code klarer und wartbarer.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Bonusprozentsatz basierend auf dem Joblevel eines Mitarbeiters. Wenn der Joblevel unbekannt ist, soll ein Standardprozentsatz von 5% verwendet werden. Implementieren Sie dies mit einem `COND` Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus_percentage.
    rv_percentage = COND p DECIMALS 2(
      WHEN iv_job_level = `Manager` THEN `0.10`
      WHEN iv_job_level = `Senior`  THEN `0.07`
      WHEN iv_job_level = `Junior`  THEN `0.05`
      ELSE `0.03` " Default for others/unknown
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie ein einfaches 3D-Modell (repräsentiert durch eine URL) in den `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` und zeigen Sie es an. Das Modell selbst kann ein Platzhalter sein, da keine tatsächliche GUI-Operation ausgeführt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `LOAD_MODEL` des `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dmodel_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container READ-ONLY.
    DATA mo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE string.
    METHODS load_model_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_model_id TYPE string
        iv_model_url TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dmodel_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_model_from_url.
    TRY.
        mo_3d_viewer->load_model(
          id   = iv_model_id
          path = iv_model_url
        ).
        mo_3d_viewer->set_displaymode( if_ecl_constants=>displaymode_fit ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_ecl_error_3dviewer.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_load_model_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_load_model_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_load_model_success.
    DATA(lo_display) = NEW zcl_3dmodel_display( 'MODEL_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_display->load_model_from_url( iv_model_id = 'CUBE' iv_model_url = 'https://example.com/cube.vrml' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = abap_true act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_load_model_failure.
    " In a real scenario, this would involve mocking the 3D viewer or a faulty URL.
    " Here, we simulate a 'failure' by asserting false, assuming the try-catch block covers. 
    " For simplicity, the 3D viewer's LOAD_MODEL is often hard to truly 'fail' in a unit test 
    " without a proper mock framework or a truly invalid input that raises an expected exception.
    DATA(lo_display) = NEW zcl_3dmodel_display( 'FAIL_CONTAINER' ).
    " The actual success/failure depends on the internal implementation of LOAD_MODEL.
    " We assume for this test that for an invalid URL it could internally lead to an error.
    " As we cannot simulate a technical error of the control here, we assert true for successful call
    " and would need more sophisticated mocking for negative testing.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_display->load_model_from_url( iv_model_id = 'INVALID' iv_model_url = 'INVALID_URL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = abap_true act = lv_success " Asserting true because without real GUI, the method call itself succeeds. Real error would be GUI-runtime. 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die grundlegende Instanziierung um das Laden eines Modells, was die Kernfunktionalität des 3D-Viewers darstellt. Die Methodenkettung und die klare Struktur (Modell-ID, Modell-URL als Parameter) sind Ausdruck modernen ABAP-Stils. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist wesentlich, um Laufzeitfehler des GUI-Controls abzufangen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für die Instanziierung des `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer`. Simulieren Sie einen Fehlerfall, der eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen wie `cx_ecl_error_3dviewer`.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_robust_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container READ-ONLY.
    DATA mo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer READ-ONLY.
    METHODS initialize_viewer
      IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING   cx_ecl_error_3dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_robust_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD initialize_viewer.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.
        " Simulate a condition that might lead to a viewer error.
        " In a real scenario, this could be an invalid parent or environment issues.
        IF iv_container_name = 'INVALID_CONTAINER'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_ecl_error_3dviewer.
        ENDIF.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_container.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_ecl_error_3dviewer INTO DATA(lx_ecl_error).
        MESSAGE lx_ecl_error->get_text( ) TYPE `E` DISPLAY LIKE `I`.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data1,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data1,
           BEGIN OF ty_s_data2,
             prop_x TYPE string,
             prop_y TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data2.

    METHODS process_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_data.
    CASE TYPE OF ir_data->*.
      WHEN TYPE ty_s_data1 INTO DATA(ls_data1).
        rv_output = |Data1: A={ ls_data1-field_a }, B={ ls_data1-field_b }|.
      WHEN TYPE ty_s_data2 INTO DATA(ls_data2).
        rv_output = |Data2: X={ ls_data2-prop_x }, Y={ ls_data2-prop_y }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_output = `Unknown Data Type`.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie konzeptionell, wie mit Ereignissen des `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` umgegangen wird, z.B. wenn ein Modell geladen ist oder eine Interaktion stattfindet. Fokus auf die Registrierung des Event-Handlers in einer modernen ABAP-Klasse.
hint: Ereignisse werden über `SET HANDLER` registriert. Da dies ein GUI-Control ist, wird der Test konzeptionell sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dviewer_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container READ-ONLY.
    DATA mo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_event_triggered TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE string.

    METHODS handle_model_loaded
      FOR EVENT model_loaded OF cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer
      IMPORTING e_id.

    METHODS is_event_triggered RETURNING VALUE(rv_triggered) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_model_loaded FOR mo_3d_viewer.
    mv_event_triggered = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_model_loaded.
    " In a real scenario, this method would process the event.
    " For unit testing, we just set a flag.
    mv_event_triggered = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_event_triggered.
    rv_triggered = mv_event_triggered.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_handler_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handler_registration.
    DATA(lo_event_handler) = NEW zcl_3dviewer_event_handler( 'EVENT_CONTAINER' ).
    " In a real UI environment, an event would be triggered by user interaction or system action.
    " Here, we can only assert that the handler was correctly registered.
    " To truly test the handler, one would need a mock framework to 'raise' the event.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = abap_false act = lo_event_handler->is_event_triggered( ) ).
    " A conceptual 'trigger' for the handler if mocking wasn't available:
    " CALL METHOD lo_event_handler->handle_model_loaded EXPORTING e_id = 'DUMMY_ID'.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = abap_true act = lo_event_handler->is_event_triggered( ) ).

    " The fact that the constructor runs without dump implies registration succeeded.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_event_handler->mo_3d_viewer ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl die tatsächliche Auslösung und Verarbeitung von GUI-Ereignissen in einem Unit-Test schwierig zu simulieren ist, zeigt dieses Beispiel die grundlegende Struktur der Event-Registrierung in einem modernen ABAP-Kontext. Das `SET HANDLER` Statement wird verwendet, um eine Methode des lokalen Klasse an ein Ereignis des GUI-Controls zu binden. Dies ist essenziell für interaktive GUI-Anwendungen.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8 kodierten XSTRING in einen STRING im System-Codepage-Format. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Konvertierung korrekt erfolgt und Sonderzeichen richtig dargestellt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und die Methode `create` mit `encoding = 'UTF-8'`, gefolgt von `read`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_xstring_to_string.
    DATA: lo_conv TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-8'
          endian   = 'BIG'
        ).
        lo_conv->read(
          EXPORTING
            input  = iv_utf8_xstring
          IMPORTING
            data   = rv_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder Exception weiterleiten
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    " Manuelle UTF-8 Kodierung für den Testfall
    " 'Hallo Welt! ÄÖÜäöüß' in UTF-8 Bytes
    lv_utf8_xstring = '48616C6C6F2057656C742120C384C396C39CC3A4C3B6C3BCC39F'.

    DATA(lv_result_string) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_xstring_to_string( lv_utf8_xstring ).

      msg = 'UTF-8 to string conversion failed'
    ).

explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die sichere und explizite Konvertierung von UTF-8 kodierten Binärdaten (XSTRING) in einen ABAP-STRING unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_abap_conv_in_ce`. Die Methode `create` ermöglicht die Angabe des Quell-Encoding und der Endianness, während `read` die eigentliche Konvertierung durchführt. Dies ist essentiell für die Interaktion mit externen Systemen, die UTF-8 verwenden.
keywords: Codepage, UTF-8, XSTRING, CONVERSION, cl_abap_conv_in_ce

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen 4-Byte XSTRING, der einen Integer im Big-Endian-Format darstellt, in einen ABAP-Integer (Little-Endian-System).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` mit `endian = 'BIG'` und `read` in Kombination mit einem `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Integer.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_endian_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_big_endian_to_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_big_endian_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_endian_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_big_endian_to_int.
    DATA: lo_conv TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.
    DATA: lv_xstring_4_bytes TYPE xstring LENGTH 4.

    IF xstrlen( iv_big_endian_xstring ) <> 4.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input XSTRING must be 4 bytes long for integer conversion.'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_xstring_4_bytes = iv_big_endian_xstring.

    TRY.
        lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          endian = 'BIG'
        ).
        lo_conv->read(
          EXPORTING
            input  = lv_xstring_4_bytes
          IMPORTING
            data   = rv_integer
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_big_endian_to_int FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_length FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_big_endian_to_int.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_endian_int( ).
    DATA(lv_big_endian_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_expected_int) TYPE i VALUE 256.

    " 256 (decimal) is 0x00000100 in hex. Big Endian: 00000100
    lv_big_endian_xstring = '00000100'.

    DATA(lv_result_int) = lo_cut->convert_big_endian_to_int( lv_big_endian_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_int
      exp = lv_expected_int
      msg = 'Big Endian to integer conversion failed'
    ).

    lv_expected_int = 1.
    lv_big_endian_xstring = '00000001'.
    lv_result_int = lo_cut->convert_big_endian_to_int( lv_big_endian_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_int
      exp = lv_expected_int
      msg = 'Big Endian to integer conversion failed for 1'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_endian_int( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_short) TYPE xstring VALUE '0001'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>raise_exception( lo_cut->convert_big_endian_to_int( lv_xstring_short ) )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR'
      msg = 'Expected CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR for invalid length'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Konvertierung von Binärdaten (XSTRING) mit spezifischer Endianness in einen nativen ABAP-Datentyp (Integer). Die Klasse `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` ist hierfür das Standardwerkzeug. Durch die Angabe von `endian = 'BIG'` wird sichergestellt, dass die Bytes korrekt interpretiert werden, unabhängig von der systemeigenen Endianness. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Verarbeitung von Daten aus heterogenen Systemen.
keywords: Endian, XSTRING, INTEGER, CONVERSION, BINARY, cl_abap_conv_in_ce

solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_special_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_special_day,
             date TYPE d,
             text TYPE string,
             color TYPE i,
           END OF ty_special_day,
           tt_special_days TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_special_day WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_and_check_special_days
      IMPORTING
        it_special_days TYPE tt_special_days.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_special_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_and_check_special_days.
    DATA: lo_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
    DATA: lt_special_days_cal TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>tt_special_days.
    DATA: ls_special_day_cal TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>ty_special_day.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_calendar
      EXPORTING
        parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0.

    LOOP AT it_special_days INTO DATA(ls_input_day).
      ls_special_day_cal-date  = ls_input_day-date.
      ls_special_day_cal-text  = ls_input_day-text.
      ls_special_day_cal-color = ls_input_day-color.
      APPEND ls_special_day_cal TO lt_special_days_cal.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_calendar->set_special_days(
      EXPORTING
        special_days = lt_special_days_cal
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_calendar->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Flügen, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen und mehr als 200 freie Sitze haben. Geben Sie eine Tabelle mit den Flugnummern (CARRID, CONNID) zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `WHERE` und `VALUE #` für die deklarative Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen (für den Testfall)
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( cityto = 'NEW YORK' AND seatsocc < 200 )
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result_keys) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge nach NEW YORK mit weniger als 200 belegten Sitzen
    " Für einen robusten Test müsste man Testdaten in SFLIGHTS einfügen oder mocken.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob Ergebnisse zurückkommen und die Struktur stimmt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_result_keys
      msg = 'Expected some flights to be returned, but none found.'
      revert = abap_true
    ).

    " Beispiel für einen spezifischeren Test, falls Testdaten bekannt sind:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_keys ) exp = 1 ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_keys[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_keys[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne ABAP-Syntax `FOR ... IN` in Kombination mit `WHERE` und dem `VALUE #`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle deklarativ zu filtern und eine neue Tabelle mit den gewünschten Feldern zu konstruieren. Dies ist wesentlich prägnanter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND`-Anweisungen und fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, VALUE, SFLIGHTS, FILTER, Declarative

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der freien Sitze (`SEATSOCC` ist belegte Sitze, also `SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der `sflights`-Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen (für den Testfall)
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_sum_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE i.

    " Manuelle Berechnung für den Testfall (oder Mock-Daten)
    " Hier wird angenommen, dass es LH-Flüge gibt und die Summe 100 ist.
    " Für einen robusten Test müsste man Testdaten in SFLIGHTS einfügen oder mocken.
    SELECT SUM( seatsmax - seatsocc ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_sum WHERE carrid = lv_test_carrid.

    DATA(lv_result_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_free_seats( lv_test_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_sum
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Sum of free seats calculation failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht er eine funktionale und deklarative Berechnung von Summen, Minima, Maxima oder anderen aggregierten Werten. Dies macht den Code kompakter und leichter verständlich als traditionelle `LOOP`-Schleifen mit manueller Akkumulation.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, SFLIGHTS, AGGREGATION, SUM, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Klassen (die ein gemeinsames Interface implementieren) basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erzeugt. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein `INTERFACE`, mehrere implementierende `CLASSEN` und eine `CLASS-METHOD` mit `NEW` als Factory.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_action.
  METHODS execute_action RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_action.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_flight_id TYPE sflight-connid.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_flight_id TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_flight_id = iv_flight_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_flight_action~execute_action.
    rv_message = |Flug { mv_flight_id } wurde gebucht.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cancel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_action.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_flight_id TYPE sflight-connid.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_flight_id TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cancel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_flight_id = iv_flight_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_flight_action~execute_action.
    rv_message = |Buchung für Flug { mv_flight_id } wurde storniert.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_action_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_action_type TYPE string
        iv_flight_id   TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_action) TYPE REF TO zif_flight_action
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_action_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_action.
    CASE iv_action_type.
      WHEN 'BOOK'.
        ro_action = NEW zcl_flight_booking( iv_flight_id ).
      WHEN 'CANCEL'.
        ro_action = NEW zcl_flight_cancel( iv_flight_id ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Aktionstyp: { iv_action_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_booking FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_cancel FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_booking.
    DATA(lv_flight_id) TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '0017'.
    DATA(lo_action) = zcl_flight_action_factory=>create_action( iv_action_type = 'BOOK' iv_flight_id = lv_flight_id ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_action->execute_action( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = |Flug { lv_flight_id } wurde gebucht.|
      msg = 'Booking action message incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lo_action IS INSTANCE OF zcl_flight_booking )
      msg = 'Expected instance of ZCL_FLIGHT_BOOKING'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_cancel.
    DATA(lv_flight_id) TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '0017'.
    DATA(lo_action) = zcl_flight_action_factory=>create_action( iv_action_type = 'CANCEL' iv_flight_id = lv_flight_id ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_action->execute_action( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = |Buchung für Flug { lv_flight_id } wurde storniert.|
      msg = 'Cancel action message incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lo_action IS INSTANCE OF zcl_flight_cancel )
      msg = 'Expected instance of ZCL_FLIGHT_CANCEL'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_invalid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>raise_exception( zcl_flight_action_factory=>create_action( iv_action_type = 'UNKNOWN' iv_flight_id = '0000' ) )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR'
      msg = 'Expected CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR for unknown action type'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Pattern in ABAP, eine zentrale Technik der objektorientierten Programmierung. Eine `CLASS-METHOD` (`create_action`) ist für die Instanziierung von Objekten zuständig, die ein gemeinsames `INTERFACE` (`zif_flight_action`) implementieren. Der `NEW`-Operator wird verwendet, um die Objekte zu erzeugen. Dies fördert lose Kopplung, da der Client-Code nur das Interface kennt und nicht die konkreten Implementierungsklassen. Polymorphie wird durch den Aufruf der Methode `execute_action` über die Interface-Referenz erreicht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory, Interface, Polymorphism, NEW, CLASS-METHODS

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('Available', 'Limited', 'Full') basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze. Mehr als 50 freie Sitze ist 'Available', 1-50 ist 'Limited', 0 ist 'Full'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für eine prägnante bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_free_seats > 50 THEN 'Available'
      WHEN iv_free_seats > 0  THEN 'Limited'
      WHEN iv_free_seats = 0  THEN 'Full'
      ELSE 'Invalid'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_available FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_limited FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_full FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_available.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Available' msg = 'Status for 100 seats incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_limited.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Limited' msg = 'Status for 25 seats incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_full.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Full' msg = 'Status for 0 seats incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( -10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Invalid' msg = 'Status for negative seats incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, bedingte Logik in ABAP auszudrücken. Er ersetzt lange `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Konstrukte durch eine einzige, lesbare Anweisung, die einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zurückgibt. Dies führt zu kompakterem und klarerem Code, insbesondere wenn es darum geht, einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Fällen zu bestimmen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, EXPRESSION, CASE, IF

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_count,
           tt_flight_group_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_counts) TYPE tt_flight_group_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_group_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    " Für einen robusten Test müsste man Testdaten in SFLIGHTS einfügen oder mocken.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob Ergebnisse zurückkommen und die Struktur stimmt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_result_counts
      msg = 'Expected some grouped flight counts, but none found.'
      revert = abap_true
    ).

    " Beispiel für einen spezifischeren Test, falls Testdaten bekannt sind:
    " DATA(lv_expected_lh_count) TYPE i.
    " SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_lh_count WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    " READ TABLE lt_result_counts INTO DATA(ls_lh_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = lv_expected_lh_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine sehr mächtige moderne ABAP-Funktion für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten nach einem oder mehreren Kriterien zu gruppieren und Aggregatfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` (Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe) direkt im Loop zu verwenden. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungslogik erheblich und macht den Code effizienter und lesbarer als manuelle Gruppierungen.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT, GROUP BY, AGGREGATION, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in Struktur gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_read_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_read_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_read_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_read( ).
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE sflight.
    ls_test_data-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_test_data-connid = '0400'.
    ls_test_data-fldate = '20231101'.

    DATA(lv_carrid_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_structure = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid_value exp = 'LH' msg = 'Dynamic read of CARRID failed' ).

    DATA(lv_fldate_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_structure = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FLDATE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_fldate_value exp = '20231101' msg = 'Dynamic read of FLDATE failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) aus der `sflights`-Tabelle enthält, aber ohne Duplikate.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `DISTINCT` und `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_distinct_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_distinct_carriers
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sflight_distinct_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Starten Sie ein externes Programm auf dem Frontend des Benutzers (z.B. Notepad) und übergeben Sie optional Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `EXECUTE` der Klasse `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES`. Beachten Sie die Sicherheitsaspekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_execute_program DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_notepad IMPORTING iv_filepath TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_execute_program IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_notepad.
    DATA(lv_program) = 'notepad.exe'. " For Windows
    IF sy-opsys = 'Linux'. " Example for Linux
      lv_program = 'gedit'. " Or 'xdg-open'
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_parameter) = COND string( WHEN iv_filepath IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_filepath ELSE '' ).

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute(
          EXPORTING
            application = lv_program
            parameter   = lv_parameter
            minimized   = abap_true " Start minimized
            synchronous = abap_false " Do not wait for program to finish
        ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Handle exception, e.g., program not found or security restrictions
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Starten des Programms.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_execute_notepad FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_execute_notepad.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_execute_program( ).
    IF sy-batch IS NOT INITIAL. " Cannot test GUI services in batch
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Skipping GUI test in batch mode' act = abap_true ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " This test will attempt to open Notepad/Gedit.
    " It's hard to assert the actual execution of an external program in a unit test.
    " We can only assert that the ABAP method call itself does not raise an exception.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->execute_notepad( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Method call should not raise exception' act = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception raised during program execution' ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Test with a dummy file (requires file to exist)
    DATA(lv_temp_file) = 'C:\temp\test_execute_file.txt'.
    IF sy-opsys = 'Linux'.
      lv_temp_file = '/tmp/test_execute_file.txt'.
    ENDIF.
    " Create dummy file (using GUI_DOWNLOAD as a proxy for file creation)
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename = lv_temp_file
        filetype = 'ASC'
        CHANGING
          data_tab = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello World' ) )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
        lo_cut->execute_notepad( iv_filepath = lv_temp_file ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Method call with file should not raise exception' act = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception raised during program execution with file' ).
      ENDTRY.
      " Clean up dummy file
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>delete_file( EXPORTING filename = lv_temp_file EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `EXECUTE`-Methode ermöglicht das Starten beliebiger Programme auf dem Frontend. Die Verwendung von `COND string(...)` ist ein modernes ABAP 7.40+ Feature zur konditionalen Zuweisung von Werten. Die Methode wird asynchron aufgerufen (`synchronous = abap_false`), um die ABAP-Transaktion nicht zu blockieren. Sicherheitsaspekte sind hierbei kritisch und müssen in einer Produktivumgebung berücksichtigt werden.
keywords: Frontend, Programm, Ausführen, Execute, GUI, Sicherheit, COND

CLASS zcl_fes_gui_upload DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_line,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_line.
    TYPES: tt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS upload_text_file IMPORTING iv_filepath TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_content) TYPE tt_lines.

CLASS zcl_fes_gui_upload IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_text_file.
    DATA: lt_raw_data TYPE string_table.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
          EXPORTING
            filename = iv_filepath
            filetype = 'ASC'
          CHANGING
            data_tab = lt_raw_data
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Convert string_table to tt_lines using VALUE and FOR
          rt_content = VALUE #( FOR <line> IN lt_raw_data ( content = <line> ) ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Handle exception, e.g., file not found, access denied, or non-GUI environment
        " For simplicity, return empty table on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_viewer.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    TRY.
        " Create a dummy container for testing purposes.
        " In a real scenario, this would be linked to a screen element.
        lo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
        ro_viewer = NEW cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer( parent = lo_container ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Handle exception, e.g., in non-GUI environment or container error
        CLEAR ro_viewer. " Ensure viewer is initial on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_viewer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_viewer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ecl_viewer_init( ).
    IF sy-batch IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Skipping GUI test in batch mode' act = abap_true ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_viewer) = lo_cut->create_viewer( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Viewer instance should be created' act = lo_viewer ).

    " Clean up the dummy container and viewer to avoid resource leaks in real GUI
    IF lo_viewer IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_container) = lo_viewer->get_parent( ).
      IF lo_container IS BOUND.
        CALL METHOD lo_container->free
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1.
      ENDIF.
      CALL METHOD lo_viewer->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine temporäre Datei auf dem Frontend und schreiben Sie Text hinein. Löschen Sie die Datei anschließend wieder.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>FILE_SAVE_DIALOG` für den Pfad, `GUI_DOWNLOAD` zum Schreiben und `DELETE_FILE` zum Löschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_temp_file_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_delete_temp_file IMPORTING iv_content TYPE string
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_temp_file_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_delete_temp_file.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string,
          lt_data     TYPE string_table.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    APPEND iv_content TO lt_data.

    TRY.
        " Get a temporary file path from the user (or generate one)
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog(
          EXPORTING
            window_title    = 'Temporäre Datei erstellen'
            default_extension = 'txt'
            default_file_name = 'temp_abap_file.txt'
          CHANGING
            filename        = lv_filepath
            rc              = DATA(lv_rc)
        ).

        IF lv_rc = 1 AND lv_filepath IS NOT INITIAL. " User selected a file
          " Write content to the file
          cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
            EXPORTING
              filename = lv_filepath
              filetype = 'ASC'
            CHANGING
              data_tab = lt_data
            EXCEPTIONS
              OTHERS   = 1
          ).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Delete the file
            cl_gui_frontend_services=>delete_file(
              EXPORTING
                filename = lv_filepath
              EXCEPTIONS
                OTHERS = 1
            ).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              rv_success = abap_true.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Handle GUI exceptions
        MESSAGE 'Fehler bei Frontend-Dateioperationen.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_temp_file_operations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_temp_file_ops( ).
    IF sy-batch IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Skipping GUI test in batch mode' act = abap_true ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " This test requires user interaction for FILE_SAVE_DIALOG.
    " In a real unit test, this would typically be mocked or skipped.
    " For demonstration, we assume user interaction or a pre-defined path.
    " Due to FILE_SAVE_DIALOG, a direct automated assertion of success is difficult.
    " We assert that the method call itself does not dump.
    TRY.
        " Note: This will open a save dialog. User must click 'Save' or 'Cancel'.
        " If 'Cancel' is clicked, rv_success will be false.
        DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_and_delete_temp_file( 'Test content for temporary file.' ).
        " We cannot reliably assert lv_success without user interaction.
        " Instead, we assert that no exception occurred.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Method call should not raise exception' act = abap_true ).
    CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception raised during temporary file operations' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

    METHODS clear_viewer_content IMPORTING io_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_clear_viewer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clear_viewer_content.
    TRY.
        io_viewer->clear( ).
      CATCH cx_ecl_error.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Leeren des Viewers.' TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        MESSAGE 'Allgemeiner GUI-Fehler beim Leeren des Viewers.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_clear_viewer FOR TESTING.
    METHODS create_viewer RETURNING VALUE(ro_viewer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.
    METHODS create_dummy_dwf_file IMPORTING iv_filepath TYPE string.
    METHODS delete_dummy_file IMPORTING iv_filepath TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clear_viewer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ecl_clear_viewer( ).
    IF sy-batch IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Skipping GUI test in batch mode' act = abap_true ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_viewer) = create_viewer( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Viewer instance should be created' act = lo_viewer ).

    DATA(lv_temp_file) = 'C:\temp\clear_test.dwf'.
    IF sy-opsys = 'Linux'.
      lv_temp_file = '/tmp/clear_test.dwf'.
    ENDIF.
    create_dummy_dwf_file( lv_temp_file ).

    " Load a file first to have content to clear
    DATA(lo_loader) = NEW zcl_ecl_load_file( ). " Re-use loader from previous example
    lo_loader->load_viewer_file( io_viewer = lo_viewer iv_filepath = lv_temp_file ).

    " Now clear the viewer
    TRY.
        lo_cut->clear_viewer_content( io_viewer = lo_viewer ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Clearing viewer should not raise exception' act = abap_true ).
    CATCH cx_ecl_error cx_gui_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception raised during viewer clear' ).
    ENDTRY.

    delete_dummy_file( lv_temp_file ).
    " Clean up
    IF lo_viewer IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_container) = lo_viewer->get_parent( ).
      IF lo_container IS BOUND.
        CALL METHOD lo_container->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      ENDIF.
      CALL METHOD lo_viewer->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_viewer.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    TRY.
        lo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_CLEAR' ).
        ro_viewer = NEW cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer( parent = lo_container ).
    CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        CLEAR ro_viewer.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dummy_dwf_file.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename = iv_filepath
        filetype = 'ASC'
        CHANGING
          data_tab = VALUE string_table( ( 'Dummy content for clear test' ) )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Failed to create dummy DWF file for test' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_dummy_file.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>delete_file(
      EXPORTING
        filename = iv_filepath
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Log or ignore
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CLEAR`-Methode ist wichtig, um den 2D-Viewer in einen leeren Zustand zurückzusetzen, beispielsweise vor dem Laden einer neuen Datei. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist auch hier Standard. Der Unit Test lädt zunächst eine Datei und ruft dann `CLEAR` auf, um zu überprüfen, ob der Vorgang ohne Fehler abläuft.
keywords: GUI, Control, 2D Viewer, Clear, Reset, Initialisierung

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Dateiauswahldialog auf dem Frontend, um dem Benutzer die Auswahl einer Datei zu ermöglichen. Geben Sie den ausgewählten Pfad zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `FILE_OPEN_DIALOG` der Klasse `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_file_open_dialog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS open_file_dialog RETURNING VALUE(rv_filepath) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_open_dialog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_file_dialog.
    DATA: lt_file_table TYPE filetable,
          lv_rc         TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
          EXPORTING
            window_title    = 'Datei auswählen'
            default_extension = 'txt'
            file_filter     = '*.txt,Textdateien (*.txt);*.log,Logdateien (*.log)'
            multiselection  = abap_false
          CHANGING
            file_table      = lt_file_table
            rc              = lv_rc
        ).

        IF lv_rc = 1 AND lines( lt_file_table ) = 1.
          rv_filepath = lt_file_table[ 1 ]-fullpath.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Öffnen des Dateiauswahldialogs.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_open_file_dialog FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_open_file_dialog.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_file_open_dialog( ).
    IF sy-batch IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Skipping GUI test in batch mode' act = abap_true ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " This test requires user interaction. The dialog will appear.
    " If the user selects a file, rv_filepath will be filled.
    " If the user cancels, rv_filepath will be initial.
    " We assert that the method call itself does not dump.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_filepath) = lo_cut->open_file_dialog( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Method call should not raise exception' act = abap_true ).
        " Further assertions would depend on mocking user interaction or manual verification.
        " For example, if a file is known to exist and the user selects it:
        " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'File path should be returned if user selects a file' act = lv_filepath ).
    CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception raised during file open dialog' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `FILE_OPEN_DIALOG` ist der Standardweg, um einen Dateiauswahldialog auf dem Frontend zu öffnen. Sie ermöglicht die Definition von Titeln, Standarderweiterungen und Dateifiltern. Die Verwendung von `filetable` und `rc` für das Ergebnis ist typisch. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist für GUI-Interaktionen unerlässlich. Der Unit Test bestätigt, dass der Dialog ohne Laufzeitfehler aufgerufen werden kann.
keywords: Frontend, Dateidialog, File Open, GUI, Dateiauswahl

Instructions: Kopieren Sie eine Datei auf dem Frontend von einem Quellpfad zu einem Zielpfad.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `COPY` der Klasse `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_copy_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_frontend_file IMPORTING iv_source_path TYPE string
                                       iv_target_path TYPE string
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_copy_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_frontend_file.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>copy(
          EXPORTING
            source = iv_source_path
            target = iv_target_path
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Kopieren der Datei.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_file_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_copy_file_failure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS create_dummy_file IMPORTING iv_filepath TYPE string.
    METHODS delete_dummy_file IMPORTING iv_filepath TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_file_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_copy_file( ).
    IF sy-batch IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Skipping GUI test in batch mode' act = abap_true ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_source_file) = 'C:\temp\source_file.txt'.
    DATA(lv_target_file) = 'C:\temp\target_file.txt'.
    IF sy-opsys = 'Linux'.
      lv_source_file = '/tmp/source_file.txt'.
      lv_target_file = '/tmp/target_file.txt'.
    ENDIF.

    create_dummy_file( lv_source_file ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->copy_frontend_file( iv_source_path = lv_source_file iv_target_path = lv_target_file ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Copying existing file should succeed' act = lv_success ).

    " Verify target file exists
    DATA(lo_file_exist_checker) = NEW zcl_fes_file_exist( ). " Re-use from FES_002
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Target file should exist after copy' act = lo_file_exist_checker->check_file_exists( lv_target_file ) ).

    delete_dummy_file( lv_source_file ).
    delete_dummy_file( lv_target_file ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_copy_file_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_copy_file( ).
    IF sy-batch IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Skipping GUI test in batch mode' act = abap_true ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_non_existent_source) = 'C:\temp\non_existent_source.txt'.
    DATA(lv_target_file) = 'C:\temp\target_for_fail.txt'.
    IF sy-opsys = 'Linux'.
      lv_non_existent_source = '/tmp/non_existent_source.txt'.
      lv_target_file = '/tmp/target_for_fail.txt'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->copy_frontend_file( iv_source_path = lv_non_existent_source iv_target_path = lv_target_file ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Copying non-existent file should fail' act = lv_success ).

    " Verify target file does not exist
    DATA(lo_file_exist_checker) = NEW zcl_fes_file_exist( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Target file should not exist after failed copy' act = lo_file_exist_checker->check_file_exists( lv_target_file ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dummy_file.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename = iv_filepath
        filetype = 'ASC'
        CHANGING
          data_tab = VALUE string_table( ( 'Dummy content for copy test' ) )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Failed to create dummy file for test' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_dummy_file.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>delete_file(
      EXPORTING
        filename = iv_filepath
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Log or ignore
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COPY`-Methode ermöglicht das Kopieren von Dateien direkt auf dem Frontend des Benutzers. Dies ist effizient, da die Daten nicht über den Applikationsserver geleitet werden müssen. Die Fehlerbehandlung ist entscheidend, um Probleme wie nicht existierende Quelldateien oder fehlende Berechtigungen abzufangen. Der Unit Test erstellt eine Quelldatei, kopiert sie und überprüft die Existenz der Zieldatei.
keywords: Frontend, Datei kopieren, Copy File, GUI, Dateisystem

Instructions: Deklarieren und füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Tabelle SFLIGHT) unter Verwendung moderner Syntax (Inline-Deklaration und VALUE-Operator).
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Struktur und `DATA(...) = VALUE #(...)` für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_modern_declaration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_modern_declaration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    rt_sflight = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_modern_declaration( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflight ) exp = 3 msg = 'Tabelle sollte 3 Einträge haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Erster Eintrag CARRIER falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` definiert eine lokale Struktur, während `VALUE #()` eine interne Tabelle direkt mit Daten initialisiert. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als die traditionelle `APPEND`-Schleife.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, Inline Declaration, TYPES BEGIN OF

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator aggregiert Werte einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fp_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fp_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR flight IN it_sflight
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fp_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_fp_reduce=>ty_sflight_data_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '650.50' msg = 'Gesamtpreis falsch berechnet.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kürzer und funktionaler macht.
keywords: Functional Programming, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, um nur Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers zu erhalten, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fp_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_sflight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_data_tt
        iv_carrier     TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_data_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fp_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fp_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_fp_filter=>ty_sflight_data_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_data iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Falsche Anzahl gefilterter Flüge.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Erster gefilterter Flug falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen zu benötigen.
keywords: Functional Programming, FILTER, Internal Tables, WHERE

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck, um einen Text basierend auf dem Flugstatus zurückzugeben.
hint: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne Alternative zur `CASE`-Anweisung für die Zuweisung von Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_flight_status TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_flight_status,
                 booked TYPE ty_flight_status VALUE 'B',
                 canceled TYPE ty_flight_status VALUE 'C',
                 departed TYPE ty_flight_status VALUE 'D',
               END OF gc_flight_status.

    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE ty_flight_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status
                                WHEN gc_flight_status-booked   THEN 'Gebucht'
                                WHEN gc_flight_status-canceled THEN 'Storniert'
                                WHEN gc_flight_status-departed THEN 'Abgeflogen'
                                ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_booked FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_canceled FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_booked.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_status_text( zcl_cond_switch=>gc_flight_status-booked ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Gebucht' msg = 'Status Gebucht falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_canceled.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_status_text( zcl_cond_switch=>gc_flight_status-canceled ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Storniert' msg = 'Status Storniert falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_unknown.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_status_text( 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Unbekannt' msg = 'Status Unbekannt falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ist eine prägnante Möglichkeit, einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zuzuweisen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als verschachtelte `IF`-Anweisungen oder traditionelle `CASE`-Anweisungen für Zuweisungen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, SWITCH, Expressions, CASE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Datumsangaben unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CREATE` und `GET_DIFFERENCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dt_tstmp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_difference_in_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE d
        iv_date2 TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dt_tstmp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_difference_in_days.
    DATA(lv_timestamp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create( iv_date = iv_date1 iv_time = '000000' ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create( iv_date = iv_date2 iv_time = '000000' ).

    DATA(ls_difference) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_difference( iv_tstmp1 = lv_timestamp1 iv_tstmp2 = lv_timestamp2 ).

    rv_days = ls_difference-days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes zur Laufzeit und geben Sie seinen Namen aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `GET_NAME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, Dynamic Programming, Data References

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Bestimmung von Bildinformationen (MIME-Typ, Breite, Höhe) für ein gegebenes Bild, indem Sie die Konzepte von `cl_fxs_image_info` und `S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE` verwenden. Da die Klasse `cl_fxs_image_info` nicht direkt aufrufbar ist, wird hier eine Mock-Implementierung gezeigt, die die Struktur `S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE` verwendet.
hint: Definieren Sie die Struktur `S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE` und eine Methode, die diese Struktur füllt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_info_determiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF s_xslfo_supplementary_image,
             mime_type TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
             file_size TYPE i,
           END OF s_xslfo_supplementary_image.

    METHODS determine_image_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_content TYPE xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_image_info) TYPE s_xslfo_supplementary_image.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_info_determiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD determine_image_info.
    " Simulate image information determination
    " In a real scenario, cl_fxs_image_info would be used here.
    IF iv_image_content IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_image_info-mime_type = 'image/jpeg'. " Example MIME type
      rs_image_info-width = 800. " Example width
      rs_image_info-height = 600. " Example height
      rs_image_info-file_size = xstrlen( iv_image_content ).
    ELSE.
      CLEAR rs_image_info.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_image_content) TYPE xstring VALUE '47494638396101000100800000FFFFFF00000021F90401000000002C00000000010001000002024401003B'. " A very small GIF image in hex
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->determine_image_info( lv_image_content ).

In einem realen Szenario würde hier die SAP-Standardklasse `cl_fxs_image_info` verwendet, um tatsächliche Bildmetadaten zu extrahieren.
