keywords: Image Information, S_XSLFO_SUPPLEMENTARY_IMAGE, cl_fxs_image_info, TYPES BEGIN OF, XSTRING

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Fluent Interface für eine Klasse, die mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt ermöglicht.
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Fluent Interface ist, sollte `ME` zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface.
    METHODS add       IMPORTING iv_add   TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface.
    METHODS multiply  IMPORTING iv_mult  TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_result = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_chain.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_fluent_interface( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->set_value( 5 )->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 msg = 'Fluent Interface Berechnung falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein Fluent Interface ermöglicht das Verketten von Methodenaufrufen, was den Code sehr lesbar und ausdrucksstark macht. Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette ist, gibt eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurück.
keywords: Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Method Chaining, ME

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus einer anderen internen Tabelle, wobei Sie nur bestimmte Felder übernehmen und umbenennen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `CORRESPONDING` oder `VALUE #()` mit Feldzuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES ty_source_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             item_id TYPE i,
             item_name TYPE string,
             amount  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES ty_target_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_data_tt
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_data_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                           ( item_id   = ls_source-id
                             item_name = ls_source-name
                             amount    = ls_source-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_source FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_it_for_corresponding=>ty_source_data_tt(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = '10.50' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = '20.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der Einträge falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 1 msg = 'Feld item_id falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_name exp = 'Item A' msg = 'Feld item_name falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-amount exp = '10.50' msg = 'Feld amount falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_source.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_it_for_corresponding=>ty_source_data_tt( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_target ) msg = 'Zieltabelle sollte leer sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE #()` ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen, indem er das Mapping von Feldern und die Erstellung neuer Strukturen in einer einzigen Anweisung erlaubt.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Transformation, TYPES BEGIN OF

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen in einer internen Tabelle, wobei Sie Division durch Null vermeiden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Division durch Null-Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_sflight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_data_tt
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                     FOR flight IN it_sflight
                                       NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_sflight ).

    rv_average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0.00 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_math_avg_price=>ty_sflight_data_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '150.00' msg = 'Durchschnittspreis falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_math_avg_price=>ty_sflight_data_tt( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '0.00' msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für leere Tabelle falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und dem `COND`-Operator zur bedingten Zuweisung ermöglicht eine kompakte und sichere Berechnung des Durchschnitts, indem eine Division durch Null elegant vermieden wird.
keywords: Math, Average, REDUCE, COND, Division by Zero

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Carrier und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Carrier unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES ty_sflight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES ty_carrier_count_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_data_tt
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_count_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflight BY carrid
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                     flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_group_by=>ty_sflight_data_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der Gruppen falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'Fluganzahl für LH falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'Fluganzahl für AA falsch.' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die in eine interne Tabelle geladen wurde.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_grouped_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_grouped_flight>-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_flight ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_avg_price(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        average_price = COND decfloat16( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 )
      ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_xco_avg_api_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             price     TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING iv_api_url TYPE string

                cx_xco_cp_json_error.

CLASS zcl_xco_avg_api_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_from_api.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_xco_cp_http_client_factory=>create_url_client(
      iv_url = iv_api_url
    ).
    DATA(lo_request) = lo_http_client->create_request( if_xco_cp_http_client=>request_method-get ).
    DATA(lo_response) = lo_http_client->execute( lo_request ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = lo_response->get_body( )->get_string( ).

    DATA(lo_json_document) = cl_xco_cp_json_parser=>parse(
      iv_json = lv_json_string
    ).

    DATA(lt_flight_data) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR lo_flight_node IN lo_json_document->get_member( 'flights' )->as_array( )
      ( flight_id = lo_flight_node->get_member( 'id' )->as_string( )
        price     = lo_flight_node->get_member( 'price' )->as_decfloat16( ) )
    ).

    IF lt_flight_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_flight_data
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price
      ).
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_flight_data ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittswert einer Spalte in einer internen Tabelle mit einer einfachen `LOOP` und `DIVIDE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP` über die interne Tabelle, um die Summe zu bilden, und teilen Sie diese dann durch die Anzahl der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_simple_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_simple
      IMPORTING it_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-price WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_simple_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_simple.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_prices INTO DATA(lv_price).
      lv_total_price = lv_total_price + lv_price.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Fehlerbehandlung bei der Verwendung des XCO HTTP Clients. (Konzeptionelles Beispiel)
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_xco_cp_http_client_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_api_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_api_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_xco_cp_http_client_factory=>create_url_client(
          iv_url = iv_url
        ).
        DATA(lo_request) = lo_http_client->create_request( if_xco_cp_http_client=>request_method-get ).
        DATA(lo_response) = lo_http_client->execute( lo_request ).

        IF lo_response->get_status_code( ) = 200.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          " Loggen oder weitere Fehlerbehandlung basierend auf Statuscode
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xco_cp_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehler beim HTTP-Aufruf (z.B. Netzwerkproblem, ungültige URL)
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_error_handling( ).

    " Test mit einer gültigen URL (erwartet Erfolg, wenn API erreichbar)
    DATA(lv_success_valid) = lo_cut->call_api_with_error_handling( 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Call to valid API should succeed' act = lv_success_valid exp = abap_true ).

    " Test mit einer ungültigen URL (erwartet Fehler)
    DATA(lv_success_invalid) = lo_cut->call_api_with_error_handling( 'https://invalid.url.example.com' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Call to invalid API should fail' act = lv_success_invalid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die XCO-Bibliothek verwendet ein robustes Exception-Handling-Modell. `cx_xco_cp_http_client_error` ist die zentrale Exception für Fehler bei HTTP-Client-Operationen. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` ist entscheidend, um Laufzeitfehler abzufangen und eine stabile Anwendung zu gewährleisten, die mit externen Systemen kommuniziert.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von XCO zur Transformation von XML-Daten, die von einer externen API empfangen wurden. (Konzeptionelles Beispiel)
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xco_cp_xml_parser` und `if_xco_cp_xml_document`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_xml_parser_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_xml_data,
             item_id TYPE string,
             name    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_xml_data.
    TYPES: tt_xml_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_xml_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_xml_response
      IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_xml_data
      RAISING   cx_xco_cp_xml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_xml_parser_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_xml_response.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xco_cp_xml_parser=>parse(
      iv_xml = iv_xml_string
    ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_root_node( ).
    DATA(lo_items_node) = lo_root_node->get_child_node( 'items' ).

    LOOP AT lo_items_node->get_child_nodes( 'item' ) INTO DATA(lo_item_node).
      APPEND VALUE ty_xml_data(
        item_id = lo_item_node->get_attribute( 'id' )->get_value( )
        name    = lo_item_node->get_child_node( 'name' )->get_value( )
      ) TO rt_parsed_data.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_json_writer_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             flight_id TYPE string,

      RAISING   cx_xco_cp_json_error.

CLASS zcl_xco_json_writer_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_json_request.
    DATA(lo_json_writer) = cl_xco_cp_json_writer=>create( ).

    lo_json_writer->begin_object( ).
      lo_json_writer->write_member( 'flight_id' )->set_value( is_flight_data-flight_id ).
      lo_json_writer->write_member( 'origin' )->set_value( is_flight_data-origin ).
      lo_json_writer->write_member( 'destination' )->set_value( is_flight_data-destination ).
      lo_json_writer->write_member( 'price' )->set_value( is_flight_data-price ).
    lo_json_writer->end_object( ).

    rv_json_string = lo_json_writer->get_json( )->get_string( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von Aliasen (`s` und `c`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit. `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist eine moderne ABAP-Syntax, die die Deklaration der internen Tabelle vereinfacht.

    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid

In solchen Fällen sind die Felder der rechten Tabelle im Ergebnis initial. Die Join-Bedingung kann über mehrere Felder (`ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND ...`) definiert werden.
keywords: JOINS, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SFLIGHT, SBOOK, OPEN SQL

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` mittels INNER JOIN. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') und sortieren Sie sie nach Flugdatum absteigend.
hint: Fügen Sie `WHERE` und `ORDER BY` Klauseln zur `SELECT`-Anweisung hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_join_filter_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_schedule,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_schedule.
    TYPES tt_flight_schedule TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_schedule WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_sorted_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_schedule) TYPE tt_flight_schedule.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_join_filter_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sorted_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY s~fldate DESCENDING
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_schedule.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_filter_sort FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_filter_sort.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_join_filter_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sorted_flights( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) > 0 exp = abap_true msg = 'Result table should contain entries' ).

    " Verify filtering
    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID should be LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Verify sorting (check first two entries)
    IF lines( lt_results ) >= 2.
      DATA(ls_first) = lt_results[ 1 ].
      DATA(ls_second) = lt_results[ 2 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_first-fldate >= ls_second-fldate msg = 'Results should be sorted by FLDATE DESC' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert einen INNER JOIN mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel zur Filterung und einer `ORDER BY`-Klausel zur Sortierung. Die `WHERE`-Klausel `s~carrid = @iv_carrid` filtert die Ergebnisse nach der übergebenen Fluggesellschaft. Die `ORDER BY s~fldate DESCENDING` sortiert die Flüge absteigend nach Datum. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist obligatorisch in modernem Open SQL.
keywords: JOINS, INNER JOIN, WHERE, ORDER BY, SFLIGHT, SPFLI, OPEN SQL, FILTER, SORT

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der gebuchten Sitze, indem Sie `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` joinen und aggregieren. Beschränken Sie die Ausgabe auf `CARRID`, `CARRNAME`, `FLIGHT_COUNT`, `TOTAL_BOOKED_SEATS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT` und `SUM` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_join_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid             TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname           TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count       TYPE i,
             total_booked_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_join_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_summary.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( s~connid ) AS flight_count, SUM( s~seatsocc ) AS total_booked_seats
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_join_aggregation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) > 0 exp = abap_true msg = 'Result table should contain entries' ).

    " Check for a specific carrier (e.g., 'LH') if it exists
    READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_summary-carrname msg = 'CARRNAME for LH should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 exp = abap_true msg = 'Flight count for LH should be greater than 0' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-total_booked_seats >= 0 exp = abap_true msg = 'Total booked seats for LH should be non-negative' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert einen INNER JOIN mit Aggregatfunktionen (`COUNT`, `SUM`) und einer `GROUP BY`-Klausel. Es berechnet für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der gebuchten Sitze. Die `GROUP BY`-Klausel ist notwendig, um die Aggregation pro Fluggesellschaft durchzuführen. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion von Open SQL für Reporting- und Analyseaufgaben.
keywords: JOINS, AGGREGATION, GROUP BY, COUNT, SUM, SFLIGHT, SCARR, OPEN SQL

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flugverbindungen, die sowohl in `SPFLI` als auch in `SFLIGHT` existieren, aber unterschiedliche Werte für die maximale Kapazität (`SEATSMAX` in `SFLIGHT`, `SEATSMAX` in `SPFLI`) aufweisen. Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` und vergleichen Sie die Felder `SEATSMAX` aus beiden Tabellen in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_join_comparison DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_capacity_mismatch,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             sflight_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             spfli_seatsmax   TYPE spfli-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_capacity_mismatch.
    TYPES tt_capacity_mismatch TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_capacity_mismatch WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_capacity_mismatches RETURNING VALUE(rt_mismatches) TYPE tt_capacity_mismatch.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_join_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_capacity_mismatches.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~seatsmax AS sflight_seatsmax, p~seatsmax AS spfli_seatsmax
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      WHERE s~seatsmax <> p~seatsmax
      INTO TABLE @rt_mismatches.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die durchschnittliche Auslastung ihrer Flüge. Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` und aggregieren Sie die Daten.
hint: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung als `SUM(SEATSOCC) / SUM(SEATSMAX)` und verwenden Sie `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_join_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy_summary,
             carrid             TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname           TYPE scarr-carrname,
             average_occupancy  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_occupancy_summary.
    TYPES tt_occupancy_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupancy RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_occupancy_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_join_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname,
           CAST( SUM( s~seatsocc ) AS dec( 15, 2 ) ) / CAST( SUM( s~seatsmax ) AS dec( 15, 2 ) ) AS average_occupancy
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING SUM( s~seatsmax ) > 0 " Vermeidet Division durch Null
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_join_avg_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_average_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) > 0 exp = abap_true msg = 'Result table should contain entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-carrid msg = 'CARRID should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_first_entry-average_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_first_entry-average_occupancy <= 1 exp = abap_true msg = 'Average occupancy should be between 0 and 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine komplexere Aggregation über einen `INNER JOIN`. Es berechnet die durchschnittliche Auslastung der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Die Division von `SUM(SEATSOCC)` durch `SUM(SEATSMAX)` erfordert `CAST`-Operationen, um eine Dezimalzahl als Ergebnis zu erhalten. Die `HAVING`-Klausel filtert Gruppen, bei denen die Summe der maximalen Sitze Null ist, um Division-by-Zero-Fehler zu vermeiden. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Reporting-Szenario.
keywords: JOINS, AGGREGATION, AVERAGE, SUM, GROUP BY, HAVING, SFLIGHT, SCARR, OPEN SQL, CAST

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die in `SCARR` definiert sind, aber keine Flüge in `SFLIGHT` haben. Verwenden Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Führen Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` von `SCARR` nach `SFLIGHT` durch und filtern Sie, wo die Felder von `SFLIGHT` `IS NULL` sind.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_join_no_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_no_flights,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_no_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_no_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_no_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_without_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_no_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_join_no_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_without_flights.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname
      FROM scarr AS c
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflight AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid IS NULL
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carriers_no_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carriers_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_join_no_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_carriers_without_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results msg = 'Result table should not be initial (even if empty)' ).
    " In a standard SFLIGHT/SCARR setup, all carriers usually have flights.
    " If the test data guarantees carriers without flights, further assertions would be added.
    " For example, if 'XX' is a carrier without flights:
    " READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY carrid = 'XX' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Carrier XX should be found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine gängige Technik, um 'fehlende' Beziehungen zwischen Tabellen zu finden. Durch einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` von `SCARR` nach `SFLIGHT` werden alle Fluggesellschaften beibehalten. Die `WHERE s~carrid IS NULL`-Klausel filtert dann genau die Fluggesellschaften heraus, für die keine passenden Flüge in `SFLIGHT` gefunden wurden. Dies ist nützlich für Datenbereinigung oder Konsistenzprüfungen.
keywords: JOINS, LEFT OUTER JOIN, WHERE IS NULL, SFLIGHT, SCARR, OPEN SQL

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens in einem String durch ein anderes Zeichen, unter Verwendung von String-Templates und der eingebauten `REPLACE`-Funktion.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_char_in_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_char     TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new_char     TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_char_in_string.
    rv_output_string = |{ REPLACE( val = iv_input_string old = iv_old_char new = iv_new_char occ = 0 ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_replace_char FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_char.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_template( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_char_in_string( iv_input_string = 'Hello, World!' iv_old_char = ',' iv_new_char = ';' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello; World!' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_char_in_string( iv_input_string = 'Banana' iv_old_char = 'a' iv_new_char = 'o' ).

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem gegebenen String durch einen neuen Substring.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz eines Nachrichtensammlers mit der Factory-Klasse `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY` und fügen Sie eine einfache Erfolgsmeldung hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY=>GET_MESSAGE_LIST` und die Methode `ADD_MESSAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_factory_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             type    TYPE symsgty,
             id      TYPE symsgid,
             number  TYPE symsgno,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_add_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_factory_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_add_message.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).
    lo_message_list->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'S'
      i_msgid = '00' " Example message class
      i_msgno = '001' " Example message number
      i_msgv1 = 'Operation'
      i_msgv2 = 'successful'
    ).

    LOOP AT lo_message_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_reca_msg).
      APPEND VALUE ty_message(
        type    = ls_reca_msg-msgty
        id      = ls_reca_msg-msgid
        number  = ls_reca_msg-msgno
        message = ls_reca_msg-message
      ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_success_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_success_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_factory_simple( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->create_and_add_message( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_messages[ 1 ]-id ). " Message class 00 is not defined, so it will be empty.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-type exp = 'S' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    " The actual message text depends on system configuration, so we check type and count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY` ist der empfohlene Weg, um in modernen ABAP-Anwendungen einen zentralen Nachrichtensammler zu instanziieren. Dies fördert eine konsistente Fehler- und Statusmeldungsbehandlung. Die `ADD_MESSAGE`-Methode erlaubt das Hinzufügen von Nachrichten mit variablen Platzhaltern.
keywords: Message Handling, CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY, ADD_MESSAGE, Error Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Fehlermeldung mit Platzhaltern und verwenden Sie `REPLACE` (oder String-Templates mit `REPLACE`) um diese Platzhalter im finalen Nachrichtentext zu ersetzen, bevor die Nachricht dem Sammler hinzugefügt wird.

CLASS zcl_msg_replace_placeholders DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_formatted_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_template_message TYPE string
        iv_placeholder      TYPE string

CLASS zcl_msg_replace_placeholders IMPLEMENTATION.

    rs_message_list = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    DATA(lv_final_message) = |{ REPLACE( val = iv_template_message old = iv_placeholder new = iv_replacement occ = 0 ) }|.

    rs_message_list->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'E'
      i_msgid = '00'
      i_msgno = '000' " Generic message number
      i_msgv1 = lv_final_message
    ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer internen Tabelle, die Strings enthält, alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens in jedem String. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und die `REPLACE` Funktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die Tabelle zu iterieren und `REPLACE` für die String-Manipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_replace_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_in_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE ty_string_table
        iv_old_char      TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new_char      TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_strings) TYPE ty_string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_replace_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_in_table.
    rt_output_strings = VALUE ty_string_table(
      FOR <fs_string> IN it_input_strings
      (
        |{ REPLACE( val = <fs_string> old = iv_old_char new = iv_new_char occ = 0 ) }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_in_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_in_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_replace_for( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_itab_replace_for=>ty_string_table( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Cherry' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_itab_replace_for=>ty_string_table( ( 'ApplX' ) ( 'BananX' ) ( 'ChXrry' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_in_table(
      it_input_strings = lt_input
      iv_old_char      = 'e'
      iv_new_char      = 'X'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR`-Expressions ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier wird für jeden Eintrag in der Quelltabelle eine String-Ersetzung durchgeführt und das Ergebnis direkt in eine neue Tabelle geschrieben, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, REPLACE, String Processing, VALUE

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und ersetzen Sie direkt im `SELECT`-Statement alle Leerzeichen im Feld `CARRID` durch Unterstriche.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `AS` und der `REPLACE` Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_replace_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_processed,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             carrid_processed TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_processed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_processed_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_replace_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_processed_carrid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           REPLACE( val = carrid old = ' ' new = '_' occ = 0 ) AS carrid_processed
      FROM sflights
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_replace FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_replace_select( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_processed_carrid( iv_max_rows = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid CA ' '.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( find( val = ls_flight-carrid_processed sub = '_' ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( find( val = ls_flight-carrid_processed sub = ' ' ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Möglichkeit, Funktionen wie `REPLACE` direkt in `SELECT`-Statements zu verwenden, ist ein mächtiges Feature von Open SQL in modernen ABAP-Versionen. Es reduziert die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing in ABAP-Code und verbessert die Performance, da die Transformation direkt auf der Datenbankebene stattfindet.
keywords: SELECT, REPLACE, Open SQL, Data Access, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen String, der Platzhalter enthält, und ersetzen Sie diese Platzhalter zur Laufzeit durch Werte, die aus einer internen Tabelle stammen. Nutzen Sie `REPLACE` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die Ersetzungen zu steuern, und `REPLACE` für die eigentliche String-Manipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_replace_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_placeholder_map,
             placeholder TYPE string,
             value       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_placeholder_map.
    TYPES tt_placeholder_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_placeholder_map WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_dynamic_placeholders
      IMPORTING
        iv_template_string TYPE string
        it_replacements    TYPE tt_placeholder_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_replace_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_dynamic_placeholders.
    rv_result_string = iv_template_string.

    LOOP AT it_replacements INTO DATA(ls_map).
      rv_result_string = |{ REPLACE( val = rv_result_string old = ls_map-placeholder new = ls_map-value occ = 0 ) }|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_replace FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_replace_string( ).
    DATA(lv_template) = 'Hello {name}, today is {day}.'.
    DATA(lt_replacements) = VALUE zcl_dyn_replace_string=>tt_placeholder_map(
      ( placeholder = '{name}' value = 'World' )
      ( placeholder = '{day}' value = 'Friday' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_dynamic_placeholders(
      iv_template_string = lv_template
      it_replacements    = lt_replacements
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World, today is Friday.' ).

    lv_template = 'Item {item_id} has quantity {qty}.'.
    lt_replacements = VALUE zcl_dyn_replace_string=>tt_placeholder_map(
      ( placeholder = '{item_id}' value = 'A123' )
      ( placeholder = '{qty}' value = '100' )
    ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_dynamic_placeholders(
      iv_template_string = lv_template
      it_replacements    = lt_replacements
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Item A123 has quantity 100.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Ersetzung von Platzhaltern in einem String. Durch die Iteration über eine Tabelle von Ersetzungspaaren und die wiederholte Anwendung der `REPLACE`-Funktion kann ein flexibler Mechanismus zur String-Formatierung implementiert werden, der besonders in der Generierung von Texten oder Code nützlich ist.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, String Processing, REPLACE, FOR, Placeholders

Instructions: Sammeln Sie Fehlermeldungen in einer internen Tabelle von Strukturen und fügen Sie diese gesammelt einem `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` hinzu. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `ADD_MESSAGE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und jede Nachricht einzeln hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_add_from_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_raw_message.
    TYPES tt_raw_message TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_messages_from_table
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_messages TYPE tt_raw_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO cl_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_add_from_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_messages_from_table.
    ro_message_list = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    FOR ls_raw_msg IN it_raw_messages.
      ro_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = ls_raw_msg-msgty
        i_msgid = ls_raw_msg-msgid
        i_msgno = ls_raw_msg-msgno
        i_msgv1 = ls_raw_msg-msgv1
      ).
    ENDFOR.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_from_itab FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_from_itab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_add_from_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_messages) = VALUE zcl_msg_add_from_itab=>tt_raw_message(
      ( msgty = 'E' msgid = '00' msgno = '001' msgv1 = 'Error 1' )
      ( msgty = 'W' msgid = '00' msgno = '002' msgv1 = 'Warning 2' )
      ( msgty = 'S' msgid = '00' msgno = '003' msgv1 = 'Success 3' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_message_list) = lo_cut->add_messages_from_table( it_raw_messages = lt_raw_messages ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_message_list->get_messages( ) ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_message_list->has_error_messages( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message_list->get_highest_message_type( ) exp = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine Sammlung von Rohmeldungen, die in einer internen Tabelle vorliegen, effizient in einen zentralen Nachrichtensammler überführt. Die `FOR`-Schleife in Kombination mit `ADD_MESSAGE` ist eine saubere und moderne Art, dies zu bewerkstelligen, und fördert die Modularität der Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: Message Handling, Internal Tables, FOR, ADD_MESSAGE, CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings und ersetzen Sie diese durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Kombination aus `CONDENSE` und `REPLACE` oder String-Templates mit `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_clean_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_clean_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string_spaces.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    CONDENSE lv_temp_string NO-GAPS. " Removes leading/trailing and multiple spaces, replaces with single space
    rv_output_string = lv_temp_string.
    " CONDENSE NO-GAPS already does what is asked, but if we wanted to be explicit with REPLACE:
    " rv_output_string = |{ REPLACE( val = lv_temp_string old = '  ' new = ' ' occ = 0 ) }|.
    " The above line would be needed if CONDENSE NO-GAPS didn't handle multiple spaces, but it does.
    " For demonstration of REPLACE, we can use it to ensure single spaces if CONDENSE was not used.
    " Let's stick to CONDENSE for efficiency, but mention REPLACE as an alternative for specific cases.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_clean_spaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_clean_spaces( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_string_spaces( '  Hello   World   ABAP  ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World ABAP' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->clean_string_spaces( 'SingleSpace' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'SingleSpace' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->clean_string_spaces( '   Leading and Trailing   ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Leading and Trailing' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CONDENSE NO-GAPS`-Anweisung ist eine effiziente Methode, um führende, nachfolgende und mehrfache Leerzeichen in einem String zu bereinigen und durch einzelne Leerzeichen zu ersetzen. Obwohl `REPLACE` für spezifische Ersetzungen verwendet werden kann, ist `CONDENSE NO-GAPS` für diese Aufgabe oft die direktere und performantere Lösung.
keywords: String Processing, CONDENSE, REPLACE, Leerzeichen

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Nachrichten aus einem `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` in ein benutzerdefiniertes Format umwandelt und dabei die `REPLACE`-Funktion verwendet, um bestimmte Textmuster in den Nachrichten zu anonymisieren.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Nachrichtenliste, formatieren Sie jede Nachricht und nutzen Sie `REPLACE` für die Anonymisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_anonymize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_anonymized_message,
             type    TYPE symsgty,
             text    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_anonymized_message.
    TYPES tt_anonymized_message TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_anonymized_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_anonymized_messages
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO cl_reca_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_anonymized_messages) TYPE tt_anonymized_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_anonymize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_anonymized_messages.
    LOOP AT io_message_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_reca_msg).
      DATA(lv_anonymized_text) = ls_reca_msg-message.
      " Example: Anonymize any numbers (e.g., material numbers, IDs) with 'XXXX'
      lv_anonymized_text = |{ REPLACE( val = lv_anonymized_text regex = '\d+' new = 'XXXX' occ = 0 ) }|.
      " Example: Anonymize specific words
      lv_anonymized_text = |{ REPLACE( val = lv_anonymized_text old = 'Confidential' new = '[ANONYMIZED]' occ = 0 ) }|.

      APPEND VALUE ty_anonymized_message(
        type = ls_reca_msg-msgty
        text = lv_anonymized_text
      ) TO rt_anonymized_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_anonymize_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_anonymize_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = '00' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Error with item 12345. Confidential data.' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = '00' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = 'Warning for user 67890.' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_anonymize( ).
    DATA(lt_anonymized) = lo_cut->get_anonymized_messages( io_message_list = lo_message_list ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_anonymized ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_anonymized[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Error with item XXXX. [ANONYMIZED] data.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_anonymized[ 2 ]-text exp = 'Warning for user XXXX.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung der `REPLACE`-Funktion, insbesondere mit regulären Ausdrücken (`regex`), um sensible Informationen in Nachrichtentexten zu anonymisieren. Dies ist entscheidend für Datenschutz und Compliance, wenn Nachrichten protokolliert oder an externe Systeme übermittelt werden. Die Kombination mit dem Nachrichtensammler zeigt einen realitätsnahen Anwendungsfall.
keywords: Message Handling, REPLACE, Regex, Anonymization, String Processing, CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von zwei Ganzzahlen (10 und 20) mit dem `COMPUTE`-Befehl und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Variablen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COMPUTE`-Befehl für arithmetische Operationen. Beachten Sie die Datentypen für die Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE i.
    COMPUTE lv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
    COMPUTE rv_average = lv_sum / 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_compute_average( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_average( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '15.0' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_average( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '5.5' ).

Obwohl moderne ABAP-Syntax oft funktionale Ausdrücke bevorzugt, ist `COMPUTE` weiterhin gültig und nützlich für schrittweise Berechnungen. Die Verwendung von `decfloat16` stellt sicher, dass auch bei der Division von Ganzzahlen Dezimalwerte korrekt behandelt werden.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Bildinformationen (Breite, Höhe, Typ) einer gegebenen Bild-XSTRING-Repräsentation mithilfe der Klasse `CL_FXS_IMAGE_INFO`.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_FXS_IMAGE_INFO` und verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_IMAGE_INFO_FROM_XSTRING`. Beachten Sie die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_info_determiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_info,
             width  TYPE i,
             height TYPE i,
             type   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_info.
    METHODS get_info_from_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_image_info) TYPE ty_image_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_info_determiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_info_from_xstring.
    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ).
    TRY.
        lo_image_info->get_image_info_from_xstring(
          EXPORTING
            i_xstring = iv_image_xstring
          IMPORTING
            e_width   = rs_image_info-width
            e_height  = rs_image_info-height
            e_type    = rs_image_info-type
        ).
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_image_info).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Loggen des Fehlers oder Rückgabe einer leeren Struktur
        CLEAR rs_image_info.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_info_from_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_info_from_xstring.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_image_info_determiner( ).
    " Ein sehr kleines, gültiges GIF-Bild als XSTRING (1x1 Pixel, rot)
    DATA(lv_gif_xstring) TYPE xstring VALUE '47494638396101000100800000FF000000000021F90401000000002C00000000010001000002024401003B'.
    DATA(ls_image_info) = lo_cut->get_info_from_xstring( lv_gif_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_image_info-width  exp = 1   msg = 'Breite sollte 1 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_image_info-height exp = 1   msg = 'Höhe sollte 1 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_image_info-type   exp = 'GIF' msg = 'Typ sollte GIF sein' ).

    " Test mit leerem XSTRING (sollte Fehler fangen und leere Struktur zurückgeben)
    CLEAR lv_gif_xstring.
    ls_image_info = lo_cut->get_info_from_xstring( lv_gif_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_image_info-width  msg = 'Breite sollte initial sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_image_info-height msg = 'Höhe sollte initial sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_image_info-type   msg = 'Typ sollte initial sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung der SAP-Standardklasse `CL_FXS_IMAGE_INFO` zur Extraktion von Metadaten aus einem Bild, das als XSTRING vorliegt. Dies ist nützlich für Anwendungen, die Bilddateien verarbeiten müssen, ohne sie auf dem Dateisystem zu speichern. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' (CITYFROM) abfliegen und von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (CARRID) durchgeführt werden, und verwenden Sie dabei eine funktionale `FILTER`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen, um eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt LH-Flüge von Frankfurt in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid   exp = 'LH'        msg = 'CARRID sollte LH sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' msg = 'CITYFROM sollte FRANKFURT sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Einträge enthält, die den angegebenen Bedingungen entsprechen. Dies ist wesentlich prägnanter und oft performanter als eine explizite `LOOP` mit `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_template_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_string_template_flight=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid   = 'LH'

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der `sflights`-Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Initialisieren Sie einen Akkumulator und addieren Sie die Preise in der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur mit dem `CORRESPONDING`-Operator, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen kopiert werden.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtumsatz aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), indem Sie `COMPUTE` in einer Schleife verwenden und das Ergebnis in einer Inline-deklarierten Variablen speichern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` für die Inline-Deklaration und `COMPUTE` für die Akkumulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_total_revenue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_revenue
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_total_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_current_total) = 0. " Inline-Deklaration für den Akkumulator

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COMPUTE lv_current_total = lv_current_total + ls_flight-price.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_total_revenue = lv_current_total.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_calculate_total_revenue FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_revenue.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_compute_total_revenue( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge in SFLIGHT mit Preisen > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Gesamtumsatz sollte nicht 0 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_result > 0 ) msg = 'Gesamtumsatz sollte positiv sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination des traditionellen `COMPUTE`-Befehls mit modernen ABAP-Features wie der Inline-Deklaration (`DATA(...)`) innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Anweisung. Obwohl für Aggregationen der `REDUCE`-Operator oft bevorzugt wird, demonstriert dies, wie `COMPUTE` weiterhin in modernen Kontexten verwendet werden kann, um schrittweise Berechnungen durchzuführen.
keywords: COMPUTE, LOOP, Internal Tables, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (`sflight`) und füllen Sie diese mit einigen Daten. Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und Feld-Symbole.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit Feld-Symbolen, um die Tabelle dynamisch zu manipulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Struktur-Beschreibung für SFLIGHT erhalten
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " 2. Tabellen-Beschreibung erstellen
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    " 3. Dynamische Tabelle erstellen
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 4. Daten hinzufügen
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = '0400'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CITYFROM' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'FRANKFURT'. ENDIF.
    INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = '0017'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CITYFROM' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'NEW YORK'. ENDIF.
    INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamische Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Tabelle sollte 2 Einträge haben' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_line> msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte existieren' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID des ersten Eintrags falsch' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_line> msg = 'Zweiter Eintrag sollte existieren' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CITYFROM' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'CITYFROM des zweiten Eintrags falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und Feld-Symbolen. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die in Szenarien nützlich ist, in denen die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. bei generischen Datenverarbeitungsroutinen oder Schnittstellen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Quadratwurzel einer Zahl (z.B. 144) mit der `SQRT`-Funktion und dem `COMPUTE`-Befehl, wobei das Ergebnis in einer Inline-deklarierten Variablen gespeichert wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CARRID, CONNID) und den Preis (PRICE) aus der `sflights`-Tabelle enthält, indem Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` verwenden.

CLASS zcl_value_for_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_value_for_itab IMPLEMENTATION.

Es ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Syntax, um Daten zu mappen und zu filtern, was den Code deutlich lesbarer und wartbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP`-Konstrukte mit expliziten `APPEND`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle für eine ALV-Anzeige, die die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` anzeigt. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation und `cl_alv_table_create` für die dynamische Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_agg_data.
    TYPES: tt_agg_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE REF TO data.
    METHODS get_aggregated_field_catalog RETURNING VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_sflight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_aggregated) = REDUCE tt_agg_data(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_agg_data( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflight BY carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
      ( APPEND VALUE ty_agg_data(
          carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
          total_price = SUM( ls_sflight-price )
        ) TO result
      ) ).

    DATA(lt_fcat) = get_aggregated_field_catalog( ).
    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = rt_data.

    ASSIGN rt_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_target_table>).
    <fs_target_table> = lt_aggregated.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_aggregated_field_catalog.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Airline' ) TO rt_field_catalog.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'TOTAL_PRICE' coltext = 'Total Price' inttype = 'P' intlen = 8 decimals = 2 ) TO rt_field_catalog.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Further checks could involve specific values if test data is controlled
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_alv_status_icon IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_with_status.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lt_fcat) = get_field_catalog_with_status( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` visualisiert. Beachten Sie, dass für die Anzeige ein Custom Container auf einem Dynpro benötigt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` und bereiten Sie die Daten in einer internen Tabelle vor. Aggregation mit `COLLECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flights_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_chart_data,
            carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
            count  TYPE i,
          END OF ls_chart_data.
    DATA: lt_chart_data LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_chart_data.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT ls_flight-carrid INTO ls_chart_data.
      ls_chart_data-count = ls_chart_data-count + 1.
      CLEAR ls_chart_data-carrid. " Clear key field for next COLLECT
    ENDLOOP.
    " Move collected data to final table
    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_chart_data ( carrid = ls_entry-carrid count = ls_entry-count ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CHART_CONTAINER' " Needs a screen container
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_container( lo_container ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Flights per Carrier' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_category_label( 'Carrier' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_value_label( 'Number of Flights' ).

    " Prepare data for chart engine
    DATA: lt_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_series.
    DATA: ls_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_series.
    DATA: lt_categories TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_categories.
    DATA: ls_category TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_category.

    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      ls_category-name = ls_data-carrid.
      APPEND ls_category TO lt_categories.

      ls_data_series-data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data( ( ls_data-count ) ).
      ls_data_series-legend = ls_data-carrid.
      APPEND ls_data_series TO lt_data_series.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart_engine->set_data_series( lt_data_series ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_categories( lt_categories ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

    " To display the chart, this method would typically be called from a PBO
    " of a screen with a custom container named 'CHART_CONTAINER'.
    " For a standalone example, this is illustrative.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_market_share DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_chart_market_share IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_chart_data,
            carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
            total_price TYPE sflight-price,
          END OF ls_chart_data.
    DATA: lt_chart_data LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_chart_data.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT ls_flight-carrid INTO ls_chart_data.
      ls_chart_data-total_price = ls_chart_data-total_price + ls_flight-price.
      CLEAR ls_chart_data-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_chart_data ( carrid = ls_entry-carrid total_price = ls_entry-total_price ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CHART_CONTAINER'
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_container( lo_container ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_pie ).

CLASS zcl_chart_price_trend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_agg_data,
            carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
            fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
            avg_price TYPE sflight-price,

          END OF ls_agg_data.
    DATA: lt_agg_data LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_agg_data.

    SELECT carrid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    " Aggregate average price per carrier and date
    lt_agg_data = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE tt_agg_data( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight BY carrid, fldate
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate

          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate
          avg_price = AVG( ls_flight-price )
          count = COUNT( ls_flight-price )
        ) TO result
      ) ).

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(

    " Populate data series (one series per carrier)

      DATA(ls_data_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_series( legend = ls_agg_carrier-carrid ).

  METHOD display_chart.

            count TYPE i,

    tt_agg_data = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE tt_agg_data( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight BY carrid, currency
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid, currency = ls_flight-currency
      ( APPEND VALUE ty_agg_data(
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          currency = ls_flight-currency
          count = COUNT( ls_flight-carrid )
        ) TO result
      ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CHART_CONTAINER'
        dynpro_program = sy-repid

    lo_chart_engine->set_category_label( 'Carrier' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_value_label( 'Number of Flights' ).

    DATA: lt_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_series.
    DATA: lt_categories TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_categories.

    " Populate categories (carriers)
    LOOP AT tt_agg_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_carrier) GROUP BY ls_agg_carrier-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_category( name = ls_agg_carrier-carrid ) TO lt_categories.

    " Populate data series (one series per currency)

      DATA(ls_data_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_series( legend = ls_agg_currency-currency ).
      LOOP AT lt_categories INTO DATA(ls_category).
        READ TABLE tt_agg_data WITH KEY carrid = ls_category-name currency = ls_agg_currency-currency INTO DATA(ls_found).

          APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data( ls_found-count ) TO ls_data_series-data.
        ELSE.
          APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data( 0 ) TO ls_data_series-data.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_data_series TO lt_data_series.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart_engine->set_data_series( lt_data_series ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_categories( lt_categories ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle für eine ALV-Anzeige, die Daten aus `SFLIGHT` enthält. Fügen Sie eine Spalte `FLIGHT_STATUS` hinzu, die den Status 'On Time', 'Delayed' oder 'Cancelled' basierend auf einer zufälligen Logik setzt. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` für die Zuweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FOR` und `COND` für die Datenbefüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             currency    TYPE sflight-currency,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_table_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE REF TO data.
    METHODS get_field_catalog_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_with_status.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lt_fcat) = get_field_catalog_with_status( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = rt_data.

    ASSIGN rt_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Populate dynamic table with status using FOR and COND
    <fs_table> = VALUE tt_sflight_status( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
      ( VALUE ty_sflight_status(
          carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
          price = ls_sflight-price
          currency = ls_sflight-currency
          flight_status = COND string(
            WHEN sy-tabix MOD 3 = 0 THEN 'On Time'
            WHEN sy-tabix MOD 3 = 1 THEN 'Delayed'
            ELSE 'Cancelled'
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_field_catalog_with_status.
    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_field_catalog
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      IMPORTING
        e_field_catalog  = rt_field_catalog.

    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat(
      fieldname = 'FLIGHT_STATUS'
      coltext   = 'Flight Status'
      inttype   = 'C'
      intlen    = 20
      outputlen = 20
    ) TO rt_field_catalog.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
