CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_table_with_status( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_table> IS NOT INITIAL ).
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGN <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_line> IS NOT INITIAL ).
    DATA(lv_status) = ''.
    TRY.
        GET REFERENCE OF <fs_line>-flight_status INTO DATA(lr_status).
        lv_status = lr_status->*.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Field FLIGHT_STATUS not found or accessible.' ).
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_status IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_status = 'On Time' OR lv_status = 'Delayed' OR lv_status = 'Cancelled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_filter_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE REF TO data.
    METHODS get_field_catalog RETURNING VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_filter_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lt_fcat) = get_field_catalog( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    " Filter flights with price > 300
    DATA(lt_filtered_sflight) = FILTER sflight_tt FROM lt_sflight WHERE price > 300.

    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = rt_data.

    ASSIGN rt_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    <fs_table> = lt_filtered_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_field_catalog
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      IMPORTING
        e_field_catalog  = rt_field_catalog.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Liniendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Monat für die letzten 12 Monate aus `SFLIGHT` anzeigt. Wenn keine Daten für einen Monat vorhanden sind, soll der Wert 0 angezeigt werden. Beachten Sie, dass für die Anzeige ein Custom Container auf einem Dynpro benötigt wird.
hint: Generieren Sie eine Liste der letzten 12 Monate und aggregieren Sie die `SFLIGHT`-Daten. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_monthly_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_monthly_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_agg_data,
            year_month TYPE char6,
            count TYPE i,
          END OF ls_agg_data.
    DATA: tt_agg_data LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_agg_data.

    " Get data for the last 12 months
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_12_months_ago) = lv_current_date - 365.

    SELECT fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN @lv_12_months_ago AND @lv_current_date.

    " Aggregate count per year-month
    tt_agg_data = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE tt_agg_data( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight BY substring( val = ls_flight-fldate off = 0 len = 6 )
      GROUP BY year_month = substring( val = ls_flight-fldate off = 0 len = 6 )
      ( APPEND VALUE ty_agg_data(
          year_month = year_month
          count = COUNT( ls_flight-fldate )
        ) TO result
      ) ).

    " Generate categories for last 12 months, filling missing months with 0
    DATA: lt_categories TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_categories.
    DATA: lt_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_series.
    DATA(ls_data_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_series( legend = 'Number of Flights' ).

    DATA(lv_date) = lv_12_months_ago.
    DO 12 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_year_month) = lv_date(6).
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_category( name = lv_year_month ) TO lt_categories.

      READ TABLE tt_agg_data WITH KEY year_month = lv_year_month INTO DATA(ls_found).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data( ls_found-count ) TO ls_data_series-data.
      ELSE.
        APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data( 0 ) TO ls_data_series-data.
      ENDIF.

      lv_date = lv_date + 30. " Approximate next month
    ENDDO.
    APPEND ls_data_series TO lt_data_series.

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CHART_CONTAINER'
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_container( lo_container ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Monthly Flight Count (Last 12 Months)' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_category_label( 'Month' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_value_label( 'Count' ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data_series( lt_data_series ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_categories( lt_categories ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus `SFLIGHT` anzeigt. Passen Sie den Titel des Diagramms und die Beschriftungen der Achsen dynamisch an.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `set_chart_title`, `set_category_label` und `set_value_label` der `cl_gui_chart_engine`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_custom_labels DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_chart_title TYPE string DEFAULT 'Dynamic Flight Chart'
        iv_category_label TYPE string DEFAULT 'Airline'
        iv_value_label TYPE string DEFAULT 'Flight Count'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_custom_labels IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_chart_data,
            carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
            count  TYPE i,
          END OF ls_chart_data.
    DATA: lt_chart_data LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_chart_data.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT ls_flight-carrid INTO ls_chart_data.
      ls_chart_data-count = ls_chart_data-count + 1.
      CLEAR ls_chart_data-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_chart_data ( carrid = ls_entry-carrid count = ls_entry-count ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CHART_CONTAINER'
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_container( lo_container ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( iv_chart_title ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_category_label( iv_category_label ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_value_label( iv_value_label ).

    DATA: lt_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_series.
    DATA: ls_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_series.
    DATA: lt_categories TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_categories.
    DATA: ls_category TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_category.

    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      ls_category-name = ls_data-carrid.
      APPEND ls_category TO lt_categories.

      ls_data_series-data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data( ( ls_data-count ) ).
      ls_data_series-legend = ls_data-carrid.
      APPEND ls_data_series TO lt_data_series.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart_engine->set_data_series( lt_data_series ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_categories( lt_categories ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_price FOR TESTING.

    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA',
          mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0017',
          mv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20251206'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate price = 100.00 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_sflight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = 150.00.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate iv_new_price = lv_new_price ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-price exp = lv_new_price msg = 'Price should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id

CLASS zcl_update_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_safely.
    TRY.
        UPDATE sflights SET price = @iv_new_price
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rv_error_message = 'Update failed, but no exception raised (e.g., record not found).'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_db_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge aus und aktualisieren Sie deren Preise basierend auf einer Bedingung, indem Sie eine interne Tabelle verwenden und dann eine Massenaktualisierung durchführen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)` und anschließend `UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flights_by_condition
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
        iv_price_increase TYPE s_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_by_condition.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid_filter
        AND price < @iv_price_threshold.

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price + iv_price_increase.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights.
      rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_field    TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING   cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_set_clause) = |{ iv_field } = '{ iv_new_value }'|.

    TRY.
        UPDATE sflights SET (lv_set_clause)
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_dyn_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage    TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 " e.g., 1.10 for +10%
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_percent_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_by_percentage.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid_filter.

    IF lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_updated_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
        ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
          connid   = ls_flight-connid
          fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
          price    = ls_flight-price * iv_percentage
          currency = ls_flight-currency )
      ).

      UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_updated_flights.
      rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges in `SFLIGHTS` nur, wenn der aktuelle Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, unter Verwendung einer `CASE`-Anweisung in der `SET`-Klausel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... SET price = CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_case_set DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_price_with_case
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid        TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid        TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate        TYPE s_date
        iv_threshold_price TYPE s_price
        iv_new_price     TYPE s_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_case_set IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_with_case.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = CASE WHEN price < @iv_threshold_price THEN @iv_new_price ELSE price END
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`MAXFSEAT`) für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers in `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf der Summe der aktuellen Sitzplatzbelegung (`SEATSCC`) aller Flüge dieses Carriers, multipliziert mit einem Faktor.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Subquery mit `SELECT SUM(...)` in der `SET`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_maxfseat_aggregated
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_factor        TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 " e.g., 1.20 for 20% increase
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_maxfseat_aggregated.
    UPDATE sflights SET maxfseat = ( SELECT SUM( seatscc ) * @iv_factor
                                     FROM sflights AS sub
                                     WHERE sub~carrid = sflights~carrid )
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid_filter.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251215' seatscc = 50 maxfseat = 100 )

Instructions: Erstelle eine XLSX-Datei mit zwei Blättern. Das erste Blatt enthält Flugdaten (`sflights`), das zweite Blatt enthält Fluggesellschaftsdaten (`scarr`). Formatiere die Überschriften beider Blätter fett.
hint: Nutze `add_sheet`, `add_sheet_from_data` und `set_cell_style` mit `cl_xlsx_cell_style`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_multi_sheet RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_multi_sheet.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr UP TO 3 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_style_bold) = NEW cl_xlsx_cell_style( ).
    lo_style_bold->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    " Sheet 1: SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lo_sheet_flights) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Flugdaten' ).
    lo_sheet_flights->add_sheet_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_tab = lt_sflights
        i_initial_row = 1
        i_initial_column = 1
        i_with_column_headers = abap_true
    ).
    " Apply bold style to header row
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_style(
        i_row = 1
        i_column = sy-tabix
        i_style = lo_style_bold
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sheet 2: SCARR
    DATA(lo_sheet_carriers) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Fluggesellschaften' ).
    lo_sheet_carriers->add_sheet_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_tab = lt_scarr
        i_initial_row = 1
        i_initial_column = 1
        i_with_column_headers = abap_true
    ).
    " Apply bold style to header row
    LOOP AT lt_scarr ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_scarr>).
      lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_style(
        i_row = 1
        i_column = sy-tabix
        i_style = lo_style_bold
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportiere Daten aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit dynamisch ermittelt wird, in eine XLSX-Datei. Die Spaltenüberschriften sollen dabei aus dem Feldkatalog generiert werden.
hint: Nutze RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) um die Struktur zu analysieren und die Spaltenüberschriften zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        i_data TYPE REF TO data " Internal table with any structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_data> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN i_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF <lt_data> IS NOT BOUND OR <lt_data> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Dynamische Daten' ).

    " Get field names for headers
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_data>[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA lt_headers TYPE string_table.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND ls_component-name TO lt_headers.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add headers
    lo_sheet->add_row( lt_headers ).

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT <lt_data> ASSIGNING <ls_data>.
      DATA lt_row_values TYPE string_table.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE ANY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO lt_row_values. " Convert any type to string
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      lo_sheet->add_row( lt_row_values ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Lese Daten aus einer vorhandenen XLSX-Datei (als XSTRING) und gib den Inhalt des ersten Blattes als interne Tabelle von Strings zurück.
hint: Nutze `cl_xlsx_document=>create_from_xstring` und `get_sheet_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_xlsx_data
      IMPORTING
        i_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_xlsx_data.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = cl_xlsx_document=>create_from_xstring( i_xstring ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ). " Get first sheet

    IF lo_sheet IS BOUND.
      DATA lt_sheet_data TYPE cl_xlsx_document=>tt_sheet_data.
      lo_sheet->get_sheet_data( IMPORTING et_data = lt_sheet_data ).

      LOOP AT lt_sheet_data INTO DATA(ls_row).
        DATA lv_row_string TYPE string.
        LOOP AT ls_row-cells INTO DATA(ls_cell).
          lv_row_string = |{ lv_row_string }{ COND string( WHEN lv_row_string IS NOT INITIAL THEN ',' ELSE '' ) }{ ls_cell-value }|.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND lv_row_string TO rt_data.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_xlsx_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_xlsx_data.
    " Create a dummy XLSX file in XSTRING for testing
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_test_data UP TO 1 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx_writer) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet_writer) = lo_xlsx_writer->add_sheet( 'TestSheet' ).
    lo_sheet_writer->add_sheet_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_tab = lt_test_data
        i_initial_row = 1
        i_initial_column = 1
        i_with_column_headers = abap_true
    ).
    DATA(lv_test_xstring) = lo_xlsx_writer->save_document( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_read_data( ).
    DATA(lt_read_data) = lo_cut->read_xlsx_data( lv_test_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_read_data msg = 'Gelesene Daten sollten nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_read_data ) exp = 2 msg = 'Erwartet 2 Zeilen (Header + 1 Datenzeile)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine vorhandene XLSX-Datei, die als XSTRING vorliegt, einliest. Es verwendet `create_from_xstring` um das Dokument zu öffnen und `get_sheet_by_index` sowie `get_sheet_data` um den Inhalt des ersten Arbeitsblatts zu extrahieren. Instructions: Erstelle eine XLSX-Datei mit Flugdaten. Hebe alle Flugpreise über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert farblich hervor und füge eine Zeile mit der Summe der Flugpreise hinzu.
hint: Nutze `set_cell_style` mit `cl_xlsx_cell_style` für bedingte Formatierung und `set_cell_formula` für die Summenformel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_styling_formula DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_formatted_sflights
      IMPORTING
        i_threshold TYPE sflights-price DEFAULT 500
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_styling_formula IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_formatted_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Flugpreise' ).

    " Style for highlighted cells (e.g., red background)
    DATA(lo_style_highlight) = NEW cl_xlsx_cell_style( ).
    lo_style_highlight->set_background_color( cl_xlsx_cell_style=>co_color_red ).

    " Add headers
    lo_sheet->add_row( VALUE string_table( ( 'Carrier ID' ) ( 'Connection ID' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ( 'Price' ) ( 'Currency' ) ) ).

    " Add data and apply conditional styling
    DATA lv_row_idx TYPE i VALUE 1.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_row_idx = lv_row_idx + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 1 i_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 2 i_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 3 i_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 4 i_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 5 i_value = ls_sflight-currency ).

      IF ls_sflight-price > i_threshold.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_style( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 4 i_style = lo_style_highlight ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add sum formula
    lv_row_idx = lv_row_idx + 1.
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 3 i_value = 'Total:' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_formula( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 4 i_formula = |SUM(D2:D{ lv_row_idx - 1 })| ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere einen Timer, dessen Event-Handler auf einen spezifischen Kontext oder Parameter zugreifen kann, der beim Start des Timers festgelegt wurde. Die Lösung muss ohne tatsächliche GUI-Interaktion testbar sein.
hint: Speichere den Kontext als Attribut in der Timer-verwaltenden Klasse, auf das der Event-Handler zugreifen kann.

CLASS zcl_timer_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_gui_event_handler.
    DATA mv_last_context TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_tick_count TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_initial_context TYPE string.
    METHODS start_timer.
    METHODS stop_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_current_context TYPE string.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    i_initial_context = COND string( WHEN i_initial_context IS INITIAL THEN 'Default Context' ELSE i_initial_context ).
    mv_current_context = i_initial_context.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 750. " 0.75 seconds
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_background.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mv_tick_count = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->start( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_tick_count = mv_tick_count + 1.
    mv_last_context = mv_current_context.
    " Simulate context change for next tick
    mv_current_context = |{ mv_current_context }_tick{ mv_tick_count }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simuliere eine periodische Hintergrundprüfung mit einem Timer, der seine Aktivitäten in einer internen Log-Tabelle protokolliert. Die Lösung muss ohne tatsächliche GUI-Interaktion testbar sein.

CLASS zcl_timer_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES if_gui_event_handler.

             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

CLASS zcl_timer_logger IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstelle eine XLSX-Datei, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften (`scarr`) enthält und für jede Fluggesellschaft einen Hyperlink zu deren Website (simuliert) hinzufügt.
hint: Nutze `set_cell_value` und `set_cell_hyperlink`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_hyperlink DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_with_hyperlinks RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_hyperlink IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_with_hyperlinks.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Fluggesellschaften' ).

    " Add headers
    lo_sheet->add_row( VALUE string_table( ( 'Carrier ID' ) ( 'Carrier Name' ) ( 'URL' ) ) ).

    DATA lv_row_idx TYPE i VALUE 1.
    LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      lv_row_idx = lv_row_idx + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 1 i_value = ls_scarr-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 2 i_value = ls_scarr-carrname ).

      DATA(lv_url) = |https://www.{ to_lower( ls_scarr-carrid ) }.com|.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 3 i_value = lv_url ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_hyperlink( i_row = lv_row_idx i_column = 3 i_url = lv_url ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_auto_width IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementiere einen Timer, der eine Methode asynchron aufruft, um die GUI nicht zu blockieren. Die Lösung muss ohne tatsächliche GUI-Interaktion testbar sein.
hint: Nutze `CALL METHOD ... IN BACKGROUND TASK` oder `CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK` innerhalb des Timer-Event-Handlers, um die Aktion asynchron auszuführen. Für den Unit-Test wird die asynchrone Logik direkt aufgerufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_async DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_gui_event_handler.
    DATA mv_async_call_count TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_async_timer.
    METHODS stop_async_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer IMPORTING sender.
    METHODS perform_async_action FOR BACKGROUND TASK.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_async IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 1000.
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_background.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mv_async_call_count = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_async_timer.
    mo_timer->start( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_async_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    " In a real GUI scenario, this would prevent GUI blocking.
    " For unit test, we simulate the background task call.
    CALL METHOD perform_async_action IN BACKGROUND TASK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_async_action.
    " This method runs in a separate work process (simulated for test)
    mv_async_call_count = mv_async_call_count + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_async_timer_action FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_async_timer_action.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_async( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_async_call_count exp = 0 msg = 'Asynchroner Zähler sollte initial 0 sein' ).

    " Simulate the timer event, which in turn calls the async method
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( sender = lo_cut->mo_timer ).
    " Directly call the async method for testing purposes
    lo_cut->perform_async_action( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_async_call_count exp = 2 msg = 'Asynchroner Zähler sollte 2 sein nach simulierten Aufrufen' ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( sender = lo_cut->mo_timer ).
    lo_cut->perform_async_action( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_async_call_count exp = 4 msg = 'Asynchroner Zähler sollte 4 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein Timer eine Aktion asynchron auslösen kann, um die GUI nicht zu blockieren. Die Methode `perform_async_action` ist als `FOR BACKGROUND TASK` deklariert, was in einem echten System eine Ausführung in einem separaten Workprozess bedeuten würde. Im Unit-Test wird diese Methode direkt aufgerufen, um die Logik zu überprüfen.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, asynchronous, background task, GUI blocking, event handling

CLASS zcl_barcode_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und die Währung aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, wobei die Flugnummern in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FOR` -Expression mit `VALUE #` und `to_upper`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             loccur TYPE sflight-loccur,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapped_flight,
             flight_number TYPE sflight-connid,
             currency_code TYPE sflight-loccur,
           END OF ty_mapped_flight.
    TYPES: tt_mapped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_reduced
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_flights) TYPE tt_mapped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights.
    rt_mapped_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
        ( flight_number = to_upper( ls_flight-connid )
          currency_code = ls_flight-loccur )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_number exp = '0017' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von `sflights` Datensätzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` -Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-loccur,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_input.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Datensätze in eine interne Tabelle ein und lesen Sie einen Datensatz mit einem Tabellen-Ausdruck (`TABLE_LINE`) aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #` zum Füllen der Tabelle und `itab[ key_field = value ]` zum Lesen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expressions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    lt_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251206' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251206' price = '250.50' )
    ).

    TRY.
        rs_flight = lt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expressions( ).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Tabellen-Ausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle über ihren Schlüssel, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist für nicht gefundene Zeilen wichtig.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, VALUE, cx_sy_itab_line_not_found

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methoden der Typbeschreibungsklassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_type_name
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_type_name.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    rv_type_name = lo_descr->get_name( ).

    IF lo_descr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
      DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr ).
      rv_type_name = |{ rv_type_name } (Table of { lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_name( ) })|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Optimieren Sie das Lesen eines Datensatzes aus einer internen Tabelle, indem Sie einen Hash-Schlüssel verwenden.

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Schnittstelle mit einer Methode und implementieren Sie diese in einer Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` und `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING INTERFACE`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log file or system log
    cl_demo_output=>display( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_message.
    DATA(lo_logger) = CAST zif_logger( NEW zcl_console_logger( ) ).
    " This test primarily checks for syntax and execution without error.
    " Verifying cl_demo_output is difficult in a unit test.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking cl_demo_output or checking a log table.
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for console logger' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " If execution reaches here, it's a success for this simple test " ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Schnittstellen (`INTERFACE`) definieren Verträge für Klassen und fördern die lose Kopplung und Polymorphie. Die Implementierung einer Schnittstelle in einer Klasse (`IMPLEMENTING INTERFACE`) stellt sicher, dass die Klasse die definierten Methoden bereitstellt. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Konzept der modernen Objektorientierung in ABAP.
keywords: Interface, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Class, Implementing

Instructions: Fügen Sie die Zeilen einer zweiten internen Tabelle an eine erste interne Tabelle an, wobei Sie moderne Syntax verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Operator `APPEND LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_lines_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights1 TYPE ty_t_sflight
        it_flights2 TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_lines_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_flights.
    rt_combined_flights = it_flights1.
    APPEND LINES OF it_flights2 TO rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_append_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_lines.
    DATA: lt_flights1 TYPE zcl_append_lines_of=>ty_t_sflight,
          lt_flights2 TYPE zcl_append_lines_of=>ty_t_sflight,
          ls_flight   TYPE zcl_append_lines_of=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights1.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ).
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_lines_of( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->append_flights( it_flights1 = lt_flights1 it_flights2 = lt_flights2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Operator `APPEND LINES OF` ermöglicht das effiziente Anhängen aller Zeilen einer internen Tabelle an eine andere. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu Schleifen und einzelnen `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, APPEND LINES OF, VALUE, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle filtern und transformieren, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                   WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                   ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_expression.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_for_expression=>ty_t_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_for_expression=>ty_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 250 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' price = 50  ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = 150 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen. Er verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert Boilerplate-Code im Vergleich zu expliziten Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Filtering, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_t_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_item IN it_items NEXT s = s + ls_item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>ty_t_items.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 10 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 20 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 30 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 60 ).

    CLEAR lt_items.
    lv_sum = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Methode, um Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere aggregierte Werte zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen zu verwenden.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen mit dem `SWITCH`-Operator zu.

solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_day_of_week TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_type.
    rv_day_type = SWITCH string(
                      iv_day_of_week
                      WHEN 1 THEN 'Sonntag'

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung mit dem `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER type( itab WHERE condition )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_city        TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_city ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_expression=>ty_t_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_filter_expression=>ty_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'  ) TO lt_flights.

keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Functional Programming, Filtering

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus den ersten 3 Einträgen der Tabelle `sflight`, wobei jeder Flug ein 'Flight'-Element mit 'Carrid', 'Connid' und 'Fldate' als Attribute ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP` über die interne Tabelle und `write_attribute` für jedes Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_sflights_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_xml_from_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sflights_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_from_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_sxml_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).
    lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_sxml_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Carrid' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sxml_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Connid' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sxml_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Fldate' value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).
    rv_xml_string = lo_sxml_writer->get_output_as_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_sflights_writer( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_xml_from_sflights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flights><Flight Carrid="' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = 'Connid="' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = 'Fldate="' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Generierung von XML aus Datenbanktabellen. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_sxml_writer)`, `DATA(ls_flight)`) und der modernen `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` Syntax macht den Code kompakt und lesbar, was typisch für ABAP 7.50+ ist.
keywords: XML, SXML, Internal Tables, sflight, cl_sec_sxml_writer, LOOP, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Verschieben Sie den Wert einer Zeichenkette nur dann nach links, wenn sie mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt. Nutzen Sie moderne Konditional-Ausdrücke.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_cond_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS conditional_shift IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_cond_shift IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD conditional_shift.
    rv_output = COND string( WHEN iv_input CP iv_prefix && '*' THEN
                               DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
                               SHIFT lv_temp LEFT BY strlen( iv_prefix ) PLACES.
                               lv_temp
                             ELSE
                               iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->conditional_shift( iv_input = 'PREFIX_VALUE' iv_prefix = 'PREFIX' ) exp = '_VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->conditional_shift( iv_input = 'NO_PREFIX_VALUE' iv_prefix = 'PREFIX' ) exp = 'NO_PREFIX_VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->conditional_shift( iv_input = 'PRE' iv_prefix = 'PRE' ) exp = '' ).

CLASS zcl_str_table_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD process_and_shift_strings.
    rt_output = VALUE string_table( FOR <fs_string> IN it_input

                                    ( COND string( WHEN lv_shifted CP 'FLIGHT*' THEN

Instructions: Lese eine einzelne Flugverbindung aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer und Datum.

CLASS zcl_sql_single_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_s_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_single_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_total_price.

CLASS zcl_sql_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, SUM( price ) AS total_price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      GROUP BY carrid

CLASS zcl_sql_cds_view IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_http_check_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_http_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_http_check_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_http_url.
    TRY.
        cl_http_utility=>check_url_syntax( iv_url = iv_url ).
        IF iv_url CS 'http://' OR iv_url CS 'https://'.
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_http_utility_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine URL für einen externen Dienst, der Flugdaten basierend auf einer `sflights`-Abfrage erwartet, und kodieren Sie die Parameter.
hint: Kombiniere `SELECT SINGLE` mit `cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~create_query_string` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_sql_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_sql_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_url.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lt_params) = VALUE if_http_utility=>ty_s_parameters_table(
        ( name = 'carrid' value = ls_sflight-carrid )
        ( name = 'connid' value = ls_sflight-connid )
        ( name = 'fldate' value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }| )
        ( name = 'price' value = |{ ls_sflight-price }| )
      ).
      DATA(lv_query) = cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~create_query_string( it_parameters = lt_params ).
      rv_url = |https://example.com/api/flights?{ lv_query }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_url = 'Flight not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese alle Flugverbindungen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und transformiere die Daten in eine neue interne Tabelle, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen und ein neues Feld berechnet wird.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA()` und `VALUE #( FOR ... )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_transform_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_info,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             adjusted_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_info.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE ty_t_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_transform_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              ( carrier_id     = ls_sflight-carrid
                                connection_id  = ls_sflight-connid
                                flight_date    = ls_sflight-fldate
                                adjusted_price = ls_sflight-price * '0.9' ) ). " 10% Rabatt
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD aggregate_passengers.
    rt_aggregated = VALUE tt_carrier_passengers(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_passengers = REDUCE s_seatsocc(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT sum = sum + ls_grouped_flight-seatsocc
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der `SEATSMAX` für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`). Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP` mit Inline-Deklaration und einer `IF`-Bedingung.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Summenvariable inline im `LOOP` und verwenden Sie `ADD` innerhalb der `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_add_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_lh_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE s_seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_add_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_lh_seats.
    DATA(lv_sum_seats) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        ADD ls_flight-seatsmax TO lv_sum_seats.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_total_seats = lv_sum_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 100 )

Obwohl `ADD` ein älterer Operator ist, ist seine Verwendung in Kombination mit modernen Syntaxelementen wie Inline-Deklarationen und funktionalen Ausdrücken weiterhin relevant und lesbar für einfache arithmetische Operationen.

Instructions: Addiere einen Bonuswert zu einem Gesamtbetrag, aber nur, wenn die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) in einem Flug über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung des Bonus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` um den Bonuswert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu bestimmen und diesen dann zum Gesamtbetrag zu addieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS calculate_total_with_bonus
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_amount TYPE s_price
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_sflight_data
        iv_threshold   TYPE s_seatsocc
        iv_bonus_value TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_amount) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_with_bonus.
    DATA(lv_bonus_to_add) = COND s_price(
      WHEN is_flight_data-seatsocc > iv_threshold THEN iv_bonus_value
      ELSE 0
    ).

    rv_final_amount = iv_base_amount + lv_bonus_to_add.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bonus_applied.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_add( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_cond_add=>ty_sflight_data( seatsocc = 120 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_with_bonus(
      iv_base_amount = '100.00'
      is_flight_data = ls_flight
      iv_threshold   = 100
      iv_bonus_value = '25.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '125.00' msg = 'Bonus should be applied' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_bonus_not_applied.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_add( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_cond_add=>ty_sflight_data( seatsocc = 80 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_with_bonus(
      iv_base_amount = '100.00'
      is_flight_data = ls_flight
      iv_threshold   = 100
      iv_bonus_value = '25.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '100.00' msg = 'Bonus should not be applied' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante und ausdrucksstarke bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Anstatt einer `IF`-`ELSE`-Struktur kann der Wert einer Variablen direkt basierend auf einer Bedingung zugewiesen werden. In diesem Beispiel wird der Bonuswert mit `COND` ermittelt und anschließend zum Basisbetrag addiert, was den Code kürzer und leichter verständlich macht.
keywords: COND, conditional logic, ADD, expressions, modern ABAP

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Quadrate einer Liste von Zahlen. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die Quadrate zu bilden, und `REDUCE`, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` für die Transformation und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_reduce_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_of_squares) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum_of_squares = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR num IN it_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + ( num * num )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_reduce_add( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 msg = 'Sum of squares mismatch (1*1+2*2+3*3+4*4 = 1+4+9+16 = 30)' ).

    lt_numbers = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      ( 5 ) ( 10 )
    ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 125 msg = 'Sum of squares mismatch (5*5+10*10 = 25+100 = 125)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die elegante Kombination von `FOR` (implizit durch die Iteration in `REDUCE`) und `REDUCE` zur Berechnung der Summe der Quadrate. Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist hier besonders effizient, da er die Transformation (Quadrieren) und die Aggregation (Addieren) in einem einzigen, flüssigen Ausdruck zusammenfasst. Dies ist ein weiteres Beispiel für die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Programmierkonzepte in modernem ABAP.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, ADD, sum of squares, functional programming, internal tables

Instructions: Füge zu jeder Zeile einer internen Tabelle einen festen Wert hinzu. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue Tabelle mit den aktualisierten Werten zu erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und dem Additionsoperator (`+`) für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_add_to_rows DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_value_to_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items   TYPE tt_item
        iv_add_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_add_to_rows IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_value_to_items.
    rt_updated_items = VALUE tt_item(
      FOR ls_item IN it_items
      ( id = ls_item-id value = ls_item-value + iv_add_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_value_to_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_value_to_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_add_to_rows( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_for_add_to_rows=>tt_item(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 )
      ( id = 3 value = 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->add_value_to_items( it_items = lt_source iv_add_val = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 msg = 'Row count mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = 15 msg = '1st item value mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-value exp = 25 msg = '2nd item value mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-value exp = 35 msg = '3rd item value mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ist ideal, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, indem jede Zeile einer Quelltabelle transformiert wird. Hier wird für jede Zeile der `value`-Feld um `iv_add_val` erhöht. Dies ist eine moderne und deklarative Alternative zu einer `LOOP` mit `APPEND` und manueller Zuweisung, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, internal tables, transformation, ADD, functional programming

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer Tabelle, die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_flights_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_cut_off_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_flights_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE fldate < iv_cut_off_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20230101'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20230102'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20230103'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.

    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_delete_flights_by_date( ).
    DATA(lv_cut_off_date) = '20230102'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deleter->delete_old_flights( it_flights = lt_flights iv_cut_off_date = lv_cut_off_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights after deletion' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-fldate exp = '20230103' msg = 'Incorrect flight remaining' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE` ist die moderne und effizienteste Methode, um mehrere Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu entfernen. Es ist performanter als das Schleifen und Löschen einzelner Zeilen.

CLASS zcl_delete_adj_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Preise zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_for_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE p(
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_compute_reduce_sum( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um die Summe und die Anzahl der Flüge zu aggregieren, und berechnen Sie dann den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE ty_s_agg(
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE p DECIMALS 2
           count = 0 TYPE i
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price,
           count = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum_price / ls_aggregation-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_agg,
         sum_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
         count     TYPE i,
       END OF ty_s_agg.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Query-Parameter aus einem URL-String und geben Sie diese als interne Tabelle von Name-Wert-Paaren zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_parse_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param.
    TYPES tt_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_url_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_url_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parameters) TYPE tt_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_parse_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_url_parameters.
    DATA(lv_query_string) = ``.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF `?` IN iv_url_string MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_query_string = iv_url_string+lv_offset+1.
    ENDIF.

    cl_http_utility=>parse_form_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_form_data = lv_query_string
      IMPORTING
        e_fields    = DATA(lt_fields)
    ).

    rt_parameters = VALUE #( FOR field IN lt_fields ( name = field-key value = field-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen URL-Query-String aus einer internen Tabelle von Name-Wert-Paaren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>url_encode` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_build_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param.
    TYPES tt_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_query_string
      IMPORTING
        it_parameters TYPE tt_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_query_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_build_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_query_string.
    DATA(lv_query_parts) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR param IN it_parameters
        ( |{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-value ) }| )
    ).
    rv_query_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR part IN lv_query_parts
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN part ELSE s && `&` && part )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE zcl_http_build_query=>tt_params(
      ( name = 'param1' value = 'value one' )
      ( name = 'param2' value = 'value&two' )
      ( name = 'param3' value = 'value/three' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_query) = `param1=value%20one&param2=value%26two&param3=value%2fthree`.

  METHOD test_non_existent_node.

explanation: `cl_xml_document` ist die zentrale Klasse für die XML-Verarbeitung in ABAP. Die Methode `parse_xstring` (nach Konvertierung des Strings in XSTRING) und `get_node_by_path` ermöglichen einen direkten und effizienten Zugriff auf XML-Daten mittels XPath.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und extrahieren Sie alle Werte eines bestimmten Knotennamens in einer Liste.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_get_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_all_node_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_node_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_get_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_node_values.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_nodes_by_path( iv_xpath ).

    rt_node_values = VALUE #( FOR node IN lo_nodes ( node->get_value( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein komplexeres XML-Dokument mit verschachtelten Elementen und Attributen programmatisch.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_complex_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_id TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_carrier   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_date      TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_complex_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'FlightDetails' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    lo_root->set_attribute( name = 'xmlns' value = 'http://example.com/flights' ).

    DATA(lo_flight) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
    lo_root->append_child( lo_flight ).

    lo_flight->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = iv_flight_id ).
    lo_flight->set_attribute( name = 'carrier' value = iv_carrier ).

    DATA(lo_date_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Date' ).
    lo_flight->append_child( lo_date_node ).
    lo_date_node->append_child( lo_xml_document->create_text_node( iv_date ) ).

    DATA(lo_status_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Status' ).
    lo_flight->append_child( lo_status_node ).
    lo_status_node->append_child( lo_xml_document->create_text_node( 'Confirmed' ) ).

    DATA(lx_xml_string) = lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ).
    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lx_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                            `  <Flight id="0017" carrier="LH">` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `    <Date>20251206</Date>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `    <Status>Confirmed</Status>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `  </Flight>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `</FlightDetails>`.

Die Methoden `create_element`, `set_attribute`, `append_child` und `create_text_node` werden sequenziell verwendet, um die gewünschte Struktur zu erzeugen. Die Verwendung von `sflights` Daten zeigt eine realistische Anwendung.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine XSLT-Transformation auf einem XML-Dokument durch, um es in ein anderes Format zu überführen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string  TYPE string
        iv_xslt_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_transformed_xml) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xslt_exception
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_xslt_processor) = NEW cl_xslt_processor( ).
    lo_xslt_processor->set_parameter( name = 'XSLT_STRING' value = iv_xslt_string ).

    DATA(lx_transformed_xml) = lo_xslt_processor->transform(
      xml_document = lo_xml_document
      xslt_document = lo_xslt_processor->create_xslt_document_from_string( iv_xslt_string )
    ).

    rv_transformed_xml = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lx_transformed_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_xslt) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <xsl:for-each select="root/item">
      <xsl:value-of select="."/>
      <xsl:text>
</xsl:text>

</xsl:stylesheet>`.
    DATA(lv_expected_output) = `Data1` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && `Data2` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    DATA(lv_actual_output) = lo_cut->transform_xml(

  <xsl:template match="/">

  </xsl:template>`.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>raise_exception(
        class_name = 'CX_XSLT_EXCEPTION'

      )
