Instructions: Fügen Sie einem bestehenden XML-Dokument programmatisch ein neues Element hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und die Methoden `get_node_by_path`, `create_element` und `append_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_add_element DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_element_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_parent_xpath TYPE string
        iv_new_element_name TYPE string
        iv_new_element_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xml_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_add_element IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_element_to_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( iv_parent_xpath ).
    IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_new_element) = lo_xml_document->create_element( iv_new_element_name ).
      IF iv_new_element_value IS NOT INITIAL.
        lo_new_element->append_child( lo_xml_document->create_text_node( iv_new_element_value ) ).
      ENDIF.
      lo_parent_node->append_child( lo_new_element ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lx_modified_xml) = lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ).
    rv_modified_xml = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lx_modified_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_element_with_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_empty_element FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_to_non_existent_parent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_element_with_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_add_element( ).
    DATA(lv_input_xml) = `<root><data><item>Existing Data</item></data></root>`.
    DATA(lv_expected_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `<root>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `  <data>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `    <item>Existing Data</item>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `    <newElement>New Value</newElement>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `  </data>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `</root>`.

    DATA(lv_actual_xml) = lo_cut->add_element_to_xml(
      iv_xml_string        = lv_input_xml
      iv_parent_xpath      = '/root/data'
      iv_new_element_name  = 'newElement'
      iv_new_element_value = 'New Value'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_xml
      exp = lv_expected_xml
      msg = 'Element mit Wert sollte korrekt hinzugefügt werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_empty_element.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_add_element( ).
    DATA(lv_input_xml) = `<root><data></data></root>`.
    DATA(lv_expected_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `<root>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `  <data>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `    <emptyElement/>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `  </data>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `</root>`.

    DATA(lv_actual_xml) = lo_cut->add_element_to_xml(
      iv_xml_string        = lv_input_xml
      iv_parent_xpath      = '/root/data'
      iv_new_element_name  = 'emptyElement'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_xml
      exp = lv_expected_xml
      msg = 'Leeres Element sollte korrekt hinzugefügt werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_to_non_existent_parent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_add_element( ).
    DATA(lv_input_xml) = `<root><data></data></root>`.
    DATA(lv_actual_xml) = lo_cut->add_element_to_xml(
      iv_xml_string        = lv_input_xml
      iv_parent_xpath      = '/root/nonexistent'
      iv_new_element_name  = 'newElement'
      iv_new_element_value = 'New Value'
    ).

    " If parent node not found, XML should remain unchanged (except for pretty print potentially)
    DATA(lv_expected_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `<root>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `  <data/>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            `</root>`.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_xml
      exp = lv_expected_xml
      msg = 'XML sollte unverändert bleiben, wenn Elternknoten nicht existiert.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man ein bestehendes XML-Dokument dynamisch modifiziert. Nach dem Parsen des XML wird der Ziel-Elternknoten mittels XPath gefunden. Anschließend wird ein neues Element erstellt und als Kind des Elternknotens hinzugefügt. Die Verwendung von `render_2_xstring` mit `pretty_print` sorgt für eine gut lesbare Ausgabe des modifizierten XML.
keywords: XML, Modification, cl_xml_document, XPath, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT für Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Flugnummern und Zielen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie die FOR-Expression mit einem WHERE-Zusatz, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data)
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight_data WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_frankfurt FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_frankfurt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_city( 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for FRANKFURT' act = lt_filtered_flights ). " Should not be initial if data exists
    " To make this test robust, ensure SFLIGHT has data for FRANKFURT.
    " For a real test, you might mock SFLIGHT or insert test data.
    " Here, we assume SFLIGHT has data.
    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-cityfrom
        exp = 'FRANKFURT'
        msg = 'First flight cityfrom should be FRANKFURT'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_city( 'NONEXISTENTCITY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_filtered_flights
      msg = 'Should return an empty table for a non-existent city'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR` Expressions ermöglichen eine deklarative und kompakte Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und zu transformieren. In Kombination mit `VALUE #(` wird eine neue Tabelle direkt initialisiert, was zu kürzerem und lesbarerem Code führt als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ...` Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Filter, Declarative

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (OCCUPSEAT) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie die REDUCE-Expression, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_seat_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_seat_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, occupseat
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflight_data
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-occupseat ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_seats_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_seats.
    " Assuming 'LH' has flights in SFLIGHT with occupseat values
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_seat_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    " This test is dependent on SFLIGHT data.
    " For a real test, you'd mock SFLIGHT or insert specific test data.
    " Here, we just assert it's not negative.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_total_seats >= 0 )
      msg = 'Total seats should be non-negative'
    ).
    " If we knew the exact data, we could assert a specific value, e.g.:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 1234 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_seats_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_seat_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'XX' ). " Non-existent airline
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total seats should be 0 for non-existent airline'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Weise. Sie ersetzt explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit einer lokalen Variablen für die Summe, was den Code kürzer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Sum, Functional

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Beschreibung für einen Flug, die die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugort und Zielort enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates für eine einfache und lesbare String-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS format_flight_description
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_description.
    rv_description = |Flug { is_flight_data-carrid } { is_flight_data-connid } von { is_flight_data-cityfrom } nach { is_flight_data-cityto }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_description.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_formatter( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_formatter=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid   = 'LH'
      connid   = '400'
      cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
      cityto   = 'NEW YORK'
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_description) = 'Flug LH 400 von FRANKFURT nach NEW YORK'.
    DATA(lv_actual_description) = lo_cut->format_flight_description( ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_description
      exp = lv_expected_description
      msg = 'Formatted description does not match expected value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates bieten eine moderne und sehr lesbare Syntax zur dynamischen Erstellung von Strings. Sie erlauben das direkte Einbetten von Variablen und Ausdrücken in einen String, was die Notwendigkeit von Verkettungsoperatoren oder `WRITE TO` Anweisungen reduziert und den Code übersichtlicher macht.
keywords: String Template, String Processing, Formatting, Readability

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('On Time', 'Delayed', 'Cancelled') basierend auf einem gegebenen Verspätungsstatus (DELAYED_STATUS) und ob der Flug storniert wurde (IS_CANCELLED).
hint: Verwenden Sie die COND-Expression für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_delayed_status TYPE abap_bool
        iv_is_cancelled   TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
                  WHEN iv_is_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Cancelled'
                  WHEN iv_delayed_status = abap_true THEN 'Delayed'
                  ELSE 'On Time'
                ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_on_time FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delayed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cancelled FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_on_time.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delayed_status = abap_false iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'On Time' msg = 'Status should be On Time' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delayed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delayed_status = abap_true iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Delayed' msg = 'Status should be Delayed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cancelled.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delayed_status = abap_true iv_is_cancelled = abap_true ). " Delayed but cancelled
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Cancelled' msg = 'Status should be Cancelled (cancelled takes precedence)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Sie ersetzt mehrzeilige `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Blöcke durch eine einzelne Zeile, was die Lesbarkeit verbessert und den Code straffer macht, insbesondere bei der Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expression, Assignment

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Verwenden Sie Inline-Deklarationen für alle Variablen.
hint: Deklarieren Sie Variablen direkt dort, wo sie verwendet werden, z.B. in SELECT SINGLE oder READ TABLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_detail) TYPE ty_flight_detail
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } on { iv_fldate } not found.|.
    ENDIF.

    rs_flight_detail = ls_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existing_flight RAISING cx_sy_read_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_flight.
    " Assuming flight 'LH', '0400', '19950215' exists in SFLIGHT
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_flight_details) = lo_cut->get_flight_details(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = '19950215'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_details-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_details-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_details-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_READ_ERROR'
    ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_details(
      iv_carrid = 'XX'
      iv_connid = '9999'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) ermöglichen es, Variablen direkt an der Stelle ihrer ersten Verwendung zu deklarieren. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit, da der Typ der Variablen oft aus dem Kontext ersichtlich ist, und reduziert die Notwendigkeit, alle Variablen am Anfang einer Methode zu deklarieren. Es fördert einen "just-in-time"-Deklarationsstil.
keywords: Inline Declaration, DATA, SELECT SINGLE, Readability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten verarbeitet. Die Datenquelle (eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten) soll über den Konstruktor injiziert werden, um die Klasse testbarer und flexibler zu machen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CONSTRUCTOR mit einem IMPORTING-Parameter für die Datenquelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS get_number_of_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_flights_to_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityto TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_number_of_flights.
    rv_count = lines( mt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_to_city.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN mt_flights WHERE ( cityto = iv_cityto ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_count FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flights_to_city FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_count.
    " Prepare test data
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_processor=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '19950215' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '19950215' cityfrom = 'DALLAS' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '19950215' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->get_number_of_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect flight count' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flights_to_city.
    " Prepare test data
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_processor=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '19950215' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '19950215' cityfrom = 'DALLAS' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '19950215' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lt_ny_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_to_city( 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_ny_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights to New York' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_ny_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_ny_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konstruktor-Injektion ist ein grundlegendes Prinzip der modernen Objektorientierung und des Dependency Inversion Principle. Sie ermöglicht es, Abhängigkeiten (hier: die Flugdaten) von außen in eine Klasse zu übergeben, anstatt sie intern zu erzeugen oder zu laden. Dies macht die Klasse unabhängiger von konkreten Datenquellen, leichter testbar (durch Übergabe von Mock-Daten) und flexibler für verschiedene Anwendungsfälle.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, Dependency Injection, Testability, Flexibility

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die zwei Einträge enthält, ohne explizite APPEND-Anweisungen zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle direkt mit Werten zu initialisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_table_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_entry,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_entry.
    TYPES tt_flight_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_table_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_table.
    rt_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' cityfrom = 'DALLAS' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung, wenn versucht wird, auf einen nicht existierenden Flug in einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit der Ausnahme `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        is_key     TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    TRY.
        rs_flight = it_flights[ is_key ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
          EXPORTING
            text = |Flight { is_key-carrid } { is_key-connid } not found in table.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_flight RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_flight.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_access=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '19950215' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
    ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_flight_access=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_access( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_key( it_flights = lt_test_flights is_key = ls_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_access=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '19950215' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
    ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_flight_access=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_access( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
    ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_by_key( it_flights = lt_test_flights is_key = ls_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken für Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND` ist der moderne Weg, um Fehler beim Zugriff auf interne Tabellen zu behandeln. Dies ist robuster und klarer als die Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach `READ TABLE` und ermöglicht eine gezieltere Reaktion auf Fehlerbedingungen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception Handling, Internal Table, CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer in Sekunden zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `SUBTRACT` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timestamp_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_duration_in_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_duration_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_duration_in_seconds.
    DATA(lv_duration) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      tstmp1 = iv_timestamp1
      tstmp2 = iv_timestamp2
    ).
    rv_duration_seconds = lv_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_duration_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_duration FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_duration_calculation.
    DATA(lv_tstmp1) = '20230101100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = '20230101100010.0000000'. " 10 seconds later
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timestamp_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lo_cut->calculate_duration_in_seconds( iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp2 iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_duration exp = 10 msg = 'Duration should be 10 seconds' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_duration.
    DATA(lv_tstmp) = '20230101120000.0000000'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timestamp_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lo_cut->calculate_duration_in_seconds( iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_duration exp = 0 msg = 'Duration should be 0 seconds' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_duration.
    DATA(lv_tstmp1) = '20230101100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = '20230101100010.0000000'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timestamp_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lo_cut->calculate_duration_in_seconds( iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp1 iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_duration exp = -10 msg = 'Duration should be -10 seconds' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` bietet eine Reihe von Methoden zur modernen und robusten Bearbeitung von Zeitstempeln. Die Methode `SUBTRACT` ermöglicht eine einfache und präzise Berechnung der Dauer zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden, was die manuelle Berechnung überflüssig macht und Fehlerquellen reduziert.
keywords: Date, Time, Timestamp, Duration, CL_ABAP_TSTMP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine "fluent interface" (Method Chaining) für den Aufbau einer einfachen Fluganfrage ermöglicht.
hint: Geben Sie `ME` aus den Methoden zurück, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_query_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_query_builder.

    METHODS to_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_city TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_query_builder.

    METHODS with_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_query_builder.

    METHODS build_query_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_query) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_from_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom.
    DATA mv_to_city TYPE sflight-cityto.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_query_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD from_city.
    mv_from_city = iv_city.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_city.
    mv_to_city = iv_city.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD with_carrier.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_query_string.
    rv_query = |SELECT * FROM SFLIGHT WHERE 1=1|.
    IF mv_from_city IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_query = rv_query && | AND CITYFROM = '{ mv_from_city }'|.
    ENDIF.
    IF mv_to_city IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_query = rv_query && | AND CITYTO = '{ mv_to_city }'|.
    ENDIF.
    IF mv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_query = rv_query && | AND CARRID = '{ mv_carrid }'|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_full_query FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_partial_query FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_query FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_full_query.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_flight_query_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_query) = lo_builder->from_city( 'FRANKFURT' )->to_city( 'NEW YORK' )->with_carrier( 'LH' )->build_query_string( ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'SELECT * FROM SFLIGHT WHERE 1=1 AND CITYFROM = ''FRANKFURT'' AND CITYTO = ''NEW YORK'' AND CARRID = ''LH'''.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_query exp = lv_expected msg = 'Full query string mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_partial_query.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_flight_query_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_query) = lo_builder->from_city( 'LONDON' )->build_query_string( ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'SELECT * FROM SFLIGHT WHERE 1=1 AND CITYFROM = ''LONDON'''.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_query exp = lv_expected msg = 'Partial query string mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_query.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_flight_query_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_query) = lo_builder->build_query_string( ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'SELECT * FROM SFLIGHT WHERE 1=1'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_query exp = lv_expected msg = 'Empty query string mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, auch bekannt als "Fluent Interface", ist ein Designmuster, das die Lesbarkeit von Code verbessert, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt hintereinander zu reihen. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies ist ein modernes OO-Konzept, das zu ausdrucksstärkerem und wartbarerem Code führt.
keywords: Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Object Orientation, Design Pattern, Readability

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings und ersetzen Sie diese durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Funktion `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    lv_temp_string = |{ lv_temp_string ALPHA = OUT }|.

    " Replace multiple spaces with single space
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp_string WITH ' '.

    rv_cleaned_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_clean_string_full FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_clean_string_leading_trailing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_clean_string_no_change FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_clean_string_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_string_full.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `  Hello   World   ABAP  `.
    DATA(lv_expected) = `Hello World ABAP`.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->clean_string( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Full cleaning failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_clean_string_leading_trailing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `  Single spaces `.
    DATA(lv_expected) = `Single spaces`.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->clean_string( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Leading/trailing spaces failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_clean_string_no_change.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `No extra spaces`.
    DATA(lv_expected) = `No extra spaces`.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->clean_string( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'No change expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_clean_string_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `   `.
    DATA(lv_expected) = ``.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->clean_string( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Empty string cleaning failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von String-Templates mit dem `ALPHA = OUT` Zusatz und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` bietet eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode zur String-Bereinigung. `ALPHA = OUT` entfernt führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen, während der Regex-Ersetzung alle internen Mehrfachleerzeichen durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen ersetzt. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und leistungsfähiger als ältere `TRANSLATE` oder `REPLACE` Schleifen.
keywords: String Processing, REGEX, REPLACE, ALPHA, String Template, Cleaning

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Abflugort (CITYFROM) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Ort. Geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `GROUP BY` Klausel in einer `FOR`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_city
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_city_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_city.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data)
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    rt_city_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight_data GROUP BY ( cityfrom = flight-cityfrom ) ASCENDING
      ( cityfrom = flight-cityfrom
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_city_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_city( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flight counts returned' act = lt_city_counts ). " Should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data
    IF lines( lt_city_counts ) > 0.
      " Assert that FRANKFURT (if present) has a count
      DATA(ls_frankfurt_entry) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouper=>ty_flight_count( ).
      READ TABLE lt_city_counts INTO ls_frankfurt_entry WITH KEY cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_frankfurt_entry-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'FRANKFURT should have flights' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_flights_empty.
    " To properly test an empty scenario, SFLIGHT would need to be empty or mocked.
    " For this example, we assume SFLIGHT always has some data.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking the SELECT statement.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_city_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_city( ).
    " If SFLIGHT is empty, this would be 0. Otherwise, it should be > 0.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_city_counts ) >= 0 ) msg = 'Table lines should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit der `GROUP BY`-Klausel ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion zur Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, komplexe Gruppierungslogik deklarativ und kompakt auszudrücken, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert im Vergleich zu manuellen Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Table, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten (Felder) einer beliebigen Struktur und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        lo_structdescr ?= lo_typedescr.

        LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
            name = ls_component-name
            type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( )
          ) TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_rtti_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_simple_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_structure_data RAISING cx_sy_rtti_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_structure.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( REF #( ls_sflight ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_components ) > 0 ) msg = 'SFLIGHT components not found' ).
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'CARRID' INTO DATA(ls_carrid_comp).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrid_comp-type exp = 'CARRID' msg = 'CARRID component type mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_simple_structure.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test.
    DATA: ls_test TYPE ty_test.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( REF #( ls_test ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 msg = 'Simple structure component count mismatch' ).
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'FIELD1' INTO DATA(ls_field1_comp).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_field1_comp-type exp = 'STRING' msg = 'FIELD1 component type mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_structure_data.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_RTTI_ERROR'
    ).
    lo_cut->get_structure_components( REF #( lv_string ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` sind die zentralen Werkzeuge dafür. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, und ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für flexible und erweiterbare Anwendungen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, Reflection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr,
          lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_tabledescr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line        TYPE REF TO data,
          lv_value       TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " All fields as string for simplicity
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_structdescr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lo_tabledescr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_structdescr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_tabledescr.

        " Fill with some example data
        CREATE DATA lr_line LIKE LINE OF rr_dynamic_table.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                       <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                       <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
        ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

        LOOP AT 1 TO 2.
          DO lines( lt_components ) TIMES.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              lv_value = |{ lt_components[ sy-index ]-name }_Value_{ sy-loopc }|.
              <fs_field> = lv_value.
            ENDIF.
          ENDDO.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_create_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze (OCCUPSEAT) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Summe zu bilden, und teilen Sie diese durch die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_occupied_seats.
    SELECT carrid, occupseat
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    IF lt_sflight_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR flight IN lt_sflight_data
                                   NEXT sum = sum + flight-occupseat ).

    rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lines( lt_sflight_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_seats_single_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_seats_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_seats.
    " Assuming 'LH' has flights in SFLIGHT with occupseat values
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_average_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    " This test is dependent on SFLIGHT data. We just assert it's non-negative.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_average_seats >= 0 ) msg = 'Average seats should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_seats_single_flight.
    " Mock SFLIGHT data for a single flight scenario
    DATA(lt_mock_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '19950215' occupseat = 100 )
    ).
    " In a real scenario, you'd inject this mock data.
    " For this example, we rely on SFLIGHT data, so this test might not be perfectly isolated.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_average_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( 'AA' ).
    " If 'AA' has only one flight with 100 seats, average is 100.
    " This needs SFLIGHT data to be predictable or mocked.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_average_seats >= 0 ) msg = 'Average seats should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_seats_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_average_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( 'ZZ' ). " Non-existent airline
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average_seats exp = 0 msg = 'Average seats should be 0 for non-existent airline' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts unter Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Expression für die Summenbildung und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Einträge ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode. Sie vermeidet explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen für die Zählung, was den Code kompakter und leichter verständlich macht. Die Verwendung von `decfloat34` sorgt für präzise Gleitkomma-Berechnungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Average, Internal Table, DECFLOAT34

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_writer( ).
    lo_writer->write_data( EXPORTING data = lt_sflights ).
    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_reader( iv_json_string ).
        lo_reader->read_data( IMPORTING data = rs_data ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_fdt_json_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_json_error->textid
            previous = lx_json_error.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine transformierte interne Tabelle (aus SFLIGHTS) unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE` in JSON.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücke, um die Daten vor der Serialisierung zu manipulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_transform_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_report,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency_code TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_flight_report.
    TYPES: tt_flight_report TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_report WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_transformed_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_transform_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_transformed_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    DATA(lt_transformed_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_report(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( airline_id    = ls_sflight-carrid,
        flight_num    = ls_sflight-connid,
        flight_date   = ls_sflight-fldate,
        total_price   = ls_sflight-price,
        currency_code = ls_sflight-curr )
    ).

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_writer( ).
    lo_writer->write_data( EXPORTING data = lt_transformed_flights ).
    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_transform_serialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_transformed_sflights( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"AIRLINE_ID"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FLIGHT_NUM"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"TOTAL_PRICE"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"CARRID"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die leistungsstarken `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücke von ABAP 7.55, um Daten aus SFLIGHTS zu transformieren (z.B. Feldnamen ändern) und dann die transformierten Daten in JSON zu serialisieren. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Bereich von Zellen (z.B. A1:B2) aus einer Excel-Datei und füllen Sie damit eine interne Tabelle mit einer passenden Struktur. Die Excel-Datei wird als XSTRING übergeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_FDT_XL_SPREADSHEET und iterieren Sie über die Zeilen und Spalten. Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression für die Tabellenbefüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_range_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
        col1 TYPE string,
        col2 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_excel_row,
      tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_range_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        i_start_row TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        i_start_col TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        i_end_row TYPE i DEFAULT 2
        i_end_col TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_excel_data) TYPE tt_excel_data
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_range_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_range_to_table.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( iv_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = lo_excel->get_range_data(
      i_start_row = i_start_row
      i_start_column = i_start_col
      i_end_row = i_end_row
      i_end_column = i_end_col
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_raw_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
      DATA(ls_row) = VALUE ty_excel_row(
        col1 = <fs_row>[ 1 ]
        col2 = <fs_row>[ 2 ]
      ).
      APPEND ls_row TO rt_excel_data.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-col2 exp = 'B1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-col1 exp = 'A2' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und exportieren Sie diese in eine Excel-Datei. Die Excel-Datei soll die Spalten CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE und PRICE enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie die neue SELECT-Syntax und CL_FDT_XL_SPREADSHEET. Verwenden Sie eine LOOP-Expression, um die Daten zeilenweise in das Excel-Objekt zu schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_to_excel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_excel,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight_excel,
      tt_sflight_excel TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_excel WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_as_excel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_to_excel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_as_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.

    lo_excel->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row i_column = 1 i_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row i_column = 2 i_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row i_column = 3 i_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row i_column = 4 i_value = 'Price' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row i_column = 1 i_value = <fs_sflight>-carrid ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row i_column = 2 i_value = <fs_sflight>-connid ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row i_column = 3 i_value = <fs_sflight>-fldate ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( i_row = lv_row i_column = 4 i_value = <fs_sflight>-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights_to_excel FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA(lo_exporter) = NEW zcl_sflights_to_excel( ).
    DATA(lv_excel_xstring) = lo_exporter->get_sflights_as_excel( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_excel_xstring ).

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( lv_excel_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_header) = lo_reader->get_cell_value( i_row = 1 i_column = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_header exp = 'Airline ID' ).

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
        id        TYPE szk_app_id,
        subject   TYPE string,
        date_from TYPE d,
        date_to   TYPE d,
      END OF ty_appointment_data,
      tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_appointments_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE tt_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_appointments_in_range.
    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = VALUE tt_appointment_data(
      ( id = '001' subject = 'Meeting A' date_from = '20250101' date_to = '20250101' )
      ( id = '002' subject = 'Meeting B' date_from = '20250105' date_to = '20250105' )
      ( id = '003' subject = 'Meeting C' date_from = '20250110' date_to = '20250110' )
      ( id = '004' subject = 'Meeting D' date_from = '20250115' date_to = '20250115' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( lt_all_appointments USING KEY default
      WHERE date_from >= iv_start_date AND date_to <= iv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie CL_FDT_XL_SPREADSHEET zum Lesen und eine MAP-Expression zur Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS read_excel_to_map
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_string_map) TYPE ty_string_map
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_excel_to_map.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( iv_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = lo_excel->get_range_data( i_start_row = 1 i_start_column = 1 i_end_row = 100 i_end_column = 2 ).

    rt_string_map = VALUE ty_string_map(
      FOR <fs_row> IN lt_raw_data
      WHERE lines( <fs_row> ) = 2 AND <fs_row>[ 1 ] IS NOT INITIAL
      ( <fs_row>[ 1 ] = <fs_row>[ 2 ] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer eines Termins in Minuten. Simulieren Sie einen Termin.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_APPOINTMENT und die Methoden GET_DATE_FROM/TO und GET_TIME_FROM/TO, um die Dauer zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_duration_in_minutes
      IMPORTING
        iv_appointment_id TYPE szk_app_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_duration_minutes) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_appointment.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_duration_in_minutes.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( iv_appointment_id ).
    DATA(lv_start_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp(
      date = lo_appointment->get_date_from( )
      time = lo_appointment->get_time_from( )
    ).
    DATA(lv_end_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp(
      date = lo_appointment->get_date_to( )
      time = lo_appointment->get_time_to( )
    ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      tstmp1 = lv_end_timestamp
      tstmp2 = lv_start_timestamp
    ).

    rv_duration_minutes = lv_diff_seconds / 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und deren Flügen in eine neue Struktur, die nur die Fluggesellschaften mit mindestens einem Flug nach 'FRA' (Frankfurt) enthält, und listen Sie für diese Fluggesellschaften alle Flugverbindungen auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR` Ausdrücke mit `VALUE` und `FOR GROUPS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES: tt_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connections TYPE tt_connections,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_carrier_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carrier_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      WHERE ( line_exists( flight[ cityto = 'FRA' ] ) ) " Filter groups where at least one flight goes to FRA
      (
        carrid = flight-carrid
        connections = VALUE #( 
          FOR conn IN GROUP flight
          (
            connid = conn-connid
            fldate = conn-fldate
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_carrier_flights( lt_raw_flights ).

    DATA(ls_aa_flights) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ] ) ) ).

  METHOD test_no_fra_flights.

    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE zcl_nes_nested_for=>tt_flight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250105' cityfrom = 'SFO' cityto = 'ORD' )

CLASS zcl_fae_join_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere und die Anzahl der Flüge, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum, aus einer gegebenen Liste von Flugbuchungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `REDUCE` Ausdrücke mit `FOR GROUPS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             passnum  TYPE sbook-passnum,
           END OF ty_booking_raw.
    TYPES: tt_booking_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_pass TYPE i,
             num_bookings TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_summaries TYPE tt_flight_summary,
             total_carrier_pass TYPE i,
             total_carrier_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_booking_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF booking_carr IN it_bookings BY booking_carr-carrid
      (
        carrid = booking_carr-carrid
        flight_summaries = VALUE #( 
          FOR GROUPS OF booking_date IN GROUP booking_carr BY booking_date-fldate
          (
            fldate = booking_date-fldate
            total_pass = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR b IN GROUP booking_date NEXT sum = sum + b-passnum )
            num_bookings = lines( GROUP booking_date )
          )
        )
        total_carrier_pass = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR b IN GROUP booking_carr NEXT sum = sum + b-passnum )
        total_carrier_flights = lines( GROUP booking_carr )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_order_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_order_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights_by_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        ORDER BY carrid, fldate
        INTO TABLE @rt_flight_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_order_by( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_order_by=>tt_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights_by_carriers( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Check if sorted by carrid and fldate
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_fldate) TYPE sflight-fldate.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        IF ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid OR
           ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-fldate < lv_prev_fldate ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Results are not correctly sorted.' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_order_by( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_order_by=>tt_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights_by_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ORDER BY` Klausel in Kombination mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse direkt in der Datenbank zu sortieren, was oft performanter ist als eine nachträgliche Sortierung in ABAP. Die moderne Syntax mit Hostvariablen (`@`) bleibt erhalten.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, SELECT, ORDER BY, Database Access, Sorting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle von Flugverbindungen, wobei für jede Verbindung ein Status ('Active', 'Inactive', 'Future') basierend auf dem Flugdatum und einem gegebenen Stichtag zugewiesen wird. Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `COND` Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung des Status.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_cond_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_input,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_input.
    TYPES: tt_flight_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_input
        iv_key_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_cond_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    rt_flights_status = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        status = COND string(
          WHEN ls_flight-fldate < iv_key_date THEN 'Inactive'
          WHEN ls_flight-fldate = iv_key_date THEN 'Active'
          WHEN ls_flight-fldate > iv_key_date THEN 'Future'
          ELSE 'Unknown' " Fallback
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flugdaten für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an Sitzen (seatsmax) haben. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse nach der Datenbankabfrage, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer zu berücksichtigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für die Datenbankabfrage und anschließend den `FILTER` Operator für die In-Memory-Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_filter_post DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_filter,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_carrier_filter.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_filter TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers_filter TYPE tt_carrier_filter
        iv_connid_filter   TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_post IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    IF it_carriers_filter IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers_filter
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers_filter-carrid
          AND seatsmax >= @it_carriers_filter-min_seats
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_raw_flights WHERE connid = iv_connid_filter ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_no_match.

Dies ist nützlich, wenn bestimmte Filterkriterien nicht direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel der Datenbankabfrage verwendet werden können oder wenn eine weitere Verfeinerung der Daten im ABAP-Programm erforderlich ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine hierarchische Struktur von Fluggesellschaften, die jeweils eine Liste ihrer Flüge enthalten. Für jede Fluggesellschaft soll zusätzlich die Anzahl der Flüge und die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze berechnet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit verschachtelten `VALUE` und `REDUCE` Ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_hierarchical_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_hierarchy,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_seats TYPE i,
             flights     TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_carrier_hierarchy.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_hierarchy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_hierarchy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE tt_carrier_hierarchy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_hierarchical_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_hierarchy.
    rt_hierarchy = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      (
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        num_flights = lines( GROUP flight ),
        total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT sum = sum + f-seatsmax ),
        flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR f IN GROUP flight
          (
            connid = f-connid,
            fldate = f-fldate,
            seatsmax = f-seatsmax
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für eine gegebene Liste von Fluggesellschaften die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche Anzahl der Sitze pro Flug aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und aggregierende Funktionen im `SELECT` Statement.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` in Kombination mit `COUNT(*)` und `AVG()` sowie `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_agg_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_id,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier_id.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_agg_data,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             avg_seats   TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_carrier_agg_data.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_agg_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_agg_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_aggregates
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_agg_data) TYPE tt_carrier_agg_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_agg_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_aggregates.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, AVG( seatsmax ) AS avg_seats
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        GROUP BY carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_agg_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, wobei jede Fluggesellschaft eine String-Liste aller ihrer Flugnummern (kommasepariert) enthält. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit einem verschachtelten `FOR` und String-Templates zur Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_string_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_conns,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connections_str TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_conns.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_conns TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_conns WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_connections_string
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_conns) TYPE tt_carrier_conns.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_string_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_connections_string.
    rt_carrier_conns = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      (
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        connections_str = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN f-connid ELSE |{ s }, { f-connid }| ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_update_with_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_raw,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_booking_raw.
    TYPES: tt_booking_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: tt_booking_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook-bookid WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_bookings_in TYPE tt_booking_raw
        it_cancelled_ids TYPE tt_booking_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_bookings_out) TYPE tt_booking_raw.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_update_with_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_booking_status.
    rt_bookings_out = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_booking IN it_bookings_in
      (
        bookid = ls_booking-bookid,
        status = COND string(
          WHEN line_exists( it_cancelled_ids[ table_line = ls_booking-bookid ] ) THEN 'Cancelled'
          ELSE 'Confirmed'
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_route,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             route  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_route.
    TYPES: tt_flight_routes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_route WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_routes,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             routes TYPE tt_flight_routes,
           END OF ty_carrier_routes.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_routes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_routes WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_routes
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_routes) TYPE tt_carrier_routes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_routes.
    rt_carrier_routes = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      (
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        routes = VALUE #( 
          FOR f IN GROUP flight
          (
            connid = f-connid,
            route = |{ f-cityfrom } -> { f-cityto }|
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
