CLASS zcl_nes_unique_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights   TYPE i,
             num_unique_planes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_unique_plane_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_unique_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_unique_plane_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      (
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        num_flights = lines( GROUP flight ),
        num_unique_planes = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                      DATA(plane_types) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-planetype WITH EMPTY KEY
                                      FOR f IN GROUP flight
                                      WHERE ( NOT line_exists( plane_types[ table_line = f-planetype ] ) )
                                      NEXT plane_types = VALUE #( BASE plane_types ( f-planetype ) )
                                           count = count + 1 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten dynamisch modifiziert, indem sie ein Feld-Symbol verwendet, um auf die Zeilen zuzugreifen und ein bestimmtes Feld zu aktualisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol> und den Zuweisungsoperator =.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_modify_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_status
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_flights TYPE tt_flight_status
        IV_NEW_STATUS TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_modify_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_status.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_status.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      <fs_flight>-status = iv_new_status.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_modify_status FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_status.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_fsym_modify_table=>tt_flight_status.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight1>).
    <fs_flight1>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight1>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight1>-fldate = '20250101'.
    <fs_flight1>-status = 'PLANNED'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight2>).
    <fs_flight2>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight2>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight2>-fldate = '20250102'.
    <fs_flight2>-status = 'PLANNED'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsym_modify_table( ).
    lo_cut->modify_status( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights IV_NEW_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight1>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be COMPLETED' act = <fs_flight1>-status exp = 'COMPLETED' ).
    ENDLOOP.

explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation von Zeilen einer internen Tabelle ohne explizites `MODIFY TABLE`. Dies ist performanter, da keine Kopie der Zeile erstellt wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Komponentenwert einer Struktur dynamisch über den Feldnamen (als String) ausliest und aktualisiert, indem sie ein Feld-Symbol verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person,
             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
             city TYPE string,
           END OF ty_person.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_person
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_person.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA: ls_person TYPE zcl_fsym_dynamic_access=>ty_person.
    ls_person-name = 'Max Mustermann'.
    ls_person-age  = 30.
    ls_person-city = 'Berlin'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsym_dynamic_access( ).

    " Test get_component_value
    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_person iv_component = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Name should be Max Mustermann' act = lv_name exp = 'Max Mustermann' ).

    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_person iv_component = 'AGE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Age should be 30' act = lv_age exp = '30' ). " Age is i, converted to string

    " Test set_component_value
    lo_cut->set_component_value( EXPORTING iv_component = 'CITY' iv_new_value = 'Hamburg' CHANGING cs_data = ls_person ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'City should be Hamburg' act = ls_person-city exp = 'Hamburg' ).

    lo_cut->set_component_value( EXPORTING iv_component = 'AGE' iv_new_value = '35' CHANGING cs_data = ls_person ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Age should be 35' act = ls_person-age exp = 35 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>` ist der Schlüssel für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Routinen, bei denen der genaue Feldname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structures

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String in eine generische Datenreferenz und greifen Sie dann mit Feld-Symbolen dynamisch auf die Komponenten zu, ohne die genaue Struktur zur Kompilierzeit zu kennen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` für die dynamische Typisierung, gefolgt von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_fsym_generic_deser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS deserialize_and_read
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_component_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_fsym_generic_deser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_and_read.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    " Dynamische Typisierung für die Deserialisierung
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( VALUE #( ( name = 'ID' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) ( name = 'NAME' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) ( name = 'AGE' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) ) ) ).
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    " Deserialisieren
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string CHANGING data = <fs_data> ).

    " Dynamischer Zugriff auf die Komponente
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_component_value = <fs_component>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_deserialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_deserialization.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_fsym_generic_deser( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = `{"ID":"G001","NAME":"Generic User","AGE":42}`.

    DATA(lv_id) = lo_cut->deserialize_and_read( iv_json_string = lv_json_input iv_component_name = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID mismatch' act = lv_id exp = 'G001' ).

    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->deserialize_and_read( iv_json_string = lv_json_input iv_component_name = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Name mismatch' act = lv_name exp = 'Generic User' ).

    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->deserialize_and_read( iv_json_string = lv_json_input iv_component_name = 'AGE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Age mismatch' act = lv_age exp = '42' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen die Struktur der JSON-Daten zur Kompilierzeit nicht vollständig bekannt ist und generisch verarbeitet werden muss.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen mit Feld-Symbolen und serialisieren Sie diese dann in einen JSON-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Erstellung von Tabellen und Strukturen, `ASSIGN` für Feld-Symbole und `CL_UI2_JSON=>SERIALIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_json_dynamic_ser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_serialize
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_json_dynamic_ser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_serialize.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data_table TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_data_line TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    " Dynamische Strukturdefinition
    lr_struct_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( VALUE #(
      ( name = 'ID' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) )
      ( name = 'VALUE' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
    ) ).

    " Dynamische Tabellendefinition
    lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_type ).

    " Dynamische Tabelle erzeugen
    CREATE DATA lr_data_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Zeilen dynamisch füllen
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      CREATE DATA lr_data_line TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_type.
      ASSIGN lr_data_line->* TO <fs_line>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = |ITEM_{ sy-index ALPHA = IN }|. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = sy-index * 10. ENDIF.

      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDDO.

    " Tabelle serialisieren
    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = <fs_table> pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die performante Iteration und den Zugriff auf interne Tabellenzeilen mittels Feld-Symbolen im Vergleich zu Work Areas.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` für die performante Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_perf_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_with_field_symbol
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.

    METHODS process_with_work_area
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_perf_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_field_symbol.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE ty_data.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_data>.
      <fs_data>-value = |Processed by FS: { <fs_data>-key }|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_with_work_area.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    LOOP AT ct_data INTO ls_data.
      ls_data-value = |Processed by WA: { ls_data-key }|.
      MODIFY TABLE ct_data FROM ls_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_performance_loop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_performance_loop.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_fsym_perf_loop=>tt_data.
    DO 100 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( key = sy-index value = 'Initial' ) TO lt_test_data.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsym_perf_loop( ).

    DATA(lt_data_fs) = lt_test_data.
    lo_cut->process_with_field_symbol( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data_fs ).
    READ TABLE lt_data_fs INDEX 50 INTO DATA(ls_data_fs).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'FS processed value mismatch' act = ls_data_fs-value exp = 'Processed by FS: 50' ).

    DATA(lt_data_wa) = lt_test_data.
    lo_cut->process_with_work_area( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data_wa ).
    READ TABLE lt_data_wa INDEX 50 INTO DATA(ls_data_wa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'WA processed value mismatch' act = ls_data_wa-value exp = 'Processed by WA: 50' ).

    " Assert that both methods produce the same logical result
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Results should be identical' act = lt_data_fs exp = lt_data_wa ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Iteration über interne Tabellen mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` ist performanter als `LOOP AT ... INTO work_area` gefolgt von `MODIFY TABLE`. Dies liegt daran, dass bei Feld-Symbolen direkt auf die Tabellenzeile verwiesen wird, während bei Work Areas eine Kopie der Zeile erstellt und zurückgeschrieben werden muss.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Performance, LOOP AT ASSIGNING, Work Area

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Deserialisierung eines JSON-Strings mit Fehlerbehandlung, um ungültige JSON-Eingaben abzufangen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um Ausnahmen der Klasse `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` oder `CX_SY_JSON_PARSE_ERROR` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             id    TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_simple_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_simple_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string CHANGING data = rs_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        " Fehler bei der Typkonvertierung oder Strukturinkompatibilität
        MESSAGE lx_conversion_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        " Fehler beim Parsen des JSON-Strings (z.B. ungültiges Format)
        MESSAGE lx_parse_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_json FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_json FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_mismatched_json FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = `{"id":"A001","value":"Test Value"}`.
    DATA(ls_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling( lv_json_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID mismatch' act = ls_data-id exp = 'A001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value mismatch' act = ls_data-value exp = 'Test Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = `{"id":"A001","value":"Test Value"`." Missing closing brace
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( class = 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR' act = `lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling( lv_json_input )` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mismatched_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = `{"id":"A001","value":123}`." Value is number, expected string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( class = 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR' act = `lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling( lv_json_input )` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ist entscheidend für die robuste Verarbeitung externer Daten wie JSON. `CX_SY_JSON_PARSE_ERROR` fängt Syntaxfehler im JSON-String ab, während `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` Probleme bei der Typkonvertierung oder der Zuordnung zu ABAP-Strukturen behandelt. Dies stellt sicher, dass die Anwendung bei fehlerhaften Eingaben nicht abstürzt.
keywords: JSON, /ui2/cl_json, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, DESERIALIZE, Exceptions

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines beliebigen Feldes in einer beliebigen internen Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen und einem Suchwert aktualisiert. Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_generic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_table_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_key_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_key_value        TYPE string
        iv_target_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value        TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_any_table        TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_generic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_table_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_key_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_key_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_key_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_key_field> = iv_key_value.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_target_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_target_field> = iv_new_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit bestimmten Feldnamen und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen mit Feld-Symbolen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einem dynamischen Gruppierungsschlüssel und Feld-Symbolen für die Gruppen und Gruppenelemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_dynamic_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_data,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_data.
    TYPES: tt_sales_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE tt_sales_data
        iv_group_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_dynamic_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sum.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group_key> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_member> TYPE ty_sales_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_amount> TYPE i.

    LOOP AT it_sales_data ASSIGNING <fs_member> GROUP BY ( <fs_member>-(iv_group_field) ) ASSIGNING <fs_group_key>.
      DATA(ls_result_line) = VALUE ty_grouped_result( group_key = <fs_group_key> ).
      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group_key> ASSIGNING <fs_member>.
        ls_result_line-total_amount = ls_result_line-total_amount + <fs_member>-amount.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_result_line TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_key = 'North' INTO DATA(ls_north).

  METHOD test_group_by_product.
    DATA: lt_sales TYPE tt_sales_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'North' product = 'A' amount = 10 ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'South' product = 'B' amount = 20 ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'North' product = 'C' amount = 15 ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'South' product = 'A' amount = 25 ) TO lt_sales.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsym_dynamic_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_and_sum( it_sales_data = lt_sales iv_group_field = 'PRODUCT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should have 3 groups' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_key = 'A' INTO DATA(ls_product_a).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Product A total mismatch' act = ls_product_a-total_amount exp = 35 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_key = 'B' INTO DATA(ls_product_b).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Product B total mismatch' act = ls_product_b-total_amount exp = 20 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_key = 'C' INTO DATA(ls_product_c).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Product C total mismatch' act = ls_product_c-total_amount exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die die Feldnamen und Werte einer beliebigen Struktur ausliest und in eine interne Tabelle von Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren umwandelt, unter Verwendung von RTTI und Feld-Symbolen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>GET_DDIC_TYPE` und `GET_COMPONENTS` für RTTI, und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsym_rtti_struct_to_kv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_value_pair,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_value_pair.
    TYPES: tt_key_value_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_value_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_struct_to_kv
      IMPORTING
        ir_any_structure TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_kv_pairs) TYPE tt_key_value_pairs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsym_rtti_struct_to_kv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_struct_to_kv.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_any_structure->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_structure> ) AS cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( key = ls_component-name value = <fs_component_value> ) TO rt_kv_pairs.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (lv_table_type)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die dynamische Datenbefüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT' or 'ZCL_DYN_TABLE_CREATE=>TY_SFLIGHT_DATA'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type).
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Example: Fill with some dummy data or data from SFLIGHT
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 2 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_initial).

      LOOP AT lt_sflight_initial ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight_initial>).
        CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
        ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_field> = <fs_sflight_initial>-carrid.
        ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_field> = <fs_sflight_initial>-connid.
        ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_field> = <fs_sflight_initial>-fldate.
        ENDIF.

        INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters  TYPE abap_parmbind_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string. " Return as string for generic example
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_instance TYPE REF TO object,
          lx_exception      TYPE REF TO cx_root.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_class_instance TYPE (iv_class_name).

        CALL METHOD lo_class_instance->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE it_parameters
          RECEIVING RESULTS
            FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_result>).

        IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_result = <fs_result>. " Convert to string for generic return
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |General Error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dyn_object_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_printable. " A simple interface for demonstration

    METHODS create_and_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_printable.
  METHODS print_message
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_object_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call.
    DATA: lo_object    TYPE REF TO object,
          lx_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        " Check if the created object implements the expected interface
        DATA(lo_printable) = CAST if_printable( lo_object ).

        CALL METHOD lo_printable->(iv_method_name)
          RECEIVING RESULTS
            FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_result>).

        IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_result = <fs_result>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |Error creating object: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |Error calling method: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |Error casting object (interface not implemented): { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |General Error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_printable~print_message.
    rv_message = 'Hello from ZCL_DYN_OBJECT_FACTORY!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Komponenten einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String bekannt ist, und lesen oder ändern Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_component_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure      TYPE ty_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value)   TYPE string.

    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_structure      TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <lv_field>.

    IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <lv_field>. " Convert to string for generic return
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_structure TO <lv_field>.

    IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <lv_field> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
          " Handle conversion error, e.g., log it or raise a specific exception
          " For this example, we'll just ignore it.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Feldnamen, der zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT <lt_table> BY (lv_field_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    " Populate with some sample data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sort_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lt_flights TO <lt_sort_table>.

    IF <lt_sort_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          SORT <lt_sort_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error INTO DATA(lx_sort_error).
          " Handle error if sort field does not exist
          " For this example, we'll just return unsorted table
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    rt_sorted_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_dynamic_message_e.
    " Test for an error message (type 'E') which typically raises an exception
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_message_handler( ).

    " Assuming message class '00' and message number '001' exists as type 'E'

    TRY.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_message_handler( ).

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Open SQL-Abfrage aus und befüllen Sie das Ergebnis direkt in eine interne Tabelle unter Verwendung von Constructor Expressions.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT ... FROM (lv_table_name) WHERE (lv_where_clause) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result)` mit dynamischen Tabellennamen und WHERE-Klauseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_constructor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_data_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name    TYPE string
        iv_where_clause  TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_max_rows      TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data)   TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_constructor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_fields TYPE string VALUE `CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE`.

    TRY.
        IF iv_where_clause IS INITIAL.
          SELECT (lv_fields)
            FROM (iv_table_name)
            UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS
            INTO TABLE @rt_data.
        ELSE.
          SELECT (lv_fields)
            FROM (iv_table_name)
            WHERE (iv_where_clause)
            UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS
            INTO TABLE @rt_data.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle dynamic SQL errors
        " For this example, we'll just clear the result table
        CLEAR rt_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Möglichkeit, Tabellennamen und WHERE-Klauseln dynamisch zu übergeben, ist entscheidend für generische Datenzugriffsschichten. Die Syntax `INTO TABLE @rt_data` ist ein Beispiel für eine Constructor Expression, die die direkte Befüllung einer internen Tabelle ermöglicht. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Vergleichswert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamisch erstellten Ausdruck oder `LOOP AT ... WHERE (lv_dynamic_condition)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_operator   TYPE string " e.g., '=', '>', '<'
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    " Populate with some sample data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_filtered> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>     TYPE any,
                   <lv_field>    TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA REF TO tt_sflight_data.
    ASSIGN lt_flights TO <lt_filtered>.

    IF <lt_filtered> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(lv_dynamic_condition) = |{ iv_field_name } { iv_operator } '{ iv_value }'|.

      LOOP AT <lt_filtered> ASSIGNING <ls_line> WHERE (lv_dynamic_condition).
        APPEND <ls_line> TO rt_filtered_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Feldnamen, der zur Laufzeit übergeben wird, und aggregieren Sie Daten für jede Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit einem dynamisch erstellten Gruppierungsschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_group_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    " Populate with some sample data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 20 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_group_key> TYPE any.

    " Dynamic grouping using FOR GROUPS
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF <fs_flight> IN lt_flights
                                GROUP BY ( <fs_flight>-(iv_group_field) ) AS group_key
                                ( group_key   = <group_key>
                                  count       = GROUP SIZE
                                  total_price = SUM( <fs_flight>-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten (Felder) einer beliebigen Struktur oder internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit mithilfe von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` oder `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE d,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_components.
    DATA: lo_descr_ref TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lo_descr_ref = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    CASE lo_descr_ref->kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_descr_ref.
        rt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
        lo_table_descr ?= lo_descr_ref.
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        rt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle other types or raise an exception
        CLEAR rt_components.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse und rufen Sie eine Methode auf, deren Parameter ebenfalls dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle befüllt werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CREATE OBJECT (lv_class_name)` mit `CALL METHOD ... PARAMETER-TABLE` und `VALUE #(...)` für die Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_obj_param_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_calculator.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_param_data  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_calculator.
  METHODS add
    IMPORTING
      iv_val1 TYPE i
      iv_val2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
  METHODS subtract
    IMPORTING
      iv_val1 TYPE i
      iv_val2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_diff) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_obj_param_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object,
          lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          lx_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        DATA(lo_calculator) = CAST if_calculator( lo_object ).

        " Dynamically build parameter table
        CASE iv_method_name.
          WHEN 'ADD' OR 'SUBTRACT'.
            lt_parameters = VALUE #(
              ( name = 'IV_VAL1' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_input value = NEW i( it_param_data[ 1 ] ) )
              ( name = 'IV_VAL2' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_input value = NEW i( it_param_data[ 2 ] ) )
            ).
          WHEN OTHERS.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = 'Unsupported method for dynamic parameters'.
        ENDCASE.

        CALL METHOD lo_calculator->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING RESULTS
            FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_result>).

        IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_result = <fs_result>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |Error creating object: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |Error calling method: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |Error casting object: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |General Error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_calculator~add.
    rv_sum = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_calculator~subtract.
    rv_diff = iv_val1 - iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer dynamisch definierten Zeilenstruktur zur Laufzeit und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE_EMPTY` oder `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component.
    TYPES tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_components TYPE tt_components
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_abap_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_struct_descr    TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr     TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_data_handle     TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_dynamic_field> TYPE any.

    " 1. Build RTTI component table from input
    LOOP AT it_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_component-type )
      ) TO lt_abap_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic structure description
    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_abap_components ).

    " 3. Create dynamic table description
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " 5. Fill with some dummy data
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_dynamic_field>.
        IF <lv_dynamic_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_dynamic_field> = 'Value A'.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_dynamic_field>.
        IF <lv_dynamic_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_dynamic_field> = 100.
        ENDIF.
        INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

        CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_dynamic_field>.
        IF <lv_dynamic_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_dynamic_field> = 'Value B'.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_dynamic_field>.
        IF <lv_dynamic_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <lv_dynamic_field> = 200.
        ENDIF.
        INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen generischen Event-Handler, der dynamisch auf Events reagiert, deren Namen und Parameter zur Laufzeit bekannt sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` mit dynamischem Event-Namen und `GET BINDING` für Event-Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS register_and_raise_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_event_name TYPE string
        iv_sender_class TYPE string.

    METHODS handle_any_event FOR EVENT (any_event) OF (any_class).
ENDCLASS.

" Dummy class to raise events
CLASS zcl_event_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS my_dynamic_event EXPORTING VALUE(iv_message) TYPE string.
    EVENTS another_event EXPORTING VALUE(iv_value) TYPE i.

    METHODS raise_my_dynamic_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string.
    METHODS raise_another_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD raise_my_dynamic_event.
    RAISE EVENT my_dynamic_event EXPORTING iv_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD raise_another_event.
    RAISE EVENT another_event EXPORTING iv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_and_raise_event.
    DATA: lo_sender TYPE REF TO object,
          lo_handler TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_event_handler.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_sender TYPE (iv_sender_class).
    CREATE OBJECT lo_handler.

    " Dynamically register handler
    SET HANDLER lo_handler->handle_any_event FOR lo_sender EVENTS (iv_event_name).

    " Dynamically raise event
    CASE iv_event_name.
      WHEN 'MY_DYNAMIC_EVENT'.
        DATA(lo_sender_typed) = CAST zcl_event_sender( lo_sender ).
        lo_sender_typed->raise_my_dynamic_event( 'Hello Dynamic Event!' ).
      WHEN 'ANOTHER_EVENT'.
        DATA(lo_sender_typed_2) = CAST zcl_event_sender( lo_sender ).
        lo_sender_typed_2->raise_another_event( 123 ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unsupported event
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_any_event.
    DATA: lv_event_name TYPE string,
          lv_sender_class TYPE string,
          lv_message TYPE string,
          lv_value TYPE i.

    " Get event name and sender class dynamically
    GET BINDING OF EVENT (any_event) OF (any_class) FOR me RECEIVER lo_sender.
    lv_event_name = cl_abap_eventdescr=>describe_by_event( lo_sender->get_class_name( ) iv_event_name ).
    lv_sender_class = lo_sender->get_class_name( ).

    " Dynamically read event parameters
    CASE lv_event_name.
      WHEN 'MY_DYNAMIC_EVENT'.
        GET BINDING OF PARAMETER iv_message OF EVENT my_dynamic_event OF zcl_event_sender RECEIVER lv_message.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Handled event '{ lv_event_name }' from '{ lv_sender_class }' with message: '{ lv_message }'| ).
      WHEN 'ANOTHER_EVENT'.
        GET BINDING OF PARAMETER iv_value OF EVENT another_event OF zcl_event_sender RECEIVER lv_value.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Handled event '{ lv_event_name }' from '{ lv_sender_class }' with value: { lv_value }| ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Handled unknown event '{ lv_event_name }' from '{ lv_sender_class }'| ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_event_handling FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_event_handling_another FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_event_handling.
    " This test primarily checks if the dynamic event handling mechanism works
    " and if cl_demo_output is called. Direct assertion on cl_demo_output is tricky.
    " We'll rely on the fact that no exception is raised and the code path is executed.

    cl_demo_output=>begin_section( 'Test Dynamic Event Handling' ).
    zcl_dyn_event_handler=>register_and_raise_event(
      iv_event_name   = 'MY_DYNAMIC_EVENT'
      iv_sender_class = 'ZCL_EVENT_SENDER'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>end_section( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Dynamic event handling for MY_DYNAMIC_EVENT executed without error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_event_handling_another.

    zcl_dyn_event_handler=>register_and_raise_event(
      iv_event_name   = 'ANOTHER_EVENT'
      iv_sender_class = 'ZCL_EVENT_SENDER'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>end_section( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Dynamic event handling for ANOTHER_EVENT executed without error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die dynamische Event-Behandlung in ABAP ermöglicht es, auf Ereignisse zu reagieren, deren Namen und Parameter erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept für hochflexible und erweiterbare Architekturen, z.B. in Plugin-Systemen oder generischen Frameworks. Die Verwendung von `SET HANDLER ... EVENTS (any_event)` und `GET BINDING OF PARAMETER ...` in Kombination mit RTTI-Klassen erlaubt es, Event-Parameter dynamisch zu lesen und zu verarbeiten. `CL_DEMO_OUTPUT` wird hier zur Demonstration verwendet.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID). Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann verwendet werden, um eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_data
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'. " Assuming 'LH' has flights in SFLIGHT

    " Get expected sum directly from DB for comparison
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_expected_price) WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_result_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_price
      exp = lv_expected_price
      msg = 'Calculated total price does not match expected value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Variablen. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Methode, um Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere aggregierte Werte zu berechnen, ohne explizite `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und nach 'NEW YORK' fliegen. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf den Zeilen einer Quelltabelle, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ts_flight_detail,
           tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_frankfurt_newyork_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_newyork_flights.
    " First, get all flights and their city information
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    " Now filter using the FILTER operator
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_frankfurt_newyork_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_frankfurt_newyork_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_newyork_flights( ).

    " Assert that the table is not empty (assuming such flights exist)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Assert that all entries match the filter criteria
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' msg = 'City from mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'City to mismatch' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Zeilen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren, und ist oft effizienter als manuelle `LOOP`- und `DELETE`-Operationen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Table Filtering, Declarative Programming

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in einen Zeitstempel (UTC). Nutzen Sie moderne Konvertierungsfunktionen.

CLASS zcl_date_time_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                iv_time TYPE sy-uzeit

CLASS zcl_date_time_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_timestamp.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_to_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_time_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lv_timestamp) = lo_cut->convert_to_timestamp( iv_date = lv_date iv_time = lv_time ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_timestamp msg = 'Timestamp should not be initial' ).

    DATA: lv_date_back TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_time_back TYPE sy-uzeit.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_time_back exp = lv_time msg = 'Time conversion mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: Date, Time, Timestamp, CONVERT_DATE_TIME, UTC

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen dem höchsten und dem niedrigsten Flugpreis für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator und die `SUBTRACT`-Operation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um den höchsten und niedrigsten Preis zu finden, und subtrahieren Sie diese dann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price_difference
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_difference) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_difference.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_prices IS INITIAL.
      rv_difference = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_price) = REDUCE #( INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                   FOR price_val IN lt_prices
                                   NEXT max_p = nmax( max_p, price_val ) ).

    DATA(lv_min_price) = REDUCE #( INIT min_p TYPE sflight-price = lt_prices[ 1 ]-price " Initialize with first element
                                   FOR price_val IN lt_prices
                                   NEXT min_p = nmin( min_p, price_val ) ).

    rv_difference = lv_max_price - lv_min_price. " SUBTRACT operation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_price_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_price_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_subtract( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'. " Assuming 'LH' has flights with varying prices

    SELECT MAX( price ) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_expected_max) WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    SELECT MIN( price ) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_expected_min) WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    DATA(lv_expected_diff) = lv_expected_max - lv_expected_min.

    DATA(lv_result_diff) = lo_cut->calculate_price_difference( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_diff
      exp = lv_expected_diff
      msg = 'Calculated price difference does not match expected value'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_price_difference( 'XX' )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Difference should be 0 for non-existent carrid'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SUBTRACT`-Operation wird hier im Kontext moderner `REDUCE`-Operatoren verwendet, um die maximale und minimale Werte aus einer Liste zu extrahieren. Dies zeigt, wie grundlegende mathematische Operationen in funktionalen Programmierparadigmen effizient eingesetzt werden können, um komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: Math, SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Aggregation, Max, Min

CLASS zcl_docking_container_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluginformationen (CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE) und fügen Sie neue Zeilen hinzu, wobei Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `BASE` verwenden, um bestehende Daten zu erweitern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( BASE ... )` um eine Tabelle zu initialisieren und gleichzeitig neue Einträge hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_value_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.

CLASS zcl_itab_value_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_extended_flights.
    DATA: lt_initial_flights TYPE tt_flight_key.

    " Populate some initial data
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20230102' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.

    " Extend the table using VALUE with BASE
    rt_flights = VALUE #( BASE lt_initial_flights
                          ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20230103' )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20230104' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Flugnummern zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Nutzen Sie String-Templates und den `FOR` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit String-Templates für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_for_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS concatenate_carrids
      IMPORTING it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_for_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carrids.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR carrid_val IN it_carrids
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ carrid_val }|
                           ELSE |{ s }, { carrid_val }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_carrids.
    DATA: lt_test_carrids TYPE zcl_str_for_concat=>tt_carrid.
    INSERT 'LH' INTO TABLE lt_test_carrids.
    INSERT 'AA' INTO TABLE lt_test_carrids.
    INSERT 'UA' INTO TABLE lt_test_carrids.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_for_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carrids( lt_test_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH, AA, UA' msg = 'Concatenated string mismatch' ).

    CLEAR lt_test_carrids.
    lv_result = lo_cut->concatenate_carrids( lt_test_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' msg = 'Empty table should result in empty string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `REDUCE` und String-Templates ermöglicht eine elegante und effiziente Verkettung von Elementen einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzigen String, was die Lesbarkeit gegenüber traditionellen `LOOP`- und `CONCATENATE`-Anweisungen erheblich verbessert.
keywords: String Processing, String Templates, REDUCE, Concatenation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von klassenbasierten Ausnahmen (`TRY...CATCH`) und der `RAISE EXCEPTION` Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY`, `CATCH` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING iv_numerator   TYPE i
                iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING   cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS perform_division_with_handling.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_division_with_handling.
    DATA: lv_num TYPE i VALUE 10,
          lv_den TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_res TYPE f.

    TRY.
        lv_res = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = lv_num iv_denominator = lv_den ).
        " cl_demo_output=>display( |Result: { lv_res }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        " cl_demo_output=>display( |Error: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        " In a real application, log the error or inform the user appropriately.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und dessen Komponenten zu analysieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und seine Unterklassen wie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ts_flight_data.

    METHODS analyze_data_object
      IMPORTING id_data TYPE any
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_type_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_data_object.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( id_data ).

    APPEND |Type Name: { lo_typedescr->get_name( ) }| TO rt_type_info.
    APPEND |Type Kind: { lo_typedescr->type_kind }| TO rt_type_info.

    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      APPEND |Structure Components:| TO rt_type_info.
      LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND |  - Name: { ls_component-name }, Type: { ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ) }| TO rt_type_info.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( line_exists( lt_result[ table_line CS 'Name: CARRID' ] ) ) msg = 'Should contain CARRID component' ).

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Anzahl von Flügen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `FOR` mit `INDEX INTO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
      connid = ls_sflight-connid
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      price = ls_sflight-price
    ) ).

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_all_flights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = NEW cl_abap_int_table( ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " For simplicity, duplicates are possible if iv_count > total flights
      APPEND lv_random_index TO lt_selected_indices->*.
    ENDDO.

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR lv_idx IN lt_selected_indices->* " +1 because internal tables are 1-indexed
                                   INDEX INTO lt_all_flights ( lt_all_flights[ lv_idx + 1 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 ).
    " Further assertions could check if the selected flights are valid SFLIGHT entries
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_flights.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie Flugverspätungen, indem Sie jedem Flug aus SFLIGHT eine zufällige Verspätung zwischen 0 und 60 Minuten hinzufügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Minuten und `cl_abap_tstmp=>add()` für die Zeitstempelberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_delay DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_delay,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             delay_min TYPE i,
             new_deptime TYPE sflight-deptime,
             new_arrtime TYPE sflight-arrtime,
           END OF ty_flight_delay.
    TYPES tt_flight_delay TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_delay WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_random_delays
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_delay) TYPE tt_flight_delay.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_delay IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_random_delays.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = 60 ). " 0 to 60 minutes delay

    rt_flights_with_delay = VALUE tt_flight_delay( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
      connid = ls_sflight-connid
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      fltime = ls_sflight-fltime
      deptime = ls_sflight-deptime
      arrtime = ls_sflight-arrtime
      delay_min = lo_random->get_next( )
      new_deptime = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
                                                  date = ls_sflight-fldate
                                                  time = ls_sflight-deptime )
                                        secs  = lo_random->get_next( ) * 60 )->get_time( )
      new_arrtime = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
                                                  date = ls_sflight-fldate
                                                  time = ls_sflight-arrtime )
                                        secs  = lo_random->get_next( ) * 60 )->get_time( )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delay_assignment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delay_assignment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_delay( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->assign_random_delays( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_flight-delay_min ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-delay_min GE 0 AND ls_flight-delay_min LE 60 ).
      IF ls_flight-delay_min > 0.
        DATA(lv_original_deptime_secs) = ( ls_flight-deptime DIV 10000 * 3600 ) + ( ( ls_flight-deptime MOD 10000 ) DIV 100 * 60 ) + ( ls_flight-deptime MOD 100 ).
        DATA(lv_new_deptime_secs) = ( ls_flight-new_deptime DIV 10000 * 3600 ) + ( ( ls_flight-new_deptime MOD 10000 ) DIV 100 * 60 ) + ( ls_flight-new_deptime MOD 100 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_new_deptime_secs GE lv_original_deptime_secs ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `FOR`-Iteration wird verwendet, um die Daten aus `SFLIGHT` zu transformieren und neue Felder hinzuzufügen. Die Zeitstempelberechnung erfolgt mit `cl_abap_tstmp`.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT so auf, dass sie in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` hierarchisch nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Verbindungsnummer dargestellt werden können.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Feldern für den Baum (z.B. `NODE_KEY`, `PARENT_KEY`, `TEXT`, `LEVEL`) und füllen Sie diese mit den hierarchischen Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_flight_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_hierarchy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_flight_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_hierarchy.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight ) ).
    SORT lt_sflight BY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                             FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight ( ls_sflight-carrid ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_carrier_node_key) = |C{ lv_node_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node(
        node_key   = lv_carrier_node_key
        parent_key = ''
        text       = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrid }|
        level      = 0
        is_folder  = abap_true
        carrid     = lv_carrid
      ) TO rt_tree_nodes.

      DATA(lt_connections) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                                 FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrid ) ( ls_sflight-connid ).

      LOOP AT lt_connections INTO DATA(lv_connid).
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        DATA(lv_conn_node_key) = |N{ lv_node_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
        APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node(
          node_key   = lv_conn_node_key
          parent_key = lv_carrier_node_key
          text       = |Verbindung: { lv_connid }|
          level      = 1
          is_folder  = abap_true
          carrid     = lv_carrid
          connid     = lv_connid
        ) TO rt_tree_nodes.

        DATA(lt_flights_for_conn) = FILTER sflight_tab( lt_sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid ).
        LOOP AT lt_flights_for_conn INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node(
            node_key   = |F{ lv_node_counter ALPHA = OUT }|
            parent_key = lv_conn_node_key
            text       = |Flug am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } - Preis: { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency }|
            level      = 2
            is_folder  = abap_false
            carrid     = ls_flight-carrid
            connid     = ls_flight-connid
            fldate     = ls_flight-fldate
          ) TO rt_tree_nodes.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hierarchy_creation FOR TESTING.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_fcat_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_fcat_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_display( ). " Dummy data for field catalog generation

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>screen0 " Dummy container, not actually used for display
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_data
        ).
        rt_fcat = lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->get_fcat( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Error handling
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).
      CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
          <fs_fcat>-key = abap_true. " Example: Mark as key field for tree
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Verbindung'.
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Flugdatum'.
        WHEN 'PRICE'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Preis'.
        WHEN 'CURRENCY'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Währung'.
          <fs_fcat>-no_out = abap_true. " Example: Don't display currency as a separate column
        WHEN OTHERS.
          <fs_fcat>-no_out = abap_true.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA(lt_fcat) = create_field_catalog( ).

    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_FLIGHT_TREE_DISPLAY=>TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
        is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid handle = 'TREE' )
        i_save           = 'A'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_flight_nodes
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
    ).

    mo_column_tree->set_hierarchy_header(
      i_field_name_key       = 'NODE_KEY'
      i_field_name_parent    = 'PARENT_KEY'
      i_field_name_node_text = 'TEXT'
      i_field_name_is_folder = 'IS_FOLDER'
      i_field_name_level     = 'LEVEL'
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_field_catalog.
    DATA(lt_dummy_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_nodes( ).
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>screen0
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_dummy_data
        ).
        rt_fcat = lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->get_fcat( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Error handling
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT rt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).
      CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.
        WHEN 'NODE_KEY' OR 'PARENT_KEY' OR 'LEVEL' OR 'IS_FOLDER'.
          <fs_fcat>-no_out = abap_true.
        WHEN 'TEXT'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Beschreibung'.
          <fs_fcat>-outputlen = 50.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Verbindung'.
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Flugdatum'.
        WHEN 'PRICE'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Preis'.
        WHEN 'CURRENCY'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Währung'.
          <fs_fcat>-no_out = abap_true.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
