Instructions: Mischen Sie die Reihenfolge der Einträge in einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `REDUCE`-Anweisung, um die Tabelle neu aufzubauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_flights.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( it_flights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = lv_max_index ).

    DATA(lt_temp_flights) = it_flights.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_flights_local) = VALUE tt_sflight( ).

    DO lines( it_flights ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_pos) = lo_random->get_next( ) + 1. " +1 for 1-indexed tables
      IF lv_random_pos > lines( lt_temp_flights ). " Adjust if random pos is out of bounds due to shrinking table
        lv_random_pos = lines( lt_temp_flights ).
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lt_temp_flights[ lv_random_pos ] TO lt_shuffled_flights_local.
      DELETE lt_temp_flights INDEX lv_random_pos.
      IF lt_temp_flights IS INITIAL.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lo_random = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = lines( lt_temp_flights ) - 1 ).
    ENDDO.

    rt_shuffled_flights = lt_shuffled_flights_local.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_shuffled_flights[ carrid = ls_original-carrid AND connid = ls_original-connid ] ) ).

    " Note: Asserting actual shuffle is hard, as it's random. We check size and content.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 10 zufälligen Ganzzahlen innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs (z.B. 1 bis 100).

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_number_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE cl_abap_int_table=>tt_abap_int.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_number_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = iv_min max = iv_max ).

    rt_random_numbers = VALUE cl_abap_int_table=>tt_abap_int( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count ( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und wählen Sie für jede Gruppe einen zufälligen Flug aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_random_int` innerhalb der Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight ) ).

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_random_flights = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights BY ls_group-carrid
                                          GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                                          ( LET lv_max_index = lines( GROUP ls_group ) - 1
                                                lo_random = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = lv_max_index ) IN
                                            ( VALUE #( GROUP ls_group )[ lo_random->get_next( ) + 1 ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_random_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_random_flights ).
    " Check if there's exactly one flight per carrier that exists in SFLIGHT
    DATA(lt_carriers_in_sflight) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                                       FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_random_flights ) exp = lines( lt_carriers_in_sflight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_random_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( sflight[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate ] ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assuming SFLIGHT is not empty for this test.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_per_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_random_flights) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_per_carrier( ).
    " If SFLIGHT was empty, lt_random_flights should be empty.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen eindeutigen, zufälligen alphanumerischen Schlüssel (z.B. 8 Zeichen lang) für eine neue Entität.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in Kombination mit Zeichenkettenoperationen und einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 8
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_unique_key) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_key.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = lv_chars_len ).

    rv_unique_key = REDUCE string( INIT s = ''
                                   FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
                                   NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_key( ).
    DATA(lv_key) = lo_cut->generate_unique_key( 12 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_key ) exp = 12 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_key_uniqueness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_key( ).
    DATA(lt_generated_keys) = NEW cl_abap_string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_num_keys) = 100.

    DO lv_num_keys TIMES.
      APPEND lo_cut->generate_unique_key( 8 ) TO lt_generated_keys->*.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lt_unique_keys) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                               FOR ls_key IN lt_generated_keys->* ( ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_generated_keys->* ) exp = lines( lt_unique_keys ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_color DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             t_color    TYPE lvc_t_colo,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES tt_sflight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_colors_to_nodes
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_nodes TYPE tt_sflight_nodes
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes_with_colors) TYPE tt_sflight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_colors_to_nodes.
    rt_nodes_with_colors = VALUE tt_sflight_nodes( FOR ls_node IN it_flight_nodes
                                                  ( ls_node
                                                    t_color = COND lvc_t_colo(
                                                                WHEN ls_node-price > iv_price_threshold
                                                                THEN VALUE lvc_t_colo( ( fname = 'TEXT' col_int = 6 col_inv = 1 ) ) " Red color
                                                                ELSE VALUE lvc_t_colo( ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen aus SFLIGHT, aber fügen Sie jedem Preis vor der Berechnung einen kleinen zufälligen 'Rauschwert' hinzu (z.B. +/- 10% des Preises).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für den Rauschwert und `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_price_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_noisy_average_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_price_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_noisy_average_price.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight ) ).

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_percent) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = -10 max = 10 ). " +/- 10%

    DATA(lv_total_noisy_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ( ls_flight-price * ( 1 + lo_random_percent->get_next( ) / 100 ) ) ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_noisy_price / lines( lt_sflight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum und die Anzahl der verfügbaren Sitze (Capacity - Occupied) berechnet.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_available DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             avail_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_available IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid      = flight-carrid,
                             connid      = flight-connid,
                             fldate      = flight-fldate,
                             avail_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsmax > seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 180 ) ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Flugdatensatz aus `sflights` mittels Tabellenausdruck und kopieren Sie relevante Felder in eine neue Struktur. Modifizieren Sie ein Feld und fügen Sie es einer anderen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `sflights[ KEY ... ]` für den Tabellenzugriff und `CORRESPONDING` für das Kopieren von Feldern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA ls_flight_raw TYPE sflight.
    TRY.
        ls_flight_raw = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid, connid = iv_connid, fldate = iv_fldate ].

        DATA ls_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info.
        ls_flight_info = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight_raw MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid fldate = fldate ).
        ls_flight_info-status = 'Processed'.

        APPEND ls_flight_info TO rt_processed_flights.

      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle case where flight is not found
        MESSAGE 'Flight not found' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_access_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_access_flight.
    " Insert a dummy flight into sflight for testing
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 100 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_access( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Processed' ).

    " Test for non-existent flight
    DATA(lt_empty) = lo_cut->process_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_empty ).

    " Clean up dummy data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle, ohne explizite `READ TABLE` Anweisungen. In Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` können Daten effizient zwischen kompatiblen Strukturen oder Tabellen kopiert werden, wobei nur übereinstimmende Felder übertragen werden. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt modern über `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found`.
keywords: Table Expression, CORRESPONDING, LINE OF, Internal Tables, sflight

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge in `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Erstellen Sie eine Ergebnis-Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und Fluganzahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und den `GROUP SIZE` Zusatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                            flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    " Insert dummy data for testing
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_group( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).

    " Clean up dummy data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250102'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50, ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und performante Gruppierung von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle. Der Zusatz `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe, was Aggregationen stark vereinfacht und den Code lesbarer macht als manuelle Gruppierungslogik.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflight

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug einen Status ('Full', 'Almost Full', 'Available') zu, basierend auf der Auslastung (belegte Sitze im Verhältnis zur Kapazität). Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator.
hint: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung von Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING iv_seats_max TYPE sflight-seatsmax
                iv_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA lv_occupancy_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
    IF iv_seats_max > 0.
      lv_occupancy_rate = ( iv_seats_occ / iv_seats_max ) * 100.
    ELSE.
      lv_occupancy_rate = 0.
    ENDIF.

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 95 THEN 'Full'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 70 THEN 'Almost Full'
      ELSE 'Available' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_max = 200 iv_seats_occ = 195 ) exp = 'Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_max = 200 iv_seats_occ = 140 ) exp = 'Almost Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_max = 200 iv_seats_occ = 50 ) exp = 'Available' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_max = 0 iv_seats_occ = 0 ) exp = 'Available' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator (Conditional Expression) ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Anstatt einer `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Struktur kann der Wert direkt basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zugewiesen werden, was den Code kürzer und klarer macht.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expression, ELSE

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie eine Bonuspunktkategorie ('Short', 'Medium', 'Long', 'Unknown') für einen Flug basierend auf der Flugdistanz. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator.
hint: Der `SWITCH` Operator ist ideal für mehrere bedingte Zuweisungen basierend auf einem einzelnen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_bonus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_bonus_category
      IMPORTING iv_distance TYPE sflight-distance
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bonus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_bonus_category.
    rv_category = SWITCH string(
      iv_distance
      WHEN 0 TO 500  THEN 'Short'
      WHEN 501 TO 2000 THEN 'Medium'
      WHEN OTHERS     THEN 'Long' ).

    IF iv_distance < 0. " Example for an 'Unknown' case not covered by SWITCH OTHERS
      rv_category = 'Unknown'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_bonus_category( 300 ) exp = 'Short' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_bonus_category( 1500 ) exp = 'Medium' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_bonus_category( 3000 ) exp = 'Long' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_bonus_category( 500 ) exp = 'Short' ).

explanation: Der `SWITCH` Operator ist ein Konstruktorausdruck, der eine elegante Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF` oder `CASE` Anweisungen bietet, wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Er ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Bedingungen auf dem Wert einer einzelnen Variablen basieren. `OTHERS` dient als Fallback, ähnlich wie `ELSE`.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expression, OTHERS, ELSE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen reduzierten Flugpreis für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH'. Wenn es sich um 'LH' handelt, wird der Preis um 10% reduziert, ansonsten bleibt er gleich. Verwenden Sie den `IF` Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_flight_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
