Instructions: Erstelle eine abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_data_processor` mit einer abstrakten Methode `process_record` und einer konkreten Methode `process_data_table`, die eine interne Tabelle durchläuft und für jeden Eintrag `process_record` aufruft. Implementiere eine konkrete Unterklasse `zcl_sum_processor`, die Zahlen summiert.
hint: Die konkrete Methode in der Basisklasse iteriert über die Daten und ruft die abstrakte Methode auf. Nutze `FOR` für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    ABSTRACT METHODS process_record IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i.
    METHODS process_data_table IMPORTING it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sum_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_data_processor FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_record REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_sum TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_table.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(lv_value).
      process_record( lv_value ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_record.
    mv_sum = mv_sum + iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definiere eine Enumeration für die Priorität von Aufgaben (NIEDRIG, MITTEL, HOCH). Erstelle eine Methode, die eine Liste von Aufgaben nach ihrer Priorität sortiert.

CLASS zcl_task_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM task_priority,
             low,

             high,
           END OF ENUM task_priority.

             id       TYPE i,
             name     TYPE string,

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben, unter Verwendung von `JOIN` und Aggregatsfunktionen in Open SQL.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN`, `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in einer Open SQL-Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_agg_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_flight_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_agg_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_flight_carriers.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( s~carrid ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT( s~carrid ) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrier_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,

CLASS zcl_join_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flight_data.
    DATA lt_flights_source1 TYPE tt_combined_flight_data.
    DATA lt_flights_source2 TYPE tt_combined_flight_data.

    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, 'DB_SOURCE' AS source
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights_source1
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    " Simulate another source with different data or criteria
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, 'SIM_SOURCE' AS source
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights_source2
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_combined_data = VALUE #( BASE rt_combined_data (
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights_source1
      ( ls_flight ) )
      ( FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights_source2
      ( ls_flight ) )
    ).

    " Alternatively, if both SELECTs could be combined directly with UNION ALL:
    " SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, 'DB_SOURCE' AS source
    "   FROM sflights AS s
    "   INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
    "   UP TO 50 ROWS
    " UNION ALL
    " SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, 'SIM_SOURCE' AS source
    "   FROM sflights AS s
    "   INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
    "   WHERE s~cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
    "   UP TO 50 ROWS
    " INTO TABLE @rt_combined_data.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD export_with_styling.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights

    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xlsx->save_file(

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR ... IN` Schleife, um Daten aus `sflights` und `scarr` zu verarbeiten, die durch einen `JOIN` verbunden sind, und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit den Ergebnissen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN` mit einer `SELECT` Anweisung, die einen `JOIN` enthält, und `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_join_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carrier_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_carrier_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_carrier_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_carrier_details
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_flight_carrier_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_join_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_carrier_details.
    DATA lt_joined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_details = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN lt_raw_data
                           ( carrid    = ls_data-carrid,
                             carrname  = ls_data-carrname,
                             connid    = ls_data-connid,
                             fldate    = ls_data-fldate,
                             description = |Flug { ls_data-connid } von { ls_data-carrname } am { ls_data-fldate DATE = USER }|
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten in eine XLSX-Datei, wobei die zu exportierenden Spalten dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die Spaltennamen sollen als interne Tabelle übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Flexibilität von `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` und die Möglichkeit, eine interne Tabelle mit den gewünschten Spaltennamen zu übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflights-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflights-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename    TYPE string DEFAULT 'dynamic_columns.xlsx'
        it_column_names TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_columns.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).

    " Create a dynamic internal table with only the requested columns
    DATA lt_dynamic_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dynamic_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA lt_dynamic_data LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data.
    ASSIGN lt_dynamic_data->* TO <ft_dynamic_data>.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_dynamic_line) TYPE REF TO data.
      ASSIGN lr_dynamic_line->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

      " Dynamically assign values based on requested columns
      LOOP AT it_column_names INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " This part is simplified. In a real scenario, you'd build a dynamic structure
          " or use a more sophisticated way to map fields to the XLSX writer.
          " For cl_ehfnd_xlsx, it expects the internal table structure to match.
          " A more robust solution would involve building a dynamic internal table type.
          " For this example, we'll assume cl_ehfnd_xlsx can handle a subset of fields
          " if the i_table is passed with a structure that matches the requested columns.
          " However, cl_ehfnd_xlsx typically expects the full structure and filters internally.
          " Let's adjust to pass the full table and rely on cl_ehfnd_xlsx's internal filtering
          " or create a dynamic structure for the export.
          " For simplicity, we'll pass the full table and rely on cl_ehfnd_xlsx's ability to map.
          " A direct dynamic column selection for add_sheet_from_itab is not directly supported
          " by passing a list of column names. It expects the structure of i_table.
          " So, we need to build a dynamic internal table with only the selected columns.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      " This dynamic table creation is complex for a simple example.
      " A more practical approach for cl_ehfnd_xlsx is to filter the source ITAB first.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Re-thinking: cl_ehfnd_xlsx does not have a direct 'select columns' parameter.
    " The easiest way to achieve dynamic columns is to build a new internal table
    " with only the desired columns and then pass that to add_sheet_from_itab.
    " This requires dynamic internal table creation, which is advanced.
    " Let's simplify the 'dynamic' aspect to filtering the *display* of columns
    " if cl_ehfnd_xlsx supported it, or by pre-processing the ITAB.
    " Given the constraint, I will simulate dynamic column selection by creating
    " a new internal table with only the requested columns using dynamic programming.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_flights ).
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>t_component_table.

    LOOP AT it_column_names INTO DATA(lv_req_column).
      READ TABLE lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = lv_req_column.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_dynamic_type) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA lt_dynamic_data TYPE HANDLE lo_dynamic_type.
    ASSIGN lt_dynamic_data->* TO <ft_dynamic_data>.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO ls_flight.
      CREATE DATA lr_dynamic_line TYPE HANDLE lo_dynamic_type.
      ASSIGN lr_dynamic_line->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_value>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_target_value> = <fs_source_value>.
        ENDIF.
      END LOOP.
      APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <ft_dynamic_data>.
    END LOOP.

    lo_xlsx->add_sheet_from_itab(
      EXPORTING
        i_sheet_name = 'Dynamische Spalten'
        i_table      = <ft_dynamic_data>
    ).

    lo_xlsx->save_file(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_filename
        i_path     = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>gc_path_application
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_export_dynamic_columns FOR TESTING RAISING cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_export_dynamic_columns.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_dynamic_columns( ).
    DATA(lv_filename) = 'test_dynamic_columns.xlsx'.
    DATA(lt_columns) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).

    TRY.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Placeholder for successful execution check "
          msg = 'XLSX export with dynamic columns should complete without error' ).
      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man dynamisch die Spalten für einen XLSX-Export auswählen kann. Es wird eine neue interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit erstellt, deren Struktur nur die angeforderten Spalten enthält. Die Daten werden dann von der Quelltabelle in diese dynamische Tabelle kopiert. Dies erfordert den Einsatz von RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und Feldsymbolen, was ein fortgeschrittenes ABAP-Konzept ist. Die `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` Klasse kann dann diese dynamisch erstellte Tabelle verarbeiten.
keywords: XLSX, File Handling, cl_ehfnd_xlsx, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `FULL OUTER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `scarr` durch, um alle Flüge und alle Fluggesellschaften anzuzeigen, auch wenn keine Übereinstimmung gefunden wird. Verwenden Sie moderne Open SQL Syntax.
hint: Open SQL unterstützt `FULL OUTER JOIN` ab ABAP 7.55. Beachten Sie, dass die Ergebnisse NULL-Werte enthalten können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_full_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_full_join_data,
             s_carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             s_connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             s_fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             c_carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             c_carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_full_join_data.
    TYPES tt_full_join_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_full_join_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_full_outer_join_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_full_join_data) TYPE tt_full_join_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_full_outer_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_full_outer_join_data.
    SELECT s~carrid AS s_carrid, s~connid, s~fldate,
           c~carrid AS c_carrid, c~carrname
      FROM sflights AS s
      FULL OUTER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_full_join_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_full_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_full_outer_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_full_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_full_outer_join_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    " Check for entries where only sflights data exists (c_carrid is initial)
    DATA(lv_sflights_only_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_data) WHERE s_carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND c_carrid IS INITIAL.
      lv_sflights_only_count = lv_sflights_only_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for entries where only scarr data exists (s_carrid is initial)
    DATA(lv_scarr_only_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO ls_data WHERE s_carrid IS INITIAL AND c_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_scarr_only_count = lv_scarr_only_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that there are entries from both sides, potentially unmatched
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_sflights_only_count >= 0 ). " Can be 0 if all sflights have carriers
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_scarr_only_count >= 0 ).   " Can be 0 if all carriers have flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FULL OUTER JOIN` ist ein mächtiges Feature in Open SQL ab ABAP 7.55, das es ermöglicht, alle Zeilen aus beiden Tabellen zurückzugeben, auch wenn keine Übereinstimmung in der Join-Bedingung gefunden wird. Nicht übereinstimmende Spalten enthalten dann NULL-Werte. Dies ist nützlich für die Analyse von Datenbeziehungen, bei denen alle Einträge beider Seiten relevant sind.
keywords: JOIN, Open SQL, FULL OUTER JOIN, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.55

CLASS zcl_xlsx_cell_comment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_cell_comment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_with_comment.
    DATA lt_data TYPE tt_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
    <fs_data>-col1 = 'Wert 1'.
    <fs_data>-col2 = 'Wert 2'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_data ASSIGNING <fs_data>.
    <fs_data>-col1 = 'Wert 3'.

    lo_xlsx->add_sheet_from_itab(
      EXPORTING
        i_sheet_name = 'Daten mit Kommentar'
        i_table      = lt_data
    ).

    " Add a comment to cell B2 (row 2, column 2)
    lo_xlsx->set_cell_comment(
      i_sheet_name = 'Daten mit Kommentar'
      i_row        = 2
      i_column     = 2
      i_comment    = 'Dies ist ein wichtiger Kommentar zur Zelle B2.'
    ).

    lo_xlsx->save_file(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_filename
        i_path     = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>gc_path_application

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `scarr` durch und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem Mindestpreis.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `WHERE`-Klausel in der `SELECT`-Anweisung nach dem `JOIN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_with_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES tt_filtered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflights-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_with_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND s~price > @iv_min_price
      INTO TABLE @rt_filtered_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_with_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-price > 100 ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Filterbedingungen (`WHERE`-Klausel) direkt in einer Open SQL `SELECT`-Anweisung mit `INNER JOIN` anwendet. Dies ist die effizienteste Methode, um Daten zu filtern, da die Filterung auf der Datenbankebene erfolgt und nur die relevanten Daten an das ABAP-Programm übertragen werden. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: JOIN, Open SQL, WHERE, Filter, Internal Tables

Instructions: Exportieren Sie eine interne Tabelle in eine XLSX-Datei und setzen Sie die Breite einer bestimmten Spalte automatisch oder manuell.
hint: `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` bietet Methoden zur Spaltenbreitenanpassung, z.B. `set_column_width` oder `set_column_autofit`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_column_width DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             long_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_with_column_width
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'column_width.xlsx'
      RAISING
        cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_column_width IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_with_column_width.
    DATA lt_data TYPE tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Kurzer Text' long_text = 'Dies ist ein sehr langer Text, der die Spaltenbreite beeinflussen sollte.' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Noch kürzer' long_text = 'Ein weiterer langer Text, um die automatische Anpassung zu testen.' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).

    lo_xlsx->add_sheet_from_itab(
      EXPORTING
        i_sheet_name = 'Spaltenbreite'
        i_table      = lt_data
    ).

    " Set column 1 (ID) to a fixed width
    lo_xlsx->set_column_width( i_sheet_name = 'Spaltenbreite' i_column = 1 i_width = 10 ).

    " Autofit column 3 (LONG_TEXT)
    lo_xlsx->set_column_autofit( i_sheet_name = 'Spaltenbreite' i_column = 3 ).

    lo_xlsx->save_file(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_filename
        i_path     = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>gc_path_application
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_column_width( ).

    TRY.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Placeholder for successful execution check "
          msg = 'XLSX export with column width adjustment should complete without error' ).
      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Spaltenbreite in einer XLSX-Datei mit `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` anpassen kann. Die Methode `set_column_width` ermöglicht das Setzen einer festen Breite, während `set_column_autofit` die Breite automatisch an den Inhalt der Spalte anpasst. Instructions: Transformieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur die Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen kopiert werden. Nutzen Sie hierfür den modernen CORRESPONDING Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CORRESPONDING Operator für Strukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS transform_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_struct=>ty_source( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 field3 = 'World' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->transform_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field1 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 msg = 'Field2 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_x msg = 'Field_x should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine prägnante Syntax, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu verschieben, deren Feldnamen übereinstimmen. Dies ersetzt die ältere MOVE-CORRESPONDING Anweisung und ist besonders nützlich für die schnelle Datenanpassung.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, STRUCTURE, DATA TRANSFORMATION, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Quelltabelle in eine interne Zieltabelle, wobei die Tabellentypen teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen haben. Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING Operator mit der BASE-Ergänzung, um vorhandene Daten in der Zieltabelle zu erhalten und nur die übereinstimmenden Felder zu aktualisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CORRESPONDING Operator mit BASE für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    " Initialisiere Zieltabelle mit einigen Daten, die erhalten bleiben sollen
    rt_target = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' flight_date = '20250101' status = 'X' )
                         ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' flight_date = '20250102' status = 'Y' ) ).

    " Aktualisiere rt_target mit Daten aus it_source, nur übereinstimmende Felder
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( rt_target ) it_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_itab=>ty_source_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'Frankfurt' cityto = 'New York' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' cityfrom = 'Singapore' cityto = 'London' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target_result) = lo_cut->transform_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target_result ) exp = 4 msg = 'Should have 4 entries' ).

    " Check first entry (original + updated)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_result[ 1 ]-flight_date exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_result[ 1 ]-status exp = 'X' ).

    " Check third entry (new from source)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_target_result[ 3 ]-flight_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_target_result[ 3 ]-status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING Operator kann auch für interne Tabellen verwendet werden. Mit der BASE-Ergänzung (ab ABAP 7.40) können Sie eine Zieltabelle initialisieren oder vorhandene Daten beibehalten und nur die übereinstimmenden Felder aus der Quelltabelle hinzufügen oder aktualisieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Datenaggregation und -transformation.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, INTERNAL TABLES, DATA TRANSFORMATION, BASE, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null verhindert, indem sie eine benutzerdefinierte, klassenbasierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn der Divisor Null ist.
hint: Definieren Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme, die von CX_STATIC_CHECK erbt, und verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_divide_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_divide_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 msg = 'Division should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_division_by_zero was not raised' ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_division_by_zero caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Klassenbasierte Ausnahmen (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglichen eine strukturierte und typsichere Fehlerbehandlung. Durch das Erben von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` wird die Ausnahme als prüfbar deklariert, was bedeutet, dass der Aufrufer sie entweder behandeln oder weiterleiten muss. Dies verbessert die Robustheit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY CATCH, CUSTOM EXCEPTION, CLASS-BASED EXCEPTIONS, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme mit einer dynamisch generierten Fehlermeldung auslöst. Die Meldung soll aus einer Nachrichtenklasse stammen und Platzhalter verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ... MESSAGE ID ... NUMBER ... WITH ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      " Angenommen, Nachrichtenklasse ZMSG und Nachricht 001 existieren:
      " 001: Der Wert &1 ist ungültig. Er muss größer als &2 sein.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        MESSAGE ID 'ZMSG' NUMBER '001' WITH iv_value '0'.
    ENDIF.
    " Weitere Verarbeitung...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_negative_value_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_positive_value_no_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_negative_value_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_exception( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_value( -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception was not raised for negative value' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        " Überprüfen Sie die Meldung (Annahme: ZMSG 001 existiert)
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_exception->msgid exp = 'ZMSG' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_exception->msgno exp = '001' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_exception->msgv1 exp = '-5' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_exception->msgv2 exp = '0' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_positive_value_no_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_exception( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_value( 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'No exception raised for positive value' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception raised for positive value' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die MESSAGE-Ergänzung bei RAISE EXCEPTION (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht es, eine Ausnahme mit einer spezifischen, aus einer Nachrichtenklasse stammenden Meldung zu verknüpfen. Dies ist entscheidend für die Internationalisierung und die Bereitstellung aussagekräftiger Fehlermeldungen für den Endbenutzer.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, MESSAGE, EXCEPTION MESSAGE, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHTS in eine interne Tabelle, deren Struktur nicht exakt mit SFLIGHTS übereinstimmt. Verwenden Sie die SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE Anweisung, um nur die übereinstimmenden Felder zu übertragen.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...).
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             custom_field TYPE string,

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 5 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Internal table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrid should match' ).

Es werden automatisch nur die Felder übertragen, deren Namen in beiden Strukturen übereinstimmen, was manuelle Zuweisungen überflüssig macht und den Code sauberer hält.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Wenn ein Flug eine bestimmte Bedingung (z.B. zu viele belegte Sitze) erfüllt, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die den betroffenen Flug identifiziert. Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator mit einem FOR-Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie VALUE, FOR und RAISE EXCEPTION in einem funktionalen Kontext.
solution:
CLASS zcx_flight_overbooked DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE s_date READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_overbooked IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor( textid = textid ).
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
    mv_fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_flight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flight_table
      RAISING
        zcx_flight_overbooked.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flights.
    DATA(lv_dummy) = VALUE i(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( seatsocc > seatsmax )
      ( THROW zcx_flight_overbooked( iv_carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     iv_connid = ls_flight-connid
                                     iv_fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_overbooked_flight FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_flight_overbooked.
    METHODS test_normal_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_overbooked_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_processor=>ty_flight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_flights( lt_flights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_flight_overbooked was not raised' ).
      CATCH zcx_flight_overbooked INTO DATA(lx_overbooked).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_flight_overbooked caught as expected' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_overbooked->mv_carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_overbooked->mv_connid exp = '0400' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_overbooked->mv_fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_normal_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_processor=>ty_flight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_flights( lt_flights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'No exception raised for normal flights' ).
      CATCH zcx_flight_overbooked.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception raised' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus dem VALUE-Operator, FOR-Ausdrücken und der THROW-Anweisung (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, Ausnahmen direkt innerhalb funktionaler Ausdrücke auszulösen. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code, insbesondere bei der Validierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Die Ausnahme kann dabei zusätzliche Informationen über den Fehlerkontext mitgeben.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, RAISE EXCEPTION, INTERNAL TABLES, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, THROW, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, bei der die Feldnamen nicht übereinstimmen. Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING Operator mit der MAPPING-Ergänzung, um die Feldzuordnungen explizit zu definieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie CORRESPONDING mit MAPPING für explizite Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine 'resumable' Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein nicht-kritischer Fehler auftritt. Der Aufrufer soll die Möglichkeit haben, die Ausnahme zu behandeln und die Programmausführung fortzusetzen.
hint: Definieren Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme mit der RESUMABLE-Ergänzung.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_warning DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        iv_message TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_warning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor( textid = textid ).
    mv_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_item
      IMPORTING
        iv_item TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_item) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_resumable_warning.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_item.
    IF iv_item MOD 2 <> 0. " Wenn ungerade, Warnung auslösen
      RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_warning( iv_message = |Item { iv_item } is odd, but processing continues.| ).
    ENDIF.
    rv_processed_item = iv_item * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_resumable_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_resumable_warning.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resumable_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lv_result = lo_cut->process_item( 3 ). " Ungerade Zahl, löst resumable Ausnahme aus
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Resumable exception was not raised' ).
      CATCH zcx_resumable_warning INTO DATA(lx_warning).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( |Resumable exception caught: { lx_warning->mv_message }| ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_warning->mv_message exp = 'Item 3 is odd, but processing continues.' ).
        RESUME.
    ENDTRY.
    " Nach RESUME sollte die Ausführung hier fortgesetzt werden
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 6 msg = 'Processing should continue and result be correct' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->process_item( 4 ). " Gerade Zahl, keine Ausnahme
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 msg = 'Even number processing should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Resumable Exceptions (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglichen es, auf nicht-kritische Fehler zu reagieren, ohne die aktuelle Verarbeitung abzubrechen. Nach dem Fangen einer resumable Ausnahme kann der Code im CATCH-Block ausgeführt und anschließend mit der RESUME-Anweisung die Programmausführung an der Stelle fortgesetzt werden, an der die Ausnahme ausgelöst wurde. Dies ist ideal für Warnungen oder Fehler, die eine Korrektur oder Protokollierung erfordern, aber keinen Abbruch rechtfertigen.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, RESUMABLE, TRY CATCH, ERROR RECOVERY, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln. Nutzen Sie hierfür den REDUCE-Operator und den CORRESPONDING Operator, um die Aggregationsergebnisse in eine Zielstruktur zu übertragen.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit BASE und CORRESPONDING für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES ty_flight_summary_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summary = REDUCE ty_flight_summary_table(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_flight_summary_table( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( LET current_carrid = ls_flight-carrid IN
          result = VALUE #( BASE result
                             ( CORRESPONDING ty_flight_summary(
                                 carrid = current_carrid
                                 total_seats_occupied = REDUCE i(
                                   INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_group_flight-seatsocc )
                             ) )
                           ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary msg = 'Summary table should not be empty' ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob LH in der Zusammenfassung ist und einen Wert hat
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_reduce_corresponding=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats_occupied msg = 'LH total seats should be calculated' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'LH not found in summary' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Weitere Prüfungen für andere Fluggesellschaften oder Gesamtanzahl der Einträge
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und deklarativen Weise. In Kombination mit FOR GROUPS OF und dem CORRESPONDING Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) können Sie gruppierte Daten effizient verarbeiten und die Ergebnisse direkt in eine Zielstruktur oder -tabelle überführen, was zu sehr kompaktem und leistungsstarkem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, CORRESPONDING, AGGREGATION, INTERNAL TABLES, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen kritischen Fehler in einer Methode, der eine Ausnahme auslöst. Implementieren Sie im aufrufenden Code einen CLEANUP-Block, um sicherzustellen, dass vor der Fehlerbehandlung oder -weiterleitung notwendige Aufräumarbeiten (z.B. das Zurücksetzen eines Status) durchgeführt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP...ENDTRY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cleanup_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS perform_critical_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

    METHODS reset_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cleanup_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_critical_operation.
    mv_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.
    mv_status = 'COMPLETED'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reset_status.
    mv_status = 'RESET'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_critical_operation_with_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_critical_operation_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_critical_operation_with_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cleanup_example( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_critical_operation( 0 ). " Löst Ausnahme aus
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
      CLEANUP.
        lo_cut->reset_status( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_status exp = 'RESET' msg = 'Status should be reset in CLEANUP' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_critical_operation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cleanup_example( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_critical_operation( 1 ). " Erfolgreiche Ausführung
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_status exp = 'COMPLETED' msg = 'Status should be completed' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception raised' ).
      CLEANUP.
        " CLEANUP wird auch bei erfolgreicher Ausführung aufgerufen
        lo_cut->reset_status( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_status exp = 'RESET' msg = 'Status should be reset after success' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CLEANUP-Block (ab ABAP 7.40) in einer TRY...CATCH...ENDTRY-Struktur stellt sicher, dass bestimmte Aufräumarbeiten immer ausgeführt werden, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt und gefangen wird oder nicht. Dies ist entscheidend für die Konsistenz von Daten und Ressourcen, z.B. um Sperren freizugeben, temporäre Daten zu löschen oder Status zurückzusetzen, bevor die Fehlerbehandlung abgeschlossen ist oder die Ausnahme weitergeleitet wird.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, CLEANUP, TRY CATCH, RESOURCE MANAGEMENT, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere durch, wobei die Zieltabellenzeilen mit einem Initialwert vorbelegt und dann mit den übereinstimmenden Feldern der Quelltabelle aktualisiert werden. Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING Operator mit der BASE-Ergänzung und einem VALUE-Konstruktor.
hint: Kombinieren Sie VALUE, BASE und CORRESPONDING für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_value_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE f,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             value TYPE f,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_with_base
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_value_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_with_base.
    rt_target = VALUE ty_target_table(
      FOR ls_source IN it_source
      ( CORRESPONDING ty_target_line(
          BASE VALUE ty_target_line( description = 'Default Description' status = 'N' )
          ls_source MAPPING name TO description
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert den VALUE-Operator mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und dem CORRESPONDING Operator mit BASE und MAPPING (ab ABAP 7.40/7.50). Dies ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Jede Zeile der Zieltabelle wird zunächst mit einem Standardwert initialisiert (BASE VALUE), dann werden die übereinstimmenden Felder aus der Quelltabelle kopiert, wobei auch Feldnamen explizit umbenannt werden können (MAPPING).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Wenn eine Zahl außerhalb eines gültigen Bereichs liegt, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die die ungültige Zahl und den gültigen Bereich enthält. Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator, um gültige Zahlen zu filtern, und RAISE EXCEPTION für ungültige.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER, um gültige Elemente zu isolieren, und THROW für die Ausnahmebehandlung bei ungültigen Elementen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_range DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_min TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_max TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        iv_value TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_min TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_max TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor( textid = textid ).
    mv_value = iv_value.
    mv_min = iv_min.
    mv_max = iv_max.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min     TYPE i
        iv_max     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_numbers.
    rt_valid_numbers = FILTER #( it_numbers EXCEPT IN it_numbers
                                  WHERE ( table_line < iv_min OR table_line > iv_max )
                                  ( THROW zcx_invalid_range( iv_value = table_line
                                                             iv_min = iv_min
                                                             iv_max = iv_max ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_number_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 5 ) ( 10 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->validate_numbers( it_numbers = lt_input iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_number_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 15 ) ( 10 ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_numbers( it_numbers = lt_input iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_invalid_range was not raised' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_range INTO DATA(lx_range).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_invalid_range caught as expected' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_range->mv_value exp = 15 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_range->mv_min exp = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_range->mv_max exp = 10 ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht das Filtern von internen Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen. In Kombination mit der EXCEPT IN-Klausel und der THROW-Anweisung (ab ABAP 7.50) kann man Elemente, die eine Bedingung nicht erfüllen, direkt in einer Ausnahme verpacken. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu validieren und Fehler zu behandeln, indem man die Logik für gültige und ungültige Fälle klar trennt.
keywords: FILTER, RAISE EXCEPTION, THROW, INTERNAL TABLES, VALIDATION, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS liest und diese in eine interne Tabelle mit einer komplexeren Struktur transformiert. Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING Operator innerhalb eines FOR-Ausdrucks, um die Transformation zeilenweise durchzuführen und dabei zusätzliche Felder zu berechnen oder zu initialisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR, CORRESPONDING und VALUE für zeilenweise Transformationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             occupied_seats TYPE i,
             max_seats TYPE i,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES ty_flight_detail_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_detailed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_details) TYPE ty_flight_detail_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_detailed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_details = VALUE ty_flight_detail_table(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( CORRESPONDING ty_flight_detail(
          ls_sflight MAPPING carrid TO carrier_id
                                 fldate TO flight_date
                                 seatsocc TO occupied_seats
                                 seatsmax TO max_seats
        )
        occupancy_rate = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0
                                 THEN ( ls_sflight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax
                                 ELSE 0 )
        status_text = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc > ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN 'OVERBOOKED'
                              WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN 'FULL'
                              WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc > ls_sflight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'HIGH'
                              ELSE 'LOW' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_detailed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_detailed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_cut->get_detailed_flights( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_details msg = 'Detailed flights table should not be empty' ).

    DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_details[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-carrier_id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-connection_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-flight_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-occupied_seats ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-max_seats ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_first_flight-occupancy_rate >= 0 AND ls_first_flight-occupancy_rate <= 100 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-status_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt die Kombination aus dem VALUE-Operator, FOR-Ausdrücken und dem CORRESPONDING Operator (ab ABAP 7.40/7.55) für eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Innerhalb des FOR-Ausdrucks wird jede Quellzeile verarbeitet, wobei CORRESPONDING die Feldzuordnung übernimmt und zusätzliche Felder wie 'occupancy_rate' und 'status_text' direkt berechnet oder mit COND-Ausdrücken (ab ABAP 7.40) belegt werden können. Dies führt zu sehr expressivem und wartbarem Code für komplexe Datenanreicherungen.
keywords: FOR, CORRESPONDING, VALUE, INTERNAL TABLES, DATA TRANSFORMATION, COND, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Benutzernamen validiert. Wenn ein Benutzername ungültige Zeichen enthält, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die den ungültigen Benutzernamen und die erlaubten Zeichen angibt. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Fehlermeldung.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates für dynamische Fehlermeldungen und RAISE EXCEPTION.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_username DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_username TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_allowed_chars TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        iv_username TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_allowed_chars TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_username IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor( textid = textid ).
    mv_username = iv_username.
    mv_allowed_chars = iv_allowed_chars.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_user_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_username
      IMPORTING
        iv_username TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_username.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_user_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_username.
    DATA(lv_allowed_chars) = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_'.
    DATA(lv_invalid_char_found) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT iv_username INTO DATA(lv_char).
      IF NOT lv_allowed_chars CS lv_char.
        lv_invalid_char_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_invalid_char_found = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_username(
        iv_username = iv_username,
        iv_allowed_chars = lv_allowed_chars,
        textid = VALUE scx_t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '002' " Annahme: ZMSG 002: Benutzername '&1' enthält ungültige Zeichen. Erlaubt sind: '&2'.
                                   attr1 = 'MV_USERNAME' attr2 = 'MV_ALLOWED_CHARS' )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String, der Flugdaten (basierend auf der Struktur von SFLIGHT) enthält, und extrahieren Sie spezifische Felder in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des XML und XPath-Ausdrücke, um die Knoten zu finden und Daten zu extrahieren.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_flights.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

        DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
        DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

        LOOP AT lt_flight_nodes INTO DATA(lo_flight_node).
          DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight(
            carrid   = lo_flight_node->find_node( 'Carrid' )->get_value( )
            connid   = lo_flight_node->find_node( 'Connid' )->get_value( )
            fldate   = lo_flight_node->find_node( 'Fldate' )->get_value( )
            price    = lo_flight_node->find_node( 'Price' )->get_value( )
            currency = lo_flight_node->find_node( 'Currency' )->get_value( )
          ).
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_not_found.
        " Handle error appropriately, e.g., log it
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Erstellen des Dokuments und der Knoten, dann `render_2_string` zur Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flights_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flights_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'Carrid' iv_value = ls_flight-carrid )->append_to_parent( ).
      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'Connid' iv_value = ls_flight-connid )->append_to_parent( ).
      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'Fldate' iv_value = ls_flight-fldate )->append_to_parent( ).
      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'Price' iv_value = ls_flight-price )->append_to_parent( ).
      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'Currency' iv_value = ls_flight-currency )->append_to_parent( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING o_string = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie einen XML-String, finden Sie einen spezifischen Knoten (z.B. einen Flugpreis) und aktualisieren Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie XPath, um den Knoten zu lokalisieren, und `set_value`, um den Wert zu ändern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_modify_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid     TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate     TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price  TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_modify_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

        DATA(lv_xpath) = |
          /Flights/Flight[
            Carrid='{ iv_carrid }' and
            Connid='{ iv_connid }' and
            Fldate='{ iv_fldate }'
          ]/Price
        |.

        DATA(lo_price_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( lv_xpath ).

        IF lo_price_node IS BOUND.
          lo_price_node->set_value( iv_new_price ).
          lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING o_string = rv_updated_xml ).
        ELSE.
          rv_updated_xml = iv_xml_string. " Node not found, return original XML
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_not_found.
        rv_updated_xml = iv_xml_string. " Error, return original XML
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_price.
    DATA(lv_xml_string) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><Flights><Flight><Carrid>LH</Carrid><Connid>0400</Connid><Fldate>20250101</Fldate><Price>123.45</Price><Currency>EUR</Currency></Flight></Flights>`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_modify_node( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_xml) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_xml_string = lv_xml_string iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_new_price = '99.99' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_updated_xml exp = '<Price>99.99</Price>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_updated_xml exp = '<Price>123.45</Price>' ).

    DATA(lv_xml_no_change) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_xml_string = lv_xml_string iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '0000' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_new_price = '1.00' ).

Es verwendet String-Templates (`|...|`) zur dynamischen Erstellung von XPath-Ausdrücken, um einen spezifischen Knoten zu finden. Nach dem Auffinden wird der Wert des Knotens mit `set_value` aktualisiert. Die Methode `find_node` ist effizient für die gezielte Knotensuche.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener XML-String eine minimale erwartete Struktur aufweist (z.B. das Vorhandensein eines Root-Elements und bestimmter Kindknoten).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und prüfen Sie die Existenz von Knoten mit `find_node` oder `get_elements_by_tag_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_validate_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_validate_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

        DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
        IF lo_root IS NOT BOUND OR lo_root->get_name( ) <> 'Flights'.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).
        IF lines( lt_flight_nodes ) = 0.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_flight_nodes INTO DATA(lo_flight_node).
          IF lo_flight_node->find_node( 'Carrid' ) IS NOT BOUND OR
             lo_flight_node->find_node( 'Connid' ) IS NOT BOUND OR
             lo_flight_node->find_node( 'Fldate' ) IS NOT BOUND.
            rv_is_valid = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_is_valid = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_not_found.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_validate_flight_xml FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_invalid_root_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><Data><Flight><Carrid>LH</Carrid><Connid>0400</Connid><Fldate>20250101</Fldate></Flight></Data>`.
    DATA(lv_missing_node_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><Flights><Flight><Carrid>LH</Carrid><Connid>0400</Connid></Flight></Flights>`.
    DATA(lv_empty_flights_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><Flights></Flights>`.

Die Verwendung von `get_document_element` und `find_node` in Kombination mit `IS BOUND` ist eine moderne und robuste Methode, um die Existenz von XML-Elementen zu überprüfen, ohne auf Fehler zu laufen.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String, der Namespaces verwendet, und extrahieren Sie Daten korrekt.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_namespaced_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_extracted_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_namespaced_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

        " Register namespace for XPath
        lo_xml_document->set_namespace_for_prefix( iv_prefix = 'ns' iv_namespace = 'http://www.example.com/flights' ).

        DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( '/ns:Flights/ns:Flight/ns:Carrid' ).

        IF lo_node IS BOUND.
          rv_extracted_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_not_found.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_parse_namespaced_xml.
    DATA(lv_xml_string) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><ns:Flights xmlns:ns="http://www.example.com/flights"><ns:Flight><ns:Carrid>LH</ns:Carrid><ns:Connid>0400</ns:Connid></ns:Flight></ns:Flights>`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_namespace_parse( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->parse_namespaced_xml( lv_xml_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lv_xml_no_namespace) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><Flights><Flight><Carrid>LH</Carrid><Connid>0400</Connid></Flight></Flights>`.
    DATA(lv_result_no_ns) = lo_cut->parse_namespaced_xml( lv_xml_no_namespace ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result_no_ns ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht es, qualifizierte Namen in XPath zu verwenden (z.B. `ns:Carrid`) und somit korrekt auf Elemente in einem bestimmten Namespace zuzugreifen. Dies ist entscheidend für die Verarbeitung komplexer XML-Strukturen.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_regex_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-submatch TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_replace_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_date_format
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_replace_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_date_format.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_regex_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    rv_modified_text = lo_matcher->replace_all( replacement = `$3.$2.$1` ).

CLASS zcl_regex_split_multi_delim IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem log-ähnlichen String alle Schlüssel-Wert-Paare, wobei Schlüssel alphanumerisch sind und Werte in Anführungszeichen stehen oder einfache Zahlen sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit Capturing Groups, um sowohl Schlüssel als auch Wert zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_key_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_value,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_value.
    TYPES: tt_key_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_pairs
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_pairs) TYPE tt_key_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_key_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_pairs.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|(\d+))`.
    " Group 1: Key (alphanumeric)
    " Group 2: Value in quotes (non-greedy)
    " Group 3: Numeric value

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_regex_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_string ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      DATA(ls_pair) = VALUE ty_key_value(
        key = ls_match-submatches[1]
      ).
      IF ls_match-submatches[2] IS NOT INITIAL.
        ls_pair-value = ls_match-submatches[2].
      ELSEIF ls_match-submatches[3] IS NOT INITIAL.
        ls_pair-value = ls_match-submatches[3].
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_pair TO rt_pairs.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der Regex verwendet nicht-fangende Gruppen (`(?:...)`) und alternative Muster (`|`), um entweder in Anführungszeichen eingeschlossene Strings oder Zahlen als Werte zu matchen. `find_all` und der Zugriff auf `submatches` ermöglichen die präzise Extraktion der einzelnen Komponenten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein komplexes XML-Dokument mit verschachtelten Elementen und Attributen aus einer internen Tabelle, die hierarchische Daten darstellt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_xml_document` und verschachtelte Schleifen, um die hierarchische Struktur abzubilden. Verwenden Sie `create_attribute` und `set_attribute_node`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
             quantity  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id TYPE string,
             customer TYPE string,
             order_date TYPE s_date,
             items    TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_order.
    TYPES: tt_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_orders_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_orders TYPE tt_orders
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_orders_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Orders' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_orders INTO DATA(ls_order).
      DATA(lo_order_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Order' ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_order_node ).

      lo_order_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'OrderID' iv_value = ls_order-order_id )->append_to_parent( ).
      lo_order_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'Customer' iv_value = ls_order-customer )->append_to_parent( ).
      lo_order_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'OrderDate' iv_value = ls_order-order_date )->append_to_parent( ).

      DATA(lo_items_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Items' ).
      lo_order_node->append_child( lo_items_node ).

      LOOP AT ls_order-items INTO DATA(ls_item).
        DATA(lo_item_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Item' ).
        lo_items_node->append_child( lo_item_node ).

        DATA(lo_attr_id) = lo_xml_document->create_attribute( iv_name = 'id' iv_value = ls_item-item_id ).
        lo_item_node->set_attribute_node( lo_attr_id ).

        lo_item_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'Description' iv_value = ls_item-description )->append_to_parent( ).
        lo_item_node->create_element_and_value( iv_name = 'Quantity' iv_value = ls_item-quantity )->append_to_parent( ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING o_string = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_orders_xml.
    DATA: lt_orders TYPE zcl_xml_create_complex=>tt_orders,
          lt_items1 TYPE zcl_xml_create_complex=>tt_items,

    APPEND VALUE #( item_id = 'A1' description = 'Laptop' quantity = 1 ) TO lt_items1.
