Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Attributwerte eines bestimmten Elements aus einem XML-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und XPath, um das Element zu finden, dann iterieren Sie über dessen Attribute.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_extract_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_element_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_extract_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_element_attributes.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

        DATA(lo_element_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( iv_xpath ).

        IF lo_element_node IS BOUND.
          DATA(lt_attribute_nodes) = lo_element_node->get_attributes( ).
          LOOP AT lt_attribute_nodes INTO DATA(lo_attribute_node).
            APPEND VALUE ty_attribute(
              name = lo_attribute_node->get_name( )
              value = lo_attribute_node->get_value( )
            ) TO rt_attributes.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_not_found.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_xml_string) = `<?xml version="1.0"?><Root><Data id="123" type="test" status="active"></Data><OtherData></OtherData></Root>`.

    DATA(lt_attrs) = lo_cut->extract_element_attributes( iv_xml_string = lv_xml_string iv_xpath = '/Root/Data' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_attrs ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attrs[ 1 ]-name exp = 'id' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attrs[ 1 ]-value exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attrs[ 2 ]-name exp = 'type' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attrs[ 2 ]-value exp = 'test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attrs[ 3 ]-name exp = 'status' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attrs[ 3 ]-value exp = 'active' ).

    DATA(lt_no_attrs) = lo_cut->extract_element_attributes( iv_xml_string = lv_xml_string iv_xpath = '/Root/OtherData' ).

Nach dem Auffinden des Elements mittels XPath (`find_node`) wird die Methode `get_attributes` verwendet, um eine Liste aller Attribute dieses Knotens zu erhalten. Eine Schleife über diese Attribute ermöglicht dann den Zugriff auf deren Namen (`get_name`) und Werte (`get_value`). Instructions: Löschen Sie ein spezifisches Element aus einem XML-Dokument basierend auf einem XPath-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und `find_node` gefolgt von `remove_child` des übergeordneten Knotens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_delete_element DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_element_by_xpath
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_delete_element IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_element_by_xpath.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

        DATA(lo_node_to_delete) = lo_xml_document->find_node( iv_xpath ).

        IF lo_node_to_delete IS BOUND.
          DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_node_to_delete->get_parent( ).
          IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.
            lo_parent_node->remove_child( lo_node_to_delete ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING o_string = rv_modified_xml ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_not_found.
        rv_modified_xml = iv_xml_string. " Error, return original XML
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_element_by_xpath FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_element_by_xpath.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_delete_element( ).
    DATA(lv_xml_string) = `<?xml version="1.0"?><Root><Data id="123"></Data><OtherData></OtherData></Root>`.

    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_cut->delete_element_by_xpath( iv_xml_string = lv_xml_string iv_xpath = '/Root/Data' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Data id="123">' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<OtherData>' ).

    DATA(lv_xml_no_change) = lo_cut->delete_element_by_xpath( iv_xml_string = lv_xml_string iv_xpath = '/Root/NonExistent' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_xml_no_change exp = lv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt das Löschen eines spezifischen XML-Elements. Zuerst wird das zu löschende Element mit `find_node` lokalisiert. Dann wird der übergeordnete Knoten des Elements mit `get_parent` ermittelt. Schließlich wird das Element mit `remove_child` vom übergeordneten Knoten entfernt. Dies ist eine präzise Methode zur Manipulation der XML-Struktur.
keywords: XML, Delete, Element, cl_xml_document, XPath, Node

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Preise zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_sum_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_sum_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA(lv_actual_price) TYPE sflight-price.

    " Ermittle die erwartete Summe direkt aus der Datenbank für Vergleichszwecke
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_price WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

    lv_actual_price = lo_cut->sum_flight_prices( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Summe der Flugpreise für AA ist korrekt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und deklarative Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Hier wird die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft berechnet, ohne explizite Schleifen, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller eindeutigen Fluggesellschaftsnamen aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer lokalen Hash-Tabelle zur Verwaltung der Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_unique_carrids TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
           unique_carrids = lt_unique_carrids
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid IN
      WHERE ( NOT line_exists( unique_carrids[ table_line = lv_carrid ] ) )
      NEXT unique_carrids = VALUE #( BASE unique_carrids ( lv_carrid ) )
           result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN lv_carrid ELSE |{ result }, { lv_carrid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_unique_carriers( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_list) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_list) TYPE string.
    DATA: lt_carrids TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_carrids.
    LOOP AT lt_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      IF lv_expected_list IS INITIAL.
        lv_expected_list = lv_carrid.
      ELSE.
        lv_expected_list = |{ lv_expected_list }, { lv_carrid }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_list exp = lv_expected_list msg = 'Liste der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften ist korrekt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `REDUCE`, um eine Liste eindeutiger Werte zu sammeln und gleichzeitig zu einem String zu verketten. Die `WHERE`-Klausel und die Akkumulation in einer Hash-Tabelle stellen sicher, dass nur neue Werte verarbeitet werden, was eine effiziente Methode zur Deduplizierung und String-Konstruktion darstellt.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, Unique, sflights, Concatenation

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

  METHOD test_display_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_basic_display( ).
    " Da cl_salv_table UI-Interaktion beinhaltet, kann der Display-Aufruf

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flüge aus `sflights` an, aber blenden Sie die Spalte 'PLANETYPE' aus und setzen Sie 'CARRID' an die erste Position.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden des `cl_salv_columns_list`-Objekts, das Sie über `get_columns()` erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_column_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_custom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_column_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_custom.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    DATA: lo_columns TYPE REF TO cl_salv_columns_list.
    DATA: lo_column TYPE REF TO cl_salv_column.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
                                CHANGING  t_table      = lt_sflights ).

        lo_columns = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).

        " Spalte 'PLANETYPE' ausblenden
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( 'PLANETYPE' ).
        lo_column->set_visible( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>false ).

        " Spalte 'CARRID' an erste Position setzen
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column->set_position( 1 ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die von 'FRANKFURT' nach 'NEW YORK' gehen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um die interne Tabelle zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_route
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_route.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom AND cityto = iv_cityto ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den um 10% erhöhten Preis enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transform_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             price_inc TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                      ( carrid    = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                        connid    = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                        price_inc = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.1' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_transform_data( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flight_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_actual_transformed msg = 'Transformierte Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    IF lines( lt_actual_transformed ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_actual_transformed[ 1 ].
      DATA(ls_original_sflight) TYPE sflight.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_original_sflight WHERE carrid = ls_first_entry-carrid AND connid = ls_first_entry-connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-price_inc exp = ls_original_sflight-price * '1.1' msg = 'Preis wurde korrekt um 10% erhöht' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ist ideal für die Transformation und Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, Daten aus einer Quelltabelle zu iterieren und in einer neuen Struktur zu sammeln, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie viele Flüge jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflights` anbietet, und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Map (Hash-Tabelle).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Hash-Tabelle als Akkumulator, um die Zählungen pro Fluggesellschaft zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_counts TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_counts = REDUCE ty_carrier_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_carrier_counts( )
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT counts = VALUE #( BASE counts ( key <fs_sflight>-carrid value = counts[ <fs_sflight>-carrid ] + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flüge aus `sflights` an und implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für Doppelklick auf eine Zeile, um eine Meldung mit der Flugnummer anzuzeigen.
hint: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für `cl_salv_events_list=>if_salv_events_list~double_click` und verwenden Sie eine lokale Klasse für das Event-Handling.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_event.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FOR EVENTS double_click OF cl_salv_events_list.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_salv_events_list
          IMPORTING
            e_row
            e_column.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_double_click.
        DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
        DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

        " Daten aus dem ALV-Grid holen (hier vereinfacht)
        " In einem echten Szenario würde man die Daten über das ALV-Objekt abrufen
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

        READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX e_row INTO ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          MESSAGE |Flugnummer: { ls_sflight-connid }| TYPE 'I'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_event.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lo_events TYPE REF TO cl_salv_events_list.
    DATA: lo_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = mo_salv_table
                                CHANGING  t_table      = lt_sflights ).

        lo_events = mo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).
        CREATE OBJECT lo_event_handler.
        SET HANDLER lo_event_handler->on_double_click FOR lo_events.

        mo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer Map (Fluggesellschaft -> Durchschnittspreis).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Map, die sowohl die Summe der Preise als auch die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft speichert, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES: ty_avg_prices TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES: ty_result_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-price WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE ty_result_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_intermediate_stats TYPE ty_avg_prices.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    lt_intermediate_stats = REDUCE ty_avg_prices(
      INIT stats = VALUE ty_avg_prices( )
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid IN
      NEXT stats = VALUE #( BASE stats ( key lv_carrid
                                         value = VALUE ty_carrier_stats( total_price = stats[ lv_carrid ]-total_price + <fs_sflight>-price
                                                                         flight_count = stats[ lv_carrid ]-flight_count + 1 ) ) )
    ).

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR <fs_stat> IN lt_intermediate_stats
                             ( key <fs_stat>-table_line value = <fs_stat>-total_price / <fs_stat>-flight_count ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_avg_price_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_price_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_avg_prices) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_price_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_expected_avg_prices) TYPE zcl_red_avg_price=>ty_result_map.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_temp_stats TYPE zcl_red_avg_price=>ty_avg_prices.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      ASSIGN lt_temp_stats[ KEY table_line = ls_sflight-carrid ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_stat>).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        INSERT VALUE #( table_line = ls_sflight-carrid total_price = ls_sflight-price flight_count = 1 ) INTO TABLE lt_temp_stats ASSIGNING <fs_stat>.
      ELSE.
        <fs_stat>-total_price = <fs_stat>-total_price + ls_sflight-price.
        <fs_stat>-flight_count = <fs_stat>-flight_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_temp_stats INTO DATA(ls_temp_stat).
      INSERT VALUE #( key ls_temp_stat-table_line value = ls_temp_stat-total_price / ls_temp_stat-flight_count ) INTO TABLE lt_expected_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_avg_prices ) exp = lines( lt_expected_avg_prices ) msg = 'Anzahl der Fluggesellschaften mit Durchschnittspreis ist korrekt' ).
    LOOP AT lt_expected_avg_prices ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_expected>).
      DATA(lv_carrid) = <fs_expected>-table_line.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_avg_prices[ lv_carrid ] exp = <fs_expected>-table_line tolerance = '0.01' msg = |Durchschnittspreis für { lv_carrid } ist korrekt| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine komplexe Aggregation mit `REDUCE`, bei der Zwischenergebnisse (Gesamtpreis und Anzahl der Flüge) in einer Map gesammelt werden, um anschließend den Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um aggregierte Daten aus internen Tabellen zu gewinnen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Average, Map, sflights

CLASS zcl_salv_layout_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 enthält. Für diese Flüge soll der Preis um 5% reduziert werden, ansonsten bleibt der Preis unverändert.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `VALUE` für bedingte Transformationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_adjusted,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_adjusted.
    TYPES: tt_flight_adjusted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_adjusted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_adjusted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_flight_adjusted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_adjusted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( <fs_sflight>-price > 500 )
                                   ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                     connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                     fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                                     price  = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-price > 500 THEN <fs_sflight>-price * '0.95'
                                                      ELSE <fs_sflight>-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_adjusted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjusted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_adjusted) = lo_cut->get_adjusted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_actual_adjusted msg = 'Angepasste Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    LOOP AT lt_actual_adjusted INTO DATA(ls_adjusted_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_adjusted_flight-price > 500 * '0.95' ) msg = 'Preis sollte über 500 (reduziert) sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_adjusted_flight-price < 500 ) msg = 'Preis sollte reduziert sein' ).
      " Überprüfen Sie, ob der Preis korrekt reduziert wurde
      DATA(lv_original_price) TYPE sflight-price.
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO lv_original_price WHERE carrid = ls_adjusted_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_adjusted_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_adjusted_flight-fldate.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_adjusted_flight-price exp = lv_original_price * '0.95' tolerance = '0.01' msg = 'Preis korrekt um 5% reduziert' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel zum Filtern und dem `COND`-Operator für bedingte Zuweisungen innerhalb der Transformation. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Verarbeitung von internen Tabellen, bei der Filterung und Transformation in einem Schritt erfolgen.
keywords: FOR, COND, VALUE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit einer Inline-Deklaration für die Gruppenschlüssel und den `GROUP SIZE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Simulate sflight data for demonstration
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '9300'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                             ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      DATA(ls_flight_count) = VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
                                                     flight_count = GROUP SIZE ).
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'LH count incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'AA count incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_ua) WITH KEY carrid = 'UA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'UA count incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ermöglicht eine elegante und performante Gruppierung von Daten direkt in der Schleife. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Syntax für Datenaggregation.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Group Size, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Bild von einem Format (z.B. BMP) in ein anderes (z.B. JPEG) unter Verwendung der `cl_igs_image_converter` Klasse. Überprüfen Sie, ob die Konvertierung erfolgreich war.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `convert_image` der Klasse `cl_igs_image_converter`. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie gültige Bilddaten als XSTRING bereitstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_converter_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_bmp_to_jpeg
      IMPORTING
        iv_bmp_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_jpeg_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_igs_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_converter_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_bmp_to_jpeg.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW cl_igs_image_converter( ).

    rv_jpeg_xstring = lo_converter->convert_image(
      i_image_xstring  = iv_bmp_xstring
      i_image_type_in  = cl_igs_image_converter=>c_image_type_bmp
      i_image_type_out = cl_igs_image_converter=>c_image_type_jpeg
    ).

    IF rv_jpeg_xstring IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_igs_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Image conversion failed'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_image_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_image_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_image_converter_example( ).
    " Minimal valid BMP header for a 1x1 pixel image (white)
    DATA(lv_bmp_data) = '424D3A0000000000000036000000280000000100000001000000010018000000000004000000C40E0000C40E00000000000000000000FF0000'.
    DATA(lv_jpeg_data) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lv_jpeg_data = lo_cut->convert_bmp_to_jpeg( lv_bmp_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_jpeg_data IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'Converted JPEG should not be initial' ).
        " Further checks could involve checking the first few bytes for JPEG signature (FF D8 FF E0/E1)
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_jpeg_data(2) exp = 'FFD8' msg = 'Output is not a JPEG' ).
      CATCH cx_igs_error INTO DATA(lx_igs_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_igs_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_igs_image_converter` ist Teil des Internet Graphics Service (IGS) und ermöglicht die serverseitige Konvertierung von Bildern. Die Verwendung ist direkt und erfordert die Übergabe von Bilddaten als XSTRING sowie die Angabe der Quell- und Zielformate. Fehlerbehandlung ist wichtig, da die Konvertierung fehlschlagen kann.
keywords: cl_igs_image_converter, Image Conversion, XSTRING, IGS, Error Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CONNID) aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' enthält. Nutzen Sie eine `FOR` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_lh_connids
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (SEATSOCC) aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH'.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `REDUCE` Expression, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Simulate sflight data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 75.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 125 msg = 'LH total incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 100 msg = 'AA total incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = 0 msg = 'XX total incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen. Sie initialisiert einen Wert (`INIT`) und wendet dann in einer Schleife (`FOR`) eine Operation (`NEXT`) auf jedes Element an, um den Wert schrittweise zu reduzieren. Dies ersetzt manuelle Schleifen und temporäre Variablen für Summierungen oder ähnliche Operationen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, Math

CLASS zcl_table_expression_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_matching_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_matching_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Simulate sflight data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 40.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 60.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 70.

    TRY.
        rv_connid = lt_sflights[ carrid = 'LH' AND seatsocc > 50 ]-connid.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_connid = 'NOT_FOUND'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA dref TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)` und `ASSIGN dref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_name TYPE string " e.g., 'TY_DYNAMIC_DATA'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " Get description of the structure type
    lr_struct_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_structure_name ).
    lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_type ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.

    " Assign to field symbol for access
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_table>).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Assign line type to field symbol for appending data
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_type.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Fill with data
    <fs_line>-field1 = 'Eintrag 1'.
    <fs_line>-field2 = 10.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_dynamic_table>.

    <fs_line>-field1 = 'Eintrag 2'.
    <fs_line>-field2 = 20.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_dynamic_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_CREATOR=>TY_DYNAMIC_DATA' ).

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <fs_table> IS NOT INITIAL exp = abap_true msg = 'Dynamic table not created' ).

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode, wobei nur Flüge mit einem bestimmten Status (repräsentiert durch `cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>status_open`) berücksichtigt werden.

CLASS zcl_join_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             price         TYPE s_price,
             flight_status TYPE char1, " Simulated status field
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES ty_flight_price_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    CONSTANTS: lc_simulated_open_status TYPE char1 VALUE 'O'.

    DATA lt_flights TYPE ty_flight_price_tab.

    SELECT s~carrid,
           s~price,
           CASE WHEN s~carrid = @iv_carrier THEN @lc_simulated_open_status ELSE 'X' END AS flight_status
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                     WHERE ( flight_status = lc_simulated_open_status )
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wähle Flugdaten aus `sflights` und `scarr` in eine interne Tabelle aus. Kopiere diese Daten dann in eine andere interne Tabelle mit einer ähnlichen Struktur, aber möglicherweise unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, unter Verwendung von `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder `CORRESPONDING` Operator. Filtere dabei nach einem Status, der durch `cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>status_open` repräsentiert wird.
hint: Nutze `SELECT JOIN` und den `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname      TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_status TYPE char1, " Simulated status field
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES ty_source_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             airline_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             airline_name TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_num   TYPE s_conn_id,
             status_flag  TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES ty_target_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE ty_target_data_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_flights_with_status.
    CONSTANTS: lc_simulated_open_status TYPE char1 VALUE 'O'.

    DATA lt_source_flights TYPE ty_source_data_tab.

    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           s~connid,
           CASE WHEN s~carrid = 'LH' THEN @lc_simulated_open_status ELSE 'X' END AS flight_status
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE ( CASE WHEN s~carrid = 'LH' THEN @lc_simulated_open_status ELSE 'X' END ) = @lc_simulated_open_status
      INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights.

    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_source_flights MAPPING airline_id = carrid
                                                                 airline_name = carrname
                                                                 flight_num   = connid
                                                                 status_flag  = flight_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermittle die durchschnittliche Flugauslastung (Anzahl der Buchungen / maximale Kapazität) pro Fluggesellschaft für Flüge mit einem 'offenen' Status, repräsentiert durch `cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>status_open`.

CLASS zcl_join_avg_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_capacity,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname      TYPE scarr-carrname,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_capacity.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE ty_carrier_capacity_tab.

CLASS zcl_join_avg_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier.
    CONSTANTS: lc_simulated_open_status TYPE char1 VALUE 'O'.

    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           AVG( CAST( s~booked AS dec( 15, 2 ) ) / CAST( s~seatsmax AS dec( 15, 2 ) ) ) AS avg_occupancy
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE ( CASE WHEN s~carrid = 'LH' THEN @lc_simulated_open_status ELSE 'X' END ) = @lc_simulated_open_status
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_occupancy.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_append_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD combine_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights_lh) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230102' )
    ).

      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20230101' )

    APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_lh TO rt_combined_flights.
    APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_ua TO rt_combined_flights.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' durchgeführt werden und eine Flugnummer größer als '0017' haben. Sammeln Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_source.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_filtered(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight_source WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' AND connid > '0017' )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge von AA mit connid > '0017' in SFLIGHT
    " Wenn SFLIGHT leer ist oder keine passenden Daten enthält, muss der Test angepasst werden.
    " Für diesen Test fügen wir Mock-Daten hinzu, falls SFLIGHT leer sein könnte.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle, die pro Fluggesellschaft eine weitere interne Tabelle mit Flügen enthält. Extrahieren Sie alle Flüge in eine einzige flache Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke, um durch die innere Tabelle zu iterieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights  TYPE tt_flight_detail,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flat_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flat_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flat_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flat_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS flatten_flights
      IMPORTING it_nested_flights TYPE tt_carrier_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flat_flights) TYPE tt_flat_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flatten_flights.
    rt_flat_flights = VALUE tt_flat_flight(
      FOR carrier_entry IN it_nested_flights
        FOR flight_detail IN carrier_entry-flights
          ( carrid = carrier_entry-carrid,
            connid = flight_detail-connid,
            fldate = flight_detail-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_nested( ).

    DATA(lt_nested_data) = VALUE zcl_it_for_nested=>tt_carrier_flights(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )

      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Flüge in der flachen Tabelle sein.'

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRIER ID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den frühesten Flugtermin.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             earliest_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_source.

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight_source BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE flight_count
      ( carrid        = flight-carrid,
        flight_count  = flight_count,
        earliest_fldate = REDUCE sflight-fldate(
                            INIT min_date = flight-fldate
                            FOR member IN GROUP flight
                              NEXT min_date = COND #( WHEN member-fldate < min_date THEN member-fldate ELSE min_date ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL )
      msg = 'Die Zusammenfassungstabelle sollte nicht leer sein.'
    ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob LH vorhanden ist und die Anzahl > 0 ist
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    IF ls_lh_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 )
        msg = 'Fluggesellschaft LH sollte Flüge haben.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( ls_lh_summary-earliest_fldate IS NOT INITIAL )
        msg = 'Frühester Flugtermin für LH sollte gesetzt sein.'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob AA vorhanden ist und die Anzahl > 0 ist
    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    IF ls_aa_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( ls_aa_summary-flight_count > 0 )
        msg = 'Fluggesellschaft AA sollte Flüge haben.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke Funktion in modernem ABAP, um Daten deklarativ zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können komplexe Aggregationen wie das Finden des Minimums oder Maximums pro Gruppe direkt im Ausdruck durchgeführt werden.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Tabelle von Flugnummern. Entfernen Sie führende Nullen und fügen Sie ein Präfix 'FL-' hinzu. Sammeln Sie die transformierten Strings in einer neuen Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_connids.
    rt_transformed_connids = VALUE tt_transformed_connid(
      FOR connid_entry IN it_connids
      LET lv_cleaned_connid = |{ CONV sflight-connid( connid_entry ) }| IN " Entfernt führende Nullen
      ( |FL-{ lv_cleaned_connid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid INTO TABLE lt_sflight_source.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight_source
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_for_reduce( ).

    " Annahme: SFLIGHT enthält Daten für 'LH'
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( lv_total_price_lh >= 0 )
      msg = 'Der Gesamtpreis sollte nicht negativ sein.'
    ).

    " Für einen präzisen Test müssten Mock-Daten verwendet werden.
    " Hier ein einfacher Test mit bekannten Werten, falls SFLIGHT leer ist oder nur bestimmte Daten enthält.
    DATA(lt_mock_sflight) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-price = '50.00'.

    " Wenn die Datenbank SFLIGHT leer ist, würde dieser Test fehlschlagen.
    " Ein besserer Test würde die Datenbankzugriffe mocken.
    " Hier eine Annahme, dass SFLIGHT Daten enthält.
    IF lv_total_price_lh > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( lv_total_price_lh > 0 )
        msg = 'Der Gesamtpreis für LH sollte größer als 0 sein.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein funktionaler Operator, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (z.B. Summe, Minimum, Maximum). In Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ist dies eine sehr elegante und performante Art der Aggregation, die eine explizite `LOOP`-Schleife mit Akkumulator überflüssig macht.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, Internal Tables, Math

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT, die von 'LH' oder 'AA' durchgeführt werden und deren Flugdatum im Jahr 2023 liegt. Sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck für komplexe Filterkriterien.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_complex_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_complex_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_source.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_filtered(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight_source
      WHERE ( ( flight-carrid = 'LH' OR flight-carrid = 'AA' ) AND flight-fldate BETWEEN '20230101' AND '20231231' )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_complex_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_complex_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_filter_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_complex_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL )
      msg = 'Die gefilterte Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein.'
    ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( ( ls_first_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_first_flight-carrid = 'AA' ) AND
                       ls_first_flight-fldate BETWEEN '20230101' AND '20231231' )
        msg = 'Der erste gefilterte Flug sollte den komplexen Kriterien entsprechen.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `FILTER` ein eigener Operator ist, kann die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks für komplexe Filterungen verwendet werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. Dies ist eine deklarative und effiziente Methode, um Daten basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu selektieren.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Complex Filtering, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle mit den Feldern CARRIER und FLIGHT_NUMBER an eine Zieltabelle mit den Feldern CARRIER_ID und FLIGHT_ID an. Felder mit gleichem Namen sollen automatisch gemappt werden.

CLASS zcl_it_append_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES: tt_target_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_corresponding_flights
      IMPORTING it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_target_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_append_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_corresponding_flights.
    DATA(lt_initial_target) = VALUE tt_target_flight(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT enthält, aber nur die Zeilen, die nicht bereits in einer Blacklist von Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie dabei `FOR` mit `EXCEPT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `EXCEPT` für eine effiziente Negativfilterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_blacklist TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_except_blacklist
      IMPORTING it_blacklist TYPE tt_carrid_blacklist
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_except_blacklist.
    DATA: lt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_source.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_filtered(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight_source EXCEPT it_blacklist WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_except_blacklist FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_except_blacklist.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_except( ).

    DATA(lt_blacklist) = VALUE zcl_it_for_except=>tt_carrid_blacklist(
      ( 'LH' )
      ( 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_except_blacklist( lt_blacklist ).

    " Annahme: SFLIGHT enthält Daten, die nicht in der Blacklist sind.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL )
        msg = 'Die gefilterte Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid <> 'LH' AND lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid <> 'UA' )
        msg = 'Der erste Flug sollte nicht von LH oder UA sein.'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test mit einer Blacklist, die alle vorhandenen Fluggesellschaften abdeckt (falls bekannt)
    DATA(lt_all_carrids) TYPE zcl_it_for_except=>tt_carrid_blacklist.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_carrids.
    DATA(lt_empty_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_except_blacklist( lt_all_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_empty_result
      msg = 'Wenn alle Fluggesellschaften in der Blacklist sind, sollte das Ergebnis leer sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `EXCEPT`-Klausel innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.55) ermöglicht eine deklarative Negativfilterung. Es werden nur die Zeilen verarbeitet, die nicht in der angegebenen Vergleichstabelle enthalten sind. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Blacklist-Szenarien zu implementieren.
keywords: FOR, EXCEPT, Internal Tables, Filtering, Blacklist

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, basierend auf der Kombination aus Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_adj_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_adj_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flight_data.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_adj_duplicates=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251202'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_adj_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_duplicates( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0018' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Sie erfordert, dass die Tabelle zuvor nach den relevanten Feldern sortiert wird. Dies ist eine klassische, aber immer noch moderne und performante Methode.
keywords: DELETE, ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Table, Sort, Grouping

CLASS zcl_delete_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus der Originaltabelle enthält, außer denen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne, funktionale Art, Elemente auszuschließen, was einer 'Löschung durch Nicht-Aufnahme' entspricht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_exclude DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filter,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filter.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filter TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_out_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_sflight_filter
        iv_exclude_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_exclude IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_out_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flight_data EXCEPT WHERE carrid = iv_exclude_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_out_carrier.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_exclude=>tt_sflight_filter.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251202' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_exclude( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_out_carrier( it_flight_data = lt_flights iv_exclude_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP, um neue interne Tabellen zu erstellen, die nur die gewünschten Elemente enthalten. Die `EXCEPT WHERE` Klausel ermöglicht es, Elemente auszuschließen, was eine funktionale Alternative zum direkten Löschen darstellt und oft zu lesbarerem und wartbarerem Code führt.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Functional Programming, EXCEPT WHERE, DELETE (by exclusion)

Instructions: Löschen Sie einen spezifischen Flug aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf den Primärschlüsselwerten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum).
hint: Verwenden Sie die `DELETE FROM ... WHERE ...` Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_delete_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_delete_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flight.
    DELETE FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flight.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'XX',
          lv_connid TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '9999',
          lv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20251231'.

    " Prepare: Insert a test entry
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                                           price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_delete_single( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->delete_flight( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_connid = lv_connid iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten so, dass für jede Fluggesellschaft nur der Flug mit der höchsten Flugnummer erhalten bleibt. Verwenden Sie einen funktionalen Ansatz mit `REDUCE` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS` und `MAX` um die gewünschten Zeilen zu selektieren, was einer 'Löschung' der unerwünschten Zeilen entspricht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_group.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_connid_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_sflight_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_connid_per_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_group( )
                                    FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flight_data GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                    ASCENDING
                                    " Find the flight with the maximum connid within each group
                                    LET max_connid_flight = REDUCE #( INIT max_f = VALUE ty_sflight_group( )
                                                                      FOR f IN GROUP flight
                                                                      WHERE ( f-connid > max_f-connid OR max_f-connid IS INITIAL )
                                                                      NEXT max_f = f )
                                    IN
                                    APPEND max_connid_flight TO result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) TO lt_flights.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `REDUCE` und `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` ist ein sehr modernes und leistungsstarkes Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um komplexe Aggregationen und Filterungen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Anstatt unerwünschte Zeilen explizit zu löschen, wird hier eine neue Tabelle erstellt, die nur die gewünschten Zeilen enthält. Dies ist ein funktionaler Ansatz, der oft zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und weniger fehleranfälligem Code führt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Einträge der Originaltabelle enthält, außer den ersten N Einträgen, unter Verwendung des `VALUE` Operators mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` um die ersten N Einträge zu überspringen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_skip_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_numbered_data,
             index TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_numbered_data.
    TYPES: tt_numbered_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_numbered_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS skip_first_n_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_numbered_data
        iv_skip_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_data) TYPE tt_numbered_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_skip_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD skip_first_n_entries.
    DATA(lv_current_index) = 0.
    rt_remaining_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN it_data
                                 WHERE ( ( lv_current_index = lv_current_index + 1 ) > iv_skip_count )
                                 ( ls_entry ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( index = 3 value = 'C' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( index = 4 value = 'D' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_skip_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->skip_first_n_entries( it_data = lt_data iv_skip_count = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-value exp = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-value exp = 'D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_skip_all_entries.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_value_skip_n=>tt_numbered_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( index = 1 value = 'A' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( index = 2 value = 'B' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_skip_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->skip_first_n_entries( it_data = lt_data iv_skip_count = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).

  METHOD test_skip_zero_entries.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_value_skip_n=>tt_numbered_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( index = 1 value = 'A' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_skip_n( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die einen Zähler verwendet, ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, die bestimmte Anfangselemente 'überspringt'. Dies ist eine elegante Alternative zum direkten Löschen und fördert einen deklarativen Programmierstil.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Table, Functional Programming, Skip, Delete (by exclusion)

CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_type_by_extension
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type_by_extension.
    CASE iv_file_extension.
      WHEN 'pdf'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_pdf.
      WHEN 'xml'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_xml.
      WHEN 'html' OR 'htm'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_html.
      WHEN 'jpg' OR 'jpeg'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_jpeg.
      WHEN 'png'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_png.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_binary. " Default or unknown
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) in eine neue Tabelle transformiert, die nur die Flugnummer und den Preis enthält, wobei der Preis um einen bestimmten Faktor erhöht wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit dem `VALUE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
        iv_factor  TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                      ( flight_id      = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
                                        adjusted_price = flight-price * iv_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE zcl_flight_transformer=>tt_sflight_raw.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_raw_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).

Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus den Elementen der Quelltabelle konstruiert, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einem initialen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                               FOR flight IN it_flights
                               NEXT total = total + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`), um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und mit einem Preis über einem Schwellenwert zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_raw
        iv_carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price_min  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_raw.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_price_min ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
