Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und Werten füllt. Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` und Feldsymbole.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_value,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_value.
    TYPES: tt_field_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE string_table " List of field names
        it_data_rows         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_field_values " Each row is a list of field_name/value pairs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data)       TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " All fields as string for simplicity
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any table line.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lt_current_row_data).
      CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
      LOOP AT lt_current_row_data INTO DATA(ls_field_value).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_value-field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <lv_field> = ls_field_value-field_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_fill.
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD1' ) ( 'FIELD2' ) ).

    DATA(lt_data_rows) TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_filler=>STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_dynamic_table_filler=>tt_field_values.
    APPEND VALUE #( ( field_name = 'FIELD1' field_value = 'Value A1' ) ( field_name = 'FIELD2' field_value = 'Value B1' ) ) TO lt_data_rows.
    APPEND VALUE #( ( field_name = 'FIELD1' field_value = 'Value A2' ) ( field_name = 'FIELD2' field_value = 'Value B2' ) ) TO lt_data_rows.

    DATA(lo_filler) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_filler( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_data) = lo_filler->fill_dynamic_table( it_field_definitions = lt_field_defs it_data_rows = lt_data_rows ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <ls_dynamic_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_field1>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_field2>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field1> exp = 'Value A1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field2> exp = 'Value B1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die dynamische Tabellenfüllung mit `CREATE DATA` und Feldsymbolen ist ein mächtiges Feature für Szenarien, in denen die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies ist typisch für generische Schnittstellen oder Tools. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` ermöglicht die typsichere Definition dynamischer Strukturen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, RTTI

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Dateityp (Erweiterung) aus einem Dateinamen und geben Sie den entsprechenden MIME-Typ unter Verwendung von `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` zurück. Behandeln Sie Fälle, in denen keine Erweiterung vorhanden ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Funktionen wie `FIND` oder `SUBSTRING` und `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_mime_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_type_from_filename
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_mime_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type_from_filename.
    DATA(lv_dot_pos) = find( val = iv_filename sub = '.' occ = -1 ).

    IF lv_dot_pos IS INITIAL OR lv_dot_pos = 0.
      rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_binary. " No extension, assume binary or unknown
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_extension) = to_lower( iv_filename+lv_dot_pos+1 ).

    CASE lv_extension.
      WHEN 'pdf'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_pdf.
      WHEN 'xml'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_xml.
      WHEN 'html' OR 'htm'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_html.
      WHEN 'jpg' OR 'jpeg'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_jpeg.
      WHEN 'png'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_png.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_mime_type_binary.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight_info,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_grouped_info TYPE ty_grouped_flight_info.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      CLEAR ls_grouped_info.
      ls_grouped_info-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_grouped_info-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      ls_grouped_info-average_price = REDUCE #( INIT total TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                                FOR GROUP MEMBER flight IN GROUP
                                                NEXT total = total + flight-price ) / GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_grouped_info TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_raw_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_raw_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_raw_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '250.00' ) TO lt_raw_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' price = '350.00' ) TO lt_raw_flights.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_raw_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-average_price exp = '150.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-average_price exp = '250.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight_raw.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_raw_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_grouped ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit `GROUP SIZE` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator für die Durchschnittsberechnung ermöglicht dies eine sehr kompakte und deklarative Lösung für komplexe Gruppierungsaufgaben, die zuvor mehrere Schleifen und manuelle Aggregationen erforderten.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Finde alle Wörter, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen, in einem gegebenen Satz.

CLASS zcl_str_find_capital_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_capital_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_str_find_capital_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_capital_words.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\b[A-Z]\w*\b' IN iv_sentence
         RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).
    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_sentence+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_words.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Data Aging Temperatur für ein spezifisches Objekt (z.B. einen Flug in `sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_session_temperature` und die Methode `GET_TEMPERATURE`. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine systemnahe Funktion ist und eine tatsächliche Data Aging Konfiguration erfordert. Das Beispiel demonstriert die API-Nutzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_da_get_temperature DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS get_data_aging_temperature
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE sabp_daag_temperature. " 'H' for Hot, 'C' for Cold, 'W' for Warm, 'N' for Not Aged
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_get_temperature IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_aging_temperature.
    " This is a conceptual example. In a real scenario, the Data Aging
    " framework would be configured and the object would be registered.
    " The actual temperature depends on system configuration and data age.

    DATA(lo_da_manager) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_da_object_key,
             object_name TYPE sabp_daag_object_name,
             key_value   TYPE string, " Concatenated key values
           END OF ty_da_object_key.
    DATA: lt_object_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_da_object_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_object_key  TYPE ty_da_object_key.

    ls_object_key-object_name = 'SFLIGHT'. " Example object name
    ls_object_key-key_value = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate }|.
    APPEND ls_object_key TO lt_object_keys.

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_temperatures) = lo_da_manager->get_temperature(
                                  EXPORTING
                                    it_object_keys = lt_object_keys
                                  EXCEPTIONS
                                    OTHERS         = 1
                                ).
        IF lt_temperatures IS NOT INITIAL.
          rv_temperature = lt_temperatures[ 1 ]-temperature.
        ELSE.
          rv_temperature = 'N'. " Not Aged or no temperature found
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_abap_daag_error INTO DATA(lx_daag_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        rv_temperature = 'E'. " Error
    ENDTRY.

    " For this example, we'll return a fixed value if no actual DA is configured
    IF rv_temperature IS INITIAL OR rv_temperature = 'E'.
      rv_temperature = 'N'. " Default to Not Aged for demonstration
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_find_classification DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_case_find_classification IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtere alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die in 'FRANKFURT' starten und deren Flugnummer (CONNID) ein '0' enthält.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` mit `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_origin_and_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_connid_char TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_origin_and_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityfrom = iv_origin_city
                                    AND ( FIND( val = connid sub = iv_connid_char ) IS NOT INITIAL ) ).

    " Map to return type
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN rt_filtered_flights
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                     fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_flights.

      iv_origin_city = 'FRANKFURT'
      iv_connid_char = '0'

      act = lines( lt_result )

Instructions: Zähle, wie viele Flüge in `sflights` eine bestimmte Zeichenkette in ihrer Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) enthalten.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_by_carrid_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrid_substring.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( FIND( val = ls_sflight-carrid sub = iv_substring ) IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String mit einer bestimmten Zeichenkette beginnt oder endet, unter Verwendung von String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `starts_with` und `ends_with`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_starts_ends_with DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_string_boundaries
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_prefix  TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_suffix  TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_unit_assert=>ty_boolean_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_starts_ends_with IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_string_boundaries.
    DATA(lv_starts_with) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_ends_with) = abap_false.

    IF iv_prefix IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_starts_with = starts_with( val = iv_text sub = iv_prefix ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_suffix IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_ends_with = ends_with( val = iv_text sub = iv_suffix ).
    ENDIF.

    rs_result = NEW cl_abap_unit_assert=>ty_boolean_result(
      value = COND abap_bool(
        WHEN iv_prefix IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_suffix IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_starts_with AND lv_ends_with
        WHEN iv_prefix IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_starts_with
        WHEN iv_suffix IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_ends_with
        ELSE abap_false
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mappen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur auf eine Zielstruktur. Verwenden Sie CONV, um Felder mit unterschiedlichen, aber kompatiblen Typen zu konvertieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator mit dem BASE-Zusatz und CONV für die Feldkonvertierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             amount TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    CLASS zcl_conv_struct_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS map_data
          IMPORTING
            is_source TYPE ty_source_data
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data
          RAISING
            cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    TRY.
        rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
                      is_source
                      MAPPING
                        id     = CONV i( is_source-id )
                        amount = CONV p( is_source-amount )
                    ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid
            value  = lx_error->value.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 100 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: CORRESPONDING mit MAPPING ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, Strukturen zu mappen. CONV wird hier verwendet, um explizite Typkonvertierungen für Felder durchzuführen, die nicht direkt kompatibel sind, aber konvertiert werden können.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle, indem Sie den Wert eines Feldes während der Transformation mit CONV in einen anderen Typ konvertieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, und CONV für die Feldkonvertierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_line.

    TYPES: tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_line.

    TYPES: tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_conv_itab_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS transform_table
          IMPORTING
            it_source TYPE tt_source_table
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_table
          RAISING
            cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    TRY.
        rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                             ( key   = ls_source-key
                               value = CONV i( ls_source-value ) ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid
            value  = lx_error->value.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_success.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_source_table(
      ( key = 'A' value = '1' )
      ( key = 'B' value = '2' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_itab_transform( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-key exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-key exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-value exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_failure.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_source_table(
      ( key = 'A' value = '1' )
      ( key = 'B' value = 'X' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_itab_transform( ).
    lo_cut->transform_table( lt_source ). " Should raise cx_sy_conversion_error
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Operator in Kombination mit VALUE ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Transformation von internen Tabellen. CONV wird hier pro Zeile angewendet, um die Typkonvertierung während der Schleife durchzuführen.
keywords: CONV, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Control in einem Custom Container und zeigen Sie einen mehrzeiligen Text an, der mit String-Templates generiert wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER und CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT. String-Templates sind ideal für die Textgenerierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string
        iv_content TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_text.
    " Create a custom container (assuming a screen with a custom control area 'CUSTOM_CONTROL')
    IF mo_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL'. " This name must match a custom control on a screen
    ENDIF.

    " Create the text editor control
    IF mo_editor IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_editor
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_container.
    ENDIF.

    " Generate text using string templates
    DATA(lv_display_text) = |{ iv_title }~n{ sy-uline(80) }~n{ iv_content }|.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt eines CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Controls aus und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen im Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode GET_TEXT_AS_STREAM und dann String-Operationen oder SPLIT, um die Zeilen zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit. " Inject the editor instance

    METHODS get_line_count
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_editor = io_editor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_line_count.
    DATA lv_text TYPE string.
    IF mo_editor IS BOUND.
      mo_editor->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_text ).
      " Split the text by newline character and count lines
      SPLIT lv_text AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE DATA(lt_lines).
      rv_line_count = lines( lt_lines ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle case where editor is not bound (e.g., in unit test or error)
      rv_line_count = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_count.
    " Mocking cl_gui_textedit for unit testing
    CLASS lcl_mock_textedit DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_textedit.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_mock_text TYPE string.
        METHODS get_text_as_stream REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_textedit IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_text_as_stream.
        text = mv_mock_text.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_mock_editor) = NEW lcl_mock_textedit( ).
    lo_mock_editor->mv_mock_text = |Line 1{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }Line 2{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }Line 3|.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_textedit_read( lo_editor = lo_mock_editor ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->get_line_count( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 ).

    lo_mock_editor->mv_mock_text = 'Single Line'.
    lv_count = lo_cut->get_line_count( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 ).

    lo_mock_editor->mv_mock_text = ''.
    lv_count = lo_cut->get_line_count( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 ). " SPLIT ' ' AT CR_LF results in 1 line
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode GET_TEXT_AS_STREAM ist der moderne Weg, um den gesamten Textinhalt eines CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Controls zu erhalten. Die Zeilenzählung erfolgt effizient mit SPLIT und LINES(), was die Handhabung von Textdaten in ABAP vereinfacht. Die Verwendung eines Mock-Objekts im Unit-Test ist eine moderne Praxis, um GUI-abhängige Logik testbar zu machen.

hint: Nutzen Sie CL_GUI_ALV_GRID und den VALUE-Operator, um die Daten aus SFLIGHTS zu selektieren und zu formatieren.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.

    TYPES: tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_gui_alv_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS display_sflights.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
        DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
        DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    " Create a custom container (assuming a screen with a custom control area 'ALV_CONTROL')
    IF mo_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'ALV_CONTROL'. " This name must match a custom control on a screen
    ENDIF.

    " Create the ALV grid control
    IF mo_alv_grid IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
        EXPORTING
          i_parent = mo_container.
    ENDIF.

    " Populate data using VALUE operator and SELECT
    mt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
                           ( carrid   = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                             connid   = <fs_sflight>-connid
                             fldate   = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                             price    = <fs_sflight>-price
                             currency = <fs_sflight>-currency ) ).

    " Set table for ALV display
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_DISPLAY' " Use the local type name
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
    ).

    " Flush to ensure GUI update
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Event-Handling für einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile in einem CL_GUI_ALV_GRID. Zeigen Sie die Daten der doppelgeklickten Zeile an.
hint: Verwenden Sie SET HANDLER für das Event DOUBLE_CLICK und die Methode GET_SELECTED_ROWS_ID.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display_event,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,

           END OF ty_sflight_display_event.

    TYPES: tt_sflight_display_event TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_gui_alv_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor.
        METHODS display_sflights.
        METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
          IMPORTING
            e_row
            e_column.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
        DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
        DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_display_event.
        DATA mv_last_clicked_row TYPE i. " For unit test verification
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Create a custom container (assuming a screen with a custom control area 'ALV_CONTROL_EVENT')
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTROL_EVENT'.

    " Create the ALV grid control
    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_container.

    " Register event handler
    SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights.
    " Populate data using VALUE operator and SELECT
    mt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS )
                           ( carrid   = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                             connid   = <fs_sflight>-connid
                             fldate   = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                             price    = <fs_sflight>-price
                             currency = <fs_sflight>-currency ) ).

    " Set table for ALV display
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_DISPLAY_EVENT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
    ).

    " Flush to ensure GUI update
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    " In a real scenario, you would get the selected row data
    " and display it, e.g., in a popup or another screen area.
    " For this example, we just store the row number.
    mv_last_clicked_row = e_row.
    MESSAGE |Double-clicked row: { e_row }, Column: { e_column }| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handler_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handler_logic.
    " This unit test cannot simulate a real GUI double-click.
    " It can only test the logic within the event handler if it were called.
    " We can manually call the event handler method to test its internal logic.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_alv_event( ).
    " Simulate a double click on row 5, column 'CARRID'
    lo_cut->handle_double_click( e_row = 5 e_column = 'CARRID' ).

    " Assert that the internal state was updated correctly
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_last_clicked_row exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist der Standardweg, um auf Benutzerinteraktionen in GUI-Controls zu reagieren. Die Methode handle_double_click wird automatisch aufgerufen, wenn das double_click-Event des ALV-Grids ausgelöst wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Splitter-Container, der einen Bildschirm vertikal in zwei Bereiche teilt. Platzieren Sie in jedem Bereich ein CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Control.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER, um die Bereiche zu definieren, und dann CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT in jedem Sub-Container.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_layout DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_split_editors.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_main_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_splitter       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_editor1        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_editor2        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_layout IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_split_editors.
    " Create a main custom container (assuming a screen with 'MAIN_CONTROL')
    IF mo_main_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_main_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'MAIN_CONTROL'.
    ENDIF.

    " Create the splitter container within the main container
    IF mo_splitter IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter
        EXPORTING
          parent  = mo_main_container
          rows    = 1
          columns = 2. " Split vertically into two columns
    ENDIF.

    " Get the sub-containers from the splitter
    DATA(lo_container1) = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_container2) = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    " Create first text editor in the left pane
    IF mo_editor1 IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_editor1
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_container1.
      mo_editor1->set_text_as_stream( text = |Editor 1: Left Pane~nThis is the first text editor.| ).
    ENDIF.

    " Create second text editor in the right pane
    IF mo_editor2 IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_editor2
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_container2.
      mo_editor2->set_text_as_stream( text = |Editor 2: Right Pane~nThis is the second text editor.| ).
    ENDIF.

    " Flush to ensure GUI update
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetze alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem gegebenen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_text     TYPE string
        iv_new_text     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_text.
    rv_result = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_text IN rv_result WITH iv_new_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_simple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_text( iv_input_string = 'Hello World, Hello ABAP' iv_old_text = 'Hello' iv_new_text = 'Hi' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hi World, Hi ABAP' msg = 'Simple replacement failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_text( iv_input_string = 'NoMatch' iv_old_text = 'X' iv_new_text = 'Y' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'NoMatch' msg = 'No match replacement failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_text( iv_input_string = 'AAAAA' iv_old_text = 'A' iv_new_text = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'BBBBB' msg = 'Full replacement failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Operator ist die moderne und effiziente Art, alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in ABAP zu ersetzen. Er ist direkt und leicht lesbar, ohne dass Schleifen oder komplexe String-Operationen erforderlich sind.
keywords: REPLACE, String, String Processing

Instructions: Ersetze einen Teilstring basierend auf einer Bedingung. Wenn der String 'ERROR' enthält, ersetze es durch 'FAILURE', sonst belasse den String unverändert.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REPLACE` mit einem `COND` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_conditionally.
    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN iv_input_string CA 'ERROR' THEN
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'ERROR' IN iv_input_string WITH 'FAILURE'
      ELSE
        iv_input_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_cond FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_cond.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_conditionally( 'This is an ERROR message.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'This is an FAILURE message.' msg = 'Conditional replacement (ERROR) failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_conditionally( 'No issue here.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'No issue here.' msg = 'Conditional replacement (no ERROR) failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_conditionally( 'ERROR ERROR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'FAILURE FAILURE' msg = 'Conditional replacement (multiple ERROR) failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf Bedingungen in einem funktionalen Stil. In Kombination mit `REPLACE` können so bedingte String-Manipulationen sehr kompakt und lesbar formuliert werden, ohne IF-Blöcke zu benötigen.
keywords: REPLACE, COND, String, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie mehrere verschiedene Zeichen in einem String basierend auf einer Mapping-Tabelle. Zum Beispiel, ersetzen Sie 'ä' durch 'ae', 'ö' durch 'oe', 'ü' durch 'ue'.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle für die Ersetzungsregeln und eine Schleife mit `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_multi_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_replace_map,
             old_char TYPE string,
             new_char TYPE string,
           END OF ty_replace_map.
    TYPES: tt_replace_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_replace_map WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_multiple_chars
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        it_replace_map  TYPE tt_replace_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_multi_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_multiple_chars.
    rv_result = iv_input_string.
    LOOP AT it_replace_map INTO DATA(ls_map).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ls_map-old_char IN rv_result WITH ls_map-new_char.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_multiple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_multi_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_map) = VALUE zcl_str_multi_replace=>tt_replace_map(
      ( old_char = 'ä' new_char = 'ae' )
      ( old_char = 'ö' new_char = 'oe' )
      ( old_char = 'ü' new_char = 'ue' )
      ( old_char = 'ß' new_char = 'ss' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_multiple_chars( iv_input_string = 'Müller-Lüdenscheidt Straße' it_replace_map = lt_map ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Mueller-Luedenscheidt Strasse' msg = 'Multiple character replacement failed' ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein XSTRING von einer Legacy-Kodierung (z.B. ISO-8859-1, Codepage 1100) in ein XSTRING mit UTF-8-Kodierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` mit `create_in` und `create_out` für XSTRING-zu-XSTRING-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_xstr_legacy_to_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_codepage TYPE cpcoll
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstr_legacy_to_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring.
    DATA: lv_string_temp TYPE string.

    " Convert input XSTRING (legacy) to temporary STRING (UTF-16)
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in( encoding = iv_source_codepage ).
    lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING buffer = iv_input_xstring IMPORTING data = lv_string_temp ).

    " Convert temporary STRING (UTF-16) to output XSTRING (UTF-8)
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_string_temp IMPORTING buffer = rv_output_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " 'Test' in ISO-8859-1 is '54657374'

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie einen Teilstring in einer internen Tabelle von Strings, aber nur, wenn der Teilstring existiert. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Tabellen-Iterationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` für die Iteration und `REPLACE` innerhalb des Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_in_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_in_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_old_text      TYPE string
        iv_new_text      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_in_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_in_table.
    rt_result_strings = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_string IN it_input_strings
      ( COND string(
          WHEN ls_string CA iv_old_text THEN
            REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_text IN ls_string WITH iv_new_text
          ELSE
            ls_string
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_in_itab FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_in_itab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_in_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Hello World' )
      ( 'ABAP is great' )
      ( 'Another World' )
      ( 'No match here' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Hello ABAP' )
      ( 'ABAP is great' )
      ( 'Another ABAP' )
      ( 'No match here' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_in_table( it_input_strings = lt_input iv_old_text = 'World' iv_new_text = 'ABAP' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Replacement in internal table failed' ).

    DATA(lt_input_no_change) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Line 1' )
      ( 'Line 2' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result_no_change) = lo_cut->replace_in_table( it_input_strings = lt_input_no_change iv_old_text = 'X' iv_new_text = 'Y' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_no_change exp = lt_input_no_change msg = 'No change in internal table failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR` Operator, um über eine interne Tabelle zu iterieren und gleichzeitig eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren. In Kombination mit dem `COND` Operator wird jede Zeile bedingt verarbeitet: Nur wenn der `iv_old_text` in der Zeile gefunden wird (`CA` Operator), wird die Ersetzung mittels `REPLACE` durchgeführt. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Tabellen zu transformieren.
keywords: REPLACE, Internal Tables, FOR, COND, String Processing, VALUE

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem String mehrere unterschiedliche Muster durch jeweils spezifische Ersatzstrings in einem funktionalen Stil.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer internen Tabelle von Such- und Ersatzpaaren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_replace_rule,
             pattern TYPE string,
             replacement TYPE string,
           END OF ty_replace_rule.
    TYPES: tt_replace_rules TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_replace_rule WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_with_rules
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        it_rules        TYPE tt_replace_rules
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_with_rules.
    rv_result = REDUCE string(
      INIT current_string = iv_input_string
      FOR ls_rule IN it_rules
      NEXT current_string = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ls_rule-pattern IN current_string WITH ls_rule-replacement
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_replace FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_rules) = VALUE zcl_str_reduce_replace=>tt_replace_rules(
      ( pattern = 'old' replacement = 'new' )
      ( pattern = 'text' replacement = 'data' )
      ( pattern = 'ABAP' replacement = 'SAP' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'This is an old text about ABAP'.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'This is an new data about SAP'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_with_rules( iv_input_string = lv_input it_rules = lt_rules ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'REDUCE replacement with multiple rules failed' ).

    DATA(lv_input_no_match) = 'No changes here'.
    DATA(lv_result_no_match) = lo_cut->replace_with_rules( iv_input_string = lv_input_no_match it_rules = lt_rules ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_no_match exp = lv_input_no_match msg = 'REDUCE replacement with no matches failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges funktionales Feature in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. In diesem Beispiel wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um eine Kette von `REPLACE`-Operationen auf einen String anzuwenden, basierend auf einer Liste von Regeln. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und expressivem Code für komplexe String-Transformationen.
keywords: REPLACE, REDUCE, String, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Leerzeichen in einem String durch Unterstriche, aber nur, wenn der String nicht bereits Unterstriche enthält.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_cond_cp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_spaces_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_cond_cp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_spaces_conditionally.
    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN iv_input_string CP '*_*' THEN " Check if string already contains underscores
        iv_input_string
      ELSE
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ' ' IN iv_input_string WITH '_'
    ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der HTML-Entitäten enthält, in einen String mit den entsprechenden Unicode-Zeichen. (z.B. '&' zu '&', '<' zu '<').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_html_utilities` oder manuellen Ersetzungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_html_entities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decode_html_entities
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_html TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decoded_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_html_entities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decode_html_entities.
    " For simplicity, we'll use direct REPLACE for common entities.
    " For full HTML entity decoding, CL_ABAP_HTML_UTILITIES=>UNESCAPE_HTML would be used.
    " However, the request focuses on 'REPLACE' and 'cl_abap_conv_obj'.
    " We can simulate a conversion process using REPLACE.

    rv_decoded_string = iv_input_html.

    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '&' IN rv_decoded_string WITH '&'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '<' IN rv_decoded_string WITH '<'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '>' IN rv_decoded_string WITH '>'.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_counts.
    DATA(lv_counts_text) = get_flight_counts( ).

    DATA(lo_dialog_container) = NEW cl_gui_dialogbox_container(
      width    = 400
      height   = 250
      title    = 'Fluganzahl pro Fluggesellschaft'
    ).

    DATA(lo_text_edit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_dialog_container
      wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_fixed_position
    ).

    lo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( text = lv_counts_text ).
    lo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF struct_carrier_count.
    DATA lt_carrier_counts TYPE TABLE OF struct_carrier_count.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      APPEND VALUE struct_carrier_count( carrid = ls_group-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) TO lt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_counts_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR count_entry IN lt_carrier_counts
      NEXT s = s && |Fluggesellschaft: { count_entry-carrid }, Flüge: { count_entry-count } \n|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid  TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_avg_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
    METHODS calculate_avg_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lv_avg_occupancy) = calculate_avg_occupancy( iv_carrier ).
    DATA(lv_display_text) = |Durchschnittliche Auslastung für { iv_carrier }: { lv_avg_occupancy * 100 } %|.

    DATA(lo_dialog_container) = NEW cl_gui_dialogbox_container(
      width    = 400
      height   = 150
      title    = 'Durchschnittliche Auslastung'
    ).

    DATA(lo_label) = NEW cl_gui_label(
      parent = lo_dialog_container
      text   = lv_display_text
    ).

    lo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_avg_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_occupancy_sums,
             total_occupied TYPE i,
             total_max      TYPE i,
           END OF struct_occupancy_sums.

    DATA(ls_sums) = REDUCE struct_occupancy_sums(
      INIT total_occupied = 0
           total_max      = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT total_occupied = total_occupied + flight-seatsocc
           total_max      = total_max + flight-seatsmax
    ).

    IF ls_sums-total_max > 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = CONV f( ls_sums-total_occupied ) / ls_sums-total_max.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(ls_max_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( COND #( WHEN flight-seatsmax_e > ls_max_flight-seatsmax_e THEN flight ELSE ls_max_flight ) )
    ).

    IF ls_max_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_flight_info = |Flug mit max. Economy-Sitzen: { ls_max_flight-carrid } { ls_max_flight-connid }, Sitze: { ls_max_flight-seatsmax_e }|.
    ELSE.
      rs_flight_info = 'Keine Flüge gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` in einem einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `LOOP`.

CLASS zcl_carrier_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE s_carr_id_tab(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( flight-carrid )
    ).
    SORT lt_unique_carriers ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_carriers.

    rv_carrier_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR carrier IN lt_unique_carriers
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrier
        ELSE s && ', ' && carrier
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sorted_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Dynamische Sortierung
    SORT lt_sflights BY (iv_sort_field).

      title    = |Flüge sortiert nach { iv_sort_field }|

      report        = sy-repid
      set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
    ).

    lo_alv->display( ).

    lo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Flugnummern aus `sflights` zu einem String, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.

CLASS zcl_flight_concat_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_connids_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_concat_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_connids_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_connids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( ( flight-seatsmax_e - flight-seatsocc_e ) >= iv_min_free_seats )
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid
        ELSE s && ', ' && flight-connid
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und deren Gesamtanzahl an Flügen zurückgibt, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `HAVING`.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_counts_filtered
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE zcl_flight_group_having=>tt_carrier_count.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ts_carrier_count,
           tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_counts_filtered.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         HAVING GROUP SIZE > iv_min_flights
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      APPEND VALUE ts_carrier_count( carrid = ls_group-carrid flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).

Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Methode, die komplexe Datenanalysen direkt im `LOOP` ermöglicht.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price OPTIONAL
        iv_currency TYPE s_curr OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_table.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_data.
    " Initial table (can be empty or pre-filled)
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ). " Start with an empty table

    " Insert new line using VALUE operator
    INSERT VALUE #(
      carrid   = iv_carrid
      connid   = iv_connid
      fldate   = iv_fldate
      price    = iv_price
      currency = iv_currency
    ) INTO TABLE rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrier   TYPE s_carr_id,
             date_val  TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_corresponding_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source_data TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_corresponding_data.
    " Initial target table
    rt_target_table = VALUE #( ). " Start with an empty table

    " Insert new line using CORRESPONDING operator
    INSERT CORRESPONDING #(
      is_source_data
      MAPPING
        carrier = carrid
        flight_id = connid
        date_val = fldate
    ) INTO TABLE rt_target_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle zurückgibt, und verketten Sie diese mit einer weiteren Methode, die die zurückgegebene Tabelle weiterverarbeitet (z.B. filtert und dann eine neue Zeile einfügt).
hint: Verwenden Sie `RETURNING VALUE` für Methodenparameter und den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_table.

    METHODS add_special_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_table
        iv_new_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_special_flight.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #(
      carrid   = rt_updated_flights[ 1 ]-carrid " Take carrier from first entry
      connid   = iv_new_connid
      fldate   = sy-datum
      price    = '999.99'
      currency = 'EUR'
    ) INTO TABLE rt_updated_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_and_added) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' )->add_special_flight( iv_new_connid = '9999' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_filtered_and_added
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered_and_added WITH KEY connid = '9999' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = sy-tabix
      msg = 'Special flight should be found in the chained result'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verkettung von Methoden (`Method Chaining`) durch die Verwendung von `RETURNING VALUE`. Die erste Methode gibt eine interne Tabelle zurück, die direkt als Eingabe für die nächste Methode dient. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: METHOD, RETURNING VALUE, Method Chaining, FILTER, INSERT, Object Orientation

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, indem Sie Daten aus einer Quelltabelle aggregieren und transformieren. Zählen Sie die Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHT`.
hint: `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET count = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #(
        BASE result
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = count )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_aggregate_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->aggregate_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flight_counts
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
    ).

    " Check if counts are plausible (e.g., for 'AA')
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_aa_count-count > 0
        msg = 'Flight count for AA should be greater than 0'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation und Transformation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` ermöglicht er eine prägnante und effiziente Gruppierung und Zählung von Elementen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als traditionelle Schleifen mit `AT NEW`.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, FOR GROUPS OF, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit dem `FOR` Ausdruck, indem Sie über die Tabelle `SFLIGHT` iterieren und nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Verbindungs-ID 'einfügen'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_connid.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Read all flights (or a subset for performance)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    " Filter using FOR expression
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( connid = iv_connid )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_for_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_connid( lv_test_connid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-connid

    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_empty_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_connid( 'XXXX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_empty_result
      msg = 'Result table should be empty for non-existing connid'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und zu transformieren. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit `IF` Bedingungen zu schreiben, kann man die Logik prägnant in einer Zeile formulieren, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: FOR, Internal Table, Filtering, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile aus einer internen Quelltabelle an einer bestimmten Position in eine interne Zieltabelle ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINE OF ... INTO TABLE ... INDEX ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_line_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_line_at_index
      IMPORTING
        is_line_to_insert TYPE ty_data
        iv_index          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_line_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_line_at_index.
    " Initialize target table
    rt_target_table = VALUE #(
      ( id = 1 text = 'First' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Second' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Third' )
    ).

    " Insert the new line at the specified index
    INSERT is_line_to_insert INTO TABLE rt_target_table INDEX iv_index.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_at_middle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_at_end FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_at_middle.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_line_of( ).
    DATA(ls_new_line) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_line_of=>ty_data( id = 99 text = 'Inserted' ).
    DATA(lv_index) = 2.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_line_at_index( is_line_to_insert = ls_new_line iv_index = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Expected 4 lines after insertion'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ lv_index ]-id
      exp = 99
      msg = 'Inserted line should be at the specified index'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ lv_index + 1 ]-id
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Original line should be shifted'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_at_end.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_line_of( ).
    DATA(ls_new_line) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_line_of=>ty_data( id = 100 text = 'Last' ).
    DATA(lv_index) = 4. " Insert at the end

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_line_at_index( is_line_to_insert = ls_new_line iv_index = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Expected 4 lines after insertion at end'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 4 ]-id
      exp = 100
      msg = 'Inserted line should be at the last position'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... INDEX ...` Syntax ist die klassische und weiterhin gültige Methode, um eine Zeile an einer spezifischen Position in einer internen Tabelle einzufügen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Reihenfolge der Elemente eine Rolle spielt.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Table, Index, LINE OF

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten in eine Datenbanktabelle `ZFLIGHT_DATA` ein, indem Sie diese direkt aus der `SFLIGHT` Datenbanktabelle auswählen. Die Methode soll die Anzahl der eingefügten Zeilen zurückgeben. (Hinweis: `ZFLIGHT_DATA` muss als transparente Tabelle im System existieren).
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT target_table FROM ( SELECT ... FROM source_table ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_sflights_to_custom_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_sflights_to_custom_table.
    " Delete existing entries for the carrier to ensure clean test runs
    DELETE FROM zflight_data WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    " Insert data into ZFLIGHT_DATA by selecting directly from SFLIGHT
    INSERT zflight_data FROM (
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
    ).
    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode für Massendatenoperationen, da die Daten direkt auf der Datenbankebene verarbeitet werden, ohne dass sie zuerst in den Applikationsserver geladen werden müssen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode mit optionalen Parametern, die Standardwerte verwenden, wenn sie nicht explizit übergeben werden. Die Methode soll eine Struktur mit den finalen Werten zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_method_optional_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL DEFAULT '0000'

      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
      status = iv_status
    ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, die aus einer `COND` Expression generiert wird, um bedingte Werte zu setzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT VALUE #( COND ... ) INTO TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_product_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_is_active TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_product_conditionally.
    rt_products = VALUE #(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Laptop' status = 'A' )
    ).

    INSERT VALUE #(
      id     = iv_id
      name   = iv_name
      status = COND char1( WHEN iv_is_active = abap_true THEN 'A' ELSE 'I' )
    ) INTO TABLE rt_products.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'A' msg = 'Status should be Active' ).

  METHOD test_insert_inactive_product.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, die aus einer `SWITCH` Expression generiert wird, um Werte basierend auf mehreren Fällen zu setzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT VALUE #( SWITCH ... ) INTO TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             item_id   TYPE i,
             product   TYPE string,
             category  TYPE string,
             price     TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_order_item.
    TYPES: tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_order_item_with_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_item_id TYPE i
        iv_product TYPE string
        iv_product_type TYPE char1 " E: Electronics, B: Books, C: Clothing
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_order_items) TYPE tt_order_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_order_item_with_category.
    rt_order_items = VALUE #(
      ( item_id = 1 product = 'Smartphone' category = 'Electronics' price = '800.00' )
    ).

    INSERT VALUE #(
      item_id  = iv_item_id
      product  = iv_product
      category = SWITCH string(
                   iv_product_type
                   WHEN 'E' THEN 'Electronics'
                   WHEN 'B' THEN 'Books'
                   WHEN 'C' THEN 'Clothing'
                   ELSE 'Miscellaneous'
                 )

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` Daten zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie dann eine weitere Methode, um diese Tabelle mit `FOR` und `GROUP BY` zu verarbeiten und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Datum zu ermitteln.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `RETURNING VALUE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             key   TYPE ty_flight_key,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights_by_group
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD summarize_flights_by_group.
    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ASCENDING
      ( key-carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        key-fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        count = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_string_tmpl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_string_tmpl IMPLEMENTATION.

      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>utclong_from_syst( )
      message   = |User { nvl( iv_user, sy-uname ) } logged: { iv_message_text }|
      user_id   = nvl( iv_user, sy-uname )

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft sowie die Gesamtkapazität der Sitze pro Gesellschaft. Nutzen Sie dabei die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der `COUNT` Aggregatfunktion und `SUM` für die Kapazität.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary_line) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_capacity = SUM( ls_sflight-seatsocc + ls_sflight-seatsfree )
      ).
      APPEND ls_summary_line TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summary ). " Ensure table is not empty for test

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouping=>ty_flight_summary(
      carrid = 'AA'
      flight_count = 0
      total_capacity = 0
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_aa_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'Flight count for AA should not be zero' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-total_capacity exp = 0 msg = 'Total capacity for AA should not be zero' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No summary found for carrier AA' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine deklarative und performante Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` und `SUM(...)` sind Aggregatfunktionen, die direkt im Schleifenkopf verwendet werden können, um Gruppenergebnisse zu berechnen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit manueller Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, COUNT, SUM

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und einer Mindestkapazität von 200 Sitzen enthält, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR` Expression in Verbindung mit `VALUE #(...)` und `WHERE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_min_capacity TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND ( ls_sflight-seatsocc + ls_sflight-seatsfree ) >= iv_min_capacity )
        ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
          connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
          fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
          capacity = ls_sflight-seatsocc + ls_sflight-seatsfree )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
