  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_process_type_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_process_type_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ctx_process_type( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_process_type_message( ).

    " In einem Unit-Test läuft das Programm im Dialogmodus.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Programm läuft im Dialogprozess.'
                                        msg = 'Message for dialog process incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden `is_dialog()` und `is_background()` der Klasse `cl_abap_context_info` ermöglichen eine einfache Unterscheidung des aktuellen Prozesstyps. Dies ist wichtig für die Anpassung des Programmverhaltens an die Laufzeitumgebung.
keywords: CONTEXT, DIALOG, BACKGROUND, cl_abap_context_info, CONDITIONAL

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Tabellentyp mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel (UNIQUE KEY) und füllen Sie diesen mit Daten, um die Eindeutigkeit zu demonstrieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ... WITH UNIQUE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_typ_unique_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item.
    TYPES: ty_t_items TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS get_unique_items RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE ty_t_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_typ_unique_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_items.
    TRY.
        rt_items = VALUE #( ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' )
                            ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' )
                            ( id = 1 name = 'Item C' ) ). " This will cause a dump
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        " Handle duplicate key error, e.g., log it or return partial data
        rt_items = VALUE #( ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' )
                            ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_typ_unique_key( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_cut->get_unique_items( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should contain 2 unique items' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[1]-id exp = 1 msg = 'First item ID incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[2]-name exp = 'Item B' msg = 'Second item name incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Definition eines `UNIQUE KEY` für interne Tabellen stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge basierend auf den Schlüsselkomponenten existieren können. Dies ist entscheidend für die Datenkonsistenz und kann Laufzeitfehler (`cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key`) verursachen, wenn versucht wird, Duplikate einzufügen.
keywords: TYPES, INTERNAL TABLES, UNIQUE KEY, SORTED TABLE, EXCEPTION HANDLING

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge der Tabelle `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_counts IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA gt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    gt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 120 )
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 )
                           ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B737' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 160 )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250101' price = '110.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 90 )
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '220.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 280 )
                           ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0005' fldate = '20250104' price = '180.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A330' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 200 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( gt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 4 ).
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count_lh-count exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count_aa-count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `GROUP BY` in `LOOP AT` ermöglicht eine effiziente Aggregation von Daten direkt während der Schleifenverarbeitung, ohne dass separate temporäre Tabellen oder manuelle Gruppierungslogik erforderlich sind. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Fluggesellschaften aus `sflight` enthält, wobei die Fluggesellschaften in Kleinbuchstaben umgewandelt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE` und `to_lower()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_transformed_flights IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                               ( carrid = to_lower( ls_sflight-carrid )
                                 connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA gt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS test_transformed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    gt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 120 )
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transformed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_info) = lo_cut->get_transformed_flights( gt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_info ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_info INTO DATA(ls_info_lh) INDEX 1.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv, das den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflight` als CSV-String) enthält. Der Dateiname im ZIP soll 'flights.csv' sein.

CLASS zcl_zip_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_zip IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                               RETURNING VALUE(rx_zip_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_zip.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string,
          lo_zip        TYPE REF TO cl_abap_zip.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_zip.

    " Convert sflight data to CSV string
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string && |{ ls_sflight-carrid },{ ls_sflight-connid },{ ls_sflight-fldate },{ ls_sflight-price },{ ls_sflight-currency }\n|.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add CSV string to zip archive
    lo_zip->add( name    = 'flights.csv'
                 content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_by_external_encoding( )->convert( lv_csv_string ) ).

    " Save zip archive to xstring
    lo_zip->save( EXPORTING compress = abap_true
                  IMPORTING zip_data = rx_zip_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entpacken Sie ein gegebenes ZIP-Archiv (als `XSTRING`) und lesen Sie den Inhalt einer bestimmten Datei ('test.txt') daraus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ZIP` und dessen Methoden `LOAD` und `GET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_file_content_from_zip IMPORTING ix_zip_data TYPE xstring
                                      IMPORTING iv_file_name TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_file_content_from_zip.
    DATA: lo_zip TYPE REF TO cl_abap_zip,
          lx_content TYPE xstring.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_zip.
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( ix_zip_data ).
        lo_zip->get( EXPORTING name    = iv_file_name
                     IMPORTING content = lx_content ).

        rv_content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_by_external_encoding( )->convert( lx_content ).

      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., file not found or invalid zip
        rv_content = 'Error: Could not extract file or invalid ZIP data.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, wobei jede Fluggesellschaft eine interne Tabelle von Flügen enthält. Erstellen Sie eine flache Liste aller Flüge.

CLASS zcl_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_flights,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE tt_flight,
           END OF ty_airline_flights.
    TYPES tt_airline_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS flatten_flights IMPORTING it_airline_flights TYPE tt_airline_flights
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flatten_flights.
    rt_all_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_airline IN it_airline_flights
                               FOR ls_flight  IN ls_airline-flights
                               ( carrid = ls_airline-carrid
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über `sflight` und erhöhen Sie den Preis für Flüge, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen, um 10%. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und den `COND` Operator für die Preisanpassung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_prices_for_destination IMPORTING CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                          IMPORTING iv_destination TYPE s_city.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_for_destination.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) WHERE cityto = iv_destination.
      <fs_sflight>-price = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR' THEN <fs_sflight>-price * '1.10'
                                   WHEN <fs_sflight>-currency = 'USD' THEN <fs_sflight>-price * '1.10'
                                   ELSE <fs_sflight>-price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights_copy[ 3 ]-price exp = '220.00' ).

explanation: `LOOP AT ... WHERE` in Kombination mit `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ermöglicht die direkte und effiziente Bearbeitung von Tabellenzeilen, die einer Bedingung entsprechen. Der `COND` Operator bietet eine kompakte Syntax für bedingte Zuweisungen und ersetzt `IF`-`ELSEIF`-`ENDIF`-Blöcke.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv, das für jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflight` eine separate Textdatei mit deren Fluginformationen enthält. Der Dateiname soll dem Format 'flights_[CARRID].csv' folgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `CL_ABAP_ZIP=>ADD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_multi_files DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_zip_by_airline IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rx_zip_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_files IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_by_airline.
    DATA: lo_zip TYPE REF TO cl_abap_zip.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_zip.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_csv_string) TYPE string.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight INTO DATA(ls_group_flight).
        lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string && |{ ls_group_flight-carrid },{ ls_group_flight-connid },{ ls_group_flight-fldate }\n|.
      ENDLOOP.

      DATA(lv_file_name) = |flights_{ lv_carrid }.csv|.
      lo_zip->add( name    = lv_file_name
                   content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_by_external_encoding( )->convert( lv_csv_string ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_zip->save( EXPORTING compress = abap_true
                  IMPORTING zip_data = rx_zip_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_append_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) in der Tabelle `sflight`. Ignorieren Sie Flüge mit 0 maximalen Sitzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO` mit `WHERE` und einer manuellen Max-Suche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_max_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_utilization,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             utilization TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_utilization.

    METHODS get_highest_utilization_flight IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                           RETURNING VALUE(rs_highest_util_flight) TYPE ty_flight_utilization.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_max_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_utilization_flight.
    DATA: lv_max_utilization TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.00'.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE seatsmax > 0.
      DATA(lv_current_utilization) = ( CONV decfloat34( ls_sflight-seatsocc ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax ) * 100.
      IF lv_current_utilization > lv_max_utilization.
        lv_max_utilization = lv_current_utilization.
        rs_highest_util_flight = VALUE #( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
                                          connid      = ls_sflight-connid
                                          utilization = lv_max_utilization ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA gt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    gt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 ) "66.67%
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 120 ) "80.00%
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 280 ) "93.33%
                           ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B737' seatsmax = 0 seatsocc = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_highest_utilization_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_max_util( ).
    DATA(ls_highest) = lo_cut->get_highest_utilization_flight( gt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_highest-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_highest-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_highest-utilization exp = '93.33' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `REDUCE` oft für Aggregationen verwendet wird, ist eine einfache `LOOP AT ... INTO` Schleife mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und einer `IF`-Bedingung immer noch eine klare und effiziente Methode, um den Maximalwert basierend auf einer berechneten Metrik zu finden. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert ungültige Einträge vorab.
keywords: LOOP, WHERE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Calculation, Max Value

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiersitze (SEATSMAX) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'DL' aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'DL' )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge, die nach dem 01.01.2025 stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` vor `FOR GROUPS` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group,
           tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_filtered_flights.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE fldate > '20250101' )
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid )
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                    connid = flight-connid,
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_group_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_group=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0402'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250105'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20241231'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_filtered_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` mit `FOR GROUPS` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Datenverarbeitung. Zuerst werden die Daten gefiltert, und dann wird das gefilterte Ergebnis direkt gruppiert und aggregiert, alles in einem einzigen, lesbaren Ausdruck. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen ABAP-Code.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von 'LH' enthält und deren Flugpreis um 10% erhöht ist. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ts_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                      WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                      ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) EXCEPT price
                                        price = flight-price * '1.10' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ts_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( 0 ) )
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_flights = lt_flights ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( iv_carrid = 'AA' it_flights = lt_flights ).
    DATA(lv_total_ua) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( iv_carrid = 'UA' it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '200.00' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen. Sie initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei sie in jedem Schritt den Wert der Variablen aktualisiert. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr prägnante Art, Summen oder andere Aggregationen zu berechnen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Sum

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge (SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ts_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ts_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_carrier_count TYPE ts_carrier_count.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_carrier_count-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_carrier_count-count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_carrier_count TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).

explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine direkte Gruppierung von Tabellenzeilen innerhalb der Schleife. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was Aggregationen wie Zählungen sehr einfach macht.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der alle Flugnummern einer Fluggesellschaft (SFLIGHT) auflistet, getrennt durch Kommas.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates und `FOR`-Expressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_string_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ts_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_numbers_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_numbers_string.
    rv_flight_string = |
      { REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ``
          FOR flight IN it_flights
          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid ELSE s && `, ` && flight-connid ) ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Flugobjekten und iterieren Sie diese, um deren Details auszugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `NEW`-Operator für die Objekterstellung und `LOOP AT` für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ts_flight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS create_and_process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_infos) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: ms_flight_data TYPE ts_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_flight_data = is_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_info.
    rv_info = |Flight { ms_flight_data-carrid } { ms_flight_data-connid } on { ms_flight_data-fldate DATE = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_flight_objects = VALUE #( FOR data IN it_flight_data ( NEW zcl_flight_object( data ) ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_objects INTO DATA(lo_flight).
      APPEND lo_flight->get_flight_info( ) TO rt_flight_infos.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_message_text.
    " Dummy implementation for interface
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    <fs_data>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_data>-connid = '0017'. <fs_data>-fldate = '20250102'.

  ENDMETHOD.

Die anschließende `LOOP AT`-Schleife iteriert über diese Referenzen und ruft Methoden auf.
keywords: NEW, Object Orientation, CLASS, LOOP AT, FOR

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugpreis für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (SFLIGHT) direkt in der internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... REFERENCE INTO ... WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ts_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_factor TYPE s_price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_flights REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      lr_flight->price = lr_flight->price * iv_factor.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_updater=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_updater( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_prices( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_factor = '1.20' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-price exp = '120.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ]-price exp = '180.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ]-price exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... REFERENCE INTO` ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung von Tabellenzeilen, ohne dass eine explizite `MODIFY`-Anweisung erforderlich ist. In Kombination mit der `WHERE`-Klausel ist dies eine sehr effiziente Methode, um spezifische Einträge in einer internen Tabelle zu aktualisieren.
keywords: LOOP AT, REFERENCE INTO, WHERE, Internal Table, Update

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen externen String, der in einer bestimmten Codepage (z.B. ISO-8859-1) vorliegt, in die interne ABAP-Codepage (UTF-8).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in` und `convert`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_charset_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_iso_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_iso_string TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_charset_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_iso_to_utf8.
    DATA: lo_converter TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.

    lo_converter = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
      encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      input    = iv_iso_string
    ).

    lo_converter->read( IMPORTING data = rv_utf8_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_iso_to_utf8 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_iso_to_utf8.
    DATA: lv_iso_string TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lv_test_char  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'ä'. " German umlaut

    " Simulate an ISO-8859-1 encoded string (e.g., 'ä' is X'E4')
    lv_iso_string = '48616C6C6F2077656C742120E4'. " 'Hallo welt! ä' in ISO-8859-1

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_charset_converter( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_utf8_result) = lo_cut->convert_iso_to_utf8( lv_iso_string ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_utf8_result exp = 'Hallo welt! ä' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_conv_obj` ist das zentrale Werkzeug für die Zeichenkonvertierung in ABAP. `create_in` erstellt einen Konverter für eingehende Daten aus einer spezifischen Codepage. Die Methode `read` liest die konvertierten Daten in den Ziel-String. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Verarbeitung externer Daten.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_obj, Character Set, Conversion, Encoding, XSTRING, ISO-8859-1, UTF-8

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen internen ABAP-String in eine externe Codepage (z.B. UTF-16BE) für die Ausgabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out` und `convert`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_charset_output_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_utf16be
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_utf16be_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_charset_output_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_utf16be.
    DATA: lo_converter TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    lo_converter = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      encoding = 'UTF-16BE'
      endian   = 'BIG'
      replacement = '#'
    ).

    lo_converter->write( EXPORTING data = iv_utf8_string ).
    rx_utf16be_xstring = lo_converter->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_utf8_to_utf16be FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf8_to_utf16be.
    DATA(lv_utf8_string) = 'Hallo Welt! äöüß'.
    DATA(lx_expected_utf16be) TYPE xstring.

    " Expected UTF-16BE for 'Hallo Welt! äöüß'
    " H: 0048, a: 0061, l: 006C, l: 006C, o: 006F,  : 0020, W: 0057, e: 0065, l: 006C, t: 0074, !: 0021,  : 0020
    " ä: 00E4, ö: 00F6, ü: 00FC, ß: 00DF
    lx_expected_utf16be = '00480061006C006C006F002000570065006C00740021002000E400F600FC00DF'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_charset_output_converter( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lx_utf16be_result) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_utf16be( lv_utf8_string ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_utf16be_result exp = lx_expected_utf16be ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für die Ausgabe von Daten in einer spezifischen externen Codepage wird `cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out` verwendet. Hier wird der interne UTF-8-String in UTF-16BE konvertiert. Die Methode `write` fügt den String zum Konverterpuffer hinzu, und `get_buffer` liefert das Ergebnis als XSTRING, was für binäre Datenströme geeignet ist.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_obj, Character Set, Conversion, Encoding, XSTRING, UTF-16BE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle von Flugstatus-Texten basierend auf dem Flugstatus-Code (SFLIGHT), wobei 'X' für 'Cancelled', 'O' für 'On Time' und alles andere für 'Delayed' steht.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR`-Expression mit `COND` oder `SWITCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ts_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_status_text,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ts_flight_status_text.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status_texts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_status_text WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_status_to_text
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_texts) TYPE tt_flight_status_texts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_status_to_text.
    rt_status_texts = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                  connid = flight-connid,
                                  status_text = SWITCH string(
                                    flight-status
                                    WHEN 'X' THEN 'Cancelled'
                                    WHEN 'O' THEN 'On Time'
                                    ELSE 'Delayed' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_status_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_mapping.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_status_mapper=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-status = 'O'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-status = 'X'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-status = 'D'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->map_flight_status_to_text( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-status_text exp = 'On Time' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status_text exp = 'Cancelled' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-status_text exp = 'Delayed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SWITCH`-Expression innerhalb einer `FOR`-Expression und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten während der Transformation einer internen Tabelle. Dies ersetzt längere `IF`-`ELSE IF`-Konstrukte und macht den Code funktionaler.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Internal Table

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Daten für die nächsten 7 Tage, beginnend mit dem heutigen Datum.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `FROM 1 TO 7` und Datumskalkulationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_seven_days
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dates) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_seven_days.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    rt_dates = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > 6 ( lv_today + i ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_date_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_result_dates) = lo_cut->get_next_seven_days( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_dates ) exp = 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_dates[ 1 ] exp = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_dates[ 7 ] exp = sy-datum + 6 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit `FROM ... UNTIL` ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, Schleifen für eine feste Anzahl von Iterationen zu definieren. Hier wird sie verwendet, um eine Tabelle mit aufeinanderfolgenden Daten zu generieren, indem das aktuelle Datum inkrementell erhöht wird.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Date, Loop, Iteration

Instructions: Ketten Sie Methodenaufrufe, um eine Liste von Flügen (SFLIGHT) zu filtern, deren Preise zu erhöhen und dann die Flugnummern als String zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie Method Chaining und funktionale Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ts_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

    METHODS increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_factor TYPE s_price
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

    METHODS get_connid_string
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid_string) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS process_flights_chained
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid          TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_factor          TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD increase_prices.
    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) EXCEPT price
                                     price = flight-price * iv_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_connid_string.
    rv_connid_string = |
      { REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ``
          FOR flight IN it_flights
          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid ELSE s && `, ` && flight-connid ) ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flights_chained.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_chaining( ).

    rv_final_string = lo_processor->get_connid_string(
                        it_flights = lo_processor->increase_prices(
                                       iv_factor = iv_factor
                                       it_flights = lo_processor->filter_by_carrier(
                                                      iv_carrid = iv_carrid
                                                      it_flights = it_initial_flights ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_chaining=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lv_result) = zcl_flight_chaining=>process_flights_chained(
                         it_initial_flights = lt_flights
                         iv_carrid          = 'LH'
                         iv_factor          = '1.10' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0400, 0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, kombiniert mit funktionalen Ausdrücken wie `FILTER`, `VALUE` und `REDUCE`, ermöglicht es, komplexe Datenverarbeitungspipelines in einer sehr flüssigen und lesbaren Weise zu schreiben. Jede Methode gibt ein Ergebnis zurück, das direkt als Eingabe für die nächste Methode dient.
keywords: Method Chaining, Functional Programming, FILTER, VALUE, REDUCE, Internal Table

Instructions: Kopieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHT) in eine andere, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen werden sollen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_full,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ts_flight_full.
    TYPES: tt_flights_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ts_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flights_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_key_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_flights_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_flights_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_key_fields.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_copy_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_fields.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_flight_copy=>tt_flights_full.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>).
    <fs_source>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_source>-connid = '0400'. <fs_source>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_source>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_source>.
    <fs_source>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_source>-connid = '0017'. <fs_source>-fldate = '20250102'. <fs_source>-price = '200.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_copy( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->copy_key_fields( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion zum Zuweisen von Werten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit (teilweise) gleichen Feldnamen. Mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel kann man explizit festlegen, welche Felder kopiert werden sollen, was eine präzise und effiziente Datenübertragung ermöglicht.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Copy, Mapping

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei Duplikate basierend auf einem Schlüssel vermieden werden sollen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` oder `FOR` mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_merge DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ts_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flights_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ts_flight_key
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS merge_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_flights_key
      CHANGING
        ct_target_flights TYPE tt_flights_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_merge IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_flights.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source_flights INTO TABLE ct_target_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_merge_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_flights.
    DATA: lt_target TYPE zcl_flight_merge=>tt_flights_key.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_target ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'.

    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_flight_merge=>tt_flights_key.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. " Duplicate
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'. " New entry

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_merge( ).
    lo_cut->merge_flights( EXPORTING it_source_flights = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_flights = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_target[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_target[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_target[ carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`-Anweisung ist eine effiziente Methode, um mehrere Zeilen aus einer Tabelle in eine andere einzufügen. Die `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`-Klausel ist besonders nützlich für Tabellen mit eindeutigen Schlüsseln, da sie verhindert, dass Laufzeitfehler bei doppelten Einträgen auftreten, und stattdessen die Duplikate einfach ignoriert werden.
keywords: INSERT LINES, Internal Table, Merge, Duplicates, Sorted Table

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Flugstruktur (SFLIGHT) basierend auf dem Feldnamen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den dynamischen Feldzugriff mit `(field_name)` oder `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutze den REDUCE-Operator mit einer lokalen Variablen für die Summe und iteriere über die gefilterten SFLIGHT-Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR wa IN it_sflight
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + wa-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verkette alle Fluggesellschafts-IDs (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Vermeide doppelte Einträge.
hint: Nutze REDUCE in Kombination mit einer internen Hash-Tabelle oder einem SET für die eindeutigen IDs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carrids_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids_string.
    DATA: lt_unique_carrids TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR wa IN it_sflight
      WHERE ( fldate > iv_date )
      LET carrid_added = lt_unique_carrids-carrid IS NOT INITIAL IN
      IF NOT carrid_added.
        INSERT wa-carrid INTO TABLE lt_unique_carrids.
        IF result IS INITIAL.
          NEXT result = wa-carrid
        ELSE.
          NEXT result = result && `,` && wa-carrid
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concat_carrids FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_carrids.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_reduce_concat_carrid=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250103'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_carrid( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrids_string( iv_date = '20250101' it_sflight = lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'AA,LH' ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser REDUCE-Operator demonstriert die Verkettung von Strings mit einer Bedingung und der Vermeidung von Duplikaten. Die Verwendung von `LET` für lokale Variablen innerhalb des REDUCE-Ausdrucks und einer Hash-Tabelle zur Überprüfung auf Eindeutigkeit macht den Code sehr effizient und lesbar.

Instructions: Finde den höchsten Flugpreis (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.

                                FOR wa IN it_sflight
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT max_price = nmax( val1 = max_price val2 = wa-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere die Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermittle für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Das Ergebnis soll in einer neuen internen Tabelle gespeichert werden.
hint: Kombiniere REDUCE mit einer internen Hash-Tabelle oder einem Map-ähnlichen Ansatz, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_temp_agg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             sum_price TYPE sflight-price,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_temp_agg.
    TYPES: tt_temp_agg TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_temp_agg WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    DATA(lt_temp_agg) = REDUCE tt_temp_agg(
      INIT temp_table = VALUE tt_temp_agg( )
      FOR wa IN it_sflight
      LET current_entry = temp_table[ KEY carrid = wa-carrid DEFAULT VALUE ty_temp_agg( carrid = wa-carrid ) ] IN
      NEXT temp_table = VALUE tt_temp_agg(
        temp_table,
        ( carrid = wa-carrid
          sum_price = current_entry-sum_price + wa-price
          count = current_entry-count + 1 )
      )
    ).

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE tt_grouped_result(
      FOR wa_agg IN lt_temp_agg
      ( carrid = wa_agg-carrid
        flight_count = wa_agg-count
        avg_price = COND #( WHEN wa_agg-count > 0 THEN wa_agg-sum_price / wa_agg-count ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_reduce_group_sflight=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-price = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-price = 150.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrid( it_sflight = lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-avg_price exp = 150 ).

    DATA(ls_aa) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-avg_price exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von REDUCE zur Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten. Es wird eine temporäre Hash-Tabelle verwendet, um Zwischenergebnisse zu speichern, und dann ein weiterer FOR-Ausdruck, um die finalen Durchschnittswerte zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und performante Art, Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren, ohne explizite LOOP-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Grouping, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Hashed Table, COND

Instructions: Erstelle eine Liste von Flugobjekten (Instanzen einer lokalen Klasse), indem du die Daten aus der SFLIGHT-Tabelle reduzierst. Jedes Objekt soll die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Datum enthalten.
hint: Verwende REDUCE, um eine interne Tabelle von Objektreferenzen zu erstellen. Die Objekte können in einer lokalen Klasse definiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_to_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS lcl_flight DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA: carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
        DATA: connid TYPE sflight-connid.
        DATA: fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                      iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                      iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        me->carrid = iv_carrid.
        me->connid = iv_connid.
        me->fldate = iv_fldate.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: ty_flight_ref TYPE REF TO lcl_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flight_refs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_ref WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flight_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_objects) TYPE tt_flight_refs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_to_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_objects.
    rt_flight_objects = REDUCE tt_flight_refs(
      INIT flights = VALUE tt_flight_refs( )
      FOR wa IN it_sflight
      NEXT flights = VALUE tt_flight_refs( flights ( NEW lcl_flight( iv_carrid = wa-carrid
                                                                     iv_connid = wa-connid
                                                                     iv_fldate = wa-fldate ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_objects.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_reduce_to_objects=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250102'.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie REDUCE verwendet werden kann, um eine interne Tabelle von Objektreferenzen zu erstellen. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und moderne Art, Daten aus einer flachen Struktur in eine objektorientierte Darstellung zu transformieren, ohne explizite LOOP- und APPEND-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Ermittle den Namen des übergeordneten Pakets für ein gegebenes Entwicklungsobjekt (z.B. eine Klasse oder ein Funktionsbaustein).
hint: Verwende die Klasse CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES und ihre Methode GET_PARENT_PACKAGE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_get_parent_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_parent_package_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_parent_package) TYPE devclass
      RAISING
        cx_pak_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_get_parent_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_parent_package_name.
    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    rv_parent_package = lo_package_queries->get_parent_package( iv_package_name = iv_object_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_parent_package FOR TESTING RAISING cx_pak_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_parent_package.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_get_parent_package( ).
    " Annahme: ZLOCAL ist ein existierendes Paket ohne übergeordnetes Paket oder ein Testpaket
    " Für einen echten Test müsste ein Paket mit bekanntem Parent verwendet werden.
    " Hier wird ein Dummy-Wert verwendet, da die Methode eine Ausnahme werfen könnte, wenn das Paket nicht existiert.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_parent) = lo_cut->get_parent_package_name( 'ZLOCAL' ).
        " Wenn ZLOCAL kein Parent hat, sollte der Rückgabewert leer sein oder eine spezifische Ausnahme auftreten.
        " Für diesen Test nehmen wir an, dass 'ZLOCAL' kein Parent hat.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_parent ).
      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        " Erwartete Ausnahme, wenn das Paket nicht existiert oder die Methode fehlschlägt.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception caught for ZLOCAL, adjust test data.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Beispiel für ein Paket, das ein Parent haben könnte (muss im System existieren)
    " DATA(lv_parent_for_subpackage) = lo_cut->get_parent_package_name( 'Z_MY_SUBPACKAGE' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_parent_for_subpackage exp = 'Z_MY_MAIN_PACKAGE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES` bietet eine standardisierte API, um Informationen über ABAP-Pakete abzufragen. Die Verwendung von `GET_INSTANCE` und der direkten Methode `GET_PARENT_PACKAGE` ist der moderne Weg, um solche Metadaten programmatisch zu ermitteln, anstatt auf veraltete Funktionsbausteine oder direkte Tabellenzugriffe zurückzugreifen.
keywords: CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES, Package, Dynamic Programming, Metadaten, ABAP Development Tools

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein bestimmtes ABAP-Paket im System existiert.
hint: Nutze die Klasse CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES und eine ihrer Methoden, die die Existenz eines Pakets validieren kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_check_existence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_package_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_check_existence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_package_exists.
    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.
        lo_package_queries->get_package_info( iv_package_name = iv_package_name ).
        rv_exists = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_package_existence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_package_existence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_check_existence( ).

    " Test für ein existierendes Paket (z.B. 'SFLIGHT')
    DATA(lv_exists_sflight) = lo_cut->check_package_exists( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exists_sflight ).

    " Test für ein nicht-existierendes Paket
    DATA(lv_exists_nonexistent) = lo_cut->check_package_exists( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_PAK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exists_nonexistent ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Anstatt direkt in Systemtabellen wie TADIR zu suchen, bietet `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES` eine robuste und API-basierte Methode zur Überprüfung der Paketexistenz. Die Methode `GET_PACKAGE_INFO` wirft eine Ausnahme, wenn das Paket nicht gefunden wird, was eine saubere Fehlerbehandlung mittels TRY-CATCH ermöglicht.
keywords: CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES, Package, Existence Check, Dynamic Programming, Exception Handling

Instructions: Lese alle Entwicklungsobjekte (z.B. Klassen, Funktionsgruppen) aus einem bestimmten ABAP-Paket aus.
hint: Verwende die Klasse CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES und eine Methode, die den Inhalt eines Pakets liefert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_get_package_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_object,
             object_type TYPE trobjtype,
             object_name TYPE trobj_name,
           END OF ty_package_object.
    TYPES: tt_package_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_package_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_objects_in_package
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_package_objects) TYPE tt_package_objects
      RAISING
        cx_pak_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_get_package_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_objects_in_package.
    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_objects) = lo_package_queries->get_objects_in_package( iv_package_name = iv_package_name ).

    rt_package_objects = VALUE tt_package_objects(
      FOR ls_object IN lt_objects
      ( object_type = ls_object-object_type
        object_name = ls_object-object_name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_package_objects FOR TESTING RAISING cx_pak_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_package_objects.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_get_package_objects( ).

    " Test für ein bekanntes Paket (z.B. 'SFLIGHT')
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_objects) = lo_cut->get_objects_in_package( 'SFLIGHT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_objects ).
        " Überprüfe, ob mindestens ein Objekt vom Typ 'CLAS' (Klasse) oder 'PROG' (Report) vorhanden ist
        DATA(lv_found_class) = abap_false.
        LOOP AT lt_objects INTO DATA(ls_object).
          IF ls_object-object_type = 'CLAS' OR ls_object-object_type = 'PROG'.
            lv_found_class = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_class ).

      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception caught for SFLIGHT package.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Test für ein nicht-existierendes Paket
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_objects_in_package( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_PAK' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_pak_error for non-existent package.' ).
      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ). " Exception ist wie erwartet aufgetreten
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `GET_OBJECTS_IN_PACKAGE` der Klasse `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES` ist der moderne Weg, um den Inhalt eines ABAP-Pakets abzufragen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine elegante Transformation der zurückgegebenen Daten in eine benutzerdefinierte Struktur.
keywords: CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES, Package, Objects, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) und Flugnummern (CONNID) aus der SFLIGHT-Tabelle enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwende den FOR-Operator in Kombination mit dem VALUE-Operator, um die Transformation und Filterung durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR wa IN it_sflight
      WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( carrid = wa-carrid
        connid = wa-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_transform.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_for_filter_transform=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_sflight>-price = 250.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_sflight>-price = 50.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_min_price = 120 it_sflight = lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Operator in Kombination mit VALUE ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und kompakte Syntax zur Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt mehrere Zeilen Code mit expliziten LOOP- und IF-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit erheblich.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filter, Transform, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_string_template_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
