Instructions: Bestimme den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Günstig', 'Normal', 'Teuer') basierend auf seinem Preis (PRICE) und gib diesen Status zurück.
hint: Verwende den COND-Operator für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE ty_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN is_sflight-price < 100 THEN 'Günstig'
      WHEN is_sflight-price < 300 THEN 'Normal'
      ELSE 'Teuer'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE zcl_cond_flight_status=>ty_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).

    ls_sflight-price = 50.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight ) exp = 'Günstig' ).

    ls_sflight-price = 150.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight ) exp = 'Normal' ).

    ls_sflight-price = 350.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight ) exp = 'Teuer' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht eine bedingte Zuweisung in einem Ausdruck, was den Code für einfache IF-ELSE-IF-Konstrukte erheblich verkürzt und lesbarer macht. Er ist ideal für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Strukturen in eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und den Preis (PRICE) als String enthält, wobei der Preis mit zwei Dezimalstellen formatiert ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_format_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Der CONV-Operator ermöglicht die Typkonvertierung in einem Ausdruck. In Kombination mit String-Templates und der `COUNTRY`-Option kann man numerische Werte direkt in formatierte Strings umwandeln, was besonders nützlich für die Darstellung von Währungen oder Zahlen ist. Instructions: Kopiere Daten von einer SFLIGHT-Struktur in eine andere Struktur, die nur die Felder CARRID, CONNID und FLDATE enthält, unter Verwendung des CORRESPONDING-Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_sflight_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,

unit_test:

Mit der `BASE`-Option können zusätzliche Felder initialisiert oder vorbelegt werden, was den Code sehr flexibel macht.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus der SFLIGHT-Tabelle für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und speichere sie in einer internen Tabelle, wobei die interne Tabelle direkt in der SELECT-Anweisung deklariert wird.
hint: Nutze SELECT mit INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights) für die Inline-Deklaration der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_inline_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_select_inline_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_from_db)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_sflight = lt_flights_from_db.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_inline.
    " Annahme: Es gibt Einträge in SFLIGHT für 'AA'
    " Für einen echten Test müsste SFLIGHT mit Testdaten befüllt werden.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_inline_data( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrid( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_no_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration von Datenobjekten (`@DATA(...)`) direkt in der SELECT-Anweisung ist ein Feature von ABAP 7.40+. Es reduziert die Notwendigkeit, interne Tabellen explizit vorab zu deklarieren, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht, insbesondere bei einfachen Datenbankabfragen.
keywords: SELECT, Inline Declaration, Database Access, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle von Integern.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_negative FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_positive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( -1 ) ( -2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Die Initialisierung `INIT s = 0` und die Iteration `FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num` sind sehr ausdrucksstark und vermeiden explizite Schleifen.
keywords: REDUCE, NUMBER, SUM, Internal Table, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die das Quadrat jeder Zahl aus einer Quelltabelle enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_square_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_squares IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rt_squares) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle von Integern. Behandeln Sie den Fall einer leeren Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `LINES` für die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0. 
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft jede eindeutige Zahl in einer internen Tabelle vorkommt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_number_count,
        number TYPE i,
        count  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_number_count,
      ty_number_count_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_number_count WITH UNIQUE KEY number.

    METHODS count_occurrences IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_number_count_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_occurrences.
    rt_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF number IN it_numbers
      GROUP BY number
      ( number = <group>-number
        count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR member IN <group> NEXT c = c + 1 ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_max_number DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_number IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_max) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_max_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_number.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_max = 0. " Oder eine andere Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Exception
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    rv_max = REDUCE i( INIT m = it_numbers[1] FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT m = COND #( WHEN num > m THEN num ELSE m ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer `SFLIGHTS`-ähnlichen Tabelle, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).

CLASS zcl_sum_prices_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      ty_flight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_sum,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        total_price TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_carrier_sum,
      ty_carrier_sum_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_sum WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_total_prices IMPORTING it_flights TYPE ty_flight_table
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_sums) TYPE ty_carrier_sum_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_prices_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_prices.
    rt_carrier_sums = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF flight IN it_flights
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid = <group>-carrid
        total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN <group> NEXT s = s + member-price ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_all_numbers_positive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_all_positive IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_all_positive) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_all_numbers_positive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_all_positive.
    DATA(lv_negative_exists) = COND abap_bool( 
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_numbers[ WHERE table_line <= 0 ] ) THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
    rv_all_positive = NOT lv_negative_exists.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum und dem aktuellen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract` für Zeitstempel-Differenzen und konvertieren Sie in Jahre.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_age DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_birthdate TYPE d
        iv_current_date TYPE d DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_age IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_age_in_years.
    DATA(lv_birth_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date = iv_birthdate ).
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date = iv_current_date ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
                                       tstmp1 = lv_current_tstmp
                                       tstmp2 = lv_birth_tstmp ).

    rv_age = lv_diff_seconds / ( 365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern und Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagiere (`passengers`) für jede Gruppe. Geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...) GROUP BY ...` mit der `CORRESPONDING` Klausel für die Ergebnisstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_pass TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        ls_summary-total_pass = ls_summary-total_pass + ls_grouped_flight-passengers.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob für 'LH' ein Eintrag existiert und Passagiere > 0 sind

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (`fldate`) und Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus `sflights` enthält. Die Fluggesellschaft soll dabei in Kleinbuchstaben umgewandelt werden.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                 carrid = to_lower( ls_flight-carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression mit `DATA(...)` für die Akkumulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                         FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                         NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passengers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gehen Sie durch eine Liste von Zahlen und kategorisieren Sie jede Zahl als 'Klein' (<= 10), 'Mittel' (> 10 und <= 100) oder 'Groß' (> 100). Geben Sie die Zahl und ihre Kategorie zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` und eine `CASE` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_categorized_number,
             value    TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_categorized_number.
    TYPES tt_categorized_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_categorized_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_numbers
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_categorized) TYPE tt_categorized_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_numbers.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      DATA(ls_categorized) = VALUE ty_categorized_number( value = lv_number ).
      CASE lv_number.
        WHEN 0 TO 10.
          ls_categorized-category = 'Klein'.
        WHEN 11 TO 100.
          ls_categorized-category = 'Mittel'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          ls_categorized-category = 'Groß'.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_categorized TO rt_categorized.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->categorize_numbers( lt_input ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für eine Liste von Flugsegmenten aus `sflights` die Dauer jedes Fluges in Minuten. Nehmen Sie an, dass `fldate` und `deptime` den Startzeitpunkt und `arrtime` den Endzeitpunkt am selben Tag darstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` und die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` zur Zeitstempelberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             duration_min TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES tt_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_flight_durations
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_durations) TYPE tt_flight_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_flight_durations.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ls_flight-fldate
                                                                        iv_time = ls_flight-deptime ).
      DATA(lv_end_tstmp)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ls_flight-fldate
                                                                        iv_time = ls_flight-arrtime ).
      DATA(lv_diff_sec)    = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( iv_tstmp1 = lv_end_tstmp
                                                      iv_tstmp2 = lv_start_tstmp ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_duration( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                       connid = ls_flight-connid
                                       fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                       duration_min = lv_diff_sec / 60 ) TO rt_durations.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Prüfen, ob für einen bekannten Flug die Dauer plausibel ist (z.B. > 0)
    READ TABLE lt_durations INTO DATA(ls_first_duration) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_duration-duration_min >= 0 ) ##NO_TEXT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` Anweisung wird verwendet, um jeden Flug einzeln zu verarbeiten. `DATA(...)` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration von Zeitstempelvariablen. Die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` bietet moderne Methoden zur Manipulation und Berechnung mit Zeitstempeln, was die Handhabung von Datums- und Zeitberechnungen erheblich vereinfacht und robuster macht.
keywords: LOOP, DATA, Date/Time, Time Calculation, cl_abap_tstmp

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob es in der Tabelle `sflights` Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' gibt, ohne die Daten der gefundenen Zeile zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE ...` und `DATA(...)` für die Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_lh_flights_exist
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_lh_flights_exist.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent.
    " Für diesen Test müsste man eine Tabelle ohne 'XX' Flüge haben oder eine Mock-Tabelle verwenden.
    " Hier wird nur die Funktionalität demonstriert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_exists( ).
    " Da die Methode direkt auf sflights zugreift, ist ein negativer Test schwierig ohne Mocking.
    " Wir simulieren hier nur den Aufruf.
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_lh_flights_exist( ).
    " Wenn 'LH' nicht existiert, wäre dies false. Da es existiert, ist es true.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ) ##NO_TEXT.
  ENDMETHOD.

In Kombination mit der `WHERE` Klausel und `EXIT` bei erstem Treffer ist dies die performanteste Art, die Existenz eines Eintrags zu prüfen. `DATA(...)` wird hier für die Inline-Deklaration der Schleifenvariable in der `WHERE` Klausel verwendet.
keywords: LOOP, DATA, Internal Tables, Existence Check, TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             sflights,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                            ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )
                              status = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-actdep = ls_flight-schdep THEN 'On Time'
                                                   ELSE 'Delayed' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit den meisten Passagieren aus der Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie dessen Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` mit `MAXIMUM` oder `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_pass DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_max_flight.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE ty_max_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_pass IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rs_max_flight = REDUCE ty_max_flight(
      INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_max_flight( passengers = -1 )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ls_flight-passengers > max_flight-passengers
      NEXT max_flight = VALUE ty_max_flight( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                             connid = ls_flight-connid
                                             passengers = ls_flight-passengers )
      ELSE max_flight = max_flight
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_passengers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_max_flight-passengers >= 0 ) ##NO_TEXT.
    " Weitere spezifische Prüfungen wären hier sinnvoll, wenn Testdaten bekannt sind.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression wird hier verwendet, um iterativ den Flug mit den meisten Passagieren zu finden. `INIT` initialisiert eine Struktur, die den aktuellen Maximalwert speichert. Die `WHERE` Klausel innerhalb von `REDUCE` ist eine ABAP 7.50+ Erweiterung, die die Bedingung für die Aktualisierung des Akkumulators direkt im Ausdruck ermöglicht. `DATA(...)` wird implizit für die Schleifenvariable `ls_flight` verwendet.
keywords: REDUCE, DATA, Internal Tables, Aggregation, MAXIMUM

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_flight_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                           flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `LINES` für den Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
      connid = ls_sflight-connid
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
    ) ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_max_index
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_sflight FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) = lo_cut->get_random_sflight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_sflight-carrid msg = 'A flight should be returned' ).

    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @ls_sflight-carrid
        AND connid = @ls_sflight-connid
        AND fldate = @ls_sflight-fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_check_sflight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_check_sflight-carrid msg = 'Returned flight should exist in sflights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode liest alle Flüge in eine interne Tabelle und wählt dann mit `cl_abap_random_int` einen zufälligen Index, um einen Eintrag zu lesen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Tabelleninitialisierung ist modern.

Instructions: Mischen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) zufällig.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Hilfstabelle mit Zufallszahlen und sortieren Sie danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shuffle_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_shuffler,
             random_key TYPE i,
             sflight    TYPE ty_sflight,
           END OF ty_shuffler.
    TYPES tt_shuffler TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_shuffler WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 1000000 ). " Large range for better randomness

    DATA(lt_shuffler) = VALUE tt_shuffler(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( )
        sflight    = ls_sflight )
    ).

    SORT lt_shuffler BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_shuffler IN lt_shuffler
      ( ls_shuffler-sflight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shuffle_table( ).
    DATA(lt_original_sflights) = VALUE zcl_shuffle_table=>tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      )
    ).

    IF lines( lt_original_sflights ) < 2. " Need at least 2 entries to shuffle
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Not enough data in sflights for shuffle test' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_shuffled_sflights) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_shuffled_sflights )
      exp = lines( lt_original_sflights )
      msg = 'Number of entries should remain the same'
    ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_original) = lt_original_sflights.
    SORT lt_sorted_original BY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA(lt_sorted_shuffled) = lt_shuffled_sflights.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled BY carrid connid fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sorted_shuffled
      exp = lt_sorted_original
      msg = 'Content should be identical after sorting'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs(
      act = lt_shuffled_sflights
      exp = lt_original_sflights
      msg = 'Order should be different after shuffling (probabilistic)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine interne Tabelle wird mit einer zufälligen Sortierspalte erweitert und dann nach dieser Spalte sortiert. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um Tabellen zufällig zu mischen. `VALUE` und `FOR` sind hierbei Schlüssel für modernen Code.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, Shuffle, SORT, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und String-Templates mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string IMPORTING iv_length TYPE i
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_chars_len - 1 ).

    rv_random_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
      NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1)
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_string_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_content FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_string_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 10.
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( lv_length ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ) exp = lv_length ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_string_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string( ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( 5 ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_is_alphanumeric) = xsdbool( match( val = lv_random_string regex = `^[A-Za-z0-9]*$` ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_alphanumeric msg = 'String should contain only alphanumeric characters' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um iterativ Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Satz von Zeichen auszuwählen, die durch `cl_abap_random_int` zufällig bestimmt werden. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Strings zu generieren.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie 100 Würfelwürfe (1-6) und zählen Sie, wie oft jede Zahl gewürfelt wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Hash-Tabelle zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_roll DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_roll_count,
             dice_value TYPE i,
             count      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_roll_count.
    TYPES tt_roll_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_roll_count WITH UNIQUE KEY dice_value.

    METHODS simulate_dice_rolls IMPORTING iv_num_rolls TYPE i DEFAULT 100
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_roll_counts) TYPE tt_roll_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_roll IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_dice_rolls.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 6 ).
    DATA(lt_roll_counts) = VALUE tt_roll_count( ).

    LOOP AT sy-tab_lines INTO DATA(lv_index) FROM 1 TO iv_num_rolls.
      DATA(lv_roll) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      COLLECT VALUE ty_roll_count( dice_value = lv_roll count = 1 ) INTO lt_roll_counts.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_roll_counts = lt_roll_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dice_roll_simulation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dice_roll_simulation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_roll( ).
    DATA(lv_num_rolls) = 1000. " Increase rolls for better statistical distribution
    DATA(lt_roll_counts) = lo_cut->simulate_dice_rolls( lv_num_rolls ).

    DATA(lv_total_rolls) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_roll_counts INTO DATA(ls_roll_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_roll_count-dice_value >= 1 AND ls_roll_count-dice_value <= 6 ) ).
      lv_total_rolls = lv_total_rolls + ls_roll_count-count.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_rolls exp = lv_num_rolls ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_roll_counts ) exp = 6 msg = 'All 6 sides should be present (probabilistic)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode simuliert Würfelwürfe mit `cl_abap_random_int` und zählt die Ergebnisse effizient mit einer Hash-Tabelle und `COLLECT`.
keywords: RANDOM, Math, Dice Roll, COLLECT, Hash Table, cl_abap_random_int

CLASS zcl_tstmp_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_seconds_between.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Differenz zweier interner Tabellen (alle Einträge in Tabelle A, die nicht in Tabelle B sind). Verwenden Sie `sflights` als Basis.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `FILTER` für eine funktionale Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_difference IMPORTING it_table_a TYPE tt_sflight_full
                                               it_table_b TYPE tt_sflight_full
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_difference) TYPE tt_sflight_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_difference.
    " Create a hashed table of keys from table B for efficient lookup
    DATA(lt_keys_b) = VALUE tt_sflight_key(
      FOR ls_entry IN it_table_b
      ( carrid = ls_entry-carrid
        connid = ls_entry-connid )
    ).

    " Filter table A: keep entries whose key is NOT found in lt_keys_b
    rt_difference = FILTER #( it_table_a USING KEY primary_key WHERE
      carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND
      NOT ( carrid = lt_keys_b[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = carrid connid = connid ]-carrid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die verbleibende Menge eines Artikels, nachdem mehrere Abzüge von einer Startmenge vorgenommen wurden.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_quantities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_quantity IMPORTING iv_initial_quantity TYPE i
                                                     it_subtractions     TYPE tt_quantities
                                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_remaining_quantity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_quantity.
    rv_remaining_quantity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = iv_initial_quantity
      FOR lv_subtraction IN it_subtractions
      NEXT sum = sum - lv_subtraction
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutze die `REDUCE`-Expression in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>COMPARE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_min DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        it_tstmps TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF timestampl WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_tstmp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_min IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_tstmp.
    IF it_tstmps IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_tstmp = REDUCE timestampl(
      INIT min_tstmp = it_tstmps[ 1 ]
      FOR tstmp IN it_tstmps
      NEXT min_tstmp = COND timestampl(
        WHEN cl_abap_tstmp=>compare( iv_tstmp1 = tstmp iv_tstmp2 = min_tstmp ) = -1 THEN tstmp
        ELSE min_tstmp
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_in_last_hour DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_in_last_hour
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_in_last_hour) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_in_last_hour IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_in_last_hour.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_current( ).
    DATA(lv_one_hour_ago) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_current_tstmp
      iv_value  = 3600 " 3600 Sekunden = 1 Stunde
      iv_unit   = cl_abap_tstmp=>unit_second
    ).

    IF cl_abap_tstmp=>compare( iv_tstmp1 = iv_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_one_hour_ago ) = 1 AND
       cl_abap_tstmp=>compare( iv_tstmp1 = iv_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_current_tstmp ) <= 0.
      rv_is_in_last_hour = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_in_last_hour = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertiere einen Zeitstempel in eine benutzerdefinierte String-Repräsentation, z.B. 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>MOVE_TSTMP_TO_DATE_TIME` und String-Templates für die Formatierung.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_tstmp) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_tstmp.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t.

    cl_abap_tstmp=>move_tstmp_to_date_time(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp = iv_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        ev_date  = lv_date
        ev_time  = lv_time
    ).

    rv_formatted_tstmp = |{ lv_date(4) }-{ lv_date+4(2) }-{ lv_date+6(2) } { lv_time(2) }:{ lv_time+2(2) }:{ lv_time+4(2) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein Zeitstempel in der Zukunft liegt (bezogen auf den aktuellen Systemzeitstempel).
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>COMPARE` mit dem aktuellen Zeitstempel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_is_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_future_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_is_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_future_tstmp.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_current( ).
    IF cl_abap_tstmp=>compare( iv_tstmp1 = iv_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_current_tstmp ) = 1.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_future FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_is_not_future FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_future.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_is_future( ).
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_current( ).
    DATA(lv_future_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add(
      iv_tstmp = lv_current_tstmp
      iv_value = 60
      iv_unit  = cl_abap_tstmp=>unit_second
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_future_tstmp( lv_future_tstmp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_not_future.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_is_future( ).
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_current( ).
    DATA(lv_past_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_current_tstmp
      iv_value  = 60
      iv_unit   = cl_abap_tstmp=>unit_second
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_future_tstmp( lv_past_tstmp ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_future_tstmp( lv_current_tstmp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COMPARE`-Methode von `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` bietet eine zuverlässige und typsichere Möglichkeit, Zeitstempel zu vergleichen, was für Validierungen oder zeitbasierte Logik unerlässlich ist.
keywords: TIMESTAMP, FUTURE, COMPARE, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, VALIDATION

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer aufsteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `SORT` Anweisung mit der `BY` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    SORT lt_flights BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING.
    rt_sorted_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->sort_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 1.
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_current).
        IF sy-tabix > 1.
          DATA(ls_previous) = lt_result[ sy-tabix - 1 ].
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
            act = ( ls_current-carrid > ls_previous-carrid OR
                    ( ls_current-carrid = ls_previous-carrid AND
                      ls_current-connid >= ls_previous-connid ) )
            msg = 'Table is not sorted correctly'
          ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SORT` Anweisung ist die Standardmethode zum Sortieren interner Tabellen. Die `BY` Klausel ermöglicht das Sortieren nach mehreren Feldern in auf- oder absteigender Reihenfolge. Dies ist eine grundlegende, aber effiziente Operation.
keywords: SORT, Internal Table, BY, ASCENDING

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Fluggesellschaft, aber stellen Sie sicher, dass die ursprüngliche Reihenfolge der Einträge mit gleicher Fluggesellschaft beibehalten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `STABLE` Klausel mit `SORT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_stable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_index,
             original_index TYPE i,
             carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid         TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate         TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_index.
    TYPES tt_sflight_with_index TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_index WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights_stable
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_with_index.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_stable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_stable.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    DATA lt_flights_with_index TYPE tt_sflight_with_index.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      APPEND VALUE #( original_index = lv_index
                      carrid         = ls_flight-carrid
                      connid         = ls_flight-connid
                      fldate         = ls_flight-fldate ) TO lt_flights_with_index.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_flights_with_index STABLE BY carrid ASCENDING.
    rt_sorted_flights = lt_flights_with_index.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_flights_stable FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_flights_stable.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_stable( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->sort_flights_stable( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 1.
      DATA(lv_found_other_carrier) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_current).
        IF sy-tabix > 1.
          DATA(ls_previous) = lt_result[ sy-tabix - 1 ].
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
            act = ( ls_current-carrid > ls_previous-carrid OR
                    ( ls_current-carrid = ls_previous-carrid AND
                      ls_current-original_index >= ls_previous-original_index ) )
            msg = 'Table is not stable sorted correctly'
          ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `STABLE` Klausel bei `SORT` garantiert, dass die relative Reihenfolge von Zeilen, die nach den Sortierkriterien gleich sind, beibehalten wird. Dies ist wichtig, wenn eine Vorsortierung oder die ursprüngliche Reihenfolge für sekundäre Kriterien relevant ist.
keywords: SORT, STABLE, Internal Table, Relative Order

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle, die selbst eine interne Tabelle als Komponente enthält. Sortieren Sie zuerst nach dem Hauptfeld und dann nach einem Feld in der geschachtelten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit der `BY` Klausel und greifen Sie auf die geschachtelte Tabelle zu, um deren Einträge zu sortieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header,
             header_id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_header.
    TYPES tt_headers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_nested_table
      IMPORTING
        it_headers        TYPE tt_headers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted) TYPE tt_headers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_nested_table.
    rt_sorted = it_headers.

    SORT rt_sorted BY header_id ASCENDING.

    LOOP AT rt_sorted ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_header>).
      SORT <fs_header>-items BY item_id ASCENDING.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_nested_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_nested_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_nested( ).

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_sort_nested=>tt_headers(
      ( header_id = 2 description = 'Header B'
        items = VALUE zcl_sort_nested=>tt_items( ( item_id = 2 quantity = 20 ) ( item_id = 1 quantity = 10 ) ) )
      ( header_id = 1 description = 'Header A'
        items = VALUE zcl_sort_nested=>tt_items( ( item_id = 3 quantity = 30 ) ( item_id = 1 quantity = 5 ) ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_sort_nested=>tt_headers(
      ( header_id = 1 description = 'Header A'
        items = VALUE zcl_sort_nested=>tt_items( ( item_id = 1 quantity = 5 ) ( item_id = 3 quantity = 30 ) ) )
      ( header_id = 2 description = 'Header B'
        items = VALUE zcl_sort_nested=>tt_items( ( item_id = 1 quantity = 10 ) ( item_id = 2 quantity = 20 ) ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->sort_nested_table( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result
      exp = lt_expected
      msg = 'Nested table was not sorted correctly'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Sortieren geschachtelter Tabellen erfordert zwei Schritte: Zuerst die äußere Tabelle sortieren und dann in einer Schleife über die äußere Tabelle jede innere Tabelle separat sortieren. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen (`ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_header>)`) ist hier effizient, da sie direkte Referenzen auf die Tabellenzeilen ermöglicht und unnötiges Kopieren vermeidet.
keywords: SORT, Nested Table, LOOP AT ASSIGNING, Field Symbol

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach einem benutzerdefinierten Kriterium: Zuerst sollen alle Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft erscheinen, danach die restlichen Flüge, sortiert nach Flugdatum.

CLASS zcl_sort_custom_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_custom,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             sort_key TYPE i, " Custom sort key
           END OF ty_sflight_custom.
    TYPES tt_sflight_custom TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_custom WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights_custom
      IMPORTING
        iv_preferred_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_custom.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sort_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid           TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_preferred_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sort_key)  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_custom_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_custom.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    DATA lt_flights_custom TYPE tt_sflight_custom.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        sort_key = calculate_sort_key( iv_carrid = ls_flight-carrid iv_preferred_carrid = iv_preferred_carrid )
      ) TO lt_flights_custom.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_flights_custom BY sort_key ASCENDING fldate ASCENDING.
    rt_sorted_flights = lt_flights_custom.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sort_key.
    IF iv_carrid = iv_preferred_carrid.
      rv_sort_key = 1. " Preferred carrier comes first
    ELSE.
      rv_sort_key = 2. " Other carriers come second
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_flights_custom FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_flights_custom.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_custom_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_preferred_carrid) = 'LH'. " Lufthansa

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->sort_flights_custom( lv_preferred_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lv_found_other_carrier) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_current).
      IF ls_current-carrid = lv_preferred_carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
          act = lv_found_other_carrier
          msg = 'Preferred carrier found after other carriers'
        ).
      ELSE.
        lv_found_other_carrier = abap_true.
      ENDIF.

      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        DATA(ls_previous) = lt_result[ sy-tabix - 1 ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( ls_current-sort_key > ls_previous-sort_key OR
                  ( ls_current-sort_key = ls_previous-sort_key AND
                    ls_current-fldate >= ls_previous-fldate ) )
          msg = 'Custom sort order or fldate sort within group is incorrect'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für komplexe Sortierlogiken, die nicht direkt durch `BY` Klauseln abgebildet werden können, ist es eine moderne Praxis, ein temporäres Sortierfeld zu berechnen. Dieses Feld kann dann in der `SORT` Anweisung verwendet werden. Die Berechnung erfolgt hier in einer separaten Methode, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit erhöht.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS method_a
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lv_method_name TYPE string.
    lv_method_name = iv_method_name.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found or call failed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_a.
    rv_text = 'Method A was called.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_text = 'Method B was called.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE ANY.
    DATA: lv_component_name TYPE string.
    lv_component_name = iv_component_name.

        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_value = |{ <fs_component> }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_value = 'Error: Component not found.'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus einer dynamisch angegebenen Datenbanktabelle (z.B. SFLIGHT), wobei die Spalten ebenfalls dynamisch ausgewählt werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name   TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
        iv_column_list  TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    DATA: lv_table_name  TYPE string VALUE 'SFLIGHT',
          lv_column_list TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE'.

    lv_table_name = iv_table_name.
    lv_column_list = iv_column_list.

    TRY.
        " Create dynamic internal table based on the selected columns
        CREATE DATA ro_data_ref TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (lv_table_name) WITH EMPTY KEY.
        ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          SELECT (lv_column_list)
            FROM (lv_table_name)
            INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>
            UP TO 10 ROWS.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error cx_sy_create_data_error.
        CLEAR ro_data_ref.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen internen Tabelle dynamisch aktualisiert, basierend auf dem Feldnamen und dem neuen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in einer `LOOP AT` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_update_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_table_field
      IMPORTING
        io_table_ref      TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_field_name     TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_update_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_table_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_any_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_any_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_any_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN io_table_ref->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF <lt_any_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_any_table> ASSIGNING <ls_any_line>.
      TRY.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_line> TO <fs_any_field>.
          IF <fs_any_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            " Attempt to assign the new value. Type conversion might be needed in real scenarios.
            <fs_any_field> = iv_new_value.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
          " Field not found in this line's structure, or other assignment error
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die prüft, ob ein bestimmtes Feld in einer dynamisch übergebenen Struktur existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und prüfen Sie, ob das Feldsymbol zugewiesen wurde (`IS ASSIGNED`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS field_exists
      IMPORTING
        io_structure_ref  TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any structure
        iv_field_name     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD field_exists.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_any_structure> TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_any_field>     TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN io_structure_ref->* TO <ls_any_structure>.
    IF <ls_any_structure> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_structure> TO <fs_any_field>.
        IF <fs_any_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_exists = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_exists = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Typ eines dynamisch übergebenen Feldes (als Referenz) ermittelt und als String zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET REFERENCE` und `DESCRIBE FIELD` mit `TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_type
      IMPORTING
        io_field_ref      TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any field
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type)    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_any_field> TYPE ANY.
    DATA: lv_type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    ASSIGN io_field_ref->* TO <fs_any_field>.
    IF <fs_any_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      DESCRIBE FIELD <fs_any_field> TYPE lv_type_kind.
      CASE lv_type_kind.
        WHEN 'C'. rv_type = 'Character'.
        WHEN 'N'. rv_type = 'Numeric Character'.
        WHEN 'D'. rv_type = 'Date'.
        WHEN 'T'. rv_type = 'Time'.
        WHEN 'I'. rv_type = 'Integer'.
        WHEN 'P'. rv_type = 'Packed Number'.
        WHEN 'F'. rv_type = 'Floating Point'.
        WHEN 'X'. rv_type = 'Hexadecimal'.
        WHEN 'S'. rv_type = 'Short Integer'.
        WHEN 'B'. rv_type = 'Byte'.
        WHEN 'G'. rv_type = 'String'.
        WHEN 'Y'. rv_type = 'XString'.
        WHEN OTHERS. rv_type = 'Unknown/Complex Type'.
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      rv_type = 'Unassigned Reference'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` und die Methode `get_array_as_json_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parse_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_person,
        name TYPE string,
        age  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_person,
      ty_persons TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_person WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_persons
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_persons) TYPE ty_persons.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_persons.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_parser->parse_json( iv_json_string ).
        DATA(lt_json_table) = lo_json_parser->get_array_as_json_table( 'persons' ).
        LOOP AT lt_json_table INTO DATA(ls_json_entry).
          DATA(lo_entry_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
          lo_entry_parser->parse_json( ls_json_entry ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_person(
            name = lo_entry_parser->get_value_as_string( 'name' )
            age  = lo_entry_parser->get_value_as_int( 'age' )
          ) TO rt_persons.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data_row,
        col1 TYPE string,
        col2 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data_row,
      ty_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_excel_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring    TYPE xstring
        iv_sheet_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_excel_data.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xlsx->load_xlsx_xstring( iv_xstring ).
        DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->get_sheet_by_name( iv_sheet_name ).
        IF lo_sheet IS BOUND.
          " Annahme: Daten beginnen ab Zeile 2 (nach Kopfzeile)
          LOOP AT lo_sheet->get_rows( ) INTO DATA(ls_row) FROM 2.
            DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_data_row(
              col1 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row-row_index ip_column = 1 )
              col2 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row-row_index ip_column = 2 )
            ).
            APPEND ls_data TO rt_data.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine XLSX-Datei mit dynamischen Spaltenüberschriften.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` und iterieren Sie über die Feldnamen der internen Tabelle für die Kopfzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'SFlights Data' ).

    " Dynamische Kopfzeilen aus der Struktur der internen Tabelle
    DATA(lr_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lr_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_col_idx) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = ls_component-name ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_bold( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx ).
      lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Datenzeilen
    DATA(lv_row_idx) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lv_col_idx = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        DATA(lv_value) = CONV string( <fs_sflight>-(ls_component-name) ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = lv_value ).
        lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row_idx = lv_row_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_xlsx_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen komplexen JSON-String, der eine Mischung aus Objekten und Arrays enthält, und extrahieren Sie spezifische Daten mit dynamischen Pfaden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `get_value_as_string`, `get_array_as_json_table` und `get_object_as_json` von `cl_clb_parse_json`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parse_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id   TYPE string,
        name TYPE string,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_order_data,
        order_id TYPE string,
        customer TYPE string,
        items    TYPE ty_items,
      END OF ty_order_data.

    METHODS parse_order_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_order) TYPE ty_order_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_order_data.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_parser->parse_json( iv_json_string ).

        rs_order-order_id = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( 'order.id' ).
        rs_order-customer = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( 'order.customer.name' ).

        DATA(lt_json_items) = lo_json_parser->get_array_as_json_table( 'order.items' ).
        LOOP AT lt_json_items INTO DATA(ls_json_item_entry).
          DATA(lo_item_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
          lo_item_parser->parse_json( ls_json_item_entry ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_item(
            id   = lo_item_parser->get_value_as_string( 'itemId' )
            name = lo_item_parser->get_value_as_string( 'itemName' )
          ) TO rs_order-items.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine XLSX-Datei und wenden Sie bedingte Formatierung an (z.B. Zeilen einfärben basierend auf einem Wert).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` und die Style-Methoden des Sheet-Objekts in einer Schleife über die Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_cond_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_cond_format
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_cond_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_cond_format.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'SFlights Cond. Format' ).

    " Kopfzeilen
    DATA(lr_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lr_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_col_idx) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = ls_component-name ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_bold( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx ).
      lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Datenzeilen mit bedingter Formatierung
    DATA(lv_row_idx) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lv_col_idx = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        DATA(lv_value) = CONV string( <fs_sflight>-(ls_component-name) ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = lv_value ).

        " Bedingte Formatierung: Wenn 'CARRID' = 'LH', dann Zeile grün einfärben
        IF ls_component-name = 'CARRID' AND <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
          lo_sheet->set_row_background_color( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_color = 'FFC6EFCE' ). " Helles Grün
        ENDIF.

        lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row_idx = lv_row_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_xlsx_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugtabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die in den nächsten 30 Tagen stattfinden, und geben Sie eine Tabelle mit den Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern zurück. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `VALUE`.
hint: Berechnen Sie das Enddatum und verwenden Sie es in der `WHERE`-Bedingung des `FILTER` Operators.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_upcoming_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_upcoming_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_upcoming_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lv_today + 30.

    rt_upcoming_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER sflights_tab FROM lt_sflights
                                   WHERE fldate >= lv_today AND fldate <= lv_future_date
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_upcoming_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upcoming_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights_date( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_upcoming_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Es sollten kommende Flüge gefunden werden.' ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lv_today + 30.

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( <fs_flight>-fldate >= lv_today AND <fs_flight>-fldate <= lv_future_date )
                                        msg = 'Flugdatum sollte im Bereich der nächsten 30 Tage liegen.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `FILTER` mit Datumsbereichen. Es kombiniert die Filterung nach `fldate` mit der Erstellung einer neuen Tabelle (`VALUE #(...)`) und der Projektion relevanter Felder, um kommende Flüge zu identifizieren.
keywords: FILTER, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights, Date, Range, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (CARRID, CONNID, PRICE), die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 enthält, basierend auf einer simulierten `sflights` Tabelle. Der Preis soll dabei verdoppelt werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` für die Iteration mit `VALUE #()` für die Konstruktion und `WHERE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_value_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES: tt_flight_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS transform_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_flight_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_value_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    DATA: lt_sflights_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock.

    lt_sflights_mock = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 400.00 currency = 'EUR' )
                                ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 600.00 currency = 'USD' )
                                ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = 800.00 currency = 'EUR' )
                                ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0182' price = 300.00 currency = 'USD' ) ).

    rt_transformed = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_mock WHERE ( price GT 500 )
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                price  = ls_flight-price * 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_003 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_003 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_value_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[1]-price exp = 1200.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[2]-price exp = 1600.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` Schleifen und `WHERE`-Bedingungen innerhalb eines Tabellenkonstruktors (`VALUE #()`) ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und funktionale Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen in einem einzigen Statement. Dies ist prägnanter und oft performanter als explizite `LOOP`s.

CLASS zcl_filter_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_mock.

                            ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' )
                            ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0182' fldate = '20250103' ) ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer simulierten `sflights` Tabelle, die in EUR sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `INIT`-Initialisierung und einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_eur_total RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_eur_total.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_mock.
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 400.00 currency = 'EUR' )
                            ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 600.00 currency = 'USD' )
                            ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = 800.00 currency = 'EUR' )
                            ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0182' price = 300.00 currency = 'USD' ) ).

    rv_total = REDUCE #( INIT total TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                           FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( currency = 'EUR' )
                           NEXT total = total + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_005 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_calculate_eur_total FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_005 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_eur_total.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_value( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_eur_total( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 1200.00 ). "400 + 800
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren. Die `INIT`-Klausel definiert den Startwert, und die `NEXT`-Klausel beschreibt die Schritt für Schritt Aggregation. Dies macht Aggregationen extrem kompakt und gut lesbar, vergleichbar mit funktionalen Reduce-Operationen in anderen Sprachen.
keywords: REDUCE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Liste von Namen zu einem einzigen String zusammen, getrennt durch ein Semikolon.

CLASS zcl_join_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
