Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle von Wertepaaren (CARRID, ANZAHL DER FLÜGE) basierend auf einer simulierten `sflights` Tabelle, wobei die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert werden und die Anzahl pro Fluggesellschaft ermittelt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` mit `FOR` und `VALUE #()`, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_mock.
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
                            ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
                            ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
                            ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0182' )
                            ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0405' ) ).

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                         ( carrier = ls_flight-carrid
                           count   = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_010 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_count_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_010 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( ).
    
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(lv_aa_count) = lt_counts[ KEY ty_carrier_count COMPONENTS carrier = 'AA' ]-count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_aa_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = lt_counts[ KEY ty_carrier_count COMPONENTS carrier = 'LH' ]-count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lh_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck innerhalb eines `VALUE` Konstruktors ist eine hochmoderne und effiziente Methode, interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen (hier: `GROUP SIZE` für die Anzahl der Elemente pro Gruppe). Dies ist eine mächtige Abkürzung für komplexe Gruppenbildungen, die früher umfangreiche `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` oder `LOOP AT ... COLLECT` Schleifen erforderten.
keywords: VALUE, FOR GROUPS OF, Grouping, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle von Flug-Status-Datensätzen. Wenn der Preis eines (simulierten `sflights`-)Fluges über 700 liegt, soll der Status 'High', sonst 'Normal' sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` in Kombination mit `COND` im `VALUE` Ausdruck, um bedingt Werte zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_cond_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_cond_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_mock.
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' price = 650.00 )
                            ( carrid = 'LH' price = 800.00 )
                            ( carrid = 'BA' price = 400.00 )
                            ( carrid = 'SQ' price = 950.00 ) ).

    rt_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                         ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                           status = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-price > 700 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_011 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_011 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_cond_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_status ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status[ KEY ty_flight_status COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ]-status exp = 'Normal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status[ KEY ty_flight_status COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ]-status exp = 'High' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status[ KEY ty_flight_status COMPONENTS carrid = 'BA' ]-status exp = 'Normal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status[ KEY ty_flight_status COMPONENTS carrid = 'SQ' ]-status exp = 'High' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verschachtelung von `COND` Ausdrücken innerhalb eines `VALUE` und `FOR`-Konstruktors erlaubt die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten während der Initialisierung einer internen Tabelle. Dies eliminiert die Notwendigkeit von `IF`-Statements innerhalb von `LOOP`s und macht den Code extrem lesbar und 'fließend'.
keywords: VALUE, COND, FOR, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine vorhandene interne Tabelle an einer bestimmten Position ein. Die neue Zeile soll mit `VALUE` definiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT` mit einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor für die Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_insert_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key   TYPE char10,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY key.
    METHODS insert_item IMPORTING iv_position TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_insert_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_item.
    DATA: lt_initial_items TYPE tt_item.
    lt_initial_items = VALUE #( ( key = 'ITEM1' value = 'First Item' )
                                ( key = 'ITEM2' value = 'Second Item' ) ).

    " Kopieren für die Rückgabe und um die ursprüngliche Tabelle nicht zu ändern
    rt_items = lt_initial_items.

    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 'NEWITEM' value = 'Newly Inserted' ) INTO TABLE rt_items INDEX iv_position.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_012 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_insert_item FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_012 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_insert_table( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_cut->insert_item( iv_position = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[2]-key exp = 'NEWITEM' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[2]-value exp = 'Newly Inserted' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[3]-key exp = 'ITEM2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung eines `VALUE`-Konstruktors direkt in der `INSERT`-Anweisung ist eine moderne und typsichere Möglichkeit, einzelne Zeilen in interne Tabellen einzufügen. Es ist hierbei nicht notwendig, zuerst eine Workarea zu definieren und zu füllen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur kopiert, wobei die Feldnamen identisch sind. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des CORRESPONDING-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING #( source_structure )` Operator für die einfache Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_basic_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine Zieltabelle von Flugbuchungen (sbook) mit neuen Daten aus einer Quelltabelle, wobei nur die übereinstimmenden Zeilen basierend auf einem Schlüssel aktualisiert werden. Verwenden Sie `REPLACING CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Der `REPLACING CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` Zusatz ist ideal für das Aktualisieren von Tabellen basierend auf Schlüsseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_replacing_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_update,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             bookid   TYPE s_book_id,
             custtype TYPE s_cust_ty,
             order_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_booking_update.
    TYPES: tt_booking_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_update WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate bookid.

    METHODS update_bookings
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_booking_update
      CHANGING
        ct_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_replacing_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_bookings.
    " ct_bookings muss einen passenden Schlüssel haben, damit REPLACING funktioniert.
    " Hier simulieren wir, dass sbook einen Schlüssel aus carrid, connid, fldate, bookid hat.
    " In realen Szenarien würde man den Tabellentyp von sbook anpassen oder eine Hilfsstruktur verwenden.
    REPLACING CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ct_bookings FROM it_updates.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replacing_itab FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replacing_itab.
    DATA: lt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook,
          lt_updates TYPE zcl_cor_replacing_itab=>tt_booking_update.

    " Initial bookings
    APPEND VALUE sbook( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' bookid = '00000001' custtype = 'B' smoker = 'X' ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE sbook( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' bookid = '00000002' custtype = 'A' smoker = ' ' ) TO lt_bookings.

    " Updates
    APPEND VALUE zcl_cor_replacing_itab=>ty_booking_update( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' bookid = '00000001' custtype = 'C' order_date = '20251101' ) TO lt_updates.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_cor_replacing_itab=>ty_booking_update( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251203' bookid = '00000003' custtype = 'D' order_date = '20251102' ) TO lt_updates.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_replacing_itab( ).
    lo_cut->update_bookings( EXPORTING it_updates = lt_updates CHANGING ct_bookings = lt_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_bookings ) exp = 3 msg = 'One new line should be added, one updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_bookings[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid connid fldate bookid = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' bookid = '00000001' ) ]-custtype exp = 'C' msg = 'Updated booking should have new custtype' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_bookings[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid connid fldate bookid = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' bookid = '00000001' ) ]-smoker exp = 'X' msg = 'Non-mapped field should remain unchanged' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_bookings[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid connid fldate bookid = VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251203' bookid = '00000003' ) ]-custtype exp = 'D' msg = 'New booking should be inserted' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Zusatz `REPLACING CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` (ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine leistungsstarke Erweiterung des `CORRESPONDING`-Operators für interne Tabellen. Er ermöglicht das Aktualisieren von Zeilen in einer Zieltabelle, wenn ein passender Schlüssel in der Quelltabelle gefunden wird. Nicht übereinstimmende Zeilen in der Quelltabelle werden als neue Zeilen in die Zieltabelle eingefügt. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Tabellen zu synchronisieren.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, REPLACING, Internal Tables, Update, ABAP 7.50, SBOOK

CLASS zcl_uuid_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_uuid_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_uuid_x16) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ).

Die Methode `create_uuid_x16` erzeugt eine 16-Byte-UUID im RAW-Format, während `uuid_x16_to_c32` diese in eine lesbare 32-stellige Hexadezimal-String-Repräsentation umwandelt. CLASS zcl_uuid_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_c32_to_x16
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid_c32 TYPE sysuuid_c32
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_uuid_x16) TYPE sysuuid_x16
      RAISING

CLASS zcl_uuid_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_c32_to_x16.

        rv_uuid_x16 = cl_system_uuid=>if_system_uuid_static~uuid_c32_to_x16( iv_uuid_c32 ).
      CATCH cx_uuid_error INTO DATA(lx_uuid_error).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung einer UUID als Primärschlüssel in einer internen Tabelle, die eine Datenbanktabelle simuliert. Fügen Sie Zeilen mit generierten UUIDs ein und lesen Sie sie aus.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Feld vom Typ `RAW(16)` für die UUID und verwenden Sie es als Schlüssel. Nutzen Sie `cl_system_uuid` zur Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_as_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_entry,
             id   TYPE sysuuid_x16,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_entry.
    TYPES: tt_data_entry TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data_entry
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data_entry
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_uuid) TYPE sysuuid_x16.

    METHODS get_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE sysuuid_x16
        it_data TYPE tt_data_entry
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_data_entry
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_as_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    rv_new_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ).
    INSERT VALUE #( id = rv_new_uuid name = iv_name value = iv_value ) INTO TABLE ct_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_entry.
    READ TABLE it_data INTO rs_entry WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_uuid_key_operations FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_uuid_key_operations.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_uuid_as_key=>tt_data_entry,
          lv_uuid1 TYPE sysuuid_x16,
          lv_uuid2 TYPE sysuuid_x16.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_as_key( ).

    lv_uuid1 = lo_cut->add_entry( EXPORTING iv_name = 'Item A' iv_value = 10 CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).
    lv_uuid2 = lo_cut->add_entry( EXPORTING iv_name = 'Item B' iv_value = 20 CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two entries should be added' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_uuid1 exp = lv_uuid2 msg = 'UUIDs should be unique' ).

    DATA(ls_entry1) = lo_cut->get_entry( iv_id = lv_uuid1 it_data = lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry1-name exp = 'Item A' msg = 'Retrieved entry name should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry1-value exp = 10 msg = 'Retrieved entry value should match' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ).
    lo_cut->get_entry( iv_id = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ) it_data = lt_data ). " Non-existent UUID
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: UUIDs eignen sich hervorragend als Primärschlüssel, da sie global eindeutig sind und Kollisionen minimieren. In ABAP können sie als `RAW(16)`-Felder in internen Tabellen oder Datenbanktabellen gespeichert werden. Die Verwendung von `SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY id` gewährleistet effizienten Zugriff und die Eindeutigkeit der Schlüssel.
keywords: UUID, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, Primary Key, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40, RAW(16)

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR <wa> IN <itab> NEXT sum = sum + <wa>-price )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                NEXT total = total + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_calculation.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 1000 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 500 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' price = 750 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 2250 msg = 'Total price should be 2250' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert reduziert. Er ist ideal für Aggregationen wie Summen, Minima, Maxima oder die Verkettung von Strings. Die `INIT`-Klausel definiert den Startwert und Typ des Akkumulators, während die `NEXT`-Klausel die Logik für jeden Tabelleneintrag festlegt. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugbuchungen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein. Wenn eine Buchung bereits existiert (basierend auf einem Schlüssel), soll sie nicht überschrieben werden. Verwenden Sie `KEEPING TARGET LINES` mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( TABLE target_table FROM source_table KEEPING TARGET LINES )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_keeping_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             bookid   TYPE s_book_id,
             custtype TYPE s_cust_ty,
           END OF ty_booking_data.
    TYPES: tt_booking_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_booking_data
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate bookid.

    METHODS merge_bookings
      IMPORTING
        it_new_bookings TYPE tt_booking_data
      CHANGING
        ct_existing_bookings TYPE tt_booking_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_keeping_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_bookings.
    ct_existing_bookings = CORRESPONDING #( ct_existing_bookings FROM it_new_bookings KEEPING TARGET LINES ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_merge_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_bookings.
    DATA: lt_existing TYPE zcl_cor_keeping_lines=>tt_booking_data,
          lt_new TYPE zcl_cor_keeping_lines=>tt_booking_data.

    " Existing bookings
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' bookid = '00000001' custtype = 'B' ) INTO TABLE lt_existing.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' bookid = '00000002' custtype = 'A' ) INTO TABLE lt_existing.

    " New bookings (one existing, one new)
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' bookid = '00000001' custtype = 'C' ) INTO TABLE lt_new. " Existing key, different data
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251203' bookid = '00000003' custtype = 'D' ) INTO TABLE lt_new. " New key

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_keeping_lines( ).
    lo_cut->merge_bookings( EXPORTING it_new_bookings = lt_new CHANGING ct_existing_bookings = lt_existing ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_existing ) exp = 3 msg = 'One new line should be added, existing kept' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing[ KEY id COMPONENTS carrid connid fldate bookid = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' bookid = '00000001' ) ]-custtype exp = 'B' msg = 'Existing booking should keep its original custtype' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing[ KEY id COMPONENTS carrid connid fldate bookid = VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251203' bookid = '00000003' ) ]-custtype exp = 'D' msg = 'New booking should be inserted' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Zusatz `KEEPING TARGET LINES` mit `CORRESPONDING` (ab ABAP 7.50) ist ideal für das Zusammenführen von Tabellen, bei dem vorhandene Zeilen in der Zieltabelle nicht überschrieben werden sollen, wenn ein passender Schlüssel in der Quelltabelle gefunden wird. Nur Zeilen aus der Quelltabelle, für die kein passender Schlüssel in der Zieltabelle existiert, werden hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode für 'Insert-only'-Merge-Operationen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, KEEPING TARGET LINES, Internal Tables, Merge, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Zuordnung von Feldern zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, wobei ein Feld in der Zielstruktur umbenannt werden soll. Verwenden Sie die `MAPPING` und `REPLACE` Klauseln des CORRESPONDING-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( source_structure MAPPING target_field = source_field REPLACE target_field WITH new_target_field )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_replace_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             flight_number TYPE s_conn_id,
             departure_date TYPE s_date,
             origin_city TYPE s_city_fr,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             from_city TYPE s_city_fr,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_with_replace
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_replace_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_replace.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING
                                   connid = flight_number
                                   fldate = departure_date
                                   from_city = origin_city ).
    rs_target-status = 'ACTIVE'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_mapping.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_cor_replace_mapping=>ty_source_data,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_cor_replace_mapping=>ty_target_data.

    ls_source = VALUE #( flight_number = '1234' departure_date = '20251231' origin_city = 'MUNICH' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_replace_mapping( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_with_replace( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-connid exp = '1234' msg = 'Connid should be mapped from flight_number' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-fldate exp = '20251231' msg = 'Fldate should be mapped from departure_date' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-from_city exp = 'MUNICH' msg = 'From_city should be mapped from origin_city' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'ACTIVE' msg = 'Status should be set manually' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REPLACE`-Klausel des `CORRESPONDING`-Operators ist nicht direkt für das Umbenennen von Feldern gedacht, sondern für das Ersetzen von Werten in der Zielstruktur, die bereits durch eine `MAPPING`-Klausel zugewiesen wurden. In diesem Beispiel wird die `MAPPING`-Klausel verwendet, um Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen zuzuordnen. Die `REPLACE`-Klausel würde hier nur Sinn machen, wenn man einen bereits zugewiesenen Wert durch einen anderen ersetzen wollte, was in diesem Kontext nicht direkt demonstriert wird, da die `MAPPING`-Klausel die primäre Funktionalität abdeckt. Die Erklärung wurde angepasst, um dies klarzustellen. Der Fokus liegt hier auf der flexiblen Zuordnung mit `MAPPING`.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, REPLACE, Structure Mapping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Zuordnung von Feldern zwischen zwei internen Tabellen durch, wobei ein Feld in der Zielstruktur umbenannt werden soll. Verwenden Sie die `MAPPING` und `REPLACE` Klauseln des CORRESPONDING-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( TABLE target_table FROM source_table MAPPING target_field = source_field REPLACE target_field WITH new_target_field )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_itab_replace_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             dep_date TYPE s_date,
             from_city TYPE s_city_fr,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_fr,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES: tt_target_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_cor_itab_replace_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights_with_replace.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING
                                           connid = flight_id
                                           fldate = dep_date
                                           cityfrom = from_city ).
    LOOP AT rt_target_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      <fs_target>-status = 'PROCESSED'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_itab_replace_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_itab_replace_mapping.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_cor_itab_replace_map=>tt_source_flight,
          lt_target TYPE zcl_cor_itab_replace_map=>tt_target_flight.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_cor_itab_replace_map=>ty_source_flight( flight_id = '001' dep_date = '20250101' from_city = 'BER' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_cor_itab_replace_map=>ty_source_flight( flight_id = '002' dep_date = '20250102' from_city = 'FRA' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_itab_replace_map( ).
    lt_target = lo_cut->map_flights_with_replace( it_source_flights = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of lines should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' msg = 'First connid should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-status exp = 'PROCESSED' msg = 'First status should be set' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRA' msg = 'Second cityfrom should be mapped' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Ähnlich wie bei Strukturen ermöglicht die `MAPPING`-Klausel des `CORRESPONDING`-Operators auch bei internen Tabellen die flexible Zuordnung von Feldern mit unterschiedlichen Namen. Die `REPLACE`-Klausel ist hier ebenfalls nicht direkt für das Umbenennen gedacht, sondern für das Ersetzen von Werten. In diesem Beispiel wird die `MAPPING`-Klausel verwendet, um die Felder korrekt zuzuordnen, und anschließend eine Schleife, um den Status zu setzen, da `REPLACE` nicht für das Umbenennen von Feldern während der Zuordnung vorgesehen ist.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Zuordnung von Feldern zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, wobei ein Feld in der Zielstruktur umbenannt werden soll. Verwenden Sie die `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` Klauseln des CORRESPONDING-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( source_structure MAPPING target_field = source_field EXCEPT field_to_exclude )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_map_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_info,
             old_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             description TYPE string,
             creation_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_source_info.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_info,
             new_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             description TYPE string,
             update_date TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target_info.

    METHODS map_with_except
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_map_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_except.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING
                                   new_id = old_id
                                   update_date = creation_date
                                 EXCEPT description ). " description wird hier explizit ausgeschlossen
    rs_target-description = 'Custom Description'. " und manuell gesetzt
    rs_target-status = 'NEW'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_except FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_except.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_cor_map_except=>ty_source_info,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_cor_map_except=>ty_target_info.

    ls_source = VALUE #( old_id = 'XYZ' description = 'Original Desc' creation_date = '20250115' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_map_except( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_with_except( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-new_id exp = 'XYZ' msg = 'New ID should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-update_date exp = '20250115' msg = 'Update date should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-description exp = 'Custom Description' msg = 'Description should be custom' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'NEW' msg = 'Status should be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` im `CORRESPONDING`-Operator bietet eine sehr feingranulare Kontrolle über die Feldzuordnung. Man kann explizit Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen zuordnen und gleichzeitig andere Felder, die ansonsten automatisch zugewiesen würden, von der Zuordnung ausschließen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn bestimmte Felder eine spezielle Logik erfordern oder manuell gesetzt werden sollen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, EXCEPT, Structure Mapping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Zuordnung von Feldern zwischen zwei internen Tabellen durch, wobei ein Feld in der Zielstruktur umbenannt werden soll. Verwenden Sie die `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` Klauseln des CORRESPONDING-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( TABLE target_table FROM source_table MAPPING target_field = source_field EXCEPT field_to_exclude )`.

CLASS zcl_cor_itab_map_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             item_code TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             item_text TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_item.
    TYPES: tt_source_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_product,
             product_id TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             product_name TYPE string,
             stock_qty TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target_product.
    TYPES: tt_target_product TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_items_to_products
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_source_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_products) TYPE tt_target_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_itab_map_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_items_to_products.
    rt_target_products = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_items MAPPING
                                            product_id = item_code
                                            product_name = item_text
                                            stock_qty = quantity
                                          EXCEPT quantity ). " quantity wird hier explizit ausgeschlossen
    LOOP AT rt_target_products ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_product>).
      <fs_product>-status = 'AVAILABLE'.
      " Hier könnte man eine komplexere Logik für stock_qty implementieren, da es ausgeschlossen wurde
      " <fs_product>-stock_qty = <fs_product>-stock_qty * 2. " Beispiel
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_cor_itab_map_except=>tt_source_item,
          lt_target TYPE zcl_cor_itab_map_except=>tt_target_product.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_cor_itab_map_except=>ty_source_item( item_code = 'P001' item_text = 'Laptop' quantity = 10 ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_cor_itab_map_except=>ty_source_item( item_code = 'P002' item_text = 'Mouse' quantity = 50 ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_itab_map_except( ).
    lt_target = lo_cut->map_items_to_products( it_source_items = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of lines should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-product_id exp = 'P001' msg = 'First product ID should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-product_name exp = 'Laptop' msg = 'First product name should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-stock_qty exp = 10 msg = 'First stock quantity should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-status exp = 'AVAILABLE' msg = 'First status should be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` ist auch bei internen Tabellen sehr nützlich. Sie erlaubt es, Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen zuzuordnen und gleichzeitig bestimmte Felder von der automatischen Zuordnung auszuschließen. Dies gibt Entwicklern die Flexibilität, eine Basismap durchzuführen und dann spezifische Felder manuell zu verarbeiten oder zu überschreiben, was zu sauberem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, EXCEPT, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen einem angegebenen Minimum und Maximum.

CLASS zcl_random_number_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_number) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_random_number_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_int.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    rv_random_number = lo_random->get_next( min = iv_min max = iv_max ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine angegebene Anzahl von eindeutigen Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines Bereichs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `HASHED TABLE` zur Überprüfung der Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_ints
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_ints.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_generated_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lv_number) TYPE i.

    IF iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      " Not enough unique numbers possible in the range
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_invalid_parameter=>cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
    ENDIF.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DO.
        lv_number = lo_random->get_next( min = iv_min max = iv_max ).
        TRY.
            INSERT lv_number INTO TABLE lt_generated_numbers.
            EXIT. " Number is unique, exit inner loop
          CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
            " Number already exists, try again
        ENDTRY.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    rt_unique_numbers = VALUE #( lt_generated_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random_ints FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unique_random_too_many FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_ints.
    DATA(lo_gen) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 5.
    DATA(lv_min) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max) = 10.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_gen->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = lv_count iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_numbers )
      exp = lv_count
      msg = 'Anzahl der generierten Zahlen stimmt nicht überein.'
    ).

    " Check for uniqueness (by converting to HASHED TABLE and checking lines)
    DATA(lt_unique_check) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      INSERT lv_num INTO TABLE lt_unique_check.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_check )
      exp = lv_count
      msg = 'Generierte Zahlen sind nicht eindeutig.'
    ).

    " Check if all numbers are within range
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO lv_num.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( lv_num >= lv_min AND lv_num <= lv_max )
        msg = |Zahl { lv_num } liegt nicht im Bereich [{ lv_min }, { lv_max }]| 
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unique_random_too_many.
    DATA(lo_gen) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 10.
    DATA(lv_min) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max) = 5. " Only 5 unique numbers possible

    " Expecting an exception
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_exception_class_name = 'CX_ABAP_INVALID_PARAMETER'
    ).
    lo_gen->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = lv_count iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_abap_random_int` mit einer `HASHED TABLE` und einer `DO...LOOP` Struktur, um eine bestimmte Anzahl eindeutiger Zufallszahlen zu generieren. Die `HASHED TABLE` sorgt für effiziente Eindeutigkeitsprüfung. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für die Zuweisung zum Rückgabeparameter ist moderner ABAP-Stil.
keywords: Random Numbers, Internal Tables, HASHED TABLE, Uniqueness, Exceptions

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein gegebenes Datum und eine Uhrzeit in einen UTCLONG-Zeitstempel.

CLASS zcl_datetime_to_utclong DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_datetime_to_utclong IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_utclong.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) TYPE timestamp.
    CONVERT DATE iv_date TIME iv_time INTO TIME STAMP lv_timestamp.
    rv_utclong = cl_abap_utclong=>create_from_timestamp( timestamp = lv_timestamp ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_datetime_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_datetime_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_datetime_to_utclong( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lv_utclong) = lo_converter->convert_to_utclong(
      iv_date = lv_date
      iv_time = lv_time
    ).

    " Convert back to timestamp for comparison (UTCLONG has higher precision, so direct comparison might fail)
    DATA(lv_timestamp_expected) TYPE timestamp.
    CONVERT DATE lv_date TIME lv_time INTO TIME STAMP lv_timestamp_expected.

    DATA(lv_timestamp_actual) TYPE timestamp.
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_utclong INTO DATE DATA(lv_date_actual) TIME DATA(lv_time_actual).
    CONVERT DATE lv_date_actual TIME lv_time_actual INTO TIME STAMP lv_timestamp_actual.

    " Compare only up to seconds, as UTCLONG has nanoseconds
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_timestamp_actual(14) " Compare YYYYMMDDhhmmss
      exp = lv_timestamp_expected(14)
      msg = 'Konvertierter UTCLONG stimmt nicht mit ursprünglichem Datum/Uhrzeit überein (bis Sekunden).'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung von Datum und Uhrzeit in einen `TIMESTAMP` und dann in `UTCLONG` ist der empfohlene Weg, um die hohe Präzision von `UTCLONG` zu nutzen. `cl_abap_utclong=>create_from_timestamp()` ist hierfür die zentrale Methode.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einem UTCLONG-Feld und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, die den aktuellen Zeitstempel und einen zufälligen Wert enthalten. Filtern Sie dann Einträge, die vor einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt erstellt wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES`, `VALUE #`, `FOR`, `cl_abap_utclong=>now()`, `cl_abap_random_int` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_data_proc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id        TYPE i,
             timestamp TYPE utclong,
             value     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_filter_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_count        TYPE i
        iv_filter_until TYPE utclong OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_data_proc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_filter_data.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
      ( id        = i
        timestamp = cl_abap_utclong=>now( )
        value     = lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = 100 ) )
    ).

    IF iv_filter_until IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( lt_raw_data WHERE timestamp > iv_filter_until ).
    ELSE.
      rt_filtered_data = lt_raw_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_and_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_utclong_data_proc( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 10.

    " Test 1: No filter
    DATA(lt_all_data) = lo_processor->generate_and_filter_data( iv_count = lv_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_all_data )
      exp = lv_count
      msg = 'Anzahl der generierten Daten ohne Filter stimmt nicht überein.'
    ).

    " Test 2: Filter some data
    DATA(lv_filter_time) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " Ensure some data is 'older' than filter_time
    DATA(lt_filtered_data) = lo_processor->generate_and_filter_data(
      iv_count        = lv_count
      iv_filter_until = lv_filter_time
    ).

    " All generated data should be newer than lv_filter_time, so all should be returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered_data )
      exp = lv_count
      msg = 'Anzahl der gefilterten Daten stimmt nicht überein (alle sollten neuer sein).'
    ).

    " Test 3: Filter with a future timestamp (should return 0)
    DATA(lv_future_time) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ) + 10000000. " 1 second in future
    DATA(lt_empty_data) = lo_processor->generate_and_filter_data(
      iv_count        = lv_count
      iv_filter_until = lv_future_time
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_empty_data )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Anzahl der gefilterten Daten stimmt nicht überein (alle sollten älter sein).'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `UTCLONG` in einer strukturierten internen Tabelle. Die Daten werden mit `VALUE #` und einem `FOR`-Ausdruck generiert, was eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Tabellenfüllung ist. Das Filtern erfolgt elegant mit dem `FILTER`-Operator, der ab ABAP 7.40 verfügbar ist.
keywords: UTCLONG, Internal Tables, Data Structures, FOR, VALUE #, FILTER

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen String einer bestimmten Länge, der nur Großbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Zeichenauswahl und String-Templates zum Aufbau des Strings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_char_index) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_char) TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      lv_random_char_index = lo_random->get_next( min = 0 max = strlen( lc_chars ) - 1 ).
      lv_char = lc_chars+lv_random_char_index(1).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lv_char.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_random_string_content FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_gen) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 10.
    DATA(lv_random_str) = lo_gen->generate_random_string( iv_length = lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = strlen( lv_random_str )
      exp = lv_length
      msg = 'Generierter String hat nicht die erwartete Länge.'
    ).

  METHOD test_random_string_content.
    DATA(lo_gen) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 20.
    DATA(lv_random_str) = lo_gen->generate_random_string( iv_length = lv_length ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_allowed_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.

    DATA(lv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_random_str+sy-index-1(1).
      IF NOT ( find( val = lc_allowed_chars sub = lv_char ) IS NOT INITIAL ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener UTCLONG-Zeitstempel innerhalb eines bestimmten Zeitfensters (Start- und End-UTCLONG) liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie einfache Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`) für UTCLONG-Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_time_window DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_utclong_in_window
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong_to_check TYPE utclong
        iv_start_utclong    TYPE utclong
        iv_end_utclong      TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_in_window) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_time_window IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_utclong_in_window.
    rv_is_in_window = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_utclong_to_check >= iv_start_utclong AND iv_utclong_to_check <= iv_end_utclong
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_utclong_in_window FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_utclong_outside_window FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utclong_in_window.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_utclong_time_window( ).
    DATA(lv_start) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    DATA(lv_check) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    DATA(lv_end) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_checker->is_utclong_in_window(
        iv_utclong_to_check = lv_check
        iv_start_utclong    = lv_start
        iv_end_utclong      = lv_end
      )
      msg = 'UTCLONG sollte im Zeitfenster liegen.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_utclong_outside_window.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_utclong_time_window( ).
    DATA(lv_start) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    DATA(lv_end) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    DATA(lv_check_after) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_checker->is_utclong_in_window(
        iv_utclong_to_check = lv_check_after
        iv_start_utclong    = lv_start
        iv_end_utclong      = lv_end
      )
      msg = 'UTCLONG sollte außerhalb des Zeitfensters liegen (nach Ende).'
    ).

    DATA(lv_check_before) = lv_start - 10000000. " 1 second before start
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_checker->is_utclong_in_window(
        iv_utclong_to_check = lv_check_before
        iv_start_utclong    = lv_start
        iv_end_utclong      = lv_end
      )
      msg = 'UTCLONG sollte außerhalb des Zeitfensters liegen (vor Start).'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: UTCLONG-Werte können direkt mit Vergleichsoperatoren verglichen werden, was eine einfache und effiziente Überprüfung von Zeitfenstern ermöglicht. Die Verwendung des `COND`-Operators ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, bedingte Zuweisungen vorzunehmen.
keywords: UTCLONG, Date/Time, Conditional Logic, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 100 Einträgen, wobei jeder Eintrag eine zufällige ID (1-10) und einen zufälligen Wert (1-100) hat. Gruppieren Sie diese Tabelle dann nach der zufälligen ID und berechnen Sie die Summe der Werte pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int`, `VALUE #`, `FOR`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES tt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             id    TYPE i,
             sum_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS generate_and_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_sum) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_group.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).

    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE tt_raw_data(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > 100
      ( id    = lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = 10 )
        value = lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = 100 ) )
    ).

    rt_grouped_sum = VALUE tt_grouped_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( id = ls_data-id ) ASCENDING
      ( id        = ls_data-id
        sum_value = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_data> IN GROUP ls_data NEXT s = s + <fs_data>-value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_sum.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_random_group_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->generate_and_group( ).

    " Check if all IDs from 1 to 10 are present (probabilistically, but for 100 items, highly likely)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_result ) >= 1 AND lines( lt_result ) <= 10 )
      msg = 'Anzahl der Gruppen ist unerwartet.'
    ).

    " Check if sum_value is positive for all groups
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_group-sum_value > 0 )
        msg = |Summe für ID { ls_group-id } sollte positiv sein.| 
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " A more robust test would involve generating fixed data, but this tests the grouping logic.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_utclong_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_utclong.
    DATA(lv_timestamp_str) = iv_utclong->get_timestamp( ). " Returns YYYYMMDDHHMMSSNNNNNNN

    rv_formatted_string = |{ lv_timestamp_str(4) }-{ lv_timestamp_str+4(2) }-{ lv_timestamp_str+6(2) } |
                        && |{ lv_timestamp_str+8(2) }:{ lv_timestamp_str+10(2) }:{ lv_timestamp_str+12(2) }|
                        && |.{ lv_timestamp_str+14(3) }|.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Objekten verwaltet. Die Klasse soll eine Methode bereitstellen, die ein zufälliges Objekt aus der Liste zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int`.
hint: Speichern Sie die Objekte in einer internen Tabelle und verwenden Sie den Zufallsgenerator, um einen Index auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_object_picker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_object.
    TYPES tt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_objects.

    METHODS get_random_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_object) TYPE ty_object
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_objects TYPE tt_objects.
    DATA mo_random  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_random_int.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_object_picker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_objects = it_objects.
    mo_random = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_random_object.
    IF mt_objects IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_index) = mo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = lines( mt_objects ) ).
    READ TABLE mt_objects INDEX lv_index INTO rs_random_object.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Should not happen if lv_index is within bounds
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit eines Code-Blocks mit Nanosekundenpräzision unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_utclong`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_utclong=>now()` vor und nach dem Code-Block und `cl_abap_utclong=>diff()` zur Berechnung der Differenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_performance_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_execution_time
      IMPORTING
        io_code_to_execute TYPE REF TO if_executable_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_duration_seconds) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_executable_code.
  METHODS execute.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_performance_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_execution_time.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).

    io_code_to_execute->execute( ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).

    rv_duration_seconds = cl_abap_utclong=>diff( utclong1 = lv_end_time utclong2 = lv_start_time ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_executable_code~execute.
    " Simulate some work
    DATA(lv_dummy) TYPE i.
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      lv_dummy = lv_dummy + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_measure_time.
    DATA(lo_monitor) = NEW zcl_performance_monitor( ).
    DATA(lo_code) = NEW ltcl_test( ). " Self-reference for executable code

    DATA(lv_duration) = lo_monitor->measure_execution_time( io_code_to_execute = lo_code ).

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Addieren oder subtrahieren Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl von Sekunden zu einem UTCLONG-Zeitstempel und geben Sie den neuen Zeitstempel zurück.
hint: UTCLONG-Werte können direkt mit numerischen Werten (DECFLOAT34) addiert oder subtrahiert werden, um Sekunden zu manipulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_manipulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
        iv_seconds TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_utclong) TYPE utclong.

    METHODS subtract_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
        iv_seconds TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_utclong) TYPE utclong.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_manipulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_seconds.
    rv_new_utclong = iv_utclong + iv_seconds.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract_seconds.
    rv_new_utclong = iv_utclong - iv_seconds.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_subtract_seconds FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_subtract_seconds.
    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_utclong_manipulator( ).
    DATA(lv_original_utclong) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_seconds_to_add TYPE decfloat34 VALUE '10.5'.

    DATA(lv_added_utclong) = lo_manipulator->add_seconds(
      iv_utclong = lv_original_utclong
      iv_seconds = lc_seconds_to_add
    ).

    DATA(lv_diff_add) = cl_abap_utclong=>diff(
      utclong1 = lv_added_utclong
      utclong2 = lv_original_utclong
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_diff_add
      exp = lc_seconds_to_add
      msg = 'Addition von Sekunden war nicht korrekt.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_subtracted_utclong) = lo_manipulator->subtract_seconds(
      iv_utclong = lv_added_utclong
      iv_seconds = lc_seconds_to_add
    ).

    DATA(lv_diff_sub) = cl_abap_utclong=>diff(
      utclong1 = lv_subtracted_utclong
      utclong2 = lv_original_utclong
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( abs( lv_diff_sub ) < '0.0000001' ) " Should be very close to zero
      msg = 'Subtraktion von Sekunden war nicht korrekt (Rückkehr zum Original).'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: UTCLONG-Werte können direkt mit numerischen Werten vom Typ `DECFLOAT34` addiert oder subtrahiert werden, um Zeitmanipulationen in Sekunden (mit Nanosekundenpräzision) durchzuführen. Dies ist eine sehr intuitive und leistungsstarke Funktion von `UTCLONG`.
keywords: UTCLONG, Date/Time, Math, Time Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine zufällige Auswahl von Feldern aus einer gegebenen Struktur zurückgibt. Die Auswahl soll dynamisch erfolgen und die Anzahl der Felder zufällig sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`), `cl_abap_random_int` und `REDUCE` mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_random_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_fields) TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_random_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_fields.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_num_fields_to_select) = lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = lines( lt_components ) ).

    DATA(lt_selected_indices) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DO lv_num_fields_to_select TIMES.
      DATA(lv_index) TYPE i.
      DO.
        lv_index = lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = lines( lt_components ) ).
        TRY.
            INSERT lv_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
            EXIT.
          CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    rt_random_fields = VALUE tt_field_info(
      FOR lv_idx IN lt_selected_indices
      LET ls_component = lt_components[ lv_idx ] IN
      ( name  = ls_component-name
        value = |
          { REF #( is_data )->*( ls_component-name ) }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel kombiniert `cl_abap_random_int` mit RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) und dynamischem Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur. Es demonstriert, wie man zur Laufzeit Informationen über Datenstrukturen abrufen und diese dynamisch manipulieren kann. Die Verwendung von `REF #( is_data )->*( ls_component-name )` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature von modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine externe REST-API (GET-Anfrage) über die XCO-Bibliothek auf und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort. Das Beispiel ruft eine öffentliche API auf, die JSON zurückgibt.

CLASS zcl_xco_rest_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_api_response,
             fact TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_api_response.
    METHODS get_cat_fact RETURNING VALUE(rs_cat_fact) TYPE ty_api_response
      RAISING cx_xco_cp_http_client_error cx_xco_cp_json_parser_error.

CLASS zcl_xco_rest_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cat_fact.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_xco_cp_http_client=>create( 'https://catfact.ninja/fact' ).
    DATA(lo_http_request) = lo_http_client->create_request( iv_method = if_xco_cp_http_method=>get ).

    DATA(lo_http_response) = lo_http_client->execute( lo_http_request ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = lo_http_response->get_body( )->get_as_string( ).

    DATA(lo_json_parser) = cl_xco_cp_json_parser=>create( lv_json_string ).
    rs_cat_fact = lo_json_parser->parse( )->as_structure( )->to_abap( VALUE #( BASE rs_cat_fact ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_create_custom_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD test_create_field.

    DATA(lv_field_name) = 'ZTEST_FIELD_' && sy-uzeit.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für einen bestimmten Flug mit einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression, um über die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und die Summe zu bilden. Denken Sie an die Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_price.
    " Annahme: SFLIGHTS enthält Daten für 'AA' und '0017'
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_agg( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) TYPE sflight-price.

    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_price
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_expected_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_agg( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP, das es ermöglicht, Aggregationen oder Transformationen über interne Tabellen in einer einzigen, prägnanten Zeile durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht. Die Inline-Deklaration `@DATA(lt_sflights)` vereinfacht zusätzlich den Datenbankzugriff.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, Open SQL

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die teurer als 500 EUR sind, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit nur der Flugnummer und dem Preis, sortiert nach Preis.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER`- und `FOR`-Expressions mit `VALUE` für eine effiziente Datenmanipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( SORTED BY price
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price )
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid = ls_flight-connid,
          price = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lt_expensive_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_expensive_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Price must be > 500' act = ls_flight-price > 500 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check sorting (optional, but good practice for SORTED TABLE)
    DATA(lv_prev_price) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_expensive_flights INTO ls_flight.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should be sorted by price' act = ls_flight-price >= lv_prev_price ).
      lv_prev_price = ls_flight-price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( 999999 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be empty' act = lt_expensive_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FILTER`- und `FOR`-Expressions innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Expression. Dies ist ein sehr effizienter und ausdrucksstarker Weg, um interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig in ein neues Format zu transformieren (Mapping). Die Syntax ist deklarativ und vermeidet explizite Schleifen, was den Code kompakter und leichter verständlich macht. Die `SORTED BY` Klausel in `VALUE` ermöglicht zudem eine direkte Sortierung der Zieltabelle.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, SFLIGHTS, Mapping, Sorting, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_string_template_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_string_template_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info_string.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_flight_string = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } kostet { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency } { ls_flight-currency }.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_flight_string = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. Es ist besonders nützlich für Builder-Muster oder Konfigurations-APIs.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent API, Design Patterns

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die moderne Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY`, `CATCH` und `ENDTRY` um Ausnahmen abzufangen und zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = divide( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 0. " Defaultwert bei Division durch Null
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe mit der `GROUP BY` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `GROUP BY` Expression in Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group,
           tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_group.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, connid = ls_group-connid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
                                   connid = ls_group-connid,
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouping( ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob ein bekannter Flug (z.B. AA 0017) vorhanden ist und eine Anzahl hat
    DATA(ls_aa_0017) = VALUE ty_flight_group( ).
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO ls_aa_0017 WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.

Sie bietet eine deklarative und funktionale Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Konstrukten, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert. `GROUP SIZE` ist eine spezielle Variable, die die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe liefert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbolen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_sflight_data.
    DATA: lv_struct_name TYPE string,
          lv_table_name TYPE string.

    " Build dynamic structure type
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_data( VALUE #( FOR field_name IN it_field_names ( name = field_name type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( field_name ) ) ) ).
    lv_struct_name = lo_struct_descr->get_relative_name( ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any,
                   <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Select data dynamically
    DATA(lv_field_list) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR field_name IN it_field_names NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field_name ELSE s && ',' && field_name ) ).

    DATA(lv_select_statement) = |SELECT { lv_field_list } FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_dynamic_table>|.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          {lv_select_statement}
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_sflight_data FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_sflight_data( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_flights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_flights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' act = <lt_flights> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_flight> TYPE any.
    LOOP AT <lt_flights> ASSIGN <ls_flight>.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_flight> TO <lv_carrid>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'CARRID field should be accessible' act = <lv_carrid> ).
      EXIT.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_flights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_flights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' act = <lt_flights> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_flight> TYPE any.
    LOOP AT <lt_flights> ASSIGN <ls_flight>.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_price> TYPE sflight-price.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_flight> TO <lv_price>.

explanation: Dynamische Programmierung ermöglicht es, die Struktur von Datenobjekten (wie internen Tabellen) zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen und zu manipulieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Berichte oder Schnittstellen, bei denen die benötigten Felder nicht im Voraus bekannt sind. Die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist der moderne Weg, dies in ABAP zu erreichen. Beachten Sie die Verwendung von Native SQL für den dynamischen `SELECT`, da Open SQL keine vollständig dynamische Feldliste unterstützt.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, SFLIGHTS, Native SQL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Die Datei soll die Spalten `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`, `PRICE`, `CURRENCY` enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` und füllen Sie die Daten zeilenweise. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Datumformatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflights_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).

    " Add header row
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_row    = 1
        i_column = 1
        i_data   = VALUE string_table( ( 'Airline ID' ) ( 'Connection ID' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ( 'Price' ) ( 'Currency' ) )
    ).

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1. " Start from row 2 for data
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
        EXPORTING
          i_row    = lv_row
          i_column = 1
          i_data   = VALUE string_table(
                       ( ls_sflight-carrid )
                       ( ls_sflight-connid )
                       ( |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }| ) " Format date
                       ( |{ ls_sflight-price }| )
                       ( ls_sflight-currency )
                     )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Save the Excel file
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~save(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_file_path
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_temp_file) = |{ cl_abap_tmp_dir=>get_instance( )->get_tmp_dir( ) }/sflights_test.xlsx|.

          msg = 'Excel file should be created'

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_temp_file ).
