Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit zwei Blättern. Das erste Blatt soll 'Header' heißen und einen Titel enthalten. Das zweite Blatt soll 'Data' heißen und eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `sflight` enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `add_sheet` und `set_active_sheet` von `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multi_sheet_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).

    " Sheet 1: Header
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Header' ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_active_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Header' ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_row    = 1
        i_column = 1
        i_data   = VALUE string_table( ( 'Flight Data Report' ) )
    ).

    " Sheet 2: Data
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Data' ).
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_active_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Data' ).

    DATA(lt_airlines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carrids).
    lt_airlines = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_carrid IN lt_carrids ( ls_carrid-carrid ) ).

    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_row    = 1
        i_column = 1
        i_data   = VALUE string_table( ( 'Airline ID' ) )
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_airlines INTO DATA(lv_airline).
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
        EXPORTING
          i_row    = sy-tabix + 1
          i_column = 1
          i_data   = VALUE string_table( ( lv_airline ) )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~save(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_file_path
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `set_cell_format` und `set_column_format` mit den entsprechenden Formatierungsoptionen von `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_formatting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_formatted_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_formatting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).

    " Add header row
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_row    = 1
        i_column = 1
        i_data   = VALUE string_table( ( 'Airline ID' ) ( 'Connection ID' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ( 'Price' ) ( 'Currency' ) )
    ).
    " Format header row as bold
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_cell_format(
      EXPORTING
        i_row    = 1
        i_column = 1
        i_format = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>c_format_bold
        i_count  = 5 " Apply to 5 columns
    ).

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
        EXPORTING
          i_row    = lv_row
          i_column = 1
          i_data   = VALUE string_table(
                       ( ls_sflight-carrid )
                       ( ls_sflight-connid )
                       ( |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }| )
                       ( |{ ls_sflight-price }| ) " Price as string for now, format applied later
                       ( ls_sflight-currency )
                     )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Format 'Price' column (column 4) as currency
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_column_format(
      EXPORTING
        i_column = 4
        i_format = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>c_format_currency
    ).

    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~save(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_file_path
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD get_greeting_message.
    DATA(lv_language) = cl_abap_syst=>get_langu( ).

    CASE lv_language.
      WHEN 'D'.

CLASS zcl_syst_prod_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_production_system
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_prod) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_syst_prod_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_production_system.
    DATA(lv_sysid) = cl_abap_syst=>get_sysid( ).

    " Example logic: Systems starting with 'P' are production
    " In a real scenario, this logic would be more robust (e.g., configuration table)
    IF lv_sysid CP 'P*'.
      rv_is_prod = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_prod = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit Daten aus `sflight`. Fügen Sie einen Filter für die Spalte 'Airline ID' hinzu und setzen Sie die erste Zeile als Kopfzeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_auto_filter` und `set_header_row` von `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_filters DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_excel_with_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_filters IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_excel_with_filter.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).

    " Add header row
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_row    = 1
        i_column = 1
        i_data   = VALUE string_table( ( 'Airline ID' ) ( 'Connection ID' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ( 'Price' ) ( 'Currency' ) )
    ).

    " Set first row as header row
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_header_row( i_row = 1 ).

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~add_data(
        EXPORTING
          i_row    = lv_row
          i_column = 1
          i_data   = VALUE string_table(
                       ( ls_sflight-carrid )
                       ( ls_sflight-connid )
                       ( |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }| )
                       ( |{ ls_sflight-price }| )
                       ( ls_sflight-currency )
                     )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Apply auto filter to the entire data range (from header row)
    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~set_auto_filter( i_row_from = 1 i_column_from = 1 i_row_to = sy-tabix i_column_to = 5 ).

    lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~save(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_file_path
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwendet, um nach einer bestimmten Zeit ein Ereignis auszulösen. Der Ereignishandler soll einen internen Status aktualisieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_timer` und registrieren Sie einen Handler für das `FINISHED`-Ereignis. Testen Sie die Logik des Event-Handlers direkt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS finished_event EXPORTING VALUE(iv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.
    METHODS get_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
    " Helper method for unit testing the event handler logic
    METHODS trigger_finished_for_test.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string VALUE 'Timer not started'.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    mv_status = |Timer started for { iv_interval } seconds.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    mv_status = 'Timer stopped'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    mv_status = 'Timer finished!'.
    RAISE EVENT finished_event EXPORTING iv_message = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status.
    rv_status = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_finished_for_test.
    handle_finished( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timer_start_stop FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_timer_finished_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_start_stop.
    DATA(lo_timer) = NEW zcl_timer_basic( ).
    lo_timer->start_timer( 1 ). " Set a short interval for testing
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_timer->get_status( ) exp = 'Timer started for 1 seconds.' msg = 'Timer should be started' ).
    lo_timer->stop_timer( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_timer->get_status( ) exp = 'Timer stopped' msg = 'Timer should be stopped' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timer_finished_event.
    DATA(lo_timer) = NEW zcl_timer_basic( ).
    DATA(lv_event_message) TYPE string.

    " Local class to handle the event
    CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS receive_event FOR EVENT finished_event OF zcl_timer_basic
          IMPORTING iv_message.
        DATA mv_received_message TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD receive_event.
        mv_received_message = iv_message.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_receiver) = NEW lcl_event_receiver( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_receiver->receive_event FOR lo_timer.

    " Trigger the event handler logic for testing
    lo_timer->trigger_finished_for_test( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_receiver->mv_received_message exp = 'Timer finished!' msg = 'Event message should be received' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_timer->get_status( ) exp = 'Timer finished!' msg = 'Status should be updated by event' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_gui_timer` zum Starten und Stoppen eines Timers sowie zur Behandlung seines `FINISHED`-Ereignisses. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_timer)`) und String-Templates (`|...|`) werden verwendet. Der Unit-Test simuliert das Auslösen des Ereignisses über eine Hilfsmethode, um die Logik des Event-Handlers zu überprüfen, da GUI-Ereignisse nicht direkt in Unit-Tests ausgelöst werden können.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, EVENTS, SET HANDLER, DATA, String Templates, Event Handling, GUI

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwaltet und dessen Intervall zur Laufzeit dynamisch anpassen kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Eigenschaft `interval` des Timers und die Methoden `run()` und `stop()` zur Neukonfiguration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic_interval DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_initial_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS set_new_interval IMPORTING iv_new_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.
    METHODS get_current_interval RETURNING VALUE(rv_interval) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_current_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic_interval IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_initial_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    mv_current_interval = iv_initial_interval.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_new_interval.
    mo_timer->stop( ). " Stop current timer
    mo_timer->interval = iv_new_interval. " Set new interval
    mo_timer->run( ). " Restart with new interval
    mv_current_interval = iv_new_interval.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    mv_current_interval = 0. " Indicate stopped or no interval
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    " Logic to be executed when timer finishes
    " For this example, we just log or update an internal state
    " To make it restart automatically, one would call run() again here.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_interval.
    rv_interval = mv_current_interval.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_interval FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_interval.
    DATA(lo_timer_manager) = NEW zcl_timer_dynamic_interval( ).
    lo_timer_manager->start_timer( 5 ). " Start with 5 seconds
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_timer_manager->get_current_interval( ) exp = 5 msg = 'Initial interval should be 5' ).

    lo_timer_manager->set_new_interval( 10 ). " Change to 10 seconds
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_timer_manager->get_current_interval( ) exp = 10 msg = 'Interval should be updated to 10' ).

    lo_timer_manager->stop_timer( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_timer_manager->get_current_interval( ) exp = 0 msg = 'Interval should be 0 after stop' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie das Intervall eines `cl_gui_timer` zur Laufzeit geändert werden kann. Durch Stoppen und erneutes Starten des Timers mit einem neuen `interval`-Wert kann das Zeitverhalten dynamisch angepasst werden. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_timer_manager)`) sind ein Kernbestandteil des modernen ABAP-Stils.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, interval, dynamic, DATA, GUI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwendet, um periodisch Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` abzurufen und einen internen Puffer zu aktualisieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_timer` und eine `SELECT`-Anweisung mit Inline-Deklarationen für die Datenbeschaffung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_sflight_refresh DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_refresh_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_refresh_timer.
    METHODS get_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    METHODS trigger_refresh_for_test. " Helper for unit test
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_flight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS fetch_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_sflight_refresh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_refresh_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    fetch_sflight_data( ). " Initial fetch
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_refresh_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    fetch_sflight_data( ). " Refresh data
    mo_timer->run( ). " Restart timer for next interval
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fetch_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_flight_data
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_data.
    rt_flight_data = mt_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_refresh_for_test.
    fetch_sflight_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_refresh FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_refresh.
    DATA(lo_sflight_refresher) = NEW zcl_timer_sflight_refresh( ).
    lo_sflight_refresher->start_refresh_timer( 1 ). " Start with 1 second interval

    " Simulate timer event to trigger data fetch
    lo_sflight_refresher->trigger_refresh_for_test( ).

    DATA(lt_data) = lo_sflight_refresher->get_flight_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_data msg = 'Flight data should not be initial after refresh' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 10 msg = 'Should fetch 10 rows' ).

    lo_sflight_refresher->stop_refresh_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Integration von `cl_gui_timer` mit Datenzugriff. Der Timer löst periodisch die Methode `fetch_sflight_data` aus, die Daten aus der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle abruft. Die Verwendung von `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data)` ist ein Paradebeispiel für moderne ABAP-Inline-Deklarationen, die den Code kürzer und lesbarer machen. Der Timer wird im Event-Handler neu gestartet, um eine kontinuierliche Aktualisierung zu gewährleisten. Eine Hilfsmethode ermöglicht das Testen der Datenabruflogik im Unit-Test.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) filtert und eine neue Tabelle mit nur den Flügen eines bestimmten Carriers und Preises über einem Schwellenwert erstellt. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration und `VALUE #(...)` für die Konstruktion der neuen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrier      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price    TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier AND price > iv_min_price )
        ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_it_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_it_for_value=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '90.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->filter_flights(
      it_flights   = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrier   = 'LH'
      iv_min_price = '100.00'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 matching flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First flight should be 0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'Second flight should be 0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR`-Iteratoren und `VALUE`-Konstruktorausdrücken zur effizienten Manipulation interner Tabellen. Anstatt einer expliziten `LOOP` und `APPEND` wird die neue Tabelle direkt deklariert und mit den gefilterten Elementen befüllt, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_processor)`) werden ebenfalls verwendet.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Filter, DATA, Constructor Expressions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Begrüßungsnachricht basierend auf einer Uhrzeit und einem Namen generiert. Verwenden Sie String-Templates und einen `COND`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie `|...|` für String-Templates und `COND` für die Auswahl des passenden Grußes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_time TYPE tims
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_greeting.
    DATA(lv_part_of_day) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_time BETWEEN '060000' AND '115959' THEN 'Guten Morgen'
      WHEN iv_time BETWEEN '120000' AND '175959' THEN 'Guten Tag'
      WHEN iv_time BETWEEN '180000' AND '235959' THEN 'Guten Abend'
      ELSE 'Hallo'
    ).
    rv_greeting = |{ lv_part_of_day }, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem initialen Wert und einer Akkumulationslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '500.00' msg = 'Total price calculation incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_flights( ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_price( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und wendet dann in jedem Schleifendurchlauf eine Akkumulationslogik an. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP` und `SUM`-Anweisungen durch eine kompakte, funktionale Syntax. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_calculator)`) tragen zur Modernität bei.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math, DATA, Constructor Expressions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten um eine neue Spalte erweitert, die den Status des Fluges (z.B. 'On Time', 'Delayed') basierend auf einem Kriterium enthält. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit einer `LET`-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE #(...)` in Kombination mit `LET` für temporäre Berechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_let_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime TYPE sflight-deptime,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES: tt_flights_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime TYPE sflight-deptime,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES: tt_flights_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_in TYPE tt_flights_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_out) TYPE tt_flights_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_let_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_status.
    rt_flights_out = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_in
      LET lv_status = COND string(
                          WHEN ls_flight-deptime < '100000' THEN 'On Time'
                          ELSE 'Delayed'
                        ) IN
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        deptime = ls_flight-deptime,
        status = lv_status )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_it_let_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_it_let_expression=>tt_flights_in(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' deptime = '090000' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' deptime = '110000' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230101' deptime = '100000' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20230101' deptime = '120000' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->add_flight_status( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 msg = 'Result table should have 4 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-status exp = 'On Time' msg = 'First flight status incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'On Time' msg = 'Second flight status incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-status exp = 'Delayed' msg = 'Third flight status incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-status exp = 'Delayed' msg = 'Fourth flight status incorrect' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FOR` und `VALUE` zusammen mit der `LET`-Anweisung, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren und dabei temporäre Variablen (`lv_status`) für Berechnungen innerhalb des Ausdrucks zu definieren. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Transformationen und Erweiterungen von Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung, ohne separate Schleifen oder Hilfsvariablen außerhalb des Ausdrucks. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_processor)`) sind Standard.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für eine 'Logger'-Funktionalität und implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei verschiedenen Klassen (z.B. für Konsolen- und Datei-Logging). Verwenden Sie dann eine Factory-Methode, um Instanzen der Logger-Klassen zu erzeugen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING`, `NEW #(...)` und `DATA` für die Factory-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / 'Console Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a file.
    " For simplicity, we just simulate it.
    mv_file_path = |File Log: { iv_message }|. " Store for testing
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_logger
      IMPORTING
        iv_logger_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_logger) TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_logger.
    CASE iv_logger_type.
      WHEN 'CONSOLE'.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
      WHEN 'FILE'.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle error or return default
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_file_logger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_console_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " Cannot assert WRITE output directly, but can check for no dump.
    lo_console_logger->zif_logger~log_message( 'Test message to console' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Placeholder assert
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_file_logger.
    DATA(lo_file_logger) = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
    lo_file_logger->zif_logger~log_message( 'Test message to file' ).
    " In a real test, you would check if the file was written correctly.
    " Here, we check an internal state if available.
    " For this example, we cannot directly access mv_file_path from outside.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Placeholder assert
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_method.
    DATA(lo_logger_console) = zcl_logger_factory=>create_logger( 'CONSOLE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_logger_console ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_logger_console IS INSTANCE OF zcl_console_logger ).

    DATA(lo_logger_file) = zcl_logger_factory=>create_logger( 'FILE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_logger_file ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_logger_file IS INSTANCE OF zcl_file_logger ).

    DATA(lo_logger_default) = zcl_logger_factory=>create_logger( 'UNKNOWN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_logger_default ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_logger_default IS INSTANCE OF zcl_console_logger ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert objektorientierte Prinzipien in modernem ABAP: Interfaces zur Definition von Verträgen (`zif_logger`), Implementierung in konkreten Klassen (`zcl_console_logger`, `zcl_file_logger`) und eine Factory-Methode (`zcl_logger_factory=>create_logger`) zur entkoppelten Instanziierung. Die Verwendung von `NEW #(...)` für die Objekterzeugung und Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_logger_console)`) sind zentrale Elemente des modernen Stils.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interfaces, Factory Method, DATA, NEW, Polymorphism

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*)` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ls_flight_line-carrid.
      DATA(ls_flight_count) = VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight_line-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle um, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und benennen Sie die Felder dabei um. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit Feldumbenennung.

CLASS zcl_it_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES: tt_flights_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES: tt_flights_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights_to_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_in TYPE tt_flights_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_out) TYPE tt_flights_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights_to_summary.
    rt_flights_out = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_in
      ( airline_id = ls_flight-carrid,
        flight_num = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus einer SORTED TABLE von Flugdaten.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und `FOR` mit `WHERE` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_modify_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Vergleiche den Speicherverbrauch einer internen Tabelle vor und nach dem Hinzufügen einer großen Menge von Daten.
hint: Messe den Speicherverbrauch vor und nach der Operation mit `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable`.

CLASS zcl_mem_compare_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_table_memory
      IMPORTING iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_memory_info) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_compare_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_memory.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_data,
          lv_initial_size TYPE i,
          lv_final_size TYPE i.

    lv_initial_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable( lt_data ).

    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = sy-index text = |Entry { sy-index } with some additional text| ) TO lt_data.
    ENDDO.

    lv_final_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable( lt_data ).

    DATA(ls_result) = VALUE struct_memory_info(
      initial_size = lv_initial_size
      final_size   = lv_final_size
      diff_size    = lv_final_size - lv_initial_size
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_memory_info LIKE ls_result.
    ASSIGN ls_result TO CAST #( rs_memory_info ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper structure for the result (define globally or in a dictionary)
TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_memory_info,
         initial_size TYPE i,
         final_size   TYPE i,
         diff_size    TYPE i,
       END OF struct_memory_info.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_growth.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_compare_size( ).
    DATA(lv_num_entries) = 1000.
    DATA(lr_memory_info) = lo_cut->compare_table_memory( lv_num_entries ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_memory_info> TYPE struct_memory_info.
    ASSIGN lr_memory_info->* TO <ls_memory_info>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_memory_info>-final_size msg = 'Final size should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_memory_info>-final_size > <ls_memory_info>-initial_size ) msg = 'Final size should be greater than initial size' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_memory_info>-diff_size > 0 ) msg = 'Difference in size should be positive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie `cl_abap_memory_utilities` verwendet werden kann, um den Speicherverbrauch vor und nach einer Operation zu vergleichen. Instructions: Vergleiche die Performance des Zugriffs auf eine SORTED TABLE mit einem Primärschlüssel und einem Sekundärschlüssel.
hint: Nutze `GET RUN TIME FIELD` oder `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less` für Performance-Tests und greife mit `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` und `FOR ... USING KEY` zu.

CLASS zcl_sflight_key_performance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate
                             WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY by_planetype COMPONENTS planetype.

    METHODS measure_primary_key_access
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
                iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.

    METHODS measure_secondary_key_access
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
                iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_key_performance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_primary_key_access.
    DATA: lv_start TYPE i,
          lv_end TYPE i,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_start.
    READ TABLE it_sflights INTO ls_sflight
      WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                     connid = iv_connid
                     fldate = iv_fldate.
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_end.
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end - lv_start.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_secondary_key_access.
    DATA: lv_start TYPE i,
          lv_end TYPE i,
          lt_sflights_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_start.
    lt_sflights_filtered = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                     USING KEY by_planetype
                                     WHERE ( planetype = iv_planetype ) ( ls_sflight ) ).
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_end.
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end - lv_start.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 120 )

    DATA(lv_runtime_primary) = lo_cut->measure_primary_key_access(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'AA'
      iv_connid   = '0017'
      iv_fldate   = '20250101'
    ).

    DATA(lv_runtime_secondary) = lo_cut->measure_secondary_key_access(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_planetype = '747'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_runtime_primary >= 0 ) msg = 'Primary key runtime should be non-negative' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_runtime_secondary >= 0 ) msg = 'Secondary key runtime should be non-negative' ).
    " Note: Actual performance comparison depends on data volume and system load.
    " For small datasets, differences might be negligible or even inverse due to overhead.
    " This test primarily demonstrates the measurement technique.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Performance von Primär- und Sekundärschlüsselzugriffen auf `SORTED TABLE`s gemessen werden kann. Obwohl die absolute Laufzeit von vielen Faktoren abhängt, ist die Verwendung von `GET RUN TIME FIELD` eine Standardmethode, um Code-Abschnitte zu profilieren und Optimierungspotenziale zu identifizieren. Der direkte Zugriff über den Primärschlüssel ist in der Regel am schnellsten, während Sekundärschlüssel Flexibilität bei akzeptabler Performance bieten.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Secondary Key, Performance, GET RUN TIME, Internal Tables

Instructions: Ermittle den Speicherverbrauch einer komplexen Datenstruktur, die verschachtelte interne Tabellen und Objekte enthält.
hint: Erstelle eine komplexe Datenstruktur und nutze `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable` für die gesamte Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_complex_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             desc TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sub_item.
    TYPES: tt_sub_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sub_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_main_item,
             key      TYPE string,
             value    TYPE string,
             sub_items TYPE tt_sub_items,
           END OF ty_main_item.
    TYPES: tt_main_items TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_main_item WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    CLASS zcl_nested_object DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_data TYPE string.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_data TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_nested_object IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_data = iv_data.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_complex_data,
             main_table TYPE tt_main_items,
             nested_obj TYPE REF TO zcl_nested_object,
           END OF ty_complex_data.

    METHODS create_and_measure_complex_data
      IMPORTING iv_num_main_items TYPE i
                iv_num_sub_items  TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_size) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_complex_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_measure_complex_data.
    DATA: ls_complex_data TYPE ty_complex_data.

    DO iv_num_main_items TIMES.
      DATA(ls_main_item) = VALUE ty_main_item(
        key = |KEY_{ sy-index }|
        value = |Value for main item { sy-index }|
      ).
      DO iv_num_sub_items TIMES.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sub_item(
          id = sy-index
          desc = |Sub item { sy-index } for main item { ls_main_item-key }|
        ) TO ls_main_item-sub_items.
      ENDDO.
      INSERT ls_main_item INTO TABLE ls_complex_data-main_table.
    ENDDO.

    ls_complex_data-nested_obj = NEW zcl_nested_object( |Data for nested object| ).

    rv_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable( ls_complex_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS zcl_sflight_insert_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflight_insert_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.

    TRY.

      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100
    ).

explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` ist es wichtig, Duplikate zu behandeln. Die moderne ABAP-Syntax ermöglicht dies elegant mit `TRY ... CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key`, anstatt den `sy-subrc` nach jedem `INSERT` zu prüfen. Dies führt zu robusterem und lesbarerem Code.

Instructions: Demonstriere die Freigabe von Speicher einer internen Tabelle und messe den Effekt auf den Speicherverbrauch.
hint: Nutze `CLEAR` und `FREE` für die Tabelle und `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_free_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_large_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             data TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_large_data.
    TYPES: tt_large_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_large_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_memory_release
      IMPORTING iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_memory_info) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_free_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_memory_release.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_large_data,
          lv_size_after_fill TYPE i,
          lv_size_after_clear TYPE i,
          lv_size_after_free TYPE i.

    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_large_data(
        id = sy-index
        text = |Long text for entry { sy-index } to consume memory|
        data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_xstring_from_string( |Binary data { sy-index }| )
      ) TO lt_data.
    ENDDO.

    lv_size_after_fill = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable( lt_data ).

    CLEAR lt_data. " Clears content, but keeps allocated memory
    lv_size_after_clear = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable( lt_data ).

    FREE lt_data. " Clears content and releases allocated memory
    lv_size_after_free = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_variable( lt_data ).

    DATA(ls_result) = VALUE struct_memory_release_info(
      size_after_fill  = lv_size_after_fill
      size_after_clear = lv_size_after_clear
      size_after_free  = lv_size_after_free
    ).
    CREATE DATA rs_memory_info LIKE ls_result.
    ASSIGN ls_result TO CAST #( rs_memory_info ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper structure for the result (define globally or in a dictionary)
TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_memory_release_info,
         size_after_fill  TYPE i,
         size_after_clear TYPE i,
         size_after_free  TYPE i,
       END OF struct_memory_release_info.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_release FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_release.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_free_table( ).
    DATA(lv_num_entries) = 100.
    DATA(lr_memory_info) = lo_cut->measure_memory_release( lv_num_entries ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_memory_info> TYPE struct_memory_release_info.
    ASSIGN lr_memory_info->* TO <ls_memory_info>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_memory_info>-size_after_fill > 0 ) msg = 'Size after fill should be positive' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_memory_info>-size_after_clear < <ls_memory_info>-size_after_fill ) msg = 'Size after clear should be less than after fill' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_memory_info>-size_after_free < <ls_memory_info>-size_after_clear ) msg = 'Size after free should be less than after clear' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_memory_info>-size_after_free >= 0 ) msg = 'Size after free should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verdeutlicht den Unterschied zwischen `CLEAR` und `FREE` für interne Tabellen in Bezug auf den Speicherverbrauch, gemessen mit `cl_abap_memory_utilities`. `CLEAR` leert den Inhalt, behält aber den zugewiesenen Speicher, während `FREE` sowohl den Inhalt löscht als auch den Speicher freigibt. Dies ist entscheidend für die Speicheroptimierung in langlebigen Programmen oder bei der Verarbeitung sehr großer Datenmengen.
keywords: cl_abap_memory_utilities, Memory, FREE, CLEAR, Internal Tables, Optimization

Instructions: Transformiere eine SORTED TABLE von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft enthält.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrier
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    rt_result = REDUCE tt_carrier_flight_count(
      INIT lt_counts TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_count = GROUP SIZE IN GROUP ls_sflight
      IN
      NEXT lt_counts = VALUE #( lt_counts
                                 ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_count FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_group_reduce=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ 1 ]-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ 2 ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_group_reduce=>tt_sflight_sorted(
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_counts ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Sie ermöglicht komplexe Transformationen in einer deklarativen und funktionalen Weise, die den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert, insbesondere im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... AT NEW` Konstrukten.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, Grouping, Aggregation, Functional Programming

hint: Verwenden Sie `get_aggregations` und `add_aggregation`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_aggregated.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_aggregated.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 50 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = lt_sflights ).
        DATA(lo_aggregations) = lo_salv_table->get_aggregations( ).

        " Aggregation für 'PRICE' hinzufügen (Summe)
        lo_aggregations->add_aggregation( columnname = 'PRICE' aggregation = if_salv_c_aggregation=>sum ).

        " Gruppierung nach 'CARRID' für Subtotals (optional, aber sinnvoll bei Aggregation)
        DATA(lo_sorts) = lo_salv_table->get_sorts( ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'CARRID' subtotal = abap_true ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_sflights IS INITIAL ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = lt_sflights ).

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an, aber nur für dynamisch ausgewählte Spalten (z.B. 'CARRID', 'CONNID', 'FLDATE').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table=>factory` mit einem dynamisch erzeugten Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset,
           tt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_columns TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_columns.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_dynamic_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Dynamischen Feldkatalog erstellen
    DATA lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    LOOP AT it_columns INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = lv_column_name ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf Feldkatalog erstellen
    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lt_dynamic_data.

    ASSIGN lt_dynamic_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_data>.

    " Daten in die dynamische Tabelle kopieren
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight>).
      DATA ls_dynamic_row TYPE REF TO data.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_row> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA ls_dynamic_row LIKE LINE OF <fs_dynamic_data>.
      ASSIGN ls_dynamic_row->* TO <fs_dynamic_row>.

      LOOP AT it_columns INTO lv_column_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_source_field>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_target_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_dynamic_row> TO <fs_dynamic_data>.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = <fs_dynamic_data> ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_columns FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_dynamic_columns( ).
    DATA lt_columns TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_columns.

    APPEND 'FLDATE' TO lt_columns.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_dynamic_columns( it_columns = lt_columns ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies erfordert die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle mittels `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` und Feldkatalog (`lvc_t_fcat`). Die Daten werden dann manuell in diese dynamische Tabelle kopiert. `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` sind hierfür unerlässlich. `VALUE lvc_s_fcat(...)` ist ein moderner Konstruktorausdruck.

CLASS zcl_salv_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_for_exp.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_for_exp.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    IF lt_sflights_all IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Moderne Datenvorbereitung mit FOR-Ausdruck und WHERE-Klausel
    DATA(lt_sflights_filtered) = VALUE sflights_tt(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_all WHERE ( price > 500 )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    IF lt_sflights_filtered IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flüge über 500 gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = lt_sflights_filtered ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_expression.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 600 ) TO lt_sflights_all.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 450 ) TO lt_sflights_all.

    DATA(lt_sflights_filtered) = VALUE sflights_tt(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_all WHERE ( price > 500 )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = lt_sflights_filtered ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_salv_table ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Datenvorbereitung mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Klausel. Dies ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen, bevor sie an das ALV übergeben werden. Es ist wesentlich lesbarer und effizienter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte.
keywords: cl_salv_table, FOR Expression, WHERE, Internal Tables, Data Preparation, VALUE

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an, wobei die `PRICE`-Werte in einer neuen Spalte in USD umgerechnet werden (angenommener fester Wechselkurs). Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` für die Datenaggregation und Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_reduce_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_usd,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             price_usd TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_usd,
           tt_sflight_usd TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_usd WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_usd.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_reduce_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_usd.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CONSTANTS: lc_exchange_rate TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '1.10'. " Beispiel Wechselkurs

    " Transformation mit REDUCE und FOR-Ausdruck
    DATA(lt_sflights_usd) = REDUCE tt_sflight_usd(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_usd( )
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_sflight_usd(
        BASE result
        ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid    = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
          price     = ls_sflight-price
          currency  = ls_sflight-currency
          price_usd = ls_sflight-price * lc_exchange_rate )
      )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = lt_sflights_usd ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_transform.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    CONSTANTS: lc_exchange_rate TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '1.10'.

    DATA(lt_sflights_usd) = REDUCE zcl_salv_reduce_transform=>tt_sflight_usd(
      INIT result = VALUE zcl_salv_reduce_transform=>tt_sflight_usd( )
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = VALUE zcl_salv_reduce_transform=>tt_sflight_usd(
        BASE result
        ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid    = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
          price     = ls_sflight-price
          currency  = ls_sflight-currency
          price_usd = ls_sflight-price * lc_exchange_rate )
      )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_usd ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_usd[ 1 ]-price_usd exp = '110.00' ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = lt_sflights_usd ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_salv_table ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine interne Tabelle zu transformieren und eine neue Spalte mit umgerechneten Werten hinzuzufügen. `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für deklarative Aggregationen und Transformationen, das den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht. `VALUE BASE` wird verwendet, um die vorherigen Einträge beizubehalten.
keywords: cl_salv_table, REDUCE, FOR Expression, Internal Tables, Transformation, VALUE BASE

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an und heben Sie Zeilen hervor, bei denen der `PRICE` über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_selections` und `set_selection_mode` sowie `set_color` für Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_row_highlight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_highlighted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_row_highlight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_highlighted.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 50 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CONSTANTS: lc_price_threshold TYPE s_price VALUE 700.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = lt_sflights ).

        " Zeilen markieren, bei denen der Preis über dem Schwellenwert liegt
        DATA(lo_selections) = lo_salv_table->get_selections( ).
        lo_selections->set_selection_mode( if_salv_c_selection_mode=>row_single ). " Einzelne Zeilenauswahl

        LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          IF ls_sflight-price > lc_price_threshold.
            lo_selections->set_color(
              row     = sy-tabix
              color   = cl_salv_display_settings=>c_color_info_light
              colname = '' " Leerer Colname für ganze Zeile
            ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_row_highlight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_row_highlight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 800 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 600 ) TO lt_sflights.

    CONSTANTS: lc_price_threshold TYPE s_price VALUE 700.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_alv_table = lt_sflights ).
        DATA(lo_selections) = lo_salv_table->get_selections( ).
        lo_selections->set_selection_mode( if_salv_c_selection_mode=>row_single ).

        LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          IF ls_sflight-price > lc_price_threshold.
            lo_selections->set_color(
              row     = sy-tabix
              color   = cl_salv_display_settings=>c_color_info_light
              colname = ''
            ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        " Direkte Überprüfung der Zeilenfarbe ist im Unit Test schwierig, 
        " aber wir können prüfen, ob die Methode ohne Fehler aufgerufen wird.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Zeilen im ALV basierend auf einer Bedingung farblich hervorhebt. Die Methode `set_color()` des Selektionsobjekts (`get_selections()`) ermöglicht dies. Die Verwendung von `cl_salv_display_settings=>c_color_info_light` für die Farbe ist eine typsichere und standardisierte Methode. `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` ist moderne Syntax für die Iteration über interne Tabellen.
keywords: cl_salv_table, ALV Highlighting, get_selections, set_color, cl_salv_display_settings, LOOP AT DATA

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz von `CL_GUI_PICTURE` und laden Sie ein Bild von einer dynamisch konstruierten URL. Die URL soll den Fluggesellschaftscode (CARRID) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates (`|...|`) zur dynamischen Erstellung der Bild-URL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_dynamic_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    METHODS get_picture_url RETURNING VALUE(rv_url) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    DATA mo_picture TYPE REF TO cl_gui_picture.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_dynamic_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    " Erstelle einen Custom Container, um das Bild zu hosten
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' ).
    mo_picture = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = mo_container ).
    mo_picture->load_picture_from_url( url = get_picture_url() ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_picture_url.
    " Beispiel-URL, die dynamisch den Fluggesellschaftscode einfügt
    rv_url = |https://example.com/images/{ mv_carrid }_logo.png|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_url_construction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_url_construction.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pic_dynamic_url( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_expected_url) = 'https://example.com/images/LH_logo.png'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_picture_url() exp = lv_expected_url msg = 'URL should match expected value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne und lesbare Art, Strings zu konstruieren. Sie ermöglichen die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken in den String, was die Lesbarkeit gegenüber der klassischen Verkettung (`&&`) erheblich verbessert und Fehler reduziert.
keywords: CL_GUI_PICTURE, String Templates, GUI Controls, Dynamic URL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und befüllen Sie ihn mit einem `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`. Der Textinhalt des `TEXTEDIT` soll dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle generiert werden, die mit `FOR` und `REDUCE` aggregiert wurde.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` um die Daten zu verarbeiten und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_textedit_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_aggregated_text RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_textedit_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'TEXT_CONTAINER' ).
    mo_textedit = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = mo_container ).
    mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( text = get_aggregated_text() ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_aggregated_text.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE TABLE OF ty_flight.

    " Beispielhafte Daten aus sflights filtern und aggregieren
    lt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid ) WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ).

    rv_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT s = s && |Flug { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }\n| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_textedit_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_text().
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_text ) " Should not be initial if sflights has LH entries
      OR cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_text exp = 'Flug LH-' msg = 'Aggregated text should contain flight info' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR` und `REDUCE` sind leistungsstarke funktionale Ausdrücke, die es ermöglichen, interne Tabellen kompakt zu verarbeiten und zu aggregieren. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code im Vergleich zu klassischen Schleifen (`LOOP AT`).
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTAINER, CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT, FOR, REDUCE, Internal Tables, String Processing

Instructions: Laden Sie ein Base64-kodiertes Bild als XSTRING und zeigen Sie es in einem `CL_GUI_PICTURE` an. Das Base64-String soll als Eingabeparameter übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` oder `cl_http_utility=>decode_base64` um den Base64-String in XSTRING zu konvertieren, und `cl_gui_picture->load_picture_from_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_base64_load DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_base64_string TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_picture TYPE REF TO cl_gui_picture.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS convert_base64_to_xstring IMPORTING iv_base64 TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_base64_load IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'PICTURE_CONTAINER' ).
    mo_picture = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = mo_container ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = convert_base64_to_xstring( iv_base64_string ).
    IF lv_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_picture->load_picture_from_data( xdata = lv_xstring ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_base64_to_xstring.
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_http_utility=>decode_base64( iv_base64 ).
      CATCH cx_bcs.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen
        MESSAGE 'Fehler bei Base64-Dekodierung' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_base64_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_base64 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_base64_conversion.
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'SGVsbG8gV2VsdCE='." Base64 for 'Hello World!'
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = 'Hello World!' codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pic_base64_load( iv_base64_string = lv_test_string ).
    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_base64_to_xstring( lv_test_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring msg = 'Base64 conversion should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_base64.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pic_base64_load( iv_base64_string = '' ).
    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_base64_to_xstring( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_actual_xstring msg = 'Empty Base64 should result in empty XSTRING' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die direkte Verarbeitung von XSTRING-Daten für Bilder ist effizienter, da keine temporären Dateien oder URLs benötigt werden. `cl_http_utility=>decode_base64` bietet eine einfache und moderne Methode zur Dekodierung von Base64-Strings in binäre Daten (XSTRING).
keywords: CL_GUI_PICTURE, XSTRING, Base64, Data Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und setzen Sie seine Breite dynamisch basierend auf einem booleschen Flag. Wenn das Flag wahr ist, soll die Breite 500 Pixel betragen, ansonsten 200 Pixel.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck, um den Wert für die Breite zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_dynamic_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_is_wide TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_container_width RETURNING VALUE(rv_width) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mv_is_wide TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_dynamic_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_is_wide = iv_is_wide.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'SIZE_CONTAINER' ).
    " Die Breite des Containers wird hier nicht direkt gesetzt, da dies über den Screen Painter oder Layout-Manager geschieht.
    " Die Methode get_container_width simuliert die dynamische Bestimmung.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_container_width.
    rv_width = COND #( WHEN mv_is_wide = abap_true THEN 500 ELSE 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_wide_container FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_narrow_container FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_wide_container.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_dynamic_size( iv_is_wide = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_container_width() exp = 500 msg = 'Width should be 500 for wide flag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_narrow_container.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_dynamic_size( iv_is_wide = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_container_width() exp = 200 msg = 'Width should be 200 for narrow flag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COND` ist ein bedingter Ausdruck, der eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zu klassischen `IF`-Anweisungen für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen bietet. Dies verbessert die Code-Klarheit und reduziert Boilerplate-Code.
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTAINER, COND, Conditional Logic, Dynamic Sizing

Instructions: Erstellen Sie mehrere `CL_GUI_PICTURE` Objekte in einem `CL_GUI_FLOW_CONTAINER` basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Bild-URLs. Die Bilder sollen nebeneinander angezeigt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` um über die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und die `CL_GUI_PICTURE` Objekte zu erstellen und in den Flow Container einzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_flow_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_picture_urls TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_picture_urls TYPE tt_picture_urls.
    METHODS get_picture_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_flow_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_flow_container.
    DATA mt_pictures TYPE TABLE OF REF TO cl_gui_picture.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_flow_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_flow_container = NEW cl_gui_flow_container( container_name = 'FLOW_CONTAINER' ).

    mt_pictures = VALUE #( FOR lv_url IN it_picture_urls
                           ( NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = mo_flow_container ) ) ).

    LOOP AT mt_pictures INTO DATA(lo_picture).
      DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix.
      lo_picture->load_picture_from_url( url = it_picture_urls[ lv_index ] ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_picture_count.
    rv_count = lines( mt_pictures ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiple_pictures FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_pictures FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_pictures.
    DATA: lt_urls TYPE zcl_pic_flow_container=>tt_picture_urls.
    APPEND 'https://example.com/img1.png' TO lt_urls.
    APPEND 'https://example.com/img2.png' TO lt_urls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pic_flow_container( it_picture_urls = lt_urls ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_picture_count() exp = 2 msg = 'Should create 2 picture objects' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_pictures.
    DATA: lt_urls TYPE zcl_pic_flow_container=>tt_picture_urls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pic_flow_container( it_picture_urls = lt_urls ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_picture_count() exp = 0 msg = 'Should create 0 picture objects for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_pic_dynamic_visibility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_status TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 active   TYPE ty_status VALUE 'ACTIVE',
                 inactive TYPE ty_status VALUE 'INACTIVE',
                 error    TYPE ty_status VALUE 'ERROR',
               END OF gc_status.
