CLASS zcl_pic_dynamic_visibility IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_status = iv_status.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'VISIBILITY_CONTAINER' ).
    mo_picture = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = mo_container ).
    " Die Sichtbarkeit wird hier nicht direkt gesetzt, da dies über den Screen Painter oder Layout-Manager geschieht.
    " Die Methode is_picture_visible simuliert die dynamische Bestimmung.

  METHOD is_picture_visible.
    rv_visible = SWITCH abap_bool(
      mv_status
      WHEN gc_status-active THEN abap_true

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung von mehreren Ereignissen (z.B. Klicks auf Bilder in einem Container) und aggregieren Sie die Ergebnisse mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine Summe oder einen aggregierten Wert aus den simulierten Ereignissen zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_event_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_event.
    TYPES: tt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_events IMPORTING it_events TYPE tt_events RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_event_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_events.
    " Simuliert die Aggregation von Werten aus einer Liste von Ereignissen.
    " Zum Beispiel könnten 'value' die Punkte sein, die ein Klick auf ein Bild generiert.
    rv_total_value = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_event IN it_events
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_event-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_aggregation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_events FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_aggregation.
    DATA: lt_events TYPE zcl_con_event_reduce=>tt_events.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 10 ) TO lt_events.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 20 ) TO lt_events.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 5 ) TO lt_events.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_event_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->process_events( lt_events ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 35 msg = 'Total value should be 35' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_events.
    DATA: lt_events TYPE zcl_con_event_reduce=>tt_events.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_event_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->process_events( lt_events ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total value should be 0 for empty event list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_event.
    DATA: lt_events TYPE zcl_con_event_reduce=>tt_events.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 100 ) TO lt_events.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_event_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->process_events( lt_events ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 100 msg = 'Total value should be 100 for single event' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung ermöglicht. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Verarbeitung von Listen von Ereignissen oder Datenpunkten, um Summen, Zähler oder andere aggregierte Ergebnisse zu berechnen, und führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTAINER, Event Handling, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_pic_value_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_flight_number TYPE s_conn_id.

CLASS zcl_pic_value_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_flight_number = iv_flight_number.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'VALUE_CONTAINER' ).
    mo_picture = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = mo_container ).
    " Hier würde man normalerweise das Bild laden, z.B. aus der MIME-Repository
    " mo_picture->load_picture_from_url( url = get_picture_id() ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_picture_id.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight(
      sflights[ connid = mv_flight_number ] OPTIONAL ).

    IF ls_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_picture_id = SWITCH string(
        ls_sflight-carrid
        WHEN 'LH' THEN 'SAP_LOGO_LH'
        WHEN 'AA' THEN 'SAP_LOGO_AA'
        ELSE 'SAP_LOGO_DEFAULT' ).
    ELSE.
      rv_picture_id = 'SAP_LOGO_NOT_FOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER` und platzieren Sie in seinen beiden Bereichen jeweils einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER`. Die Aufteilung soll dynamisch über String-Templates konfiguriert werden.

CLASS zcl_con_splitter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_split_ratio TYPE i.
    METHODS get_left_container_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_right_container_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.

    DATA mo_right_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mv_split_ratio TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_con_splitter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_split_ratio = iv_split_ratio.
    DATA(lv_main_container_name) = |MAIN_SPLITTER_CONTAINER|.
    DATA(lo_main_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = lv_main_container_name ).

    mo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = lo_main_container,
      rows    = 1,
      columns = 2 ).

    mo_splitter->set_column_mode( mode = cl_gui_splitter_container=>co_sash_mode_absolute ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_sash( id = 1 value = mv_split_ratio ).

    mo_left_container = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    mo_right_container = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    " Optional: Setze Namen für die Untercontainer, um sie später zu identifizieren
    mo_left_container->set_container_name( |LEFT_PANEL_{ mv_split_ratio }| ).
    mo_right_container->set_container_name( |RIGHT_PANEL_{ mv_split_ratio }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_left_container_name.
    rv_name = |LEFT_PANEL_{ mv_split_ratio }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_right_container_name.
    rv_name = |RIGHT_PANEL_{ mv_split_ratio }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_dynamic_tooltip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_con_dynamic_tooltip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'AIRLINES_CONTAINER' ).
    mo_container->set_tooltip( tooltip = get_airlines_tooltip() ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_airlines_tooltip.
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( ls_sflight-carrid ) ).

    rv_tooltip = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = |Verfügbare Fluggesellschaften:\n|
      FOR lv_carrid IN lt_carrids

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sum_total_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sum_total_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

        INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights

Instructions: Ermittle den Gesamtpreis der Flüge, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit `SUM` in der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_grouped_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_grouped_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_carrier_total) = VALUE ty_carrier_total( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                        total_price = REDUCE #( 
                                                            INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                                            FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                            NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_group_member>-price ) ).
      APPEND ls_carrier_total TO rt_carrier_totals.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_grouped_prices FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_grouped_price( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_totals) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should contain entries' act = ( lines( lt_carrier_totals ) > 0 ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_carrier_totals INTO DATA(ls_lh_total) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH should be in the results' act = ( sy-subrc = 0 ) ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_filter_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sum_filter_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_post_date_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate > iv_date ).

Instructions: Berechne den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode und serialisiere das Ergebnis (Fluggesellschaft und Gesamtpreis) in ein XSTRING.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `SUM` und anschließend `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` gefolgt von `cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_to_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_sum,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_sum.

    METHODS get_and_serialize_carrier_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring_result) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_serialize_carrier_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(ls_carrier_sum) = VALUE ty_carrier_sum(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      total_price = REDUCE #( 
          INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
          FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price )
    ).

    DATA lv_xml_string TYPE string.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE carrier_sum = ls_carrier_sum
      RESULT XML lv_xml_string.

    rv_xstring_result = cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_to_xstring( lv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_and_serialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_and_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_serialize( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_result) = lo_cut->get_and_serialize_carrier_sum( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'XSTRING result should not be initial' act = lv_xstring_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'XSTRING result length should be positive' act = ( xstrlen( lv_xstring_result ) > 0 ) ).

    DATA lv_xml_string TYPE string.
    lv_xml_string = cl_abap_container_utilities=>xstring_to_string( lv_xstring_result ).

    DATA ls_deserialized_sum TYPE zcl_sum_serialize=>ty_carrier_sum.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE XML lv_xml_string
      RESULT carrier_sum = ls_deserialized_sum.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized_sum-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_deserialized_sum-total_price > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Aggregation von Daten mittels `REDUCE` und `SUM` mit der Serialisierung des Ergebnisses. Zuerst wird der Gesamtpreis für eine Fluggesellschaft berechnet, dann wird die Ergebnisstruktur mittels `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` in XML konvertiert und schließlich das XML in ein XSTRING umgewandelt.
keywords: REDUCE, SUM, XSTRING, Serialization, CALL TRANSFORMATION, cl_abap_container_utilities

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge enthält.

solution:
CLASS zcl_value_for_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_sums_with_value RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_sums_with_value.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_totals = VALUE tt_carrier_totals(
        FOR GROUPS <key> OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
        ( carrid      = <key>-carrid
          total_price = REDUCE #( 
              INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
              FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP <key>
              NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_group_member>-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should contain entries' act = ( lines( lt_carrier_totals ) > 0 ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_carrier_totals INTO DATA(ls_lh_total) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.

    ENDIF.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität (seatsmax) überschreiten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_cond_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_by_min_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_cond_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_by_min_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( seatsmax > iv_min_seats )
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_sflights_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

CLASS zcl_gui_sflights_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    IF mo_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
      mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
        i_parent = mo_container
        i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING AS carrier
      ( node_key = |CARRIER_{ carrier-carrid }|
        text = |Fluggesellschaft: { carrier-carrid }|
        is_folder = abap_true )
      FOR flight_by_carrier IN carrier
      ( node_key = |FLIGHT_{ flight_by_carrier-carrid }_{ flight_by_carrier-connid }|
        text = |Flug { flight_by_carrier-connid } - Datum: { flight_by_carrier-fldate }|
        parent_key = |CARRIER_{ carrier-carrid }| )
    ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'CARRIER_LH' ). " Beispiel: Lufthansa erweitern
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_tree.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    METHODS on_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = mo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).
    SET HANDLER me->on_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Wurzel' is_folder = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'ITEM1' text = 'Element 1' parent_key = 'ROOT' )
      ( node_key = 'ITEM2' text = 'Element 2' parent_key = 'ROOT' )
    ).
    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_node_double_click.
    DATA(lv_node_text) = 'Unbekannter Knoten'.
    DATA(lt_nodes) = mo_tree->get_nodes( ).
    READ TABLE lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node) WITH KEY node_key = node_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_node_text = ls_node-text.
    ENDIF.
    MESSAGE |Knoten '{ lv_node_text }' ({ node_key }) doppelt geklickt!| TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die angezeigten Knoten eines CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE basierend auf einem Suchbegriff. Nur Knoten, deren Text den Suchbegriff enthält, sollen sichtbar sein.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_tree.
    METHODS filter_tree IMPORTING iv_search_term TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_all_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = mo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    mt_all_nodes = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Alle Elemente' is_folder = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'FRUIT' text = 'Früchte' parent_key = 'ROOT' is_folder = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'APPLE' text = 'Apfel' parent_key = 'FRUIT' )
      ( node_key = 'BANANA' text = 'Banane' parent_key = 'FRUIT' )
      ( node_key = 'VEG' text = 'Gemüse' parent_key = 'ROOT' is_folder = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'CARROT' text = 'Karotte' parent_key = 'VEG' )
      ( node_key = 'POTATO' text = 'Kartoffel' parent_key = 'VEG' )
    ).
    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = mt_all_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_tree.
    DATA(lt_filtered_nodes) = FILTER cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes FROM mt_all_nodes
      WHERE text CP |*{ iv_search_term }*| OR node_key = 'ROOT'. " Wurzelknoten immer anzeigen

    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = lt_filtered_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Test mit Filter 'Apfel'
    lo_cut->filter_tree( 'Apfel' ).
    " Manuelle Überprüfung des Baums wäre hier nötig.
    " Für den Unit-Test prüfen wir nur, ob die Methode läuft.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_cut->mo_tree ).

    lo_cut->filter_tree( 'Banane' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_cut->mo_tree ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Kontextmenü für die Knoten des Baums. Bei Auswahl einer Option im Kontextmenü soll eine entsprechende Aktion (z.B. eine Meldung) ausgelöst werden. Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Operator zur Aktionsauswahl.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS on_function_selected FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING fcode node_key.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = mo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).
    SET HANDLER me->on_context_menu_request FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER me->on_function_selected FOR mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Aktionen' is_folder = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'ACTION1' text = 'Aktion 1' parent_key = 'ROOT' )
      ( node_key = 'ACTION2' text = 'Aktion 2' parent_key = 'ROOT' )
    ).
    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_context_menu_request.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'F_DETAIL' text = 'Details anzeigen' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'F_EDIT' text = 'Bearbeiten' ).
    menu = lo_menu.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_function_selected.
    DATA(lv_message) = SWITCH string(
      fcode
      WHEN 'F_DETAIL' THEN |Details für Knoten '{ node_key }' anzeigen.|
      WHEN 'F_EDIT'   THEN |Knoten '{ node_key }' bearbeiten.|
      ELSE |Unbekannte Funktion '{ fcode }' für Knoten '{ node_key }'.|
    ).
    MESSAGE lv_message TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Baum mit einer rekursiven Methode, die eine verschachtelte Datenstruktur (z.B. eine Baumstruktur aus einer internen Tabelle) in CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE-Knoten umwandelt.
hint: Definieren Sie eine rekursive Methode, die sich selbst aufruft, um Kindknoten zu verarbeiten. Nutzen Sie den FOR-Operator für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_recursive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id       TYPE string,
             parent_id TYPE string,
             text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_recursive_tree.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_source_data TYPE ty_data_tab.

    METHODS add_child_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key
        it_data       TYPE ty_data_tab
      CHANGING
        ct_tree_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_recursive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_recursive_tree.
    IF mo_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
      mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
        i_parent = mo_container
        i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      ).
    ENDIF.

    mt_source_data = VALUE ty_data_tab(
      ( id = 'A' parent_id = '' text = 'Gruppe A' )
      ( id = 'A1' parent_id = 'A' text = 'Unterpunkt A1' )
      ( id = 'A2' parent_id = 'A' text = 'Unterpunkt A2' )
      ( id = 'A21' parent_id = 'A2' text = 'Detail A2.1' )
      ( id = 'B' parent_id = '' text = 'Gruppe B' )
      ( id = 'B1' parent_id = 'B' text = 'Unterpunkt B1' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Rekursiver Baum' is_folder = abap_true )
    ).

    add_child_nodes( iv_parent_key = 'ROOT' it_data = mt_source_data CHANGING ct_tree_nodes = lt_tree_nodes ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = lt_tree_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_child_nodes.
    DATA(lt_children) = FILTER #( it_data WHERE parent_id = iv_parent_key ).

    LOOP AT lt_children INTO DATA(ls_child).
      INSERT VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>s_node(
        node_key = ls_child-id
        text = ls_child-text
        parent_key = iv_parent_key
        is_folder = COND abap_bool( WHEN line_exists( mt_source_data[ parent_id = ls_child-id ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
      ) INTO TABLE ct_tree_nodes.

      add_child_nodes( iv_parent_key = ls_child-id it_data = it_data CHANGING ct_tree_nodes = ct_tree_nodes ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Baum, der Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS anzeigt. Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu aggregieren und diese Information im Baum darzustellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um die Fluganzahl zu zählen und diese in den Knotentext zu integrieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_reduced_data.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_reduced_data.
    IF mo_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
      mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
        i_parent = mo_container
        i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_carrier_counts) = REDUCE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
      INIT nodes = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
        ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Fluggesellschaften' is_folder = abap_true )
      )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING AS carrier
      NEXT nodes = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
        nodes
        ( node_key = |CARRIER_{ carrier-carrid }|
          text = |{ carrier-carrid } ({ lines( carrier ) } Flüge)|
          parent_key = 'ROOT'
          is_folder = abap_true )
      )
    ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = lt_carrier_counts ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Existenzprüfung' is_folder = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'NODE1' text = 'Knoten 1' parent_key = 'ROOT' )
    ).

    " Prüfen, ob 'NODE1' bereits existiert, bevor ein Duplikat hinzugefügt wird
    IF NOT line_exists( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'NODE1' ] ).
      INSERT VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>s_node(
        node_key = 'NODE1' text = 'Knoten 1 (Duplikat)' parent_key = 'ROOT'
      ) INTO TABLE lt_nodes.
    ENDIF.

    " Hinzufügen eines neuen Knotens, der definitiv nicht existiert
    IF NOT line_exists( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'NODE2' ] ).
      INSERT VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>s_node(
        node_key = 'NODE2' text = 'Knoten 2' parent_key = 'ROOT'
      ) INTO TABLE lt_nodes.
    ENDIF.

    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Baum, der die Verwendung von 'FOR ... IN GROUP' demonstriert, um Daten aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaften zu gruppieren und die Flüge als Unterknoten anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Operator mit GROUP BY, um die Daten zu strukturieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_for_in_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_grouped_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_for_in_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_grouped_sflights.
    IF mo_container IS INITIAL.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
      mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
        i_parent = mo_container
        i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Alle Flüge' is_folder = abap_true )
      FOR flight_entry IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = flight_entry-carrid ) ASCENDING AS carrier_group
      ( node_key = |CARRIER_{ carrier_group-carrid }|
        text = |Fluggesellschaft: { carrier_group-carrid }|
        parent_key = 'ROOT'
        is_folder = abap_true )
      FOR flight_in_group IN carrier_group
      ( node_key = |FLIGHT_{ flight_in_group-carrid }_{ flight_in_group-connid }|
        text = |Flug { flight_in_group-connid } am { flight_in_group-fldate DATE = USER }|
        parent_key = |CARRIER_{ carrier_group-carrid }| )
    ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes( table_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger, einschließlich CC und BCC.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD_RECIPIENT` mit dem Parameter `I_EXPRESS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_multi_recip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_multi_recipients
      IMPORTING
        it_to_emails  TYPE ad_smtpadr_tab
        it_cc_emails  TYPE ad_smtpadr_tab OPTIONAL
        it_bcc_emails TYPE ad_smtpadr_tab OPTIONAL
        iv_subject    TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_multi_recip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_multi_recipients.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs_message=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_message=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    LOOP AT it_to_emails INTO DATA(lv_email).
      DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_recipient=>create_internet_address( lv_email ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ). " Default: TO
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT it_cc_emails INTO lv_email.
      lo_recipient = cl_bcs_recipient=>create_internet_address( lv_email ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient i_express = 'X' ). " CC
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT it_bcc_emails INTO lv_email.
      lo_recipient = cl_bcs_recipient=>create_internet_address( lv_email ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient i_express = 'B' ). " BCC
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).

    COMMIT WORK.

    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_multi_recipients FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lt_to) = VALUE ad_smtpadr_tab( ( 'to1@example.com' ) ( 'to2@example.com' ) ).
    DATA(lt_cc) = VALUE ad_smtpadr_tab( ( 'cc1@example.com' ) ).
    DATA(lt_bcc) = VALUE ad_smtpadr_tab( ( 'bcc1@example.com' ) ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_email_multi_recipients(
      it_to_emails  = lt_to
      it_cc_emails  = lt_cc

    ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Der Parameter `I_EXPRESS` der Methode `ADD_RECIPIENT` wird verwendet, um die Art des Empfängers zu steuern. hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA=>GET_FIXED_VALUES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_read_domain_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low  TYPE ddtext,
             text TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.
    TYPES: tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_domain_fixed_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_read_domain_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_domain_fixed_values.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>create( iv_domain_name ).
        DATA(lt_fixed_values_raw) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( ).

        rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_fixed_values_raw
                                   ( low = ls_raw-low
                                     text = ls_raw-ddtext ) ).
      CATCH cx_reca_ddic_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Domäne existiert nicht
        " In einem realen Szenario könnte hier ein Log-Eintrag erfolgen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_dynamic_domain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             low  TYPE ddtext,
             text TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_ddic_dynamic_domain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_domain_values.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>create( iv_dynamic_domain_name ).
        DATA(lt_fixed_values_raw) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( ).

        rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_fixed_values_raw
                                   ( low = ls_raw-low
                                     text = ls_raw-ddtext ) ).
      CATCH cx_reca_ddic_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung für nicht existierende oder fehlerhafte Domäne

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaften, deren `CARRID` in den Festwerten einer bestimmten Domäne (`S_CARR_ID`) enthalten ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA` mit dem `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_domain_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_domain_values.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_allowed_carrids) = VALUE s_carr_id_tab( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>create( iv_domain_name ).
        DATA(lt_fixed_values_raw) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( ).
        lt_allowed_carrids = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_fixed_values_raw ( ls_raw-low ) ).
      CATCH cx_reca_ddic_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Wenn Domäne nicht existiert, keine Filterung
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Filtern der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle mit dem FILTER-Operator
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN lt_allowed_carrids ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_filter_sflights( ).

    " Daher sollte das Ergebnis leer sein, da keine Übereinstimmungen gefunden werden.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_domain_values( 'S_TRVL_T' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered_flights ). " Sollte leer sein, da Domäne nicht existiert
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den Zugriff auf DDIC-Domänen mit dem modernen `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen. Zuerst werden die erlaubten `CARRID`-Werte aus der Domäne (`S_TRVL_T` im Testfall) abgerufen. Anschließend wird die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle mit dem `FILTER`-Operator gefiltert, um nur die Einträge zu erhalten, deren `CARRID` in der Liste der erlaubten Werte enthalten ist. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazität aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sum for LH should not be zero' act = lv_sum_lh exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sum for AA should not be zero' act = lv_sum_aa exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen hat, unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING`.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structures.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
    " Manuelle Zuweisung für nicht übereinstimmende Felder, falls nötig
    rs_target-field_x = |Mapped from { is_source-field3 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_struct=>ty_source,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_corresponding_struct=>ty_target.

    ls_source-field1 = 'Value 1'.
    ls_source-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-field3 = 'Original Field3'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_struct( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_structures( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 should match' act = ls_target-field1 exp = ls_source-field1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 should match' act = ls_target-field2 exp = ls_source-field2 ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und berechnen Sie dann die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzkapazität der gefilterten Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
      rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_avg( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_lh) = lo_cut->get_avg_seats_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Average for LH should not be zero' act = lv_avg_lh exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    " Example value, adjust based on actual SFLIGHTS data. Assuming LH has flights with 300 seats each.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Example average for LH' act = lv_avg_lh exp = 300.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Zuerst wird die Tabelle gefiltert, dann werden die Werte der gefilterten Tabelle aggregiert. Dies ist ein Muster, das in modernen ABAP-Anwendungen häufig für Datenanalysen verwendet wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` für die dynamische Typisierung und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " Alle Felder als String
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.

    DO 2 TIMES. " Zwei Zeilen mit Beispieldaten füllen
      ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line_wa>).
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line_wa> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <lv_field> = |{ ls_component-name }_Value_{ sy-index }|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line_wa> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_field_names TYPE string_table,
          lo_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data.

    APPEND 'FIELD_A' TO lt_field_names.
    APPEND 'FIELD_B' TO lt_field_names.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    lo_dynamic_table = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_names ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 INTO <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'First line should not be initial' act = <ls_line> exp = '' operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ne ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field_a>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'FIELD_A value should match' act = <lv_field_a> exp = 'FIELD_A_Value_1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und dynamischer Programmierung zur Laufzeit eine interne Tabelle mit variabler Struktur erstellen und füllen kann. Dies ist nützlich für generische Berichte oder Schnittstellen, bei denen die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Klassen `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` sind hierfür zentrale Werkzeuge.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Komponenten (Felder) einer beliebigen Struktur und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_typedescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA: lo_descr_ref TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.

    lo_descr_ref = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_descr_ref.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        APPEND 'Provided data reference is not a structure.' TO rt_components_info.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
      APPEND |Component: { ls_component-name }, Type: { ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ) }| TO rt_components_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_rtti_struct FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_rtti_non_struct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_struct.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_rtti_struct_info=>ty_test_struct,
          lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    GET REFERENCE OF ls_data INTO lo_data_ref.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_info( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_struct_components( lo_data_ref ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of components should be 3' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should contain ID component' substring = 'Component: ID, Type: I' in = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should contain NAME component' substring = 'Component: NAME, Type: STRING' in = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should contain DATE component' substring = 'Component: DATE, Type: D' in = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_rtti_non_struct.
    DATA: lv_data TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',
          lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    GET REFERENCE OF lv_data INTO lo_data_ref.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_info( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_struct_components( lo_data_ref ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should indicate non-structure' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Error message should be correct' act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Provided data reference is not a structure.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Typinformationen von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln. Die Klassen `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` sind hierfür essenziell. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Komponenten einer Struktur dynamisch auslesen kann, was für generische Frameworks oder Debugging-Tools sehr nützlich ist.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_structdescr, Dynamic Programming, Reflection

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie robuste Fehlerbehandlung für ein Division-durch-Null-Szenario.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_div_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_div_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>zerodivide.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_div_by_zero( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_div_by_zero( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE caught as expected.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ermöglicht das Abfangen von Laufzeitfehlern wie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`. `DATA(lo_cut)` demonstriert die Inline-Deklaration von Objekten.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, EXCEPTION, DATA, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, Error Handling

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus `sflights` und behandeln Sie das Szenario, wenn kein Datensatz gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF DATA(ls_flight)` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_read_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_data_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_read_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight = ls_flight.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_read_sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details(
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
      iv_connid = '0017'
      iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_read_sflight( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flight_details(
          iv_carrid = 'XX'
          iv_connid = '9999'
          iv_fldate = '19000101' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception CX_SY_NO_DATA_FOUND not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_data_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception CX_SY_NO_DATA_FOUND caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DATA(ls_flight)` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Struktur für das `SELECT SINGLE`-Ergebnis. Die `@`-Escape-Zeichen für Hostvariablen sind modernes ABAP. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt über `sy-subrc` und das Auslösen einer spezifischen Ausnahme.
keywords: DATA, SELECT SINGLE, SFLIGHTS, Database Access, CX_SY_NO_DATA_FOUND

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie einen funktionalen Methodenaufruf, der eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab, um eine verkettete Ausnahme zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lv_result) = lo_object->functional_method()` innerhalb von `TRY...CATCH` und die `PREVIOUS`-Option beim Auslösen einer neuen Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_inner_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_inner_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_outer_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_outer_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS inner_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_inner_error.

    METHODS outer_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_outer_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD inner_method.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_inner_error.
    ENDIF.
    rv_output = iv_input * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD outer_method.
    TRY.
        rv_output = inner_method( iv_input ).
      CATCH zcx_inner_error INTO DATA(lx_inner).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_outer_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_inner.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_outer_method_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_outer_method_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_outer_method_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->outer_method( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_outer_method_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_exception( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->outer_method( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception ZCX_OUTER_ERROR not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_outer_error INTO DATA(lx_outer).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception ZCX_OUTER_ERROR caught as expected.' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_outer->previous ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( lx_outer->previous IS INSTANCE OF zcx_inner_error )
          msg = 'Previous exception is not ZCX_INNER_ERROR' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DATA(lx_inner)` deklariert die Ausnahmeobjekte inline. Die `PREVIOUS`-Option beim Auslösen einer Ausnahme ermöglicht das Verketten von Ausnahmen, was die Fehleranalyse erleichtert.
keywords: DATA, TRY, CATCH, EXCEPTION, Chained Exceptions, Functional Programming, PREVIOUS

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Strings. Nur Strings, die erfolgreich in eine Zahl konvertiert werden können, sollen in der Ergebnistabelle enthalten sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( ... )` mit einer Hilfsmethode, die `TRY...CATCH` verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_with_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_numeric_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings      TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_numeric
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_numeric) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_numeric_strings.
    rt_numbers = FILTER #( it_strings USING is_numeric ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_numeric.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_num) = CONV i( iv_string ).
        rv_is_numeric = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_is_numeric = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie eine Liste von Strings (die Zahlen darstellen). Ignorieren Sie nicht-numerische Einträge und summieren Sie die gültigen Zahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE #( ... )` mit `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb der `REDUCE`-Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_with_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_numeric_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings      TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numeric_strings.
    rv_total_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR string IN it_strings
      NEXT
        sum = sum +
              COND #(
                WHEN string IS NUMERIC THEN
                  TRY.
                      CONV i( string )
                    CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                      0
                  ENDTRY
                ELSE
                  0
              ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_numeric FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_mixed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_numeric.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_with_try( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_reduce_with_try=>tt_strings(
      ( '10' )
      ( '20' )
      ( '30' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->sum_numeric_strings( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Datum- und Zeit-String in einen Zeitstempel. Behandeln Sie Fehler bei ungültigen Eingaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time` innerhalb von `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_str TYPE string
        iv_time_str TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_timestamp) TYPE timestampl
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_par_val.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_timestamp.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t.

    TRY.
        lv_date = CONV d( iv_date_str ).
        lv_time = CONV t( iv_time_str ).
        cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
          EXPORTING
            iv_date = lv_date
            iv_time = lv_time
          IMPORTING
            ev_tstmp = rv_timestamp
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_strg_par_val
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_strg_par_val=>default_text
            previous = lx_conv_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_tstmp_param_error INTO DATA(lx_tstmp_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_strg_par_val
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_strg_par_val=>default_text
            previous = lx_tstmp_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwalten Sie generische Beziehungen zwischen zwei Objekten (dargestellt durch Strings) mithilfe der Klasse `CL_BINARY_RELATION`. Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Beziehung hinzufügt und eine andere, die alle Beziehungen eines Startobjekts zurückgibt. Beachten Sie, dass für die Persistenz ein `COMMIT WORK` erforderlich ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BINARY_RELATION_FACTORY` zum Erstellen und Abfragen von Beziehungen. Objekte können als `SO_LOC_OBJ_KEY` repräsentiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_relation,
             object_a TYPE string,
             object_b TYPE string,
           END OF ts_relation.
    TYPES: tt_relations TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_relation WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_a TYPE string
        iv_object_b TYPE string.

    METHODS get_relations_for_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_relations) TYPE tt_relations.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_obj_type TYPE so_obj_type VALUE 'ZDEMO_OBJ',
               gc_rel_name TYPE so_rel_name VALUE 'ZDEMO_REL'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_relation.
    DATA(lo_factory) = cl_binary_relation_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(ls_obj_a) = VALUE so_loc_obj_key( obj_id = iv_object_a obj_type = gc_obj_type ).
    DATA(ls_obj_b) = VALUE so_loc_obj_key( obj_id = iv_object_b obj_type = gc_obj_type ).

    TRY.
        lo_factory->create_relation(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = ls_obj_a
            ip_object_b = ls_obj_b
            ip_relation_name = gc_rel_name
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Beziehung existiert bereits
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_relations_for_object.
    DATA(lo_factory) = cl_binary_relation_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(ls_obj) = VALUE so_loc_obj_key( obj_id = iv_object obj_type = gc_obj_type ).
    DATA lt_relations_raw TYPE cl_binary_relation_factory=>tt_relations.

    lo_factory->get_relations_for_object(
      EXPORTING
        ip_object = ls_obj
        ip_relation_name = gc_rel_name
      IMPORTING
        ep_relations = lt_relations_raw
    ).

    rt_relations = VALUE #( FOR ls_relation_raw IN lt_relations_raw
                             ( object_a = ls_relation_raw-object_a-obj_id
                               object_b = ls_relation_raw-object_b-obj_id ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_relations FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA(lo_factory) = cl_binary_relation_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA lt_all_relations TYPE cl_binary_relation_factory=>tt_relations.
    lo_factory->get_relations_for_object(
      EXPORTING
        ip_object = VALUE so_loc_obj_key( obj_id = '*' obj_type = zcl_binary_relation_demo=>gc_obj_type )
        ip_relation_name = zcl_binary_relation_demo=>gc_rel_name
      IMPORTING
        ep_relations = lt_all_relations
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_all_relations INTO DATA(ls_relation).
      lo_factory->delete_relation(
        EXPORTING
          ip_object_a = ls_relation-object_a
          ip_object_b = ls_relation-object_b
          ip_relation_name = zcl_binary_relation_demo=>gc_rel_name
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    setup( ). " Cleanup after each test
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_relations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_demo( ).
    lo_cut->add_relation( iv_object_a = 'CityA' iv_object_b = 'CityB' ).
    lo_cut->add_relation( iv_object_a = 'CityA' iv_object_b = 'CityC' ).
    lo_cut->add_relation( iv_object_a = 'CityB' iv_object_b = 'CityD' ).

    DATA(lt_relations_a) = lo_cut->get_relations_for_object( 'CityA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_relations_a ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cut->get_relations_for_object( 'CityX' ) ).

    DATA(lt_relations_b) = lo_cut->get_relations_for_object( 'CityB' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_relations_b ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_BINARY_RELATION` bietet eine generische Möglichkeit, Beziehungen zwischen beliebigen Objekten zu modellieren und zu verwalten, ohne explizite Join-Tabellen erstellen zu müssen. Die Factory-Klasse vereinfacht das Erstellen und Abfragen dieser Beziehungen.
keywords: CL_BINARY_RELATION, Object Orientation, Relationships, API, COMMIT WORK

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `FRIENDS`-Konzepts in ABAP OO. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_SECRET_DATA`, die private Daten enthält. Erstellen Sie eine zweite Klasse `ZCL_DATA_ANALYST`, die als `FRIEND` von `ZCL_SECRET_DATA` deklariert wird, um auf die privaten Daten zugreifen zu können, während andere Klassen dies nicht können.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FRIENDS`-Anweisung in der `DEFINITION`-Sektion der Klasse, deren private Komponenten zugänglich gemacht werden sollen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secret_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_secret_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_secret_value TYPE string VALUE 'Geheime Daten'.

    FRIENDS zcl_data_analyst.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secret_data IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_analyst DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_analysis) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_analyst IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_secret_data.
    " Zugriff auf private Komponente mv_secret_value ist hier erlaubt
    rv_analysis = |Analyse der geheimen Daten: { io_secret_data->mv_secret_value }|. 
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Das `FRIENDS`-Konzept ermöglicht einen kontrollierten Zugriff auf private oder geschützte Komponenten einer Klasse durch spezifisch deklarierte Freund-Klassen oder -Interfaces. Dies kann für bestimmte Designmuster nützlich sein, bei denen eine enge Kopplung zwischen Klassen erforderlich ist, ohne die Kapselung vollständig aufzugeben.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und die um 10% erhöhten Preise aller Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle enthält, deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression in einer `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ts_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights_with_increased_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights_with_increased_price.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        price  = ls_flight-price * '1.10' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_for_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_expression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights_with_increased_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-price > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR`-Expressions ermöglichen eine kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von Daten in internen Tabellen, ähnlich wie List Comprehensions in anderen Sprachen. In Kombination mit `VALUE` können neue Tabellen direkt konstruiert werden.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, die nach 'NEW YORK' fliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_to_new_york
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_to_new_york.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, cityto FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT total_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_expression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_expression_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_to_new_york( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge nach NEW YORK in sflights und die Summe ist > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_price >= 0 ).
    " Für einen präziseren Test müsste man Testdaten in sflights sicherstellen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE`-Expressions bieten eine funktionale Art der Aggregation über interne Tabellen, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht als traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisungen. Sie sind ideal für die Berechnung von Summen, Minima, Maxima usw.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die eine Kapazität von mehr als 200 Passagieren haben und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Verwenden Sie eine Prädikatmethode für die Datumsprüfung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und einer statischen Prädikatmethode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ts_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_large_capacity_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_details.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_future_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_expression_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_large_capacity_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflights
      WHERE seatsmax > 200 AND ( zcl_filter_expression_demo=>is_future_date( fldate ) = abap_true ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_future_date.
    IF iv_fldate > sy-datum.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_expression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_expression_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_large_capacity_flights( ).

    " Test, ob die Filterung korrekt funktioniert
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-seatsmax > 200 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Für einen umfassenderen Test müssten Testdaten in sflights eingefügt werden,
    " die sowohl die Kriterien erfüllen als auch nicht erfüllen.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FILTER`-Expressions ermöglichen eine deklarative Filterung von internen Tabellen. Die Kombination mit Prädikatmethoden (hier `is_future_date`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wiederverwendbarkeit komplexer Filterbedingungen, da die Logik ausgelagert wird.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Predicate Method, sflights, ABAP_BOOL

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle in eine interne Tabelle, wobei die Spaltennamen der internen Tabelle nicht exakt mit denen der Datenbanktabelle übereinstimmen müssen.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_corr_fields_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING FIELDS`-Klausel in Open SQL in Kombination mit Aliasen im `SELECT`-Statement vereinfacht das Lesen von Daten in interne Tabellen erheblich, indem sie die manuelle Feldzuordnung übernimmt und den Code sauberer hält. Die Inline-Deklaration `@DATA(...)` oder die Verwendung von `@<itab>` für bereits deklarierte Tabellen ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.
keywords: Open SQL, Database, Internal Tables, DATA, Corresponding Fields, Aliases, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Flugstatus (z.B. 'X' für storniert, 'Y' für verspätet, 'Z' für pünktlich) einen beschreibenden Text zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie eine `SWITCH`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Absolutwert einer Zahl und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf die nächste ganze Zahl.

solution:
CLASS zcl_math_functions_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_entry
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_entry.
    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = lines( it_data ) ).
    rs_entry = it_data[ lv_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_select( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_random_select=>tt_data( ( id = 1 text = 'A' ) ( id = 2 text = 'B' ) ( id = 3 text = 'C' ) ).
    DATA(ls_selected) = lo_cut->get_random_entry( it_data = lt_data ).

    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_original).
      IF ls_selected = ls_original.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found msg = 'Selected entry must be from original table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_select( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_data) = VALUE zcl_random_select=>tt_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      ACT = #( lo_cut->get_random_entry( it_data = lt_empty_data ) )
      EXPECTED_CLASS = 'CX_SY_TABLE_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Passwort einer bestimmten Länge, das Kleinbuchstaben, Großbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random=>create` und `get_next` in einer `REDUCE`-Schleife, um Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Zeichensatz zu wählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    rv_password = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_length
      NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_chars_len - 1 )(1)
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_month) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 12 ).
    DATA(lv_day) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 28 ). " Vereinfacht, um komplexe Datumvalidierung zu vermeiden

      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_invalid_date.

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus.
hint: Lesen Sie alle Einträge in eine interne Tabelle, mischen Sie diese mit `cl_abap_random=>shuffle` und nehmen Sie die ersten N Einträge mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    lo_random->shuffle( CHANGING c_table = lt_all_flights ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count AND i <= lines( lt_all_flights )
                          ( lt_all_flights[ i ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle ABAP-Variablendeklarationen (z.B. `DATA(...)`) aus einem gegebenen Code-String.
hint: Nutzen Sie reguläre Ausdrücke mit `cl_abap_regex` und `cl_abap_match`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_data_declarations
      IMPORTING
        iv_abap_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_declarations) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_data_declarations.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = `DATA\s*\([^)]*\)` ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_abap_code ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_match( ) TO rt_declarations.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
