Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Objekten zufällig in N gleich große Gruppen.
hint: Mischen Sie die Liste mit `cl_abap_random=>shuffle` und verwenden Sie dann `GROUP BY` oder `FOR` mit `MOD` für die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group,
             group_id TYPE i,
             items TYPE tt_item,
           END OF ty_group.
    TYPES: tt_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_randomly
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_item
        iv_num_groups TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_groups) TYPE tt_group
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_randomly.
    IF iv_num_groups <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_shuffled_items) = it_items.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    lo_random->shuffle( CHANGING c_table = lt_shuffled_items ).

    rt_groups = VALUE tt_group(
      FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i < iv_num_groups
      ( group_id = i + 1,
        items = VALUE tt_item(
          FOR j = 0 THEN j + 1 WHILE j < lines( lt_shuffled_items )
          WHERE ( j MOD iv_num_groups ) = i
          ( lt_shuffled_items[ j + 1 ] )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_randomly.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_random_grouping=>tt_item(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 10 ( id = i, name = |Item { i }| )
    ).
    DATA(lt_groups) = lo_cut->group_randomly( it_items = lt_items iv_num_groups = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_groups ) exp = 2
                                      msg = 'Should create 2 groups' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_groups[1]-items ) exp = 5
                                      msg = 'First group should have 5 items' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_groups[2]-items ) exp = 5
                                      msg = 'Second group should have 5 items' ).

  METHOD test_group_randomly_uneven.

    ).
    DATA(lt_groups) = lo_cut->group_randomly( it_items = lt_items iv_num_groups = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_groups ) exp = 3
                                      msg = 'Should create 3 groups' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_groups[1]-items ) exp = 3
                                      msg = 'First group should have 3 items' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_groups[2]-items ) exp = 2

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die basierend auf einer Zufallswahrscheinlichkeit einen von zwei Werten zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random=>get_next_float` und vergleichen Sie das Ergebnis mit einem Schwellenwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_choice DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_choice
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability_for_value1 TYPE f " Probability for value1 (0.0 to 1.0)
        iv_value1                 TYPE string
        iv_value2                 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_chosen_value)    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_choice IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_choice.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_float) = lo_random->get_next_float( ).

    IF lv_random_float < iv_probability_for_value1.
      rv_chosen_value = iv_value1.
    ELSE.
      rv_chosen_value = iv_value2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_choice_50_50 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_choice_high_prob FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_choice_low_prob FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_choice_50_50.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_choice( ).
    DATA(lv_value1_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_value2_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 1000.

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_choice) = lo_cut->get_random_choice( iv_probability_for_value1 = 0.5
                                                  iv_value1 = 'A'
                                                  iv_value2 = 'B' ).
      IF lv_choice = 'A'.
        lv_value1_count = lv_value1_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_value2_count = lv_value2_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_value1_count > ( lv_iterations * 0.4 ) AND lv_value1_count < ( lv_iterations * 0.6 ) )
                                      msg = 'A should be chosen roughly 50% of the time' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_value2_count > ( lv_iterations * 0.4 ) AND lv_value2_count < ( lv_iterations * 0.6 ) )
                                      msg = 'B should be chosen roughly 50% of the time' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_choice_high_prob.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_choice( ).
    DATA(lv_value1_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 100.

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_choice) = lo_cut->get_random_choice( iv_probability_for_value1 = 0.9
                                                  iv_value1 = 'High'
                                                  iv_value2 = 'Low' ).
      IF lv_choice = 'High'.
        lv_value1_count = lv_value1_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_value1_count > ( lv_iterations * 0.8 ) )
                                      msg = 'High should be chosen significantly more often' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_choice_low_prob.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_choice( ).
    DATA(lv_value1_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 100.

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_choice) = lo_cut->get_random_choice( iv_probability_for_value1 = 0.1
                                                  iv_value1 = 'Low'
                                                  iv_value2 = 'High' ).
      IF lv_choice = 'Low'.
        lv_value1_count = lv_value1_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_value1_count < ( lv_iterations * 0.2 ) )
                                      msg = 'Low should be chosen significantly less often' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der einzigartigen Flugverbindungen (CONNID).
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR GROUPS und innerhalb der Gruppe COUNT mit DISTINCT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_conn_count,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        unique_conn TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrier_conn_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_conn_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_conn_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_unique_connections
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_conn_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_unique_connections.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid ) 
      ( 
        carrid      = <fs_flight>-carrid
        unique_conn = COUNT( DISTINCT <fs_flight>-connid )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_unique_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->count_unique_connections( ).

    DATA lv_expected_lh_conn TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT connid ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_expected_lh_conn.
    DATA lv_expected_aa_conn TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT connid ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO lv_expected_aa_conn.

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_result).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_lh_result-unique_conn
        exp = lv_expected_lh_conn
        msg = 'Incorrect unique connection count for LH'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'LH not found in result' ).
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_result).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_aa_result-unique_conn
        exp = lv_expected_aa_conn
        msg = 'Incorrect unique connection count for AA'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'AA not found in result' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `COUNT( DISTINCT ... )` können aggregierte Werte wie die Anzahl eindeutiger Elemente pro Gruppe effizient berechnet werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: COUNT, Grouping, FOR GROUPS, DISTINCT, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die jeweils eine interne Tabelle von Flügen enthalten. Zählen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge, die eine maximale Kapazität (SEATSMAX) von über 300 haben, über alle Fluggesellschaften hinweg.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit einer geschachtelten FOR-Schleife und einer WHERE-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_flight_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
        seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        flights  TYPE tt_flight_data,
      END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_large_flights_nested
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_flights TYPE tt_carrier_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_large_flights) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_flight_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_large_flights_nested.
    rv_total_large_flights = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_count = 0
      FOR ls_carrier_flights IN it_carrier_flights
      FOR ls_flight IN ls_carrier_flights-flights
      WHERE ( seatsmax > 300 )
      NEXT total_count = total_count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_nested_flight_counter=>tt_carrier_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #(

      flights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 350 ) 
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' seatsmax = 290 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' seatsmax = 400 ) 
      )
    ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lv_actual_count) = lo_cut->count_large_flights_nested( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_count
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Incorrect count of large flights in nested structure'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression (ab ABAP 7.50) in Kombination mit geschachtelten `FOR`-Schleifen und `WHERE`-Bedingungen ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und deklarative Aggregation von Daten über komplexe, verschachtelte Strukturen hinweg. Dies ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Art, Daten zu verarbeiten.
keywords: COUNT, REDUCE, FOR, Nested Tables, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_assertion_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_assertion_demo IMPLEMENTATION.

    ASSERTIONS FIELDS iv_value ID z_assertion_demo
      CONDITION iv_value > 0.

        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_assertion_failed=>default_text
          program = sy-repid
          include = sy-cprog
          line = sy-linno.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine funktionale Expression (z.B. REDUCE), um eine Liste von Zahlen zu summieren. Wenn dabei eine negative Zahl gefunden wird, soll die Summation abgebrochen und eine Ausnahme vom Typ CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR ausgelöst werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie THROW in einer REDUCE-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_sum_throw DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_positive_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_sum_throw IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_positive_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR n IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + COND #( WHEN n < 0 THEN THROW cx_sy_arithmetic_error( textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>default_text ) ELSE n ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_sum_throw( ).
    DATA lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i VALUE #( (1) (2) (3) ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_positive_numbers( lt_numbers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 6 ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected arithmetic error for valid numbers' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_with_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_sum_throw( ).
    DATA lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i VALUE #( (1) (2) (-3) (4) ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->sum_positive_numbers( lt_numbers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected arithmetic error for negative number was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). 
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `THROW` Expression (ab ABAP 7.55) ermöglicht das Auslösen von Ausnahmen direkt innerhalb von funktionalen Ausdrücken wie `REDUCE` oder `COND`. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code, der Fehlerbedingungen elegant in die Datenverarbeitung integriert, ohne den Fluss durch separate IF-Blöcke zu unterbrechen.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, THROW, REDUCE, Functional Programming, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR

CLASS zcl_carrier_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_flight_not_available.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT it_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrier TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_flight_not_available(
          carrid = lv_carrier
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_message = 'All carriers are valid.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität (SEATSMAX) für alle Flüge in SFLIGHTS. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme vom Typ CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Aggregatfunktion im SELECT und prüfen Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_seats_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_avg_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_seats) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_seats_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_seatsmax.
    DATA lv_total_seats TYPE i.
    DATA lv_flight_count TYPE i.

    SELECT SUM( seatsmax ) FROM sflights INTO lv_total_seats.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO lv_flight_count.

    IF lv_flight_count = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_zerodivide=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_avg_seats = lv_total_seats / lv_flight_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_seats_with_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_seats_no_data FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert_failed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_seats_with_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_seats_calculator( ).
    DATA lv_expected_sum TYPE i.
    DATA lv_expected_count TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( seatsmax ) FROM sflights INTO lv_expected_sum.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO lv_expected_count.

    IF lv_expected_count > 0.
      TRY.
          DATA(lv_actual_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_seatsmax( ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_avg exp = lv_expected_sum / lv_expected_count ).
        CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected zero divide exception' ).
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>skip_test( 'No data in SFLIGHTS for test_avg_seats_with_data' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_seats_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_seats_calculator( ).
    " Temporarily clear SFLIGHTS or mock it for this test
    " For this example, we assume SFLIGHTS might be empty or we simulate it.
    " A real test would use test doubles.
    DATA lv_flight_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO lv_flight_count.

    IF lv_flight_count = 0.
      TRY.
          lo_cut->calculate_avg_seatsmax( ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected zero divide exception was not raised' ).
        CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). 
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>skip_test( 'SFLIGHTS contains data, cannot test zero divide directly' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist besonders wichtig bei mathematischen Operationen mit variablen Daten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp füllt und dann die Anzahl der Zeilen zählt. Wenn der übergebene Tabellentyp ungültig ist, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme vom Typ CX_SY_DYN_TABLE_CREATE_ERROR aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie CREATE DATA mit TYPE TABLE OF und RTTI, um den Tabellentyp zu validieren. Anschließend COUNT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_dynamic_table_rows
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_row_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_dynamic_table_rows.
    DATA lr_table TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lr_descr_tab TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        " Dynamically create an internal table
        CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name).

        " Get table description to check if it's a valid table type
        lr_descr_tab ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lr_table ).

        " Fill with some dummy data (example for SFLIGHTS)
        IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHTS'.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
          ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_sflights>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE <lt_sflights>.
            rv_row_count = lines( <lt_sflights> ).
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          " For other types, just return 0 or a dummy count
          rv_row_count = 0.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_dyn_table_create_error(
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_create_error=>default_text
          previous = lx_create_error
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #` um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES tt_flight_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES tt_flight_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' price = '200' ) TO lt_input.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE #` können neue Tabellen basierend auf den Elementen einer Quelltabelle erstellt werden, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht.
keywords: FOR Expression, Internal Tables, Transformation, VALUE #

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die Methoden-Chaining (Fluent Interface) ermöglicht, um eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Objekt auszuführen.
hint: Jede Methode in der Kette muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME->`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_interface DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface,
             add       IMPORTING iv_add   TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface,
             multiply  IMPORTING iv_mult  TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface,
             get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_result = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_expression DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für 'LH' in SFLIGHT mit Preisen
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'ZZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_total_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und kompakten Weise. Er initialisiert eine Variable und wendet dann eine Operation iterativ auf die Elemente der Tabelle an, um ein Endergebnis zu erhalten.
keywords: REDUCE Expression, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_filter_expression DEFINITION

Instructions: Messen Sie die Performance der Transformation einer internen Tabelle mit einer `LOOP AT` Schleife im Vergleich zu einem `FOR` Ausdruck. Die Transformation soll ein Feld der Tabelle modifizieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds()` und `FOR` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_loop_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_performance_results,
             loop_time TYPE i,
             for_time  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_performance_results.

    METHODS measure_transformation
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE ty_performance_results.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_loop_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_transformation.
    DATA: lt_sflight_orig TYPE tt_sflight,
          lt_sflight_loop TYPE tt_sflight,
          lt_sflight_for  TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Populate original table
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight_orig
      UP TO 1000 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lt_sflight_loop = lt_sflight_orig.
      LOOP AT lt_sflight_loop ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
        <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.1'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDDO.
    rs_results-loop_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ) - lv_start_time.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lt_sflight_for = lt_sflight_orig.
      lt_sflight_for = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight_for ( <fs_sflight> WITH price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.1' ) ).
    ENDDO.
    rs_results-for_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ) - lv_start_time.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance der Aggregation von Daten (z.B. Summe eines Feldes pro Gruppe) unter Verwendung von `COLLECT` und dem `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds()` und den `REDUCE` Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_collect_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_aggregated_data.
    TYPES tt_aggregated_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_performance_results,
             collect_time TYPE i,
             reduce_time  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_performance_results.

    METHODS measure_aggregation
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE ty_performance_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_collect_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_aggregation.
    DATA: lt_sflight_orig TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    " Populate original table with some duplicate carrid for aggregation
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight_orig
      UP TO 5000 ROWS.
    " Duplicate data to make aggregation more meaningful
    APPEND LINES OF lt_sflight_orig TO lt_sflight_orig.
    APPEND LINES OF lt_sflight_orig TO lt_sflight_orig.

    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lt_aggregated_collect) TYPE tt_aggregated_data.
      LOOP AT lt_sflight_orig ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
        COLLECT VALUE ty_aggregated_data( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid total_price = <fs_sflight>-price ) INTO lt_aggregated_collect.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDDO.
    rs_results-collect_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ) - lv_start_time.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lt_aggregated_reduce) TYPE tt_aggregated_data.
      lt_aggregated_reduce = REDUCE #( 
        INIT result TYPE tt_aggregated_data
        FOR GROUPS OF <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight_orig GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid
        WITHOUT MEMBERS
        NEXT result = VALUE #( 
          result
          ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
            total_price = SUM( <fs_sflight>-price ) ) 
        )
      ).
    ENDDO.
    rs_results-reduce_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ) - lv_start_time.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_select_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_select_performance.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA: ls_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    " Ensure a record exists for testing
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_key
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " If not found, pick any existing record
      SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_key.
    ENDIF.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fallback if SFLIGHT is empty or no suitable record
      ls_key-carrid = 'AA'.
      ls_key-connid = '0017'.
      ls_key-fldate = '20250101'.
    ENDIF.


    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      SELECT SINGLE *
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
        WHERE carrid = ls_key-carrid AND connid = ls_key-connid AND fldate = ls_key-fldate.
    ENDDO.
    rs_results-single_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ) - lv_start_time.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      SELECT *
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
        UP TO 1 ROWS
        WHERE carrid = ls_key-carrid AND connid = ls_key-connid AND fldate = ls_key-fldate.
    ENDDO.
    rs_results-up_to_1_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ) - lv_start_time.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit einer komplexeren mathematischen Berechnung, die moderne ABAP-Arithmetik-Ausdrücke verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds()` und moderne arithmetische Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_math_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_calculation_result,
             input_value TYPE decfloat34,
             result      TYPE decfloat34,
             runtime     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_calculation_result.

    METHODS perform_complex_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_value TYPE decfloat34 DEFAULT '123.45'
        iv_iterations  TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_calculation_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_math_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_complex_calculation.
    DATA(lv_intermediate_result) = iv_input_value.
    DATA(lv_final_result) = iv_input_value.

    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_intermediate_result = ( lv_intermediate_result ** 2 + 10 ) / ( lv_intermediate_result * '0.5' - 5 ).
      lv_final_result = sqrt( abs( lv_intermediate_result ) ) + log( abs( lv_intermediate_result ) ).
    ENDDO.
    rs_result-runtime = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ) - lv_start_time.

    rs_result-input_value = iv_input_value.
    rs_result-result = lv_final_result.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA mt_node_table TYPE lvc_t_nkey.
    DATA mt_item_table TYPE lvc_t_item.
    DATA mt_field_catalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    METHODS add_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey OPTIONAL
        iv_node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_text       TYPE lvc_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_populate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_dynnr   = '0100'
    ).
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      EXPORTING
        parent              = lo_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
        item_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>item_sel_mode_single
        no_toolbar          = abap_true
    ).

    mt_field_catalog = VALUE #( 
      ( fieldname = 'TEXT'   coltext = 'Description' ) 
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Airline' ) 
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Connection' ) 
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' coltext = 'Flight Date' ) 
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'  coltext = 'Price' ) 
    ).
    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_fieldcatalog  = mt_field_catalog
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_populate_tree.
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    CLEAR: mt_node_table, mt_item_table.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_node_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflight_data GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( key = ls_flight-carrid text = |Airline: { ls_flight-carrid }| )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_group).
      add_node( iv_node_key = ls_group-key iv_text = ls_group-text ).

      DATA(lt_flights_for_carrid) = VALUE tt_sflight_node(
        FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight_data WHERE ( carrid = ls_group-key )
        ( ls_flight )
      ).

      LOOP AT lt_flights_for_carrid INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        DATA(lv_node_key) = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|.
        add_node( iv_parent_key = ls_group-key
                  iv_node_key   = lv_node_key
                  iv_text       = |Flight: { ls_flight-connid } on { ls_flight-fldate } Price: { ls_flight-price }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->add_nodes_and_items(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_table = mt_node_table
        i_item_table = mt_item_table
    ).
    mo_tree->expand_tree( ).

    ro_tree = mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_node.
    DATA(ls_node) TYPE lvc_s_nkey.
    ls_node-node_key = iv_node_key.
    ls_node-text = iv_text.
    IF iv_parent_key IS SUPPLIED.
      ls_node-relatkey = iv_parent_key.
      ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND ls_node TO mt_node_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_flight_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA mt_node_table TYPE lvc_t_nkey.
    DATA mt_item_table TYPE lvc_t_item.

    METHODS add_node_and_item
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey OPTIONAL
        iv_node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_text       TYPE lvc_value
        is_item_data  TYPE REF TO data OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_HIER'
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_dynnr   = '0100'
    ).
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      EXPORTING
        parent              = lo_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
        item_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>item_sel_mode_single
        no_toolbar          = abap_true
    ).
    DATA(lt_fcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'TEXT'   coltext = 'Description' )
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Connection' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' coltext = 'Flight Date' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'  coltext = 'Price' )
    ).
    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flight_hierarchy.
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    CLEAR: mt_node_table, mt_item_table.

    LOOP AT it_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight_root) GROUP BY ls_flight_root-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid_key) = ls_flight_root-carrid.
      add_node_and_item( iv_node_key = lv_carrid_key iv_text = |Airline: { lv_carrid_key }| ).

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight_root INTO DATA(ls_flight_connid) GROUP BY ls_flight_connid-connid.
        DATA(lv_connid_key) = |{ lv_carrid_key }-{ ls_flight_connid-connid }|.
        add_node_and_item( iv_parent_key = lv_carrid_key
                           iv_node_key   = lv_connid_key
                           iv_text       = |Connection: { ls_flight_connid-connid }| ).

        LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight_connid INTO DATA(ls_flight_date).
          DATA(lv_fldate_key) = |{ lv_connid_key }-{ ls_flight_date-fldate }|.
          DATA(lr_item_data) = REF #( ls_flight_date ).
          add_node_and_item( iv_parent_key = lv_connid_key
                             iv_node_key   = lv_fldate_key
                             iv_text       = |Date: { ls_flight_date-fldate } Price: { ls_flight_date-price }|
                             is_item_data  = lr_item_data ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->add_nodes_and_items(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_table = mt_node_table
        i_item_table = mt_item_table
    ).
    mo_tree->expand_tree( ).
    ro_tree = mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_node_and_item.
    DATA(ls_node) TYPE lvc_s_nkey.
    ls_node-node_key = iv_node_key.
    ls_node-text = iv_text.
    IF iv_parent_key IS SUPPLIED.
      ls_node-relatkey = iv_parent_key.
      ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND ls_node TO mt_node_table.

    IF is_item_data IS BOUND.
      DATA(ls_item) TYPE lvc_s_item.
      ls_item-node_key = iv_node_key.
      ls_item-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
      ASSIGN is_item_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item_data>).
      ls_item-value = <fs_item_data>-carrid.
      APPEND ls_item TO mt_item_table.

      ls_item-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
      ls_item-value = <fs_item_data>-connid.
      APPEND ls_item TO mt_item_table.

      ls_item-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
      ls_item-value = <fs_item_data>-fldate.
      APPEND ls_item TO mt_item_table.

      ls_item-fieldname = 'PRICE'.
      ls_item-value = <fs_item_data>-price.
      APPEND ls_item TO mt_item_table.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_val_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( "Reduziert die Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0 "Initialisiert den Akkumulator
      FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) "Iteriert über sflights und filtert
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price "Aktualisiert den Akkumulator
    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Dokumente und eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Typ eine konkrete Dokumenteninstanz (z.B. PDF oder Word) zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine statische Factory-Methode in der abstrakten Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abs_document DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT. "Abstrakte Basisklasse
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_document_type TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF gc_document_type,
        pdf  TYPE ty_document_type VALUE 'PDF',
        word TYPE ty_document_type VALUE 'WORD',
      END OF gc_document_type.

    METHODS render_content ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
    CLASS METHODS create_document "Statische Factory-Methode
      IMPORTING
        iv_document_type TYPE ty_document_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zcl_abs_document
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    CASE iv_document_type.
      WHEN gc_document_type-pdf.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_con_pdf_document( ).
      WHEN gc_document_type-word.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_con_word_document( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unsupported document type: { iv_document_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_pdf_document DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abs_document FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS render_content REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_pdf_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD render_content.
    rv_content = 'PDF Content Rendered'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_word_document DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abs_document FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS render_content REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_word_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD render_content.
    rv_content = 'Word Content Rendered'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_pdf FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_word FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_pdf.
    DATA(lo_pdf_doc) = zcl_abs_document=>create_document( zcl_abs_document=>gc_document_type-pdf ).
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_pdf_doc->render_content( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_content exp = 'PDF Content Rendered' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_pdf_doc IS INSTANCE OF zcl_con_pdf_document ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_word.
    DATA(lo_word_doc) = zcl_abs_document=>create_document( zcl_abs_document=>gc_document_type-word ).
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_word_doc->render_content( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_content exp = 'Word Content Rendered' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_word_doc IS INSTANCE OF zcl_con_word_document ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid.
    TRY.
        zcl_abs_document=>create_document( 'UNKNOWN' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Expected exception raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine Factory-Methode in einer abstrakten Klasse ist ein klassisches Entwurfsmuster (Factory Method Pattern). Sie kapselt die Logik zur Erstellung konkreter Objekte und ermöglicht es, neue Dokumententypen hinzuzufügen, ohne den Client-Code zu ändern. Die abstrakte Methode `render_content` stellt sicher, dass jede konkrete Dokumentenklasse ihre eigene Rendering-Logik implementiert, was zu einem flexiblen und erweiterbaren System führt.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Object Orientation, Factory Method, Design Patterns, Polymorphism, Class Methods

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern für einen Berichtsprozess. Eine abstrakte Basisklasse definiert die Struktur des Berichts, während konkrete Unterklassen spezifische Schritte implementieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine nicht-finale Methode als Template und abstrakte Methoden für die variablen Schritte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abs_report_template DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT. "Abstrakte Basisklasse
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report. "Template Method
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
    METHODS format_header ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_header) TYPE string.
    METHODS format_body ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_body) TYPE string.
    METHODS format_footer ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_footer) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_report_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_data( ).
    DATA(lv_header) = format_header( lt_data ).
    DATA(lv_body) = format_body( lt_data ).
    DATA(lv_footer) = format_footer( lt_data ).

    " In einem realen Szenario würde dies den Bericht zurückgeben oder speichern.
    " Für Demo-Zwecke verwenden wir cl_demo_output.
    cl_demo_output=>display(
      EXPORTING
        data = |{ lv_header }\n{ lv_body }\n{ lv_footer }|
        name = 'Generated Report'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_simple_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abs_report_template FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_header REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_body REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_footer REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_simple_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    rt_data = VALUE #( ( 'Line 1: Data A' ) ( 'Line 2: Data B' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_header.
    rv_header = |--- Simple Report ({ sy-datum }) ---|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_body.
    rv_body = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR line IN it_data NEXT s = s && line && |\n| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_footer.
    rv_footer = |--- End of Report ({ lines( it_data ) } lines) ---|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simple_report_parts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simple_report_parts.
    DATA(lo_report) = NEW zcl_con_simple_report( ).
    " Die generate_report-Methode verwendet cl_demo_output=>display, was schwer direkt zu testen ist.
    " Hier testen wir die einzelnen überschriebenen Methoden.
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_report->get_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_report->format_header( lt_data ) exp = |--- Simple Report ({ sy-datum }) ---| ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_report->format_body( lt_data ) exp = 'Line 1: Data A' && |\n| && 'Line 2: Data B' && |\n| ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_report->format_footer( lt_data ) exp = |--- End of Report (2 lines) ---| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template Method Pattern, implementiert mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse und abstrakten Methoden, definiert den Skelett-Algorithmus einer Operation in einer Basisklasse und überlässt die Implementierung bestimmter Schritte den Unterklassen. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendung von Code und stellt sicher, dass die Gesamtstruktur des Algorithmus beibehalten wird, während spezifische Details angepasst werden können. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` und String-Templates in den Implementierungen zeigt moderne ABAP-Funktionalität.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Object Orientation, Template Method, Design Patterns, Polymorphism, REDUCE, String Templates

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf seinem Datum. Wenn das Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt, ist der Status 'Completed', sonst 'Scheduled'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator für eine kompakte Bedingungsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Completed'
      WHEN iv_fldate = sy-datum THEN 'Today'
      ELSE 'Scheduled'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_completed_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_scheduled_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_today_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_completed_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( sy-datum - 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Completed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_scheduled_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( sy-datum + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Scheduled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_today_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Today' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator (Conditional Expression) ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Implementierung von bedingten Zuweisungen. Anstatt eine `IF`-`ELSE IF`-`ENDIF`-Struktur zu verwenden, kann der Wert direkt basierend auf den Bedingungen zugewiesen werden. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die funktionale Lesbarkeit.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming, Expressions

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in einer Tabelle, der eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer hat. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Standardflug zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `THEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_find_first DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid      TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_find_first IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight.
    rs_flight = VALUE #( "Initialisiert die Ergebnisstruktur
      FOR flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ) "Iteriert und filtert
      THEN flight "Gibt den ersten gefundenen Flug zurück
      ELSE VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' fldate = '19000101' ) "Standardwert, wenn nichts gefunden wird
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_val_find_first=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).

  METHOD test_find_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_find_first( ).

      iv_connid      = '0400'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-carrid exp = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-connid exp = '0000' ).

explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `THEN`/`ELSE` ermöglicht das Suchen und Zurückgeben des ersten passenden Eintrags aus einer internen Tabelle oder einen Standardwert, falls nichts gefunden wird. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode, um Suchoperationen durchzuführen, ohne explizite `LOOP` und `CHECK` Anweisungen zu verwenden.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, THEN, ELSE, Internal Tables, Search, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die nur die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` enthält und diese alphabetisch sortiert.

CLASS zcl_val_distinct_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen Wert aus einer internen Tabelle zu lesen. Wenn der Index ungültig ist, geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück, anstatt einen Dump zu verursachen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `TRY` und `CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_try_catch_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_data_at_index
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_try_catch_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_at_index.
    rs_data = VALUE #( "Initialisiert die Ergebnisstruktur
      TRY.
          DATA(ls_found) = it_data[ iv_index ]. "Versucht, auf den Index zuzugreifen
          RETURN ls_found.
        CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found. "Fängt den Fehler ab, wenn der Index ungültig ist
          RETURN VALUE #( id = 0 value = 'Default' ). "Gibt Standardwert zurück
      ENDTRY.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_valid_index FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_invalid_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_valid_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_try_catch_read( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_val_try_catch_read=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'First' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Second' )
    ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_data_at_index( it_data = lt_data iv_index = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-value exp = 'Second' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_invalid_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_try_catch_read( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_val_try_catch_read=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'First' )
    ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_data_at_index( it_data = lt_data iv_index = 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-id exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-value exp = 'Default' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` und einem `TRY`-`CATCH`-Block innerhalb einer Zuweisung ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Fehlerbehandlung beim Zugriff auf interne Tabellen. Anstatt den Zugriff separat zu prüfen und dann zuzuweisen, kann der gesamte Vorgang in einer einzigen Anweisung gekapselt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um Dumps bei ungültigen Tabellenindizes zu vermeiden und einen definierten Standardwert zurückzugeben.
keywords: VALUE, TRY, CATCH, Error Handling, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Exceptions

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen, basierend auf Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugnummer (`connid`). Die Tabelle muss vorab nach diesen Feldern sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             maxseats TYPE sflight-maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights.

    " Wichtig: Tabelle muss vorab sortiert sein für DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid.

    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_duplicates=>tt_sflight.

    " Testdaten mit Duplikaten
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum + 1. " Duplikat
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. " Duplikat
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_adjacent_duplicates( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ). " Erwartet 3 eindeutige Zeilen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0018' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine leistungsstarke Anweisung, um redundante Daten in internen Tabellen zu bereinigen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, da die Anweisung nur *aufeinanderfolgende* Duplikate entfernt.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Verfügbar', 'Fast voll', 'Voll') basierend auf der Auslastung (`seatsocc` im Verhältnis zu `maxseats`) unter Verwendung des `COND` Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_occupied TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_max_seats      TYPE sflight-maxseats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_percentage) = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_max_seats > 0 THEN ( iv_seats_occupied * 100 ) / iv_max_seats
      ELSE 0
    ).

    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage < 50 THEN 'Verfügbar'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 50 AND lv_occupancy_percentage < 90 THEN 'Fast voll'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 90 THEN 'Voll'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 40 iv_max_seats = 100 ) exp = 'Verfügbar' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 70 iv_max_seats = 100 ) exp = 'Fast voll' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 95 iv_max_seats = 100 ) exp = 'Voll' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 0 iv_max_seats = 0 ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Anstatt mehrere `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Blöcke zu verwenden, kann der Wert direkt basierend auf Bedingungen zugewiesen werden, was den Code kürzer und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: IF, COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug (Fluggesellschaft 'LH', Flugnummer '0400') in einer internen Tabelle existiert, und geben Sie dessen Flugdatum zurück. Verwenden Sie eine Inline-Deklaration für die gelesene Zeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... INTO DATA(...)` und prüfen Sie anschließend mit `IF ... IS NOT INITIAL`.

CLASS zcl_read_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             maxseats TYPE sflight-maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_fldate) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_date.
    READ TABLE it_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid INTO DATA(ls_flight).

    IF ls_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ELSE.
      rv_fldate = '00000000'. " Standardwert für nicht gefunden
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flight_date FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_get_flight_date.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_read_flight=>tt_sflight.

    " Testdaten
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum + 1.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_flight( ).

    " Flug gefunden
    DATA(lv_found_date) = lo_cut->get_flight_date( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found_date exp = sy-datum + 1 ).

    " Flug nicht gefunden

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_not_found_date exp = '00000000' ).

Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(ls_flight)` macht den Code kürzer und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit, die Struktur `ls_flight` explizit zu deklarieren.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' mit der Flugnummer '0400' in der Zukunft liegt und ob die maximale Sitzplatzanzahl größer als Null ist. Geben Sie 'TRUE' zurück, wenn alle Bedingungen erfüllt sind, sonst 'FALSE'.

solution:
CLASS zcl_check_future_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             maxseats TYPE sflight-maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS is_valid_future_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_future_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_future_flight.
    READ TABLE it_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid INTO DATA(ls_flight).

    IF ls_flight IS NOT INITIAL AND
       ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum AND
       ls_flight-maxseats > 0.
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_empty_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_string_empty_check IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt und deren maximale Sitzplatzanzahl kleiner oder gleich 100 ist. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_out_old_small_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate >= sy-datum AND maxseats > 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_complex_delete.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_complex_delete=>tt_sflight.

    " Testdaten
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum - 1. <fs_flight>-maxseats = 80. " Soll gelöscht werden
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum + 1. <fs_flight>-maxseats = 150. " Bleibt
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum - 5. <fs_flight>-maxseats = 100. " Soll gelöscht werden
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum + 10. <fs_flight>-maxseats = 90. " Bleibt (Datum ok, aber Maxseats <= 100)

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_complex_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_out_old_small_flights( lt_flights ).

explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist extrem leistungsfähig, um komplexe Filterbedingungen direkt und deklarativ anzuwenden. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein übergebenes Objekt einer bestimmten Klasse (`cl_abap_unit_assert`) angehört und ob es initial ist. Geben Sie 'TRUE' zurück, wenn beides zutrifft, sonst 'FALSE'.

CLASS zcl_object_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_assert_object.
    IF io_object IS INSTANCE OF cl_abap_unit_assert AND io_object IS INITIAL.
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_check_assert_object FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_assert_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_object_check( ).

    " Objekt ist vom Typ und initial
    DATA: lo_assert_initial TYPE REF TO cl_abap_unit_assert.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_assert_object( lo_assert_initial ) exp = abap_true ).

    " Objekt ist vom Typ, aber nicht initial
    DATA(lo_assert_instance) = NEW cl_abap_unit_assert( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_assert_object( lo_assert_instance ) exp = abap_false ).

    " Objekt ist nicht vom Typ
    DATA(lo_other_object) = NEW zcl_object_check( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_assert_object( lo_other_object ) exp = abap_false ).

    " Objekt ist initial, aber nicht vom Typ
    DATA: lo_other_initial TYPE REF TO zcl_object_check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_assert_object( lo_other_initial ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `IF`-Anweisung erlaubt die Kombination von Typenprüfung (`IS INSTANCE OF`) und Initialitätsprüfung (`IS INITIAL`) für Objektreferenzen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Bedingung. Dies ist besonders nützlich in der objektorientierten Programmierung, um die Gültigkeit von Objekten vor der Verwendung zu gewährleisten.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen, die keine gültige Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA', 'LH', 'UA') haben. Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE` mit einer `NOT IN` Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_delete_invalid_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_delete_invalid_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_valid_carriers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'AA' ) ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ).

CLASS zcl_filter_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom

CLASS zcl_filter_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airlines_from_city.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251206' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251206' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' )

CLASS zcl_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_map_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_flights_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251206' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )

    ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge, die von 'BERLIN' abfliegen, und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für diese Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'BERLIN' cityto = 'MUC' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'BERLIN' cityto = 'LAX' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'LONDON' cityto = 'BER' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    " Simplified logic for demonstration. In a real scenario, you'd parse extension more robustly.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht. Fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` spezifisch ab und alle anderen unerwarteten Ausnahmen mit `WHEN OTHERS`. Geben Sie im Fehlerfall eine entsprechende Meldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke mit `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` und `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    DATA(lv_division_result) TYPE decfloat34.

    TRY.
        lv_division_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Division successful: { lv_division_result }|.

      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 'Error: Division by zero is not allowed.'.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_result = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.

      CATCH OTHERS.
        rv_result = 'An unknown and unhandled error occurred.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_successful_division FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result
                                        exp = 'Error: Division by zero is not allowed.'
                                        msg = 'Should catch division by zero exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_successful_division.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result
                                        exp = 'Division successful: 5'
                                        msg = 'Should perform successful division' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit spezifischen Ausnahmen (hier `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`) und einem abschließenden `CATCH OTHERS` Block ist die moderne und robuste Art der Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. `CATCH OTHERS` stellt sicher, dass keine unerwarteten Ausnahmen das Programm zum Absturz bringen, sondern kontrolliert behandelt werden. `DATA(lx_exception)` ist eine moderne Inline-Deklaration für die Ausnahmeobjekt-Referenz.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
