Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Strings verarbeitet. Jeder String soll in eine Ganzzahl konvertiert werden. Wenn ein String nicht konvertiert werden kann, soll eine spezifische Ausnahme `CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER` abgefangen und eine Fehlermeldung protokolliert werden. Alle anderen unerwarteten Ausnahmen sollen mit `WHEN OTHERS` abgefangen und ebenfalls protokolliert werden. Die Verarbeitung soll für die restlichen Strings fortgesetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb einer Schleife und `CONTINUE` nach der Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_to_int_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             input_string TYPE string,
             converted_value TYPE i,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES tt_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_to_int_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings.
    DATA: ls_result TYPE ty_result.

    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      ls_result-input_string = lv_string.
      CLEAR ls_result-converted_value.
      CLEAR ls_result-error_message.

      TRY.
          ls_result-converted_value = lv_string.
          ls_result-error_message = 'Success'.

        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number.
          ls_result-error_message = |Error: '{ lv_string }' is not a valid number.|.

        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
          ls_result-error_message = |Unexpected error for '{ lv_string }': { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.

        CATCH OTHERS.
          ls_result-error_message = |Unknown error for '{ lv_string }'.|.
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_with_errors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_with_errors.
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE string_table(
      ( '123' )
      ( 'ABC' )
      ( '456' )
      ( 'XYZ' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_string_to_int_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_converter->convert_strings( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 4
                                        msg = 'All input strings should be processed' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-converted_value exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-error_message exp = 'Success' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-converted_value exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'not a valid number' act = lt_results[ 2 ]-error_message ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ]-converted_value exp = 456 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ]-error_message exp = 'Success' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 4 ]-converted_value exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'not a valid number' act = lt_results[ 4 ]-error_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man robuste Datenverarbeitung in Schleifen implementiert. Durch das Umschließen der kritischen Operation mit `TRY...CATCH` und die Verwendung von `WHEN OTHERS` als Fallback können Fehler für einzelne Einträge abgefangen und protokolliert werden, ohne die gesamte Verarbeitung zu unterbrechen. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(lv_string)` und `VALUE string_table(...)` sind moderne ABAP-Syntaxelemente.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, Exception Handling, Schleife, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER, CONTINUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Operation ausführt, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslösen kann. Fangen Sie diese benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme spezifisch ab. Verwenden Sie zusätzlich einen `CLEANUP` Block, um sicherzustellen, dass eine Ressource (z.B. ein Dateihandle oder eine Datenbankverbindung) immer geschlossen wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht. `WHEN OTHERS` soll als letzter Fallback dienen.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP...ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
        iv_trigger_unknown_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    METHODS open_resource.
    METHODS close_resource.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_resource.
    mv_resource_open = abap_true.
    cl_demo_output=>write( 'Resource opened.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD close_resource.
    IF mv_resource_open = abap_true.
      mv_resource_open = abap_false.
      cl_demo_output=>write( 'Resource closed.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_operation.
    TRY.
        open_resource( ).

        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.

        IF iv_trigger_unknown_error = abap_true.
          " Simulate an unexpected runtime error
          DATA(lv_zero) = 0.
          DATA(lv_result) = 10 / lv_zero.
        ENDIF.

        rv_status = 'Operation successful.'.

      CATCH zcx_custom_error.
        rv_status = 'Caught custom error.'.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_status = |Caught unexpected system error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.

      CATCH OTHERS.
        rv_status = 'Caught unknown error (WHEN OTHERS).'.

      CLEANUP.
        close_resource( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_operation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_custom_error_handling FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_error_handling FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_unknown_runtime_error FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_successful_operation.

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_manager->perform_operation( iv_trigger_error = abap_false iv_trigger_unknown_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Operation successful.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_manager->mv_resource_open msg = 'Resource should be closed after success' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_custom_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_resource_manager( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_manager->perform_operation( iv_trigger_error = abap_true iv_trigger_unknown_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Caught custom error.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_manager->mv_resource_open msg = 'Resource should be closed after custom error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_resource_manager( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_manager->perform_operation( iv_trigger_error = abap_false iv_trigger_unknown_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'Caught unexpected system error' act = lv_status ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_manager->mv_resource_open msg = 'Resource should be closed after system error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_on_unknown_runtime_error.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_resource_manager( ).
    " This test specifically checks the cleanup block for a runtime error not caught by CX_ROOT
    " (e.g., a very low-level system error that might not inherit from CX_ROOT directly, though rare).
    " In this specific case, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE *does* inherit from CX_ROOT, so the previous test covers it.
    " However, the principle of CLEANUP for *any* exit (exception or not) is demonstrated.
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_manager->perform_operation( iv_trigger_error = abap_false iv_trigger_unknown_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_manager->mv_resource_open msg = 'Resource should be closed even on runtime error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP` Block in einem `TRY...CATCH...ENDTRY` Konstrukt ist entscheidend für die Sicherstellung der Ressourcenfreigabe. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, sei es durch normalen Programmfluss oder durch eine Ausnahme. Dies ist eine moderne und sichere Methode, um 'Resource Leaks' zu verhindern. `WHEN OTHERS` fängt hier alle verbleibenden, nicht spezifisch abgefangenen Ausnahmen ab.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, CLEANUP, Exception Handling, Benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme, TRY CATCH, Ressourcenfreigabe

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (z.B. aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`) verarbeitet. Simulieren Sie eine Situation, in der die Verarbeitung eines einzelnen Fluges fehlschlagen kann (z.B. durch eine Division durch Null bei der Berechnung eines Durchschnitts). Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler, aber fahren Sie mit der Verarbeitung der restlichen Flüge fort. Verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` als Fallback für unerwartete Fehler.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration und `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb der Schleife. Die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` kann für Testdaten verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA: ls_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CLEAR ls_flight_info.
      ls_flight_info-carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ls_flight_info-connid = ls_sflight-connid.
      ls_flight_info-fldate = ls_sflight-fldate.
      ls_flight_info-price = ls_sflight-price.
      ls_flight_info-currency = ls_sflight-currency.
      ls_flight_info-error_message = 'Success'.

      TRY.
          " Simulieren einer fehlerhaften Berechnung, z.B. Division durch Null
          IF ls_sflight-seatsocc = 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
          ENDIF.
          " Beispiel: Berechnung des Preises pro besetztem Sitz
          ls_flight_info-price = ls_sflight-price / ls_sflight-seatsocc.

        CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
          ls_flight_info-error_message = |Error: Division by zero for flight { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }|.

        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
          ls_flight_info-error_message = |Unexpected error for flight { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.

        CATCH OTHERS.
          ls_flight_info-error_message = |Unknown error for flight { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } (WHEN OTHERS).|.
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND ls_flight_info TO rt_processed_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_flight_processing_with_errors.

    " Testdaten: Ein Flug mit seatsocc = 0 zur Simulation eines Fehlers
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '1000' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.

Die Methode soll diese spezifischen Ausnahmen auslösen. Der aufrufende Code soll diese spezifischen Ausnahmen abfangen und entsprechend reagieren. Ein `WHEN OTHERS` Block soll alle nicht erwarteten Ausnahmen abfangen und eine generische Fehlermeldung zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_data_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input
        zcx_data_range_error.

    METHODS process_validation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_data.
    IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input EXPORTING textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_value < 0 OR iv_value > 100.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_range_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_data_range_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_status = 'Data is valid.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_validation.
    TRY.
        rv_result_message = validate_data( iv_value ).

      CATCH zcx_invalid_input.
        rv_result_message = 'Validation Error: Input value is initial or invalid.'.

      CATCH zcx_data_range_error.
        rv_result_message = 'Validation Error: Input value is out of allowed range (0-100).'.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_result_message = |An unexpected system error occurred: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.

      CATCH OTHERS.
        rv_result_message = 'An unknown and unhandled error occurred (WHEN OTHERS).'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:

CLASS zcl_external_communicator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_comm_timeout
        zcx_comm_error.

    METHODS execute_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_external_communicator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_request.
    CASE iv_error_type.
      WHEN 'TIMEOUT'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_comm_timeout EXPORTING textid = zcx_comm_timeout=>default_text.
      WHEN 'ERROR'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_comm_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_comm_error=>default_text.
      WHEN 'RUNTIME'.
        " Simulate a runtime error not directly caught by specific CX_ classes
        DATA(lv_zero) = 0.
        DATA(lv_result) = 1 / lv_zero.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_response = 'External system response: OK'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_request.
    DATA lv_error_text TYPE string.
    TRY.
        rv_status_message = send_request( iv_error_type ).

      CATCH zcx_comm_timeout INTO DATA(lx_timeout).
        MESSAGE lx_timeout->get_text( ) INTO lv_error_text.
        rv_status_message = |Communication Timeout: { lv_error_text }|.

      CATCH zcx_comm_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) INTO lv_error_text.
        rv_status_message = |Communication Error: { lv_error_text }|.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) INTO lv_error_text.
        rv_status_message = |Unexpected System Error: { lv_error_text }|.

      CATCH OTHERS.
        rv_status_message = 'An unknown and unhandled error occurred (WHEN OTHERS).'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

'URL not found', 'Network error'), soll eine spezifische Ausnahme ausgelöst werden. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler. Verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` als Fallback für alle anderen unerwarteten Fehler. Die Verarbeitung soll für die restlichen URLs fortgesetzt werden.
hint: Definieren Sie benutzerdefinierte Ausnahmen für URL-Fehler. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `TRY...CATCH` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.

CLASS zcl_url_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_url_result,
             url         TYPE string,
             status      TYPE string,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_url_result.
    TYPES tt_url_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_url_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_url_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_url_not_found
        zcx_network_error.

    METHODS process_urls
      IMPORTING
        it_urls TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_url_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_url_data.
    " Simulierte URL-Abrufe
    CASE iv_url.
      WHEN 'http://valid.com'.
        rv_data = 'Data from valid.com'.
      WHEN 'http://notfound.com'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_url_not_found.
      WHEN 'http://networkerror.com'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_network_error.
      WHEN 'http://runtimeerror.com'.
        DATA(lv_zero) = 0.
        DATA(lv_result) = 1 / lv_zero.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_data = 'Default data'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_urls.
    DATA: ls_result TYPE ty_url_result.

    LOOP AT it_urls INTO DATA(lv_url).
      ls_result-url = lv_url.
      CLEAR ls_result-status.
      CLEAR ls_result-error_message.

      TRY.
          ls_result-status = fetch_url_data( lv_url ).
          ls_result-error_message = 'Success'.

        CATCH zcx_url_not_found.
          ls_result-status = 'Failed'.
          ls_result-error_message = |URL not found: { lv_url }|.

        CATCH zcx_network_error.
          ls_result-status = 'Failed'.
          ls_result-error_message = |Network error for URL: { lv_url }|.

        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
          ls_result-status = 'Failed'.
          ls_result-error_message = |Unexpected system error for URL { lv_url }: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.

        CATCH OTHERS.
          ls_result-status = 'Failed'.
          ls_result-error_message = |Unknown error for URL { lv_url } (WHEN OTHERS).|.
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine komplexe Berechnung durchführt, die mehrere Schritte umfasst. Jeder Schritt kann eine andere Art von Ausnahme auslösen. Implementieren Sie einen `TRY...CATCH` Block, der diese spezifischen Ausnahmen in einer Kaskade abfängt. Ein `WHEN OTHERS` Block soll als letzter Fallback dienen, um alle unvorhergesehenen Fehler abzufangen und eine generische Fehlermeldung zurückzugeben. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Berechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Berechnung und verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke oder eine Kette von `CATCH` Blöcken.
solution:
CLASS zcx_calc_overflow DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_complex_calculation
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_step
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_sum TYPE i
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_calc_overflow
        zcx_calc_invalid_param.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_step.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_calc_invalid_param.
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate overflow
    IF iv_current_sum > 100000 AND iv_number > 10000.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_calc_overflow.
    ENDIF.

    rv_new_sum = iv_current_sum + iv_number.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_complex_calculation.
    DATA(lv_final_sum) = 0.
    DATA lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_final_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR number IN it_numbers
                                  NEXT sum = calculate_step( iv_current_sum = sum iv_number = number ) ).
        rv_result_message = |Calculation successful. Final sum: { lv_final_sum }|.

      CATCH zcx_calc_invalid_param INTO DATA(lx_invalid).
        lv_error_message = lx_invalid->get_text( ).
        rv_result_message = |Calculation Error: Invalid parameter - { lv_error_message }|.

      CATCH zcx_calc_overflow INTO DATA(lx_overflow).
        lv_error_message = lx_overflow->get_text( ).
        rv_result_message = |Calculation Error: Overflow detected - { lv_error_message }|.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lv_error_message = lx_root->get_text( ).
        rv_result_message = |Unexpected System Error during calculation: { lv_error_message }|.

      CATCH OTHERS.
        rv_result_message = 'An unknown and unhandled error occurred during calculation (WHEN OTHERS).'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_encryptor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_encrypted_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_encrypted) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS encrypt_data IMPORTING iv_plain_data TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_encrypted) TYPE string.
    DATA mv_last_encrypted_data TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_secure_transmitter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_encryptor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encrypt_data.
    " Simulierte Verschlüsselung (einfache Umkehrung für Demo)
    rv_encrypted = REVERSE( iv_plain_data ).
    mv_last_encrypted_data = rv_encrypted.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_encrypted_data.
    rv_encrypted = mv_last_encrypted_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secure_transmitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                      iv_plain_data TYPE string
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_transmission_status) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_secure_transmitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transmit_securely.
    " Zugriff auf die private Verschlüsselungsmethode der Freundesklasse
    DATA(lv_encrypted_data) = io_encryptor->encrypt_data( iv_plain_data ).

    " Simulierte Übertragung der verschlüsselten Daten
    rv_transmission_status = |Encrypted data '{ lv_encrypted_data }' transmitted successfully.|.

Dies gewährleistet, dass die Verschlüsselungslogik gekapselt bleibt und nur von autorisierten Komponenten aufgerufen wird, was die Sicherheit und Integrität des Datenflusses erhöht. `REVERSE` ist eine moderne String-Funktion.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine kritische Datenbankoperation simuliert (z.B. Update). Diese Operation kann zu verschiedenen Fehlern führen (z.B. 'Record not found', 'Authorization error', 'Database lock'). Implementieren Sie einen `TRY...CATCH` Block, der diese spezifischen Ausnahmen abfängt und einen `WHEN OTHERS` Block für alle unvorhergesehenen Fehler. Verwenden Sie `FINALLY` um sicherzustellen, dass eine Datenbankverbindung immer geschlossen wird.
hint: Definieren Sie benutzerdefinierte Ausnahmen für Datenbankfehler. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_db_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_db_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_db_auth_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_db_auth_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_db_update
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_db_connection_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    METHODS open_db_connection.
    METHODS close_db_connection.
    METHODS update_record
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_type TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_db_not_found
        zcx_db_auth_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_db_connection.
    mv_db_connection_open = abap_true.
    cl_demo_output=>write( 'DB Connection opened.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD close_db_connection.
    IF mv_db_connection_open = abap_true.
      mv_db_connection_open = abap_false.
      cl_demo_output=>write( 'DB Connection closed.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_record.
    CASE iv_error_type.
      WHEN 'NOT_FOUND'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_db_not_found.
      WHEN 'AUTH_ERROR'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_db_auth_error.
      WHEN 'RUNTIME'.
        DATA(lv_zero) = 0.
        DATA(lv_result) = 1 / lv_zero.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Simulate successful update
        cl_demo_output=>write( 'Record updated successfully.' ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_db_update.
    DATA lv_error_text TYPE string.
    TRY.
        open_db_connection( ).
        update_record( iv_error_type ).
        rv_status_message = 'Database update successful.'.

      CATCH zcx_db_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        lv_error_text = lx_not_found->get_text( ).
        rv_status_message = |DB Error: Record not found - { lv_error_text }|.

      CATCH zcx_db_auth_error INTO DATA(lx_auth_error).
        lv_error_text = lx_auth_error->get_text( ).
        rv_status_message = |DB Error: Authorization failed - { lv_error_text }|.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lv_error_text = lx_root->get_text( ).
        rv_status_message = |Unexpected System Error during DB operation: { lv_error_text }|.

      CATCH OTHERS.
        rv_status_message = 'An unknown and unhandled error occurred during DB operation (WHEN OTHERS).'.

      FINALLY.
        close_db_connection( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `FINALLY` Block ist entscheidend, um sicherzustellen, dass die Datenbankverbindung immer geschlossen wird, unabhängig davon, ob die Operation erfolgreich war oder eine Ausnahme aufgetreten ist. `WHEN OTHERS` dient als letzter Fallback für alle unvorhergesehenen Fehler, was die Robustheit der Anwendung erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus einer Tabelle von Flügen alle Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit Flugnummer und Abflugort zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `VALUE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
                          ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                            connid   = flight-connid
                            cityfrom = flight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_frankfurt_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
    " To make it more robust, we should ensure test data exists or mock it.
    " For this example, assuming sflight has data.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      ).
    ENDIF.

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck ermöglicht es, eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer bestehenden zu erstellen, wobei gleichzeitig gefiltert (`WHERE`) und die Struktur der Zeilen transformiert werden kann. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten zu verarbeiten.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Filtering, Mapping, 7.40

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_group-carrid count = lv_count ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    " Check if a specific carrier (e.g., 'LH') has a count.
    " This test assumes 'LH' exists in sflight.
    DATA(ls_lh_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouping=>ty_flight_count(
                             FOR flight_count IN lt_result WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( flight_count ) ).
    IF ls_lh_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
        act = ls_lh_flights-count
        exp = 0
        msg = 'LH should have more than 0 flights'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY` Klausel im `LOOP AT` Statement ermöglicht es, interne Tabellen direkt nach einem oder mehreren Feldern zu gruppieren. Innerhalb der Schleife kann dann mit `FOR ... IN GROUP` über die Elemente der aktuellen Gruppe iteriert und Aggregationen, wie hier die Zählung mit `REDUCE`, durchgeführt werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, 7.50

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in der `sflight` Tabelle existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` oder `TABLE_LINE` mit einem Tabellenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Using LINE_EXISTS with a table expression
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_check( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' and '0400' exist in sflight for testing purposes
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exists
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Flight LH 0400 should exist'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_check( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exists
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Flight XX 9999 should not exist'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der prüft, ob eine Zeile in einer internen Tabelle, die durch einen Tabellenschlüssel oder Index identifiziert wird, existiert. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um die Existenz von Daten zu überprüfen, ohne eine Ausnahme abfangen zu müssen, wie es bei `TABLE_LINE` der Fall wäre, wenn die Zeile nicht gefunden wird.
keywords: Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, Table Expression, Conditional Logic, 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die alle Flüge enthält. Wenn der Abflugort 'NEW YORK' ist, soll der Zielort in 'NYC' geändert werden, ansonsten bleibt er unverändert.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                                        connid   = flight-connid
                                        cityfrom = flight-cityfrom
                                        cityto   = COND #( WHEN flight-cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' THEN 'NYC' ELSE flight-cityto ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).

    " Find a flight from 'NEW YORK' and check its transformed cityto
    DATA(ls_ny_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_transform=>ty_flight_data(
                             FOR flight IN lt_result WHERE ( cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ) ( flight ) ).
    IF ls_ny_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_ny_flight-cityto
        exp = 'NYC'
        msg = 'Cityto for NEW YORK flight should be NYC'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " Find a flight not from 'NEW YORK' and check its cityto
    DATA(ls_other_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_transform=>ty_flight_data(
                                FOR flight IN lt_result WHERE ( cityfrom <> 'NEW YORK' ) ( flight ) ).
    IF ls_other_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
        act = ls_other_flight-cityto
        exp = 'NYC'
        msg = 'Cityto for non-NEW YORK flight should not be NYC'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Der `COND` Operator wird hier verwendet, um eine bedingte Zuweisung für das Feld `cityto` innerhalb der Schleife zu realisieren, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, COND, Transformation, 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze für alle Flüge in der `sflight` Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE #( INIT total = 0 FOR flight IN lt_sflights NEXT total = total + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_seats( ).

    " To make this test robust, we need to know the expected sum or mock data.
    " For now, we'll just assert it's not negative (assuming seatsocc is always non-negative).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_total_seats >= 0 )
      msg = 'Total seats should be non-negative'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`total`) und wendet dann in einer Schleife (`FOR flight IN lt_sflights`) eine Operation (`total = total + flight-seatsocc`) auf jedes Element an, um ein einzelnes Ergebnis zu produzieren.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der `sflight` Tabelle, die eine maximale Kapazität von mehr als 300 Sitzen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_capacity_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_large_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_capacity_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT *
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_large_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE seatsmax > 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_large_capacity_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_large_capacity_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_large_capacity_flights( ).

    " Assert that all returned flights have seatsmax > 300
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax > 300 )
        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } has seatsmax { ls_flight-seatsmax } <= 300|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Also check if there are any such flights (assuming sflight has data with seatsmax > 300)
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Zeilen einer Quelltabelle enthält, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und oft performanter als eine explizite `LOOP` Schleife mit `DELETE` oder `APPEND`.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Filtering, 7.40

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie für alle Flüge, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen, die Anzahl der belegten Sitze um 10.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... REFERENCE INTO` um die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_seats_for_ny_flights
      CHANGING ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_seats_for_ny_flights.
    LOOP AT ct_flights REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight) WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'.
      lr_flight->seatsocc = lr_flight->seatsocc + 10.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_seats.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Prepare test data
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_modify( ).
    lo_cut->modify_seats_for_ny_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    " Check the modified flights
    DATA(ls_ny_flight1) = lt_test_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_ny_flight1-seatsocc
      exp = 110
      msg = 'Seats for AA 0017 should be 110'
    ).

    DATA(ls_ny_flight2) = lt_test_flights[ carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_ny_flight2-seatsocc
      exp = 210
      msg = 'Seats for UA 0010 should be 210'
    ).

    " Check an unmodified flight
    DATA(ls_other_flight) = lt_test_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_other_flight-seatsocc
      exp = 150
      msg = 'Seats for LH 0400 should remain 150'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... REFERENCE INTO` Syntax ermöglicht es, direkt auf die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zu referenzieren und diese innerhalb der Schleife zu modifizieren. Dies ist effizienter als das Kopieren in eine Arbeitszeile und anschließendes `MODIFY TABLE`, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen oder komplexen Strukturen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Abflugort. Erstellen Sie eine Ergebnisstruktur, die die Fluggesellschaft, den Abflugort und eine Liste der Flugnummern für jede Gruppe enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `VALUE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck für die Liste der Flugnummern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             connids  TYPE tt_connid,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-cityfrom
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_grouped_entry) = VALUE ty_grouped_flight(
                                  carrid   = ls_group_key-carrid
                                  cityfrom = ls_group_key-cityfrom
                                  connids  = VALUE #( FOR flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_group_key ( flight_in_group-connid ) ) ).
      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_struct( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).

    " Find a specific group (e.g., 'LH' from 'FRANKFURT') and check its content
    DATA(ls_lh_fra_group) = VALUE zcl_flight_group_struct=>ty_grouped_flight(
                               FOR group_entry IN lt_result
                               WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) ( group_entry ) ).
    IF ls_lh_fra_group IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_lh_fra_group-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Carrier should be LH'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_lh_fra_group-cityfrom
        exp = 'FRANKFURT'
        msg = 'Cityfrom should be FRANKFURT'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_lh_fra_group-connids
        msg = 'Connids list should not be empty'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Innerhalb der Gruppe wird der `VALUE` Operator mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck verwendet, um eine Liste von Flugnummern zu sammeln, was eine effiziente und deklarative Art der Datenaggregation und -transformation darstellt.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über Flüge und greifen Sie dabei effizient über einen sekundären Tabellenschlüssel auf die Daten zu, um Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu finden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sec_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sec_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_with_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_key
                                WITH EMPTY KEY
                                WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY carrid_key COMPONENTS carrid.

    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_with_key.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) USING KEY carrid_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      APPEND CORRESPONDING #( <fs_flight> ) TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie einen bestimmten Flug in der `sflight` Tabelle anhand der Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und geben Sie dessen Abflugort zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WITH TABLE KEY` oder einen Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_direct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_city_from
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cityfrom) TYPE sflight-cityfrom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_direct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_from.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Using a table expression for direct access
    TRY.
        rv_cityfrom = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-cityfrom.
    CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_cityfrom = ''. " Return initial if not found
    ENDTRY.

    " Alternative using LOOP AT ... WITH TABLE KEY (less common for single access, but demonstrates syntax)
    " LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    "   rv_cityfrom = ls_flight-cityfrom.
    "   EXIT.
    " ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id_str,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid_str TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_id_str.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_berlin_flights_as_string.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom

      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'BERLIN' )
                          ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                            connid_str = |{ flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle doppelten Einträge aus einer Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern, wobei nur der erste Eintrag beibehalten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` oder den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `DISTINCT` (falls verfügbar, sonst manuell). Hier: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid connid.

    METHODS get_unique_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Simulate duplicates by selecting multiple times or inserting test data
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    APPEND LINES OF lt_sflights TO lt_sflights. " Add duplicates

    rt_unique_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ) ).

    " Sort is required for DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid.

    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deduplicate_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deduplicate_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_deduplicate( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).

    " Verify that there are no duplicates after the operation
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_result ).
    DATA(lt_check_duplicates) = lt_result.
    SORT lt_check_duplicates BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_check_duplicates COMPARING carrid connid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_check_duplicates )
      exp = lv_initial_lines
      msg = 'No duplicates should remain in the result table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um doppelte Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass die Tabelle vor der Anwendung dieses Statements nach den Vergleichsfeldern sortiert sein muss, damit alle Duplikate korrekt erkannt und entfernt werden. Dies ist eine klassische, aber immer noch relevante und effiziente Technik.
keywords: Internal Tables, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Deduplication, Sorting, 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl belegter Sitze enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `MAX` Operator innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_seat_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_max_seat_flight.
    TYPES tt_max_seat_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_seat_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_seats_per_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE tt_max_seat_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE ty_max_seat_flight(
                               INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_max_seat_flight( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid seatsocc = -1 )
                               FOR flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_group_key
                               NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight_in_group-seatsocc > max_flight-seatsocc
                                                          THEN VALUE ty_max_seat_flight( carrid = flight_in_group-carrid
                                                                                         connid = flight_in_group-connid
                                                                                         seatsocc = flight_in_group-seatsocc )
                                                          ELSE max_flight ) ).
      APPEND ls_max_flight TO rt_max_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_seats_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_seats_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_max_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_seats_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).

    " Test for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    DATA(ls_lh_max) = VALUE zcl_flight_max_seats=>ty_max_seat_flight(
                         FOR flight IN lt_result WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( flight ) ).
    IF ls_lh_max IS NOT INITIAL.
      " To make this robust, we'd need to know the actual max seats for LH or mock data.
      " For now, we'll check if seatsocc is positive.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_lh_max-seatsocc > 0 )
        msg = 'Max seats for LH should be positive'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator, um komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird der `COND` Operator verwendet, um iterativ den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl belegter Sitze zu finden. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Methode, um Top-N-Probleme pro Gruppe zu lösen.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, REDUCE, COND, Aggregation, MAX, Functional Programming, 7.50

Instructions: Verschieben Sie einen String zirkulär um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen nach rechts. Zeigen Sie die moderne Alternative zum alten `SHIFT RIGHT CIRCULAR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Slicing (`substring`) in Kombination mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_circular_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_right_circular IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string iv_shift_pos TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_circular_shift IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_right_circular.
    DATA(lv_len) = strlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_len = 0.
      rv_output = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_actual_shift) = iv_shift_pos MOD lv_len.
    IF lv_actual_shift = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    " Alte Syntax: SHIFT iv_input RIGHT CIRCULAR BY iv_shift_pos PLACES.
    rv_output = |{ substring( val = iv_input off = lv_len - lv_actual_shift len = lv_actual_shift ) }{ substring( val = iv_input len = lv_len - lv_actual_shift ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden Nullen aus einem numerischen String. Zeigen Sie die moderne Alternative zum alten `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die String-Funktion `replace_first` mit einem regulären Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_remove_leading_zeros DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_zeros IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_remove_leading_zeros IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_zeros.
    " Alte Syntax: SHIFT iv_input LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'.
    rv_output = replace_first( val = iv_input regex = '^0+' with = '' ).
    IF rv_output IS INITIAL AND iv_input IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_input CP '000*'. " Handle case like '000' -> '0'
      rv_output = '0'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie das Start- und Enddatum des aktuellen Geschäftsquartals basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum (`sy-datum`) und einer Geschäftsjahresvariante.
hint: Nutzen Sie Methoden von `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` wie `get_period_for_date` und `get_period_info`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_fiscal_quarter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_quarter_dates,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_quarter_dates.
    METHODS get_current_fiscal_quarter_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year_variant TYPE periv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_quarter_dates) TYPE ty_quarter_dates
      RAISING
        cx_bs_period_toolset_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_fiscal_quarter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_fiscal_quarter_dates.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( iv_fiscal_year_variant ).
    DATA(ls_current_period) = lo_period_toolset->get_period_for_date( sy-datum ).

    DATA(lv_quarter_start_period) = ( ( ls_current_period-fiscal_period - 1 ) DIV 3 ) * 3 + 1.
    DATA(ls_quarter_start_period) = lo_period_toolset->get_period_info(
                                        iv_fiscal_year = ls_current_period-fiscal_year
                                        iv_fiscal_period = lv_quarter_start_period ).
    rs_quarter_dates-start_date = ls_quarter_start_period-start_date.

    DATA(lv_quarter_end_period) = lv_quarter_start_period + 2.
    DATA(ls_quarter_end_period) = lo_period_toolset->get_period_info(
                                      iv_fiscal_year = ls_current_period-fiscal_year
                                      iv_fiscal_period = lv_quarter_end_period ).
    rs_quarter_dates-end_date = ls_quarter_end_period-end_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Geschäftsperioden für eine Reihe von Daten, beginnend vom aktuellen Datum minus 30 Tage bis zum aktuellen Datum.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` und dem `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_entry,
             date        TYPE d,
             fiscal_year TYPE gjahr,
             fiscal_period TYPE poper,
           END OF ty_period_entry,
           ty_period_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_periods_for_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year_variant TYPE periv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE ty_period_table
      RAISING
        cx_bs_period_toolset_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_periods_for_date_range.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( iv_fiscal_year_variant ).

    rt_periods = VALUE #( FOR date = sy-datum - 30 THEN date + 1 UNTIL date > sy-datum
                          LET ls_period = lo_period_toolset->get_period_for_date( date ) IN
                          ( date        = date,
                            fiscal_year = ls_period-fiscal_year,
                            fiscal_period = ls_period-fiscal_period ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_date_range( ).
    DATA(lt_periods) = lo_cut->get_periods_for_date_range( 'K4' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_periods ) exp = 31 ).

    DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_periods[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-date exp = sy-datum - 30 ).

    DATA(ls_last_entry) = lt_periods[ lines( lt_periods ) ].

    DATA(ls_today_period) = lt_periods[ date = sy-datum ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_today_period-fiscal_period exp = '012' ).

CLASS zcl_sflight_fiscal_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fiscal_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( iv_fiscal_year_variant ).
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE lo_period_toolset->get_period_for_date( fldate )-fiscal_year = iv_fiscal_year ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verschieben Sie Bytes in einem `xstring` um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen nach links und zeigen Sie eine moderne Alternative zum alten `SHIFT ... IN BYTE MODE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xstring`-Slicing (`substring`) und String-Templates für die moderne Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstr_shift_bytes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_left_bytes IMPORTING iv_input TYPE xstring iv_shift_pos TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstr_shift_bytes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_left_bytes.
    DATA(lv_len) = xstrlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_len = 0 OR iv_shift_pos >= lv_len.
      rv_output = xs_initial.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_shift_pos <= 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    " Alte Syntax: SHIFT iv_input LEFT BY iv_shift_pos PLACES IN BYTE MODE.
    rv_output = substring( val = iv_input off = iv_shift_pos ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Start- und Enddatum des Vormonats basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum (`sy-datum`) und einer Geschäftsjahresvariante.

solution:
CLASS zcl_period_previous_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_month_dates,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_month_dates.

CLASS zcl_period_previous_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_previous_month_dates.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( iv_fiscal_year_variant ).

    DATA(ls_previous_period) = lo_period_toolset->get_previous_period(
                                   iv_fiscal_year = ls_current_period-fiscal_year
                                   iv_fiscal_period = ls_current_period-fiscal_period ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugdauern (in Minuten) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugsegmenten, die jeweils eine Dauer enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             duration TYPE i, " Duration in minutes
           END OF ty_flight_segment.
    TYPES: ty_flight_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_duration
      IMPORTING
        it_segments TYPE ty_flight_segments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_duration) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_duration.
    rv_total_duration = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs> IN it_segments
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs>-duration
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_duration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_test_segments) = VALUE zcl_flight_reduce=>ty_flight_segments(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' duration = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' duration = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' duration = 60 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_duration( lt_test_segments ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = 360 " 120 + 180 + 60
      msg = 'Die Gesamtdauer sollte korrekt berechnet werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Akkumulationen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLE, REDUCE, AGGREGATE, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn eine Zahl größer als 10 ist, soll 'Groß' zugewiesen werden, sonst 'Klein'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_size_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_size_description.
    rv_description = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_number > 10 THEN 'Groß'
      ELSE 'Klein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_size_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_size_description.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_assign( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_size_description( 15 )
      exp = 'Groß'
      msg = 'Sollte "Groß" für Zahlen > 10 zurückgeben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_size_description( 5 )
      exp = 'Klein'
      msg = 'Sollte "Klein" für Zahlen <= 10 zurückgeben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er ersetzt die traditionelle `IF ... ENDIF`-Struktur für einfache Zuweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: COND, IF, CONDITIONAL, ASSIGNMENT, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES: ty_carrid_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE ty_carrid_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    rt_carrid_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE count
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        count  = count )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouping=>ty_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251206' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251207' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251206' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251208' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251207' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrid( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_grouped )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten drei Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_lh_count
      exp = 3
      msg = 'LH sollte 3 Flüge haben.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_aa_count) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_aa_count
      exp = 1
      msg = 'AA sollte 1 Flug haben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `GROUP BY` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Syntax, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Sie ermöglicht komplexe Gruppierungen und Berechnungen in einer sehr kompakten und lesbaren Form, die die Notwendigkeit manueller Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen reduziert.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, INTERNAL TABLE, AGGREGATE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen UTC-Zeitstempel in das lokale Datum und die lokale Uhrzeit des Benutzers.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `CONVERT_UTCLONG_TO_DATE_TIME` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_UTCLONG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utc_to_local DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_local_datetime,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
             time TYPE sy-uzeit,
           END OF ty_local_datetime.

    METHODS convert_utc_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_local_datetime) TYPE ty_local_datetime.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utc_to_local IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utc_to_local.
    cl_abap_utclong=>convert_utclong_to_date_time(
      EXPORTING
        iv_utclong = iv_utclong
      IMPORTING
        ev_date    = rs_local_datetime-date
        ev_time    = rs_local_datetime-time
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_utc_to_local FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_utc_to_local.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utc_to_local( ).
    DATA(lv_test_utclong) = '20251206100000'. " 2025-12-06 10:00:00 UTC

    DATA(ls_local_dt) = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local( iv_utclong = lv_test_utclong ).

    " Dieser Test ist empfindlich gegenüber der lokalen Zeitzone des Systems.
    " Für eine robuste Prüfung wird hier angenommen, dass die System-Zeitzone UTC+0 ist.
    " In einer realen Umgebung müsste dies dynamisch ermittelt oder gemockt werden.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_local_dt-date
      exp = '20251206'
      msg = 'Das Datum sollte korrekt konvertiert werden (Annahme: System-Zeitzone UTC+0).'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_local_dt-time
      exp = '100000'
      msg = 'Die Uhrzeit sollte korrekt konvertiert werden (Annahme: System-Zeitzone UTC+0).'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `CONVERT_UTCLONG_TO_DATE_TIME` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_UTCLONG` ist die standardisierte und typsichere Methode, um UTC-Zeitstempel in das lokale Datum und die lokale Uhrzeit des Benutzers zu konvertieren. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Anzeige von Zeitinformationen in Benutzeroberflächen.
keywords: UTCLONG, CL_ABAP_UTCLONG, LOCAL TIME, TIMEZONE, DATE, TIME

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle und deklarieren Sie die Zielvariable inline.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(...)` oder `FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` direkt bei der Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declaration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_text_for_id
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_table
        iv_id   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declaration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_for_id.
    READ TABLE it_data INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_text = ls_entry-text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_text FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_declaration( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_inline_declaration=>ty_data_table(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eins' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Zwei' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_text) = lo_cut->get_text_for_id( it_data = lt_test_data iv_id = 2 ).

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) ermöglichen die Deklaration von Variablen genau dort, wo sie benötigt werden. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit, da der Typ oft aus dem Kontext abgeleitet werden kann, und reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Variablen am Anfang einer Methode zu deklarieren.
keywords: INLINE DECLARATION, DATA, READ TABLE, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle mit einem Tabellenausdruck und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ key ]` und den `DEFAULT`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,

        iv_id       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_product_name.
    TRY.
        rv_name = it_products[ id = iv_id ]-name.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_name = 'Produkt nicht gefunden'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ key ]`) bieten eine funktionale und kompakte Möglichkeit, auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND` ist der moderne Weg, um das Fehlen eines Eintrags zu behandeln, anstatt `SY-SUBRC` zu prüfen.
keywords: TABLE EXPRESSION, INTERNAL TABLE, FUNCTIONAL, TRY CATCH, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die jeweils das Objekt selbst zurückgeben, um Methodenaufrufe zu verketten (Method Chaining).
hint: Lassen Sie die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i DEFAULT 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_operand.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_operand.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( 5 ). " Initial value 5

    lo_calculator->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 ). " (5 + 3) * 2 = 16

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_calculator->mv_value
      exp = 16
      msg = 'Method Chaining sollte korrekt funktionieren.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, bei dem Methoden das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben, ermöglicht es, mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Anweisung auszuführen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Ausdruck von sequenziellen Operationen.
keywords: METHOD CHAINING, OBJECT ORIENTATION, CLASS, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wochentag-Namen basierend auf einer numerischen Eingabe (1=Montag, 2=Dienstag, etc.) zu, unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH #( iv_day_number
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag'

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( 1 )
      exp = 'Montag'
      msg = 'Tag 1 sollte Montag sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zur `CASE`-Anweisung für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er ist besonders nützlich, wenn der zugewiesene Wert direkt von einem Ausdruck abhängt und verbessert die Lesbarkeit im Vergleich zu verschachtelten `IF`s oder `CASE` mit Zuweisung.
keywords: SWITCH, CASE, CONDITIONAL, EXPRESSION, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine einzelne Zufallszahl zwischen 1 und 100 (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und seine Methode `get_next` mit den entsprechenden Grenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_number RETURNING VALUE(rv_random_num) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_number.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 100 ).
    rv_random_num = lo_random->get_next( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_random_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_int_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_num) = lo_cut->get_random_number( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_num ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 100 ) msg = 'Number not in range 1-100' ).
