Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig einen Eintrag aus der internen Tabelle `sflights` aus und geben Sie dessen Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen in der Tabelle, generieren Sie einen zufälligen Index und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_flight_num RETURNING VALUE(rv_flight_num) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_num.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_flight_num = 'NO_FLIGHTS'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_num_flights ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    rv_flight_num = ls_flight-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_flight_selection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_flight_num) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_num( ).

    IF lv_flight_num = 'NO_FLIGHTS'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'No flights found in SFLIGHTS table for test.' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_flight_num IS NOT INITIAL ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die moderne Zufallszahlengenerierung mit der dynamischen Auswahl aus einer internen Tabelle. Die Anzahl der Zeilen wird zur Bestimmung des maximalen Index verwendet, und `READ TABLE ... INDEX` greift effizient auf den zufällig ausgewählten Eintrag zu. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lv_num_flights)`) und `@` für Hostvariablen ist ebenfalls modern.
keywords: Random, Internal Table, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, SFLIGHTS, READ TABLE

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20 (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife und eine Hash-Tabelle oder eine sortierte Tabelle, um die Einzigartigkeit der generierten Zahlen zu überprüfen und zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_nums) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 20 ).
    DATA lt_temp_nums TYPE SORTED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO 100 TIMES. " Max attempts to find 5 unique numbers
      IF lines( lt_temp_nums ) = 5.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      INSERT lo_random->get_next( ) INTO TABLE lt_temp_nums.
    ENDDO.

    rt_unique_nums = VALUE #( FOR num IN lt_temp_nums ( num ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_nums) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nums ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should generate 5 unique numbers' ).

    LOOP AT lt_nums INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 20 ) msg = 'Number not in range 1-20' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for uniqueness by inserting into a hash table
    DATA lt_check_unique TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    INSERT LINES OF lt_nums INTO TABLE lt_check_unique.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_unique ) exp = 5 msg = 'Numbers are not unique' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung von Zufallszahlen und eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY`, um die Einzigartigkeit der Zahlen sicherzustellen. Das `DO ... TIMES` mit `EXIT` ist eine moderne Schleifensteuerung, und `VALUE #( FOR ... )` wird verwendet, um die Ergebnisse effizient in die Rückgabetabelle zu kopieren. Dies ist eine elegante Methode, um eine bestimmte Anzahl eindeutiger Zufallswerte zu erhalten.
keywords: Random, Unique, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Internal Table, Sorted Table, Value Operator

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb des aktuellen Jahres.
hint: Ermitteln Sie den ersten und letzten Tag des aktuellen Jahres. Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Tage dazwischen und generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl, die Sie zum Startdatum addieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date_in_current_year RETURNING VALUE(rd_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date_in_current_year.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_year) = lv_current_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_year) = lv_current_year && '1231'.

    DATA(ld_first_day) = CONV d( lv_first_day_of_year ).
    DATA(ld_last_day) = CONV d( lv_last_day_of_year ).

    DATA(lv_days_in_year) = ld_last_day - ld_first_day + 1.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_days_in_year - 1 ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rd_random_date = ld_first_day + lv_random_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und wählen Sie für jede Gruppe zufällig einen Flug aus. Geben Sie die Flugnummern der ausgewählten Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_random_int` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_flight_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_nums) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-fldate WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lt_group_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( FOR GROUP member OF ls_flight ( member ) ).
      DATA(lv_num_group_flights) = lines( lt_group_flights ).

      IF lv_num_group_flights > 0.
        DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_num_group_flights ).
        DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
        READ TABLE lt_group_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(ls_random_flight).
        APPEND ls_random_flight-fldate TO rt_flight_nums.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_flight_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_per_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_nums) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_per_carrier( ).

    " At least one flight should be returned if SFLIGHTS has data
    IF lines( lt_flight_nums ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flight_nums IS NOT INITIAL ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'No random flights selected, check SFLIGHTS data.' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Further checks could involve verifying that each returned flight belongs to a unique carrier,
    " but this would require more complex logic to mock SFLIGHTS or query it again.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_abap_random_int` mit der modernen `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax. Für jede Gruppe von Flügen (nach Fluggesellschaft) wird ein zufälliger Index generiert, um einen einzelnen Flug auszuwählen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR GROUP ... )` ist eine moderne Art, die Elemente einer Gruppe in eine temporäre Tabelle zu sammeln.
keywords: Random, Grouping, Internal Tables, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, LOOP AT GROUP BY, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_binary_data TYPE xstring.
    TYPES: tt_binary_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_3d_model_data IMPORTING it_model_data TYPE tt_binary_data.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_3d_model_data.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    " Concatenate binary data from table into a single xstring
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = REDUCE xstring( INIT x = ''
                                            FOR <fs_data> IN it_model_data

      EXPORTING
        data = lv_xstring_data
        file_extension = 'JT' " Specify the model format, e.g., 'JT', 'STEP', 'STL'
    ).
    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_text_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_and_decompress
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_text_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress.
    DATA: lv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text(
          EXPORTING
            text   = iv_original_text
          IMPORTING
            gziped = lv_compressed_xstring
        ).

        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text(
          EXPORTING
            gziped = lv_compressed_xstring
          IMPORTING
            text   = rv_decompressed_text
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error INTO DATA(lx_compression_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder leeren String zurückgeben
        rv_decompressed_text = |Fehler bei Kompression/Dekompresssion: { lx_compression_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) in einen XSTRING und dekomprimiere sie anschließend zurück in eine identische Tabelle. Nutze dabei XML-Transformation für die Serialisierung.
hint: Serialisiere die Tabelle zuerst mit `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` in einen XSTRING, dann komprimiere mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP`. Für die Dekompression den umgekehrten Weg.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_sflight_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS decompress_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_sflight_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflight_table.
    DATA: lv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE sflight_data = it_sflight_data
          RESULT XML lv_xml_xstring.

        cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring(
          EXPORTING
            unzipped = lv_xml_xstring
          IMPORTING
            gziped   = rv_compressed_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error cx_transformation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_sflight_table.
    DATA: lv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring(
          EXPORTING
            gziped   = iv_compressed_data
          IMPORTING
            unzipped = lv_xml_xstring
        ).

        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE XML lv_xml_xstring
          RESULT sflight_data = rt_sflight_data.

      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error cx_transformation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sflight_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_compression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_sflight_compress( ).
    DATA: lt_original_sflight TYPE zcl_gzip_sflight_compress=>tt_sflight.

    " Testdaten für SFLIGHT
    lt_original_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) 
                                     ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_data) = lo_cut->compress_sflight_table( lt_original_sflight ).
    DATA(lt_decompressed_sflight) = lo_cut->decompress_sflight_table( lv_compressed_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_decompressed_sflight )
      exp = lines( lt_original_sflight )
      msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_decompressed_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = lt_original_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid
      msg = 'Erste Zeile CARRIER ID sollte übereinstimmen.'

      act = lt_decompressed_sflight[ 2 ]-price
      exp = lt_original_sflight[ 2 ]-price
      msg = 'Zweite Zeile PRICE sollte übereinstimmen.'

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kompression komplexer Datenstrukturen wie interner Tabellen. Zuerst wird die Tabelle mittels `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` in ein XML-Format (XSTRING) serialisiert, was eine standardisierte Darstellung ermöglicht. Anschließend wird dieser XSTRING mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS_XSTRING` komprimiert. Die Dekompression erfolgt analog. Dies ist ideal für die effiziente Speicherung oder Übertragung großer Datenmengen.

Instructions: Prüfe, ob eine gegebene Einkaufsgruppe zu einer vordefinierten Liste von 'kritischen' Einkaufsgruppen gehört, die durch Konstanten aus `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS` repräsentiert werden.
hint: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit den relevanten Konstanten und nutze `LINE_EXISTS` oder `FILTER` für die Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pur_ekgrp_critical DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_ekgrp_critical
      IMPORTING
        iv_ekgrp TYPE ekgrp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_critical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_ekgrp_critical IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_ekgrp_critical.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_critical_ekgrps,
                 ekgrp_001 TYPE ekgrp VALUE cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_ekgrp_001,
                 ekgrp_002 TYPE ekgrp VALUE cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_ekgrp_002,
                 ekgrp_003 TYPE ekgrp VALUE 'Z03',
               END OF gc_critical_ekgrps.

    DATA(lt_critical_ekgrps) = VALUE string_table(
      ( gc_critical_ekgrps-ekgrp_001 )
      ( gc_critical_ekgrps-ekgrp_002 )
      ( gc_critical_ekgrps-ekgrp_003 )
    ).

    rv_is_critical = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_critical_ekgrps[ table_line = iv_ekgrp ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Werte des Feldes `PRICE` zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflight_data
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE zcl_sflight_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight.

    lt_sflight_data = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) 
                                 ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) 
                                 ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20230103' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).

Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu verwenden, wird der Akkumulator (`sum`) in jedem Schritt aktualisiert. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code.

Instructions: Implementiere eine einfache Factory-Methode, die Objekte von verschiedenen Typen (z.B. 'A' oder 'B') basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt und zurückgibt. Nutze dabei ein Interface und den `NEW`-Operator.
hint: Definiere ein Interface, implementiere es in zwei Klassen und erstelle eine Factory-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die den `NEW`-Operator verwendet.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Produkttyp: { iv_product_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_product_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_product_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_unknown_product FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_product_a.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_product
      msg = 'Produkt A sollte erstellt werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_product->get_type( )
      exp = 'Product A'
      msg = 'Typ von Produkt A sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_product_b.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_product
      msg = 'Produkt B sollte erstellt werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_product->get_type( )
      exp = 'Product B'
      msg = 'Typ von Produkt B sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_unknown_product.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW zcx_abap_unit_dummy_exception( )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR'
      act_code = `zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'X' )`
      msg = 'Unbekannter Produkttyp sollte eine Ausnahme auslösen.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Pattern, ein grundlegendes Entwurfsmuster in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Die Factory-Methode `create_product` kapselt die Logik zur Objekterstellung und verwendet den `NEW`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) für die Instanziierung. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert die Erweiterbarkeit des Systems, da neue Produkttypen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne die Client-Code-Basis zu ändern. Die Verwendung von Interfaces sorgt für Polymorphie.
keywords: Objektorientierung, Factory Pattern, NEW Operator, Interface, Polymorphie, Ausnahmebehandlung

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei Datumsangaben unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
hint: Konvertiere die Datumsangaben in Timestamps und nutze dann die Methode `GET_DIFFERENCE` von `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_days_between.
    DATA: lv_timestamp_from TYPE timestampl,
          lv_timestamp_to   TYPE timestampl.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp(
          EXPORTING
            date = iv_date_from
          IMPORTING
            tstmp = lv_timestamp_from
        ).

        cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp(
          EXPORTING
            date = iv_date_to
          IMPORTING
            tstmp = lv_timestamp_to
        ).

        cl_abap_tstmp=>get_difference(
          EXPORTING
            tstmp1 = lv_timestamp_to
            tstmp2 = lv_timestamp_from
          IMPORTING
            days   = rv_days
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_tstmp_invalid_date cx_abap_tstmp_invalid_tstmp INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_days = 0. " Im Fehlerfall 0 Tage zurückgeben
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

Instructions: Versuche, einen ungültigen (nicht GZIP-formatierten) XSTRING zu dekomprimieren und fange die erwartete Ausnahme `CX_SY_COMPRESSION_ERROR` ab, um robustes Verhalten zu gewährleisten.
hint: Nutze `TRY...CATCH` um die Ausnahme `CX_SY_COMPRESSION_ERROR` abzufangen, die bei ungültigen GZIP-Daten ausgelöst wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_invalid_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_invalid_data.
    DATA: lv_decompressed_text TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text(
          EXPORTING
            gziped = iv_invalid_xstring
          IMPORTING
            text   = lv_decompressed_text
        ).
        rv_error_message = 'Dekomprimierung erfolgreich (unerwartet).'.
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error INTO DATA(lx_compression_error).
        rv_error_message = |Fehler bei Dekompression: { lx_compression_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere und dekomprimiere dynamisch erzeugte JSON-Daten, die eine Liste von Flugdaten enthalten. Nutze dabei die JSON-Serialisierung und `CL_ABAP_GZIP`.
hint: Verwende `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` mit `OPTIONS json` für die JSON-Serialisierung/Deserialisierung und `CL_ABAP_GZIP` für die Kompression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_json_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ts_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_json
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_decompressed_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_json_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_json.
    DATA: lv_json_string TYPE string,
          lv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lt_temp_data TYPE tt_flight_data.

    TRY.
        " 1. Daten in JSON-String serialisieren
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          OPTIONS json = 'X'
          SOURCE flight_data = it_flight_data
          RESULT XML lv_json_string.

        " 2. JSON-String komprimieren
        cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text(
          EXPORTING
            text   = lv_json_string
          IMPORTING
            gziped = lv_compressed_xstring
        ).

        " 3. Komprimierten XSTRING dekomprimieren
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text(
          EXPORTING
            gziped = lv_compressed_xstring
          IMPORTING
            text   = lv_json_string
        ).

        " 4. JSON-String in Datenstruktur deserialisieren
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          OPTIONS json = 'X'
          SOURCE XML lv_json_string
          RESULT flight_data = rt_decompressed_data.

      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error cx_transformation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

solution:
CLASS zcl_pur_ekgrp_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_ekgrp_info,
             ekgrp TYPE ekgrp,
             type  TYPE string,
           END OF ts_ekgrp_info,
           tt_ekgrp_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_ekgrp_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_grouped_ekgrp,
             type  TYPE string,
             ekgrps TYPE tt_ekgrp_info,
           END OF ts_grouped_ekgrp,
           tt_grouped_ekgrp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_grouped_ekgrp WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_purchasing_groups
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_ekgrps) TYPE tt_grouped_ekgrp.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pur_ekgrp_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_purchasing_groups.
    DATA(lt_all_ekgrps) = VALUE tt_ekgrp_info(
      ( ekgrp = cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_ekgrp_001 type = 'Standard' )
      ( ekgrp = cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_ekgrp_002 type = 'Standard' )
      ( ekgrp = 'Z01' type = 'Benutzerdefiniert' )
      ( ekgrp = 'Z02' type = 'Benutzerdefiniert' )
      ( ekgrp = cl_mmpur_constants=>gc_ekgrp_003 type = 'Standard' )
    ).

    rt_grouped_ekgrps = VALUE tt_grouped_ekgrp(
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF lt_all_ekgrps BY type
      GROUP SIZE DATA(lv_group_size)
      ( type = <group>-type
        ekgrps = VALUE tt_ekgrp_info( FOR <member> IN GROUP <group> ( <member> ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit `sflights` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_sum_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) TYPE s_price.
    DATA lt_sflights_lh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    LOOP AT lt_prices INTO DATA(ls_price).
      lv_expected_price = lv_expected_price + ls_price-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_expected_price
      msg = 'Total price for LH should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Die `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die relevanten Einträge, und `NEXT` definiert die Aggregationslogik. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als eine klassische `LOOP`-Anweisung.

Instructions: Erstelle einen String, der alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs aus `sflights` durch Komma getrennt auflistet.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE #( ... )` um eindeutige Werte zu sammeln und dann mit String Templates zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carriers) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE s_carr_id_tab(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( flight-carrid )
    ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_carriers COMPARING TABLE_LINE.

    rv_carriers = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR carrid IN lt_unique_carriers
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |{ carrid }| ELSE |{ result }, { carrid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_unique_carriers( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_carriers) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers_string( ).

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_sflights COMPARING carrid.

    DATA(lv_expected_carriers) = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR carrid_entry IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |{ carrid_entry-carrid }| ELSE |{ result }, { carrid_entry-carrid }| )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_carriers
      exp = lv_expected_carriers
      msg = 'Unique carriers string should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `VALUE` um zunächst alle Fluggesellschaften zu sammeln und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` um sie eindeutig zu machen. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um diese eindeutigen IDs mit String Templates zu einem einzigen, komma-separierten String zu verketten. Die `COND` Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` vermeidet ein führendes Komma.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Unique, Internal Tables, sflights, VALUE, COND

Instructions: Erstelle eine Hash-Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) die Anzahl der Flüge in `sflights` speichert.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und `VALUE hash_table( ... FOR ... )` um die Hash-Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_flight_counts DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        count  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_count,
      ty_flight_count_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_flight_counts IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE ty_flight_count_tab(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_flight_count_tab( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET current_count = counts[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid ]-count IN
      NEXT counts = VALUE ty_flight_count_tab(
        counts
        ( carrid = flight-carrid count = current_count + 1 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_flight_counts( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_expected_counts) TYPE zcl_red_flight_counts=>ty_flight_count_tab.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_count_temp).
      lt_expected_counts[ KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-count = lt_expected_counts[ KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_counts )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_counts )
      msg = 'Number of unique carriers should match'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_expected_counts INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      DATA(ls_actual) = lt_actual_counts[ KEY carrid = ls_expected-carrid ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_actual-count
        exp = ls_expected-count
        msg = |Count for carrier { ls_expected-carrid } should match|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `REDUCE` zur Erstellung einer Hash-Tabelle, die Aggregationsergebnisse speichert. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert die Hash-Tabelle. In der `NEXT`-Klausel wird der Zähler für jede Fluggesellschaft inkrementiert, wobei `VALUE` verwendet wird, um die Tabelle zu aktualisieren. `LET` wird verwendet, um den aktuellen Zählerstand für die Fluggesellschaft zu lesen.
keywords: REDUCE, Hash Table, Internal Tables, sflights, VALUE, LET

Instructions: Finde den Flug (CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE) mit dem höchsten Flugpreis aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und vergleiche den aktuellen Flugpreis mit dem bisher höchsten, um den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_max_price_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        price  TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_price_flight) TYPE ty_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_max_price_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rs_max_price_flight = REDUCE ty_flight_info(
      INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_flight_info( price = 0 )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_flight = COND #(
        WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price
        THEN VALUE ty_flight_info( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid fldate = flight-fldate price = flight-price )
        ELSE max_flight
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_max_price_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_actual_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( ).

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(ls_expected_flight) TYPE zcl_red_max_price_flight=>ty_flight_info.
    ls_expected_flight-price = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price > ls_expected_flight-price.
        ls_expected_flight = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_flight-price
      exp = ls_expected_flight-price
      msg = 'Price of max flight should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_flight-carrid
      exp = ls_expected_flight-carrid
      msg = 'Carrier of max flight should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_flight-connid
      exp = ls_expected_flight-connid
      msg = 'Connection ID of max flight should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `REDUCE`, um ein einzelnes Strukturergebnis zu aggregieren. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert die Struktur mit einem Startwert. In der `NEXT`-Klausel wird `COND` verwendet, um bedingt die `max_flight`-Struktur zu aktualisieren, wenn ein Flug mit einem höheren Preis gefunden wird. Dies ist eine elegante Möglichkeit, Min/Max-Werte zu finden.
keywords: REDUCE, Max Value, Internal Tables, sflights, COND, VALUE

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen. Berechne die Summe aller Zahlen, die größer als 10 sind.
hint: Kombiniere `FILTER` und `REDUCE` in einer Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_filter_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_of_numbers_greater_than
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_filter_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_of_numbers_greater_than.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN FILTER #( it_numbers WHERE table_line > iv_threshold )
      NEXT sum = sum + number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_sum_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_sum_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_filter_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 5 ) ( 12 ) ( 8 ) ( 20 ) ( 10 ) ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 10.
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_sum_of_numbers_greater_than( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_threshold = lv_threshold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = 32 " 12 + 20
      msg = 'Sum of numbers greater than 10 should be 32'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_sum_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_filter_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 10.
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_sum_of_numbers_greater_than( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_threshold = lv_threshold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Sum of empty table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_sum_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_red_filter_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 10.
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_sum_of_numbers_greater_than( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_threshold = lv_threshold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Sum should be 0 if no numbers match threshold'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle `it_numbers` mit `FILTER` nach Zahlen gefiltert, die größer als `iv_threshold` sind. Das Ergebnis dieses Filters wird dann direkt an `REDUCE` übergeben, um die Summe der gefilterten Zahlen zu berechnen. Dies ist sehr ausdrucksstark und vermeidet temporäre Variablen oder Schleifen.
keywords: REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Sum, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstelle für jeden Flug in `sflights` einen formatierten String der Form "Flug <CARRID>-<CONNID> am <FLDATE> kostet <PRICE> <CURRENCY>". Gib eine interne Tabelle dieser Strings zurück.
hint: Nutze String Templates mit `FOR` über die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_flight_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flight_details
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_flight_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_details.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights. " Limit for demo

    rt_flight_details = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( |Flug { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid } am { flight-fldate DATE = ISO } kostet { flight-price CURRENCY = flight-currency } { flight-currency }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_formatted_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_flight_report( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_details) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flight_details( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_actual_details )
      msg = 'Should return at least one formatted flight detail'
    ).

    IF lines( lt_actual_details ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_first_detail) = lt_actual_details[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches_regex(
        act = lv_first_detail
        exp = `^Flug \w{2}-\d{4} am \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} kostet [\d\.,]+ \w{3}$`
        msg = 'First detail string should match expected format'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine moderne und lesbare Möglichkeit, Strings zu formatieren. Variablen können direkt mit `{ variable }` eingebettet werden. Hier wird `FOR` verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle von Strings zu erstellen, wobei jeder String durch ein String Template aus den Feldern eines Fluges generiert wird. Die Formatierungsoptionen `DATE = ISO` und `CURRENCY = flight-currency` zeigen erweiterte Möglichkeiten.
keywords: String Templates, FOR, Internal Tables, sflights, Formatting, VALUE

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische WHERE-Klausel für eine SELECT-Anweisung basierend auf optionalen Eingabeparametern (z.B. Fluggesellschaft und Abflugort). Wenn ein Parameter leer ist, soll er nicht in die WHERE-Klausel aufgenommen werden.
hint: Nutze String Templates und `COND` für optionale Teile der WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_dynamic_where_clause
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_cityfrom TYPE s_city_fr OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_where_clause) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_dynamic_where_clause.
    DATA(lv_carrid_cond) = COND string( WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'| ELSE `` ).
    DATA(lv_cityfrom_cond) = COND string( WHEN iv_cityfrom IS NOT INITIAL THEN |CITYFROM = '{ iv_cityfrom }'| ELSE `` ).

    rv_where_clause = |{ lv_carrid_cond }{ COND string( WHEN lv_carrid_cond IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_cityfrom_cond IS NOT INITIAL THEN | AND | ELSE `` ) }{ lv_cityfrom_cond }|.

    IF rv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = |WHERE { rv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_all FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_cityfrom FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_where) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_where
      exp = `WHERE CARRID = 'LH' AND CITYFROM = 'FRANKFURT'`
      msg = 'Both parameters provided'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_where) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_where
      exp = `WHERE CARRID = 'AA'`
      msg = 'Only carrid provided'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_cityfrom.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_where) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( iv_cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_where
      exp = `WHERE CITYFROM = 'NEW YORK'`
      msg = 'Only cityfrom provided'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_none.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_where) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_where
      exp = ``
      msg = 'No parameters provided'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie String Templates und `COND` verwendet werden können, um dynamische SQL-WHERE-Klauseln zu erstellen. Jede Bedingung wird separat mit `COND` geprüft und nur dann in einen String umgewandelt, wenn der Parameter nicht initial ist. Anschließend werden diese Bedingungs-Strings mit einem weiteren String Template und `COND` für das "AND" verknüpft, um die endgültige WHERE-Klausel zu bilden. Dies ist flexibler und weniger fehleranfällig als die manuelle String-Verkettung.
keywords: String Templates, Dynamic SQL, COND, String Processing

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle mit Textzeilen. Verbinde alle Zeilen zu einem einzigen String, wobei jede Zeile durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt ist.

CLASS zcl_str_lines_of IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstelle eine CSV-Header-Zeile aus einer Liste von Feldnamen, getrennt durch Semikolon.

CLASS zcl_str_csv_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_str_csv_header IMPLEMENTATION.

      FOR field_name IN it_field_names

Instructions: Erstelle einen zusammenfassenden Bericht über die Flüge in `sflights`. Für jede Fluggesellschaft soll die Anzahl der Flüge und der Gesamtpreis in einem formatierten String ausgegeben werden. Alle diese Strings sollen dann zu einem Gesamtbericht verbunden werden, wobei jede Zusammenfassung eine neue Zeile bildet.
hint: Nutze `GROUP BY` mit `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation, dann String Templates für die Formatierung und `LINES OF` für den Gesamtbericht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mix_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_summary_report
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_report) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_report.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_summary_lines) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT c = c + 1 )
        total_price  = REDUCE s_price( INIT p = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT p = p + f-price )
      IN
      ( |Fluggesellschaft: { flight-carrid }, Flüge: { flight_count }, Gesamtpreis: { total_price } EUR| )
    ).

    rv_report = |{ LINES OF lt_summary_lines SEPARATOR cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_read_node IMPORTING iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring RETURNING VALUE(rv_node_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_read_node.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).
        DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( '/RootElement/Child1' ).
        IF lo_node IS BOUND.
          rv_node_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        rv_node_value = 'Error parsing XML'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie ein XML-Dokument, ändern Sie den Wert eines Knotens anhand seines XPath-Ausdrucks und serialisieren Sie es zurück in einen XSTRING.

CLASS zcl_xml_modify_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_xml_node IMPORTING iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring
                                      iv_xpath       TYPE string
                                      iv_new_value   TYPE string
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_modified_xml_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_modify_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_xml_node.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).
        DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( iv_xpath ).
        IF lo_node IS BOUND.
          lo_node->set_value( iv_new_value ).
        ENDIF.
        lo_xml_document->render_2_xstring( IMPORTING stream = rv_modified_xml_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Protokollierung oder Auslösen einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme
        " Zur Vereinfachung wird ein initialer XSTRING zurückgegeben
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_xml_node.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_modify_node( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xml_string) = `<RootElement><Data>OldValue</Data></RootElement>`. 
    DATA(lv_original_xml_xstring) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( iv_string = lv_original_xml_string ).
    DATA(lv_modified_xml_xstring) = lo_cut->modify_xml_node(
                                       iv_xml_xstring = lv_original_xml_xstring
                                       iv_xpath       = '/RootElement/Data'
                                       iv_new_value   = 'NewValue' ).
    DATA(lv_modified_xml_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string( iv_xstr = lv_modified_xml_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Knotenwert nicht aktualisiert' exp = '<Data>NewValue</Data>' act = lv_modified_xml_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'Alter Wert noch vorhanden' exp = 'OldValue' act = lv_modified_xml_string ).

    DATA(lv_non_existent_xpath_xstring) = lo_cut->modify_xml_node(
                                             iv_xml_xstring = lv_original_xml_xstring
                                             iv_xpath       = '/RootElement/NonExistent'
                                             iv_new_value   = 'ShouldNotChange' ).
    DATA(lv_non_existent_xpath_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string( iv_xstr = lv_non_existent_xpath_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'XML für nicht existierenden Knoten geändert' exp = lv_original_xml_string act = lv_non_existent_xpath_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein XML-Dokument geparst, ein spezifischer Knotenwert geändert und das Dokument wieder serialisiert wird. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist ebenfalls integriert.

Instructions: Parsen Sie ein XML-Dokument und extrahieren Sie alle Werte bestimmter Knoten mithilfe eines XPath-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `select_nodes` mit einem XPath-Ausdruck, der mehrere Knoten zurückgibt, und iterieren Sie dann über die Knotensammlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_iterate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_node_values_by_xpath IMPORTING iv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring
                                             iv_xpath       TYPE string
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_iterate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_node_values_by_xpath.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_xstring ).
        DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xml_document->select_nodes( iv_xpath ).
        LOOP AT lo_node_list->get_nodes( ) INTO DATA(lo_node).
          APPEND lo_node->get_value( ) TO rt_values.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
      CATCH cx_xml_xpath_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT` oder `SUM` in der Gruppenschleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_passengers,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        total_passengers TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrier_passengers,
      tt_carrier_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_passengers_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(lo_group).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP lo_group INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_total_seats = lv_total_seats + ls_group_member-seatsocc.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_passengers(
        carrid = lo_group->*-carrid
        total_passengers = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_result.
  ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_passengers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ). " Assuming sflight has data
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_entry-total_passengers ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` mit logischen Operatoren (`AND`, `OR`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_where_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_special_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_where_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_special_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND seatsocc > 200 )
            OR ( carrid = 'AA' AND fldate < '20250101' ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc
      ) TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-carrid ).

explanation: Die moderne Open SQL Syntax mit `@DATA(...)` und `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ermöglicht eine typsichere und performante Abfrage von Datenbanktabellen, wobei die Daten direkt in eine interne Tabelle geladen werden.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere oder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Komponenten mit identischen Namen übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
        field2 TYPE i,
        field3 TYPE string,
        extra_field TYPE c LENGTH 5,
      END OF ty_source_data,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
        field2 TYPE i,
        field3 TYPE string,
        another_field TYPE c LENGTH 5,
      END OF ty_target_data,
      tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_table
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_corresponding_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_structure.
    DATA ls_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_operator=>ty_source_data.
    ls_source-field1 = 'Value1'.
    ls_source-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-field3 = 'Hello'.
    ls_source-extra_field = 'Extra'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_operator( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Value1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field3 exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-another_field ). " Should be initial as no corresponding field
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_corresponding_table.
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_operator=>tt_source_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 field3 = 'One' extra_field = 'X' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'B' field2 = 2 field3 = 'Two' extra_field = 'Y' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-field3 exp = 'Two' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-another_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator vereinfacht die Zuweisung von Daten zwischen Strukturen und internen Tabellen, indem er Komponenten mit gleichen Namen automatisch zuordnet. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: Data Manipulation, CORRESPONDING, Structures, Internal Tables

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in einer internen Tabelle existiert, und geben Sie gegebenenfalls dessen Index zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_index.
    rv_index = LINE_INDEX( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_exists_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists_index.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251206' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251207' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists_index( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->check_flight_existence( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' it_flights = lt_test_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->check_flight_existence( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' it_flights = lt_test_flights ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_index( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' it_flights = lt_test_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_index( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' it_flights = lt_test_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_index( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' it_flights = lt_test_flights ) exp = 0 ). " 0 for not found
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` bieten eine performante und typsichere Möglichkeit, das Vorhandensein von Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu prüfen und deren Index zu ermitteln, ohne explizite `READ TABLE` Anweisungen mit `SY-SUBRC` Prüfungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Data Lookup, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Nachrichten, die für jeden Flug in einer Tabelle die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Datum in einem lesbaren Format zusammenfassen.

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und aktualisieren Sie die Anzahl der belegten Sitze direkt in der Tabelle, indem Sie Field-Symbols verwenden.

CLASS zcl_splitter_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    out->write( |Bitte diese Klasse in einem Dynpro-PBO-Modul verwenden.| ).

    mo_nested_splitter->set_column_width( column = 2 width = 50 ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Tabellentyp für numerische Werte. Füllen Sie eine Instanz dieses Typs mit Zahlen von 1 bis 10 und berechnen Sie die Summe aller geraden Zahlen mit einer REDUCE-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES TABLE OF`, `FOR ... IN` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: ty_t_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_of_evens RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_sum) = calculate_sum_of_evens( ).
    out->write( |Summe der geraden Zahlen: { lv_sum }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sum_of_evens.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE ty_t_numbers(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i <= 10
      ( i )
    ).

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN lt_numbers
      WHERE ( number MOD 2 = 0 )
      NEXT sum = sum + number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_of_evens FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_evens.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_evens( ).

    " Erwartete Summe der geraden Zahlen von 1 bis 10: 2+4+6+8+10 = 30
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'GEPLANT', 'VERSPOETET', 'GELANDET'). Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Flugstatus als Enumerationswert akzeptiert und eine entsprechende Nachricht zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ENUM` und `CASE TYPE OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM ty_e_flight_status,
             planned   VALUE IS INITIAL,
             delayed   VALUE 'D',
             landed    VALUE 'L',
             cancelled VALUE 'C',
           END OF ENUM ty_e_flight_status.

    METHODS get_status_message
      IMPORTING iv_status TYPE ty_e_flight_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( get_status_message( ty_e_flight_status=>planned ) ).
    out->write( get_status_message( ty_e_flight_status=>delayed ) ).
    out->write( get_status_message( ty_e_flight_status=>landed ) ).
    out->write( get_status_message( ty_e_flight_status=>cancelled ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_message.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN ty_e_flight_status=>planned.
        rv_message = 'Der Flug ist geplant.'.
      WHEN ty_e_flight_status=>delayed.
        rv_message = 'Der Flug ist verspätet.'.
      WHEN ty_e_flight_status=>landed.
        rv_message = 'Der Flug ist gelandet.'.
      WHEN ty_e_flight_status=>cancelled.
        rv_message = 'Der Flug wurde annulliert.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Flugstatus.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_message( zcl_flight_status_enum=>ty_e_flight_status=>delayed )   exp = 'Der Flug ist verspätet.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_message( zcl_flight_status_enum=>ty_e_flight_status=>landed )    exp = 'Der Flug ist gelandet.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_message( zcl_flight_status_enum=>ty_e_flight_status=>cancelled ) exp = 'Der Flug wurde annulliert.' ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Tabellentyp für Flugdaten (Flugnummer, Datum, Status). Füllen Sie eine Tabelle mit Beispieldaten und filtern Sie alle Flüge mit dem Status 'VERSPOETET' in eine neue Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES TABLE OF` und die `FILTER`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_s_flight_status.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_delayed_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_delayed_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_delayed) = get_delayed_flights( ).
    out->write( |Anzahl verspäteter Flüge: { lines( lt_delayed ) }| ).
    LOOP AT lt_delayed INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } Status: { ls_flight-status }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_delayed_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_t_flight_status(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251201' status = 'GEPLANT' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '123' fldate = '20251201' status = 'VERSPOETET' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20251202' status = 'GELANDET' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '567' fldate = '20251202' status = 'GEPLANT' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '124' fldate = '20251203' status = 'VERSPOETET' )
    ).

    rt_delayed_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE status = 'VERSPOETET' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch einen Strukturtyp zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und Datentypen. Demonstrieren Sie, wie eine Instanz dieser dynamischen Struktur gefüllt werden kann.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klassen `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` für die RTTS-Funktionalität.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_struct RETURNING VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = create_and_fill_dynamic_struct( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_data->* TO <ls_dynamic>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      out->write( |Dynamische Struktur erfolgreich erstellt und gefüllt.| ).
      " Dynamische Ausgabe der Felder (Beispiel)
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE any.
      DO.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF.
        DATA(lv_field_name) = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_type( <ls_dynamic> )->get_ddic_field_list( )[`sy-index` - 1]-fieldname.
        out->write( |Feld { lv_field_name }: { <lv_field> }| ).
      ENDDO.
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Fehler beim Erstellen der dynamischen Struktur.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_struct.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_field_def.
    TYPES: ty_t_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_field_definitions) = VALUE ty_t_field_def(
      ( name = 'FLUGNUMMER' type = 'CARRID' )
      ( name = 'FLUGDATUM'  type = 'DATS' )
      ( name = 'PREIS'      type = 'FLTP' )
    ).

    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT lt_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_field_def-name
        type = lo_type_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <ls_dynamic>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLUGNUMMER' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLUGDATUM' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_fldate>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PREIS' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_price>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_price> = '123.45'. ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_struct_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_struct_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_structure( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_struct( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Referenz auf dynamische Daten sollte nicht initial sein' act = lr_dynamic_data IS INITIAL ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic> TYPE any.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Feldsymbol für dynamische Struktur sollte zugewiesen sein' act = <ls_dynamic> IS ASSIGNED ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLUGNUMMER' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_carrid> exp = 'LH' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_fldate> TYPE dats.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLUGDATUM' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic> TO <lv_fldate>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_fldate> exp = sy-datum ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_price> TYPE fltp.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PREIS' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic> TO <lv_price>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_price> exp = '123.45' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Splitter-Container und implementieren Sie Methoden zum Speichern und Laden seiner Layout-Einstellungen (z.B. die Größen der Bereiche) in/aus dem Benutzerspeicher (SET/GET PARAMETER ID).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `GET_PERSISTENCE_DATA` und `SET_PERSISTENCE_DATA` des Splitter-Containers in Kombination mit `SET/GET PARAMETER ID`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_persistence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS save_layout.
    METHODS load_layout.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    CONSTANTS: gc_param_id TYPE sparm_id VALUE 'ZSPLIT_LAY'. " Parameter ID für Layout-Speicherung
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_persistence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( |Bitte diese Klasse in einem Dynpro-PBO/PAI-Modul verwenden.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    mo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent            = iv_parent_container
      rows              = 2
      columns           = 1
      no_autodef_progid = abap_true
    ).

    mo_splitter->set_row_height( row = 1 height = 50 ).
    mo_splitter->set_row_height( row = 2 height = 50 ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD save_layout.
    DATA(lv_layout_data) = mo_splitter->get_persistence_data( ).
    SET PARAMETER ID gc_param_id FIELD lv_layout_data.
    COMMIT WORK.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Splitter-Layout gespeichert.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_layout.
    DATA lv_layout_data TYPE string.
    GET PARAMETER ID gc_param_id FIELD lv_layout_data.
    IF lv_layout_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_splitter->set_persistence_data( lv_layout_data ).
      cl_demo_output=>display( |Splitter-Layout geladen.| ).
    ELSE.
      cl_demo_output=>display( |Kein gespeichertes Layout gefunden.| ).
    ENDIF.
    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Tabellentyp für Flugsegmente (Flugnummer, Startzeit, Endzeit). Füllen Sie eine Tabelle mit Beispieldaten und berechnen Sie die Gesamtflugzeit für jeden Flug unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `REDUCE` Expressions.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES TABLE OF`, `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_segment,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             dep_time  TYPE s_ltime,
             arr_time  TYPE s_ltime,
           END OF ty_s_flight_segment.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_segment TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_duration,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             duration  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_flight_duration.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_durations RETURNING VALUE(rt_durations) TYPE ty_t_flight_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_durations) = calculate_total_durations( ).
    out->write( |Flugdauern:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_durations INTO DATA(ls_duration).
      out->write( |Flug { ls_duration-carrid } { ls_duration-connid }: { ls_duration-duration } Minuten| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_durations.
    DATA(lt_segments) = VALUE ty_t_flight_segment(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' dep_time = '100000' arr_time = '120000' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' dep_time = '123000' arr_time = '140000' ) " Anschlussflug
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '123' dep_time = '080000' arr_time = '103000' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' dep_time = '150000' arr_time = '160000' )
    ).

    rt_durations = VALUE ty_t_flight_duration(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_segment IN lt_segments GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_segment-carrid connid = ls_segment-connid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid   = ls_segment-carrid
        connid   = ls_segment-connid
        duration = REDUCE i(
          INIT total_minutes = 0
          FOR ls_group_segment IN GROUP ls_segment
          NEXT total_minutes = total_minutes + (
            ( CONV i( ls_group_segment-arr_time+0(2) ) * 60 + CONV i( ls_group_segment-arr_time+2(2) ) ) -
            ( CONV i( ls_group_segment-dep_time+0(2) ) * 60 + CONV i( ls_group_segment-dep_time+2(2) ) )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein sehr effizienter und deklarativer Ansatz für komplexe Tabellenoperationen, der den Code erheblich vereinfacht und lesbarer macht als traditionelle Schleifen mit `AT END OF`.
