Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle (`ANY TABLE`) als Importparameter akzeptiert und die Anzahl der Zeilen zurückgibt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` mit einem dynamischen Schlüssel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ANY TABLE`, `DESCRIBE TABLE` und `LINE_EXISTS` mit Feldsymbolen für dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    METHODS get_line_count
      IMPORTING it_any_table TYPE any table
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS check_line_exists_dynamic
      IMPORTING it_any_table TYPE any table
                iv_key_field TYPE fieldname
                iv_key_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_t_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eins' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Zwei' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Drei' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = get_line_count( lt_data ).
    out->write( |Anzahl Zeilen: { lv_count }| ).

    DATA(lv_exists) = check_line_exists_dynamic( it_any_table = lt_data
                                                 iv_key_field = 'TEXT'
                                                 iv_key_value = 'Zwei' ).
    out->write( |'Zwei' existiert: { COND string( WHEN lv_exists = abap_true THEN 'Ja' ELSE 'Nein' ) }| ).

    lv_exists = check_line_exists_dynamic( it_any_table = lt_data
                                           iv_key_field = 'TEXT'
                                           iv_key_value = 'Vier' ).
    out->write( |'Vier' existiert: { COND string( WHEN lv_exists = abap_true THEN 'Ja' ELSE 'Nein' ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_line_count.
    rv_count = lines( it_any_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_line_exists_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE any table,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <lt_table>.
    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_key_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_field> = iv_key_value.
          rv_exists = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    rv_exists = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_line_count FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_check_line_exists_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_line_count.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_test,
             a TYPE i,
             b TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_test.
    TYPES: ty_t_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_test WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE ty_t_test(
      ( a = 1 b = 'X' )
      ( a = 2 b = 'Y' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_table_utils( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->get_line_count( lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lt_empty_table) = VALUE ty_t_test( ).
    lv_count = lo_cut->get_line_count( lt_empty_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_line_exists_dynamic.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_test,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_test.
    TYPES: ty_t_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_test WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE ty_t_test(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alice' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Bob' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_table_utils( ).

    " Existierender Wert
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_line_exists_dynamic( it_any_table = lt_test_data
                                                         iv_key_field = 'NAME'
                                                         iv_key_value = 'Alice' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exists ).

    " Nicht existierender Wert
    lv_exists = lo_cut->check_line_exists_dynamic( it_any_table = lt_test_data
                                                    iv_key_field = 'NAME'
                                                    iv_key_value = 'Charlie' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_exists ).

    " Falsches Schlüsselfeld
    lv_exists = lo_cut->check_line_exists_dynamic( it_any_table = lt_test_data
                                                    iv_key_field = 'NONEXISTENT'
                                                    iv_key_value = 'Alice' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Arbeit mit generischen internen Tabellen (`ANY TABLE`) und den dynamischen Zugriff auf deren Inhalte. Die Methode `check_line_exists_dynamic` verwendet Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`, um zur Laufzeit auf Felder einer unbekannten Struktur zuzugreifen. Obwohl `LINE_EXISTS` eine moderne Expression ist, erfordert der dynamische Schlüsselzugriff in diesem Kontext immer noch Feldsymbole. Die `TYPES` Definitionen sind hier für die Testdaten und die Struktur der Felddefinitionen wichtig.
keywords: TYPES, ANY TABLE, Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, LINE_EXISTS, Generic Programming

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Tabellentyp für eine Liste von Strings. Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die diese String-Tabelle in einen einzelnen, durch Kommas getrennten String konvertiert und umgekehrt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES TABLE OF string`, `REDUCE` für die Konvertierung zur Liste und `SPLIT` für die Konvertierung vom String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_list_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: ty_t_string_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS list_to_string
      IMPORTING it_string_list TYPE ty_t_string_list
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_single_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS string_to_list
      IMPORTING iv_single_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_string_list) TYPE ty_t_string_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_list_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_fruits) = VALUE ty_t_string_list(
      ( 'Apfel' )
      ( 'Banane' )
      ( 'Kirsche' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_fruit_string) = list_to_string( lt_fruits ).
    out->write( |Liste zu String: { lv_fruit_string }| ).

    DATA(lt_converted_fruits) = string_to_list( lv_fruit_string ).
    out->write( |String zu Liste (Anzahl): { lines( lt_converted_fruits ) }| ).
    LOOP AT lt_converted_fruits INTO DATA(lv_fruit).
      out->write( |  - { lv_fruit }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD list_to_string.
    rv_single_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR wa IN it_string_list
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN wa ELSE s && ', ' && wa )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD string_to_list.
    SPLIT iv_single_string AT ', ' INTO TABLE rt_string_list.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_list_to_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_string_to_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_list_to_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_list_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_list) = VALUE zcl_string_list_converter=>ty_t_string_list(
      ( 'Red' )
      ( 'Green' )
      ( 'Blue' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Red, Green, Blue'.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->list_to_string( lt_test_list ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected ).

    DATA(lt_empty_list) = VALUE zcl_string_list_converter=>ty_t_string_list( ).
    lv_actual = lo_cut->list_to_string( lt_empty_list ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_string_to_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_list_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Apple, Orange, Pear'.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_string_list_converter=>ty_t_string_list(
      ( 'Apple' )
      ( 'Orange' )
      ( 'Pear' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->string_to_list( lv_test_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual[1] exp = lt_expected[1] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual[2] exp = lt_expected[2] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual[3] exp = lt_expected[3] ).

    DATA(lv_empty_string) = ''.
    lt_actual = lo_cut->string_to_list( lv_empty_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual ) exp = 1 ). " SPLIT '' INTO TABLE results in one empty line
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual[1] exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konvertierung zwischen einer Liste von Strings (definiert mit `TYPES ty_t_string_list`) und einem einzelnen, durch Trennzeichen getrennten String. Die Methode `list_to_string` verwendet die `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Liste effizient zu einem String zu aggregieren, wobei String-Templates (`&&`) für die Verkettung genutzt werden. Die Methode `string_to_list` nutzt die `SPLIT`-Anweisung, um den String wieder in eine Tabelle aufzuteilen. Beide Ansätze sind modern und effizient für diese Art von Datenmanipulation.
keywords: TYPES, TABLE, STRING, REDUCE, SPLIT, Type Conversion, Functional Programming

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Konstanten-Strukturtyp für Konfigurationsparameter (z.B. 'MAX_ITEMS', 'DEFAULT_VALUE'). Greifen Sie auf die Werte dieser Konstanten zu.

CLASS zcl_config_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

             max_items     TYPE i,
             default_value TYPE string,
             is_active     TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_config_params.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_app_config TYPE ty_s_config_params,
                 max_items     TYPE i VALUE 100,
                 default_value TYPE string VALUE 'Standard',
                 is_active     TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true,
               END OF gc_app_config.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_max_items.
    rv_max_items = gc_app_config-max_items.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und die Summe der Passagierkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT` und `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_seats = lv_total_seats + ls_grouped_flight-seatsocc.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid     = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        total_seats  = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung und sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.

CLASS zcl_group_by_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             curr   TYPE s_curr_code,
             flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, curr = ls_flight-curr ) 
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA ls_grouped_entry TYPE ty_grouped_flight.
      ls_grouped_entry-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      ls_grouped_entry-curr = ls_group_key-curr.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        APPEND ls_member TO ls_grouped_entry-flights.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO rt_grouped.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_grouped ). " Ensure it's not empty

    " Check if grouping by carrid and curr works
    READ TABLE lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_entry) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-curr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-flights ).

    " Verify that all flights within a group have the same carrid and curr
    LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO ls_entry.
      IF lines( ls_entry-flights ) > 1.
        DATA(lv_first_carrid) = ls_entry-flights[ 1 ]-carrid.
        DATA(lv_first_curr) = ls_entry-flights[ 1 ]-curr.
        LOOP AT ls_entry-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_first_carrid ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-curr exp = lv_first_curr ).

CLASS zcl_group_by_filter_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_filtered_summary.

CLASS zcl_group_by_filter_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_grouped_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_type FROM lt_sflights WHERE seatsocc > 100.

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) 
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_flight_count > 2.
        APPEND VALUE ty_filtered_summary(
          carrid     = ls_group_key-carrid
          flight_count = lv_flight_count
        ) TO rt_summary.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die durchschnittliche Auslastung (Passagiere / maximale Sitze) aller Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy_summary,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_occupancy TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_occupancy_summary.
    TYPES tt_occupancy_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupancy
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_occupancy_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) 
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_occupancy) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum_occ = 0.0
             sum_seats = 0.0
        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ls_member-seatsocc
             sum_seats = sum_seats + ls_member-seatsmax
      ).

      DATA(lv_avg_occupancy) = COND decfloat16(
        WHEN lv_total_occupancy-sum_seats > 0 THEN lv_total_occupancy-sum_occ / lv_total_occupancy-sum_seats
        ELSE 0.0
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_occupancy_summary(
        carrid          = ls_group_key-carrid
        average_occupancy = lv_avg_occupancy
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die maximale Passagierkapazität enthält, direkt mit dem `VALUE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator in Verbindung mit `FOR GROUPS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_value_for_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_seats  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_results
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_value_for_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_results.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS ls_group OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                           ( carrid     = ls_group-carrid
                             flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                             max_seats  = REDUCE i(
                                            INIT mx = 0
                                            FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
                                            NEXT mx = nmax( mx, ls_member-seatsmax ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Check for a specific airline (e.g., 'DL')

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_dl_result-max_seats exp = 0 msg = 'DL max seats should not be zero' ).

CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    CLASS zcl_test_class DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA: mv_public_attr1 TYPE string,

    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      IF ls_attribute-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public.
        APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info(

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit alle öffentlichen Methoden einer gegebenen Klasse, einschließlich ihrer Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS zcl_test_class_methods DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS: method_a,
                 method_b IMPORTING iv_param1 TYPE string
                          EXPORTING ev_param2 TYPE i.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS: protected_method.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS: private_method.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter_info,
             name TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_parameter_info.
    TYPES tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name       TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE tt_parameter_info,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_methods_with_params
      IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info
      RAISING   cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_methods_with_params.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method).
      IF ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public.
        DATA ls_method_info TYPE ty_method_info.
        ls_method_info-name = ls_method-name.

        DATA(lo_method_descr) = CAST cl_abap_methdescr( ls_method-type_descr ).
        DATA(lt_parameters) = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).

        LOOP AT lt_parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
          APPEND VALUE ty_parameter_info(
            name = ls_param-name
            kind = ls_param-parameter_kind
            type = ls_param-type_descr->get_name( )
          ) TO ls_method_info-parameters.
        ENDLOOP.

        APPEND ls_method_info TO rt_methods.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine bestimmte Klasse ein gegebenes Interface implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und `implements_interface`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_implements_if DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACE zi_test_interface.
      METHODS: do_something.
    ENDINTERFACE.

    CLASS zcl_implementing_class DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zi_test_interface.
        METHODS: another_method.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_implementing_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zi_test_interface~do_something.
        " Implementation
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD another_method.
        " Implementation
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_non_implementing_class DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS: simple_method.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS check_interface_implementation
      IMPORTING iv_class_name    TYPE string
                iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING   cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_implements_if IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_interface_implementation.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
    rv_implements = lo_class_descr->implements_interface( iv_interface_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_implements_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_implements_if( ).

    " Test implementing class
    DATA(lv_implements_true) = lo_cut->check_interface_implementation(
      iv_class_name    = 'ZCL_RTTI_IMPLEMENTS_IF=>ZCL_IMPLEMENTING_CLASS'
      iv_interface_name = 'ZCL_RTTI_IMPLEMENTS_IF=>ZI_TEST_INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_implements_true msg = 'Implementing class should implement the interface' ).

    " Test non-implementing class
    DATA(lv_implements_false) = lo_cut->check_interface_implementation(
      iv_class_name    = 'ZCL_RTTI_IMPLEMENTS_IF=>ZCL_NON_IMPLEMENTING_CLASS'
      iv_interface_name = 'ZCL_RTTI_IMPLEMENTS_IF=>ZI_TEST_INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_implements_false msg = 'Non-implementing class should not implement the interface' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine praktische Anwendung von RTTI: die Überprüfung, ob eine Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert. Die Methode `implements_interface` von `cl_abap_classdescr` liefert direkt das Ergebnis. Dies ist nützlich für die Validierung von Objekten oder die dynamische Anpassung des Programmverhaltens basierend auf den Fähigkeiten eines Objekts.
keywords: RTTI, Class, Interface, implements_interface, cl_abap_classdescr, Object Orientation

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name als String gegeben ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA: mv_result TYPE string.
        METHODS: set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string,
                 get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD set_value.
        mv_result = iv_value.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD get_value.
        rv_value = mv_result.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING io_object     TYPE REF TO object
                iv_method_name TYPE string
                iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_call_error
                cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmdescr_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmdescr.

    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( io_object ).
    lo_method_descr = CAST cl_abap_methdescr( lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ) ).
    lt_parameters = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).

    DATA lt_param_table TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED AND iv_method_name = 'SET_VALUE'.
      APPEND VALUE abap_parmbind(
        name = 'IV_VALUE'
        kind = cl_abap_methdescr=>importing
        value = NEW cl_abap_typedescr=>data_ref( iv_param_value )
      ) TO lt_param_table.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_method_name = 'GET_VALUE'.
      APPEND VALUE abap_parmbind(
        name = 'RV_VALUE'
        kind = cl_abap_methdescr=>returning
        value = NEW cl_abap_typedescr=>data_ref( rv_output )
      ) TO lt_param_table.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_param_table.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_method( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_method=>zcl_dynamic_target( ).

    " Dynamically call SET_VALUE
    lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'SET_VALUE'
      iv_param_value = 'Hello Dynamic!' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_target->mv_result exp = 'Hello Dynamic!' msg = 'Result should be set by dynamic call' ).

    " Dynamically call GET_VALUE
    DATA(lv_retrieved_value) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'GET_VALUE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_retrieved_value exp = 'Hello Dynamic!' msg = 'Value should be retrieved by dynamic call' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie RTTI in Verbindung mit dynamischen Methodenaufrufen (`CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE`) verwendet werden kann. Es ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das für Frameworks, Plugin-Architekturen oder generische Datenverarbeitungsszenarien unerlässlich ist, bei denen Methoden zur Laufzeit basierend auf Konfigurationen oder Metadaten aufgerufen werden müssen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Call, Method, cl_abap_classdescr, CALL METHOD, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die gesamte Vererbungshierarchie einer Klasse bis zur Wurzelklasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und die Methode `get_superclass`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_inheritance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS zcl_base_class DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS: base_method.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_base_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD base_method.
        " Base implementation
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_middle_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_class.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS: middle_method.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_middle_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD middle_method.
        " Middle implementation
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_derived_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_middle_class.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS: derived_method.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_derived_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD derived_method.
        " Derived implementation
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS get_class_hierarchy
      IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE string_table
      RAISING   cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inheritance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_hierarchy.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lo_current_descr) = lo_class_descr.

    WHILE lo_current_descr IS BOUND.
      INSERT lo_current_descr->get_name( ) INTO TABLE rt_hierarchy INDEX 1.
      lo_current_descr = lo_current_descr->get_superclass( ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_class_hierarchy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_class_hierarchy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_inheritance( ).
    DATA(lt_hierarchy) = lo_cut->get_class_hierarchy( 'ZCL_RTTI_INHERITANCE=>ZCL_DERIVED_CLASS' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hierarchy ) exp = 3 msg = 'Hierarchy should have 3 classes' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_hierarchy[ 1 ] exp = 'ZCL_RTTI_INHERITANCE=>ZCL_BASE_CLASS' msg = 'First class should be base class' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_hierarchy[ 2 ] exp = 'ZCL_RTTI_INHERITANCE=>ZCL_MIDDLE_CLASS' msg = 'Second class should be middle class' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_hierarchy[ 3 ] exp = 'ZCL_RTTI_INHERITANCE=>ZCL_DERIVED_CLASS' msg = 'Third class should be derived class' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von RTTI, um die Vererbungshierarchie einer Klasse zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln. Durch wiederholtes Aufrufen von `get_superclass` kann man die gesamte Kette bis zur Wurzelklasse verfolgen. Dies ist nützlich für die Analyse von Klassendesigns, die Implementierung von generischen Verarbeitungslogiken, die auf der Hierarchie basieren, oder für Debugging-Zwecke.
keywords: RTTI, Class Hierarchy, Superclass, cl_abap_classdescr, Object Orientation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit alle Komponenten (Felder) einer gegebenen Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_example_struct,
             comp1 TYPE string,
             comp2 TYPE i,
             comp3 TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_example_struct.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING is_structure TYPE ty_example_struct
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING   cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( )
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Wert einer Variablen dynamisch in einen anderen Datentyp, wenn die Typen kompatibel sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>get_conversion_rules` und `ASSIGN ... CASTING` oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_data_dynamically
      IMPORTING ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data
                iv_target_type TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_target_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING   cx_sy_descr_ref_error
                cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_data_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_source_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_source_data ).
    DATA(lo_target_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_type ).

    " Check if conversion is possible (simplified check)
    IF lo_source_type->type_kind = lo_target_type->type_kind OR
       ( lo_source_type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char AND lo_target_type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num ) OR
       ( lo_source_type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num AND lo_target_type->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char ).

      CREATE DATA rr_target_data TYPE HANDLE lo_target_type.
      ASSIGN rr_target_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>).

      IF <fs_target> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_source> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Direct assignment for basic types
        <fs_target> = <fs_source>.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_move_cast_error.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_move_cast_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_conversion_fail FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_conversion( ).

    " Convert string to integer
    DATA lv_string_num TYPE string VALUE '123'.
    DATA(lr_int_data) = lo_cut->convert_data_dynamically( ir_source_data = REF #( lv_string_num ) iv_target_type = 'I' ).
    ASSIGN lr_int_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_int>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_int> exp = 123 msg = 'String to Int conversion failed' ).

    " Convert integer to string
    DATA lv_int TYPE i VALUE 456.
    DATA(lr_string_data) = lo_cut->convert_data_dynamically( ir_source_data = REF #( lv_int ) iv_target_type = 'STRING' ).
    ASSIGN lr_string_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_string>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_string> exp = '456' msg = 'Int to String conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_conversion_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_conversion( ).
    DATA lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'abc'.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_data_dynamically( ir_source_data = REF #( lv_string ) iv_target_type = 'I' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_move_cast_error for incompatible conversion' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for incompatible conversion' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von RTTI zur dynamischen Typkonvertierung. Es nutzt `cl_abap_typedescr` zur Beschreibung von Quell- und Zieltypen und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` zur dynamischen Erzeugung von Datenreferenzen. Die eigentliche Zuweisung erfolgt über Field-Symbole. Dies ist nützlich in Szenarien, wo Datenformate zur Laufzeit angepasst werden müssen, z.B. bei der Integration mit externen Systemen.
keywords: RTTI, Type Conversion, Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols, cl_abap_typedescr

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse, deren Name als String gegeben ist, und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Typ und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACE zi_dynamic_callable.
      METHODS: execute_action RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    ENDINTERFACE.

    CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_a DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zi_dynamic_callable.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_a IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zi_dynamic_callable~execute_action.
        rv_result = 'Action from Class A executed'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_b DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zi_dynamic_callable.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_b IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zi_dynamic_callable~execute_action.
        rv_result = 'Action from Class B executed'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS create_and_execute
      IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_sy_create_object_error
                cx_sy_dyn_call_error
                cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_execute.
    DATA lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lo_callable TYPE REF TO zi_dynamic_callable.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    lo_callable ?= lo_dynamic_object.

    IF lo_callable IS BOUND.
      rv_output = lo_callable->execute_action( ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_move_cast_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_and_execute_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_and_execute_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_and_execute_fail FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_execute_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_object( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_execute( 'ZCL_RTTI_DYNAMIC_OBJECT=>ZCL_DYNAMIC_CLASS_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Action from Class A executed' msg = 'Should execute action from Class A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_and_execute_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_object( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_execute( 'ZCL_RTTI_DYNAMIC_OBJECT=>ZCL_DYNAMIC_CLASS_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Action from Class B executed' msg = 'Should execute action from Class B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_and_execute_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_object( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_and_execute( 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_create_object_error for non-existent class' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for non-existent class' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Instanziierung von Objekten und den Aufruf ihrer Methoden zur Laufzeit. `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Typnamen ermöglicht die Erstellung einer Instanz, deren genauer Typ erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Durch den Downcast auf ein Interface (`lo_callable ?= lo_dynamic_object`) kann dann eine gemeinsame Methode aufgerufen werden. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept für flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Object Creation, CREATE OBJECT, Dynamic Programming, Interface, Downcast, Object Orientation

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einer internen Tabelle (z.B. Flugdaten aus `sflights`) als CSV-Anhang. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die CSV-Generierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die interne Tabelle in ein CSV-Format zu konvertieren, und `cl_document_bcs=>create_binary` für den Anhang.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_curcode,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_flights_as_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE bcs_st_subject
        it_flights   TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_flights_as_csv.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " CSV Header
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = 'Carrier ID;Connection ID;Flight Date;Price;Currency'.
    " CSV Body using REDUCE
    DATA(lv_csv_body) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = s && |{ flight-carrid };{ flight-connid };{ flight-fldate };{ flight-price };{ flight-currency }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|
    ).

    DATA(lv_xstring_csv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_by_encoding( )->string_to_xstring( lv_csv_body ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_text(
      i_text    = VALUE bcsy_text( ( 'Please find the flight data attached.' ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_binary(
      i_contents = lv_xstring_csv
      i_mimetype = 'text/csv'
      i_filename = 'flight_data.csv'
    ).
    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment = lo_attachment
      i_attachment_subject = 'flight_data.csv'
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_bcs->send( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_flights_as_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_flights_as_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'test_csv@example.com'.
    DATA(lv_subject) = |Flight Data { sy-datum }|.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_bcs_email_csv=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_flights_as_csv(
          iv_recipient = lv_recipient
          iv_subject   = lv_subject
          it_flights   = lt_flights
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'CSV email sending should not dump' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator wird verwendet, um die interne Tabelle `it_flights` effizient in einen CSV-String zu transformieren. Dies ist eine moderne, funktionale Art der Datenaggregation und -formatierung, die den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP`-Konstrukte.
keywords: Email, BCS, Internal Tables, REDUCE, CSV, Attachment

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Terminen, um nur diejenigen zurückzugeben, die innerhalb eines bestimmten Start- und Enddatums liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen, um die Termine effizient auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
        id          TYPE string,
        description TYPE string,
        start_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
        end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl,
      END OF ty_appointment_data,
      tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_all_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_data
        iv_filter_start     TYPE timestampl
        iv_filter_end       TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE tt_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_appointments_by_date.
    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #(
      it_all_appointments
      WHERE start_tstmp >= iv_filter_start AND end_tstmp <= iv_filter_end
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_system( ).

    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_filter=>tt_appointment_data(
      ( id = 'A001' description = 'Meeting 1' start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 0 ) end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 3600 ) )
      ( id = 'A002' description = 'Meeting 2' start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 7200 ) end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 10800 ) )
      ( id = 'A003' description = 'Meeting 3' start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 14400 ) end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 18000 ) )
    ).

    " Filter for appointments starting after base + 1 hour and ending before base + 3 hours
    DATA(lv_filter_start) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 3601 ).
    DATA(lv_filter_end) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 10799 ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_appointments_by_date(
      it_all_appointments = lt_appointments
      iv_filter_start     = lv_filter_start
      iv_filter_end       = lv_filter_end
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 'A002' ).

    " Test with no matching appointments
    lv_filter_start = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 100000 ).
    lv_filter_end = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 200000 ).
    lt_filtered = lo_cut->filter_appointments_by_date(
      it_all_appointments = lt_appointments
      iv_filter_start     = lv_filter_start
      iv_filter_end       = lv_filter_end
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'No appointments should be found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist kompakter und oft performanter als ein manueller `LOOP` mit `DELETE` oder `APPEND` und ist ein Kernbestandteil des modernen ABAP für die Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Date/Time, Appointment, Data Selection

Instructions: Senden Sie personalisierte E-Mails an mehrere Empfänger, deren Daten in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert sind. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator, um die Empfängerliste dynamisch zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address` und String-Templates für personalisierte Inhalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_personal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_recipient_data,
        name    TYPE string,
        email   TYPE ad_smtpadr,
        message TYPE string,
      END OF ty_recipient_data,
      tt_recipient_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_recipient_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_personalized_emails
      IMPORTING
        it_recipients TYPE tt_recipient_data
        iv_subject    TYPE bcs_st_subject.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_personal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_personalized_emails.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    LOOP AT it_recipients INTO DATA(ls_recipient).
      DATA(lv_personalized_body) = |Hello { ls_recipient-name },\n\n{ ls_recipient-message }\n\nBest regards,\nYour Team|.

      DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_text(
        i_text    = VALUE bcsy_text( ( lv_personalized_body ) )
        i_subject = iv_subject
      ).

      lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ). " Document is set per recipient for personalized content

      DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( ls_recipient-email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

      lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
      lo_bcs->send( ). " Send immediately for each personalized email
      lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ). " Create new BCS object for next email
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    ).

    TRY.

    ENDTRY.

explanation: Die Lösung iteriert über eine Tabelle von Empfängern und erstellt für jeden eine personalisierte E-Mail. String-Templates werden für den dynamischen Inhalt verwendet. Obwohl hier ein `LOOP` verwendet wird, ist die Kombination mit String-Templates und der direkten Objektinteraktion mit `cl_bcs` eine moderne und lesbare Herangehensweise. Für die Erstellung der Empfängerliste selbst könnte der `FOR` Operator verwendet werden, wenn die Empfänger aus einer anderen Quelle dynamisch generiert würden.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer eines Termins in Stunden und Minuten basierend auf Start- und End-Zeitstempeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden der Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitstempel-Arithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_duration,
        hours   TYPE i,
        minutes TYPE i,
      END OF ty_duration.

    METHODS calculate_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_duration) TYPE ty_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_duration.
    DATA(lv_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      iv_timestamp1 = iv_end_tstmp
      iv_timestamp2 = iv_start_tstmp
    ).

    rs_duration-hours = lv_seconds DIV 3600.
    rs_duration-minutes = ( lv_seconds MOD 3600 ) DIV 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_duration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_duration( ).
    DATA(lv_start) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_system( ).
    DATA(lv_end_1h) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_timestamp = lv_start iv_seconds = 3600 ). " 1 hour
    DATA(lv_end_2h30m) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_timestamp = lv_start iv_seconds = 9000 ). " 2 hours 30 minutes

    DATA(ls_duration_1h) = lo_cut->calculate_duration(
      iv_start_tstmp = lv_start
      iv_end_tstmp   = lv_end_1h
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_duration_1h-hours exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_duration_1h-minutes exp = 0 ).

    DATA(ls_duration_2h30m) = lo_cut->calculate_duration(
      iv_start_tstmp = lv_start
      iv_end_tstmp   = lv_end_2h30m
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_duration_2h30m-hours exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_duration_2h30m-minutes exp = 30 ).

    DATA(ls_duration_zero) = lo_cut->calculate_duration(
      iv_start_tstmp = lv_start
      iv_end_tstmp   = lv_start
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_duration_zero-hours exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_duration_zero-minutes exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` bietet eine robuste und präzise Möglichkeit zur Handhabung von Zeitstempeln und zur Durchführung von Zeitberechnungen. Die Verwendung ihrer Methoden wie `subtract` ist der modernen ABAP-Praxis entsprechend und vermeidet manuelle, fehleranfällige Datums-/Zeitberechnungen.
keywords: Date/Time, Timestamp, Duration, cl_abap_tstmp, Math

solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
        id          TYPE string,
        description TYPE string,
        start_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
        end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl,
      END OF ty_appointment_data,
      tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_daily_count,
        date        TYPE d,
        count       TYPE i,
      END OF ty_daily_count,
      tt_daily_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_all_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_daily_counts) TYPE tt_daily_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_by_date.
    LOOP AT it_all_appointments INTO DATA(ls_appointment) GROUP BY ( date = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_tstmp( ls_appointment-start_tstmp ) ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_daily_count( date = group_key-date count = group_key->* ) TO rt_daily_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_grouping( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_system( ).

    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_grouping=>tt_appointment_data(
      ( id = 'A001' description = 'Meeting 1' start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 0 ) end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 3600 ) )
      ( id = 'A002' description = 'Meeting 2' start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 0 ) end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 7200 ) ) " Same day as A001
      ( id = 'A003' description = 'Meeting 3' start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 86400 ) end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 90000 ) ) " Next day
      ( id = 'A004' description = 'Meeting 4' start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 86400 ) end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 93600 ) ) " Same day as A003
    ).

    DATA(lt_daily_counts) = lo_cut->group_appointments_by_date(
      it_all_appointments = lt_appointments
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_daily_counts ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_date_today) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_tstmp( lv_tstmp_base ).
    DATA(lv_date_tomorrow) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_tstmp( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 86400 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_daily_counts[ 1 ]-date exp = lv_date_today ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_daily_counts[ 1 ]-count exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_daily_counts[ 2 ]-date exp = lv_date_tomorrow ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_daily_counts[ 2 ]-count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY` Zusatz in `LOOP AT` ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Funktion, die es ermöglicht, Daten in internen Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren, ohne separate Hilfstabellen oder komplexe Logik. `group_key->*` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was die Zählung vereinfacht.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT, Date/Time, Aggregation

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Beschreibung eines Termins nur, wenn die neue Beschreibung nicht leer ist und der Termin in einer Liste existiert. Nutzen Sie moderne konditionale Zuweisungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` für konditionelle Zuweisungen und `LINE_EXISTS` für die Prüfung der Existenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
        id          TYPE string,
        description TYPE string,
        start_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
        end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl,
      END OF ty_appointment_data,
      tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS update_appointment_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_appointment_id   TYPE string
        iv_new_description  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_appointments     TYPE tt_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_appointment_description.
    IF iv_new_description IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_index) = COND i(
        WHEN line_exists( ct_appointments[ id = iv_appointment_id ] ) THEN
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = 1 msg = 'Appointment found' ). " Placeholder for actual index logic
          sy-tabix
        ELSE
          0
      ).

      IF lv_index > 0.
        ASSIGN ct_appointments[ id = iv_appointment_id ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_appointment>).
        IF <fs_appointment> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_appointment>-description = iv_new_description.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_appointment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_appointment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_update( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_system( ).

    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_update=>tt_appointment_data(
      ( id = 'A001' description = 'Old Description 1' start_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 3600 ) )
      ( id = 'A002' description = 'Old Description 2' start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 7200 ) end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( lv_tstmp_base 10800 ) )
    ).

    " Test 1: Update existing appointment with new description
    lo_cut->update_appointment_description(
      iv_appointment_id  = 'A001'
      iv_new_description = 'New Description for A001'
      CHANGING
        ct_appointments    = lt_appointments
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_appointments[ id = 'A001' ]-description exp = 'New Description for A001' ).

    " Test 2: Try to update non-existing appointment
    lo_cut->update_appointment_description(
      iv_appointment_id  = 'A003'
      iv_new_description = 'Description for A003'
      CHANGING
        ct_appointments    = lt_appointments
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_appointments ) exp = 2 msg = 'No new appointment should be added' ).

    " Test 3: Try to update with empty description
    lo_cut->update_appointment_description(
      iv_appointment_id  = 'A002'
      iv_new_description = ''
      CHANGING
        ct_appointments    = lt_appointments
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_appointments[ id = 'A002' ]-description exp = 'Old Description 2' msg = 'Description should not change' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit einer Tabellenexpression, um die Existenz eines Eintrags in der internen Tabelle effizient zu prüfen. Die Zuweisung über ein Field-Symbol (`ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`) ist eine performante Methode zur direkten Modifikation von Tabellenzeilen. `COND` wird hier verwendet, um den Index konditional zu bestimmen, was eine moderne Art der Ausdrucksformulierung ist.
keywords: Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, COND, Field Symbols, Update

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail und implementieren Sie eine grundlegende Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass der E-Mail-Versand fehlschlägt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen der Klasse `cx_bcs` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_error_hdl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE bcs_st_subject
        iv_body_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_error_hdl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_error_handling.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_text(
          i_text    = VALUE bcsy_text( ( iv_body_text ) )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
        lo_bcs->send( ).
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Log the error, e.g., using cl_abap_logger or a custom logging framework
        " cl_abap_logger=>log( i_text = lx_bcs->get_text( ) i_severity = cl_abap_logger=>error ).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'. " For demo purposes
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_send_email_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_error_hdl( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'success@example.com'.
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'Success Test'.
    DATA(lv_body) = 'This email should be sent successfully.'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->send_email_with_error_handling(
      iv_recipient = lv_recipient
      iv_subject   = lv_subject
      iv_body_text = lv_body
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true msg = 'Email sending should report success' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_send_email_failure.
    " To simulate a failure, we would typically mock cl_bcs to raise an exception.
    " For this example, we cannot easily force a cx_bcs without a real system issue.
    " We will test the error handling path by asserting that a specific error message
    " would be caught if an exception were raised.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_error_hdl( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'invalid-recipient'. " An invalid recipient might cause an error in a real system
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'Failure Test'.
    DATA(lv_body) = 'This email should fail.'.

    " In a real test, you'd use test doubles to simulate the exception.
    " Here, we just call the method and expect it to handle potential errors gracefully.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->send_email_with_error_handling(
      iv_recipient = lv_recipient
      iv_subject   = lv_subject
      iv_body_text = lv_body
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_false msg = 'Email sending should report failure' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ist die Standardmethode zur Fehlerbehandlung in modernem ABAP. Das Abfangen von Ausnahmen wie `cx_bcs` ermöglicht es, auf Fehler beim E-Mail-Versand zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Dies erhöht die Robustheit und Zuverlässigkeit der Anwendung.
keywords: Email, BCS, Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY CATCH, Communication

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Termin in der Zukunft liegt, basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemzeitstempel.
hint: Vergleichen Sie den Termin-Startzeitstempel mit dem aktuellen Systemzeitstempel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_appointment_in_future
      IMPORTING
        iv_appointment_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_appointment_in_future.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_system( ).
    IF iv_appointment_start_tstmp > lv_current_tstmp.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_appointment_in_future FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_appointment_in_future.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_future( ).
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_system( ).

    " Test 1: Appointment in the future
    DATA(lv_future_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_timestamp = lv_current_tstmp iv_seconds = 3600 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_appointment_in_future( lv_future_tstmp ) exp = abap_true ).

    " Test 2: Appointment in the past
    DATA(lv_past_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( iv_timestamp = lv_current_tstmp iv_seconds = 3600 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_appointment_in_future( lv_past_tstmp ) exp = abap_false ).

    " Test 3: Appointment exactly now (or very close)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_appointment_in_future( lv_current_tstmp ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die direkte Vergleichsoperation (`>`) zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln ist eine einfache und effiziente Methode, um festzustellen, ob ein Ereignis in der Zukunft liegt. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_system()` stellt sicher, dass der Vergleich mit dem aktuellen Systemzeitstempel erfolgt, was für solche Prüfungen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: Date/Time, Timestamp, Conditional Logic, Comparison, Future

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem dynamisch erstellten Betreff und Text, wobei die Inhalte aus einer Struktur mit variablen Feldnamen stammen können. Nutzen Sie Field-Symbols und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`) für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten und String-Templates für die Nachrichtenerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_dynamic_email
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE any
        it_field_map TYPE string_table " List of field names to extract from is_data
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_dynamic_email.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'Dynamic Email'.
    DATA(lv_body) = 'Dynamic Content:'.

    LOOP AT it_field_map INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
      IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        lv_body = lv_body && |\n  { lv_field_name }: { <fs_value> }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_text(
      i_text    = VALUE bcsy_text( ( lv_body ) )
      i_subject = lv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_bcs->send( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_dynamic_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_dynamic_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_dynamic( ).
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_flight_info,
            carrid   TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',
            connid   TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '400',
            fldate   TYPE s_date VALUE '20251225',
            cityfrom TYPE s_cityname VALUE 'Frankfurt',
            cityto   TYPE s_cityname VALUE 'New York',
          END OF ls_flight_info.

    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'CARRID' )
      ( 'CONNID' )
      ( 'FLDATE' )
      ( 'CITYFROM' )
      ( 'CITYTO' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'dynamic@example.com'.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_dynamic_email(
          is_data      = ls_flight_info
          it_field_map = lt_fields
          iv_recipient = lv_recipient
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic email sending should not dump' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert dynamische Programmierung durch den Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten mittels Field-Symbols (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`). In Kombination mit String-Templates ermöglicht dies die flexible Erstellung von E-Mail-Inhalten, deren Struktur und Daten zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Dies ist nützlich für generische E-Mail-Versandfunktionen.
keywords: Email, BCS, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, String Templates, RTTI

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flugverbindungen aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus, die einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode haben, und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie die neue `SELECT` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` mit einem `WHERE`-Zusatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_curcode,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should find flights for LH' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_carrid msg = 'All flights should be for LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_non_existent_carrid) = 'XX'.
    DATA(lt_no_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( lv_non_existent_carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_no_flights msg = 'Should find no flights for XX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue `SELECT`-Syntax mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und dem `@`-Escape-Zeichen für Host-Variablen ist ein Kernbestandteil des modernen ABAP für Datenbankzugriffe. Sie ist kompakter, lesbarer und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit, die interne Tabelle vorab zu deklarieren, was die Entwicklung beschleunigt und Fehler reduziert.
keywords: Internal Tables, SELECT, Database Access, sflights, Data Selection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Flugverbindungen aus `sflights`, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Verbindungsnummer enthält, und entfernen Sie Duplikate. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `CORRESPONDING` und eine interne Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_unique_conn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_connection_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_connection_key,
      tt_connection_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_connection_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_unique_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_connections) TYPE tt_connection_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_unique_conn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_connections.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_unique_connections = VALUE tt_connection_key(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_unique_conn( ).

    DATA(lt_unique_connections) = lo_cut->get_unique_connections( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_unique_connections msg = 'Should find unique connections' ).

    " Verify uniqueness by checking if the number of lines is less than or equal to the total flights
    DATA(lv_sflights_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO lv_sflights_count.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor und demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung, falls der Cursor nicht geöffnet werden kann oder das Fetchen fehlschlägt.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_fetch_flights RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_fetch_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX'. " Use non-existent CARRIER for demo
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_open_sql_error=>open_cursor_failed.
        ENDIF.

        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_flights UP TO 10 ROWS.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_open_sql_error=>fetch_cursor_failed.
        ENDIF.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Log error or handle it appropriately
        rv_success = abap_false.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor. " Ensure cursor is closed even on error
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Loop mit `REDUCE`, um die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` zu berechnen, die über einen Cursor abgerufen werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN CURSOR` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA(lv_cursor) = NEW cl_abap_db_cursor( ).

    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR SELECT * FROM sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN CURSOR lv_cursor
      NEXT total = total + <fs_flight>-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Funktion, die Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere kopiert, basierend auf übereinstimmenden Feldnamen, auch wenn die Strukturen unterschiedliche Typen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Komponenten beider Strukturen zu ermitteln, und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_d TYPE string, " Different field
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS copy_matching_fields IMPORTING is_source TYPE any
                                 CHANGING  cs_target TYPE any.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_matching_fields.
    DATA(lo_source_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_source ) ).
    DATA(lo_target_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( cs_target ) ).

    DATA(lt_source_components) = lo_source_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lt_target_components) = lo_target_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lt_source_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_comp>).
      READ TABLE lt_target_components WITH KEY name = <fs_source_comp>-name
        ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_comp>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Check if types are compatible (optional, but good practice)
        IF <fs_source_comp>-type->is_compatible( <fs_target_comp>-type ) OR
           <fs_source_comp>-type->is_convertible( <fs_target_comp>-type ).

          ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_source_comp>-name OF STRUCTURE is_source TO <fs_source_field>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_target_comp>-name OF STRUCTURE cs_target TO <fs_target_field>.

          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_copy_matching_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_matching_fields.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_rtti_generic_copy=>ty_source.
    ls_source-field_a = 'Source A'.
    ls_source-field_b = 100.
    ls_source-field_c = 'X'.

    DATA: ls_target TYPE zcl_rtti_generic_copy=>ty_target.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_b exp = 100 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Durch die dynamische Analyse der Strukturkomponenten und den Zugriff über `FIELD-SYMBOLS` kann eine flexible Mapping-Logik implementiert werden, die den Boilerplate-Code für manuelle Zuweisungen eliminiert und die Wartbarkeit verbessert.
