Instructions: Öffnen Sie zwei separate Cursor für verschiedene Tabellen (`SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR`) und verarbeiten Sie Daten aus beiden. Stellen Sie sicher, dass beide Cursor ordnungsgemäß geschlossen werden.
hint: Deklarieren Sie zwei separate `CURSOR` Variablen und schließen Sie beide.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_flight_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier.
    DATA: lv_cursor_flights TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor_carriers TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    DATA: ls_carrier TYPE scarr.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF scarr WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    " Open cursor for carriers first to build a lookup table
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor_carriers FOR SELECT * FROM scarr.
    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor_carriers INTO ls_carrier.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      INSERT ls_carrier INTO TABLE lt_carriers.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor_carriers.

    " Open cursor for flights
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor_flights FOR SELECT * FROM sflights.
    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor_flights INTO ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_flight_carrier(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
      ).
      READ TABLE lt_carriers INTO ls_carrier WITH KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_result-carrname = ls_carrier-carrname.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_flights_with_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_cursor_multi( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_data[1]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_data[1]-carrname ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung mehrerer Datenbank-Cursor gleichzeitig. Es zeigt, wie Daten aus zwei verschiedenen Tabellen (`SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR`) unabhängig voneinander abgerufen und dann kombiniert werden können. Dies ist nützlich für komplexe Datenintegrationsszenarien, bei denen Joins nicht optimal sind oder wenn Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen sequenziell verarbeitet werden müssen. Die korrekte Verwaltung und das Schließen beider Cursor sind hierbei entscheidend.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, Multiple Cursors, Database, Data Integration, SCARR

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object_reference)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_number RETURNING VALUE(rv_number) TYPE i.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method IMPORTING io_object     TYPE REF TO object
                                  iv_method_name TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_string.
    rv_string = 'Hello from dynamic method'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_number.
    rv_number = 42.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object RECEIVING parameter <fs_result>.
        rv_result = |{ <fs_result> }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_call_dynamic_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_method( ).

    DATA(lv_string_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = 'GET_STRING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_string_result exp = 'Hello from dynamic method' ).

    DATA(lv_number_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = 'GET_NUMBER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_number_result exp = '42' ).

    DATA(lv_invalid_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_invalid_result sub = 'Error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf in ABAP, eine fortgeschrittene RTTI-Funktionalität. Mit `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object_reference)` kann eine Methode zur Laufzeit anhand ihres Namens aufgerufen werden. Dies ist unerlässlich für Frameworks, Plugins oder generische Event-Handler, die auf unbekannte Methoden reagieren müssen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei wichtig.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Object Orientation, Reflection

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Extraktion grundlegender Metadaten (z.B. Dateigröße, Typ) aus einem Bild unter Verwendung einer konzeptionellen Image-Processor-Klasse.
hint: Stellen Sie sich eine Klasse wie CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR vor, die Methoden zur Bildanalyse bietet. Fokus liegt auf der Strukturierung des Codes mit Interfaces und Mocking.
solution:
" NOTE: CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR ist eine interne SAP-Klasse.
" Dieses Beispiel zeigt ein konzeptionelles Nutzungsmuster für eine solche Klasse
" und demonstriert moderne ABAP-Objektorientierungsprinzipien.

INTERFACE zif_image_metadata_provider.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_metadata,
           size TYPE i,
           type TYPE string,
           width TYPE i,
           height TYPE i,
         END OF ty_image_metadata.

  METHODS get_metadata
    IMPORTING
      iv_image_data TYPE xstring
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_metadata) TYPE ty_image_metadata.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_image_processor_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_image_metadata_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_processor_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_image_metadata_provider~get_metadata.
    " Simulieren der Bildverarbeitung und Metadatenextraktion
    " In einem realen Szenario würde CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR den xstring parsen
    " und tatsächliche Metadaten extrahieren.
    rs_metadata-size = xstrlen( iv_image_data ).
    IF iv_image_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Einfache Heuristik für den Typ, nicht robust
      IF iv_image_data(4) = '89504E47' THEN " PNG magic number
        rs_metadata-type = 'PNG'.
        rs_metadata-width = 100. " Mock-Wert
        rs_metadata-height = 50.  " Mock-Wert
      ELSEIF iv_image_data(3) = 'FFD8FF' THEN " JPEG magic number
        rs_metadata-type = 'JPEG'.
        rs_metadata-width = 200. " Mock-Wert
        rs_metadata-height = 150. " Mock-Wert
      ELSE.
        rs_metadata-type = 'UNKNOWN'.
        rs_metadata-width = 0.
        rs_metadata-height = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus SFLIGHT enthält, deren Flugpreis über 1000 liegt, und wandeln Sie die Fluggesellschaft in Großbuchstaben um.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem VALUE-Operator und einer WHERE-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
        ( carrier_id = to_upper( ls_flight-carrid )
          flight_num = ls_flight-connid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_min_price = 1000 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    " Prüfen, ob alle Preise > 1000 sind (indirekt, durch Überprüfung der Transformation)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_info-carrier_id exp = to_upper( ls_flight_info-carrier_id ) msg = 'Fluggesellschafts-ID sollte Großbuchstaben sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_min_price = 999999 ). " Sehr hoher Preis, sollte leer zurückgeben

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte für sehr hohen Preis leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck in Kombination mit VALUE ermöglicht die deklarative und kompakte Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen. Die WHERE-Klausel filtert die Quelldaten, und die Klammern () definieren die Struktur der neuen Zeilen. TO_UPPER ist eine moderne String-Funktion.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, WHERE, TO_UPPER, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT sum_price TYPE s_price = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier_id )
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( iv_carrier_id = 'LH' ). " Lufthansa

    " Angenommen, LH hat einige Flüge mit Preisen > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_total_price > 0 ) msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH sollte größer als Null sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_total_price_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( iv_carrier_id = 'XX' ). " Nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 0 msg = 'Gesamtpreis für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft sollte Null sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Die INIT-Klausel setzt den Startwert, und NEXT definiert die Iterationslogik.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_flight_status TYPE string.
    METHODS get_flight_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH ty_flight_status( iv_status_code
                       WHEN 'A' THEN 'Annulliert'

                       ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI-Klassen wie CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR und dynamische Methodenaufrufe mit CALL METHOD.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS _static_method_one
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS _static_method_two
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.
    DATA lo_instance TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        " Get class description
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).

        " Create instance of the class
        CREATE OBJECT lo_instance TYPE (iv_class_name).

        " Get method description
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

        " Prepare parameters if any
        IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
          ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Assuming parameter name
          ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing.
          GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
          APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
        ENDIF.

        " Prepare return value
        DATA lv_return_value TYPE string.
        GET REFERENCE OF lv_return_value INTO DATA(lr_return_value).
        APPEND VALUE abap_parmbind( name = 'RV_OUTPUT' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_returning value = lr_return_value ) TO lt_parameters.

        " Call method dynamically
        CALL METHOD (lo_instance)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

        rv_result = lv_return_value.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial INTO DATA(lx_ref_initial).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_ref_initial->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_illegal_method INTO DATA(lx_illegal_method).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_illegal_method->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _static_method_one.
    rv_output = |Method One called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _static_method_two.
    rv_output = |Method Two processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_one FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_two FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_invalid_method FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_invalid_class FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_one.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
                          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALL'
                          iv_method_name = '_STATIC_METHOD_ONE'
                          iv_param_value = 'Test Input 1'
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Method One called with: Test Input 1'
      msg = 'Dynamischer Aufruf von Methode Eins fehlgeschlagen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_two.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
                          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALL'
                          iv_method_name = '_STATIC_METHOD_TWO'
                          iv_param_value = 'Another Input'
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Method Two processed: Another Input'
      msg = 'Dynamischer Aufruf von Methode Zwei fehlgeschlagen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
                          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALL'
                          iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
                          iv_param_value = 'Dummy'
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result
      sub = 'Error'
      msg = 'Ungültiger Methodenaufruf sollte zu einem Fehler führen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_invalid_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
                          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
                          iv_method_name = '_STATIC_METHOD_ONE'
                          iv_param_value = 'Dummy'
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result
      sub = 'Error'
      msg = 'Ungültiger Klassenaufruf sollte zu einem Fehler führen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe ermöglichen es, den Namen einer aufzurufenden Methode oder sogar die Klasse selbst zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies wird oft in Frameworks oder generischen Verarbeitungsroutinen verwendet und nutzt ABAP RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CALL METHOD, CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR, Dynamic Call

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_key
        iv_carrier_id  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier_id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_itab_filter=>tt_flight_key.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '100' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier(
                          it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
                          iv_carrier_id  = 'LH'
                        ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 LH-Flüge finden' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Alle gefilterten Flüge sollten LH sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_itab_filter=>tt_flight_key.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '100' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier(
                          it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
                          iv_carrier_id  = 'UA'
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Sollte keine UA-Flüge finden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_empty_input.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_itab_filter=>tt_flight_key. " Leere Tabelle

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier(
                          it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
                          iv_carrier_id  = 'LH'
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Das Filtern einer leeren Tabelle sollte zu einer leeren Tabelle führen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, WHERE

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in eine interne Tabelle, wobei nur die Felder CARRIER_ID, CONNECTION_ID und FLIGHT_DATE in die korrespondierenden Felder der internen Tabelle übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ... UP TO N ROWS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data_subset,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data_subset.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data_subset.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO @iv_number_of_rows ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_5_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_zero_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_5_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_first_n_flights( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'Sollte genau 5 Flüge abrufen' ).
    " Prüfen, ob Felder gefüllt sind (z.B. carrid ist nicht initial)
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid msg = 'Fluggesellschafts-ID sollte nicht initial sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-connid msg = 'Verbindungs-ID sollte nicht initial sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-fldate msg = 'Flugdatum sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_zero_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_modern( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_first_n_flights( 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Das Abrufen von 0 Flügen sollte zu einer leeren Tabelle führen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Open SQL-Syntax mit INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE und dem Inline-Deklarationsoperator @ vereinfacht den Datenzugriff erheblich. UP TO N ROWS ist effizient, um nur eine begrenzte Anzahl von Datensätzen zu lesen, was die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessert.
keywords: Open SQL, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, UP TO N ROWS, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGE-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (Carrier IDs) und füllen Sie diese mit den Werten 'LH' und 'UA' unter Verwendung einer modernen FOR-Schleife und VALUE-Konstruktion.
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ) und die Struktur sign, option, low, high.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: ty_range_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_range RETURNING VALUE(rt_range) TYPE ty_range_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_range.
    rt_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrier IN VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = carrier )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_carrier_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_range )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 entries in the range table'
    ).

    DATA(ls_expected_lh) = VALUE zcl_range_for_value=>ty_range_line( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ).
    DATA(ls_expected_ua) = VALUE zcl_range_for_value=>ty_range_line( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_range[ low = 'LH' ]-high
      msg = 'High value for LH should be initial'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_range[ low = 'UA' ]-high
      msg = 'High value for UA should be initial'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_range[ low = 'LH' ]-sign

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (sflights) basierend auf einer RANGE-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator und die IN-Operation für RANGE-Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: ty_range_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
        it_carr_range TYPE ty_range_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid IN it_carr_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_dynamic_select( ).

    DATA(lt_carr_range) = VALUE zcl_range_dynamic_select=>ty_range_table(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )

    ).

      act = lines( lt_flights ) > 0

      msg = 'No flights from other carriers should be present'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur mit identischen Feldnamen, aber schließen Sie ein spezifisches Feld von der Übertragung aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie CORRESPONDING #( BASE ... EXCEPT ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_base_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE s_carr_id,
             field4 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_base_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      BASE ( field4 = 'Default Value' )
      is_source EXCEPT field3
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transfer_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transfer_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_base_except( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_base_except=>ty_source_data(
      field1 = 'Test String'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = 'LH'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->transfer_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field1
      exp = 'Test String'
      msg = 'Field1 should be transferred'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field2
      exp = 123
      msg = 'Field2 should be transferred'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_target-field3
      msg = 'Field3 should be initial (excepted)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field4
      exp = 'Default Value'
      msg = 'Field4 should have base value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: CORRESPONDING mit BASE und EXCEPT ermöglicht eine präzise und deklarative Datenübertragung zwischen Strukturen oder Tabellen. BASE setzt Initialwerte oder Standardwerte, während EXCEPT Felder von der automatischen Zuweisung ausschließt. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu MOVE-CORRESPONDING mit manueller Nachbearbeitung.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Transfer, BASE, EXCEPT, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei die Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind und explizit gemappt werden müssen.

CLASS zcl_corr_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #(

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Feldzuweisung zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, wobei die Mapping-Regeln zur Laufzeit definiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_abap_corresponding und die Methode add_mapping.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE s_carr_id,
             name   TYPE s_carrname,
             city_from TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             carrier_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrier_name TYPE s_carrname,
             departure_city TYPE s_city,
             timestamp    TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
        it_mapping_rules TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = is_source
      destination = rs_target
    ).

    LOOP AT it_mapping_rules INTO DATA(ls_rule).
      lo_corresponding->add_mapping(
        source_name      = ls_rule-source_name
        destination_name = ls_rule-destination_name
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_corresponding->execute(
      EXPORTING
        source      = is_source
      IMPORTING
        destination = rs_target
    ).

    rs_target-timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcl_sabp_dyn_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             name   TYPE s_carrname,

             departure_city TYPE s_city,
             status       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapping_rule,
             source_field      TYPE fieldname,
             target_field      TYPE fieldname,
           END OF ty_mapping_rule.

CLASS zcl_sabp_dyn_map IMPLEMENTATION.

        target_field = ls_rule-target_field )

    sabp_dyn_map=>map_structure(
      EXPORTING
        i_source_struct = is_source
        i_field_mapping = lt_field_mapping

Sie ist besonders nützlich, wenn Mapping-Regeln zur Laufzeit aus Konfigurationen oder Metadaten gelesen werden müssen, was die Wartbarkeit und Flexibilität erhöht.
keywords: SABP_DYN_MAP, Dynamic Mapping, Structures, Data Transfer, Modern ABAP
documentation_link: https://help.sap.com/doc/abapdocu_755_index_htm/7.55/en-US/abapcl_abap_corresponding.htm (SABP_DYN_MAP ist eine interne SAP-Klasse, die oft in ähnlichem Kontext wie cl_abap_corresponding verwendet wird, aber keine direkte öffentliche Dokumentation hat. Die Funktionalität ist jedoch vergleichbar mit dynamischem Corresponding.)

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei Sie eine Transformation auf ein Feld anwenden und gleichzeitig Felder ausschließen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie CORRESPONDING mit MAPPING und EXCEPT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             adjusted_price TYPE s_price,
             status     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      it_source MAPPING
        carrid   TO airline_id
        connid   TO flight_num
        price    TO adjusted_price
      EXCEPT currency
      USING
        adjusted_price = it_source-price * 1.10 " 10% Aufschlag
      BASE ( status = 'Transformed' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_transform=>ty_source_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_target )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 entries in target table'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-airline_id
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'First entry: carrid should map to airline_id'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-adjusted_price
      exp = '110.00'
      msg = 'First entry: price should be adjusted by 10%'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-currency
      msg = 'First entry: currency should be excluded'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 2 ]-status
      exp = 'Transformed'
      msg = 'Second entry: status should be set by BASE'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die USING-Klausel in CORRESPONDING ermöglicht es, Transformationen auf einzelne Felder während der Zuweisung anzuwenden. In Kombination mit MAPPING und EXCEPT bietet dies eine sehr mächtige und deklarative Syntax für komplexe Datenübertragungen und -transformationen zwischen internen Tabellen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, EXCEPT, USING, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Mapping-Tabelle zur Laufzeit und verwenden Sie diese mit CORRESPONDING, um Daten zwischen Strukturen zu übertragen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die dynamische MAPPING-Klausel mit einer internen Tabelle von Feldpaaren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_mapping_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE s_carr_id,
             name   TYPE s_carrname,
             city_from TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             carrier_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrier_name TYPE s_carrname,
             departure_city TYPE s_city,
             processed_by TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_pair,
             source_field TYPE fieldname,
             target_field TYPE fieldname,
           END OF ty_field_pair.
    TYPES: ty_field_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_with_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
        it_field_pairs TYPE ty_field_pairs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_mapping_tab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_dynamic_table.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      is_source MAPPING ( FOR ls_pair IN it_field_pairs
                           source_field = ls_pair-source_field
                           target_field = ls_pair-target_field ) 
      BASE ( processed_by = 'Dynamic Mapping' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_mapping_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_mapping_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_corr_mapping_tab( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_dyn_corr_mapping_tab=>ty_source_data(
      id        = 'LH'
      name      = 'Lufthansa'
      city_from = 'Frankfurt'
    ).

    DATA(lt_field_pairs) = VALUE zcl_dyn_corr_mapping_tab=>ty_field_pairs(
      ( source_field = 'ID'        target_field = 'CARRIER_ID' )
      ( source_field = 'NAME'      target_field = 'CARRIER_NAME' )
      ( source_field = 'CITY_FROM' target_field = 'DEPARTURE_CITY' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_with_dynamic_table(
      is_source      = ls_source
      it_field_pairs = lt_field_pairs
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-carrier_id
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'ID should be mapped to CARRIER_ID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-carrier_name
      exp = 'Lufthansa'
      msg = 'NAME should be mapped to CARRIER_NAME'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-departure_city
      exp = 'Frankfurt'
      msg = 'CITY_FROM should be mapped to DEPARTURE_CITY'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-processed_by
      exp = 'Dynamic Mapping'
      msg = 'Processed_by should be set by BASE'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.55 kann die MAPPING-Klausel von CORRESPONDING dynamisch mit einer internen Tabelle von Feldpaaren gefüllt werden. Dies bietet eine noch höhere Flexibilität als die statische MAPPING-Klausel und ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen die Mapping-Regeln vollständig zur Laufzeit generiert werden.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Dynamic Mapping, MAPPING (dynamic), Structures, Data Transfer, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Führen Sie eine tiefe (nested) Zuweisung von Daten zwischen Strukturen durch, die verschachtelte Tabellen enthalten, unter Verwendung von CORRESPONDING.
hint: CORRESPONDING unterstützt verschachtelte Strukturen und Tabellen automatisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_source,
             item_id TYPE i,
             item_desc TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_source.
    TYPES: ty_items_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_source,
             doc_id TYPE i,
             doc_date TYPE d,
             items TYPE ty_items_source,
           END OF ty_header_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_target,
             product_id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_target.
    TYPES: ty_items_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_target,
             document_id TYPE i,
             document_date TYPE d,
             products TYPE ty_items_target,
             created_by TYPE string,
           END OF ty_header_target.

    METHODS map_nested_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_header_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_header_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_nested_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      is_source MAPPING
        doc_id   TO document_id
        doc_date TO document_date
        items    TO products
      USING
        products = CORRESPONDING #( 
          is_source-items MAPPING
            item_id   TO product_id
            item_desc TO description
          BASE ( status = 'New' )
        )
      BASE ( created_by = 'System' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_nested_structure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_nested_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_nested( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_nested=>ty_header_source(
      doc_id = 100
      doc_date = sy-datum
      items = VALUE zcl_corr_nested=>ty_items_source(
        ( item_id = 10 item_desc = 'Laptop' )
        ( item_id = 20 item_desc = 'Mouse' )
      )
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_nested_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-document_id
      exp = 100
      msg = 'Document ID should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-document_date
      exp = sy-datum
      msg = 'Document Date should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( ls_target-products )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 products in target table'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-products[ 1 ]-product_id
      exp = 10
      msg = 'First product ID should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-products[ 2 ]-description
      exp = 'Mouse'
      msg = 'Second product description should be mapped'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-products[ 1 ]-status
      exp = 'New'
      msg = 'First product status should be set by BASE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-created_by
      exp = 'System'
      msg = 'Created_by should be set by BASE'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: CORRESPONDING unterstützt die tiefe Zuweisung von Daten, einschließlich verschachtelter Strukturen und interner Tabellen. Durch die rekursive Anwendung von CORRESPONDING innerhalb der USING-Klausel können komplexe Hierarchien in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck gemappt werden, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit erheblich verbessert.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Nested Structures, Internal Tables, Deep Copy, Data Transfer, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGE-Tabelle für Flugverbindungsnummern (Connection IDs) mit 'EQ' und 'BT' Optionen und verwenden Sie diese, um Flüge aus SFLIGHT zu filtern.
hint: Kombinieren Sie VALUE für die RANGE-Erstellung und FILTER für die Tabellenfilterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_eq_bt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE s_conn_id,
             high   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: ty_range_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_eq_bt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_by_connid.
    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE ty_range_table(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '0017' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0400' high = '0500' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE connid IN lt_connid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_connid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_eq_bt( ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_range_eq_bt=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0450' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0600' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0500' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights_by_connid( lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Expected 4 filtered flights (0017, 0400, 0450, 0500)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid
      exp = '0017'
      msg = 'First filtered flight should be 0017'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid
      exp = '0400'
      msg = 'Second filtered flight should be 0400'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 3 ]-connid
      exp = '0450'
      msg = 'Third filtered flight should be 0450'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 4 ]-connid
      exp = '0500'
      msg = 'Fourth filtered flight should be 0500'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige Quellstruktur in eine beliebige Zielstruktur dynamisch mappt, basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen, die identisch sein müssen.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_abap_corresponding mit der Option 'ALL FIELDS' und 'EXCEPT' dynamisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_dyn_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_generic_struct
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data
        ir_target_data TYPE REF TO data
        it_exclude_fields TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
      EXCEPTIONS
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial
        cx_sy_struct_comp_name
        cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_dyn_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_generic_struct.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_source> TYPE any,
                   <ls_target> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO <ls_source>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN ir_target_data->* TO <ls_target>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = <ls_source>
      destination = <ls_target>
    ).

    IF it_exclude_fields IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT it_exclude_fields INTO DATA(lv_field).
        lo_corresponding->add_exception(
          field_name = lv_field
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    lo_corresponding->execute(
      EXPORTING
        source      = <ls_source>
      IMPORTING
        destination = <ls_target>
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_mapping FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_generic_mapping_with_exclude FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_mapping.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_source,
            field_a TYPE string VALUE 'Value A',
            field_b TYPE i VALUE 123,
          END OF ls_source.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_target,
            field_a TYPE string,
            field_b TYPE i,
            field_c TYPE string,
          END OF ls_target.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_dyn_map( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->map_generic_struct(
          ir_source_data = REF #( ls_source )
          ir_target_data = REF #( ls_target )
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial cx_sy_struct_comp_name cx_sy_assign_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_a exp = 'Value A' msg = 'Field A should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_b exp = 123 msg = 'Field B should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_c msg = 'Field C should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generic_mapping_with_exclude.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_source,
            field_x TYPE string VALUE 'Exclude Me',
            field_y TYPE i VALUE 456,
          END OF ls_source.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_target,
            field_x TYPE string,
            field_y TYPE i,
          END OF ls_target.

    DATA(lt_exclude) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD_X' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_dyn_map( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->map_generic_struct(
          ir_source_data    = REF #( ls_source )
          ir_target_data    = REF #( ls_target )
          it_exclude_fields = lt_exclude
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial cx_sy_struct_comp_name cx_sy_assign_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_x msg = 'Field X should be excluded and initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_y exp = 456 msg = 'Field Y should be mapped' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese generische Methode nutzt cl_abap_corresponding, um Strukturen dynamisch zu mappen. Durch die Übergabe von Datenreferenzen und einer optionalen Liste von auszuschließenden Feldern kann die Methode flexibel für verschiedene Strukturtypen eingesetzt werden. Dies demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von RTTI und dynamischem Programming in modernem ABAP.
keywords: cl_abap_corresponding, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Generic Mapping, Data Transfer, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Zuweisung von Komponenten mit dynamischem Mapping durch, um eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine andere interne Tabelle zu übertragen, wobei ein Feld umbenannt und ein anderes Feld basierend auf einer Bedingung transformiert wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie CORRESPONDING mit MAPPING und einer bedingten Zuweisung in USING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_map_cond_trans DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES: ty_source_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_number TYPE s_conn_id,
             final_price TYPE s_price,
             occupancy_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES: ty_target_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_and_transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_source_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE ty_target_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_map_cond_trans IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_and_transform_flights.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( 
      it_source_flights MAPPING
        carrid   TO airline_id
        connid   TO flight_number
        price    TO final_price
      EXCEPT currency " Währung wird nicht direkt gemappt
      USING
        final_price = COND #( WHEN it_source_flights-currency = 'USD' THEN it_source_flights-price * 0.90 " 10% Rabatt für USD
                              ELSE it_source_flights-price )
        occupancy_status = COND #( WHEN it_source_flights-seatsocc > 80 THEN 'High'
                                   WHEN it_source_flights-seatsocc > 50 THEN 'Medium'
                                   ELSE 'Low' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_and_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_and_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_map_cond_trans( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_dyn_map_cond_trans=>ty_source_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 75 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 40 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_and_transform_flights( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 target flights' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'LH' msg = 'Flight 1: Airline ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-final_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Flight 1: Final Price (EUR)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-occupancy_status exp = 'Medium' msg = 'Flight 1: Occupancy Status' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-airline_id exp = 'UA' msg = 'Flight 2: Airline ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-final_price exp = '180.00' msg = 'Flight 2: Final Price (USD discounted)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-occupancy_status exp = 'High' msg = 'Flight 2: Occupancy Status' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-airline_id exp = 'AA' msg = 'Flight 3: Airline ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-final_price exp = '50.00' msg = 'Flight 3: Final Price (EUR)' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGE-Tabelle für Flugdaten (FLDATES) mit mehreren 'BT' (Between) Einträgen und verwenden Sie diese, um Flüge aus SFLIGHT zu filtern und die Ergebnisse zu reduzieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE für die RANGE-Erstellung, FILTER für die Tabellenfilterung und REDUCE für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE s_date,
             high   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: ty_range_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_date_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_date_ranges.
    DATA(lt_fldate_range) = VALUE ty_range_table(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '20250101' high = '20250105' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '20250110' high = '20250112' )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate IN lt_fldate_range )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_for_ranges FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_for_ranges.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_reduce( ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_range_reduce=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250106' price = '200.00' ) " Outside range
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250110' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0500' fldate = '20250111' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_date_ranges( lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price
      exp = '800.00'
      msg = 'Expected total price 100+150+250+300 = 800'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie cl_abap_corresponding, um eine interne Tabelle dynamisch in eine andere zu mappen, wobei die Zieltabelle eine zusätzliche Spalte enthält, die mit einem Standardwert gefüllt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie cl_abap_corresponding mit add_mapping und add_default_value.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_default_col DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id     TYPE s_carr_id,
             name   TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             carrier_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrier_name TYPE s_carrname,
             status       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_table_with_default
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_corr_default_col IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_table_with_default.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = it_source_table
      destination = rt_target_table
    ).

    lo_corresponding->add_mapping(
      source_name      = 'ID'
      destination_name = 'CARRIER_ID'
    ).
    lo_corresponding->add_mapping(
      source_name      = 'NAME'
      destination_name = 'CARRIER_NAME'
    ).
    lo_corresponding->add_default_value(
      field_name = 'STATUS'
      value      = 'Active'
    ).

    lo_corresponding->execute(
      EXPORTING
        source      = it_source_table
      IMPORTING
        destination = rt_target_table
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das verbleibende Budget, indem Sie eine Liste von Ausgaben von einem Startbudget subtrahieren.

CLASS zcl_budget_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_remaining_budget
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_budget TYPE i
        it_expenses       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_budget) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_budget_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(initial_budget) = 1000.
    DATA(expenses) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 100 ) ( 250 ) ( 50 ) ).
    DATA(remaining) = calculate_remaining_budget(
      iv_initial_budget = initial_budget
      it_expenses       = expenses
    ).
    out->write( |Verbleibendes Budget: { remaining }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_remaining_budget.
    DATA(total_expenses) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR expense IN it_expenses NEXT sum = sum + expense ).
    rv_remaining_budget = iv_initial_budget - total_expenses.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der noch verfügbaren Sitze für einen bestimmten Flug, indem Sie die gebuchten Sitze von der maximalen Kapazität subtrahieren. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `@DATA(...)` und `SUBTRACT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_seats_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_available_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_available_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_seats_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(carrier) = 'AA'.
    DATA(connection) = '0017'.
    DATA(flight_date) = '20251206'. " Use a date that might exist in sflights

    DATA(available_seats) = get_available_seats(
      iv_carrid = carrier
      iv_connid = connection
      iv_fldate = flight_date
    ).

    IF available_seats >= 0.
      out->write( |Für Flug { carrier } { connection } am { flight_date } sind { available_seats } Sitze verfügbar.| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Flug { carrier } { connection } am { flight_date } nicht gefunden oder Daten inkonsistent.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_available_seats.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_available_seats = ls_flight_data-seatsmax - ls_flight_data-seatsocc.
    ELSE.
      rv_available_seats = -1. " Indicate not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen Bonusbetrag von einem Gesamtbetrag, aber nur, wenn der Gesamtbetrag einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Verwenden Sie einen `COND`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_net_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_amount TYPE i
        iv_bonus_amount TYPE i
        iv_threshold    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_amount) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(total1) = 1000.
    DATA(bonus1) = 100.
    DATA(threshold1) = 500.
    DATA(net1) = calculate_net_amount( iv_total_amount = total1 iv_bonus_amount = bonus1 iv_threshold = threshold1 ).
    out->write( |Netto-Betrag 1: { net1 } (Erwartet: 900)| ).

    DATA(total2) = 400.
    DATA(bonus2) = 50.
    DATA(threshold2) = 500.
    DATA(net2) = calculate_net_amount( iv_total_amount = total2 iv_bonus_amount = bonus2 iv_threshold = threshold2 ).
    out->write( |Netto-Betrag 2: { net2 } (Erwartet: 400)| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_net_amount.
    rv_net_amount = COND #(
      WHEN iv_total_amount > iv_threshold
      THEN iv_total_amount - iv_bonus_amount
      ELSE iv_total_amount
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, in der von jedem Wert einer Quelltabelle ein fester Betrag subtrahiert wird.

CLASS zcl_table_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS subtract_from_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_subtract_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_values) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(source_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 100 ) ( 200 ) ( 300 ) ).
    DATA(subtract_val) = 25.
    DATA(result_values) = subtract_from_table(
      it_source_values = source_values
      iv_subtract_value = subtract_val
    ).
    out->write( |Original: { source_values }| ).
    out->write( |Subtrahiert um { subtract_val }: { result_values }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract_from_table.
    rt_result_values = VALUE #(
      FOR value IN it_source_values
      ( value - iv_subtract_value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine Tabelle mit Posten, die jeweils eine Kategorie und einen Wert haben. Gruppieren Sie die Posten nach Kategorie und subtrahieren Sie vom Wert jedes Postens innerhalb einer Gruppe den minimalen Wert dieser Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für den Minimalwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        category TYPE string,
        value    TYPE i,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items_by_group
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE ty_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(items) = VALUE ty_items(
      ( category = 'A' value = 100 )
      ( category = 'B' value = 200 )
      ( category = 'A' value = 150 )
      ( category = 'C' value = 50  )
      ( category = 'B' value = 220 )
      ( category = 'A' value = 120 )
    ).
    DATA(processed_items) = process_items_by_group( items ).
    out->write( |Original Items:| ).
    out->write( items ).
    out->write( |Processed Items (Value - Min_Group_Value):| ).
    out->write( processed_items ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_items_by_group.
    rt_processed_items = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF item IN it_items GROUP BY ( category = item-category )
      (
        LET min_value = REDUCE i( INIT m = item-value FOR member IN GROUP item NEXT m = nmin( m, member-value ) ) IN
        FOR member IN GROUP item
        ( category = member-category value = member-value - min_value )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Subtraktion durch, die zu einem negativen Ergebnis führen könnte, und fangen Sie den Fehler ab, um eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung zurückzugeben, anstatt einen Dump zu verursachen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `MESSAGE INTO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS safe_subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand1 TYPE i
        iv_operand2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_subtract_with_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand1 TYPE i
        iv_operand2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(op1) = 10.
    DATA(op2) = 20.
    TRY.
        DATA(result) = safe_subtract( iv_operand1 = op1 iv_operand2 = op2 ).
        out->write( |Ergebnis: { result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        out->write( |Fehler (safe_subtract): { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(result_msg) = safe_subtract_with_message( iv_operand1 = op1 iv_operand2 = op2 ).
    out->write( |Ergebnis (safe_subtract_with_message): { result_msg }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_subtract.
    rv_result = iv_operand1 - iv_operand2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_subtract_with_message.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_operand1 - iv_operand2.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        MESSAGE e001(sy) WITH iv_operand1 iv_operand2 INTO DATA(lv_message).
        rv_result = 0. " Oder ein anderer Standardwert
        " In einem realen Szenario würde man hier den Fehler loggen oder anders behandeln
        out->write( |Fehler bei Subtraktion: { lv_message }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: ty_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_subtract
      IMPORTING
        it_source_values TYPE ty_values
        iv_threshold     TYPE i
        iv_subtract_val  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_values) TYPE ty_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(source_values) = VALUE ty_values( ( 10 ) ( 25 ) ( 5 ) ( 40 ) ( 15 ) ).
    DATA(threshold) = 20.
    DATA(subtract_val) = 5.
    DATA(result_values) = filter_and_subtract(
      it_source_values = source_values
      iv_threshold     = threshold
      iv_subtract_val  = subtract_val
    ).
    out->write( |Original: { source_values }| ).
    out->write( |Gefiltert (> { threshold }) und subtrahiert um { subtract_val }: { result_values }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_and_subtract.
    rt_result_values = VALUE #(
      FOR value IN FILTER ty_values( it_source_values WHERE table_line > iv_threshold )
      ( value - iv_subtract_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Basiszahl verwaltet und Methoden zum Hinzufügen und Subtrahieren von Werten bereitstellt, wobei die Methoden verkettet werden können (Method Chaining).
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden die Instanz des Objekts (`ME`) zurück.

CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.

    METHODS subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(calculator) = NEW zcl_chainable_calculator( 100 ).

    DATA(final_result) = calculator->add( 50 )->subtract( 20 )->add( 10 )->get_result( ).

    out->write( |Verkettetes Ergebnis: { final_result } (Erwartet: 140)| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value - iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS subtract_numeric_strings
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_str1 TYPE string
        iv_num_str2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(str1) = '150'.
    DATA(str2) = '75'.
    DATA(result) = subtract_numeric_strings( iv_num_str1 = str1 iv_num_str2 = str2 ).
    out->write( |Ergebnis der Subtraktion von '{ str1 }' und '{ str2 }': { result }| ).

    DATA(str3) = '200'.
    DATA(str4) = '300'.
    DATA(result2) = subtract_numeric_strings( iv_num_str1 = str3 iv_num_str2 = str4 ).
    out->write( |Ergebnis der Subtraktion von '{ str3 }' und '{ str4 }': { result2 }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract_numeric_strings.
    DATA(lv_num1) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_num2) TYPE i.
    TRY.
        lv_num1 = iv_num_str1.
        lv_num2 = iv_num_str2.
        DATA(lv_diff) = lv_num1 - lv_num2.
        rv_result_str = |{ lv_diff }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_result_str = |Fehler: Ungültige numerische Zeichenkette!|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result_str = |Fehler: Arithmetischer Überlauf/Unterlauf!|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Subtraktion auf einem Feld einer dynamisch übergebenen Struktur durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und den dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id    TYPE string,
        value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_data.

    METHODS subtract_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_subtract_val TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_data( id = 'A' value = 100 ).
    DATA(lr_data) = CAST data( REF #( ls_data ) ).

    out->write( |Vor Subtraktion: ID='{ ls_data-id }', Value={ ls_data-value }| ).

    subtract_dynamic( ir_data = lr_data iv_component = 'VALUE' iv_subtract_val = 25 ).

    out->write( |Nach Subtraktion: ID='{ ls_data-id }', Value={ ls_data-value }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: Data reference invalid
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: Component not found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if component is numeric
    IF <fs_component> IS SUPPLIED AND <fs_component> IS NUMERIC.
      <fs_component> = <fs_component> - iv_subtract_val.
    ELSE.
      " Handle error: Component is not numeric or not supplied
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Restbetrag nach einer Reihe von Abzügen von einem Startwert.

CLASS zcl_chained_subtractions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_final_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_amount TYPE i
        it_deductions     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_amount) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_subtractions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(initial) = 500.
    DATA(deductions) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 50 ) ( 20 ) ( 100 ) ).
    DATA(final) = calculate_final_amount( iv_initial_amount = initial it_deductions = deductions ).
    out->write( |Startbetrag: { initial }, Abzüge: { deductions }, Endbetrag: { final }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_final_amount.
    rv_final_amount = iv_initial_amount.
    LOOP AT it_deductions INTO DATA(deduction).
      rv_final_amount = rv_final_amount - deduction.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_percentage_decrease DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_decrease_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE decfloat34
        iv_final_value   TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_percentage) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_percentage_decrease IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(initial) = 200.0.
    DATA(final) = 150.0.
    DATA(percentage) = calculate_decrease_percentage( iv_initial_value = initial iv_final_value = final ).
    out->write( |Rückgang von { initial } auf { final }: { percentage }%| ).

    DATA(initial2) = 100.0.
    DATA(final2) = 100.0.
    DATA(percentage2) = calculate_decrease_percentage( iv_initial_value = initial2 iv_final_value = final2 ).
    out->write( |Rückgang von { initial2 } auf { final2 }: { percentage2 }%| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_decrease_percentage.
    IF iv_initial_value = 0.
      rv_percentage = 0. " Oder Fehlerbehandlung
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(difference) = iv_initial_value - iv_final_value.
    rv_percentage = ( difference / iv_initial_value ) * 100.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den höchsten Flugpreis (PRICE) in der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Flugverbindung (CONNID) unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutze die `REDUCE`-Expression mit dem `MAX`-Operator, um den höchsten Wert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0
                             FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                             NEXT max_p = nmax( max_p, flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = '00000000001111.00' msg = 'Max price for LH 0400 should be 1111.00' ).

    lv_max_price = lo_cut->get_max_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = '00000000000422.00' msg = 'Max price for AA 0017 should be 422.00' ).

    lv_max_price = lo_cut->get_max_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ). " Non-existent flight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = 0 msg = 'Max price for non-existent flight should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
