Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, die ausgewählte Profilparameternamen und deren Werte enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_values()` und den `VALUE` Operator zum Konstruieren einer Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_spf_param_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_entry,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param_entry.
    TYPES: tt_param_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_param_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY name.

    CLASS-METHODS get_selected_params_map
      IMPORTING
        it_param_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_param_map) TYPE tt_param_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_spf_param_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_selected_params_map.
    DATA(lt_all_params) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_values( ).

    rt_param_map = VALUE #( FOR ls_req_name IN it_param_names
                            LET ls_param = VALUE #( lt_all_params[ name = ls_req_name ] OPTIONAL )
                            IN
                            COND #( WHEN ls_param IS NOT INITIAL
                                    THEN ( name = ls_param-name value = ls_param-value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_param_map) = zcl_spf_param_to_map=>get_selected_params_map( lt_requested_params ).

CLASS zcl_spf_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_metadata,
             name        TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
             default_val TYPE string,
             is_dynamic  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_param_metadata.
    TYPES: tt_param_metadata TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_metadata WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_dynamic_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_params) TYPE tt_param_metadata.

CLASS zcl_spf_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_params.
    DATA(lt_all_metadata) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_metadata( ).

    rt_dynamic_params = VALUE #( FOR ls_meta IN lt_all_metadata
                                 WHERE ( dynamic = 'X' )
                                 ( name        = ls_meta-name
                                   description = ls_meta-description
                                   default_val = ls_meta-default_value
                                   is_dynamic  = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Namen aller öffentlichen Attribute einer gegebenen ABAP-Klasse mithilfe der XCO Library.
hint: Nutzen Sie `XCO_CP_ABAP_REPOSITORY=>CLASS` und filtern Sie die Attribute nach Sichtbarkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_read_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_attribute_names
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE xco_ar_object_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attribute_names) TYPE xco_t_ar_object_names
      RAISING
        cx_xco_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_read_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_attribute_names.
    DATA(lo_class) = xco_cp_abap_repository=>class( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lo_class_content) = lo_class->content( ).
    DATA(lo_attributes) = lo_class_content->attributes( ).

    LOOP AT lo_attributes->all( )->get_objects( ) INTO DATA(lo_attribute).
      DATA(ls_attribute_properties) = lo_attribute->content( )->get_properties( ).
      IF ls_attribute_properties-visibility = xco_cp_abap_repository=>attribute->visibility->public.
        APPEND ls_attribute_properties-name TO rt_attribute_names.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_list_interface_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_interface_method_names.
    DATA(lo_interface) = xco_cp_abap_repository=>interface( iv_interface_name ).
    DATA(lo_interface_content) = lo_interface->content( ).
    DATA(lo_methods) = lo_interface_content->methods( ).

    LOOP AT lo_methods->all( )->get_objects( ) INTO DATA(lo_method).
      DATA(ls_method_properties) = lo_method->content( )->get_properties( ).
      APPEND ls_method_properties-name TO rt_method_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen dividiert und eine Division durch Null abfängt. Falls eine Division durch Null versucht wird, soll eine allgemeine arithmetische Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'An arithmetic error occurred.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_err_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_divider->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_err_divide( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
    ).
    lo_divider->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung, insbesondere bei kritischen Operationen wie der Division. `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ist eine spezifische Ausnahme für die Division durch Null, die hier abgefangen und in eine allgemeinere `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR` umgewandelt wird, um die Schnittstelle sauber zu halten.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, EXCEPTION, NUMBER, DIVISION, ERROR HANDLING

CLASS zcl_err_message_excp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_message_fault.

CLASS zcl_err_message_excp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      MESSAGE 'Negative values are not allowed' TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_message_fault.
    ELSEIF iv_value = 0.
      MESSAGE 'Value cannot be zero' TYPE 'W' RAISING cx_sy_message_fault.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'Data processed successfully'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die mehrere potenzielle Fehlerquellen (z.B. Division durch Null und ungültige Indexzugriffe auf eine interne Tabelle) in verschachtelten `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcken behandelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um spezifische Fehler auf verschiedenen Ebenen abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_nested_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_array_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
        it_data        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_index       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error,
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_nested_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_array_division.
    DATA lv_temp_result TYPE i.
    DATA lv_array_value TYPE i.

    TRY. " Outer TRY for array access
        READ TABLE it_data INDEX iv_index INTO lv_array_value.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Index out of bounds or line not found.'.
        ENDIF.

        TRY. " Inner TRY for division
            lv_temp_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
            rv_result = lv_temp_result * lv_array_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
              EXPORTING
                text = 'Division by zero occurred.'.
        ENDTRY.

      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Error accessing array: ' && cx_sy_itab_line_not_found->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Error during arithmetic operation: ' && cx_sy_arithmetic_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung eines `FINALLY`-Blocks, um sicherzustellen, dass eine Aufräumaktion (z.B. das Schließen einer Ressource) immer ausgeführt wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_finally DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_finally IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA lv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_local_log TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        lv_local_log = 'Resource opened.'.

        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Simulated error during operation.'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_local_log = lv_local_log && ' Operation successful.'.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        lv_local_log = lv_local_log && ' Error caught: ' && lx_error->get_text( ).

      FINALLY.
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          lv_local_log = lv_local_log && ' Resource closed.'.
          lv_resource_open = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.

    rv_log = lv_local_log.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operation_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_with_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_success.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_err_finally( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_handler->perform_operation( iv_trigger_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_log exp = 'Resource opened. Operation successful. Resource closed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_with_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_err_finally( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_handler->perform_operation( iv_trigger_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource opened.' act = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error caught: Simulated error during operation.' act = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource closed.' act = lv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FINALLY`-Block in einer `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur garantiert, dass der darin enthaltene Code immer ausgeführt wird, unabhängig davon, ob im `TRY`-Block eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht. Dies ist ideal für Aufräumaktionen wie das Schließen von Datenbankverbindungen oder Dateihandles.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, FINALLY, EXCEPTION, ERROR HANDLING, RESOURCE MANAGEMENT

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Tabelle mit Materialbeständen. Subtrahieren Sie von jedem Bestand einen festen Wert, aber nur, wenn der Bestand größer als der Wert ist. Nutzen Sie moderne Tabellenverarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` oder `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stock_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_stock_item,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_stock_item.
    TYPES: tt_stock_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_stock_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS subtract_from_stock
      IMPORTING
        it_stock_in TYPE tt_stock_items
        iv_deduct   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stock_out) TYPE tt_stock_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stock_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_stock.
    rt_stock_out = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_stock_in
                              ( material = ls_item-material
                                quantity = COND #( WHEN ls_item-quantity > iv_deduct THEN ls_item-quantity - iv_deduct ELSE ls_item-quantity ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_subtract_stock FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_subtract_stock.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stock_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_stock) = VALUE zcl_stock_subtract=>tt_stock_items(
      ( material = 'MAT1' quantity = 100 )
      ( material = 'MAT2' quantity = 10 )
      ( material = 'MAT3' quantity = 50 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_deduction) = 20.

    DATA(lt_expected_stock) = VALUE zcl_stock_subtract=>tt_stock_items(
      ( material = 'MAT1' quantity = 80 )
      ( material = 'MAT2' quantity = 10 )
      ( material = 'MAT3' quantity = 30 )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_stock exp = lt_expected_stock msg = 'Stock subtraction with condition failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... ( ... ) )` mit einem `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich moderner und lesbarer als eine klassische `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` Schleife mit `IF` und `MODIFY`.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den verbleibenden Gesamtbestand eines Materials, indem Sie alle Entnahmen von einem Startbestand subtrahieren. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `SUBTRACT` Operator in der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_quantities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_stock
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_stock TYPE i
        it_withdrawals   TYPE tt_quantities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_stock) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_stock.
    rv_remaining_stock = REDUCE i(
      INIT r = iv_initial_stock
      FOR withdrawal IN it_withdrawals
      NEXT r = r - withdrawal
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_remaining_stock FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remaining_stock.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_subtract( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_stock) = 100.
    DATA(lt_withdrawals) = VALUE zcl_reduce_subtract=>tt_quantities(
      ( 10 )
      ( 20 )
      ( 5 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_stock) = 65. " 100 - 10 - 20 - 5 = 65

    DATA(lv_remaining_stock) = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_stock( iv_initial_stock = lv_initial_stock it_withdrawals = lt_withdrawals ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining_stock exp = lv_expected_stock msg = 'Remaining stock calculation with REDUCE failed' ).

    " Test with empty withdrawals
    lv_remaining_stock = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_stock( iv_initial_stock = 50 it_withdrawals = VALUE zcl_reduce_subtract=>tt_quantities( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining_stock exp = 50 msg = 'Remaining stock with empty withdrawals failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature des modernen ABAP, das es ermöglicht, Werte aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. In diesem Beispiel wird der `SUBTRACT` Operator innerhalb des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks verwendet, um den verbleibenden Bestand deklarativ und kompakt zu berechnen, was zu sehr lesbarem und wartbarem Code führt.
keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtere eine interne Tabelle von simulierten ArchiveLink-Verbindungsdaten, um alle Einträge für ein bestimmtes Business-Objekt zu finden, unter Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken.
hint: Nutze die Syntax itab[ field = value ] oder itab[ KEY primary_key_name COMPONENTS field = value ].
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alink_connection,
             object_type TYPE string,
             object_id   TYPE string,
             doc_id      TYPE string,
             repository  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_alink_connection.
    TYPES tt_alink_connection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alink_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_alink_data_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS filter_connections
          IMPORTING
            it_all_connections TYPE tt_alink_connection
            iv_object_type     TYPE string
            iv_object_id       TYPE string
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_filtered_connections) TYPE tt_alink_connection.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_alink_data_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD filter_connections.
        rt_filtered_connections = FILTER #( it_all_connections USING KEY primary_key
                                            WHERE object_type = iv_object_type AND
                                                  object_id = iv_object_id ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_connections.
    DATA: lt_connections TYPE tt_alink_connection.
    APPEND VALUE ty_alink_connection( object_type = 'BUS2032' object_id = 'ORDER1' doc_id = 'DOC001' repository = 'A1' ) TO lt_connections.
    APPEND VALUE ty_alink_connection( object_type = 'BUS2032' object_id = 'ORDER2' doc_id = 'DOC002' repository = 'A1' ) TO lt_connections.
    APPEND VALUE ty_alink_connection( object_type = 'BUS2032' object_id = 'ORDER1' doc_id = 'DOC003' repository = 'A2' ) TO lt_connections.
    APPEND VALUE ty_alink_connection( object_type = 'BUS1001' object_id = 'MAT001' doc_id = 'DOC004' repository = 'A1' ) TO lt_connections.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_alink_data_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_connections(
      it_all_connections = lt_connections
      iv_object_type     = 'BUS2032'
      iv_object_id       = 'ORDER1'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Verbindungen für BUS2032/ORDER1 gefunden werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-doc_id
      exp = 'DOC001'
      msg = 'Erste Doc ID sollte DOC001 sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-doc_id
      exp = 'DOC003'
      msg = 'Zweite Doc ID sollte DOC003 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      msg = 'Antwort mit Standardparametern ist nicht korrekt.'
    ).

    " Test mit benutzerdefinierten Werten
    DATA(lv_response_custom) = lo_caller->call_service(
      iv_service_name = 'UpdateData'
      iv_payload      = '<data><value>ABC</value></data>'
      iv_timeout      = 120
      iv_log_level    = 'DEBUG'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_response_custom
      exp = 'Service ''UpdateData'' called with payload ''<data><value>ABC</value></data>''. Timeout: 120s, Log Level: DEBUG'
      msg = 'Antwort mit benutzerdefinierten Parametern ist nicht korrekt.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Optionale Parameter mit DEFAULT-Werten in Methodensignaturen sind eine moderne ABAP-Funktion, die die Flexibilität von Methodenaufrufen erhöht und die Notwendigkeit von Überladungen oder komplexen Parameterstrukturen reduziert. Sie verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: SAOP, Optional Parameters, DEFAULT, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstelle eine komplexe Datenstruktur für eine simulierte SAOP-Anfrage unter Verwendung des VALUE-Operators.
hint: Nutze die Syntax DATA(ls_data) = VALUE type(...) zur Initialisierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_saop_header,

    CLASS zcl_saop_request_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD build_request.
        rs_request = VALUE ty_saop_request(
          header = VALUE ty_saop_header(

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_request.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE tt_saop_items.
    APPEND VALUE ty_saop_item( item_id = 'P100' quantity = 2 unit = 'PC' ) TO lt_items.

explanation: Der VALUE-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Konstrukt in modernem ABAP, um Datenstrukturen (Strukturen und interne Tabellen) kompakt und lesbar zu initialisieren. Er reduziert die Notwendigkeit temporärer Variablen und verbessert die Ausdruckskraft des Codes.
keywords: SAOP, VALUE, Data Handling, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Definiere ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine klassenbasierte Ausnahme auslösen kann, und implementiere eine Klasse, die diese Ausnahme fängt.
hint: Verwende RAISING cx_static_check und TRY...CATCH.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document_validator.
  METHODS validate_document
    IMPORTING
      iv_document_id TYPE string
    RAISING
      cx_static_check.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcx_document_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_document_id TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_document_id TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_document_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    mv_document_id = iv_document_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document_validator.
    METHODS process_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_document_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document_validator~validate_document.
    IF iv_document_id IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_document_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_document_error=>default_text
          iv_document_id = iv_document_id.
    ENDIF.
    " Weitere Validierungslogik
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_document.
    TRY.
        zif_document_validator~validate_document( iv_document_id ).
        rv_status = 'Validierung erfolgreich'.
      CATCH zcx_document_error INTO DATA(lx_doc_error).
        rv_status = |Validierung fehlgeschlagen für Dokument '{ lx_doc_error->mv_document_id }': { lx_doc_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_status = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_document FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_document FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_document.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_document_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_checker->process_document( 'DOC_VALID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 'Validierung erfolgreich'
      msg = 'Gültiges Dokument sollte erfolgreich validiert werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_document.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_document_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_checker->process_document( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 'Validierung fehlgeschlagen'
      msg = 'Ungültiges Dokument sollte einen Fehlerstatus zurückgeben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Klassenbasierte Ausnahmen sind der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen eine strukturierte und typsichere Fehlerbehandlung, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes gegenüber der alten SY-SUBRC-Prüfung erheblich verbessert. Interfaces können definieren, welche Ausnahmen ihre Methoden auslösen können.
keywords: INTERFACE, Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, Class-Based Exceptions

Instructions: Implementiere eine Klasse, die ein Interface für eine konfigurierbare Operation verwendet und Methoden-Chaining ermöglicht.
hint: Methoden, die Chaining ermöglichen sollen, müssen eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (ME) zurückgeben.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_configurable_operation.
  METHODS set_parameter1
    IMPORTING
      iv_param TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zif_configurable_operation.
  METHODS set_parameter2
    IMPORTING
      iv_param TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zif_configurable_operation.
  METHODS execute_operation
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_operation_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_configurable_operation.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_configurable_operation~set_parameter1.
    mv_param1 = iv_param.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_configurable_operation~set_parameter2.
    mv_param2 = iv_param.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_configurable_operation~execute_operation.
    rv_result = |Operation executed with Param1: '{ mv_param1 }', Param2: '{ mv_param2 }'|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_operation_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->zif_configurable_operation~set_parameter1( 'ValueA' )->set_parameter2( 'ValueB' )->execute_operation( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Operation executed with Param1: ''ValueA'', Param2: ''ValueB'''
      msg = 'Method Chaining hat nicht das erwartete Ergebnis geliefert.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methoden-Chaining ermöglicht eine flüssigere und lesbarere Syntax, indem Methoden eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz zurückgeben. Dies ist ein Designmuster, das oft in Builder-Pattern oder Fluent Interfaces verwendet wird und die Konfigurierbarkeit von Objekten verbessert. Interfaces stellen sicher, dass die Chaining-Fähigkeit vertraglich zugesichert ist.
keywords: INTERFACE, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Object Orientation

Instructions: Bestimme dynamisch einen SAOP-Endpunkt basierend auf einem Systemparameter oder einer Umgebungsvariable unter Verwendung des COND-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutze die Syntax DATA(lv_endpoint) = COND string( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_saop_endpoint_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS resolve_endpoint
      IMPORTING
        iv_system_env TYPE string " Z.B. 'DEV', 'QAS', 'PRD'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_endpoint_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_saop_endpoint_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD resolve_endpoint.
    rv_endpoint_url = COND string(
      WHEN iv_system_env = 'DEV' THEN 'https://dev.saop.example.com/service'
      WHEN iv_system_env = 'QAS' THEN 'https://qas.saop.example.com/service'
      WHEN iv_system_env = 'PRD' THEN 'https://prd.saop.example.com/service'
      ELSE 'https://default.saop.example.com/service' " Fallback
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der COND-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu IF-ELSEIF-ELSE-Konstrukten für einfache Zuweisungen und verbessert die Ausdruckskraft des Codes, insbesondere wenn ein Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen bestimmt werden muss.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Docking Container am linken Bildschirmrand und platzieren Sie ein Textfeld (CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT) darin. Zeigen Sie den Container und das Textfeld an.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER und CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT. Achten Sie auf die PBO-Verarbeitung und das SET SCREEN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dock_text_edit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_text_edit.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_text_edit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_text_edit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_text_edit.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid                       = sy-repid
          dynnr                       = sy-dynnr
          side                        = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension                   = 200
          caption                     = 'Text Editor'
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error                  = 1
          cntl_system_error           = 2
          create_error                = 3
          lifetime_error              = 4
          lifetime_dynpro_dynpro_link = 5
          OTHERS                      = 6.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating docking container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating text edit' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( 'Hello, modern ABAP!' ).

      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_text_edit FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_text_edit.
    " This unit test can only verify the instantiation, not the visual display.
    " For GUI controls, manual inspection is often required.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dock_text_edit( ).
    lo_cut->display_text_edit( ).
    " Assertions for GUI controls are tricky without a dedicated GUI testing framework.
    " We can at least assert that no dump occurred during creation.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur during GUI control creation' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Erstellung eines CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER und das Einbetten eines CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Steuerelements. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (DATA(lo_cut)) und die Kapselung in einer Klasse sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken. Die GUI-Steuerelemente werden auf einem Dynpro (hier 100) angezeigt, das im PBO-Ereignis verarbeitet wird.
keywords: GUI, Docking Container, Text Edit, CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER, CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container und ändern Sie dessen Größe dynamisch nach der Initialisierung. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Breite des Containers anpasst.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `set_extension` des Docking Containers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dock_resize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_repid TYPE syrepid i_dynnr TYPE sydynnr.
    METHODS display_container.
    METHODS resize_container IMPORTING i_new_extension TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_repid TYPE syrepid.
    DATA mv_dynnr TYPE sydynnr.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_text_edit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_resize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_repid = i_repid.
    mv_dynnr = i_dynnr.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_container.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = mv_repid
          dynnr     = mv_dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension = 150
          caption   = 'Resizable Panel'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS    = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating docking container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating text edit' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.
      mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( 'Initial width: 150' ).

      CALL SCREEN mv_dynnr.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD resize_container.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      mo_docking_container->set_extension( i_new_extension ).
      mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( |New width: { i_new_extension }| ).
      cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Ensure GUI update
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resize_container FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resize_container.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = '100'. " Dummy dynpro number for test
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dock_resize( i_repid = lv_repid i_dynnr = lv_dynnr ).
    lo_cut->display_container( ).

    " Simulate resizing
    lo_cut->resize_container( 300 ).
    " Again, direct GUI assertion is not possible. Verify no error.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur during resize' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Größe eines Docking Containers zur Laufzeit geändert werden kann. Die Methode `set_extension` wird verwendet, um die Breite anzupassen. `cl_gui_cfw=>flush()` ist wichtig, um die GUI-Änderungen sofort sichtbar zu machen. Die Verwendung eines Konstruktors zur Übergabe von Dynpro-Informationen ist eine saubere Kapselung.
keywords: GUI, Docking Container, Resize, Dynamic, CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER, SET_EXTENSION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container mit einem Button. Implementieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für den Button-Klick, um eine Nachricht anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_BUTTON und registrieren Sie ein Ereignis für den Klick.

CLASS zcl_dock_button_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_button_panel.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_button TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_button_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_button_panel.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_top
          extension = 50
          caption   = 'Button Panel'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS    = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating docking container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_button
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container
          text   = 'Click Me!'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating button' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_button.

      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    MESSAGE 'Button was clicked!' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_button_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_button_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dock_button_event( ).
    lo_cut->display_button_panel( ).
    " Event handling for GUI controls cannot be directly tested in ABAP Unit.
    " The test primarily ensures object creation without errors.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur during button creation and event registration' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Ereignisbehandlung für einen Button, der in einem Docking Container platziert ist. Die Methode `SET HANDLER` registriert die lokale Methode `handle_button_click` für das `click`-Ereignis des Buttons. Dies ist ein Standardmuster für die Interaktion mit GUI-Steuerelementen in ABAP.
keywords: GUI, Docking Container, Button, Event Handling, CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER, CL_GUI_BUTTON, SET HANDLER

Instructions: Integrieren Sie ein ALV Grid (CL_GUI_ALV_GRID) in einen Docking Container. Zeigen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS an.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_ALV_GRID und füllen Sie den Feldkatalog sowie die Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dock_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_in_dock.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_in_dock.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
          extension = 300
          caption   = 'Flight Data'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS    = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating docking container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
        EXPORTING
          i_parent = mo_docking_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS   = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV grid' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE mt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = mt_sflights
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS           = 1 ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error setting ALV table' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_alv_in_dock FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_in_dock.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dock_alv( ).
    lo_cut->display_alv_in_dock( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur during ALV grid creation' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine sehr häufige Anwendung von Docking Containern: die Integration eines ALV Grids. Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS werden in das ALV geladen und angezeigt. Die Verwendung von `SET TABLE FOR FIRST DISPLAY` mit `I_STRUCTURE_NAME` ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, den Feldkatalog automatisch zu generieren. Inline-Deklarationen und die Kapselung in einer Klasse sind hier ebenfalls Standard.
keywords: GUI, Docking Container, ALV Grid, SFLIGHTS, CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER, CL_GUI_ALV_GRID

Instructions: Erstellen Sie verschachtelte Docking Container: einen Hauptcontainer und einen weiteren, der innerhalb des Hauptcontainers angedockt ist. Zeigen Sie in jedem Container einen einfachen Text an.
hint: Der innere Container muss den äußeren als Parent haben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dock_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dock_nested IMPLEMENTATION.

      mo_text_main->set_text_as_stream( 'Content of Main Container' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container und implementieren Sie eine Methode, um dessen Sichtbarkeit dynamisch umzuschalten (anzeigen/ausblenden).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `set_visible` und `set_invisible` des Docking Containers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dock_visibility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_repid TYPE syrepid i_dynnr TYPE sydynnr.
    METHODS display_toggle_panel.
    METHODS toggle_visibility.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_repid TYPE syrepid.
    DATA mv_dynnr TYPE sydynnr.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_text_edit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mv_is_visible TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_visibility IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_repid = i_repid.
    mv_dynnr = i_dynnr.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_toggle_panel.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = mv_repid
          dynnr     = mv_dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension = 250
          caption   = 'Toggle Panel'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS    = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating docking container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating text edit' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.
      mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( 'This panel can be toggled.' ).

      CALL SCREEN mv_dynnr.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD toggle_visibility.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      IF mv_is_visible = abap_true.
        mo_docking_container->set_invisible( ).
        mv_is_visible = abap_false.
        mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( 'Panel is now hidden.' ).
      ELSE.
        mo_docking_container->set_visible( ).
        mv_is_visible = abap_true.
        mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( 'Panel is now visible.' ).
      ENDIF.
      cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_toggle_visibility FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_toggle_visibility.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = '100'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dock_visibility( i_repid = lv_repid i_dynnr = lv_dynnr ).
    lo_cut->display_toggle_panel( ).

    lo_cut->toggle_visibility( ). " Hide
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur when hiding' ).

    lo_cut->toggle_visibility( ). " Show
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur when showing' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Sichtbarkeit eines Docking Containers zur Laufzeit mit den Methoden `set_visible` und `set_invisible` umgeschaltet werden kann. Dies ist nützlich, um dynamische Benutzeroberflächen zu erstellen, bei denen Panels je nach Benutzerinteraktion ein- oder ausgeblendet werden. `cl_gui_cfw=>flush()` ist entscheidend für die sofortige Aktualisierung der GUI.
keywords: GUI, Docking Container, Visibility, Toggle, CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER, SET_VISIBLE, SET_INVISIBLE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container und verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES, um zu überprüfen, ob der Container gültig ist und seinen Parent-Container zu ermitteln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `is_valid_container` und `get_parent_container` von CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_container_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_container_info.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_text_edit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_container_info.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension = 200
          caption   = 'Utility Test'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS    = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating docking container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating text edit' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_is_valid) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>is_valid_container( mo_docking_container ).
      DATA(lo_parent) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>get_parent_container( mo_docking_container ).

      DATA(lv_output) = |
        Container Valid: { COND #( WHEN lv_is_valid = abap_true THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' ) }
        Parent Container: { COND #( WHEN lo_parent IS BOUND THEN 'Found' ELSE 'None' ) }
      |.
      mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( lv_output ).

      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_container_utilities FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_container_utilities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_container_utils( ).
    lo_cut->check_container_info( ).

    " After creation, the container should be valid.
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>is_valid_container( lo_cut->mo_docking_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true msg = 'Container should be valid' ).

    " For a top-level docking container, the parent should be the screen container (which is not a CL_GUI_CONTAINER object directly).
    " So, get_parent_container should return initial for a top-level docking container.
    DATA(lo_parent) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>get_parent_container( lo_cut->mo_docking_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_parent msg = 'Top-level docking container should have no CL_GUI_CONTAINER parent' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung der Utility-Klasse CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES. `is_valid_container` prüft, ob ein GUI-Container-Objekt gültig ist, während `get_parent_container` den übergeordneten Container zurückgibt. Dies ist nützlich für die Validierung und Navigation in komplexen GUI-Hierarchien. Die Verwendung von String-Templates für die Ausgabe ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: GUI, Utilities, Container, Validation, Parent, CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES, IS_VALID_CONTAINER, GET_PARENT_CONTAINER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container, der einen Splitter Container (CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER) enthält, um zwei Bereiche dynamisch aufzuteilen. Platzieren Sie in jedem Bereich einen Text.
hint: Der Splitter Container wird als Child des Docking Containers erstellt und verwaltet dann seine eigenen Children.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dock_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_splitter_panel.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_splitter_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_text_top TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_text_bottom TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_splitter_panel.
    IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
        EXPORTING
          repid     = sy-repid
          dynnr     = sy-dynnr
          side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
          extension = 400
          caption   = 'Splitter Panel'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS    = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating docking container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter_container
        EXPORTING
          parent  = mo_docking_container
          rows    = 2
          columns = 1
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS  = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating splitter container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.

      " Get top and bottom sub-containers from splitter
      DATA(lo_top_container) = mo_splitter_container->get_container( row = 1 col = 1 ).
      DATA(lo_bottom_container) = mo_splitter_container->get_container( row = 2 col = 1 ).

      CREATE OBJECT mo_text_top
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_top_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating top text edit' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.
      mo_text_top->set_text_as_stream( 'Content of Top Splitter Area' ).

      CREATE OBJECT mo_text_bottom
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_bottom_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating bottom text edit' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.
      mo_text_bottom->set_text_as_stream( 'Content of Bottom Splitter Area' ).

      CALL SCREEN 100.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dock_splitter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dock_splitter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dock_splitter( ).
    lo_cut->display_splitter_panel( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur during splitter creation' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Integration eines CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER in einen CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER. Der Splitter Container ermöglicht die dynamische Aufteilung eines Bereichs in mehrere Unterbereiche, die der Benutzer zur Laufzeit anpassen kann. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Layout-Muster für komplexe GUIs. Die Verwendung von `get_container` zur Abfrage der Untercontainer ist hierbei zentral.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container und implementieren Sie eine Funktion, um den angezeigten Inhalt dynamisch zwischen einem Textfeld und einem HTML Viewer zu wechseln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `free` für das alte Steuerelement und erstellen Sie ein neues im selben Parent-Container.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dock_dynamic_content DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_repid TYPE syrepid i_dynnr TYPE sydynnr. METHODS display_dynamic_panel. METHODS switch_content IMPORTING i_content_type TYPE string. PRIVATE SECTION. DATA mv_repid TYPE syrepid. DATA mv_dynnr TYPE sydynnr. DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container. DATA mo_current_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_dock_dynamic_content IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD constructor. mv_repid = i_repid. mv_dynnr = i_dynnr. ENDMETHOD. METHOD display_dynamic_panel. IF mo_docking_container IS INITIAL. CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container EXPORTING repid = mv_repid dynnr = mv_dynnr side = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left extension = 350 caption = 'Dynamic Content' EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating docking container' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF. " Initial content: Text Edit switch_content( 'TEXT' ). CALL SCREEN mv_dynnr. ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. METHOD switch_content. IF mo_docking_container IS NOT BOUND. RETURN. ENDIF. " Free existing control if any IF mo_current_control IS BOUND. mo_current_control->free( ). CLEAR mo_current_control. cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). ENDIF. CASE i_content_type. WHEN 'TEXT'. DATA(lo_text_edit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = mo_docking_container ). lo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( 'This is a text editor.' ). mo_current_control = lo_text_edit. WHEN 'HTML'. DATA(lo_html_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_html_viewer( parent = mo_docking_container ). lo_html_viewer->load_data( EXPORTING url = 'about:blank' IMPORTING assigned_url = DATA(lv_url) ). lo_html_viewer->show_data( EXPORTING url = lv_url html_data = '

HTML Content

This is an HTML viewer.

' ). mo_current_control = lo_html_viewer. WHEN OTHERS. MESSAGE 'Invalid content type' TYPE 'E'. RETURN. ENDCASE. cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_content_switch FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_content_switch.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = '100'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dock_dynamic_content( i_repid = lv_repid i_dynnr = lv_dynnr ).
    lo_cut->display_dynamic_panel( ).

    lo_cut->switch_content( 'HTML' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur when switching to HTML' ).

    lo_cut->switch_content( 'TEXT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump should occur when switching to TEXT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der Inhalt eines Docking Containers zur Laufzeit dynamisch ausgetauscht werden kann. Das alte Steuerelement wird mit `free()` freigegeben und ein neues Steuerelement im selben Parent-Container erstellt. Dies ermöglicht hochflexible Benutzeroberflächen, bei denen der angezeigte Inhalt je nach Kontext oder Benutzeraktion vollständig geändert werden kann. Die Verwendung von `NEW` für die Objekterstellung und `DATA()` für Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne ABAP-Features.
keywords: GUI, Docking Container, Dynamic Content, Switch, CL_GUI_DOCKING_CONTAINER, CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT, CL_GUI_HTML_VIEWER, FREE

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. aus SFLIGHT) in ein JSON-Format.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `/UI2/CL_JSON` und ihre Methode `SERIALIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 3 ROWS.

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data   = lt_sflights
        pretty = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json   = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_json
      msg = 'JSON string should not be initial'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_json
      exp = 'CARRID'
      msg = 'JSON string should contain CARRID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_json
      exp = 'LH' " Assuming some SFLIGHT data exists
      msg = 'JSON string should contain some flight data'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `/UI2/CL_JSON` bietet eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, ABAP-Datenstrukturen (interne Tabellen, Strukturen, einfache Typen) in JSON zu serialisieren. CLASS zcl_fe_upload_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS upload_file_to_app_server
      IMPORTING
        iv_frontend_path TYPE string
        iv_app_server_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fe_upload_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_file_to_app_server.
    DATA lt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_frontend_path
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_error         = 1
        file_read_error         = 2
        no_batch                = 3
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 4
        invalid_type            = 5
        no_authority            = 6
        unknown_error           = 7
        bad_data_format         = 8
        cntl_error              = 9
        error_no_gui            = 10
        OTHERS                  = 11
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN DATASET iv_app_server_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_file_content INTO DATA(lv_line).
      TRANSFER lv_line TO iv_app_server_path.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_app_server_path.
    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fe_download_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_file_to_frontend
      IMPORTING
        iv_app_server_path TYPE string
        iv_frontend_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.

CLASS zcl_fe_download_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_file_to_frontend.
    DATA lt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    OPEN DATASET iv_app_server_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_app_server_path INTO DATA(lv_line).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_line TO lt_file_content.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_app_server_path.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_frontend_path
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_write_error        = 1
        no_batch                = 2
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
        invalid_type            = 4
        no_authority            = 5
        unknown_error           = 6
        bad_data_format         = 7
        cntl_error              = 8
        error_no_gui            = 9
        OTHERS                  = 10
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.
    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    IF sy-subrc = 0.

    TRY.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String mit Flugdaten und filtern Sie direkt beim Deserialisieren alle Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Wert liegt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die Daten zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_and_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_and_filter.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = iv_json_string
      CHANGING
        data = lt_all_sflights
    ).

    rt_filtered_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price ) ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"CARRID":"LH","CONNID":"0400","FLDATE":"2025-12-06","PRICE":100.00,"CURRENCY":"EUR"}, {"CARRID":"AA","CONNID":"0010","FLDATE":"2025-12-07","PRICE":250.50,"CURRENCY":"USD"}, {"CARRID":"BA","CONNID":"0100","FLDATE":"2025-12-08","PRICE":80.00,"CURRENCY":"GBP"}]`.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->deserialize_and_filter(
      iv_json_string = lv_json
      iv_min_price   = 150.00
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Should contain 1 filtered flight'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_sflight-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'Filtered flight should be AA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `/UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck kann man Daten nach dem Deserialisieren sofort filtern. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Iteration und Filterung von internen Tabellen, was den Code lesbarer und effizienter macht.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten und gruppieren Sie diese anschließend nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in einer JSON-Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE` gefolgt von einem `GROUP BY` Ausdruck und erneuter Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_grouped_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA lt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = iv_json_string
      CHANGING
        data = lt_all_sflights
    ).

    DATA(lt_grouped_by_carrid) = VALUE tt_grouped_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                 flights = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR member IN GROUP ( member ) ) ) )
    ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data   = lt_grouped_by_carrid
        pretty = abap_true
      RECEIVING
        json   = rv_grouped_json
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lv_grouped_json) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrid( lv_json ).

    ).

CLASS zcl_file_read_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_content) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_file_read_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file.
    DATA: lv_file_content TYPE string.
    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_text_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_filename = iv_file_path
          IMPORTING
            e_file_content = lv_file_content
        ).
        rt_content = VALUE #( FOR <line> IN cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = lv_file_content sep = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) ( <line> ) ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie mehrere Zeilen Text in eine Datei.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_cts_language_file_io=>write_text_file` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_write_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS write_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        it_content   TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_write_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_file.
    DATA(lv_file_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT text = ``
      FOR <line> IN it_content
      NEXT text = COND string( WHEN text IS INITIAL THEN <line> ELSE text && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <line> )
    ).
    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>write_text_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_filename = iv_file_path
            i_file_content = lv_file_content
        ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_write_file FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mv_temp_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE DATASET mv_temp_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_write_file.
    mv_temp_file_path = cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_temp_directory( ) && '/test_file_write.txt'.
    DATA(lt_content) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( 'World' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_write_text( ).
    lo_cut->write_file(
      iv_file_path = mv_temp_file_path
      it_content   = lt_content
    ).

    DATA(lv_read_content) = ``.
    OPEN DATASET mv_temp_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    READ DATASET mv_temp_file_path INTO lv_read_content.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_temp_file_path.

    DATA(lt_read_lines) = VALUE string_table( FOR <line> IN cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = lv_read_content sep = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) ( <line> ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_read_lines ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_lines[1] exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_lines[2] exp = 'World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_file_check_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_info,
             exists TYPE abap_bool,
             size   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_file_info.

      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_file_info) TYPE ty_file_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_check_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_file_status.
    rs_file_info-exists = abap_false.
    rs_file_info-size = 0.

    IF cl_cts_language_file_io=>file_exists( i_filename = iv_file_path ) EQ abap_true.
      rs_file_info-exists = abap_true.
      TRY.
          rs_file_info-size = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_size( i_filename = iv_file_path ).
        CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
          " Handle error, e.g., file exists but size cannot be determined
          MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine CSV-ähnliche Datei und parsen Sie die Daten in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_text_file`, `SPLIT` und den `MAP` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_read_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_and_parse_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_read_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_parse_csv.
    DATA: lv_file_content TYPE string.
    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_text_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_filename = iv_file_path
          IMPORTING
            e_file_content = lv_file_content
        ).

        " Skip header and process each line
        rt_sflight_data = VALUE #(
          FOR <line> IN cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = lv_file_content sep = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf )
          WHERE ( sy-tabix > 1 AND table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) " Skip header line
          LET parts = cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = <line> sep = ',' ) IN
          (
            carrid = parts[1]
            connid = CONV s_conn_id( parts[2] )
            fldate = CONV s_date( parts[3] )
          )
        ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_and_parse_csv FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.

    DATA mv_temp_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mv_temp_file_path = cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_temp_directory( ) && '/test_sflight.csv'.
    DATA(lv_content) = 'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                       'LH,0400,20250101' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                       'AA,0017,20250102'.
    OPEN DATASET mv_temp_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER lv_content TO mv_temp_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_temp_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE DATASET mv_temp_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_and_parse_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_read_csv( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->read_and_parse_csv( mv_temp_file_path ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-fldate exp = '20250102' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es nutzt `cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_text_file` zum Lesen, `cl_abap_string_utilities=>split` zum Aufteilen von Zeilen und Feldern und den `FOR` Operator mit `LET` für die Inline-Verarbeitung und Zuweisung der geparsten Werte. Instructions: Versuchen Sie, eine nicht existierende Datei zu lesen und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zu generieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_text_file` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks und `cx_static_check`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check. " Re-raise for demonstration in test
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_text_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_filename = iv_file_path
          IMPORTING
            e_file_content = rv_content
        ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Log the error or provide a user-friendly message
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING previous = lx_error. " Re-raise for testability
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_non_existent_file FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_non_existent_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_non_existent_file) = cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_temp_directory( ) && '/definitely_not_here.txt'.

    " Expecting an exception when trying to read a non-existent file
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_exception_class_name = 'CX_STATIC_CHECK'
        i_test_method_name     = 'TEST_READ_NON_EXISTENT_FILE'
        i_cut_class_name       = 'ZCL_FILE_ERROR_HANDLING'
        i_cut_method_name      = 'READ_FILE_WITH_ERROR_HANDLING'
        i_parameters           = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_FILE_PATH' value = lv_non_existent_file ) )
    ).
    " The actual call that should raise the exception
    lo_cut->read_file_with_error_handling( lv_non_existent_file ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Umgang mit Dateisystemoperationen ist eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung unerlässlich. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man `cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_text_file` in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block verwendet, um Ausnahmen wie `cx_static_check` abzufangen, die auftreten, wenn eine Datei nicht gefunden wird oder andere Dateisystemfehler auftreten. Dies ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Reaktion auf Fehler.
keywords: File, Read, Error Handling, Exception, cl_cts_language_file_io, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Spalten, die den Primärschlüssel der Tabelle `sflights` bilden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_db_sys=>get_table_columns()` und filtern Sie nach dem `is_primary_key` Attribut mit dem `FILTER` Operator.

CLASS zcl_db_primary_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_primary_key_columns
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_pk_columns) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_db_primary_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_primary_key_columns.
    DATA(lt_db_columns) = cl_db_sys=>get_table_columns( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    rt_pk_columns = VALUE #( FILTER #( lt_db_columns USING KEY primary_key WHERE is_primary_key = abap_true )

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Substrings in einem Text durch einen anderen Substring. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
        iv_old_substring TYPE string
        iv_new_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_text.
    rv_result_text = iv_original_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_substring IN rv_result_text WITH iv_new_substring.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_simple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_text( iv_original_text = 'Hello World, Hello ABAP' iv_old_substring = 'Hello' iv_new_substring = 'Hi' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hi World, Hi ABAP' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_text( iv_original_text = 'NoMatch' iv_old_substring = 'abc' iv_new_substring = 'xyz' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'NoMatch' ).

explanation: Der `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Operator ist eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, Substrings zu ersetzen. In Kombination mit der Inline-Deklaration und der direkten Zuweisung ist der Code sehr kompakt und lesbar.
