Instructions: Ermöglichen Sie einem Benutzer das Hochladen einer XLSX-Datei und lesen Sie deren Inhalt in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx`, um die hochgeladenen Binärdaten zu parsen. Für den Unit-Test simulieren Sie die Binärdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_import_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_upload,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_upload.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_upload TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_upload WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS import_xlsx_data IMPORTING iv_xlsx_xstring TYPE xstring
                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight_upload.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_import_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD import_xlsx_data.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).

    TRY.
        lo_xlsx->parse_file( iv_xlsx_xstring ).
        DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ). " Get first sheet

        DATA(lv_row) = 2. " Assuming header in row 1
        DATA(lv_max_row) = lo_sheet->get_max_row( ).

        LOOP FROM lv_row TO lv_max_row.
          DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_sflight_upload(
            carrid = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 )->get_value_as_string( )
            connid = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 )->get_value_as_string( )
            fldate = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 )->get_value_as_string( )
            price  = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 )->get_value_as_string( )
          ).
          APPEND ls_data TO rt_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx INTO DATA(lx_xlsx).
        MESSAGE lx_xlsx->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_formulas IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_xlsx_with_formulas.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflights_data( ).
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flüge mit Formeln' ).

        " Add header row
        DATA(lv_col) = 1.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = 'Price' ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = 'Discount' ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = 'Final Price (Formula)' ).

        " Add data rows and a dummy discount column
        DATA(lv_row) = 2.
        LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
          lv_col = 1.
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = <fs_sflight>-carrid ).
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = <fs_sflight>-connid ).
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = <fs_sflight>-price ).
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col++ ip_value = 10 ). " Dummy discount

          " Add formula: E = C - D (Price - Discount)
          lo_sheet->set_cell_formula( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col++ ip_formula = |C{ lv_row }-D{ lv_row }| ).
          lv_row++.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_xlsx_file_as_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx INTO DATA(lx_xlsx).
        MESSAGE lx_xlsx->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE rt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP POST Handler, der einen JSON-Payload mit einer Liste von Flugdaten (z.B. Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) empfängt. Der Handler soll die Daten verarbeiten (z.B. Flugnummern in Großbuchstaben umwandeln) und die modifizierten Daten als JSON-Antwort zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `server->request->get_cdata()` für den Payload, `cl_abap_json=>deserialize` zum Parsen und `cl_abap_json=>serialize` für die Antwort. Für die Datenstruktur können Sie eine lokale Klasse verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_post_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_post_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA: lv_json_payload TYPE string,
          lt_flights_in   TYPE tt_flight_data,
          lt_flights_out  TYPE tt_flight_data.

    lv_json_payload = server->request->get_cdata( ).

    TRY.
        cl_abap_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_json_payload
            pretty_mode = abap_true
          CHANGING
            data        = lt_flights_in
        ).

        lt_flights_out = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_flights_in ( 
                                    carrid   = to_upper( flight-carrid ),
                                    connid   = flight-connid,
                                    cityfrom = flight-cityfrom,
                                    cityto   = flight-cityto
                                  ) ).

        DATA(lv_json_response) = cl_abap_json=>serialize(
                                    EXPORTING
                                      data        = lt_flights_out
                                      pretty_mode = abap_true
                                  ).

        server->response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
        server->response->set_cdata( lv_json_response ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        server->response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
        server->response->set_cdata( |Error processing JSON: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP GET Handler, der zwei numerische URL-Parameter 'zahl1' und 'zahl2' empfängt. Der Handler soll die Summe der beiden Zahlen zurückgeben. Wenn ein Parameter fehlt oder ungültig ist, soll ein Standardwert von 0 verwendet werden. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Parameterverarbeitung und die bedingte Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_server->request->get_form_field` und `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Standardwertzuweisung und Typkonvertierung.

CLASS zcl_http_param_calc_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_param_calc_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_dividend_str) = server->request->get_form_field( 'zahl1' ).
    DATA(lv_divisor_str)  = server->request->get_form_field( 'zahl2' ).

    DATA(lv_zahl1) = COND i( WHEN lv_dividend_str IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_dividend_str CO '0123456789' THEN CONV i( lv_dividend_str ) ELSE 0 ).
    DATA(lv_zahl2) = COND i( WHEN lv_divisor_str IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_divisor_str CO '0123456789' THEN CONV i( lv_divisor_str ) ELSE 0 ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lv_zahl1 + lv_zahl2.

    server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( |Die Summe ist: { lv_sum }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP GET Handler, der eine Division durchführt. Wenn der Divisor (URL-Parameter 'divisor') 0 ist, soll ein HTTP 400 Bad Request Statuscode und eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurückgegeben werden. Andernfalls soll das Ergebnis der Division zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Division und `server->response->set_status` für den HTTP-Statuscode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_dividend_str) = server->request->get_form_field( 'dividend' ).
    DATA(lv_divisor_str)  = server->request->get_form_field( 'divisor' ).

    DATA(lv_dividend) = COND i( WHEN lv_dividend_str IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_dividend_str CO '0123456789' THEN CONV i( lv_dividend_str ) ELSE 0 ).
    DATA(lv_divisor)  = COND i( WHEN lv_divisor_str IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_divisor_str CO '0123456789' THEN CONV i( lv_divisor_str ) ELSE 0 ).

    IF lv_divisor = 0.
      server->response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
      server->response->set_cdata( 'Fehler: Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' ).
      server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lv_dividend / lv_divisor.
        server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
        server->response->set_cdata( |Das Ergebnis ist: { lv_result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        server->response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
        server->response->set_cdata( |Ein arithmetischer Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING #` Anweisung ist die moderne und prägnante Art, Felder zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit gleichen Namen zu kopieren. Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle mit Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) in eine andere interne Tabelle, die eine Teilmenge der Felder enthält und zusätzlich ein neues Feld 'FLIGHT_DESCRIPTION' hat, das aus den Quelldaten abgeleitet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um die Transformation zeilenweise durchzuführen und das neue Feld zu befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_itab_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             flight_description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_reduced) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_itab_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights.
    rt_sflights_reduced = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight )
                                     flight_description = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }|
                                   ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_map_sflights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-mandt = sy-mandt.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price = '123.45'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0010'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum + 1.
    ls_sflight-price = '500.00'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_corr_itab_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_reduced) = lo_mapper->map_sflights( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_reduced ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two entries expected.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_reduced INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_reduced1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_reduced1-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrid should be mapped.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_reduced1-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Connid should be mapped.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_reduced1-price exp = '123.45' msg = 'Price should be mapped.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_reduced1-flight_description exp = |Flug LH 0400 am { sy-datum DATE = ISO }| msg = 'Description should be derived.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_reduced INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_reduced2).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine andere mit `CORRESPONDING #` innerhalb eines `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Ausdrucks. Dies ermöglicht eine zeilenweise Verarbeitung und die gleichzeitige Befüllung von Feldern, die nicht direkt aus der Quelle kopiert werden, wie hier das `flight_description` Feld mittels String Templates. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Tabellentransformation.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Mapping, Data Transformation, VALUE, FOR, String Templates, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Felder von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Dabei sollen bestimmte Felder explizit ausgeschlossen (`EXCEPT`) und andere Felder umbenannt (`MAPPING`) werden.

    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source EXCEPT status MAPPING id = item_id name = item_name value = amount ).

explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING #` Anweisung mit den Zusätzen `EXCEPT` und `MAPPING` bietet eine sehr flexible Möglichkeit zur Feldzuweisung. `EXCEPT` schließt Felder von der automatischen Zuweisung aus, während `MAPPING` es erlaubt, Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zuzuordnen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn Quell- und Zielstrukturen ähnliche, aber nicht identische Feldnamen haben oder wenn bestimmte Felder bewusst nicht kopiert werden sollen.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer tiefen Quellstruktur, die eine Kopfdatenstruktur und eine interne Tabelle von Positionsdaten enthält, in eine tiefe Zielstruktur. Die Feldnamen können teilweise abweichen, und es sollen auch Felder in der geschachtelten Tabelle gemappt werden.

CLASS zcl_corr_deep_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             item_id TYPE i,

             menge   TYPE menge_d,
           END OF ty_item_source.

             doc_id   TYPE i,
             doc_date TYPE d,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_deep_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Feldzuweisung zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, bei der die Mapping-Regeln zur Laufzeit definiert werden. Dies soll mit der Klasse `cl_abap_corresponding` erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `create` und `execute` der Klasse `cl_abap_corresponding` und übergeben Sie eine dynamische Mapping-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_dynamic_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_id   TYPE i,
             target_name TYPE string,
             target_value TYPE decfloat16,
             additional_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
        it_mapping_rules TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_dynamic_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
                                 source      = is_source
                                 destination = rs_target
                                 mapping     = it_mapping_rules
                             ).
    lo_corresponding->execute(
      EXPORTING
        source      = is_source
      CHANGING
        destination = rs_target
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_corresponding` ermöglicht eine vollständig dynamische Feldzuweisung zur Laufzeit. Anstatt die `CORRESPONDING #` Anweisung direkt im Code zu verwenden, wird ein Objekt der Klasse erstellt und eine interne Tabelle mit den Mapping-Regeln übergeben. Dies ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen die Mapping-Logik flexibel sein muss, z.B. basierend auf Konfigurationseinstellungen oder Metadaten. Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie grundlegende Operationen (Einfügen, Lesen, Ändern, Löschen) auf einer Hashed Table.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE`, `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY`, `MODIFY TABLE`, `DELETE TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.

    METHODS update_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_new_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS delete_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_all_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_hashed_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE ty_hashed_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    DATA(ls_new_entry) = VALUE ty_data( id = iv_id text = iv_text ).
    INSERT ls_new_entry INTO TABLE mt_data.
    rv_success = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_entry.
    READ TABLE mt_data WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_id INTO rs_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_entry.
    DATA(ls_update_entry) = VALUE ty_data( id = iv_id text = iv_new_text ).
    MODIFY TABLE mt_data FROM ls_update_entry.
    rv_success = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_entry.
    DELETE TABLE mt_data WHERE id = iv_id.
    rv_success = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_entries.
    rt_data = mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_all_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_all_operations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_ops( ).
    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_hashed_table_ops=>ty_data.
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_hashed_table_ops=>ty_hashed_table.

    " Add entry
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Add entry 1' act = lo_cut->add_entry( id = 1 text = 'First' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Add entry 2' act = lo_cut->add_entry( id = 2 text = 'Second' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Add duplicate entry' act = lo_cut->add_entry( id = 1 text = 'Duplicate' ) ). " Should fail due to unique key

    lt_data = lo_cut->get_all_entries( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Initial count' act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).

    " Get entry
    ls_data = lo_cut->get_entry( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Get entry 1 ID' act = ls_data-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Get entry 1 Text' act = ls_data-text exp = 'First' ).

    " Update entry
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Update entry 1' act = lo_cut->update_entry( id = 1 new_text = 'Updated First' ) ).
    ls_data = lo_cut->get_entry( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Updated entry 1 Text' act = ls_data-text exp = 'Updated First' ).

    " Delete entry
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Delete entry 2' act = lo_cut->delete_entry( 2 ) ).
    lt_data = lo_cut->get_all_entries( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count after delete' act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 1 ).
    ls_data = lo_cut->get_entry( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Deleted entry not found' act = ls_data-id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegenden Operationen auf einer Hashed Table. Hashed Tables bieten einen sehr schnellen Zugriff auf Einträge über ihren Schlüssel, unabhängig von der Tabellengröße. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von Strukturen und `COND` für die kompakte Zuweisung von Booleans sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, INSERT, READ TABLE, MODIFY TABLE, DELETE TABLE, VALUE, COND, Object Orientation

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie eine Hashed Table mit Daten unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flights_hashed_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_initialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_initialization.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_initial_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of entries' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_flight) = lt_flights[ KEY carrid connid fldate = 'LH' '0400' '20251201' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight LH 0400 20251201 price' act = ls_flight-price exp = '100.00' ).

    " Test for non-existent entry
    TRY.
        ls_flight = lt_flights[ KEY carrid connid fldate = 'LH' '0400' '20251203' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Access to non-existent entry should raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Exception caught for non-existent entry' act = abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung von internen Tabellen, einschließlich Hashed Tables. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Wartbarkeit. Der Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen über den Schlüssel mit `lt_flights[ KEY ... ]` ist ebenfalls eine moderne und effiziente Methode.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Hashed Table basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_original USING KEY primary_key WHERE field = value )`.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_flights_hashed_table
      RETURNING

      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights_data.
    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie eine Summe oder einen Durchschnitt aus einer Hashed Table unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0 FOR <line> IN lt_hashed_table NEXT s = s + <line>-value )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights_hashed_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_flights_hashed_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights_data.
    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflights_data( ).

    " Ensure sflight has data for testing
    IF lines( lt_all_flights ) = 0.
      " Insert dummy data if sflight is empty for test purposes
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING PADDING.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING PADDING.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING PADDING.
      COMMIT WORK.
      lt_all_flights = lo_cut->get_sflights_data( ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Initial flights should not be empty' act = lines( lt_all_flights ) ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_all_flights ).
    " Expected total price based on dummy data: 100 + 120 + 250 = 470
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Calculated total price' act = lv_total exp = '470.00' ).

    " Test with an empty table
    DATA lt_empty_flights TYPE zcl_hashed_table_reduce=>ty_flights_hashed_table.
    DATA(lv_empty_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for empty table' act = lv_empty_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Zeilen iteriert und einen Akkumulator aktualisiert. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr ausdrucksstarke Art, solche Operationen durchzuführen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining für ein fluides API-Design.
hint: Geben Sie `ME` von Methoden zurück, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.

    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.

    METHODS build
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_result.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             value1 TYPE i,
             value2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_result.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    rs_result = VALUE #( value1 = mv_value1 value2 = mv_value2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_builder( ).

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_builder->set_value1( 10 )
                               ->set_value2( 'Hello' )
                               ->build( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value1 check' act = ls_result-value1 exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value2 check' act = ls_result-value2 exp = 'Hello' ).

    DATA(ls_result2) = NEW zcl_fluent_builder( )->set_value2( 'World' )->set_value1( 20 )->build( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value1 check 2' act = ls_result2-value1 exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value2 check 2' act = ls_result2-value2 exp = 'World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was zu einem sehr flüssigen und lesbaren Code führt, ähnlich einem "Builder"-Muster. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: METHOD, Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent API, Builder Pattern

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine funktionale Methode, die `FOR`- und `COND`-Ausdrücke verwendet, um Daten zu verarbeiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `RETURN VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ) ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_processing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_processing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    rt_processed_numbers = VALUE #( 
      FOR num IN it_numbers
      ( COND #( WHEN num MOD 2 = 0 THEN num * num " Square even numbers
                 ELSE num * num * num " Cube odd numbers
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_processing( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 4 ) ( 27 ) ( 16 ) ( 125 ) ). " 1^3, 2^2, 3^3, 4^2, 5^3

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_numbers( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Processed numbers match' act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

    DATA(lt_empty_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_result) = lo_cut->process_numbers( lt_empty_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Empty input should return empty output' act = lt_empty_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR`-Iteratoren und `COND`-Ausdrücken innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktors ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Datenverarbeitung. Anstatt explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen zu verwenden, können Transformationen und bedingte Logik direkt in einem Ausdruck formuliert werden, was den Code kürzer und oft verständlicher macht.
keywords: METHOD, FOR, COND, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente eines Eintrags in einer Hashed Table zu, indem Sie `FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_id       TYPE i
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        it_data     TYPE ty_hashed_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA ls_entry TYPE ty_data.

    READ TABLE it_data WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_id INTO ls_entry.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_entry TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_dynamic=>ty_hashed_table(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = 'Value A' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = 'Value B' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( iv_id = 1 iv_field_name = 'NAME' it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic access to NAME' act = lv_name exp = 'Item A' ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( iv_id = 2 iv_field_name = 'VALUE' it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic access to VALUE' act = lv_value exp = 'Value B' ).

    DATA(lv_non_existent_field) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( iv_id = 1 iv_field_name = 'DESCRIPTION' it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Access to non-existent field' act = lv_non_existent_field ).

    DATA(lv_non_existent_id) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( iv_id = 3 iv_field_name = 'NAME' it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Access to non-existent ID' act = lv_non_existent_id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur oder Tabellenzeile mittels `FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Programmieraufgaben. Es ermöglicht, Feldnamen zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen, was in Szenarien wie der Verarbeitung von Konfigurationsdaten oder der Implementierung generischer Schnittstellen nützlich ist.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FIELD-SYMBOL, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung in einer Methode unter Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` und benutzerdefinierten Ausnahmen.
hint: Definieren Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme-Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input EXPORTING textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Division success' act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception zcx_invalid_input not raised' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Exception zcx_invalid_input caught' act = abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne ABAP-Fehlerbehandlung basiert auf Ausnahmen (`Exceptions`). Durch die Definition eigener Ausnahme-Klassen, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erben, können spezifische Fehlerzustände klar kommuniziert und behandelt werden. `RAISE EXCEPTION` wird verwendet, um einen Fehler zu signalisieren, während `TRY...CATCH` die strukturierte Behandlung dieser Fehler ermöglicht.
keywords: METHOD, Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, RAISE EXCEPTION, Custom Exception

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die Existenz einer Zeile in einer Hashed Table und ermitteln Sie deren Index.
hint: Nutzen Sie `IF line_exists(...)` und `DATA(lv_index) = line_index(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flights_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
        it_flights    TYPE ty_flights_hashed_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
        it_flights    TYPE ty_flights_hashed_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i. " Returns 0 if not found, otherwise index
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN line_exists( it_flights[ KEY carrid connid fldate = is_flight_key-carrid is_flight_key-connid is_flight_key-fldate ] )
                        THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_index.
    rv_index = line_index( it_flights[ KEY carrid connid fldate = is_flight_key-carrid is_flight_key-connid is_flight_key-fldate ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_exists_and_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists_and_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_line_ops( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_line_ops=>ty_flights_hashed_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.00' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_key_exists) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_line_ops=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ).
    DATA(ls_key_not_exists) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_line_ops=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' ).

    " Test line_exists
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Existing flight should exist' act = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( ls_key_exists lt_test_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Non-existing flight should not exist' act = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( ls_key_not_exists lt_test_flights ) ).

    " Test line_index
    DATA(lv_index) = lo_cut->get_flight_index( ls_key_exists lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Index of existing flight' act = lv_index exp = 1 ). " Hashed tables are 1-indexed for LINE_INDEX

    DATA(lv_index_not_found) = lo_cut->get_flight_index( ls_key_not_exists lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Index of non-existing flight' act = lv_index_not_found exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Ausdrücke `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` bieten eine moderne und performante Möglichkeit, die Existenz von Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu prüfen und deren Index zu ermitteln. Insbesondere bei Hashed Tables nutzen sie den schnellen Schlüsselzugriff, was zu effizientem Code führt. Die Verwendung in Kombination mit dem `COND`-Operator macht den Code sehr kompakt.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die verschiedenen Arten der Parameterübergabe an eine Methode: `IMPORTING VALUE`, `IMPORTING` (by reference), `CHANGING`.
hint: `IMPORTING VALUE(iv_param)`, `IMPORTING iv_param TYPE ...`, `CHANGING cv_param TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_parameter_passing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_parameters
      IMPORTING
        VALUE(iv_value_param) TYPE i " Passed by value
        ir_ref_param          TYPE REF TO i " Passed by reference (explicit)
        iv_implicit_ref_param TYPE i " Passed by reference (implicit, default for IMPORTING)
      CHANGING
        cv_changing_param     TYPE i. " Passed by reference, can be changed

    METHODS get_initial_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_parameter_passing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_parameters.
    " iv_value_param is a copy, changes here do not affect caller's variable
    " ir_ref_param points to caller's variable, changes to dereferenced value affect caller
    " iv_implicit_ref_param points to caller's variable, changes here affect caller
    " cv_changing_param points to caller's variable, changes here affect caller

    " Change local copy of value parameter (no effect outside)
    DATA(lv_local_value) = iv_value_param.
    lv_local_value = lv_local_value + 100.

    " Change value via explicit reference parameter
    ir_ref_param->* = ir_ref_param->* + 200.

    " Change value via implicit reference parameter (IMPORTING default)
    " Note: Changing an IMPORTING parameter is generally bad practice and can lead to unexpected behavior.
    " It's shown here for demonstration of pass-by-reference, but should be avoided.
    " The compiler might warn or prevent this in strict modes.
    " For this example, we'll just read it.
    " iv_implicit_ref_param = iv_implicit_ref_param + 300. " This would change the caller's variable

    " Change value via changing parameter
    cv_changing_param = cv_changing_param + 400.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_initial_value.
    rv_value = 10.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parameter_passing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parameter_passing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_parameter_passing( ).
    DATA(lv_original_value) = lo_cut->get_initial_value( ). " 10

    DATA lv_value_param TYPE i VALUE 1.
    DATA lv_ref_param TYPE i VALUE 2.
    DATA lv_implicit_ref_param TYPE i VALUE 3.
    DATA lv_changing_param TYPE i VALUE 4.

    DATA lr_ref_param TYPE REF TO i.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_ref_param INTO lr_ref_param.

    lo_cut->demonstrate_parameters(
      EXPORTING
        iv_value_param          = lv_value_param
        ir_ref_param            = lr_ref_param
        iv_implicit_ref_param   = lv_implicit_ref_param
      CHANGING
        cv_changing_param       = lv_changing_param
    ).

    " iv_value_param (passed by value) should remain unchanged
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value param unchanged' act = lv_value_param exp = 1 ).

    " lv_ref_param (changed via explicit reference) should be updated
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Explicit ref param updated' act = lv_ref_param exp = 202 ). " 2 + 200

    " lv_implicit_ref_param (passed by implicit reference, but not changed in method)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Implicit ref param unchanged (not modified in method)' act = lv_implicit_ref_param exp = 3 ).

    " lv_changing_param (changed via changing parameter) should be updated
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Changing param updated' act = lv_changing_param exp = 404 ). " 4 + 400
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP bietet verschiedene Mechanismen zur Parameterübergabe an Methoden: `VALUE` (Übergabe einer Kopie), `REFERENCE` (explizite Referenzübergabe) und `CHANGING` (implizite Referenzübergabe mit der Absicht der Änderung). Das Verständnis dieser Unterschiede ist entscheidend für die korrekte Datenflusskontrolle und die Vermeidung unerwarteter Nebeneffekte in der objektorientierten Programmierung.
keywords: METHOD, Parameters, VALUE, REFERENCE, CHANGING, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table aus einer Standardtabelle unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( CORRESPONDING #( BASE ... ) ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_from_standard DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_std,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_std.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_standard_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_std WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_hashed,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_hashed.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_hashed WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS convert_to_hashed
      IMPORTING
        it_standard_table TYPE ty_sflight_standard_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashed_table) TYPE ty_sflight_hashed_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_from_standard IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_hashed.
    rt_hashed_table = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_entry IN it_standard_table
      ( CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( carrid = ls_entry-carrid connid = ls_entry-connid fldate = ls_entry-fldate ) ls_entry ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_from_standard( ).

    DATA(lt_standard_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_from_standard=>ty_sflight_standard_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_hashed_flights) = lo_cut->convert_to_hashed( lt_standard_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of entries in hashed table' act = lines( lt_hashed_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_flight_check) = lt_hashed_flights[ KEY carrid connid fldate = 'LH' '0400' '20251201' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price of LH 0400 20251201' act = ls_flight_check-price exp = '100.00' ).

    " Test for duplicate key (should not be added to hashed table if it was a direct insert, but here it's unique by definition)
    DATA(lt_standard_with_duplicate) = VALUE zcl_hashed_from_standard=>ty_sflight_standard_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '110.00' currency = 'EUR' ) " Duplicate key
    ).
    DATA(lt_hashed_from_duplicate) = lo_cut->convert_to_hashed( lt_standard_with_duplicate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Duplicate key should result in one entry' act = lines( lt_hashed_from_duplicate ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry should be kept for duplicate key' act = lt_hashed_from_duplicate[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE`, `FOR`-Iteratoren und `CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht eine elegante und effiziente Transformation von Daten zwischen verschiedenen Tabellentypen oder Strukturen. Hier wird eine Standardtabelle in eine Hashed Table umgewandelt, wobei `CORRESPONDING` die Feldzuordnung vereinfacht und `BASE` die Schlüsselbildung für die Hashed Table sicherstellt.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit dem `GROUP BY`-Ausdruck aggregiert und das Ergebnis in einer Hashed Table speichert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group_key)` und `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_hashed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_standard_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             number_of_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: ty_grouped_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_standard_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE ty_grouped_hashed_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_standard_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_hashed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        total_price = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT s = s + ls_flight-price )
        number_of_flights = lines( GROUP ls_group )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights_data.
    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_hashed( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflights_data( ).

    " Ensure sflight has data for testing
    IF lines( lt_all_flights ) = 0.
      " Insert dummy data if sflight is empty for test purposes
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING PADDING.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING PADDING.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING PADDING.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251201' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING PADDING.
      COMMIT WORK.
      lt_all_flights = lo_cut->get_sflights_data( ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Initial flights should not be empty' act = lines( lt_all_flights ) ).

    DATA(lt_grouped_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of grouped carriers' act = lines( lt_grouped_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_grouped_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH total price' act = ls_lh_group-total_price exp = '220.00' ). " 100 + 120
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH number of flights' act = ls_lh_group-number_of_flights exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_grouped_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA total price' act = ls_aa_group-total_price exp = '550.00' ). " 250 + 300
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA number of flights' act = ls_aa_group-number_of_flights exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY`-Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu traditionellen `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Schleifen und führt zu deutlich lesbarerem und wartbarerem Code, insbesondere wenn die Ergebnisse direkt in eine Hashed Table überführt werden sollen.
keywords: METHOD, HASHED TABLE, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Verketten Sie Strings dynamisch mit String Templates und Methoden.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates (`|...|`) und den `&&`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_city TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.

    METHODS format_list
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_templates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_greeting.
    IF iv_city IS SUPPLIED AND iv_city IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_greeting = |Hallo { iv_name } aus { iv_city }!|.
    ELSE.
      rv_greeting = |Hallo { iv_name }!|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_list.
    rv_formatted_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_item IN it_items
      NEXT s = COND #( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_item ELSE s && ', ' && ls_item )
    ).
    IF rv_formatted_list IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_formatted_list = |Liste: { rv_formatted_list }.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_greeting FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_greeting.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_templates( ).

    DATA(lv_greeting1) = lo_cut->create_greeting( iv_name = 'Max Mustermann' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Greeting without city' act = lv_greeting1 exp = 'Hallo Max Mustermann!' ).

    DATA(lv_greeting2) = lo_cut->create_greeting( iv_name = 'Erika Musterfrau' iv_city = 'Berlin' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Greeting with city' act = lv_greeting2 exp = 'Hallo Erika Musterfrau aus Berlin!' ).

    DATA(lv_greeting3) = lo_cut->create_greeting( iv_name = 'John Doe' iv_city = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Greeting with empty city' act = lv_greeting3 exp = 'Hallo John Doe!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_format_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_templates( ).

    DATA(lt_items1) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apfel' ) ( 'Birne' ) ( 'Kirsche' ) ).
    DATA(lv_list1) = lo_cut->format_list( lt_items1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted list 1' act = lv_list1 exp = 'Liste: Apfel, Birne, Kirsche.' ).

    DATA(lt_items2) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Einzelitem' ) ).
    DATA(lv_list2) = lo_cut->format_list( lt_items2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted list 2 (single item)' act = lv_list2 exp = 'Liste: Einzelitem.' ).

    DATA(lt_items3) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_list3) = lo_cut->format_list( lt_items3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Formatted list 3 (empty)' act = lv_list3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu verketten und zu formatieren. Sie ermöglichen die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken in Strings, was den Code wesentlich lesbarer und kürzer macht als die traditionelle `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` und `COND` können komplexe String-Manipulationen elegant gelöst werden.
keywords: METHOD, String Templates, String Processing, REDUCE, COND, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum und formatieren Sie es.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder `CL_ABAP_DATE_TIME_UTILITIES` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_time_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_formatted_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_weekday( iv_date ).
    CASE lv_weekday.
      WHEN 1. rv_weekday_name = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN 2. rv_weekday_name = 'Montag'.
      WHEN 3. rv_weekday_name = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN 4. rv_weekday_name = 'Mittwoch'.
      WHEN 5. rv_weekday_name = 'Donnerstag'.
      WHEN 6. rv_weekday_name = 'Freitag'.
      WHEN 7. rv_weekday_name = 'Samstag'.
      WHEN OTHERS. rv_weekday_name = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_formatted_date.
    DATA(lv_year) = iv_date(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date+4(2).
    DATA(lv_day) = iv_date+6(2).
    rv_formatted_date = |{ lv_day }-{ lv_month }-{ lv_year }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weekday_and_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekday_and_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_time_ops( ).

    " 20251206 is a Saturday
    DATA(lv_weekday_name) = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( '20251206' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Weekday for 20251206' act = lv_weekday_name exp = 'Samstag' ).

    " 20251201 is a Monday

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Weekday for 20251201' act = lv_weekday_name exp = 'Montag' ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_date) = lo_cut->get_formatted_date( '20251206' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted date for 20251206' act = lv_formatted_date exp = '06-12-2025' ).

    lv_formatted_date = lo_cut->get_formatted_date( '20240115' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Formatted date for 20240115' act = lv_formatted_date exp = '15-01-2024' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

In Kombination mit String Templates können Datumsangaben einfach und flexibel formatiert werden, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit einer einfachen Methode, die eine interne Tabelle verarbeitet, mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start` und `stop_and_get_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_measure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS measure_processing_time
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_measure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      " Simulate some processing
      rv_count = rv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_processing_time.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start( ).
    process_data( it_sflight = it_sflight ).
    rv_runtime_ms = lo_runtime->stop_and_get_runtime( ) / 1000. " Convert microseconds to milliseconds
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_measure_time FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_measure_time.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_perf_measure=>tt_sflight.
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
      <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
      <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_measure( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime) = lo_cut->measure_processing_time( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_runtime > 0 msg = 'Runtime should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_runtime` ist die moderne und präzise Methode zur Messung von Code-Ausführungszeiten in ABAP. Sie bietet eine objektorientierte Schnittstelle und liefert Ergebnisse in Mikrosekunden, was eine genaue Performance-Analyse ermöglicht. Der `LOOP` ist hier ein einfacher Schleifendurchlauf zur Simulation von Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: cl_abap_runtime, Performance, LOOP, Measurement

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Messen Sie die Performance dieser Gruppierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax und `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_sflight_agg.

    METHODS measure_grouping_time
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ASCENDING
         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
                      connid = <fs_group>-connid

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_runtime) = cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start( ).
    calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = iv_carrid it_sflight = it_sflight ).

CLASS zcl_string_perf_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_string_perf_comp IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_detail,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nested_data) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.

    METHODS measure_nested_for_time
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_flights.
    rt_nested_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflight
                               WHERE ( fldate = iv_fldate )
                               GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                               ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                 flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                    ( connid = ls_flight-connid
                                                      fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                                      price   = ls_flight-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_nested_for_time.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start( ).
    get_nested_flights( it_sflight = it_sflight iv_fldate = iv_fldate ).
    rv_runtime_ms = lo_runtime->stop_and_get_runtime( ) / 1000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_carrids) TYPE string.

    METHODS measure_concat_time
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carrids.
    rv_concatenated_carrids = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
      WHERE ( fldate > iv_min_fldate )
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN ls_sflight-carrid
        ELSE result && `, ` && ls_sflight-carrid
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_concat_time.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start( ).
    concatenate_carrids( it_sflight = it_sflight iv_min_fldate = iv_min_fldate ).
    rv_runtime_ms = lo_runtime->stop_and_get_runtime( ) / 1000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_line_exists_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_table) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

    METHODS read_table_performance
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        iv_search_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_search_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_search_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.

    METHODS line_exists_performance
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        iv_search_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_search_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_search_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_line_exists_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_table.
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = COND #( WHEN sy-index MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'LH' ELSE 'UA' )
                      connid = sy-index
                      fldate = sy-datum ) TO rt_table.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_table_performance.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start( ).
    DO 1000 TIMES. " Repeat search for better measurement
      READ TABLE it_table TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_search_carrid
                                                              connid = iv_search_connid
                                                              fldate = iv_search_fldate.
    ENDDO.
    rv_runtime_ms = lo_runtime->stop_and_get_runtime( ) / 1000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD line_exists_performance.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start( ).
    DO 1000 TIMES. " Repeat search for better measurement
      IF line_exists( it_table[ carrid = iv_search_carrid connid = iv_search_connid fldate = iv_search_fldate ] ).
        " Do nothing, just check existence
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_runtime_ms = lo_runtime->stop_and_get_runtime( ) / 1000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance des Füllens einer Standardtabelle mit `APPEND` in einer Schleife und des Füllens mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck. Messen Sie die Performance mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
hint: Führen Sie beide Füllmethoden in separaten Schleifen aus und messen Sie jede mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fill_table_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fill_with_append
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_table) TYPE tt_data.

    METHODS fill_with_for
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_table) TYPE tt_data.

    METHODS measure_append_time
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.

    METHODS measure_for_time
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_ms) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fill_table_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_with_append.
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( id = sy-index text = |Item { sy-index }| ) TO rt_table.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_with_for.
    rt_table = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                         ( id = i text = |Item { i }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_append_time.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start( ).
    fill_with_append( iv_count = iv_count ).
    rv_runtime_ms = lo_runtime->stop_and_get_runtime( ) / 1000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_for_time.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = cl_abap_runtime=>create_and_start( ).
    fill_with_for( iv_count = iv_count ).
    rv_runtime_ms = lo_runtime->stop_and_get_runtime( ) / 1000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fill_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fill_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fill_table_perf( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 10000.

    DATA(lv_append_time) = lo_cut->measure_append_time( lv_count ).
    DATA(lv_for_time) = lo_cut->measure_for_time( lv_count ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_append_time > 0 msg = 'APPEND runtime should be > 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_for_time > 0 msg = 'FOR runtime should be > 0' ).

    " FOR expressions are often more efficient for filling tables
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_for_time < lv_append_time * 1.2 msg = 'FOR expression should be faster or comparable' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Füllen interner Tabellen mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und oft performantere Alternative zum traditionellen `DO`-Loop mit `APPEND`. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ist deklarativer, kompakter und kann vom ABAP-Laufzeitsystem besser optimiert werden. Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie `cl_abap_runtime` verwendet wird, um die Performance-Vorteile dieser modernen Syntax zu quantifizieren und die Effizienz zu vergleichen.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data

        iv_field_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_flight_data.

    READ TABLE it_flight_data INDEX iv_index ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_field>.
      ELSE.
        rv_value = 'Field not found'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Row not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT` und füllen Sie diese mit zwei Beispieldatensätzen. Geben Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `ASSIGN` um die dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle zu referenzieren und zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_sflight_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_lines) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_sflight_table.
    DATA lr_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE sflight.

    " Dynamische Erzeugung einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT
    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Zeile 1 hinzufügen
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_line>-mandt = sy-mandt.
        <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'.
        <fs_line>-connid = '0400'.
        <fs_line>-fldate = '20250101'.
        <fs_line>-planetype = 'A320'.
      ENDIF.

      " Zeile 2 hinzufügen
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_line>-mandt = sy-mandt.
        <fs_line>-carrid = 'UA'.
        <fs_line>-connid = '0010'.
        <fs_line>-fldate = '20250102'.
        <fs_line>-planetype = 'B747'.
      ENDIF.

      rv_lines = lines( <fs_table> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine generische Datenreferenz. Versuchen Sie, diese sicher in einen spezifischen Strukturtyp (`SFLIGHT`) zu casten und den Wert einer Komponente zurückzugeben. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Cast fehlschlägt.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_casting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_carrid
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_casting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_carrid.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.

    " Versuch, die generische Datenreferenz in den Typ SFLIGHT zu casten
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_sflight> CASTING TYPE sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Cast erfolgreich, Zugriff auf die Komponente
      rv_carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid.
    ELSE.
      " Cast fehlgeschlagen
      rv_carrid = 'ERROR'.

ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_carriers.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflight.

    rt_flights = it_flights.

    LOOP AT rt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
        <fs_flight>-carrid = 'DL'. " Lufthansa wird zu Delta
      ELSEIF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'.
        <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. " United Airlines wird zu American Airlines
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_variable_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_generic_variable_access IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie einen Teilstring aus einem gegebenen String unter Verwendung von `ASSIGN` mit `OFFSET` und `LENGTH`. Geben Sie den extrahierten Teilstring zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... OFFSET ... LENGTH ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_substring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_substring_with_assign
      IMPORTING
        iv_full_string TYPE string
        iv_offset      TYPE i
        iv_length      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_substring) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_substring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_substring_with_assign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_substring> TYPE any.

    " Sicherstellen, dass Offset und Length gültig sind
    IF iv_offset < 0 OR iv_length < 0.
      rv_substring = 'Invalid offset or length'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamische Zuweisung eines Teilbereichs des Strings
    ASSIGN iv_full_string+iv_offset(iv_length) TO <fs_substring>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_substring = <fs_substring>.
    ELSE.
      rv_substring = 'Error extracting substring'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result_start) = lo_cut->get_substring_with_assign( iv_full_string = 'ABC' iv_offset = 0 iv_length = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_start exp = 'A' msg = 'Substring at start failed' ).

    DATA(lv_result_end) = lo_cut->get_substring_with_assign( iv_full_string = 'ABC' iv_offset = 2 iv_length = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_end exp = 'C' msg = 'Substring at end failed' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_overflow exp = 'BC' msg = 'Substring overflow failed' ).

    DATA(lv_result_neg_offset) = lo_cut->get_substring_with_assign( iv_full_string = 'ABC' iv_offset = -1 iv_length = 1 ).
