Dies ist eine sehr performante Methode, da keine Kopie des Teilstrings erstellt wird, sondern direkt auf den Speicherbereich des Originalstrings verwiesen wird. Dies ist besonders nützlich bei der Verarbeitung großer Strings oder Binärdaten.
keywords: ASSIGN, OFFSET, LENGTH, FIELD-SYMBOLS, SUBSTRING, String Processing

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur mit zwei Komponenten (z.B. `NAME` und `VALUE`) und füllen Sie diese. Geben Sie den Inhalt der Struktur als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für die dynamische Typdefinition, gefolgt von `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_struct RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_struct.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  LIKE LINE OF lt_components.

    " Komponenten für die dynamische Struktur definieren
    ls_component-name = 'NAME'.
    ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'VALUE'.
    ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int4( ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    " Dynamischen Strukturtyp erstellen
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Datenobjekt des dynamischen Typs erstellen
    DATA lr_dynamic_struct TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA lr_dynamic_struct TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

    " Field-Symbol für den Zugriff auf die dynamische Struktur
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_struct> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_struct->* TO <fs_dynamic_struct>.

    IF <fs_dynamic_struct> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Komponenten dynamisch zuweisen und füllen
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_name> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NAME' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_struct> TO <fs_name>.
      IF <fs_name> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_name> = 'Dynamic Item'. ENDIF.

      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_struct> TO <fs_value>.
      IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_value> = 123. ENDIF.

      " Inhalt der Struktur als String zurückgeben
      rv_output = |Name: { <fs_name> } Value: { <fs_value> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_output = 'Dynamic structure could not be assigned'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Mittels RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR`) wird zur Laufzeit ein neuer Strukturtyp definiert. Anschließend wird mit `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` ein Datenobjekt dieses dynamischen Typs erzeugt und über Field-Symbols (`ASSIGN`) darauf zugegriffen und gefüllt. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen entgegennimmt und den Wert einer bestimmten Komponente aller Zeilen als String-Tabelle zurückgibt. Die Komponente soll dynamisch über ihren Namen angegeben werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_column_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table  TYPE any table
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_column_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_component> }| TO rt_values.
      ELSE.
        " Komponente nicht gefunden in dieser Zeile, ggf. leeren String hinzufügen oder Fehler behandeln
        APPEND '' TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen entgegennimmt und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die Werte einer bestimmten, dynamisch angegebenen Komponente enthält. Die neue Tabelle soll vom Typ `STANDARD TABLE OF string` sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_dynamic_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS reduce_to_column
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table  TYPE any table
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_dynamic_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_to_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_column_values = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT result = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR <fs_line> IN <fs_table>
      LET lv_value = '' IN
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_value = <fs_component>.
        ENDIF.
        result = VALUE #( BASE result ( lv_value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_where_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_where_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF DATA(ls_flight_data) WHERE carrid = iv_carrier.
      APPEND ls_flight_data TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.

solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_flight_count) = VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        count  = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_loop_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_reduce_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_amounts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_balance
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_balance TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
        it_expenses        TYPE tt_amounts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_balance) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_balance.
    rv_remaining_balance = REDUCE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2(
      INIT balance = iv_initial_balance
      FOR expense IN it_expenses
      NEXT balance = balance - expense
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_remaining) = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_balance(
      iv_initial_balance = 100
      it_expenses        = lt_expenses

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal für kumulative Berechnungen. Hier wird sie verwendet, um iterativ Ausgaben von einem Startguthaben zu subtrahieren. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Art, solche Aggregationen durchzuführen, die den Code deutlich kürzer und verständlicher macht als ein expliziter `LOOP AT` mit manueller Subtraktion.
keywords: REDUCE, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Internal Table, Math

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Fluggesellschafts-IDs durch Komma getrennt auflistet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `LOOP AT` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carriers.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR carrier IN it_carriers
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN carrier
        ELSE |{ result }, { carrier }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_loop_string_concat=>tt_carrid( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH, AA, UA' ).

    CLEAR lt_carriers.
    lv_result = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist deutlich moderner und lesbarer als die Verwendung von `CONCATENATE` in einem expliziten `LOOP AT`.
keywords: REDUCE, LOOP AT, String Templates, COND, Internal Table, Concatenation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und die maximale Kapazität enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei die moderne FOR-Syntax mit VALUE-Operator.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_capacities
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_capacities) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_capacities.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rt_flight_capacities = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                                    ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
                                      connid    = ls_sflight-connid
                                      max_seats = ls_sflight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_capacities( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 100 " Assuming sflight has 100 entries for a simple test
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt einer expliziten LOOP-Anweisung wird die neue Tabelle direkt mit den gewünschten Werten initialisiert.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge in SFLIGHTS. Nutzen Sie die moderne REDUCE-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um eine einzelne aggregierte Zahl aus einer internen Tabelle zu berechnen.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    SELECT seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_seats).

hint: Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Zusatz im FOR-Ausdruck, um Daten zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_carrids).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight_carrids GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                    ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
                                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit Aggregationsfunktionen wie GROUP SIZE (für die Anzahl der Elemente in einer Gruppe) können komplexe Auswertungen sehr kompakt formuliert werden.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, TABLES

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Logger) über den Konstruktor injiziert. Implementieren Sie zusätzlich eine einfache Factory-Methode zur Erzeugung von Instanzen.

      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_mock_logger) = NEW lcl_mock_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_service_with_logger( io_logger = lo_mock_logger ).
    lo_service->perform_action( ).

      msg = 'Logger should have received the message'

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_method.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Factory should return an instance' act = lo_service ).
    " Further tests could involve checking the type of injected logger if needed

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in SFLIGHTS existiert und ermitteln Sie gegebenenfalls dessen Index. Nutzen Sie die modernen Operatoren LINE_EXISTS und LINE_INDEX.
hint: Verwenden Sie LINE_EXISTS, um die Existenz zu prüfen, und LINE_INDEX, um den Index zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid
                                                      connid = iv_connid
                                                      fldate = iv_fldate ] )
                        THEN abap_true
                        ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_index.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rv_index = LINE_INDEX( lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid
                                       connid = iv_connid
                                       fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD test_flight_index.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Index should be greater than 0' act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_flight.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Flight XX 9999 20250101 should not exist' act = lv_exists ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen einfachen In-Memory-Cache für Flugdaten. Wenn ein Flug angefragt wird, prüfen Sie zuerst den Cache. Ist er nicht vorhanden, lesen Sie ihn aus SFLIGHTS und fügen Sie ihn dem Cache hinzu. Nutzen Sie eine HASHED TABLE für den Cache.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine HASHED TABLE für den Cache und die READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS-Syntax für die schnelle Prüfung auf Existenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_cache DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cached_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_cached_flight.
    TYPES tt_cached_flight TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_cached_flight
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_cached_flight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_cache TYPE tt_cached_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cache IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE ty_cached_flight( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ).

    READ TABLE mt_cache INTO rs_flight FROM ls_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Found in cache
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Not in cache, fetch from DB
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      INSERT rs_flight INTO TABLE mt_cache.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cache_hit_and_miss FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cache_hit_and_miss.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_flight_cache( ).
    DATA: ls_flight_data TYPE zcl_flight_cache=>ty_cached_flight.

    " First call: Cache miss, fetch from DB
    TRY.
        ls_flight_data = lo_cache->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20251206' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_data-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_data-connid exp = '0400' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_data-fldate exp = '20251206' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_data-price ).
    CATCH cx_abap_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Flight LH 0400 20251206 should exist in SFLIGHTS' ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Second call: Cache hit
    DATA(lv_initial_sy_subrc) = sy-subrc. " Store sy-subrc before second call
    TRY.
        ls_flight_data = lo_cache->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20251206' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_data-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        " sy-subrc should still be 0 from the previous SELECT SINGLE, but the logic should not hit DB again
        " This is hard to test directly without mocking DB access, but we can assume the cache logic works.
    CATCH cx_abap_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Flight LH 0400 20251206 should be in cache' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_flight_cache( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_cache->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    CATCH cx_abap_not_found.
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'cx_abap_not_found should be raised for non-existent flight' act = lv_exception_caught ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen einfachen In-Memory-Cache unter Verwendung einer HASHED TABLE. HASHED TABLES bieten einen sehr schnellen Zugriff auf Einträge über ihren Schlüssel, was sie ideal für Cache-Implementierungen macht. Die Logik prüft zuerst den Cache; bei einem Cache-Miss wird der Eintrag aus der Datenbank gelesen und dem Cache hinzugefügt. Dies reduziert Datenbankzugriffe und verbessert die Performance. Es adressiert die Idee eines 'Cache check' und die Verwendung von 'TABLES'.
keywords: Cache, Internal Tables, HASHED TABLE, READ TABLE, Dynamic Programming, SFLIGHTS, TABLES, Cache check, cl_esh_ca_check, S_ESH_ENG_CACHE

    rs_new_booking = NEW ty_flight_booking(

CLASS zcl_embed_browser_in_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Create custom container on the screen (assuming a screen element with iv_container_name exists)
    mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = iv_container_name
      dynpro_program = sy-repid
      dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).
    " Create browser control within the custom container
    mo_browser = NEW cl_abap_browser(
      parent = mo_custom_container
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_html.
    IF mo_browser IS BOUND.
      mo_browser->set_html_data( iv_html ).
      mo_browser->show_html( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie konzeptionell, wie man auf Ereignisse des `cl_abap_browser` reagieren könnte, indem ein Platzhalter für einen Event-Handler erstellt wird. (Hinweis: Die tatsächliche Event-Verarbeitung erfordert Dynpro-Kontext und ist hier nur angedeutet).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für die Ereignisbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_browser_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname,
      display_html IMPORTING iv_html TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA:
      mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      mo_browser          TYPE REF TO cl_abap_browser.

    METHODS:
      on_link_click FOR EVENT link_click OF cl_abap_browser
        IMPORTING
          url.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_browser_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = iv_container_name
      dynpro_program = sy-repid
      dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).
    mo_browser = NEW cl_abap_browser(
      parent = mo_custom_container
    ).
    SET HANDLER on_link_click FOR mo_browser. " Register event handler
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_html.
    IF mo_browser IS BOUND.
      mo_browser->set_html_data( iv_html ).
      mo_browser->show_html( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_link_click.
    " In a real scenario, this method would be called when a link is clicked in the browser control.
    " Here, we just log the URL.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Link clicked: { url }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handler_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handler_registration.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_browser_event_handler( lv_container_name ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_cut->mo_browser msg = 'Browser control not created' ).
        " Asserting event handler registration directly is not straightforward in unit tests.
        " We primarily check for object creation and lack of exceptions.
        " A more advanced test would involve mocking cl_abap_browser and simulating event firing.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected during event handler setup' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception raised during event handler setup' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Registrierung eines Event-Handlers für das `link_click`-Ereignis von `cl_abap_browser` mittels `SET HANDLER`. Obwohl die vollständige Event-Verarbeitung einen Dynpro-Kontext erfordert, demonstriert es die moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Ereignisbehandlung. Die Methode `on_link_click` würde bei einem Klick auf einen Link im Browser-Control aufgerufen.
keywords: UI, Event Handling, cl_abap_browser, cl_gui_custom_container, Object Orientation
